tei:div.tei:p: hā:bye ni gu/ 1 bca 'ab 3777ne bya 8330lung0606ba 'ang 5055'bya 17 bci kho migaXng khukhu po khor

gle nga garngo/ byeraX she/waX/ sru/lha(waX/wa ste /tho /rto she/ wa/rdo/(/༷༷ nyisaX'i tho///rdo'i la 5sgyu 〉sdurnyi /de 54 rdoXtsho sa rdo5 〉ga wa tshogang ri shu su moshā 43༷ go 4pa~X/ rna/ / ge/sa|7 ri ga sheX/rdor /wa na/ (6rte ༷ ༷ na ri nya r+sā ṣe rmyu //sgro ji sno77) skresho waX / ridi/spra/77/ byeX///| sa gi ri/rdo54 spyoX/sta rgya| snyiX//ri bye jig — —

ḍi/ ༷ ci / rdo ci gyi la//rte / mi ri / cing ri rnyi 〉〉slo ༵ 4snyi gyi smye 〉snyi ga sdu rto ཿ (tho ༵ yam̐ cho — bye //tsā 〉 〈 / kyi 4rdo ༷༷༷ sku 9 tsho ༷/1 — — rdo sdi ༷ shā sho shis ḍi /byeswā dzo/sho ༷ sdi 87〈 //rdo s+ho
rdzongs — —— —— — —tsa rdosde / shong nge ༷ ༷ / sna 〉༄ sdu la rte

dpe skrun gsal bshad/ri dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod snri tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib la jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/ rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib la jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib la jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur 〉〉 dang 〈bstan 'gyur 〉 dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1 28yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad las brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mdzad pa ta cang rgya chen po gnang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/1

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang / bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈gangs can khyad nor 〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub 'bras thog ma yin zhing / mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i rmang gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang / glog klad du 'jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing / sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar zlos gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/ lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang / gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/ rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/ chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/ snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i dpyad gzhi'i nor sgrom zhig red/ 'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las ga'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par du bton mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'byug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes 'gog gi dgongs 'char thad gar stsol gnang mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhin— legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhung sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu kho//krung ge'i bod rig pa dpe rgyun khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla 8par/2

gleng gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i spyi gtsug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha sprel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyis nas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyon kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khab khag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mdzad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul khams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang ngal ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgyal lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes smras kyang lud du mi che/ de lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad noX te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshis/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de gzhan la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag tsam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag 2

tsam btang ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang / deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang / dgon sde dang / spyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/ de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhus te/ rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang / mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing / lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du mas nga tsho'i las gar gdeng 'jog tshad med dang / ma nor lam ston/ ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtshon/ nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang / snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang / zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang / slob grwa khag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/ lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang / nga tsho'i las gar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o/ /ser ba khug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshos bas phyogs ga khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla ba 6pa'i tshes 7la/

bsdo/sgrig gsal sand/7gong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang/ yang sgos mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa ste/ dam pa gang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shing du brkos yod rung / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang btsal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/ snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tshogs pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/ phyogs bsgrigs dang dpe skrun zhu 'dun yod kyang / ma dpe btsal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim 'gyangs su lus 'dug par brten/'di ga ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas spyi lo 2005nas bzung snga phyir 'bras spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang sogs rig dngos tshan pa khag dang /de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin 'brel yod khrag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum pod stong phrag brgal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang / gzhan yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe deb nyis brgyar nye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i khongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nyer lnga dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 171nas 198bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa

po'i spyan lam du phul ba yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi ni pho brang po tā lar bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum rmang gzhir bzung thog yi ge mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas can rnams se ra theg chen gling gi rgyal ba'i gzims chung bde ba can du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum dang / lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa' gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma/ de bzhin dwags po mnga' ris grwa tshang gi gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma sogs ma dpe khag bzhi tsam la 'i kha bsdur zhus pa yin/glegs bam dang chos tshan gyi go rim ni/ deb yinas 4bar pod rtags (ka) 9) rtoganakhong ) ste rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun pod bzhi dang / deb ldanas 7bar pod rtags 6༄ 6) (ja) ste thun mong phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam pod gsum/ deb 8nas 10bar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum ste pod rtags la (ja spu (ja3) (ja4)bkod yod/ deb 11pa la pod rtags 6) storgyal dbang sku 'phreng gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ mgon po bsod nams mag ldan/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ byang pa rig 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar bcas chos tshan bdun/ deb 12pa la pod rtags 6)ste zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ nyang ston khra tshang pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar bcas chos tshan lnga/ deb 13pa la pod rtags 6)ste bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta sogs chos wo drug cu re gsum/ deb 14pa la pod rtags 9)ste dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs mchod 'bul bskang bshags bstod tshogs sogs chos tshan bcu bdun/ deb 15pa la pod rtags 6)ste lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs chos tshan bcu/ deb 16pa la pod rtags (pa)ste phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs/ deb 17pa la pod rtags (pha)sde 'dul ba'i 5

las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog dang / chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 18pa la pod rtags (ba)ste bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs chos tshan bcu gcig deb 19nas 21bar pod rtags (5) smyon (mo/ste sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang pod gsum/ deb 22pa la pod rtags (dza/ste rgyal rabs deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs chos tshan bzhi/ deb 23pa la pod rtags (wa)ste snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 24pa la pod rtags (zha)ste smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi chigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis/deb 25pa gsung nang ma (ka)ste bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung gad rgyangs sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 26pa gsung nang ma (ba)ste tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig sogs chos tshan zhe gsum/ deb 27pa gsung nang ma rtog)ste rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 28pa gsung nang ma 6)sde le'u bdun pa'i brgyud 'debs sogs chos tshan nga lnga bcas te pho brang po tā la'i gsung 'bum dkar chag gi go rim ltar bsgrigs pa yin/dmigs bsal zhu bya zhig la khong gi gsung las gsang ba rgya can bris ma pod gnyis bzhugs pa ha cang bka' gnyan pa dang / gsang ba khyab bsgrags mi rung ba'i bka' srol ltar 'dir yang par skrun zhus med pa thugs nges zhu rgyu ma zad/ ma dpe'i nang du mchod brjod sogs kyi skabs su lañdza mang tsam byung yang da lta glog klad du lañdza 'a yi ge med pas 'jog thub med pa bcas kyang thugs la nges par 'tshal zhu /lhag par du rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad phyin ma phyir dpe sdur ba dang / 'tshol bde ba'i ched ma dpe'i shog grangs dang nyin srib kyi bsdus rtags (2na) (2ba ) 'di'i nang bkod yod/6

zhu dag byed skabs/ thog ma'i zhu dag dang / bskyar zhus/ yang zhus/ zhus chen bcas zhu dag gi rim pa bzhi lhag brgyud cing / tshig phrad dang / lhag bcas/ rgyan sdud gsum gyi phrad dang yig nor mngon gsal can re zung dag bcos byas pa phud/ skabs de'i yi ge'i 'bri srol/ deng skabs dang mi 'dra ba dper na/'bri la 'dri dang / tsong kha pa la btsong kha pa/ mtshams la 'tshams/ mthun la 'thun/mtsho la 'tsho/ med la smad/ byung la 'byung / rang rkya la rang skya/ grwa la pra klong la slong / rig 'dzin la rigs 'dzin/ rig gnas la rigs gnas/ rigs pa la rig pa/ gcod la spyod/ rdzong brda la rdzong sta/ rdzong bda' sogs kyang ma dpe sor bzhag byas yod/spyir na tshig don gnyis thad nas zhus dag pher nges su rloms kyang / nged rnams rtsom sgrig gi bya bar las dang po ba yin pa dang / shes rig nor gyis dbul bas phyogs gang thad nas mi ldeng ba'i cha sogs skyon dang nor 'khrul mi nyung ba zhig 'byung nges pas rgya che'i mkhyen ldan rnam pas thad gar ram/yig thog zhal par bcas gang rung gi thog nas nyes 'gog legs spel gyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rogs zhes dran skul zhu rgyu ma zad/ lhag par nged tsho'i las don thad lhag bsam rnam dag gis rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i rig dngos do dam khang gis gtsos tshan pa khag dang / mi sger bcas nas gang ci'i thad slob ston dang mthun rkyen gyi rgyab skyor tshad med gnang bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes lan brgyar zhu'o/ /ser ra khog nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas/bod sa glang lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes 15la/

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me tog ces byar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang bka' gdams glegs bam/ rat+na'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sde lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mtshan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mtshan sngags smyon zil gnon ba 'ad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hor gyi ban+de zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi pa sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'khrungs pa'i rgyud za hor gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sprul te spyi lo 1617lor lho kha 'phyongs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku 'khrungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lhag par gsal zhing byis pa phal pa'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad zhabs drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu zhe'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mdzad pa dang / chos skyong khag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' 'khrol bzhin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes mtshan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bzhin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsis dang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang rnying pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khag der spel ba gnang / dgung lo so gsum pa la gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo so drug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhus ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 9

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/ g.yin yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsang 'debs mdzad pa dang / dgon sde khag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhedas/ chos gzhis mchod rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang / de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/ 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa spyi dang / lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/ gzhung chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor la jug pa'i gru rdzings dang / mdzod la chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung / de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chag zhal gdams/ snyan mgur/ snyan dar zhal yig chab shog brtan bzhugs/ lam yigabasko 'ja'/ grwa tshang 'don cha/ dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/ bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod gnyis bcas/ legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam gzhan mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu'o/ /ser ra khri rga nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyog sgrig khang nas//()

dkar chagabla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug bsgrub pa'i shing rta/ (1)bka' gdams rin po che thig le bcu drug gi rgyun khyer dbang khrid kyi legs bshad phul byung dgongs rgyan/ (19)dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyun 'byer gyi rnal 'byor reg zig bklags chog tu bkod pa/ (43)dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rab dkar bdud rtsi'i bum bzang (71)'jam dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i zhal lung / (79)'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ 5/00)dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil lha lnga'i sgrub thabs lo paṇa zhal lung / (155)dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 0〈cog (177)na ro mkha' spyod rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi lag len la sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang sems 'dzin zung 'brel du gtong tshul mthong grol lde mig (233)lam zab nang ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor mtho ris dbang gi chu bo/ (241)1

lam zab phyi ma'i nyams len gnad sgril 'jug bde/ (247)gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras dang bcas pa'i 'khrid kyi zin bris bstan pa rgyas byed ces bya ba bum dbang gi rmi lam man gyi zin bris kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bzhed pa ma nor ba/ (254)lam zab 'pho ba'i man ngag mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i them skas/ (275)nye brgyud tshe khrid 'chi med rdo rje'i srog shing khrigs su bsdebs pa/ (283)rnam rgyal 'joms sogs la dgos pa'i gso sbyong gi cho ga (290)dze twa lugs kyi rje btsun rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs 'chi med dpal ster/ (296)rdo rje mi 'brug pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ngan song tsha gdung kun sel ga bur gsar pa'i chu dzo/na/ (306)rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i lha tshogs rnams kyi sgrub 'phrin bsnyen pa rjes gnang sogs kyi nyams len mchog thun dngos grub 'dod dgu'i snye ma g.yur za zhes bya ba/ (326)rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi las byang dbang chen dgyes pa'i rol gar/ (342)spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs srid zhi'i gdung sel/ (346)'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs shes rab snang ba rgyas byed/ (352)spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas/ (373)ma ṇi ril bsgrub nyung ngu rnam gsal/ (415)'jam dpal drag po'i nyams len rgyun khyer be+eḍūr bzhun ma'i chu rgyun/ (424)rta mgrin shā na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ (426)
zungs 'bu 9 sa lhun grub

bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug bsgrub pa'i shing rta/ (thanar༅༅/ /bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug bsgrub pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs the rgo/ /༄༅/ /swa rdzi pra dza bh+yas hā dwa dzo ya skyo/ legs byas rin chen bye ba'i gter gyur ye shes dbu ba'i do shal can/ /sku gsum go 'phang rlabs phreng stsol la nam yang yol ba med pa yi/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid gcig pu rdo rje slob dpon zhabs pad zung / /gtsug gi rgyan du 'bral med bsten no dngos grub ma lus char ltar phob/ /blo gros yangs pa'i dga' tshal gsar pa las/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon/ /grags snyan lo gos dud pa'i rkang 'thung dbang / /bslu med 'dren pa khyod ni gtan gyi skyabs/ /rgyal kun yab gcig zur phud lnga pa gang / /bshes gnyen dam par bstan la nges rnyed phyir/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyang gang gi skur tshang bas/ khyod nyid mchod pa dngos grub kun gyi gzhi/ /'on kyang sngon rabs dam pa'i gsung sgros dag khung zad rgyas bsdus tsam gyis bsgyur ba la/ /sbyar byang bkod min sngon med legs bshad kyi/ /rjod byed tshig gi snyan 'gyur ldan pa'i steng / /don bzang rgyud sde'i dgongs pa ma 'phyugs par/ /rdo rje'i slob dpon tshul bzhin dgyes bskyed pa'i/ /zung 'jug bsgrub pa'i (2na thang rta chen po 'di/ kho bos legs bshad do rar 'dren no kye/ /bsod nams zhing gi mchog gyur pa/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma mchod 'dod pa'i/ /blo dang rnam dpyod brtson pa can/ /bzang po'i skal ba ldan rnams kyis/ /thog mar gnas khang chag chag gdab/ /dkon mchog spyi yi rten rnams dang / khyad par lam rim brgyud pa sogs/ /zhwa ser cod pan 'dzin rnams kyi/ /dbang khrid rgyab rten lung man ngag /mdo rgyud bshad srol stsol mdzad pa'i/ /bla brgyud brisa'abur rab gnas can/ /bkod pas khyad par mdzes pa bstar/ /mdun du chu bzhi nyer spyod lnga/ /bkra — —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()shis rtags rdzas rin chen bdun//bza' dang bca' ba btung ba'i tshogs//bltams byed rin chen mdzes pa'i snod//maṇ+ḍal sna tshogs rol mo dang //gzhan yang steng 'og phyogs mdzes pa'i/phan gdugs rgyal mtshan bla bre sogs//ci 'byor 'bad pa chen pos bsham//sla chos ser snas nyer bcings pa'i//༅ ngon mchod pa'i than sprin la//dngos grub char chen 'bebs 'dod pa'i//gsol 'debs dgun gyi 'brug sgra bzhin//de phyir rang nyid legs2ba 'dod rnams//bcam bu g.yo sgyu'i zol spangs nas//bsod nams tshogs chen gru gzings las//don gnyis nor bu'i gling du bgrod//thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang //tshad med bzhi bsgom sngon btang nas//phyi nang gsang mchod bla med bzhin//byin brlabs dngos gzhi 'di ltar ro//rmad byung 'khor 'das brtan g.yo'i chos ma lus//kun rdzob sems kyi 'byul ngor btags tsam las//gdod nas rang bzhin dag pa dbu ma'i lam//snang stong zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i ngang //mdun gyi mkha' dbyings sra khregs rdo rje'i gur//bdud dpung sreg pa'i ye shes me dpung nang //phun tsho gos rin chen lnga las legs grub pa'i//yid 'phrog lta na sdug rnga/'i gzhal med khang //phyi nang ma lus kun bzang mchod pa'i tshogs//dbyar gyi char sprin lta bur 'khrigs pa'i dbus//gnyis 'thung gdong lnga'i dbang po rta mchog dang //rma bya nam mkha' lding gis legs steg pa'i//grangs med rin chen las grub khri steng du//'ja' tshon ltar bkra dar zab brtsegs pa'i stan//sna tsho gos pad ma rgyas pa'i ze'u 'bru'i rtser//thabs shes nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor lte bar ni//skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog r+sām pa chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa//sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs 'od can//phyag gnyis thugs gar chos 'chad phyag rgya yis//'jam gnyen ut+pal nas 'dzin pa//snyan gyi thad gar 'dab ma rgyas pa'i steng /shes rab ral gri glegs bam rnam par mdzes//ldan tshe skabs gnyis mi phyed rdo rje'i skyil krung can//mthong bas rnam grol mtshan dpe ldan pa'i sku//thos pas srid zhi'i 'jigs skyob tshangs pa'i gsung //dran pas bde chen la sbyor kun mkhyen thugs/khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po bla ma yis//gnas gsum oṃ dkar

bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug bsgrub pa'i shing rta/ (thada.āḥ dmar hūṃ mthing kha/ /me long dngas pa'i gzugs brnyan ltar shar pa'i/ /hūṃ las 'od los zab mo lta ba dang / /rgya chen spyod pa nyams len byin rlabs brgyud/ /mdor na mdo sngags chos tshul kun ston pa'i/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma sogs/ /skyabs gnas ma lus badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mkha' khyab don dam dag pa chos kyi dbyings/ /sna tsho gos sprul pa'i dbang po gzhu ris can/ /brjod bral sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar mkhan ma/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gnas 'dir gshegs/ /gsang gsum shel dkar dri bral me long la/ /mchog gsum dam pa'i snang bas kun 'char bas/ dngos grub gzigs mor mtshar ba'i byed po mchog /kun 'dus rdo rje slob dpon 'dir gshegs shig /mi phyed dad pa'i shing rta chen po yis/ /ye shes 'khor lo'i lha tshogs yid bzhin nor/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams rgyal mtshan rtser 'god phyir/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren thogs med da tshur byon/ oṃ lha ri la su gu ru burnya bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wa ra dzaḥlha baṃ sngomatho brtsegs khrom tshogs nor bu lugs/ /rang rang mos pa dang sbyar nas/ yul der bsod nams tsho gos gsog pa'i/ /yan lag bdun las thog ma'i phyag /grangs med dkyil 'khor (3ba)bye ba'i gling bzhi la/ khyab bdag rigs kyi gser sbyangs 'khor lo yis/ /dam pa'i chos kyi srid la dbang sgyur ba'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam par phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshan bzang bcu drug cha shas yongs rdzogasapas/ /mthong na mi mthun med pa'i bshes gnyen gzugs/ /'gro kun thar par 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan du/ /mes pos sprul zhes 'gro la ngom pa 'dra/ /ji lta ji snyed shes bya'i gnas lugs kyi/ /rtse dga' khong nas rgod pa'i mkhyen pa'i spyan/ dkyusang gsung rab rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i rdzas/ /thams cad gzigs pa'i dbang por lhun gyis grub/ /byams ldan mchu sgros ut+pal dmar po'i 'dab/ /'gro la rjes su chags pa'i 'dzum rlabs kyis/ /phan bde'i mgron rnams ring nas 'gugs pa la/ /lung rtogs chos kyi sgo 'phar phye ba bzhin/ srid pa brgal dka'i chu mtshor bying pa'i 'gro/ /skad cig rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa chen por/ /grangs ring bgrod dkar smra ba'i dngul chu'i thigs/ /rigs pa'i sor mos —3—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)bcad tshe 'jig snyam byed/ /dri med sdom gsum lus stobs rab tu rgyas/ /rlabs chen spyod pa'i gser sbyang dra bas mdzes/ /smin grol mtshon cha'i 'khor los bdud sde'i g.yul/ /pham mdzad bshes gnyen sa srung dbang po che/ /'khor 'das chos kyi legs pa'i lam yangs por/ /'bad med bde bar 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan mchog /dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /rtse gcig dang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /mar pa'i nang 'a maṇ+ḍal ni/ phun tshogs khod snyoms lta na sdug pa'i zhing / /phun tshogs rin chen las grub dbyig 'dzin steng / /(4na than tshogs shel dkar dbang sngon pad rā ga dang / /phun tshogs gser sbyangs las grub ri rab rtser/ 'chi med bdag po'i khang bzang nyams dga' ba/ /srid pa'i 'byor ba ma lus bsdus pa bzhin/ /bang rim bzhi'i steng legs bris grong khyer ni/ /bkod pa rgya mtsho'i dge mtshan tshar du dngar/ /dge bcu'i yon tan tshang ba yul gyi ljongs/ /phyogs mtshams 'gyur med gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ /gser ri bdun sogs grangs med sa 'dzin rnams/ /byed pos ma bskrun spel legs phreng bar bsgrigs/ /rol mtsho bdun dang chu gter chen po yi/ /'dzum rlabs dga' ston bsu ba'i cho ga mkhan/ /rgyal srid sna bdun bum bzang 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /dpag bsam shing dang nyi ma zla ba zung / /lha mi'i dpal 'byor longs spyod phun tshogs rnams/ /skyabs gnasakun 'dus drug pa rdo rje 'chang / /bshes gnyen gzugs su rnam rol dngos brgyud kyi/ dpal ldan bla ma rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ /mar pa'i nang wo chu swo ni/ gnam sngon bzhun mar 'khyil 'dra'i dal 'gro'i rgyun/ /mu tig ltar dkar dbu ba'i 'dzum phreng can/ /dri bzang ngad ldan yol med rlabs phreng g.yo/ /rin chen snod du gtams pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /rgyal ba kun dngos dpal ldan bla ma la/ /dngos bshams yid gyis sprul nas legs 'bul gyi/ /brtse chen thugs rje chen pos rab bzhes te/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis bka' drin stsal du gsol/ /oṃ mu be+e smol su gu ru bu ji bo dhi sa twa sa pā ri wā ri a pra titsā ye swāhā/ zhabs bsil zhal bsil bsang gtor rnams/ /mchod yon gnas 'jug (4bsgo zhing dang / /pañtsa mā rna bro ka 'o/ /rigs dpyad nyer spyod rol mo ni/ /pad dkar ku mud u —4

bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug bsgrub pa'i shing rta/ (thadadum wa ra sogs/ /'ja' tshon ltar bkra chu skyes sna tshogs pa/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /a tshab tu puṅge te/ /e rdo dka'i bar kun sbyor/ /dri zhim ngad kyis phyogs bral 'khor lo kun/ /rab 'gengs bdug spos chu 'dzin ltar 'khrigs pa/ /lhag ma'i tshig rkang nyis 'dab 'di/ /'og ma kun la shes par bya/ dhū pe /rmongs pa'i mun tshogs sel ba rdung ba'i gter/ /nyi zla nor bu'i 'od ldan sgron me'i tshogs/ /mo〉ā lo ke /sna tsho gos sman gyi bcud ldan bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /rba rlabs chal chil g.yo ba'i dri chab 'di/ /mos garnye/ ro brgya'i zas kyi bcud kun ma lus pa/ /gcig tu bsdus pa'i bsgos bzang dam pa 'di/ /skor ni 4khya/ sil snyan ga rnga pi wang gling bu sogs/ /snyan tshig glu dbyangs rol mor bcas pa'i tshogs/ /〉〉shasta/'dod yon sna lngas mchod 'dod na/ /sked phra lus ldem 'dren byed yon por lta/ /rab mdzes gar sgyur gzugs kyi mchod pa'i tshogs/ /skorarā pa ka ma gun pā dze ti āḥ// ka ma gu na 'dod yon lnga'i//khyad chos yin gyis bu dze min/ /'di nas e rdo dka'i bar/ /kun gyi mjug la 'dogs par bya/ /grangs med tshig gi nyams ldan rgyud mang las/ /snyan 'gyur glur len sgra yi mchod pa'i tshogs/ /momoshasta/ sprul gyi snying po'i dpal la 'gran bzod pa'i/ /mngar ba'i ngad ldan dri yi mchod pa'i tshogs/ /〉〉sgru pe/ skabs gsum dbang pos longs su nyer spyod pa'i/ bdud rtsi'i spun zla ro yi mchod pa'i tshogs/ /(5na)mo mor sa/ /legs bris rnams kyi gos zung dar zab sogs/ /pad 'dab ltar 'jam reg bya'i mchod pa'i tshogs/ /skor spar+sha/ long yod rgyas par spro 'dod na/rig ma drug ye ngo po ni/ /mdzes sdug lha mo rdo rje pi waṃ mas/ /rgyud mang stong dang ldan pa'i sgra sgrog pa/ /〉〉lti ni/ /mdzes sdug lha mo rdo rje gling bu mas/ /phul byung rna ba'i bcud du 'bud pa'i sgra/ /mo'i lo she/ /mdzes sdug lha mo rdo rje dzornga mas/ /snyan brjid dbyug gus bsnun pa'i du:bi/ /mo〉mri ti ge /mdzes sdug lha mo rdo rje rnga zlum mas//dbyar gyi 'brug stong lta bur bskul ba'i sgra/ /〉〉mu ran dze/ /mdzes sdug lha mo rdo rje ba 'ad pa mas//kun dga' khong nas rgod pa'i 'dzum gyi rlabs/ /〉〉hā si ta/ /mdzes sdug lha mo rdo rje sgeg mo mas//—5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)yid 'phrog phra ldem lus kyi rnam 'gyur tshogs/ /skor lu phye/ /mdzes sdug lha mo rdo rje glu len mas/ /mgrin pa'i dril chung 'brol ba'i 'gyur khugs dbyangs/ /khor gi ti/ /mdzes sdug lha mo rdo rje gar mkhan mas/ /grangs med sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rnam rol dag /skor ni rti/ /mdzes sdug lha mo rdo rje me rtag mas/ /bsil ma'i chu skyes phreng mdzes bstar ba 'di/ /dzer pu lgi /mdzes sdug lha mo rdo rje bdug spos mas/ /char sprin ltar 'khrigs dri bsung 'thul pa 'di/ /mo mo sgru pe/ /mdzes sdug lha mo rdo rje mar me mas/ /nyi zla lta bu'i snang gsal spar ba 'di/ /mo mo ā lo ke/ /mdzes sdug lha mo rdo rje dri chab mas/ /bzang po'i sman mchog chu yi byug pa 'di/ /mo zag rnye/ /mdzes sdug lha mo gzugs kyi rdo rje mas/ /gzigs mor tshar du dngar ba'i snang brnyan tshogs/ /skora3 pa/ /(5ba〉dzes sdug lha mo ro yi rdo rje mas/ /bdud rtsi'i dpal ldan g.yos su byas pa'i zas/ /khoskor sa/ /mdzes sdug lha mo rdo rje reg bya mas/ /'jam gnyen lha rdzas gos su byas pa 'di/ /mo mo spar+sha/ /mdzes sdug lha mo chos dbyings rdo rje mas/ /chos khams las bskyed bla med bde chen 'di/ /khor dharma dh+wa tu/ /rin chen sna bdun gyis mchod pa/ /phun tshogs gling bzhi'i dpal la dbang byed pa'i/ /thogs med rtsibs stong gser gyi 'khor lo 'di/ /〉〉tsakra rat+na/ /phul byung 'dod pa'i re ba ma lus pa/ /skong byed nor bu dbang gi rgyal po 'di/ /skor ma ṇi rat+na/ /zag med bde ba'i mchod sbyin ster mkhas pa'i/ /mdzes sdug yid 'ong btsun mo dam pa 'di/ /skor rat+na/ /byams brtse'i stobs kyis dbyig 'dzin ma lus pa/ /bde bar skyong ba'i nus ldan blon po 'di/ /skor pu ru ṣa rat+na/ /ke la sha yi sa 'dzin dbang po la/ /rin chen rgyan gyis spras 'dra'i glang po 'di/ /mor hasti rat+na/ /rlung gi shugs 'chang stong gsum skad cig la/ /thogs med nyul ba'i cang shes rta mchog 'di/ /khor a shwa rat+na/ /rā ma ṇa ltar dpa' 'dzangs rtul phod pa'i/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dmag dpon 'di/ /za'i kha zhe rat+na/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad kyis mchod pa/ /dge tshogs nor bu'i yu bas rab bteg pa'i/ /nyon mongs tsha gdung sel ba'i gdugs dkar 'di/ /skor tsha tra maṅga la/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser sbyangs las grub —6

bla ma mar pa'i cho ga zung 'jug bsgrub pa'i shing rta/ 6)pa'i/ /phan bde'i nyal 'gro'i klung la brten pa'i nya/ /skor ma tā maṅga la/ /bkra shis ri mo g.yas su rab 'khyil ba'i/ /snyan pa phyogs bcur sgrog pa'i dung (6na skokar 'di/ /mo'i shi ṣa maṅga la/ /nyes pa'i 'dam gyi dri bral byang grol gyi/ /'dab ma rnam par rgyas pa'i pad ma dkar/ /〉〉pad+ma maṅga la/ /phun tshogs zad pa med pa'i 'dod dgu'i gter/ /rin chen las grub bum pa bzang po 'di/ /skoral sha maṅga la/ /mig gi gzigs mor mtshar ba'i ri mo mchog /yongs su smin pa'i dpal gyi be'u 'di/ /khor shrī pad+ma maṅga la/ /thar pa mchog gi khang bzang dam pa'i rtser/ /zung 'jug rgyal mtshan rnam par bsgreng ba 'di/ /mo moṅgā dza maṅga la/ /rdzogs ldan mgron du 'gugs byed su wa rje'i/ /ma smad 'khor lo rtsibs stong mu khyud can/ /mo mo tsakra maṅga la/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyis mchode pa/ /ji lta ji snyed chos kyi gzugs brnyan kun/ /ma 'dres gsal bar 'char ba'i me long 'di/ /mor ā dar sha maṅga la/ /dug gsum nyon mongs ma lus sel byed pa'i/ /snying po mchog gyur sman bzang ghi nya 'di/ /mo mo go ri tsa na maṅga la/ /zla ba bzhun ma snod du 'khyil 'dra ba'i/ /rab dkar bstod kyi snying por gyur pa'i zho/ /da dhi maṅga la/ /waṃ ba'i dngos po 'joms pa'i rdo rje'i srog /ring por sgrub pa'i rtsa mchog dur pa 'di/ /skor dur ba maṅga la/ /gsang sngags nye lam grub pa'i gos bu che/ /byang chub snying por 'gyur byed bil pa 'di/ /ra mo pha la bil pa maṅga la/ /snyan pa'i grags pa srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar/ /sgrog par byed pa'i chos dung g.yas 'khyil 'di/ /skor a dzi hā maṅga la/ /srid zhi'i brtan g.yo'i yon tan ma lus pa/ /dbang du bsdu bar byed pa'i li khri 'di/ /mo mo sin sgrur maṅga la/ /yid srubs sder bcas thal bar(6bcug byed pa'i/ /mi bzad rdo rje'i mtshon cha yungs skar 'di/ /moras rā ba maṅga la/ /mkho ba'i yo byad 'bul 'dod na/ mtho ris grong khyer sa la 'phos 'dra ba'i/ /dge bcu'i yon tan kun tshang yul gru 'di/ /〉〉de sha /rin chen las grub ba gam mtho ldan pa/ /ngo mtshar bkod mdzes khang bzang dam pa 'di/ /skor gri ha/ 'phan gdugs bla bre dar gyi yol ba can/ /gdong lnga'i dbang pos bteg pa'i 'gyur med gdan/ 〉〉ā sa na/ /cod pan phyag zhabs gdu bu snyan cha —7

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)dang / /mgul rgyan 'og pags la sogs rgyan gyi tshogs/ /o mo a laṅga ra/ /ngur smrig gos dang pañtsa li ka sogs/ /sna tsho gos na bza'i khyad par ji snyed pa/ /skor bsta/ /rnam rgyal gser mdog bzang drug tsan+dan sogs/ /sna tshogs sman gyi khyad par ji snyed pa/ /o ṣa dhi/ phun tshogs ljon pa'i shing lasagrub pa'i ja/ /ga bur dri ngad 'thul ba'i btung ba 'di/ /〉〉e sgo da ka /snying po sgrub pa'i mgo pa ni/mtha' bral 'khor ba kun gsal 'gram pa la/ /bde sdug glog gi gar mkhan lta bu'i 'od/ /ma rig sde bsangs mun pa stug po'i rum/ ngan song g.yang du gom pa 'phyan rig nas/ /rnam dag nges 'byung skya rengs kyis drangs pa'i/ /dri med tshul khrims nyin byed dbang po mchog /tshangs spyod dbang phyogs 'dzin ma'i rtser 'ongs pas/ /phan bde'i 'dab brgya skrun pa'i cho ga rdzogs/ gas phan don du 'gyur na ngan song gnas/ /mtho ris skyed tshal lta bur dga' bzhin du/ /'jug nus lhag pa'i bsam pasalegs drangs pa'i/ /rlabs chen rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod tshul can/ /sgra tshad bzo gso (7na)thun mong rig pa'i gnas/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sdebazhi la sogs/ /legs pa'i lam ston gzhung lugs rgya mtsho che/ /dri med kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa la/ /klog pa thos bsam snyan 'gyur glur len zhing //spong ba bsam gtan sbrang rtsis rab myos pa'i/ /nyam chung rkang drug bdag gi spyod tshul rnams/ /mchog gsum bla ma dgyes pa'i mchod par 'bul/stobs7snyo sgo nas sdig gags pa/ /sgo gsum lang tsho dar ba'i glang po che/ /thog med bsags pa'i nyon mongs chus myos pas/ /mtha' yas dge bcu'i pad dkar rab bcom nas/ /nag po'i las kyi sna zhags ring du rkyong / /bag med mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rnon po yis/ /rnam par dag pa'i tshul khrims srog rtsa bcad/ /rang bde 'dod pa'i mi gtsang 'dam btsog tu/ /gzhan phan byang chub sems kyi yan lag bying / /theg dman lam du gol ba'i nyi 'od kyis/ /nges gsang zab mo'i lus kun gdung bas mnar/ /mdor na gnas ༅ len gyi rgyu bsgrubs pa'i/ /nyes pa'i tshogs kun stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags/ /dgo༅ lis la yi rang ba/ rnam 'dren thabs mkhas mdzad pa'i sgyu ma yis/ srid zhi'i rgud pa'i —8

bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug bsgrub pa'i shing rta/ 6)sī ta rab phral nas/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i thang yangs por/ /'gro kun 'khrid pa'i shing rta legs 'dren cing / /don du 'gyur na gzhan phyir rang nyid kyi/ /phun tshogs bde ba'i dpal kun gtong ba la/ /zhus med snying stobs cho ga btsan po can/ /dpal ldan rgyal ba'i sras kyi mdzad bzang mchog /srid 'byor e raṇ+ḍa ltar ya ma rla'i/ /ngang (7ba〉nya shes nas gtan bde'i nags klung du/ /bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab rnon po yis/ /'khor ba 'byog po'i yal ga bcad pa sogs/ /theg gsum skye 'phags kun gyi rnam dkar las/ /rgya cher spel dang grangs med 'gro rnams kyi/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tsho gos rgya mtsho la/ /kun nas dga' ba'i sems kyis yi rang ngo / /chos 'bor skor zhesagasol 'dod na/ 'gro 'di'i mchog dman khams dang dbang po'i gzhir/ /sna mang theg pa'i dbyar skyes gzhen nu'i tshogs/ /thabs mkhas dpyid kyi pho nyas legs bskyangs pa'i/ /phan bde'i dus ston phun tshogs 'grub byed sogs/ /mdor na rgyal ba rnams dang de yi sras/ /nyan thos rang rgyal kun gyis 'gro ba la/ /mtha' klas zab dang rgya che dam pa'i chos/ /'khor lo rgyun chad med par skor bar bskul//de nas zhar byung bum pa'i dbang / /byin rlabs tshul du blang ba ni/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos bla ma'i dpral ba nas/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun dang oṃ yig dkar po byung / /rang gi dpral ba'i gnas su thim pa yis/ /bum pa'i dbang bskur byin rlabs tshul du thob/ /lus kyi sdig sgrib bag chags ma lus sbyangs/ /sku yi rdo rje 'grub pa'i nus pa rnyed/ /phra rags bskyed rim sgom la dbang bar byas/ /gos bu sprul sku 'grub pa'i sa bon bzhag /mya ga mi 'dar bas gsol ba/ ring nas mgon khyod byams brtse'i dmag dpung gis/ /bdud sde'i tshogs rnams phye mar rab btags te/ /mi 'gyur 'chi ba med pa rdo rje'i skus/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i srid la dbang sgyur yang / /ma nges 'gro blo'i rin chen rtsig (8na ngo'i ngos/ /tha ma'i sbyang gzhi'i 'bod grogs gzugs brnyan stong / shar yang blo ldan ha nu sna yis/ /mi shes rlung sems lus de gang du mchis/ /de phyir bslu ba med pa'i skyabs gnas tshogs/ don la gshegs bzhugs bral yang dman —9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)blo'i ngor/ /sgyu ma'i sku de mdzo sum mthong dka' bas/ /rags pa'i lus 'di g.yo med brtan par 'os/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i zlos gar nyin mo'i mgon/ /chos dbyings thun 'tshams phang par ngal gso na/ /lha lam pha mthas gzhal dka'i lus can gyi/ /mgon skyabs dpung gnyen byed po su zhig mchis/ /tshe rabs du mar gnas ngan len gyi rgyu/ /rang gis 'bad pas bsags pa'i 'bras bu zhes//yal bar 'dor na 'gro la bu gcig ltar/ /brtse ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pa'ang gtam du zad/ /mtha' med 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po'i nang / /nyon mongs chu srin rnon po'i mche ba gtsigs/ /las ngan mi 'dod rlung shugs drag pos g.yengs/ /mi bzad sdug bsngal klong du bying ba'i 'gro/ /mgon po khyod kyis rjes su mi 'dzin na/ /g.yin phyir thugs bskyed dka' ba brgya phrag gis/ /rlabs chen spyod pa'i dka' thub bsten pa yang / /rang nyid ngal ba'i 'bras bu tsam du zad/ /bde ba 'dod kyang sdug bsngal rgyu sgrub pa'i/ /blang dor gnas la rmongs pa'i skyes bu rnams/ /kun khyen ye shes sa la ma bzhag bar//mya ngan mi 'da' brtan par bzhugs su gsol/dge brdzogs byang gi rgyur ā+o ba ni/ 'khor 'das kun gyi dge legs yid bzhin nor/ /'byung gnas rje btsun (8ba)bla ma gdengs can dbang / /lung rtogs yon tan rgya mtsho chen po'i bdag /thugs rje dus las yol med rlabs phreng can/ /gang gi sku la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams/ /bzhugs nas bla na med pa'i bsod nams kyi/ /zhing mchog dam pa skrun zhes rgyud sde las/ /lan cig min par gsungasapa don dang ldan/ /chos longs mngon sum snang ba'i skal ba dag /ma rig mun pas bsgribs pa'i 'gro ba la/ /rgyal ba rnams kyang tha mal bshes gnyen tshul/ /bstan nas zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor//dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba thams cad las/ khyod kyi ba spu'i khung bu gcig tsam yang / /tshul bzhin mchod pa'i bsod nams las dkar gyi/ /srang la gzhal tshe mngon par lci min nam/ /lung dang rigs pa'i gto tshigs rta bdun pas/ /rab drangs mchod pa'i cho ga nyin mor byed/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i 'chi med lam shar tshe/ /phan bde'i 'dab brgya 'dzum las g.yin du ci/ /de ltar phul byung —10

bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung khug bsgrub pa'i shing rta/ (thadathugs rje chen po'i rgyud//tshul 'dir 'bad pas dge ba'i sor mo yis//bskul bas mchog thun dngos grub snyan 'gyur sgra//gto bde'i thos 'dzin dga' ston 'phel ba'i tshogs/'dir snang phun tshogs glog gi gar mkhan ma//srid 'byor e raṇ+ḍali snying po ltar//rtogs nas nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims dag/nan tan snying pos tshul bzhin legs par bsrungs//tshe rabs mang por drin gyis bskyangs pa yis//mar gyur 'gro la rang gi bde ba gtong //gzhan gyi sdug 9na ) bsngal dang du len nus pa'i//byang chub sems mchog rgyud la rab tu 'phyongs//smin byed dbang gis sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs//grol byed lam gyis zung 'jug sgrub pa sogs//byas dang byed bzhin byed 'gyur dge ba kun//rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur bsngo'o//nang gi mgo yul gas wa gad/ngur smig gar gyis rol pa'i bshes gnyen mchog/skad cig gnasagyur mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs//sku mdog dmar ser zhi 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams//mthon mthing dbu skra zur phud lnga ldan pa//phyag g.yas mi shes gcod pa'i ral gri 'phyar//g.yon pas thugasaskar ༄ la yu ba nas//bzung ba'i 'dab steng sher phyin glegs bam 'dzin//zhabs gnyis mi phyed rdo rje skyil krung can//rin r+ṣa rgyan dang lha rdzas na bzas mdzes//chos sku bde ba chen po'i mkha' dbyings su//gzugs sku 'ja' tshon lta bur rnam bkra ba//skyabs gnas ma lus 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur//yan la lto na na gyi phyag la la tsho/rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa gzugs//bslu med 'dren par shar ba bla ma rje//longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zlos gar 'jam dpal dbyangs//gnyis med gto gyi skyabs gnas la phyag 'tshal//ma 'dris kun la mdza' ba'i bshes gnyen mchog khyu med dug gsum kun la sdang ba'i dgra//chags med shes rab ma la rjes su brtse//'dod bral bde ba mchog la lhag par sred/gnyis med gtan gyi skyabs gnas la phyag 'tshal//ma 'dris kun la mdza' ba'i bshesaganyen mchog/rgyu med dug gsum kun la sdang ba'i dgra/chags med shes rab ma la rjes su brtse//'dod bral bde ba mchog la lhag par sred//ro nus ma bsdebs dug gsum nad sel sman//rlung

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)gis ma drangs phan bde'i dri bsung can/ /ku mud mi 'joms legs bshad snang ba'i gter/ /(9ba)byed pos ma bskrun zung 'jug za ma tog /snyigs dus tshe thung gcig gi yun tshad la/ /sku gsum gling du 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan mchog /rdo rje 'kho nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar/ /kun 'dus 'khor lo'i mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod pa'i nang tshan maṇ+ḍal ni/'byung ba bzhi 'dus lus kyi sa gzhi'i steng / /rnam par shes pa'i sa 'dzin dbang po la/ /phung khams gser ri rol mtsho bdun gyis bskor/ /skye mched bcu gnyis gling bzhi gling phran brgyad/ /ro rkyang nam mkha'i nor bu mtshan mo'i mgon/ /dbang po lnga yi gter chen bum pa sogs/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo dpal ldan bla mar 'bul/ /zag med bde ba che la spyod par shog /amrita yi mgo'/rin chen ka pā la yi snod yangs por/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga las grub pa'i rdzas/ /tha mal snang zhen yongs dag zag pa med/ /ro mchog bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i mchod pa 'bul//sgrus shā mor pas ma byed na/ phyi nang mtshan nyid ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /theg mchog 'jug sgo dbang gis legs smin cing / /bsnyen sgrub las gsum phrin las rnam pa bzhi/ /ril bu mig sman la sogs grub chen brgyad/ /thun mong las kun sgrub la thogs med cing / /bskyed rim phra rags sgyu lus gtum mo sogs/ /'khrul med tshul bzhin nyams su bstar ba yis/ /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'bul/ /sngar bsags kyi mi dge nyag pa ni/ dngos grub 'byung gnas rdo rje slob dpon gyi/ /thugs dang 'gal sogs nges gsang theg pa yi/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa kun/ (10na skonong zhing 'grod pa'i sgo nas mthol lo bshags/ dge la rjes su yi rang ba/ skal bzang snying gi rin chen bum pa'i nang / /rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i chos kyi bdud rtsi yis/ /legs gtam tshe 'dir sangs rgyas sgrub pa sogs//rnam dkar dge ba'i tsho gos la yi rang ngo / /chos lor skor bar bskul tso/ dman pa'i theg par gol pa'i ri dwags srog /dbang rnon mtshon gyis gcod pa'i sha wa ri/ /bzang po'i skal pa can gyi gdul bya la//theg chen gsang sngags chos 'khor skor du gsol/ ga4dbang byin sa kyi tshul du 'a pa/ bla ma'i mgrin pa'i gnas nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /dmar po āḥyig dang bcas thogs med byung / /rang gi mgrin pa'i — /2

bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'dug bsgrub pa'i shing rta/ thenaganas su thim pa yis/ /smin byed gsang dbang byin rlabs tshul du thob/ /ngag gi sdig sgrib bag chags ma lus sbyangs/ /gsung gi rdo rje 'grub ba'i nus pa rnyed/ /gtum mo'i rnal 'byor sgom la dbang bar byas/ /'bras bu longs sku 'grub pa'i sa bon bzhag /mya ga mi 'dar gsol ba gdage pa/dmigs med chos sku'i rang bzhin stong pa'i gzugs/ /bde chen 'khor la'i mgon por yongs shar ba'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma skal bzang gdul bya'i don/ /mdzad phyir bskal ba rgya mtshor rtag bzhugs gsol/ /dge 0byang chub tu bsngo ba ni/ dus gsum dag tu rnyed dka'i zab mo'i lam/ /mngon par sgrub pa'i dge tshogs lcags kyi khams/ /rnam dag dri ma med pa'i bsngo ba'i rtsis/ /rnam mkhyen btso ma'i gser du 'gyur bar shog /(10bskosang mchod tsol ba'i rten skyed pa ni/ mgon po 'jam dbyangs skad cig gnas gyur te//dkyil 'khor btso bo drug pa rdo rje 'chang / /sku la bshegs pa gshegs ma sems dpa' brgyad/ /khro bo bcu sogs gdan gsum tshang bar gyur/ /yan lag bdun las phyag la'i nga ni/ mi 'gyur rin chen mtshan dpe'i zlos gar la/ /stong nyid mdzes sdug dga' mas legs 'byud pa'i/ /gnyis med gnyis su snang ba'i sgyu ma mkhan/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon po la phyag 'tshal/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan yid bzhin mtsho nang du/ /rigs gsum lha yi zla snang grangs med pa/ /don dam ngang du ro gcig kun rdzob tu/ /ma 'dres snang ba dbang po'i gzhu ris bzhin/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rdo rje'i mtshon/ /rnon pos bdud bzhi'i srog rtsa bcad pa'i khrag /bde wo lang tshor smin pa'i 'od rim gyis/ /stong gzugs mthing gsal dmar ba'i mdangs kyis mdzes/ /phung po rnam dag bde bar gshegs pa'i tshogs/ /lta bas mi ngom mtshan dpe'i lang tsho can/ khams bzhi yul lnga rnam par dag pa'i yum/ /bde chen ye shes 'dren pa'i mdza' na mo/ /skye mched yongs su dag pa'i sems dpa' rnams/ khro chagasazhi ba'i nyams kyi rol gar mkhan/ /yan lag khro bor shar ba'i gtum brngams kyis/ /bdud bzhi'i snying la 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa ster/ /gtso dang 'khor zhes sems kyi rol ba yis/ /ma rtogs bcas pas spangs rtogs yon tan kun/ /mnyam par rdzogs pas mchog dman so so sto /'dzin par byed — 13—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)rnams byis pa'i blo gros bzhin/ /de phyir mgon khyod dkyil 'khor bye ba yi/ /gcig (11na༄ra spro dang bsdu ba'i byed po ste/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi 'byung gnas su/ /nges brnyed dad pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod pa'i skabs kyi mkha ni/rdo rje'i lus kyi gser ldan lto ba na/ /mnyam sbyor rdo rje pad ma'i lhun po mchog /bcu drug dga' ba'i ri mtsho gling bzhis bskor/ /dbu ma bcu gnyis khyim gyi rgyu lam du/ /ro rkyang rlung gi nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor 'char/ /sgyu ma'i lus su ldang ba'i rin chen bdun/ /zung 'jug bum bzang yongs 'du sa brtol sogs/ /dkyil 'khor mgon po dpal ldan bla mar 'bul/ /r+sā khrug phyag glu mar pa ni/ mkha' la mkha' yi sbyor ba ji bzhin du/ /'khor lo'i mgon po yab yum mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /brjod bral lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mchog /bde stong zung du 'jug pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /sgrub pa'i mo pa khrul0ni/ /rtsa khams rlung la gnad du bsnun pa yis/ /semasakyi rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la gzhol nas/ /don gnyis 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor longs spyod pa'i/ /yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po khyod la 'bul/ /sdig sgrib nyes lhung sogs gags pa ni/ myang 'das a wa sgru ti'i grong khyer du/ /sems kyi khye'u chung dri bzhon rtar bskyon nas/ /'khrid byed chos dang gzung mar bcas pa la//log rtog sem nyi bgyis pa mthol lo bshags/ /dge ba la rjes su yi sa ba ni/grangs med bskal par tshegasakyis mi skrun par/ /skad cig tsam gyis rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar/ /byon zin 'byon 'gyur da ltar bzhugasabazhin pa'i/ /phul byung mdzad pa kun la rjes yi rang / /chos 'khor (11ba skor bar bskul ba ni/ /skad cig bzod dka'i sdug bsngal me 'obs su/ /chud pa'i 'gro rnams myur du bsgral ba'i slad/ /bde chen ye shes 'dren pa'i myur lam gyi/ /nges gsang theg pa'i chos 'khor skor du gsol/ sher dbang byin mas kyi tshi du blang ba ni/ bla ma mchog gi thugs las bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /mthing kha hūṃ sngon bcas pa thogs med byung //rang gi snying ga'i gnas su thim pa yis/ khrer dbang byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshul du thob/ /yid kyi sdig sgrib bag chags ma lus sbyangs/ /thugs kyi rdo rje 'grub pa'i nus pa rnyed/ /pho lha'i lam mchog sgom la dbang bar byas/ /'bras bu chos sku 'grub pa'i sa bon bzhag /mya ga mi 'dar gsol ba gdang pa/— /4

bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug bsgrub pa'i shing rta/ 6)nyon slongs bdud bzhi bsad pa'i dmar 'od khrag/'pho med bde ba wo por shar ba'i mdangs//rnam kun mchog ldan sku dang zung 'jug khrir//sgrib bral sku bzhi'i rdo rje rtag bzhugs gsol//dge babyang rtsa twa bsngo tsho/dman pa'i thabs kyis 'grol min 'khor lo'i mdud//rtsa khams thig le'i rnal 'byor sor mo yis//bkrol nas zung 'jug grong du sgyu lus gar//bsgyur ba'i dge tsho gos byang lho wo por bsngo//de nyid kho'i mar skul ni/bsam pa'i re ba skong ba'i yid bzhi nor//dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon po bla ma mchog/spyi bo'i pad mtshor thogs med rab gshegs nas//dbu ma'i lam brgyud snying dbus ze'u 'brur byon//'od bzhu rang gi sems dang dbyer med pa//so sor mar du mi nus ro gcig tsam//snang dang stong pa zung du khrug pa'i dngos//byar med blo 'di brjod bral ngo bor gyur//yan lagan gyis phyag la'i ya zhi//brjod bral lha yi 12na7ma ltar rnam dag pa'i/chos dbyingasadon dam zad mi shes pa'i mdzod//'khor 'das kun gyi spyi dpal wo po'i gzhi//nges pa don gyi bla mar phyag 'tshal lo//ma pa'i nang gi mkha ni/dri bral rang sems dag pa'i sa gzhi la//rang bzhin gdod nas stong pa'i sa 'dzin che//med kyang rdzun par snang ba'i gleng bzhi sogs//rmi lam yul gyi rol pa ji bzhi 'bul//don darka gtso 4ne'/dmigs med don dam chos sku'i zhing mchog tu//smra bsam brjod med kun bzang mar pa'i sprin//brtan g.yo kun khyab 'khor 'das dbyer med pa//sprosakun nyer zhi mnyam nyid ngang du 'bul/sgrub pa'i 4na gtso lang ni/btags tsam kun rdzob chos kyi rdzun pa'i gru//don dam rgya ma'i smo pa'i mtha' bral klong //dbu mar gnas pa'i nor la longs spyod pa'i//nges pa don gyi snying po'i mchod pa 'bul//tshe yo'i mas cag gsa'/dro skyes bu bsad pa'i dpa' bo ltar//med bzhin bde dang sdug pa'i gar mkhan ma//gzung 'dzin sgrog tu chud pa'i las ga kun//bshags bya bshags byed bral ba'i ngang du bshags/gas gyi dgong la yi rang phre/ma dag gnyis su 'dzin pa'i 'khrul pa'i rgya//rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i mtshon cha yis//bcad de sdug bsngal lnga pa'i 'jigs pa las//thar pa'i mdzad pa mchog la rjes yi rang /chos snyor skor bar bskul pa ni/gzhan gyis

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)brjod du med pa chos kyi sku/ /rang bzhin ma grub snang stong zung 'brel ba'i/ /tshig dang ye ger bstan du med pa'i chos/ /'khor lo gnyug ma'i ngang du skor du gsol/ rdzo dbang byin gas mus du blang pa/ bla ma'i thugs (12bting rang gi sems gnyis po/ /dbyer med zung du 'jug pa'i bde ba che/ /mkha' ltar sgrib bral 'ja' tshon ltar bkra ba'i/ /bzhi ba'i dbang bsgyur byin rlabs tshul du thob/ /lus ngag yid gsum dri ma ma lus sbyangs/ /gsang gsum rdo rje 'grub pa'i nus pa rnyed/ /zung 'jug lam bzang sgom pa dbang bar byas/ /'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon bzhag /bzhi pa gsum pas zlas drangs pa'i//sgo nas ngo sprod dgos na yang / /gong du dbang rnams byin rlabs kyi/ /tshul tsam blangs pas dngos gzhi min/ /mya ༅ mi 'dar ga i gdab ni/ /rgyu dang rkyen gyis bcos su ma mchis pa'i/ /gdod nas rnam dag chos sku bde ba che/ /lus can kun la dngos su rab snang zhing / /nam yang 'pho 'gyur med par gsal gyur cig /dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba ni/ rang bzhin 'od gsal gzhug ma lhan cig skyes/ /rtag chad mtha' bral dbu ma'i lam bsgoms pas/ kun rdzob 'khrul ngor sna tshogs snang ba kun/ /don dam dbyings su ngo bo gcig par bsngo/ /smon lam dag pas la mos sbyar ni/ de ltar dngos grub legs tshogs kun gyi gzhi/ /rdo rje slob dpon tshul bzhin mchod pa sogs/ /grangs med dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa'i/ /mtha' klas rnam par dag pa'i phung po yis/ /tshe rabs kun du dal ba'i rten thob cing / /bshes gnyen dam pa'i mgon gyis legs zin nas/ /thun mong lam gyi rgyud kun rab sbyangs te/ /rdo rje theg la bzhugs par byin gyis rlobs/ /'bad pa chen pos snyigs dus tshe gcig la/ /sku bzhi ye shes lnga yis bdag nyid mchog /kha sbyor bdun ldan go 'phang mngon byas nas/ /'gro kun byang chub mchog la 'god gyur cig /(13na7na gos shis pa brjod po ni/dran pa tsam gyis srid zhi'i 'jigs las skyob/ /mthong thos dran reg legs pa'i lam la sbyor/ /gsol ba btab pas 'dod dgu'i re stong ba'i/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /zhi ba mya ngan 'das pa'i sa brnyes kyang / /gdul bya'i snang ngor khro chags rnam 'gyur gyis/ /bdud sde'i snying ga rdzi ba'i stangs stabs can/ /yi dam lha — 16

bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug bsgrub pa'i shing rta/ 6)tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /mthu stobs rdo rje'i theg gi rjes 'gro zhing / /'phrin las thogs med sgrub pa'i dpag bsam dbang / /chos skyong dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams gyis/ /dge legs bkra shis char ltar 'bebs par mdzod/ /'di ni dmigs brtse ma sogs dang / /gtso bor 'brel ba'i dbang byas kyi/ /yang na nang gsang mchod yul ngor/ /thog ma'i skyed chog 'di ltar ro/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /rnam pa drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /dbang sngon mdangs ldan nyi ma'i gzi brjid can/ /dgyes pa'i 'dzum gyis 'gro kun bde bar bsu/ /bung ba ltar gnag ral pa'i thor cog g.yo/ /phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu thugs skar bsnol/ /rin chen rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas mdzes//zhabs gnyis mi phyed rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ /'di tsam gyis ni bde blag tu/ /rtogs par nus so rang bzo yi/ /don med tshig tshogasang la ba'i rgyu/ /gzu bor gnas rnams tshul 'di longs/ /de ltar rnam smin dkar por 'dzag pa'i rnga/ /rmad byung blo gros dbyu gus bskul ba'i tshe/ /skal bzang rna ba'i bcud len rgyas byed pa'i/ /legs bshad sgra dbyangs srid rtse'i bar du (13ba〉sgrog /sngon byon mkhas pa'i dgongs don ma 'chugs shing / rnam dpyod mthu yis brjod don phul byung ba/ /bskrun 'dir sbyar byang spel ba rigs mod kyi/ /ngag bgros rnying pa ldabs dang gang la mtshungs/ /bdud rtsis legs gtam 'jim pa'i bum pa dag /dor nas ngan skyugs kyis gang gser bum la/ /dga' bar byed ltar deng dus skye bo rnams/ /legs nyes 'byed pa'i blo gros skal pa phra/ /sngon rabs mkhas pa'i legs bshad nyin mor byed/ /dus kyis 'grib pa'i chu lha'i phang par nyal/ /tshig don dman pa'i du ba mjug ring zhig /thub bstan nam mkha'i mdzes pa 'phrog phyir rgyu/ /de phyir tshad ldan mkhas pa'i gsung rab kyang //skal ngan dus kyi nub la nye ba'i tshe/ blo dman bdag 'dras yi ger 'dri ba dag /rang nyid ngal ba'i 'bras bu tsam du zad/ /'on kyang bod dang hor gyi skad gnyis pa/ /smra ba'i dpyod ldan mer rgan bka' bcu zhes/ shes rab rgya mtshor 'bod des ring mo nas/ /'bad pa chen pos yang yang bskul ba dang //nye char gnas lnga rig pa'i chu gter dbus/ /legs bshad phud sgra sgrog pa'i 'jig rten mig /blo — 17

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)chen shes bya kun rig gang de yis/ /nan tan bskul ba'i bzhed pa skong phyir byas/ /de 'dra rab mas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon/ /'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub zhabs pad rdul/ /spyi gtsug rgyan du bsten pa'i rgyal khams pa/ /za hor rigs kyi brjes yi ger bkod/ /dge des mkha' mnyam lus can ma lus pa/ /yang dag dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes bzung ste/ /don gnyis lhun grub stobs bcu'i go 'phang mchog /thob nas 'gro kun 'dren pa'i mgon gyur cig /de (14na skor bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba 'di ni/ /bod sog gi lo tsā ba dpyod ldan mer rgan bka' bcu shes rab rgya mtsho dang / /bod lugs kyi gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta smon 'gro lo tsū ba'i gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga la gzhi byas/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi sbyor tshul sogs dmigs su phye ste/ za hor gyi rigs las ā wa sgru ti ba'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos dga' ba'i lo chu stod zla ba'i dbyangs u 'char ba'i tshes la byang phyogs gyi chu bo lo hi ta'i 'gram du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mañdzu sto ṣa shrī bha dra na ka ra dza yan+tu// maṅga lo//— 18

bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi rgyun khyer dbang khrid kyi legs bshad phul byung dgongs rgyan/ (tha)bka' gdams rin po che thig le bcu drug gi rgyun khyer dbang khrid kyi legs bshad phul byung dgongs rgyan bzhugs/na mo gu ru byu tri ra sne saḥ/ rmad byung bsod nams ye shes sa bon dag gis ring mo nyid nas bskrun pa las/ /sku gsum sdong bu rnam par rgyas pa'i mtshan dpe'i lo 'bras phyogs bcur rab g.yo ba/ /mtshan gyi gzis kyang phan dang bde ba'i 'dod dgu legs stsal yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal//rnam 'dren gtsor gyur 'od dpag med ces sngon med dpag bsam ljon pa rgyal gyur cig /gang de'i ye shes sgyu ma'i rol gar las/ /sdom brtson gnas lnga kun mkhyen lnga brgya'i gtso/ /a ti sha zhes snyan pa'i grags pa yis/ /srid 'di'i rna bar snyan pa'i gtam du 'jebs/ /mi zad gsang ba'i gdams pa bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /thugs kyi bum par legs 'khyil 'byom ston rje/ /brgyud par bcas pa'i snyan brgyud mdzod 'dzin rnams/ /skal bzang gzur gnas yongs kyis phyag bya'i gnas/ /man ngag chu shel zhun ma'i thig le gang / /nyams len snyan brgyud bcu drug cha shas su/ /rdzogs par 'khyil ba'i bka' gdams 'od dkar can/ /blo ldan kun da khong nas 'dzum pa bzhin/ /phyogs res tshim min thub pa'i bstan pa rnams/ /yongs rdzogs gcig tu dril nas nyams len pa'i/ /legs par bshad pa phul byung dgongs rgyan 'di/ /mgrin pa'i 'khor lo rnam par grol te bri/ /(2na)de yang mnyam med jo bo chen po yab sras kyi gsang chos glegs bam rin po cher grags pa/ rtog ge pa rnams kyi blo'i yul du shong bar dka' ba'i zab don 'di nyid kyi snying po'i yang snying por gyur pa/ zab don snying gi thig le bcu drug tu grags pa 'di ni slob dpon byang chub bzang po yan chad du chig brgyud bka' rgya shin tu dam zhing thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa'i bar du'ang khyab gdal du mi mdzad par —19

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)zab gnad rnams snyan brgyud kho nar bzhugs pas/ bka' rgya dbrol na sras su ga la 'gyur/ /snying gtam snying du brgyud na zab chos yin/ /legs bshad sems la 'chang na yun du 'phrod/ /mngon rtogs sems la brgyud na brtan pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar 'di nyid yi ger 'dri ba'i yul min na'ang / dus dbang gis mchog dman mtha' dag dam pa'i chos kyi rjes su phyogs pa ches nyung zhing /rgyu mtshan des chos zab mo rnams kyang rim gyis nub pa la nye ba'i dus 'dir dgos pa'i dbang gis yi ge'i phreng bar spel ba la nyes pa med pas snga rabs kyi yig rnying rnams su gab pa dang mi gsal ba dang 'khrugs pa sogs legs par bsdebs shing / rang blo'i rtsal dang rje stag tshang pa'i zur 'debs rnams kyis brgyan te bri bar bya'o/ /ding sang 'di'i dbang khrid rgyun gyi nyams len sogs 'brom gzhen nu blo gros kyis mdzad (2ba)pa'i yig rnying rnams ha cang kha mi gsal zhing / rang gzhan gyi yig cha sna tshogs snang ba'ang g.yar khral kho na las brjod don gyi 'bras bus dben par mthong la/ rje slo bo grol mchog pa'i khrid brgya'i nang gi de'ang sa bon tsam las legs par bshad pa'i cha che bar ma mthong bas 'dir mdon par gsal zhing ma 'dres par brjod pa la bzhi/ /dus khyad par can gyi skabs sgrub pa'i mchod pa/ rang nyid rgyun 'khyer du nyams su blang tshul/ gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa dbang gi cho ga /skal ldan gyi slob ma la nyams 'khrid du 'debs pa'i rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi ched ma yin yang cho 'phrul dang bla ma'i dus mchod la dmigs te dkyil 'khor bri ba sogs bcas kyi rim pa dang thun 'dzin pa'i sgrub grogs rnams dbang chog nas khrung ba ltar len zhing dngos gzhi'i nyams len dbang chog dor ba tsam mo/ /gnyis pa ni mchod pa bdun tshar dang / kun 'dus kyi dkar gtor zhig bshams/ thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni/bdag dang 'gro ba sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su 'chi'o/ /chos rnams kyi mchog zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog —20

bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi rgyun khyer dbang khrid kyi legs bshad phul byung dgongs rgyan/ (ba)'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun chen po rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sems bskyed pa ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam gyi sems can ma lus pa thams cad kyis skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan dag tu sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin (3na skong sgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ci bgyis pa dang / bgyid du bstsal ba dang bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis dang po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du bdag sogs sems can rnams kyis kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen po la sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o/ dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar bgyi'o zhes lan gsum brjod/ bla med kyi nyams len gtso che bar byed na sngags sdom spyi 'gro ltar bzung na legs par mngon no/ /mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis thugs rje chen po g.yas nor bu'i phreng ba dang g.yon shel gyi 'khor lo rtse mor sangs rgyas stong gis mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa'i thugs ga'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros/ snod bcud kyi ma dag pa sbyangs/ oṃ las rin che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang bsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa dpal kun du bzang po'i rnam par sprul pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin zad mi shes pa nam mkha' dang (3ba〉mnyam par gyur/ o sarba ta thā ga ta a lha nas/21

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)sha rdi'i bar brjod/ dngos gzhi ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shu d+dha sa dharma swā bhā wa shu (ཿlha/ snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i brtan g.yo'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang gi sems kyi cha shasalas grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi 'dod snam pha gu dra ba dra phyed mda' yab pu shu rta babs sogs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang gi steng dang shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / 'og sngon por gyur pa'i kha dog so so'i rang mdog ltar 'char ba la rnam pa yi ge'i gzugs can gyis bar mtshams med par khyab pa/ kha dog dang dbyibs rnams ma 'dres par so sor bkra ba'i steng gi yi ge thams cad oṃ/ shar ma/ lho ṇi/ nub bad/ byang me/ 'og hūṃ du snang ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du sems nyid thig le dkar po gsal stong 'od kyi rang bzhin can de nyid je cher song ba las rang nyid thub pa dang dbyer med pa'i thugs rje chen por gyur pa 'od du zhu ba las skad cig gis paṃ yig dkar po las nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i pad ma dkar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar a dkar po las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las thig le dkar po nam mkha' ltar mtha' dang bral ba'i rang bzhin can yongs su gyur pa las bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho nam mkhas gar khyab tu skus khyab pa/ dbu bcu gcig phyag stong spyan stong dang ldan pa/ rtsa zhal dkar/ g.yas dmir g.yon ljang / de'i steng gi zhal dbus ljang g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ de'i steng gi zhal dbus dmar g.yas ljang g.yon dkar ba/ de'i steng na khro zhal nag po mche ba gtsigs pa (4na〉spyan gsum pa/ ral pa dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ de'i spyi bor zhi ba'i zhal dmar po gtsug tor can/ rtsa ba'i phyag dang po gnyis thugs dar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas gnyis pa na bgrang 'phreng / gsum pa yi dgas kyi skom pa sel ba/ bzhi pa na 'khor lo/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na pad ma/ gsum pa na ril pa spyi blugs/ bzhi pa na mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ phyag lhag ma dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gnyis po thams cad mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ ba spu'i bu ga re re na sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa/ de rnams 22

bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi rgyun khyer dbang khrid kyi legs bshad phul byung dgongs rgyan/ 6)nas sangs rgyas byang sems mtha' klas pa mthong ba/ gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru las 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros pas sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad pa/ /de'i thugs skar thig le gnyis pa mi mdzad kyi bkod pa sngar lta bu'o gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na oṃ ser po las thub pa chen po rnam par snang mdzad gangs chen 'tsho sprul sku'i cha byad can/ g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang g.yon mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ g.yas g.yon du mchog zung bzhengs te bzhugs pa/ theg pa gsum gyi 'khor tshogs rgya mtshos bskor ba/ de'i thugs skar thig le gsum pa kha ba can gyi thig le/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa ji lta ba bzhin bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs gar thig le bzhi pa yang sgos dbu ru byang phyogs kyi thig le/gzhal yas khang nang du pad zla'i steng na hrīḥlas 'brom shel gyi khye'u dkar po zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ dbu sgra mthing kha dpung pa'i thad du sleb pa/ phyag g.yas shel dkar gyi 'phreng ba dang / g.yon shel gyi mkhar ba rtse mor pad ma dkar po (4ba 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar zla gdan la yum chen mo/g.yas su bla ma mar me mdzad/ g.yon du rgyal ba shākya thub pa/ 'dab ma stong la sangs rgyas stong bzhugs pas mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar thig le lnga pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na a ser po las yum sher phyin ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas dang po thugs kar skyabs sbyin gi phyag rgya dang / g.yon dang po mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ g.yas 'og mas rdo rje dang g.yon 'og mas glegs bam 'dzin pa/ zhabs skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal sras bcas kyis bskor ba/ de'i thugs skar thig le drug pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na thu ser po las thub pa bdud 'dul sprul sku'i cha lugs can/ g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ de'i thugs gar thig le bdun pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na hrīḥdakar po las spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis thugs gar thal mo sbyar ba/ lhag ma gnyis shel 'phreng dang pad dkar 'dzin pa/—23

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'khor byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i thugs skar thig le brgyad pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na snya ljang gu las sgrol ma ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang g.yon la mtheb srin gyis thugs kur 'dzin pa/ 'khor zhi ba'i lha mo dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ de'i thugs gar thig le dgu pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad nyi'i steng na ti ljang nag las sgrol ma drag mo ljang nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/dang po gnyis gri thod/ /(ldan〉sdog ma gnyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭaṃ ga 'dzin pa/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol zhing g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/'khor du lha mo drag mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ de'i thugs skar thig le bcu pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad nyi'i steng na hūṃ mthing nag las mi g.yo ba sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/khro zhing gtum pa/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan cing glang lngags dang stag sham gsol ba/ g.yas brkyang gis tshogs kyi bdag po'i gdan la me dpung gi dbus na khro bo'i tshogs kyis bskor te bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs gar thig le bcu gcig pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na hūṃ dkar po a ti sha longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs can/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun thub pa longs sku'i cha lugs can/g.yas su spyan ras gzigs/ g.yon du sgrol ma/ rgyab tu mi g.yo ba/ shar lhor jo bo paṇ+ḍita'i cha byad can/ lho nub tu 'brom dge bsnyen gyi cha byad can/ nub byang du rngog dang byang shar du khu ston gnyis bod ston rab byung gi cha byad can/ steng gi cha la brgyud pa gsum gyi bla ma'i tshogs rnams bzhugs pa/de'i thugs kur thig le bcu gnyis pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na saḥdakar po las 'brom chos kyi rgyal po longs sku'i gar chas su bzhugs pa/ dgung lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/g.yas pad dkar dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i mdun du phyi ltar na rang dang cha lugs mtshungs pa'i khye'u dkar po bzhi/ g.yas su ser (5ba)po bzhi/ g.yon du ljang —24

bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi rgyun khyer dbang khrid kyi legs bshad phul byung dgongs rgyan/ (thadagu bzhi/ rgyab tu dmar po bzhi/ nang ltar na sku mched gsum sogs/ gsang ba ltar na rigs lnga'i ngo bo/ steng gi cha la brgyud pa gsum gyi bla ma rnams dang / gsang ba ye shes sogs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs du ma rnams u rgyan gyi yul du mdzad pa ji lta ba bzhin gar stabs sna tshogs su sgyur ba/ de'i thugs gar thig le bcu gsum pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na mi ser po las rgyal ba byams pa dge slong snam sbyar chos gos gyon pa/ mtshan dpe dang ldan pa/ chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/g.yas g.yon na nam mkha' dri ma med pa dang btsun pa spyan ras gzigs gnyis dge slong gi cha byad can bzhengs dang bzhugs pa/ steng gi cha la 'phags pa thogs med sogs rgya chen spyod brgyud kyi bla ma'i tshogs rnams bzhug bas pa/ de'i thugs skar thig le bcu bzhi pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na rnyi dmar ser las rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs rang byung sprul sku'i cha lugs can/phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas g.yon du jo bo dang spyan ras gzigs gnyis rab byung gi rnam pa can/ steng gi cha la mgon po klu sgrub sogs zab mo lta brgyud kyi bla ma'i tshogs rnams bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs gar thig le bco lnga pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad ma nyi ma zla ba'i gdan la hūṃ mthing kha las rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs can sku mdog sngon po/ rdo rje dang dril bu thugs gar bsnol ste 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas g.yon du mchog zung longasasku'i cha lugs can gyis bzhengs pa/ steng gi cha la te lo na ro sogs nyams len byin rlabs brgyud kyi bla (6na〉pa'i tshogs rnams bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs gar thig le bcu drug pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na hūṃ sngon po las sangs rgyas chos kyi sku mthing skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag gnyis ting 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs skar shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems thig le dkar ser rten brten pa'i rnam pa can yungs kar gyi 'bru tshad tsam/ spro na nam mkha'i mthar khyab par nus shing / bsdu na rdul phran tsam gyi tshad du bsdu bar nus pa'i 'od zer sna —25

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)lnga'i rang bzhin can du bsam mo/ /lha tshogs thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kur hūṃ sngon po/ thugs rka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas dag pa rab 'byams kyi zhing khams nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par gyur/ pad ma ka ma la ye sto/ slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang skur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sa spru ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ zhes dbang bskur/ lus gang / dri ma dag /chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu 'khyil pa las rang rang gi sa bon gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ phyag dang phyag yul gnyis stong pa'i zhes sogs kyi yan lag bdun pa'am/ yang na ji snyed su dag ma lta bu byas kyang rung / de nas chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa/'dod yon lnga/ rgyal srid bdun rnams rgyud sde g.yin nas 'byung ba ltar rgyas par bya ba'am/ rgyun 'byer mdor bsdus su byed na 'di lta ste/ yid bzhin 'o mtsho 'khyil (6ba tha la 'gran pa'i/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil gang ga'i rgyun bzhin 'bab/ /chu skyes yal 'dab ze'u 'bru g.yur du za/ /bdug spos dbyar skyes sprin bzhin lang long g.yo/ /snang gsal sgron me nyi zla'i 'od bzhin gsal/ /dri bzang ngad ldan rba rlabs phyogs bcur 'brug /bsgos bzang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i dpal la 'khu/ grangs med rol mo rna ba'i gsos su 'jibs/ /phul byung kun du bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /dngos bshamasayid kyis rnam par rab sprul nas/ /bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung ma la/ /gus pas 'bul lo bzhes nas dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ sa ta thā ga ta a lhanas/ sha rdi'i bar brjod/ yid 'phrog gzugs sgyur snyan pa'i rol mo sgrog /dri zhim ngad 'thul ro mchog phyur bur spungs/ /'jam mnyen reg bya'i tshogs kun 'bul byed na/ /nye bar bzhes la dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sa: ta thā ga ta rū pa nas spar sha'i bar/ rtsibs stong 'bor lo rin chen dbang gi rgyal/ /yid 'ong btsun mo khyim bdag rin po che/ /gnyis 'thung dbang po cang shes rta mchog dpal/ /bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i dmag dpon —26

bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi rgyun khyer dbang khrid kyi legs bshad phul byung dgongs rgyan/ (thadasogs/ /rgyal srid bdun dang bkra shis rtags brgyad rdzas/ /yid 'phrog phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs/ /slu med mchog gsum dam pa'i tshogs la 'bul/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sa spru ta thā ga ta sa lta rat+na aṣ+ṭa maṅgal pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bas tshim par bsams la sa gu ru bud+dhā bo dha sa twa sa spru ta thā ta 3 pā las pa ri wā ra i rda ba smra ta kha kha ji hi ji hi zhes pa bdun nam gsum gyis dbul zhing / sngags mchod (7na)kyang dbul/ /ma dag zhing gi 'jig rten ji snyed pa/ /dag pa rab 'byams lha yi gzhal yas su/ /mngon par legs sgyur bcom ldan thub pa che/ /rje btsun phyag na pad ma'i tshogs la bstod/ /sde snod gsum gyi yum chen sher phyin ma/ sangs rgyas zhi dang khro bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /kun 'dus bka' gdams lhag pa'i lha mchog bzhi/ skyabs
