mchogo yi dam chos skyong rnams la bstod/ /rgya chen spyod dang zab mo lta ba'i lam/ /nyams len snyan brgyud gdams pa mchog gi gter/ /rgyun chad med par 'dzin cing spel mkhas pas/ /lha chos bdun ldan brgyud pa rnams la bstod/ /gdod nas rnam dag snang stong dag pa'i gshis/ /bzhin lag mtshan dpe'i 'ja' tshon rnam bkra ba/ /'gyur med chos sku gsal stong rlung sems zung / /ches phra thig le'i rnam par shar la bstod/ /lha chos bdun gyi nying khu thig le'i chos/ /nyams su bstar bas tshe 'dir zung 'jug sku/ /mngon du byas te don gnyis ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ zhes dang /gzhan yang bstod pa gsol 'debs sogs skabs sbyar bya/ de nas thig le bcu drug po'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra 'brug gi sgra ltar sgrog cing / sku gsung thugs las 'od zer grangs med pa 'phros pas 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams mchod/ bdag g.yin sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes lhung gi tshogs rnams byang zhing dag /mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol bar bsams la yi ge drug pa ci nus su bzla/ mthar bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams zhes sogs bsngo ba smon lam dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar rgyas par bya ba 'am/ yang na rmad byung sras (7ba tha cas ma sogs —27

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)skabs thob kyis phye ba'i gang 'os bya/ de nas/ phyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thig le'i snod kyi gzhal yas khang 'od du zhu/ bcud kyi lha rgyal ba rgya mtsho la thim/ de bzhin du phyi ma phyi ma nang ma nang ma la rim bzhin thim ste/ sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i thig le la thim/ thig le'ang je phrar gyur nas nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin du bsam/ slar yang chad mtha' sel ba'i phyir du stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur langs te rgyun gyi spyod lam la 'jug go /de yang rgyas par spro na mchod pa'ang lha bcu drug po so so la re re nas dbul zhing / bzlas pa'i skabs lha so so'i sngags bzla ba dang / dmigs pa'ang so sor byas na 'i rgyas pa cha lag tu 'gyur mod kyi/ rgyun 'byer du mchod pa cig car du 'bul zhing / bzlasapa'ang cig car du byed pa 'jug pa bde bas legs pa yin no/ /smras pa/ zab don chu shel nor bu dag /blo gros zla ba'i 'od zer dang / /phrad tshe legs bshad bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /mngon par 'bab pa 'di rmad byung / /lha chos bdun gyi nying khu 'di'i/ /dka' gnad lta ba'i blo med par/ /sngon 'gro'i chos 'ga' shes pa la/ /bka' gdams par rlom gad mo'i gnas/ /'on kyang deng dus gangs can 'dir/ /blang dor shes pa tshes nyung bas/ /blun po dregs pa'i 'ur rgyangs can/ /dam par 'dzin pa 'tshang re che/ /yid bzhin nor dang mching bu'i rdo/ /khyad par med pa'i yul phyogs su/ /'bad pas rgya mtsho cher bgrod nas/ /nor bu len pa ngal bar zad/ /de lta na yang thub pa'i bstan/ /'dzin pa'i rnam dpyod phul byung zhing / /gsang chen rgya mtshor mnga' sgyur ba'i//rdo rje 'dzin (8na ji dgyes phyir bkod/ /ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gsum pa gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa dbang gi tshig la ding sang gi phyag len yongs grags kyi lugs dgod pa/ phyag len cung zad gtsang zhing rgyas pa'i lugs dgod pa/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i lugs srol yongs su rdzogs par chad pa shin tu rgyas pa'i lugs dgod pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rang gis mthong zhing thos pa dang / dbur stod lo bya yul ba'i phyogs nas brgyud pa'i bka' —28—

bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi rgyun khyer dbang khrid kyi legs bshad phul byung dgongs rgyan/ 6)brgyud pa 'ga' zhig gi phyogs su'ang chos 'di spel ba'i srol yod 'dug pa rnams brtags tshe phal cher sgo mtshungs par bsgrub gzhi'i dkyil 'khor yang nas kyi tshom bu spungs pa dang / lo phyogs nasabargyud pa la jo 'byom gyi sku dang mchod gtor nges can du mdzad/ gzhan dag la la ched gnyer du mi mdzad par 'dug cing / rang rgyud la skul ma 'debs pa dad pa'i ljon shing sgrog dgos par bshad pa'ang mdzad pa'i rgyun yod par ma mthong / dbang dngos gzhi'i skabs gsol gdab skyabs sems rnams yig cha rnying pa ji lta ba bzhin mdzad/ de nas slob ma dkyil 'khor phyi ma nas rim pa bzhin/sgo phye nas nang du khrid de lha gang yin pa de'i mdun du slob ma sleb pa na de la dmigs nas gsol gdab mchod 'bul yid kyis byas pas byin kyis brlabs pa'i dmigs pa sprad/ lha gang yin pa'i sngags rjes zlos sam/ dpon slob gnyis nas lhan cig tu tshar gsum bzhi tsam gsung ba mdzad/phyag len de ga sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i bar du rigs 'dra par bkab mdzad pa'i rjes su slob ma rnams bum chus khrus byas/ smon lam shis brjod mdzad pa tsam mo /gnyis pa phyag len cung zad gtsang zhing rgyas pa'i lugs dgod pa la sngon 'gro/ dngos (8ba)gzhi/ mjug gi cho ga dang gsum/ dang po la gsol ba gdab pa/ sa bslang ba/ bgegs bskrad pa/mtshams gcad pa/ dkyil 'khor bri ba/ mchod pa dang yo byad bsham pa/ sgrub pa dngos dang bdun/dang po ni/ mdun du mchod pa tshar gcig bshams/ grogs dge slong bzhi'am/ bcu drug gi bar chosagos gsum dang ldan pa dang lhan cig pa'am/ rang nyid gcig pus kyang rung ste/ rang thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes spyan drangs/ yan lag bdun pa rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar ba byas/ de rjes rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems/ /thugs rje can gyis bdag la ni/ /mi dge'i las rnams sbyang ba'i phyir/ /gso sbyong dam pa stsol bar mdzod/ ces lan gsum gsol ba btab/ rgyal sras rnams kyis ji lta bar//—29

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)bdag kyang de bzhin bsgrub par bgyi/ zhes lan gsum gyis gso sbyong blangs/ de nas/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba rnams/ /bdag cag rnams la dgongs su gsol/ /zab mo thig le bcu drug gi /dkyil 'khor bri zhing bsgrub pa dang / slob ma rjes su 'dzin byed na/ /gnang ba stsol la byin gyis rlomes/zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas dgyes bzhin du gnang bar bsam mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhi bdag gi gtor ma dang / sa'i lha mo'i gtor ma mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams/ rang gi thugs ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ mgron rnams skad cig gis spyan drangs par bsam mo/ /a mri tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod/ (9na〉ngas shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du gtor ma rnams dwangs shing / mgron rnams kyi dbang po rnams tshim pa'i byed las khyad par can dang ldan par gyur/ /oṃ āḥ/ gis byin gyis brlabs/ /sa phyogs 'di nyid srung zhing skyong ba yi/ /dkar phyogs la dga' lha klu gzhi bdag dang / /sa yi lha mo brtan mar bcas rnams kyis/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /dkyil 'khor bri bar sa ni gnang ba dang / /'gal rkyen sel la mthun rkyen sgrub par mdzod/ ces gsol bas khas blangs par bsam mo /gsum pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis mi g.yo bar gsal btab/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ bar du gcod pa'i bgegs rnams skad cig gis mdun du bkug par bsams la/ sngar bzhin gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ sarba bigha na sogs gyis bsngos/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas ya sogs kyis bden pa bdar zhing / mi g.yo ba'i sngags dang sum bhas bgegs bskrad/ bzhi pa ni/ slar yang steng 'og phyogs mtshams ma lus pa/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur bla bre dang / /me dpung khro bo'i 'i 'gas pa 'a gur khang gis/ /gtams pas bar gcod kun las srung bar gyur/ badz+ra rak+ṣa/rgyal chen bzhi la dkar gtor gyi mchod pa bshams/ byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi thugs dzi'i hūṃ lasa'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rgyal po chen po sde bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drang par bsams la/ oṃ ma hā rā dzā sto ṭa rang bi ru lha ka /bi ru pak+ṣa/ be+e shra wa ṇa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā —30

bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi rgyun khyer dbang khrid kyi legs bshad phul byung dgongs rgyan/ (tha)dzaḥ sngags kyi rjes su a lha nas sha rdi'i bar gyis mchode/ gong gi sngags gsham du gtor ma dkyus ltar phul/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung / /deng 'dir bar chad srung (9ba tha dang / /bsams pa chos bzhin 'grub pa yi/ /mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzad du gsol/ /de bzhin du 'phags skyes po/spyan mi bzang / rnam thos sras/ zhes 'don pa bsgyur ro/ /lnga pa la chag chag gdab pa/ steg bu brtsig pa/ dkyil 'khor bri ba dngos dang gsum/ dang po ni/ 'grub na gnas khang gi steng 'og phyogs mtshams rnams su yi ge drug pa cho ga dang mthun par dgod/ dri bzang gi chu gtsang ma mdun du bzhag la/ rang nyid skad cig gis rgyal ba shā kya thub par bskyed pa'i gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer 'phros/ chu la thims pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsam la/ oṃ 〉lha lan mang du brjod cing dri bzang gi chu des gnas khang gi phyogs mtshams thams cad du chag chag gdab bo/ /gnyis pa ni/chu'i lhag ma rnams dang bkra shis pa'i sa sna rnams bsres pa la stegs bu dkyil 'khor che chung ji tsam bzheng pa dang bstun pa'i rgya khyon gyi tshad byas te brtsig go /gsum pa la/ thig tshon byin gyis brlab pa dang / bri ba dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ thig skud mtshan nyid dang ldan pa kha dog sna lnga pa dang / tshon rnams sta gon byas/ a mri tas bsangs/ swa bhā wasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las pad ma dkar po dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du thig tshon rnams rim pa bzhin thugs rje chen po sa bon lnga las dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i sku mdog can/ phyag g.yas rim pa bzhin 'khor lo/ rin po che/ ut+pal dmar po/ ral gri /rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon thams cad pad ma dkar po bsnams pa/ longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs can/ skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ spyan 'dren mchod bstod (10na)tshul bzhin bya/ lha rnams 'od du zhu ba thig tshon so sor gyur par bsams la yi ge drug pa dang / 'bru gsum dang /oṃ swā āḥhā hūṃ/ zhes mang du bzla/ de nas thig skud bsgril te bdud rtsi'i chu byug go /gnyis pa la thig gdab pa dang tshon dgye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'brom ku ma ra ma ti'i yig —31 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)char ha cang mi gsal zhing / de'i rgyun deng sang chad pas sgo gsal ba zhig mi 'dug pas de'i rgyu mtshan mkhas pa'i dbang po stag tshang lo tsā bas gsung pa shin tu thugs mad par 'dug cing / thig rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum so sor byed na mkhas pa de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lhan thabs kyi yig cha'i legs par bshad pa las logs su ma dgos shing / 'dir lag len 'jug pa bde bar snying por dril na 'di lta ste/ phyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang gi thig rtsa rta babs snam bu bzhi pa bde zhing / gzhan rgyud dzi spyi'i thig rtsa sor gnas dang / de'i nang du dkyil 'khor bco lnga dgos rgyu phyi ma phyi ma'i nang du nang ma nang ma shong ba dgos pa dang bcas sgo rdzogs 'grub par dka' bas rtsig pa rang 'dod snam gnyis tsam bya zhing / sgo'i rnam pa cung zad gdon la/ bco lnga po thams cad bzo thig las thig rtsa dngos gzhi mi thon/ dkyil 'khor nang ma'i dbus su pad ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar yum chen mo/ 'dab ma bzhi'i shar du thub pa/ lhor spyan ras gzigs/ nub tu mi g.yo ba/ byang du sgrol ma rnams kyi bris 'bur ram/ bsdu na sa bon bkod/ phyi rol du dkyil 'khor spyi la pad ma rdor rje me ri 'ong ba'i tshab la 'dir pad ma dang 'ja' ris sum gshigs su bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lha snam sogs dkyil 'khor gyi nang gi kha dog rnams dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun zhing lte ba'i lha lnga'i sa bon 'god na so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i tshon (10ba)gyis dgod/gzhan yang jo bo yab sras kyi sku sogs dkon mchog gi rten gsum ci 'byor gnas khang dang mthun par bsham mo/ /drug pa rdzas dang mchod pa bsham pa la bum pa bsham pa/ gtor ma bsham pa/mchod pa bsham pa/ rgyan dgod pa dang bzhi/ rgyas par spro na rnam rgyal bum pa dang bcas pa'i bum pa bcu bdun/ bsdu na gcig gis kyang rung la/ las kyi bum pa dang bcas par bum rdzas kha rgyan mgul chings gzungs thag sogs rgyud sde spyi dang mthun/ las bum bgegs bsang ba'i stabs kyis thog ma nyid nas zur du bsgrubs na 'jug pa bde bas bum pa'i nang du khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba skyed pa sogs sgrub tshul spyi dang mthun no/ /rnam rgyal bum pa rnams spyi ltar na logs su sgrub dgos pa 'dra —32

bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi rgyun khyer dbang khrid kyi legs bshad phul byung dgongs rgyan/ (thadazhig 'dug na'ang / 'dir dkyil 'khor dang lhan cig tu sgrub pa yin no/ /de yang dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mañdzi 'am khre'u'i khar rnam bum/ dkyil 'khor gyi mthar stegs kyi bar phyogs re rer bum pa bzhi bzhi dgod/ las bum yang shar du gzhag go /gnyis pa ni/ bla ma rnams la gtor ma gcig /lha bzhi la gtor ma re re/ deng sang gsang sngags rnying mar grags pa'i brtan ma bcu gnyis dang mi gcig pa'i jo bo chen po'i rjes 'brang gi brtan ma bcu gnyis la gtor ma gcig /dkar po brgyad cu la gtor ma gcig /gzhi bdag gi gtor ma dang / mgron rigs spyi'i gtor ma rnams bsham mo/ /gsum pa ni/ mchod pa bdun tshar phyogs re rer tshar bcu drug gam/ bsdu na kun bsgril las bcu drug tsam bya/ bzhi pa ni/ sa rgyan gnam rgyan sogs bkod pas mdzes shing yid du 'ong bar bsham mo/ /bdun pa sgrub pa dngos ni/bum pa dang dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs te/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi (11na ji bus su zhugs pa'i tshul gyis sgrub pa yin la/ 'don cha'i tshig skyabs 'gro nas bzung bstod pa'i bar rgyun 'byer gyi skabs ji lta ba bzhin bya/ sgrub grogs gnas brtan bcu drug yod na dge slong bzhi bzhis phyogs re rer gnas nas sngags rgyun ma chad par gzung / bsdu na rang nyid gcig bus kyang rung bas/ dbus kyi spyi'i bum pa'i gzungs thag bsnyen pa thams cad dang / bum pa g.yin rnams thig le 'phos rim gyis gzungs thag kyang spo/ la la bum pa lngar byed pa sogs dang / sgrub grogs kyi dge slong res thig re grub par bshad pa ni byed par mi sems so/ /skabs 'dir sngags bzla zhing sgrub pa'i dmigs rim ni sngar rgyun 'khyer gyi skabs bzhin thig le bcu drug po thams cad rang gi sems kyi cha shas las grub pa'i bdag skyed kyi nga rgyal 'dzin na'ang / rang nyid las rang nyid gnyis pa zhig go sa logs su phye ste spyan ras gzigs phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gyur nas thig le phyi ma'i gzhal yas khang gi sgo phye ste thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho la mchod pa dang / phyag skor ba sogs byas par mos shing ngag nas kyang sngar gyi mchod pa dang bstod pa smon lam sogs rgyas par byas/ de'i sku'i ba spu'i bu ga re —33

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)nas kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa mthong zhing / de dag rnams la'ang mchod pa sogs yid kyis byas te dad pa dang bcas pa'i ngang nas rgyal ba rgya tsho'i thugs gar zla gdan la hrīḥyig gi mthar yi ge drug pas bskor ba la dmigs te yig drug ci nus su bzlas pas lha tshogs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dang bcas pa byung / rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas sdig sgrib thams cad (11brkog /dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam mo/ /de ltar thig le re la zhag re byas nas sgrub zhag bcu drug tsam byas te thig le re re'i sgrub pa song 'tshams su de ga'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma bcug ste dbang skur ba ni sgrub pa dang 'brel ba'i dbang yin pas slob dpon nam rin pa yan la phyag len 'di ga bzhin mdzad pa byung 'dug /deng sang 'jug pa bde ba sgrub pa yun ring thung ji tsam byed kyang sngon du song bar byas nas dbang dkyus thog gcig tu skur bar byed pa mang ngo / /de ltar gong du bzlas pa zin pa dang / rgyal ba rgya mtsho de nyid dgyes te thugs spu'i sgo phye nas rang nyid dkyil 'khor nang mar khrid par bsams la/ thub chen rnam snang gangs chen mtsho la mchod bstod bzlas pa'i dmigs pa sogs sngar gyi rigs 'gre zhing / thig le lhag ma kun la'ang rgyas dgab par bya'o/ /'di'i skabs bzla rgyu'i sngags ni thig le gnyis pa la oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu ni ye swāhā/ gsum pa dang bzhi pa la yig drug /lnga pa la/ ta du thā/ oṃ ga te ga te/pā ra ga te pā ra saṃ ga te bo lha swāhā/ drug pa mu ni/ bdun pa yig drug /brgyad pa oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re swāhā/ dgu pa swāhā'i tshab tu hūṃ phaṭa sbyar/ bcu pa oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ bcu gcig pa oṃ mahā gu ru di paṃ ka rā a ti sha swāhā/ bcu gnyis pa yig drug /bcu gsum pa oṃ mai hrī ye swāhā/ bcu bzhi pa oṃ wā gi shwa ri rlu/ bco lnga pa oṃ badz+ra : ka hūṃ/ bcu drug pa oṃ sna kā ya si d+dhi hūṃ zhes pa rnams so/ /bum pa rnams kyang dkyil 'khor dang tha mi dad du lhan cig bsgrubs nas/ dbang gi tshe lha tshogs rnams las gnyis pa zhig chad pa 'od du zhu ba bum chur gyur par bsams te bskur ba yin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ slob ma rnams phyi rol tu las bum gyis khrus byas/ nang (12na)du yon dbul zhing —34

bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi rgyun khyer dbang khrid kyi legs bshad phul byung dgongs rgyan/ 6)phyag 'tshal/ gral la 'khod de thog mar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangasargyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas nyes dmigs can gyi 'khor ba 'di spangs te thar pa'i yon tan thob par 'tshal bas slob dpon gyis de'i lam bstan du gsol zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ ming 'di zhes bya ba khyed rnams 'khor ba'i 'dam lasa'ada' bar byed pa'i lam thun mong ma yin pa nga las nyan par 'dod dam zhes dris nas/ slob mas/de kho na ltar 'tshal bas thugs brtse ba can slob dpon khyed kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag la thugs brtse bar mdzad du gsol zhes lan btab/ de nas slob dpon gyis 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang thar pa'i phan yon sogs spyi'i sngon du 'gro ba rgyud 'khul nges dang / glegs bam rin po che'i lo rgyus/ khyad par chos 'di'i che ba dang bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus sogs brjod de spro ba bskyed/ 'byom chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i rang rgyud la skul ma 'debs pa pad ma'i ljon shing tshar gcig bsgrags/de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam/ bar chad sel ba'i mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems skyed pa la sngar rgyun 'khyer gyi skabs kyi tshig rnams lan gsum gsum gyi rjes zlos byed du gzhug /rje stag tshang lo tsā ba'i dgongs pa ltar na sngags sdom bzung ba legs pa 'dra zhig 'dug cing / kho bo'ang 'thad par sems/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rnams dang tha mi dad pa'i rang bzhin can gyi ngang nas bla ma (12ba〉las bla ma gnyis pa zhig zur du phye ste spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal bas slob ma rnams khrid de phyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gzhal yas khang gi shar sgo phye nas nang du khrid/ der slob ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā bas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ 'od zer gyi 'phro 'dus thig le bcu drug gi lha tshogs spyan drangs te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya a —35

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)ba sha ya ā ā zhes ye shes pa dbab bo/ /sgrub pa dang 'brel ba'i zhag re la thig le re re byed pa'i skabs ye shes pa dbab pa'ang dkyil 'khor so so'i nang du lha gang yin par bskyed na legs so/dpe phal cher na ye shes pa 'bebs pa'i gsal kha mi 'dug kyang don gyi 'thob pas kha bkang ba yin no/ /de nas dbang dngos gzhi'i don du/ gang drin ma dang / kun mkhyen ye shes kyi gsol ba gdab/de nas slob mas spyan ras gzig rgyal ba rgya mtsho de'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad na sangs rgyas byang sems grangs med pa bzhugs pa la dmigs te/ dpon slob gnyis mnyam 'don nam rjes zlos gang rung gis yan lag bdun pa bya/ de nas lhan cig tu lha gang yin pa'i sngags 'ur bar bgrangs pa'i rkyen gyis rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum byung / slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob par bsam/ de nas bla ma'i thugs ga'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i zhing nas sangs rgyas byang sems lha dang lha mo khro bo khro mo dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te slob ma'i steng phyogs su bzhugs/ dbang lha rnams kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan (13na〉pa sogs pa'i mchod sprin gyis bar snang 'gengs/ me tog dang gur kum dang tsan dan phye ma sogs kyi char 'bebs/ lha'i rnga bo che la sogs pa rol mo'i sgra dang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad gsung bar mos nas/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs rol mo dang bcas par brjod/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / oṃ re ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ga ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ zhes spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ bum chu sbyin zhing gtor bas lus gang / dri ma dag /lha rang rang gi sa bon gyis spyi bor brgyan pa la dbang lha bstim par bya'o/ /de ltar sangs rgyas chos sku'i bar du rigs 'gre ste/ yan lag bdun pa man chad tshar re bya'o/ /gsum pa mjug gi cho ga ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogasal mchod bstod/ srung ma/ yul lha gzhi bdag /rgyal chen rnams la gtang rag gtang / rgyun 'khyer gyi skabs bzhin rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams bar bsdu bya/ rdul tshon gshegs shing yo byad bsdu ba sogs las kyi rjes ma mngon par bya'o/ /—36

bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi rgyun khyer dbang khrid kyi legs bshad phul byung dgongs rgyan/ (tha)gsum pa sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i lugs srol yongs su rdzogs par tshang ba shin tu rgyas pa'i lugs dgod pa ni/ spyir 'di nyid nyams len phyogs re tsam ma yin par bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i nyams len yin pas thig le dang po snod bcud mtha' dag la tha mal gyi snang ba bkag ste dag pa'i snang ba bskyed/ de nas thig le gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa rnams ni 'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa gsum ste/ dbang yang mdo lugs kyi 'od zer chen po lta bus byin gyis brlabs te bskur/ de bzhi la rten dkyil 'khor gyi thig le zhes kyang grags/ de rjes sher phyin ma thub pa spyan ras gzigs sgrol ma zhi ba rnams bya rgyud de/ chu cod pan gyi dbang mtshan nyid tshang bar bskur/ sgrol ma khro mo dang mi g.yo ba spyod rgyud du byas (13bti rig pa'i dbang lnga mtshan nyid tshang bar bskur/ 'di drug la brten pa lha'i thig le drag zer/ jo 'brom byams 'jam dbyangs bzhi rnal 'byor rgyud de/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang man mtshan nyid tshang bar bskur/ nyams len byin rlabs rgyud gsang sngags bla med yin pas dbang bzhi mtshan nyid tshang bar bskur/ 'di lnga la rtsa rgyud bla ma'i thig ler grags/ bcu drug pa sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i thig le 'di la dbang bzhi pa'i zung 'jug tu ngo sprod pa tsam gyis kyang rung mod/ deng sang gang dag gi bla chod dang bstun na/ chos kyi sku las bzhin lag gi rnam pa can du bzhengs 'dug pas dbang bzhi tshang bar bskur na legs par sems/ 'di la zung 'jug byang chub sems kyi thig ler grags so/ /yig rnying na thig le bcu bzhi pa'i gtso bo klu sgrub la mdzad 'dug kyang / bcu gsum pa byams par mdzad pa dang / brgyud pa'i rtsa ba gang la dpags kyang 'jam dbyangs nyid lung rigs kyis 'grub bo/ la la dag na re/ kha cig jo bo la bod kyi slob mas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor bris nas dbang bskur dang rjes gnang sogs byed pa yang snang ste/ de ltar na nā ro pa la mar pa sogs kyis bskor ba dang / ga ya dha ra la 'byog mi sogs kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'ang ci'i phyir mi rung / de dag rgyud sde gang gi cho ga yin/ rnam par mi 'tsham pa'i cho ga rdzun mas blun po slu bar ma byed cig ces zur za bar byed mod/ de ltar na/ rgyud mdzad pa ni thugs rdo rje/ /gsung ba po'ang brjod —37

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)pa'ang de/ /de las gzhan dag yod min pas/ /bde chen las ga' na gsung ba med/ ces dang / brtag gnyis las/ 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga / /rang gi tsho gis ldan nyan bo nga / zhes gsungs pa ltar gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde thams cad gsung pa po'i ston pa/ (14na po sungs pa'i brjod don/ nyan pa'i 'khor tshogs thams cad 'bras dus la bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rnam rol sha stag tu bshad pas/ de lta na skabs 'dir yang mgon po snang ba mtha' yas a ti sha yab sras gyi bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rnam rol tu shar bar smra na/ ma shar ba'i sgrub byed gang du 'chad rgyu yod/shar na 'di dang rgyud gsung pa po ston pa rdo rje 'chang gi bde stong la mchog dman nam spangs rtogs kyi khyad par 'byed rgyu yod pa e yin/ yod na sangs rgyas la mchog dman yod par khas len dgos par 'gyur/ gzhan yang jo 'brom zhes pa'i tshig tsam la chen nas khyed rang gis gong du/ de lta na mi'i bla ma dang slob dpon gzhan thams cad la yang rjes gnang ci'i phyir mi rung zhes pa'i zhe 'dod de gas ha las par gda' ba/ mi'i bla ma la byin rlabs dang rjes gnang mi 'ong na sman bla sprul sku dang bdag cag gi ston pa'i rjes gnang yang ma 'thad par 'gyur zhing / 'thad na de dag 'gro ba'i bla ma yin pa la smos ma dgos/ mi ma yin na mchog gi sprul sku dge slong rnam dag ma yin par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang nā ro pa dang ga ya dha ra la brten pa'i dkyil 'khor med pa yang mi 'grub ste/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma gang yin pa de dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor byas te bla ma mchod pa dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs mkhas grub tshad ldan la grags pa rnams 'thad par khas len dgos la/ de ltar na de 'dra ba dngos su ston byed kyi dka' bstan bcos kyi lung khungs ma gang ston rgyu yod/ rdo rje slob dpon lus 'di la/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni rim bzhin gnas/ zhes pa lta bu'i tshig la ngos 'dzin na/ de 'dra'i tshig gis thig le bcu drug (14ba)kyang don gyis bstan par bshad na de la skyon gtong rgyu yang yod/ thig le bcu drug la dbang sogs bshad pas mi 'dra zer na/ bla ma mchod pa dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor la'ang dbang bzhi len par 'dug pas de gnyis don cis mi mtshungs/ gzhan yang thig le bcu drug 'di'i dbang dang —38

bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi rgyun khyer dbang khrid kyi legs bshad phul byung dgongs rgyan/ 'dasgrub skor sogs gsang sngags spyi'i skad dang mthun mi mthun sna tshogs 'dug par smra na/ dus kyi 'khor lo'ang rgyud gzhan dang bshad srol mi mthun pas chos log tu smros shig /g.yin yang jo bo a ti sha lta bu'i skyes bu la'ang gsang sngags lam/ mkhas pa'i thugs rgyal lan gnyis su chag par bshad pas rdo rje theg pa la yod med kyi tshad gzung sems can gyis bya ba'i yul min zhing / 'phags chen dam pa rnams kyi dag pa'i snang ba la 'di 'char dang 'di mi 'char zhes rang cag tshur mthong gi skye bo rnams kyis dpyod pa'i gnas ga la yin/ /gsang ba 'dus pa mtha' drug dang tshul bzhi'i rgyas 'debs pa dang / dus 'khor phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi rgyas 'debs pa'ang snang tshul 'di 'dra la dgongs shing / nyan thos sde pa rnams kyis theg pa chen po bka' min zhes zer ro/ /la la dag rje bla mas glegs bam ma gsan cing / byang chub lam gyi rim par glegs bam gyi lung 'dren gtan nas ma mdzad 'dug pas glegs bam chos rnam dag min no zhes zer mod/ spyir chos kyi rgyal po myong kha pa chen po sangs rgyas dngos yin pa la de nyid kyis glegs bam gyi chos gsan ma gsan sogs kyi tshad gzung sus rtogs/ rtogs na ni khyod kyis nam mkha'i mtha' 'jal bar nus 'dug pas ngo mtshar che/byang chub lam rim ni skyes bu mchog dman mtha' dag sangs rgyes su 'khrid par byed pa'i lam gyi 'gros ston pa'i tshogs chos yin la/ glegs bam 'di ni slob dpon (15na skom rin pa yan chad du bka' rgya shin tu dog /de nas cung yangs su song yang rje dge 'dun grub yan chad du bka' rgya dam me ba rang mdzad pa zhig byung 'dug pas rgyal ba myong kha pa chen pos snyan brgyud yin par dgongs nas lam rim du gzhung 'dren ma mdzad pa yin na/ snyan brgyud/ chog brgyud/ tsho gos chos sogs kyi rnam dbye ma dod par mig gis mthong ba dang / rna bas thos tshad kyi tshig skam kha la khyer nas sto phyir du kun la sgrog cing / rang nyid dang ma mthun pa rgyu mtshan du byas te chos la brten pa'i sdig pa gsog pa'i smre sngags kyi skad ngan phyogs bcur sgrog pa rnams dang sngon byon gyi dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyi rnam thar mi 'dra bas blo ldan rnams legs par rtogs shig /e ma sde snod gsum dang rgyud sdebazhi/ /stan thog —39—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)gcig tu nyams su len pa'i thabs/ /med byung snying gi thig le'i nyin byed kyis/ /skal bzang 'dab brgya'i tshogs rnams ring nas 'dzum/ /brgal zhing brtag pa mkhas pa'i lugs yin yang / /kun slong ngan pas nyer drangs rang bzhin chos/ /du mar smad pa'i dkar min las 'bras kyis/ /mtha' med 'khor ba'i 'khor lo bskor gyi dogs/ /blo ngan bzang brdzus bstan pa nyams pa'i las/ /dar zhing rgyas byed me tog mda' can sku/ /skye ba'i zlos gar sgyur de deng dus kha/ /bdud kyis phye ba zum par nus dka' yang / /cal sgrog brag ca'i sgra yis ri dwags kun/ /'jigs skrag duḥkha'i pha mthar btang ba bzhin/ /'gro mang log par 'phyan las bzlog slad du/ /the tshom sel ba'i tshig sbyor cung zad spel/zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gsum pa skal ldan gyi slob ma la (15bskoms khrid du 'debs pa'i rim pa la sngon 'gro/dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum/ dang po sngon 'gro la skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ skyabs yul gyi gtso bo rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i spyan ras gzigs bsgom/ gzhan 'khrid spyi dang mthun/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i spyi dang mthun/ bzhi pa'ang bla ma spyan ras gzigs su skyed pa tsam ma togs/ ku su lu'i tsho gos gsog maṇ+ḍal dbang bzhi rnams spyi dang 'dra/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la 'khrid skor bcu drug las/ dang po ni/phyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rten pa tsam zhig bdag nyid gsal 'dab/ snod bcud thams cad la tha mal gyi snang zhen yang nas yang du bkag ste dag pa'i snang bar sgyur ba la nan tan bya/ de'i ngang nas rang las gnyis pa zhig chad de dkyil 'khor gyi nang du 'ongs/ sngar gyi lha tshogs rnams la yan lag bdun pa dang / bzlas pa lan grangs mang po'i bar du bya/ thun bsdu ba'i tshe mi dmigs pa'i ngang du 'jig /'khrid rkang gzhan bco lnga po rnams la'ang phyag mchod bzlas pa la nan tan du bya ba la khyad par med/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par thig le gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa rnams la rim pa bzhin skyes bu chung ngu'i khrid/ 'bring gi khrid/ chen po theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong ba'i khrid rnams bsgom/ lnga pa —40

bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi rgyun khyer dbang khrid kyi legs bshad phul byung dgongs rgyan/ (thadal sher phyin gyi thugs ga'i 'od zer gyi 'phro 'dus bdud sde'i dpung tshogs rnams bcom nas zhi bar bsam mo//drug pa bdun pa brgyad pa dgu pa bcu pa rnams la bka' gdams lha bzhi'i khrid bsgom zhing /khyad par sgrol ma drag mo dang mi g.yo ba gnyis la dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i dmigs pa dang drag sngags 6na ) bzla/thig le bcu gcig pa 'dir ni brgyud pa gsum la brten pa'i bla ma'i sgrub pa gtso bor bya/bcu gnyis par glegs bam rin po che'i skyes rabs spyi dang /khyad par dkon mchog 'bangs kyis u rgyan gyi yul du byon pa'i rdo rje'i glu dang chos zab mo dpag tu med pa'i skor gyi rnam thar rnams yid yul du nges par byas nas rang nyid kyang blos der phyin pa dang de 'dra ba byas pa'i bsam sgom nan tan du bya/bcu gsum pa la zhi gnas gtso bor bsgom/bcu bzhi pa la zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba bsgom/bco lnga par rang gang mos pa'i bla med kyi rgyud sde zhig gi rdzogs rim dang sbyar na legs/bcu drug pa ni sangs rgyas chos sku'i thig le de nyid grangs med par spro zhing sdud pa sogs kyi ngang nas thig le'i nang du sangs rgyas kyi zhing rten brten par bcas pa grangs med pa 'char ba dang /de rnams la rang nyid kyis mjal zhing chos nyan pa sogs mang du bsams pa'i mthar thig le de nyid gsal stong dbyings rig spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang du mnyam par gzhog/thun bsdu ba ni bcu drug po thams cad la rigs 'gre'o//gsum pa mjug bsdu ba ni/'khrid rgyun 'khyer du nyams su len na bcu drug po gzhan rnams rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar 'chag med tsam byas/rang gang mos pa zhig dang /bcu drug pa gnyis la nan tan du bya/shin tu bsdus pa byed na/thig le thams cad kyi skyed chog tsam byas nas/nyams kho dmigasaphug pa gcig la byas kyang rung ngo //smras pa/rgyal ba kun gyi r+bhe gas rje'i bdag nyad mchog/cig ga bsdusabaka' gdams mes po 'brom stone rje//gangs can 'gro ba'i gawo cig ga pad dkar 'chang /cad kyi gsang gsum pha1tha sgo tha' rtogs nus//de phyir zab mo'i don 'di chu gter bzhin//gting mtha' tshad du gzhal ba'i yul min yang //mkhas pa'i legs baXd la brten rang nyid kyi//blo gros dag gis zhib

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)mor dpyad de bkod/ /dge 'dis lha cho ge bdun ldan brgyud pa'i srol/ /bka' gdams bstan pa'i nyin byed 'od stong gis/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin khyon kun rab khyab ste/ /phan bde'i snang ba rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces bka' gdams rin po che'i glegs bam gyi nying khu thig le bcu drug tu gragasapa'i rgyun 'khyer dbang 'khrid dang bsam pa'i rim pa phul byung dgongs rgyan zhes pa 'di'ang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gsar rnying gi chos tshul rgya mtsho chen po la rnam dpyod kyi 'jug pa mchog tu yangs shing khyad par rje btsun sa skya ba'i zab chos kun gyi yang rtse sa skya tshang kyi rna bar ma grags pa'i gsang chen slob bshad ces pa rje kha'u pa'i bstan 'dzin chen po gnas gsar nas chos kyi rje mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyi gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang bshes gnyen dam pa'i gzugs can 'khon ston chos kyi rgyal po dpal 'byor lhun grub sogs dam pa du ma'i bka' drin las sa dge bka' phyag gsang sngags rnying ma sogs la blo gros kyi snang ba cung zad dkar zhing khyad par chos tshul 'di pa 'brom ston chos kyi rgyal po'i byin rlabs kyi zla zer snying la 'phos pa'i bka' gdams kyi btsun pa ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes rgyal ba zhes pa sa mo glang gi lo rgyal bas cho 'phrul bstan pa'i dus ston gyi tshes bcu dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus dge bar gru 'dzin gnyis pa dga' ldan pho brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so// maṅga lo//—42

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyun 'byer gyi rnal 'byor reg zig bklags chog tu bkod pa/ 6)dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyun 'byer gyi rnal 'byor reg zig bklags chog tu bkod pa bkun tha sdo/lnga ldan ye shes gshin rje'i rigs kun gyi/ khyab bdag ma he'i zhal can gzhen nu'i sku/ /lcang lo'i zur phud ngom pa mtshams sprin gos/ /legs mnabs blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis skyongs/ /'jig rten mig gcig lnga yi bzhed srol la/ /bltos min 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi zhal lung bcud/ /sgrub thabs thugs gsang rin cen za ma tog /'khyil bde spyod ldan dga' bskyed legs pa'i lam/ /bcu gsum 'khor lo'i za 'og thags ris la/ /byin rlabs dbang gzhu'i mdangs tshon bkrag po che/ /kun gyi gzigs mor ya mtshan rnam 'phrul gyis/ /sgyu ma'i khengs pa da gdod bag la zha/ /rtse gcig nyams su bstar na skyed rim gyi/ /sku gsum lam byed ting 'dzin rta bdun pas/ /nyer drangs rdzogs rim mi slob zung 'jug gi /mkha' dbyings sa der bgrod la gcig tu nye/ /de phyir bsgos don nya phyis khog pa sa /zab brling mu tig phyur bur spungs pa'i mig /kha skong mtshon gyis phug pa (2na〉rjod bde yi/ /srad bur brgyus pa'i 'phreng rgyan deng 'dir spel/ /de yang dgra gdong 'jigs gsum sogs gshin rje nag po'i chos skor gyi nang nas gtso bor gyur pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub dkyil gzhung man ngag la paṇa grub lo tsā ba'i bzhed srol mi 'dra ba mang du byung bar bod kyi bla ma snga phyi mang pos 'grel lugs tha dad na'ang / rgyal ba gnyis pa shar btsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis yongs 'dzin gzhan la ma bltos par bla ma 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi bka' drin la brten nas shing rta'i srol phye ba'i sgrub thabs za ma tog rdo rje'i tshig rkang lta bu la nag 'gros su bris pa 'ga' zhig snang bar ras bris rdul tshon sogs kyi dmigs rten gang yang med par —43

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)bdag bskyed kyi rnal 'byor tsam la bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig pu la khyad gzhi med pa'i khyad chos ngag 'don gyi mtshams sbyor dang mngon rtogs kyi gsal byed kha 'geng dgos pa rnams ma bkang ba/thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor med kyang chad lhag tu ma 'gyur ba 'bad pas bcug par mjug tu (2ba〉sho bor lo 'khor ba dang bzlog pa sogs kyi sham bu gang yang med pa phyogs skyong gi mngon rtogs gtor chog gi skabs dgos pa cho ga'i dkyus su 'jug pa sogs rje bla ma'i dgongs pa ma lon zhing gsung 'phros ma zin pa 'dra snyam pa'i dogs gnas rgyud sde spyi nas gzhal tshe kun rtog me long du shar ba rgyun 'khyer gyi rnal 'byor kho na'i reg zig chu 'bab gyi tshul du bkod par/ dang po/ sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin la skyabs 'gro na/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems thams cad du 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ lan gsum/bla ma dang dkon cog rin po che rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sems bskyed ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po bsgom par bgyi'o/ lan gsum/ rdor sems sgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor paṃ las pad ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa gnyis rka'ang rin po che'i rgyan sna (3na)tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs gar zla ba'i steng du hūṃ yig dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa pa ri wā ra arnya nas sha lta pra titsā hūṃ swāhā/ dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bsam/ slar yang thugs —44

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyun 'khyer gyi rnal 'byor reg zig bklags chog tu bkod pa/ thenaga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rnams oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa kū la sa pa ri wā ra a: nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye āḥ&/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang / mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ semasacan thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dag /sangs rgyas sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi yon tan thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas thugs ga'i hūṃ yig la thim pas gzi brjid dang mthu stobs phun sum tshogs par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa tilgadṛ sgo me bha wa su to stso me bha wa/ a nu ra sto me bha wa/ su (3ba)po stso me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi m+me pra ya ts+tsha /sarba da rma su tsa me tsi/ shri yeḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha lha che bha ga wa na sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me mu sma ba dz+rī bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhid nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /gas rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyi sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag go /zhes gsungs nas rang la thim pas rang gi sgo gsum dang rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed par bsam/ tshogs zhing ni/ rang nyid 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i thugs gar pad ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis 'jig rten gyi khams mu med pa gsal bar byas de na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang khro bo dang rig pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i rdo rje 'jigs byed bla ma dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ 'od zer rang gi snying gar bsdu/ /gang —45

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)gi drin gyis bde chen gnas/ /skad cig gis ni thob 'gyur ba/ /bla ma rin cen lta bu yi/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /gzugs mchog mchog tu drag po che/ /dpa' bo mchog gi spyod yul can//gdul dka' 'dul ba'i don mdzad pa/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed la phyag 'tshal/ zhes bla ma dang lha la phyag bya/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od (4na)zer las byung ba'i tsa rtsi kā dkar mo/ phag mo sngon mo/dbyangs can ma dmar mo/ go rī ljang gu /phyag na mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa thogs pa rnams kyis mchod par bsam/ i hrīḥrdzi has mchod yon/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kyis zhabs bsil/ oṃ li kri tā na na du sna satwa da ma ka gaḥgaḥyis dri/ oṃ ku mā ra rū pi ṇi dzaḥdzaḥ〉 phaṭa kyis me tog /rmi rti lha lha phaṭa kyis bdug spos/oṃ di snya lo tsa na li kri tā na na ma hā aṭ+wā sna ha sa na di ni di lta ye swāhās mar me/ oṃ badz+ra ni wi t+ya āḥ& swā hās lha bshos/ oṃ badz+ra sha sna āḥ/ gis rol mo rnams dbul la lha mo rnams slar bsdu/ sdig pa rnams ni bshags par bya/ /skyes shing byung ba rnams ni bsal/ /mi byed pa yang spyan sngar brjod/ /de bzhin bsod nams rjes yi rang / /bdag gis bde 'gror yongs su bsngo/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ sems can thams cad bdag gis dgrol/ /byang chub gnas la 'god par bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni yang dag bskyed/ /yon tan rgya mtsho khyed rnams la/ /bdag gi lus ni dbul bar bgyi/ /yang dag rdzog pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /de sras lam gyur sbyin sogs tshul/ /sku gsum ye shes thob bya'i phyir/ /rab tu dang bas bsten par bgyi/ /zhes de dag gi don yid la bsam/ /rigs lnga spyi dang so so'i dam tshig dang sdom pa sngar bzung ba rnams byang chub ma thob kyi bar du brtan par gzung bar bya'o snyam du bsams la/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams//bdag la dgongs par (4ba)mdzad du gsol/ /yong grags kyi ming las gsang mas mi brjod/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis/ bskyed par —46

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyun 'byer gyi rnal 'byor reg zig bklags chog tu bkod pa/ 6)bgyi/ tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bdag gis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon cog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas bdag gis bzung / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po yi/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin cen rigs mchoge chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po lasabyung ba'i/ /pad ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam chos so sor bzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du so sor bzung / /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdome pa ma lus bzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma 11la ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs (ldan〉〉grang zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig /sems can thamasacad bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad dang gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog gis mi bskyod pa'i btang snyoms la gnas par bya'o snyam du tshad med bzhi bsgoms te bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ oṃ su bhā wa shus sarba dha rmāḥsu bhā wa shu d+dha3nya/ ma shā n+ya tā dzña na badz+ra su bhā wa glo ko3nya/ rang dang tshogs zhing gi lha dang de dag las gzhan pa'i chos thams cad brten nas btags pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtag chad la sogs pa'i mtha' bzhi dang bral ba bdag med pa'i stong pa nyid du bsam te ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /de nas sngon gyi smon lam dran par byas la/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba'i mdog can gzhu lta bu rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar ba'i phreng bas —47

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'bor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du lo las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhir rdo rjes mtshan pa'i steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ logs su 'phros pas rdo rje'i rwa ba/steng du 'phros pas rdo rje'i gur/ gur gyi 'og ra ba'i steng du rdo rje'i bla bre ste thams cad kyang rdo rje 'bar ba'i (5ba)rang bzhin bar mtshams med par dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi rol tu bskal pa 'jig pa'i me lta bu'i kha dog sna lnga'i me dpung phyogs bcur 'phro bar bsam pa srung 'khor thun mong ba'o/ /rwa ba'i dbus su rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po dkar mthing dmar ba zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad ma 'dzin pa yongs su gyur pa las chos 'byung dkar po gru gsum pa gyen du 'greng ba'i 'og tu phra zhing stod yangs pa/ 'og zur nas baṃ las byung ba'i sna tshogs pad ma'i lte bar hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar gyi rwa dkar/ lho'i rwa ser/ nub kyi rwa dmar/ byang gi rwa ljang /dbus kyi lte ba sngon pos brgyan pa/ lte ba'i dbus su ༷ las 'khor lo ra gis mtshan pa las byung ba'i rnam snang dkar po dkar mthing dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis rdo rje la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad ma 'dzin pa yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ phyi rol nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rtsig pa'i steng na rin po che sna tshogs pas mdzes par byas pa'i rin po che'i pha gus bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du rdo rje'i 'phreng bas zlum por bskor ba la brten pa'i ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mdzes par phub pa/ rtse mor rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i tog gis mdzes pa'i nang gi shar dkar (6na〉( ser nub dmar byang ljang dbus sngo ba/ pha gu'i steng na gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa dang rnga yab la sogs pas brgyan pa/ de'i phyi ngos —48

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyun 'khyer gyi rnal 'byor reg thig bklags chog tu bkod pa/ 6)su bya 'dab las 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i shar bu/ de'i steng du mda' yab pad ma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can la ba dan dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa/ rtsig pa'i mtha' nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar pos 'gram stegs kyi rnam par bskor ba la lha mo mchod rdzas thogs pa rnams 'khod nas mchod pa byed pa/ sgo dang sgo 'byud kyi phyi'i mtshams dang 'og gi phyi nang gi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje rin cen gyis spras pa/ sgo bzhi so so'i mdun du ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i steng du chos kyi 'khor lo/ de'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ rdo rje'i ra ba me ri dang bcas pa'i phyi rol tu gtum drag la sogs pa'i dur khrod brgyad na nā ga ge sar gyi shing la sogs pa'i shing brgyad/ de'i rtsa bar brgya byin la sogs pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad/ rtse mor rdzu phrul chen po ba glang po che'i gdong pa can la sogs pa'i zhing skyong brgyad/ thugs rje'i chu brgyad/ de la gnas pa'i nor rgyas la sogs pa'i klu brgyad/ de dag gi steng gi nam mkha' la sgrogs pa la sogs pa'i sprin brgyad/ ye shes kyi me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ g.yin yang keng rusadang / gsal shing gis phug pa'i ro dang / shing la dpyangs pa dang / skyes bu za ba dang / mtshon gyisaphug pa la sogs pa dang / bya (6ba〉(ga dang / bya rgod dang / khyi dang / ce spyang dang / seng ge dang / stag la sogs pa dang / ca co sgrog pa'i ro langs dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po la sogs pa rnams kyis 'jigs su rung ba/ grub pa dang / rig pa 'dzin pa dang / dam tshig spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa bcom ldan 'das la rtse gcig tu blta ba/ gsar bu skra bshig pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ cang te'u dang /thod pa dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ thod pas spyi bor brgyan pa/ rgod cing dur khrod du 'jug pa sogs kyis shin tu ngo mtshar bar byed pa'i dur khrod rnams kyis bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi re mig dgu pa'i dbus su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag la cung zad dmar ba'i mdog can gyi steng dang / nang gi phyogs gzhan gsum dang sgo bzhin sna tshogs pad ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ nang gi shar dang grwa bzhi dang phyi'i grwa bzhir sna tshogs pad ma dang zla ba'i gdan zung re re bsgoms te rten bskyed —49

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)pa'o/ /gdan dbus ma'i steng du a yig dang po las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su chu las chu bur gyi tshul du lhaḥser po las byung ba'i ral gri'i dbus su lhaḥs mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas bde bar gshegs pa thams cad oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jam dpal gzhen nur gyur pa sku mdog ser po yid tsam khros pa phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing / g.yon gyis glegs bam thugs kar bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan so gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus (7na〉rgyan pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par bsam/ de'i thugs gar āḥlas byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i rnam snang la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang /rdo rje rnon po la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa'i khro bo dang /sems ma rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i rig pa rnams oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs te 'jam dpal dang bcas pa nyi ma la zhugs pas 'od zer gyis dpag tshad stong phrag brgyar khyab pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du bsam/ de'i steng du hūṃ yig mthing kha 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang khro bo dang rig pa'i tshogs rnams oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs nas hūṃ la zhugs pa las khro bo'i rdo rje kha dog nag po rtse dgu pa rwa shin tu gdengs pa/ 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las rdo rje phra mo'i gzugs spros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / khro bo dang rig pa'i tshogs rnams spros te/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad til gyi gang bu bzhin du gang ba/ nyi ma la gnas pas sems can rnams smin par byas nas rdo rje 'jigs byed thob par byas pa dang lhan cig tu 'dus nas rdo rje la thim par bsam/ zla ba nyi ma rdo rje sa bon dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu phyag so bzhi zhabs bcu drug pa g.yas bskum zhing (7ba)g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ khams gsum po za bar nus pa/ ha ha zhes sgrog cing —50

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyun 'byer gyi rnal 'byor reg zig bklags chog tu bkod pa/ thenaljags 'dril pa/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa khro gnyer can khro gnyer gyi 'gram du smin ma dang spyan 'jig pa'i dus ltar 'bar ba/ skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'dasapa'i lha la sdigs mdzub byed pa/ 'jigs pa rnams kyang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ h+pha ka ra'i sgra chen po 'byug ltar sgrog pa/ mi'i khrag dang / zhag dang / rkang dang tshil bu za ba/ 'jigs su rung ba'i thod pa skam po lngas thod byas shing / mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu'i thod pa'i 'phrong bas brgyan pa/ sbrul nag po'i mchod phyir thogs dang / mi rus kyi 'khor lo dang rna cha la sogs pa'i rus pa'i rgyan rnams kyis brgyan pa/ gsus pa che ba gcer bu'i gzugs can smin ma dang rdzi ma dang sma ra dang ba spu rnams dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar zhing rtsa zhal nag po ma he'i gdong can shin tu khros pa rwa rnon po can/ de'i steng ma rwa gnyis kyi dbus kyi zhal dmar po rab tu 'jigs pa'i zhal nas khrag 'dzag pa/ de'i steng du 'jam dpal gyi zhal ser po yid tsam khros pa/ gzhon nu'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ spyi bor ral pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rwa'i rtsa ba'i g.yas kyi zhal dang po sngon po/ de'i g.yas zhal dmar po/ g.yon zhal ser po/ rwa'i rtsa ba'i g.yon gyi zhal dang po dkar po/ de'i g.yas zhal dud kha/ g.yon zhal nag po zhal rnamasashin tu khros pa/ zhal dgu po thams cad kyang spyan gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /phyag g.yas g.yon gyi dang po gnyis (8na)kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa mgo g.yas dang spu phyir bstan te lag pa dang rkang pa'i pags pa g.yon pa nas brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ lhag ma g.yas kyi dang po na gri gug /gnyis pa na bhi dhi pā la/ gsum pa na gtun shing / bzhi pa na chu gri /drug pa na dgra sta/ bdun pa na mdung /brgyad pa na mda'/ dgu pa na lcags kyu/ bcu pa na dbyug to/ bstogacig pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /bcu gnyisapa na 'khor lo/ bcu gsum pa na rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ bcu bzhi pa na rdo rje tho ba/ bco lnga pa na ral gri /bcu drug pa na cang te'u bsnams shing / lhag ma g.yon gyi dang po na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ gnyis pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo/ gsum pa na phub/ bzhi pa na rkang pa/ lnga pa na zhags pa/ drug pa na gzhu/bdun pa na rgyu ma/ brgyad pa na dril bu/ dgu pa na lag pa/ bcu pa na dur khrod kyi ras/ bcu gcig pa —51

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)na skyes bu gsal shing la btsugs pa/ brgya gnyis pa na me thab/ bcu gsum pa na thod tshal/ bcu bzhi pa na sdigs mdzub/ bco lnga pa na 'phan rtse gsum pa/ bcu drug pa na rlung ras bsnams pa'o/ /zhabasagayas kyi dang pos mi/ gnyis pas ma he/ gsum pas glang / bzhi pas bong bu/ lnga pas rnga mo/ drug pas khyi/ bdun pas lug /brgyad pas wa dang g.yon gyi dang pos bya rgod/ gnyis pas 'ug pa/ gsum pas bya rog /bzhi pas zhe tso/ lnga pas khra/ drug pas bya chen po/ bdun pas khyim bya/ brgyad pas bzhad mnan pa/ tshangs (8ba) pa dang / dbang po dang / khyab 'jug dang / drag po dang / gzhon nu gdong drug dang / log 'dren dang / zla ba dang / nyi ma rnams kha sbub tu byas te zhabs 'og tu mnan nas me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhug par bsam/ rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs mar zla gdan la ye shes sems dpa'/ 'jam dpal gzhen nur gyur pa sku mdog ser po yid tsam khros pa nas rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par bsam/ de'i thugs gar āḥlas byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ yig mthing kha 'od zer lnga 'phro bar bsam/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje ro langs ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas rdo rje gri gug 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod pa gdug pa'i khrag gis bkang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ thod skam lngas dbu brgyan cing / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon pas yab la 'khyud pa/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa las hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ oṃ las byung ba'i nor bu'i bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa las hūṃ las byung ba'i pad ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ āḥlas byung ba'i ze'u 'bru'i bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa glo ko3lha/ zhes 'du shes gsum dran par byas pa/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin ni/ rang gi thugs rka'i hūṃ yig gi 'od zer gyi lcags kyus mkha' khyab kyi sangs rgyas thams cad bkug nas rang (9na〉na zhal du bcug /thugs kur 'od du zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad mar zhugs pa'i thig le cha gcig lhaḥdang bcas —52

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyun 'byer gyi rnal 'byor reg zig bklags chog tu bkod pa/ thenapa de yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gdan dang bcas par bsam/ thig le cha gcig gdan de rnams kyi steng du cha bcu bdun du bsam/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ nang gi shar du k+ṣe las 'khor lo hās mtshan pa/ lhor ma las rin po che mas mtshan pa/ nub tu me las pad ma mes mtshan pa/ byang du da las ral gri das mtshan pa/ shar sgor yaṃ las tho ba yas mtshan pa/lho sgor tsa las dbyug pa tsas mtshan pa/ nub sgor ni las pad ma nis mtshan pa/ byang sgor rā las ral gri rā sa mtshan pa/ nang gi shar lhor dzā las 'khor lo dzā sa mtshan pa/ lho nub tu sa las rdo rje sa sa mtshan pa/ nub byang du do las pad ma dos mtshan pa/ byang shar du ru las ral gri rus mtshan pa/phyi'i grwa bzhir ṇa yo ni ra'i yi ge bzhi rnams 'od zer 'phro zhing 'du ba phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur ba las dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi sku yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu phyag so bzhi zhabs bcu drug pa/ zhes pa nas me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje ro langs ma sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ zhes pa nas (9ba)g.yon pas yab la 'khyud pa/ nang gi shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri /g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad ma 'dzin pa/ lhor ser sna gshin rje gshed ser po ser sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis nor bu dang ral gri /g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad ma 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis pad ma dang ral gri /g.yon gnyis nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ byang du phrag dog —53

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)gshin rje gshed ljang gu ljang sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'gyud nga / lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad ma 'dzin pa shar sgor tho ba gshin rje gshed sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la la 'khyud pa/lhag ma g.yas gnyis tho ba sngon po rwa nyi shu pa dang ral gri /g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad ma 'dzin pa/lho sgor dbyug pa gshin rje gshed dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis dbyug pa dang ral gri /g.yon gnyis pad ma dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ nub sgor pad ma gshin rje gshed dmar po dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis pad ma dang ral gri /g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang nor bu 'dzin pa/ byang sgor ral gri gshin rje gshed ljang gu ljang sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad ma 'dzin pa/ yab (10na〉rgyad po thams cad dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ sbom zhing thung la gsus khyim che ba glang po che'i ko ba'i stod g.yogs dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/rus pa'i rwa lugs kyi mngon rtogs yid bzhin nor bu/rdo rje 'chang sgo rus pas dgra nag gi sgrub thabs zhi khro rnam rol sogs nas la thor gyi lha'i ma' rtogs mi gsal ba kha bkang / rgyan drug dang rdo rje'i phreng ba can/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / 'bar ba'i mche ba rnon po bzhi bzhi rab tu gtsigs nas/ ljags rnam par 'dril zhing 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba/ mtha' yas sngon pos dbu skra bcings shing 'jog po dmar pos rna rgyan byas pa/ rigs ldan khra bos dpung pa brgyan cing dung skyong ser pos lag gdub —54

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyun 'byer gyi rnal 'byor reg zig bklags chog tu bkod pa/ 6)byas pa/ pad ma dkar pos mgul rgyan byas shing stobs rgyu ljang gus mchode phyir thogs byas pa/ nor rgyas kre pa bdud rtsi'i kha dog lta bus ska rags byas shing pad ma chen po dkar pos zhabs gdub byas pa/ klu brgyad po thams cad kyang phud kyi sgra sgrog cing / lce gnyis pa dug dang ldan pa'i mche ba'i 'phreng ba can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ste ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /nang gi shar lhor tsa tsi kā dkar mo shin tu skem zhing drag tu khros pa dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i (10ba 'ab la 'byud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo ral gri /g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad ma 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu phag mo sngon mo phag gdong can sbom zhing thung la gsus pa 'phyang ba sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yab la 'khrud pa/lhag ma g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri /g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad ma 'dzin pa/ nub byang du dbyangs can ma dmar mo zhi ba'i cha byad can dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yab la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis pad ma dang ral gri /g.yon gnyis nor bu dang 'bor lo 'dzin pa/ byang shar du go rī ljang gu sbom zhing thung la gsus pa phyang ba ljang sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yab la 'byud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad ma 'dzin pa/ yum bzhi rka'ang thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can gcer mo phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas skum zhing g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs kyis bzhugasapa/ phyi'i drwa bzhin yi ge bzhi yongs su gyur pa las mi'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhin bsam/ oṃ hrī:sti nas hūṃ phaṭa/ gtso bo yab yum bskul dpag tu med par gyur/ yum gyi ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/ phyogs bcur gshegs/ sems can rnams kyi zhe sdang sbyangs/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la bkod/ gcig tu 'dus rang dang yum la thim par bsam/ rmidzi na dzi ka /gti mug gshin rje gshed —53

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)yab yum bskul/ dpag tu med par gyur/ gong dang 'gre'o/ yum gyi ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/phyogs bcur gshegs/ sems can rnams kyi gti mug sbyangs/ me long lta bu'i ye shes la bkod/gcig tu 'dus rang dang yum la thim par bsam/ nang gi shar gyi gdan la 'khod/ ma(11na)rat+na dhi ka /ser sna gshin rje gshed bskul/ dpag tu med par gyur/ yum gyi ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/sems can rnams kyi nga rgyal dang ser sna sbyangs/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la bkod/ gcig tu 'dus rang dang yum la thim par bsam/ lto'i gdan la 'khod/ oṃ a ro li ga /'dod chags gshin rje gshed yab yum bskul/ dpag tu med par gyur/ yum gyi ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/ phyogs bcur gshegs/ sems can rnams kyi 'dod chags sbyangs/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes la bkod/ gcig tu 'dus rang dang yum la thim par bsam/ nub kyi gdan la 'khod/ oṃ pra dzñā lha ka /phrag dog gshin rje gshed yab yum bskul/ dpag tu med par gyur/ yum gyi ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/ phyogs bcur gshegs/ sems can rnams kyi phrag dog sbyangs/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes la bkod/ gcig tu 'dusarang dang yum la thim par bsam/ byang gi gdan la 'khod/ oṃ muṅka lja ka /tho ba gshin rje gshed yab yum bskul/ dpag tu med par gyur/ yum gyi ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/ phyogs bcur gshegs/sems can rnams kyi phung po'i bdud bcom/ dad pa'i stobs la bkod/ gcig tu 'dus rang dang yum la thim par bsam/ shar sgo'i dbus su 'khod/ oṃ daṇ+ḍan+t+ra ka /dbyug pa gshin rje gshed yab yum bskul/ dpag tu med par gyur/ yum gyi ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/ phyogs bcur gshegs/sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs pa'i le lo sbyangs/ brtson 'grus kyi ye shes la bkod/ gcig tu 'dus rang dang yum la thim par bsam/ lho sgo'i gdan la 'khod/ oṃ pad+ma d+dhi ka /pad ma gshin rje shed yum bskul/ dpag tu med par gyur/ yum gyi ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/ phyogs bcur gshegs/sems can rnams kyi 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom/ dran pa'i gshin rje gshed yab yum bskul/ gcig tu 'dus rang dang yum la thim par bsam/ nub sgo'i gdan la 'khod/ oṃ kha thi n+t+ra ga ral gri gshin —56

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyun 'byer gyi rnal 'byor reg zig bklags chog tu bkod pa/ 6)gshin rje gshed yab yum bskul/ dpag du med par gyur/ yum gyi ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/phyogs bcur gshegs/ sems can rnams kyi lha'i bu'i zhe sdang sbyangs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ye shes la bkod/ gcig tu 'dus rang dang yum la thim par bsam/ byang sgo'i gdan la 'khod/ oṃ mo ha ra ti/tsa tsi ka yab yum bskul/ dpag du med par gyur/ yum gyi ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/ phyogs bcur gshegs/ sems can rnams kyi sa'i khams sbyangs/ byams pa tshad med la bkod/ gcig tu 'dus rang dang yum la thim par bsam/ nang gi shar lho'i grar gdan la 'khod/ oṃ de ṣa ra ti/ phag mo yab yum bskul/ dpag tu med par gyur/ yum gyi ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/ phyogs bcur gshegs/sems can rnams kyi chu'i khams sbyangs/ snying rje ye shes la bkod/ gcig tu 'dus rang dang yum la thim par bsam/ lho nub gong dang 'gre/ oṃ rwa ga ra ti/ dbyangs can ma yab yum bskul dpag tu med par gyur/ yum gyi ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/ phyogs bcur gshegs/ semasacan rnams kyi me'i khams sbyangs/ dga' ba ye shes la bkod/ gcig tu 'dus rang dang yum la thim par bsam/ nub byang gi gdan la 'khod/ oṃ badz+ra ra hi/ go ri yab yum bskul/ dpag tu med par gyur/ yum gyi ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/ phyogs bcur gshegs/ sems can rnams kyi rlung gi khams sbyangs/ btang snyoms ye shes la bkod/ gcig tu 'dus rang dang yum la thim par bsam/ byang shar gdan la 'khod/ oṃ āḥ&/ thod pa bzhi bskul/ dpag du med par gyur/ yum gyi ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/phyogs bcur gshegs/ yul drug gi dri ma sbyangs/ slar 'dus/ phyi'i grwa bzhir 'khod/ oṃ āḥ//gzhal yas khang bskul/ dpag tu med par gyur/ yum gyi ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/ phyogs bcur gshegs/ snod kyi skyon sbyangs/ bde ba la gnas pa rnams brtan par byas/ gcig tu 'dus rang dang yum la thim par bsam/ dam tshig gi gzhal yas khang thim par bsam/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi mig gnyis su k+ṣiṃ dang 'khor lo las rdo rje mig dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi gri gug dang thod pa thugs gar 'dzin cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang —57

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)ral gri /g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad ma 'dzin pa/ rna ba gnyis su dzi dang rdo rje las rdo rje rna ba nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi gri gug dang thod pa thugs gar 'dzin cing / gong ltar 'gre/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri /g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang bad ma 'dzin pa/ sna gnyis su kho dang rin po che las rdo rje sna ser sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi gri gug dang thod pa thugs gar 'dzin cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis nor bu dang ral gri /g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad ma 'dzin pa/ lce'i rtsa bar raṃ dang pad ma las rdo rje'i lce dmar po dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi gri gug dang thod pa thugs skar 'dzin cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis pa da ma dang ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ dpral bar kai dang ral gri las rdo rje'i lus ljang khu ljang sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi gri gug dang thod pa thugs kar 'dzin cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon (12na skonyis nor bu dang pad ma 'dzin pa/ lte bar saṃ dang rdo rje las rdo rje'i yid dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi gri gug dang thod pa thugs gar 'dzin cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri /g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad ma 'dzin pa ste/ thams cad kyang pad zla la gnas pa'o/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar hūṃ lasardo rje las rdo rje'i yid dkar po dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi gri gug dang thod pa thugs kar 'dzin cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad ma 'dzin pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su āḥdang pad ma las gsung rdo rje dmar po dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi gri gug dang thod pa thugs gar 'dzin cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis pad ma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyisanor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po'i dbus su oṃ dang 'khor lo las sku rdo rje dkar po dkar sngo dmar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi gri gug dang thod pa —58

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyun 'byer gyi rnal 'byor reg thig bklags chog tu bkod pa/ 6)thugs skar 'dzin cing / lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis nor bu dang pad ma 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang khro bo'i rgyan cha lugs dang ldan pa g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'o/rang gi thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs pa la sngar bzhin mchod nas/ 'od zer gyis bkug ste thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams lha rnams kyi thugs ga'i thugs rdo rje la thim par bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa ā ma ko3lha/ 'od zer gyis bkug ste gsung rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams lha rnams kyi mgrin pa'i gsung rdo rje la thim par bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga wā ka badz+ra su bhā wa snyu ko3nya/ 'od (12ba)zer gyis bkug ste sku rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams lha rnams kyi spyi bo'i sku rdo rje la thim par bsam rma sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra su bhā wa pha ko3nya/ rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo nga yin snyam du nga rgyal bya/ dzaḥ'ajam dpal rang bzhin chos rnams kun gyi dngos/ /gnas med 'gro 'ong bral ba nam mkha' bzhin/ /dusagyi khams bzhin thugs rje 'gro 'ong bral/ /sprul pa 'gro dang bral ba'i gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /'gro dang 'ong ba'i mtshan nyid mi mnga' yang / /chu zla bzhin du gar dmigs der snang bas/ /deng 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol ba'i lha/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir 'jigs byed gshin rje gshed/ /las byed sprul pa gshin rje 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs shing bzhugs su gsol/ skyed khroḥha bho ma hā kro dha ā la ā byu a sma da pā dza pra ti kṛ hā bra swā da me dhī mun ku ru swāhā/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ hrīḥrdziḥs khro bo spros te phyir 'brang gi bgegasabaskrad la bsrungs te sngar bzhin mchod/ oṃ maṅga ra dzaḥ o daṇ+ḍa3/ oṃ pad ma baṃ/ oṃ kha ṅga hoḥs dgug gzhug bcing mnye bya/ oṃ khyuḥhi bho zhes pa nas ku ru swāhā/ slar yang thugs los pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa —59

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ hrīḥ1ཿsa khro bo spros te phyir 'brang gi bgegs bskrad la bsrungs te sngar bzhin mchod/ oṃ maṅga ra dzaḥ o daṇ+ḍa hūṃ/ oṃ pad ma baṃ/ oṃ kha ṅga hoḥs dgug gzhug bcing mnye bya/ oṃ saḥhi bho zhes pa nas ku ru swāhā/ slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa bdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan (13na)drangs la sngar bzhin mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis spros pa'i lha mo tsa tsi kā la sogs pa rnams kyis shis pa brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas zla ba lta bu'i bum pa dkar po bdud rtsi lngas gang ba bzung nas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis/ /skye bas thob pa'i dbang bskur ba/ /ji ltar de bzhin bdag gis ni/ /dag pa lha yis chus dbang bskur/ zhes gsung zhing spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ dbang gi chus lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag /chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnasapa yongs su gyur pa las/ gtso bo'i rtsa zhal gyi dbu la mi bskyod pa/ lha gzhan shar dang shar lho ba rnams la rnam snang / lho dang lho nub pa rnams la rin 'byung / nub dang nub byang pa rnams la 'od dpag med/ byang dang byang shar ba rnams la don grub kyis dbu brgyan cing / dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par bsam ste ye shes pa gzhug cing dbang bskur ba'o/ /las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin ni/ mchod pa dngos sam bshams na yid byung tsam la byin gyis brlab mi dgos shing ting nge 'dzin gyis sprul la/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra a lha nas shasta'i bar gyi sngags kyis mchod/ nang mchod la bdud rdzi ril bu btab mi dgos pas/ mchod do/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegasapa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ chos kyi phung po stong (13ba)phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥ// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥ // ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ la lī ta badz+ra gyi zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ a mo gha —60

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyun 'byer gyi rnal 'byor reg zig bklags chog tu bkod pa/ thenabadz+ra zhal du oṃ āḥlha/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ pad ma badz+ra'i zhal du oṃ āḥ// di paṃ ka ra rak+ṣi ta'i zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyi zhal du oṃ āḥ// rwa chos rab kyi zhal du oṃ āḥlha/ rwa ye shes seng ge'i zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ rwa 'bum seng gi zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ rje btsun rga lo'i zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ rong pa shes rab seng ge'i zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ bla ma ye shes dpal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ chos rje don grub rin cen gyi zhal du oṃ āḥlha/ chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po'i zhal du oṃ wāPROBPROB/ mkhas grub shes rab seng ge'i zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ rgyud pa sbyin pa dpal ba'i zhal du oṃ wāPROBPROB/ rtsa ba shes rab bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ rdo rje 'chang chos skyong rgya mtsho'i zhal du oṃ āḥlha/ rje nam mkha' grags pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ chos rje nyi ma bkra shis kyi zhal du oṃ āḥlha/mkhas grub bde legs nyi ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ shar chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ āḥ&/rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi zhal du oṃ āḥlha/ 'jam dbyangs dpal 'byor 'phrin las kyi zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥlha/ gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag gnang ba'i bla ma dam pa yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥ&/oṃ āḥrdziḥnas hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥ/ oṃ badz+re bet+ta lī nas hūṃ dzaḥswā hā oṃ āḥlha/ oṃ dzi na dzi ka hūṃ phaṭa oṃ āḥlha/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ badz+ra ra ti hūṃ phaṭa oṃ āḥ&/ gzhan yang rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tsho gos rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥ// sngon sangs rgyas (14nasgo thong ba dam pa'i chos thos pa/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la brten pa/ bstan pa dang 'khor rnam bzhi skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bsten cing bsgrubs pa'i srung ma dam tshig can rnams gyi zhal du oṃ āḥ// yul sum cu rtsa gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo dang / rnal 'byor ma dang / phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong klu la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams dang / sems can thams cad ltar gyur pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ 61

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)badz+ra sa mā dza chis spyan drangs/ rang gi lus la thim par bsam/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥ// zhesadabul la bdud rtsi lce thog tu myang zhing / rang gi lus la gnas pa'i rgyal ba rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsis mnyes shing tshim nga ra bsams la/ mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa thams cad rang bzhin med bzhin du snang ba sgyu ma bzhin du bltas la 'khor rnams kyi gtso bor brag ca'i dbyangs lta bur bstod par bsams te/ gnyis med thun mong ma yin khyab pa'i sku/ /kun la snyoms mdzad rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /chos kyi dbyings gyur rgyal ba kun gyi yum/ /ye shes sems dpa' rgyal ba kun gyi sras/ /phyag 'tshal 'jam dpal dpal gyur rdzogs pa khyod/ /chos kyi sku la byams sdang mi mnga' yang / /srid gsum gdug pa ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir/ /thugs rje thabs kyis khro rgyal skur ston pa/ /(14ba 'jigs byed gshin rje gshed la phyags 'tshal lo/ /gtso bos kyang 'khor rnams la/ /gshin rje gshed po rab 'jigs pa/ /gti mug rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /rdo rje sku la phyag la tsal bstod/ /gshin rje gshed po rab 'jigs pa/ phra ma rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /rdo rje thugs dang rab tsos pa/ /rin cen rdo rje ྾/ /'dod shas rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ phan rje skyod po rab 'jigs pa/ /rdo rje gsung dang rab tsos pa/ rdo rje gsung la ྾/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po las kun pa/ /rdo rje sku dang rab mtshungs pa/ /phyag na ral grir/ /yang 'khor rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu gtso bo la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos po khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun mchog gtso bo'i gtso/ /dkyil 'khor gtso la ྾/ ces bstod/de ltar re re nas gsal 'debs pa'i dpyad nas bsgom pa dang rnam pa gsal ba la rtse gcig tu 'jog pa'i sgom pa gnyis kyis gsal snang bsgrub cing bdag nyid dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed do snyam du nges pa shugs can la nga rgyal brtan par bya ba ni rgya che ba la bslab/ sgom pa po dang bsgom bya dang sgom rnams brtags na yang dag par cir yang ma grub bzhin du snang ba sgyu ma lta bu'i don la 'jog pa dmigs pa lha skur dmigs nas rnam pa rang bzhin med par nges pa'i rgyun skyong ba ste zab pa la —62

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyun 'byer gyi rnal 'byor reg zig bklags chog tu bkod pa/ 6)bslab/ de nas steng dang 'og gi sna rtser zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje sngon po yungs 'bru tsam la sems bzung ba brtan pa na de las (15na)phyag mtshan mang po spro zhing slar yang sdud pa'i phra mo la semasa'adzin/ /de ltar bsgoms pas skyon dag pa dran par bya ste/ zhal dgu ni gsung rab yan lag dgu /rwa gnyis ni bden pa gnyis/ phyag so bzhi dang sku gsung thugs te so bdun ni byang phyogs so bdun/zhabs bcu drug ni stong nyid bcu drug /yum dang sbyor ba ni bde ba chen po rgyas pa/ mi la sogs pa ni dngos sgrub brgyad dang / bya rgod la sogs pa ni dbang phyug brgyad dag pa yin la/ gcer bur ni sgrib g.yogs med pa dang skra gyen du brdzes pa ni myang ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang ston pa'o/ /de dag gi don mdor bsdu na gtan la dbab pa'i gzhi gsung rab yan lag dgu'i brjod bya kun rdzob sgyu ma dang don dam nam mkha' lta bu/ khong du chud pa'i lam byang phyogs so bdun yin la/ lam de'i gtso bo don dam rtogs pa la ni stong nyid bcu drug gi rtogs pa yod de/ de yang thabs bde ba chen po dang dbyer med par bzhugs pa'o/ /lam des bgrod pa'i 'bras bu dngos grub thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis kyi gtso bo ni sgrib pa zad pa'i myang 'das so/ /zhes rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnam par shar ba'i skus de ltar mtshon par go bar byed pa'o/ /'phreng ba byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gyi rdziḥs bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ 'phreng ba mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las me las pad ma mesamatshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal (15ba〉na sum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis pad ma dang ral gri /g.yon gnyis nor bu dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer sa pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥ/ baṃ lha tshos gnyis su med par bsam/ oṃ a ro li ga hūṃ phaṭa ces bzla/ gsung 'dod chag bas gshin rje gshed yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i khrag 'dzag pa'i mi mgo'i phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad kyi rnam pa can du bsam/—63

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)rang gi thugs kur nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mthar rtsa sngags la sogs pa dang lha gzhan rnams kyi thugs gar nyi gdan la rang rang gi phyag mtshan la sa bon bkod pa'i mthar sngags kyi yi ge rnams g.yas skor du 'greng ste 'od zer 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du bltas la/ oṃ ya ma rā dzā sa do me ya ya me do sa ṇa yo da ya ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya/ ya k+ṣe ya ts+tsha ni rā ma ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ rtsa sngags so/ /oṃ lha tsho nyi wi kri tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bet+ta khyi ā byu ā ga tsā hūṃ dzaḥswāhā/ oṃ dzi na dzi ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+na : ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a ro li ga hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ muṅka lha ga hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ daṇ+ḍa : ka hūṃ phaṭa/ cha pad mchi ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kha thi: ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mo ha ra ti hūṃ phaṭa/ cha de ṣa ra ti hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rwa ga (16na〉nga ti hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ra ti hūṃ phaṭa/ ces 'bor gyi sngags rnams bzla/ thun mthar gtor 'bul mi byed na slar yang mchod bstod bya zhing gshin rje gshed kyi yig brgyas lhag chad kha 'geng la gtor 'bul byed na de rnams dor nas/ gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni/ sngar bzhin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlud gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du āḥlas mi mgo'i skyed bu gsum gyi steng du āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa dkar po/ de'i nang gi shar du dra las byung ba'i ba lang gi sha gos mtshan pa/ lhor e lasabyung ba'i khyi'i sha kus mtshan pa/ nub tu lha las byung ba'i glang po che'i sha das mtshan pa/ byang du kho las byung ba'i rta'i sha has mtshan pa/ dbus su hūṃ las byung ba'i mi'i sha nas mtshan pa/ shar lhor rlu las byung ba'i dri chen bis mtshan pa/ lho nub tu māṃ las byung ba'i rak+ta ras mtshan pa/ nub byang du rlu las byung ba'i byang sems dkar po shus mtshan pa/ byang shar du 〉 las byung ba'i rkang mar mas mtshan pa/dbus su baṃ las byung ba'i dri chu lhas mtshan pa/ de dag gi steng du oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūṃ sngon po gsum steng nas steng du brtsegs par bsam/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros rlung la phog pas rlung g.yos me sbar te thod pa'i rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol bar bsam/ yi ge gsum las 'od —64

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyun 'byer gyi rnal 'byor reg zig bklags chog tu bkod pa/ (thanazer rim pa (16ba tha zhin du 'phros pas sku rdo rje gsung rdo rje thugs rdo rje rnams bkug nas yi ge gsum la rim gyis thim pa rnams thod par lhung nas zhu bas hūṃ gis kha dog dri nus kyi skyon sbyangs/āḥs bdud rtsir rtogs par byas/ oṃ gyis mang por sba ra zhing spel bar bsam/ oṃ āḥ&/ lan gsum brjod/ gtor
