ma 'bul ba rgyas par spro na/ dkyil 'khor rten brten pa'i dam tshig pa bskyed pa la/ye shes pa bstim/ de nas phyogs skyong bco lnga bkug pa la phur bu btab ste gnas bsgyur gtso 'khor rnams kyi skye mched brlab pa nas bstod pa'i bar sngar bzhin bya ba yod kyang re zhig bzhag pa'i 'jug pa bde ba/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi 'khor lo la phyogs skyong rnams kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ pad ma ka ma lā ya : gyis gdan phul/oṃ hrīḥrdziḥwi kri tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūṃ sarba du ṭaṃ n+da a di na sa pa ri wā rā na gī la ya hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/rang gi snying ga nas khro bo gshin rje gshed phyag na phur bu thogs pa spros te/ phyogs skyong rnams kyi snying ga dang mgrin pa dang rkang mthil gyi bar du phur bu btab pas grub pa'i bcud len grub pa bzhin du skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa yum dang bcas par bsam/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron rnams kyi ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dkar po 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar bsam/ hrīḥdhīḥ'i mthar/ oṃ (17na〉dz+ra bhi ra wa a dhi pa ti/ badz+ra bestu lī rda ba kla ta kha ji hi ji hi hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa bdun nam nyer gcig gis gtso bo yab yum dang / oṃ dzi na dzi ga /ces pa nas/badz+ra ra ti ba kla pra tī ts+tsha su hā/ lan gsum gyis 'khor rnams la 'bul/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod/gzugs mchog mas bstod/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pas ljags nas sbu gu can du bsam/ ya ma rā dza brjod/ oṃ bhu tsa ra rna/ ya pa tā la tsa rā ya/ mā na khe tsa rā ya/ ta pā wa ṇi gwa ṇi/ ka dak+ṣi na di kā ya/ hūṃ pa nyi ma rna phaṭa ut+ta ra ti gwa ya/ oṃ/ hrī spra/ spris/ wi k+ṣi/ kri ko /tā e/ na a/ na de/ hūṃ bh+yo/phaṭa sarba bhu te saḥ au da sha di kā lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra a lha nas sha rdi pra ti ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā'i bar gyis —65

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shemachod/ sngags mthar 'bru gsum btags la nang mchod dbul/ bcom ldan chos rje 'jam dbyangasaspyan lam du/ /bdud 'dul bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa/ /las kyi gshen rje ma mo mkha' 'gro ma/ /'byung po ro langs ci bgyi bka' nyan tshogs/ /phyi nang skyong ba'i dam can ma lus pa/ /bdag ni re ba'i sems kyas 'dud cing mchis/ /phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag gi dge ba'i bya ba rnams mthar phyin pa dang / de'i bar chad zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /oṃ ya mān+ta ka sam ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ ya mā n+ta ka twe no pa ba ḍisgro me bha ba/ su to stso me bha ba/ a nu ra sto me bha ba/su po stso me bha ba/ sab sidhi m+me pra la sa sbo na rmā (17ba〉kyi tsa me/ tsiste shri yoḥku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha lho bha ga wa na/ ya mān+ta ka ma me mu sma ya mān+ta ka bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa a tshe tshes gshin rje gshed kyi yig brgya bzla/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang / gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bya ba gang bgyisapa/ /de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ sogs brjod/ gtor mgron gyi lha rnams yo āḥ& mu sarang gnas su gshegs par bsam/ rnam dag bsam pas tshul 'dir 'bad pa las/ /byung ba'i dge bas mtha' yas 'gro ba rnams/ /skye zhing skye bar 'jam dbyangs zhi khro yis/ /'bral ba med par rjesasu 'dzin gyur cig /rnam dag yid kyi zla shel rtsig ngos la/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed dkyil 'bor ni/ /ting 'dzin pir gyis dbang po'i gzhu lta bur/ /rab bkod bsgom dang mchod bstod bzlasasogs kyis/ /rnam dkar zla 'od dung dang kun+da ltar/ /mchog tu dkar ba gang zhig bsags pa des//thams༅ ma 'dzodagobon rgya44mdzad/ /dngos grub rtsa ba theg mchog dge ba'i bshes/ /mtshan nyid ldan pas rjes su 'dzin par shog /tshe 'di'i chos brgyad byis pa'i rol rtsed dang / /'bor ba'i phun tshogs dug sprul tshang lta bur/ /rig nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ /phyin drug spyod pas rtag tu 'tsho bar shog /rnam dag dbang bzhi'i chu bos sgo gsum gyi/ /dri ma kun bkrus sku bzhi'i sa bon bzhag /dam tshig sdom pa mig gi 'bras bu ltar/ /bsrungs pas rim gnyis lam gyi snod gyur cig /skye shi bar do'i mun pa kun sel zhing / /sku gsum 'od brgya'i dra ba 'gyed byed pa/ /bskyed rim zab —66

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyun 'byer gyi rnal 'byor reg zig bklags chog tu bkod pa/ (thanamo thun bzhin bsgoms pa las/ /rdzogs rim yongs rdzogs skye ba'i rgyud smin shog /bla ma gshin rje gshed kyi lha yi tshogs/ nam (18na〉pa kha' gang ba'i bsod nams zhing mchog la/ /'khor gsum rnam par dag pa'i mchod sbyin gyis/ /rang gi rgyud ni yongs su smin par shog /sngags gnyis don ltar gdod nas dag pa'i dbyings/ /bde chen rang gi sems dang ro gcig pa/ /ye shes tshogs rdzogs 'chi ba'i skyon spangs shing / /'od gsal lam gyis chos sku thob par shog /gtum chen gnod mdzes dpal ldan khro bo bcus/ /yongs su bskor ba'i ting 'dzin la gzhol bas/ /bdud dang bgegs sogs nag po'i rtsa lag kun/ /skad cig nyid la drung nas 'byin par shog /rnam mang rin cen tsho gos 'bar gzhal med khang / /rnam snang rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid can/ /rnam par bsgoms pas ma dag zhing sbyangs te/ /rnam dag ye shes gzhal yas khang 'grub shog /der ni gur gum lhun po brtsegs pa bzhin/ khyu yi rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bar do'i smin sbyangs sgyu lus snod gyur nas/ /rgyal ba'i longs sku myur du 'grub par shog /zla nyi sa bon phyag mtshan sku rdzogs pa'i/ /rim pas ye shes lnga yi mngon byang las/ /'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /skye srid sbyong zhing sprul sku 'grub par shog /'bum phrag nyi 'od spungs pa'i gzi brjid can/ /rang nyid sems dpa' gsum gyi bdag nyid dang / /rang rig phyag rgyar sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor kyis/ /sprul pa'i sprin gyis sa gsum khyab byas nas/ /ma dag snod bcud dri ma kun sbyangs te/ /dag pa'i rten dang brten par rtag 'char ba'i/ /gzhan don phun (18ba)sum tsho gis pa'i bdag nyid can/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ting 'dzin mthar phyin shog /phyi nang bzlas brjo mthar phyin bsam gtan dang / /rdzas sogs rten 'brel 'khrul 'khor rim pa la/ /brten nas zhi sogs rab 'byams kun 'grub pa'i/ /las kyi rgyal po mchog ni 'grub par shog /zab lam rim pa lnga yi gnad kyi don/ /ma lus bsdus pa rnal 'byor rnam pa bzhi/ /spyod pa gsum dang bcas pa'i lam bzang gis/ /sku gsum go 'phang tshe 'dir thob par shog /sprul pa'i 'khor lor 'dod lha yab yum la/ /sems gzhol rjes gzhig sdud rim mchog gis ni/ /zla nyi'i rgyu —67—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)ba sgra gcan lam bkag pas/ /yas babs mas brtan dga' bzhi skye bar lha/ga /chos kyi 'khor lor sngags kyi rnal 'byor mchog /bum pa can dang rdo rje'i bzlas pa yis/ /snying ga'i rtsa mdud ma lus grol byas nas/ /lhan skyes bde bas yid la myos thob shog /slar yang byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnam 'byor gyis/ /nang gi rjes gzhig bsam gtan rim pa dang / /phyag rgya gnyis dang sbyor ba'i thabs mkhas las/ /sems dben mthar thug ting 'dzin 'dren par shog /'chi rim ji bzhin rlung rnams ma lus pa/ /snying gar thim pa'i 'od gsal de nyid las/ /dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor mtshan dpe'i dra ba can/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin rdzogs par shog /dbang po'i gzhu ltar dngas pa'i sku de nyid/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su chu 'dzin zhi ba bzhin/ /sbyangs pa'i rnam dag ye shes rnal 'byor gyis/ /bden par 'dzin pa'i sa bon drung 'byin shog /don gyi lhan cig sgom pa de nyid las/ /mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i yongs su dag pa'i sku/ /don dam 'od gsal thugs dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /zung du 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor mchog (19na smo grub shog /nam mkha' ji srid sku lnga'i bdag nyid can/ kha sbyor bdun ldan go 'phang mngon gyur nas/ /mtha' dag 'gro 'di go 'phang de nyid la/ /skad cig la nyid la bde blag 'god par shog /nyer bsdu ni/ dur khrod srung 'khor dang bcas pa gzhal yas khang la/ gzhal yas khang 'khor rnams la/ 'khor rnams dang yum rang la/ rang dam tshig sems dpa' ye shes sems dpa' la/ de ting 'dzin sems dpa' la/ de yang zhabs kyu u ni ha la/ ha mgo bo la de zla tshes la/de thig le la/ de nā da la/ de yang mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par bsam/ shis brjod ni thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad/ 'chi med lam kun khyab pa'i chu 'dzin ni/ /bgrang yas nyi 'od rtse dgas rol ba bzhin/ /dpal ldan gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor pa/ /dge legs me tog sna tshogs char du 'bebs/ tshes pa brjod pa'i 'brug gi gad brgyangs can/ /mi bzad mthu stobs rdo rje'i gnam lcags kyis/ /nag po'i rtsa lag —68

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyun 'khyer gyi rnal 'byor reg thig bklags chog tu bkod pa/ (tha)thal bar brlag mdzad pas/ /sa gsum 'gro 'di shis pas skyong gyur cig /rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /ma rungs bdud dpung 'joms mdzad gshin rje gshed/ /mi yi gzugs kyi rnam rol btsong kha pa/ /dbyer med bla ma yi dam khyod phyag 'tshal/ khri spyad rgyal sdud mdzad ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /lam 'dis grub pa mchog brnyes la lī ta/ /don yod rdo rje mar me mdzad bsrung ba//bskyed rim mthar phyin rwa lo rdo rje grags/ /la sogs dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma ni/ /dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas khyed rnams kyi/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsi snying la (19ba〉gugs pa las/ /thub bstan phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ye shes lnga bdag gshin rje gshed rnam lnga/ /bdud dpung 'joms mdzad sgo skyong khro bo bzhi/ /tshad med bzhi yi dngos gyur yum chen bzhi/ /mtshams kyi pad mar gnas pa'i thod pa la/ /legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra shis des/ /khyed kyi mi mthun rgud pa kun zad cing / /bde legs yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel gyur nas/ /phun tshogs dpal la rol ba'i bkra shis shog /rdo rje 'chang dbang thugs bcud bdud rtsi'i phul/ /dpal ldan rgyud rnams kun gyi rgyal po mchog /bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /bshad pa'i rgyud dang phyogs mthun rgyud rnams la/ /legs tshogs ji snyid mchis pa'i bkra shis des/ khyed kyi mi mthun rgud pa kun zad cing / /bde legs yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel gyur nas/ /phun tshogs dpal la rol ba'i bkra shis shog /rab 'byams zhing na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang / /rnam par dag pa'i dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma/ khyud kyi rgyal po'i lung rtogs dam chos kyi/ /phyogs gcig yan chad 'dzin pa thams cad la/ /legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra shis des/ /khyed kyi mi mthun rgyad pa kun zad cing / /bde legs yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel gyur nas/ /phun tshogs dpal la rol ba'i bkra shis shog /dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs bskor ba'i/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar rab gnas pa'i/ /nor bu'i tog mdzes rin cen ba gam can/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin gzhal yas khang / /rnam snang rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid la/ /legs tshogs ji snyed mchis pa'i bkra shis des/ /ma dag 'khor ba'i gnas 'di rab spangs nas/ /—69

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)dag pa'i zhing la rol pa'i bkra shis shog /mkhas pa'i dbang po zhabs brtan cing / /rig 'dzin bu slob rgyas pa dang / /bshad sgrub nyi zla ltar gsal ba/ khri khyen mi chad pa'i bkra shis shog /bslab pa sum ldan ngur smrig 'dzin pa yi/ /'dus pa'i tsho gis kyi gnas 'di yongs gang (20na)zhing / /rtag tu bshad sgrub bya bas srid mtha'i bar/ /thub bstan phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /thun gyi ngo bo la de ltar nyams su blangs nas thun mtshams la ji ltar bya ba sogs rin po che'i za ma tog bzhin bya'o/ /rnyed dka' don che rdo rje theg mchog rtse/ /dus kyi dgra bo'i rnal 'byor chen po'i lam/ /rgyal kun yab gcig rje btsun btsong kha pa'i/ /bzhed gzhung 'di ko yongs 'du sa brtol dbang / /tshul bzhin bstar ba'i mthu stobs thog mda' yis/ /dgra bgegs brag ri phyer 'thag de bas kyang / /snyigs dus tshe thung yun der bcu gsum gyi/ /rdo rje'i sal bgrod pa gcig tu med/ /dge bas deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /'jam dpal snying po'i gsung rab zil mngar gyis/ /nges legs srog gi ka ba rab tshugs te/ /byang chen sum rtsen dga' ston la spyod shog /ces dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i sgrub thabs za ma tog gi gsung 'don byar dgos pa rnams ris su ma bor zhing / kha skong dang mtshams sbyor tshig phrad dgos nges rnams sbyar ba'i reg zig bklags chog ma 'di yang phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams kyi zhal 'don du za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so/ /sarba maṅga lo//—70

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rab dkar bdud rtsi'i bum bzang thenadapal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rab dkar bdud rtsi'i bum bzang bzhugs/na mo badz+ra bhe ra wā ya/ in+d+ra nī la'i sa 'dzin dbang po nyin byed 'bum gyis 'byud pa bzhin/khro chags brjid pa'i ngo mtshar rol gar cir yang ston pa'i sgyu ma mkhan/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag dbang po rdo rje 'chang chen gshin rje'i gshed/ /ngur smig zol gyis 'gro la rjes chags kun mkhyen dbang po btsong kha pa/ /gang gi gsung las bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed/ /sbyin sreg mchod pas mnyes byed dngos grub kun/ /'bad med stsol ba'i rgya mtsho'i dgongs bzhed dag /'khrul med ji bzhin rtogs pa'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /gsang chen chos kyi 'dod dgu'i bang mdzod la/ /dbang sgyur 'phrin las thogs med 'khon ston rje'i/ /legs par bshad dang gdams pa'i dka' gnad bzhin//tshad ldan lag len snying por dril te 'dri/ /de la 'dir bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs sbyin sreg gi mchod pas mnyes par byed pa'i tshul/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi las/ dang po nyid lag len 'byer bde bar brjod par bya'o/ /'di la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ /rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum las/ dang bo ni/ gnas khang (2na)yid du 'ong bar phyag dar legs par byas la/ yar ngo'i tshes gcig lta bu'i dus sam/ gza' skar sbyor byed 'jam zhing bzang ba la/ /gnas khang dang bstun pa'i shar gyi phyogs su/ thab brtsigs te rdzas rnams tshogos par bya'o/ /tsun dan dkar po'i chus sbrus pa'i/ /bska kha'i ro ldan sa dkar stegs//nang du gter man ngag gi phyag len ltar/ gzhug steng du thab/ /zlum po brgyad khru de'i phyed dpangs/ /sa 'khor thig brgyad sngon 'gro ba'i/ /sor mo mtsho'i grangs zlum por bskor/ /de'i phyi sngar bzhin de'i phyi mig /lte bar pad nyi khro bo yi/ kha gyes rdor sngon srid sor brgyad/ wo mtha'i ro/ /dpangs su sor gcig de'i phyi —71 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)rol la/ mu khyud dag rdo rjes mdzes/ 'dab ma brgyad kyi phyogs bzhi dmar/ me rlung ser/ dbang ldan sngo/srin po ljang / ge sar ser pho/ /de'i phyi rdor phreng sngon pos bskor/ mdog dbyibs gdan gsum dngos grubargya mcha man ngag gi dbang du mdzad de sbas pa yin la/ zhi ba thun mong ma yin pa'i 'dri tshul man ngag zhal las shes dgos pa yod do/ /zur bzhi zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan/ /mchod rdzas phyi mchod rnam pa lnga/ logs thig mdzes khyad dang ā+o pas bya/ /chu bzhi so so'i nas phyag we ltar ldan pa/ /sreg (2ba)rdzas 'om bu srid du sor/ bcu gnyis sbom phra mthe'u chung zlum/ / la sogs 'og nas 'byung ba kun/ /khyad cho med migs gsal rdzas kyis sbags/ /kun kyang shel dkar nya phyis dung / /dkar snod ci 'byor nang du bsham/ /'das dang ma 'das gtor ma dang / /gos zung rang srung chas 'jug sogs bum pa dgang blug hro g.yab nyer dpyad kun/ /kun kyang 'khrul med bstar bar bya//rdo rje ni thabs dang dril bu ni shes rab/ /de gnyis ga'ang don dam pa byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin no/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ye tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa sto dhar ya mi hi hi hi hi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ bum pa dgang rlung g.yang nyer dpyad kun/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi3 g.yon pa'i dis kyang dkur bzhag rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa rnams mnyes par bya'o/ /hūṃ/ sems can rmongs dang bral ba yi/ /rdo rje gsor ba mdzes pa yis/ /rnam thar chos kyi bya ba ste/ g.yas pa'i mthe bong dang ming med spro dang bcas pas rdo rje bzung / /rdo rje gsor hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hoḥhoḥhoḥ au badz+ra dha rma ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba bu ji k+ṣe tra pra tsā li ni pra dzñā pā ra mi tā ra mi tā nā ba swa bhā we badz+ra satwa hri da ya sa sto ṣa ṇi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ swāhā/ las sngags kyis bsangs/ mchod yon gyi sngon du bsangs ga sto zhal bsil zhes pa dang / mchod pa dang gtor ma byin rlabs dkyus ltar byed/ rdo rje gsor/ rdzasakun/ oṃ oṃ swāhā/ a gyi sngon du tshe bro k+ṣu ṇi āḥ& zhes pa sbyor/ dngos grub rgya mtshor oṃ gcig las mi 'dug pa par mkhan gyi skyon yin pa 'dra/ gdan bzhi'i 'grel par gnyis 'byung zhes bdag gi bla ma gsung pa ni legs so/ skyong āḥswā hā me shing /oṃ hri swāhā zhun mar/ oṃ dzi swā hā 'bru/ de las gzhan pa'i rdzas rnams rma ku ru (3na)ku ru swā hā/ rdzas rnams kyi nus pa'i skyon thams cad sbyangs te bdud rtsi lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ āX lan gsum brjod/ las sngags brjod/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūṃ lan bdun brjod/ las sngags bdun brjod/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥlan —72

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rab dkar bdud rtsi'i bum bzang 6)bdun brjod/ gnyis pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa/ bral ze rgyun bzhag ni tshe long du mi tshe kyang dgol dun gyi rdze'am nor bu'i me btsug /sgron me spar bsangs chu dang nang mchod kyis bsangs/ bud shing bcug la rlung g.yab kyis spar ro/ /blugasagazar gyis mar khu bdun gyis me gso ku sha man ngag ltar 'gram/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa/ slar yang 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ thab dang me lha bskyed cing ye shes pa bsre ba/ mchod cing bstod de dam tshig bsgrag pa/ sreg rdzas phul nas slar yang mchod pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ las sngags kyis bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad ma dang zla ba'i steng du paṃ dang rdo rje las rdo rje 'dzin pa dkar po dkar mthing dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon 'og ma gnyis rin po che dang pad ma 'dzin pa zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi thab dkar zhing zlum pa mu ra na la rdo rje'i phreng ba dang kha khyer la rdo rje gyen du bsgrengs pas bskor ba/ gra bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ /dbus su pad ma dang nyi gdan la rdo rje las thams cad pa'i dbang du byas pa ste zhi bol man ngag bzhin 'don pa kha sbo dgos so/ sngon po rtse lnga pa gyen du bsgreng bar gyur pa'i dbus su raṃ las me gru gsum gyi nang du paṃ las pad ma a las zla ba'i gdan la (3ba)re dkar po las bgrang phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ me lha bcu gnyis kyi nang nas 'dzin byed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis bgrang phreng dang dbyug gu rtse gsum/ bar pa gnyis kyis mi 'jigs pa dang spyi blugs/ tha ma gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ zhi zhing dul ba drang srong gi cha lugs can/ ag tshom ring zhing ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan pa/ snying gar ri mo rtse gsum gsum mdo bas mtshan pa/ rgyan dang na bza' dkar po gsol zhing ra dkar po la g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/gnyug mar gnas pa'i rig ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i thugs gar me gru gsum pa raṃ gyis mtshan pa/dam tshig pa'i thugs ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer las spros pa'i khro bo 'dod rgyal gyis shar lho nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i me lha drang srong gi 'khor gyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ oṃ/ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po 73

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)che/ /lha yi drang srong bram ze mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod/ /oṃ shāk+ki hūṃ dzaḥthab kyi me mtshams kyi ku sha'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ phyag rgya dang salate/ oṃ mu tho rā dzaḥ o daṇ+ḍa/ཿ a pad ma baṃ/ oṃ kha thi hoḥ gnyis pa ni/ oṃ āḥhrīḥ pra ba ra sa ka raṃ pro k+ṣu ṭ+wāṃ pra ti ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ añtsa rwa 'o zhal bsil/ mar yon ji/ pā byi zhabs bsil gsum po 'di gong gi bsangs gtor gyi yas su ri 0 yolgo rjod/ o.a sna ye/ ā di byā/ ā bī sha /ma hā shri ye/ hā bya ka bya bā hā nā ya/ pu ce nasasha lta'i bar brjod/ (4na 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ṭak+ki sa dbang bskur ba/ zhes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhū ta dz+wa la dzā lā ya sarba bhi smi ku ru sarba du dzin hūṃ phaṭa tri shu dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥs ma ya rto sa ma ya lha/ gsum pa ni/ me lha'i ljags rdo rje'i rnam pa can dkar po la raṃ yig dang /dgang blugs kyi kha la ya yig 'od zer 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur/ gong gi me lha'i sngags la/bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon/ lan gsum gyis dam tshig skugs so/ /bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnams dang / khyad par sku gsung thugs rten gtsug lag khang bzang 'di dag gi rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las la bar du gcod pa thams cad shī n+ti ku ru oṃ/ 〉sreg rdzas lha'i gnas gang du 'bul gyi khyad par dmigs pas dbye dgos bo dhi bṛ /ya āḥ&/ /yam shing rnams byang chub kyi shing gi rang bzhin gyi bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gyur/ /oṃ asna skos bo dhi bṛ k+ṣu ya yam shing / spel rdzo dmigs gsal skur dgos pa spyo las shes/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shin+ti ku ru oṃ/ oṃ asna mo mar khu/ bdag cag 'byor pa phun sum tsho gos pa la/ oṃ asna ྾/ til yosarba pā paṃ da ha na badzā ya/ bdag cag ྾sdig sgrib thamasacad/ oṃ asna mdur ba oṃ badz+ra ā yu tshe bdag cag rki tshe la bar du gcod pa thams cad rkirma — ྾oṃ badz+ra (4bste/rto ya 'bras bgrus pa/ bdag cag snga bsod nams snyel bar du gcod pa thams cad skos asna rkirma sarba paṃ zho zan/bde/ mo bdag cag mo mi 'dod pa'i duḥkha thams cad mom asna ram a pra —74

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rab dkar bdud rtsi'i bum bzang (tha)ti ha ta badzā ya/ bdag cag ༅nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad mom skyi 〉yungs kar oṃ sarba a the si ji ye/bdag cag mo don grub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad ra rma asna rim badz+ra bi dz+ra ya/ bdag cag mo rnam par rgyal ba la bar du gcod pa thams cad mom asna zam oṃ mahā be bhā ya/ nas/bdag cag mo las thog med du sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad mnya asna rkirma ma hā ba lwa ya/sog /bdag cag skor mthu stobs chen po la bar du gcod pa thams cad mom byu rim gro badz+ra gha sna ri/ bdag cag mos nad thams cad rim a sna ye mo bdag cag mo mchog mthun gyi dngos grub sgrub pa'i bar du gcod pa thams cad 〉de nas sngar gyi chu bzhi nas zhal bsil dang bsangs gtor phul/ gnyis pa ni las sngags kyis bsangs/ yis sa/ ā+oṃ dan/ bri ya du/ thang chu/ lta yos me tog dkar po/sman sna/ rin po che/ dar sna/ zho 'o ma/ mar so gos phyag len ltar 'jug pa bde bar byed do/ /me lha'i thugs kar : las gzhal yas khang / zhesapa nas/ zla ba'i gdan zung re re zhes pa'i bar dkyus ltar brjod rjes thod pa 'dud rtsis gang ba bzhin gyur/ sgrub mchod dang / 'brel ba dang / rab gan rgyas pa lha la dbang bskur bdang 'brel ba/rang gzhan gyi zhi ba'i las bsgrub pa dang 'brel ba gsum las/ 'di ni dang po'i dbang btang ba/ rab gnas 'bring po la sgrub mchod khag (5na skor byed pa lag tu blang bde tsam du go zhes kho bo'i bla ma gsung ngo / /bar pa la lha gnas 'gyur tshul dang / phyi ma dam tshig pa bskyed tshul dang / ye shes pa bstim pa sogs/ phyag len zhal shes ltar bya dgos shing / bsnyen pa'i kha skongs sogs la la thamasacad pa'i sbyin sreg ces bya ba 'phrin las bzhi ga don gyis tshang ba'i man ngag 'dug kyang rnam dbye dod pa lta ci smos ming thos pa yang nyin mo'i skar ma tsam mo/ / 〉gyi rdzi li kri tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ rkarma rdo rjes dkyil 'khor ra gtu gnas bya'i lha'i drung du song ste phyag btsal/bdag cag dpon slob yon bdag dang bcas pa la mchog thun gyi dngos grub stsol phyir du sbyin sreg 'bul bas/ thab kyi gzhal yasakhang du gshegs pa zhu zhes brjod de/ lag len ltar lha grangs kyi me tog blangs la thab kyi drung du 'ongs pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi sngagasadang bas na thabatu gtso go/zhes pa nas badz+ra ra ti hūṃ phaṭa kyi bar brjod/ dbus kyi gdan la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed yab yum/ shar gyi gdan la gti mug gshin rje gshed yab yum/ lho'i gdan la ser sna ༅nub kyi gdan la 'dod chags ra byang gi gdan la phrag dog 〉shar sgo'i gdan la tho ba ྾—75

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)lho sgo'i gdan la dbyug pa ra nub sgo'i gdan la pad ma mo byang sgo'i gdan la ral gri ra shar lha'i gdan la tsa rtsi ka lho nub kyi gdan la phag mo ༅nub byang gi gdan la dbyangs can ma ri byang shar gyi gdan la go ri 〉lha rnams kyang rang rang gi sku mdog la dkar po'i gzi 'od kyi nyams dang ldan zhing 'ga' zhig sku mdog dkar por 'don pa bsgyur ba ni/ dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs kyi dgongs bzhed ma lon pa'i rtog bzor thal zhing /de ltar 'jigs byed zhi ba'i rnam pa can du bsgyur na khro bo'i chas rnams spang dgos la/ de 'dra ni kun la ma grags pa'i gtam dang / ma spangs na khyim pas rab byung gi rtags 'dzin pa bzhin no/ kho bo'i (5ba)bla mas rgyas pa'i skabs rin po ches brgyan gsung pa ni khro bo'i mdog dang cha lugs sogs dang ldan bzhin pa'i ngang nas rgyas pa'i mdangs dang gzi brjid la ni dmigs pa gtso bor gtod pa'i dgongs pa yin no/ /sku'i cha thams cad las 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs 'phro bar gyur/ stod po bya/ 'pha snyo skabs der spyan 'dren pa 'dug na'ang spyan drangs zin pa'i ye shes pa mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du spyan drangs pa'i rnam dbye ma shes par ma sto no/ /sngar bzhin chu bzhi dang mchod pa rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar dang saḥlhaḥsogs kyis gtso 'khor rnams la nang mchod 'bul/ bstod pa bya/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i rnam pa can zhes pa nas/ bcas par gyur zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin/ khyiḥlha'i mjug tu/ bdag cag dpon slob ces pa nas/ shāṇ+ḍa ku ru oṃ/ oṃ bo dhi bṛ khri ya āḥlha zhes pa nas/ mchog thun gyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la bar du bakhen da pa thams cad rigatso bo yab yum la me lha'i sngags tshab tu phyiX dang badz+ra be+e ta li gnyis sbrel nas 'bul/'khor rnams la dzi na dzi ka nas badz+ra ra ti'i bar sbrel te bzla zhing / gtso 'khor la sreg rdzas mang nyung gi khyad par dang dmigs bsal la bye brag sogs zhal shes ltar bya'o/ che ltas pa'i bar snga ma ltar ro/ /lha rnams kyi thugs ka las spros pa'i sangasargyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po/ /bum pa dkar po bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa nam mkha'i khams gang ba spros te/ bsgrub 'di'i skabs su bsgrub bya gcig dang du ma skabs thob sna tsho gos brtsi shesadagos so/ bya pad ma dkar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa la dbang bskur bas/ /nad gdon bar gcod mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad kha dog nag po'i rnam par gyur pa phyir bkrus te/ gsal zhing dngas pa 'od zer dkar po'i gzi mdangs 'phro bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhrīḥ sogs kyis zhabs(6na)—76

dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rab dkar bdud rtsi'i bum bzang / thenabasil ma ga rta gos pa gsum 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra wa gos zung sta ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra tasbu so rtsi la ye swā hā/mchod pa rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar/ gtor ma dang nang mchod phul/ gnyis med thun mong ma yin khyab pa'i sku/ /sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ āḥgyi sogs kyis mchode yon phul/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang /zhes sogs dang / gshin rje gshed kyi yi ge brgya pa brjod/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis spos dang cas te me tog rnams sngar bzhin blangs nas karma rdo rje la gto nas sngar gyi gnas su skyel ba sogs phyag len ltar byed/ khyuḥlha nas badz+ra ra ti'i bar brjod/ gtso bo yab yum lugs gzhan rnams la man ngag ltar kha spo shes dgos so/ /'khor dang bcas pa slar yang sngar gyi gnas su gshegs te gnyis su med par gyur/ gsum pa ni/ me lha'i sngags mjug tu/ pu ce nas sha lta'i bar dang oṃ āḥhrīḥsogs kyis bsangs gtor dang zhal bsil/ wa sta dang tam+bu la'i sngags kyis gos dang so rtsi 'bul/ rang sngags kyi mjug tu a kā ro mu kho btags la gtor ma 'bul/ oṃ bo rnyi bṛ spu ya āḥ/ zhes pa nas/ mchog thun sreg rdzas lhag ma rnams 'bul gyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad ces pa'i bar dkyus ltar btang / 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ sogs kyis bstod/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis/ /bdag gcag dpon slob yon mchod kyi/ /'gal rkyen bar chad kun zhi zhing / /legs tshogs dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ sogs brjod/ oṃ de ba asne/ badz+ra muḥye shes pa rang bzhin gyi (6ba)gnas su gshegs/ /dam tshig pa me 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur/ /gsum pa ni/ me ma shi bar du 'jog pa'i long med na gzhil ba'i thabs dang / las kyi rjes mi mngon pa sogs lag len ltar bya'o/ /smras pa/nyes brgya'i tshang tshing stug po'i nags klung kun/ /ye shes me dpung mchog gis sreg byed pa'i/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rab dkar bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /sngon med gter gyi bum bzang che 'di bskrun/ /rtog ges dregs pa'i blos byas yi ge dang / /blun po rang bzo'i mu cor mgal dum phreng / /'phongs pa zas 'tshol ched du sbyin sreg gi /'brel med lag len byed pa rnam par mang / /snyan brgyud zab don mtha' dag yal bor nas/ /chos kyi rnam grangs thos lo lhur len pa'i/ /zhabs rdol snod dang 'dra ba'i —77

mkhas rlom khrod/ /legs bshad zur rgyan spro ba ngal ba'i rgyu/ /'on kyang shes ldan 'ga' srid na/ /phan snyam lhag bsam gyis bkod pas/ /zhe sdang thabs rgyud gshin rje gshed/ /phyogs dus kun tu rgyas gyur cig /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rab dkar bdud rtsi'i bum bzang zhes pa 'di yang / rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi bka' drin las/ gsang sngags gsar 'gyur gshed skor gyi snyan brgyud man ngag phra zhing phra ba rnams kyang thob par rlom pa'i za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so// sarba maṅga lo//

gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i zhal lung / (tha)'jam dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i zhal lung bzhugs/swa sti si ji/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi pad mar gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /brtse ba chen pos rjes su gzung du gsol/ /spros pa'i mtshan ma kun dang yongasabral bde chen chos sku'i ngang nyid las/ /nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs skur 'og min zhing gi gtsor bzhengs kyang / shes rab e dbyings ro langs mar sbyor thabs mchoge waṃ yig dus kyi dgrar/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje gar dgu'i nyams kyis gtum chen khro bor bstan de bsngags/ /lam 'di'i shing rta'i srol 'byed bi rū pa/ /dpal 'dzin 'phags pa'i yul du nyi zla ltar/ /grags las grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba yi/ /(2na8pal ldan chos skyong gtsug gi rgyan tu mdzes/ /smin byed dbang gi chu bo ma nub rgyun/ /spel mdzad dpyal lo chag dang 'jam gsar rje/ /grol byed 'i gdams pa bka' babs glo bo pa/ /skad gnyis smra ba shes rab rin cen drin/ /'khor lo'i mgon po bsod na mas mchoge ldan zhabs//byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs zha lu pa/ /lhan skyes ye shes ngo sprod zur chen rje/ /rnam gsum byang chub bar du rigs kyi bdag /gshin rje'i gshed gyur lha lnga'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /sgrub thabs 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i zhal gyi lung / /rang bzo'i bsre bslad dri mas ma gos par/ /'khrul med brgyud pa'i bka' srol ji bzhin 'dri/ /de la 'dir bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs kyi rim pa bsgom pa po ni bcos ma'i dkyil 'khor gnyis po gang yang rung bar (2ba ji bang bskur ba mtshan nyid dang ldan pa legs par nod pa'i rig sngags 'chang ba rnams kyis —79

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)nub mo nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la gnas bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ tho rengs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis gshin rje'i gshed kyi skur langs te bde ba'i stan tshom bu dang ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil lubor la tson pa skad dang stagon bzhi dang sgrub mchod ma byas pa'i zag jog gi go mi chod la gnas pas nyams su blang ba la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum/ dang po la thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis kyi/ dang po la skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ rdor bzlas dang gsum yod pa'i dang po ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan gsum la nyung mtha' brjod cing thal mo sbyar te bla ma dang dkon cog rin po che rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gnyis pa ni/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i lam gyi rim pa zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ gsum pa ni kun mkhyen bu'i phyag len du thun mong ma (3na/yin pa'i rdor sems mdzad pa mi 'thad pa ma yin mod/ 'dir 'jug pa bde ba'i dbang du btang ste sgrub thabs bdud rtsi'i bum pa'i rjes su gongs so/ /rang gi spyi bor sna tshogs pad ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog ston ga'i zla ba ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa dang mnyam par spyor ba/ yab kyi thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ dkar po de las 'od 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te hūṃ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams —80

gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i zhal lung / 6)cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes lhung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/zhes gsol ba btab pas/ hūṃ las bdud rtsi babs te yab kyi sku gang / de nas dbyibs brgyud de yum gyi sku gang / yab yum gnyis kyi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bdag gi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar thams cad gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon te shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar bsam la ngag tu/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya badz+ra sa twa twe no pa sta dro sgo me bha ba/ su to stso me bha (3ba tha/su po skyo me bha ba/ a nu ra sto me bha ba/ sarba sirnyi sme pra ca sarba dme su tsa me tsi sto shrī yaḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wa na sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa bsgru bha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ/ zhes ci nusabazlas nas rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ phyag 'tshal bstod de phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phyag 'tshal 'dud byed phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gus pa bang sku la bdag gsol 'debs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang lhung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhid dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus shel gong dag pa ltar bsam/ gnyis pa la bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis/ dang po la yul dag pa dang ma dag pa gnyis las/ dang po ni rang skad cig gi gshin rje'i gshed dmar por gsal ba'i thugs kur oṃ dmar po las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'bor gyi steng du hūṃ dmar po yongs su gyur pa las dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa'i rkang brgyad bzhogs je 'phel du song ba'i lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ dmar po de las 'od zer kha dog 'ja' tshon lta bu 'phros lus kyi nas gang nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ 'od zer sna bug g.yas nas phyir 'thon (4na)te rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil —81

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (3)'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar/rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥs spyan drangs/na mo gu ru 4 maḥsarba ga ta shrī ra khya ya mā ri maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā re saḥcheXgabs phyag bya/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī rak+ta sogs kyi rjes la bu lugasal sna phyi6ha mdzad pa 'grel pa med kyang mchod 'phreng gi gdangs 'gebs dka' bas 'dir bdud rtsi'i bum pa'i rjes su 'brangs/a lha pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/de bzhi du sha lta'i bar pad kor sngon du 'gro ba'i so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas mchod/dkon cog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/zhes sogs gur nas byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa byas la/bu lugs la gong gi phyag 'tshal stong nyid snying rje ma dang /'dir lus dang ngag yid ma sogs mdzad pa rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa nas kha bskangs kyang bu lugs la ma tswa jiḥha 'jug pa bde phyir bdud rtsi'i bum pa bzhin bkod/oṃ badz+ra muḥs tsho gis zhid rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/gnyis pa ni/tshad med bzhi bsgom mo/gnyisapa ni/sngags tshan gsum gyi sgo nas ye shes kyi tshogs gsog pas/thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas gzung ba'i yul dang bral ba rang gi sems kyi ngo bor bsams la/oṃ su bhā wa shus sarba dharmāḥsarba bhā wa shu rdo3rnya/de ltar gzung yul ma grub pas 'dzin pa mi 'grub pa'i phyir/gzung 'dzin gyi rtog 4ba pa dang bral ba rang rig pa lha'i skur bsamasal/'byud rgya dang cas/rma yo ga — maḥyo ga shu tsos/rang nyid lha'i sku gdan dang yosapa dbyug pa la thim/de hūṃ la/de mgo bo la/de zla tshes la de thig le la/de nā da la thim pa'i mthar nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa bzhin du bsams la/'byud rgya dang bcas/oṃ shā n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3lha/gnyis pa dngos gzhi bskyed rdzogs gnyis/dang po la rten dang brten pa gnyis kyi/dang po la 'byung bzhi bsrung 'khor bu lugs la 'di yang pha'i sngon du mdzad kyang 'dir bdud rtsi'i bum pa'i rjes su yis/gzhal yas khang dang gsum las/dang po ni/stong pa'i ngang las e las nam mkha'i khams0da rtsi'i bum par migs la yang bu lugs su mdzad pa legs las skyon du mi stir bar mdzo/ chos 'byung gi rang bzhin de'i dbus su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon ༵ zlum po dbus cud zad mtho ba phyogs kyi dbang

gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i zhal lung / 6)las gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu dbus su yaṃ dang 'chang bzung la g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po dbus su raṃ dang gru gsum 'bar ba'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa/de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pa chus gang ba lta bu baṃ gyis mtshan pa/de'i steng du lo las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa dbus su lam dang grwa bzhir rdo rje phyed pasamatshan pa/ de'i steng du / yig sngon po zhu ba las ri rab rtsa ba bang rim bzhi rtse mo lcog bzhi pa rin po che sna bzhi las grub (ldan)pa'i phyogs mdog gi dbang las lcog brgyad du snang ba/ gnyis pa ni rgya gzhung du mi gsal yang 'phags pa rin po che dang dpyal los skabs 'dir bshad pa legs pa'i cha'o/de'i steng du paṃ las pad ma 'bum e las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lte bar hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i ra ba dang 'dra ba/ steng rdo rje'i bla bre dang gur rdo rje phyed pa'i tog can thams cad kyang kha dog nag po rdo rje phra mos bar mtshams med par gtams pas dum bu gcig tu gyur pa'i phyi rol kun tu ye shes kyi me dmar nag bu lugs la kha don lnga ldan snang yang 'dir bskyed 6rnam shad kyi dgong po ltar bkod 'ur sgra dang bcas 'bar pa'i bsrung 'khor gyi dbusasu/ gsum pa ni/ paṃ las sna tsho gos pad ma 'dab ma 'bum la li ta'i rjes su ngas te rnam bshad las gsungasapa ltar bca yo dang ldan pa/ oṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ljang ser gyi steng du hūṃ las sna tsho gos rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus gru bzhi nag po'i lte bar sa las gzhalayas khang gru bzhi sgo rta babs bzhis mdzes par byas pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang gtso bo'i sku mdog la brten nas kha dog bsgyur ba rgyud sde gzhan du yong 'dug kyang sa zhal gnyis ka mthun par 'di bzhin byung / ldan pa'i steng na gser gyi pha gu 'char kha yod pa rin po che'i phra tshom can/ de'i steng du rin po che'i bre phul gyis bteg pa'i gser gyi gdung (5ba〉spob la brten pa'i tsi pa hrī kha nas 'phyang ba'i do shal dang do shal phyed pa la me long dang rnga yab dang / me tog gi 'phreng ba dang / dar gyi chun po du mas spras pas/ de'i steng du bya 'dab kyi sner spyi —83

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)blugs mchu med mgo bo thur bstan lta bu'i mda' yab dang pad ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyi pu shu gyen bstan gyis bskor ba/ nang ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rdo rje'i gdung zlum por bskor ba la brten pa'i bya 'dab kyi 'og gi rtsigs pa'i rtsa bar 'dod yon gyi snam bu la mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin spro ba/ gdung zlum gyi steng du rtsig pa lnga bsgrigs las rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bres pa/ dbus gru bzhi pa'i rtsig steng nas rgya phibs kyi rnam par phub pa'i rtse mor rdo rje phyed pa nor bu mig gsum pa'i rtog gis spras pa/ sgo bzhir rta babs snam bu bzhi pa dmar dkar sngo ser ljang ba'i mdangs can/ de'i steng du pad ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo/ steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can phyogs kun tu gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang bum pa las thon pa'i me tog gi sdong po sogs bkod pa phun sum tshogs pas mdzes pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba'i dbus su paṃ las sna tsho gis pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i phyogs bzhi dmar/ me rlung ser/ dbang ldan sngo/ bden bral dang lte ba ljang / ge sar ser ba'i lto ba dang phyogs bzhir e las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/gnyibs pa brten (6na)pa la/ bskyed pa la bsnyen pa/ nye bar bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ sgrub pa chen po dang bzhi yod pa'i dang po ni/ gdan dbus ma'i steng du slar yang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang ྅: las sna tshogs rdo rje brtsegs pa'i lte ba'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros par srid kyi nā da bkug ste thim pa'i rkyen gyis phyag mtshan sa bon nyi ma dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas hūṃ dmar po cha lnga ldan du gyur pa las dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa'i rkang brgyad bzhogs je 'phel du song ba'i lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ dmar po de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thamasa.a bha yas bshad pa'i rnam grangs su bkod pa lugs 'di la mi sbyor ba rdo rje rigs kyi nang gses kyi rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor yin pas rdo rje'i dgrag pa kho na'o/ khud kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas gshin rje'i gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hūṃ la thim/ dbyug pa hūṃ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor —84

gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i zhal lung / 6)du gyur pa ni/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dmar po nyi ma bye ba'i 'od dang mtshungs pa yum rdo rje ro langs mas 'byud pa/ shar gyi 'dab ma la gti mug gshin rje'i gshed dkar po tsa rtsi ka nag mos 'gyud pa/ lhor ser sna gshin rje'i gshed ser po phag mo ser mo phag zhal can mas 'byud pa/ nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed dmar po dbyangs can ma dkar mos 'byud pa/ byang du phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed ljang gu go rī ljang sngon mas(6ba 〉 khyud pa ste dpa' bo thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i dbyug pa dkar po 'char ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / g.yon na bdud mtha' dag gi khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ cung zad ba 'ad pa'i zhal rnam par bgrad pa/ mche ba brtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ smin mtshams su khro gnyer gsum bsgreng ba/ gsusakhyim dang brla dang brang zheng rnams che zhing sbom la rgyas pa/ sku dang yan lag dang nying lag thung zhing rags pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ mtha' yas sngon pos dbu skra bcingasapa/ 'jog po dmar pos sna cha/ dung skyong ser pos phyag gdub/ pad ma dkar pos mgul rgyan/ rigs ldan khra bos dpung rgyan/ nor rgyas kyi bu bdud rtsi'i kha dog lta bus ska rags/ stobs rgyu ljang gus se ral kha/ pad chen dkar po'i zhabs gdub bcings pa/ stag lpags rlone pa'i sham thabs can/ rusapa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ mi mgo rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa'i kha nas rgyu rlon la brgyus pa'i do shal dang rin po che'i rtse phran can gyi skam po lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ snyan gong ut+pal dang dar dpyangs g.yo ba/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ rgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung / snying rje rngams dang zhi ba ste gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pas gshin rje'i tshogs skrag par byed pa/ ma he dmar po rab tu khros pa rus pa'i zin bris mang por keng rus kyi dra bzhes par zha lu tsan+d+ra pas/ rus(7na〉 keng rus khyad par che/ /rus rgyan bshar mar keng rus kyi/ /dra bas g.yogs la lung rgyab med/ /gsung pa 'thad par snang /dra bas g.yogs pa'i steng na 'khas ( g.yas bskums pas ma he'i rwa dang gshin rje nag po g.yas dbyug pa dang g.yon zhags pa thogs pa kha sbub —85

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)tu bsnyel ba'i ltag rtsa dang g.yon bskums pas ma he'i tshang ra dang gshin rje'i rkang pa mnan cing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ tsan+d+ra pas 'khor rnams la ma he dngag na rje'i gdan gyi khungs medagasung yang zhal gyi ga cha kun mthun pas bla ma'i mnag las so/ /de dag gi pang na gnas pa'i yum rnams kyang zhes gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra nag po grol bas sku sked yan chad non pa/ stod smad rgyas la sked pa phra ba/ phyag rgya lnga dang sbrul sa rgyas brgyan pa/ g.yas pas rdo rje gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'byud pa/ mgo bo bskam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang bskam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ gcer bu g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis 'byud pa'o/ khar lhor mu men gyi bum pa ngo bo bzhi mnyam rnam pa gser btso ma'i khu ba lta bus gang ba/ lho nub tu gser gyi bum pa gla rtsi be+eḍūr+ya'i khu ba lta bus gang ba/ nub byang du byu ru'i bum pa sih+la mtshal cog la ma lta bus gang ba/ byang shar du dngul gyi bum pa ga bur shel dkar bzhu ba lta bus gang ba ste bzhi ga 'di thod pa zla ba ltar dkar ba dngas ma'i mchog gis yongs su gang bas kha bcad pa'o/ gtso bo'i (7ba)thugs kur paṃ las pad ma dang e dmar po las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bo hūṃ dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa rkang brgyad bzhogs je 'phel du song ba'i lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ dmar por bsam/ gnyis pa nye bar bsnyen pa la/ bde ba bsgrub pa/ shes rab bskyed pa/ gnas gsum byin rlabs dngos dang gsum/ dang po ni rang nyid gshin rje'i gshed dmar po dang rig ma ro langs mar bsgom pa lha'i 'du shes/ hūṃ las byung ba'i yab kyi bu lugs la rtse mor /dang bugar phaṭa sogs bshad na'ang bdud rtsi'i bum pa dang rnam bshad na mi gsal bas bto snyoms su bas rdo rje dang a las byung ba'i yum gyi pad ma gsal 'debs pa sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs 'di la brten nas lhan skyes mngon du bya'o snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes te 'du shes gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas snyoms par zhugs pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i bde chen gyi ye shes rgyud la —86

gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i zhal lung / the)skyes par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3lha/ gnyis pa ni/ yum gyi lte ba'i 'og tu hrīḥlas pad ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hrīḥdamar po drod kyi rang bzhin can gyis brgyan pa/ de'i rtse mo nas yab kyi spyi bor sa zhal gnyis ka'i ga du migs go yang mkha ༄ chus gtso sgo spyi bo nas tshes po gos spyod do/ /nya dkar po saḥ'i drod kyis bskul ba la brten nas spyi bo'i bdud rtsi las 'thon pa'i ri 'a dkar po shel dkar gyi skud pa lta bus (8na sprol bar bsam/ gsum gas che chung na med pas ma byas kyang rung zhes tham cad mkhyen pa bu gsung yang da lta sa zhal gnyis ka'i phyag len la mdzad pa ni/ lha rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa lte bar oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la āḥs mtshan pa/ thugs kur hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de dag las 'od 'phros pas gdod ma nas grub pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta oṃ arnya nas shasta bra twe ts+tsha swā hās mchod/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje rnams bdag gi gnas gsum du thim pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsam/ 'byud rgya dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+pa ko3nya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka badz+ra su bhā pra āt+pa ko3gi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3nya/ gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer sa pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu dang bcasapa'i gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tsho gos mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ (8ba)sarba ta thā ga tā pañtsa kū la sa pa ri wā ra arnya nas sha lta pra tī ts+tsha swā hās mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṇiñtsa hu me/ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzi bha wa a bhi sa ṣañtsa me/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus gang / dri ma dag nas dbang bskur gyi lha rnams cod pan du gyur pa ni —87

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa'/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ bzhi pa ni/rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes sems dpa' lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod 'thor zhid / oṃ hrīḥdzhaiḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hās/ phyi 'brangs bgegs bskrad/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī rak+ta sogs kyi mthar chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ 'di'i 'og tu mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba bu lugs la mdzad kyang rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi gzhung na mi gsal bas btang snyoms su bzhag mod/ chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa la 'brul pa mi mnga' bas byas kyang skyon du mi sems so/ /gnyis pa rdzogs rim ni/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu/ srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ de dur khrod brgyad la/ de gzhal yas khang la/ de 'khor rnams la/ de gtso bo'i yum la/ de yab la/ de ye shes sems dpa' la/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la/ de ā la/ de ha la/ de mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig li la/ de nā da (9na〉pa/ nā da yang 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du bsam mo/ gsum pa mjug la/ dag pa dran pa/ bzlas pa/ mchod bstod/ kha zas/ nyal ba/ ldang ba/spyod lam dang bdun las dang po ni/ 'od gsal gyi ngang nas chu las nya ldang ba bzhin du skad cig gis rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gsal bar bsam/ dmar ba nyid ni 'dod la sogs pa brlag pa'i don to/ /spyan gsum ni 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i dus gsum gyi phyir ro/ /phyag gnyis ni dngos po dang dngos med la sogs pa'i rtog pa 'joms pa'o//shes rab ma la 'khyud pa ni stong pa dang snying rje tha mi dad pa'i sbyor bas so/ /klu brgyad ni rnam par shes pa brgyad mtshon pa'o/ /mgo po'i 'phreng ba rgya phyed ni yi ge lnga bcu'i sbyor bas so/ /g.yon na thod pa ni ye shes lnga'i bdud rtsi'i ros yongs su gang ba'i stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /g.yas na dbyug pa ni phung po dang nyon mongs pa dang / lha'i bu dang / 'chi bdag gi bdud bzhi rnam par 'joms pa snying rje'i rang bzhin no/ /g.yon brkyang gi gom stabs ni khams gsum rnam par mtshon pa'o/ /lha mo'i —88

gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i zhal lung / 6)phyag g.yon par bdud bzhi'i khrag na re dang bcud len du ma kun nas myang ba'i phyir ro/ /g.yas par rdo rje gri gug ni dngos po dang dngos med kyi rnam rtog gcod pa'i phyir ro/ /gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir khro bo'i gzugs nyid do/ /gsus pa che ba ni mya ngan las 'da' ba'i phyir ro/ /dbu skra dmar ser (9ba)gyen du brdzes pa ni sangs rgyas che ba'i yon tan gong nas gong du rgyas pa'i phyir ro/ ngosabazhi ni sdug bsngal ba dang / kun 'byung ba dang / 'gog pa dang / lam gyi bden pa bzhi rab tu rtogasapa'i phyir ro/ /sgo bzhi ni bdud bzhi kun nas skug pa'i phyir ro/ /zur bzhi ni tshangs pa'i gnas gzhi rab tu rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /ka ba brgyad ni rmi lam lta bu dang / dri za'i grong khyer lta bu dang / sprul pa lta bu dang / brag ca lta bu dang / sgyu ma lta bu dang / smig rgyu lta bu dang / me long gi gzugs brnyan dang /chu'i zla ba dang / nam mkha'i dngos po dang / dngos po med pa'i nyon mongs pa 'joms pa'i phyir ro/ rta babs bzhi ni sbyin pa dang / snyan par smra ba dang / don spyod pa dang / don mthun pa nyid dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi rnam par dag pa'i don to/ /gnyis pa ni/ dpa' bo g.yul du bsad pa'i thod pa lta bu mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i thod 'phreng ngam ma 'byor na ru raka 'am 'bo ti tse gang rung lag g.yas su bzhag /g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod gtor/ khyoḥrdziḥs bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las phreng rdog re re'i ngo bo yang hūṃ dang rdo rje/ dbyug pa las skyes pa'i zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dmar po/ yum rdo rje ro langs mas 'khyud pa/ 'khor gcig phyag gnyibs pa zhes pa nas/ dbu bcan bzhug bang pa'i dpral bar skye'o dkar po nas/ dzaḥlha baṃ sngo'i bar dang / oṃ sarba ta shrī rak+ta ya mā ri a nas shasta bra tī ts+tsha swā hā'i bar gyis (10na〉pa chod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun rab mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal/ zhes pas bstod/lag pa kha sbyar ba'i bar du 'phreng ba bcug /thabs shes snyoms par zhugs pas gshin rje gshed yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i mi mgo khrag 'dzag pa'i phreng bar bsam/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya'i bar —89

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)du 'phreng ba bzung bas snying mgrin/ dpral bar reg cing / hūṃ āḥ.o lce la reg /oṃ badz+ra dzi hā/ dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs skar ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ dmar po re res mtshan pa'i mthar sngags kyi 'phreng ba 'od zer 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur te/ sngags 'phreng rnams las khro bo'i tsho gos nam mkha' khyab par spros/ sems can thams cad kyi don phun sum tshogs pa byas/ zhi ba la sogs pa'i 'phrin las dpag med bsgrubs/slar 'dus nas rang nyid la thim par bsam/ oṃ hrīḥrdziḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ snying po/ oṃ ho k+ṣiṃ k+ṣa me ka rā ya gro hā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po/ oṃ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā dhi pa ta ye ma hā du rda n+ta da mo kā ya/ nā sha ya/ nā sha ya/ pi drwa pa ya/ bi drwa pa ya/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'phreng sngags/ ode ṣa ra ti skud nu da tru ṭa hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥswā hā/ gtso bo'i yum dang 'khor gyi yang sgo snya sa go la/ nyes brtsegs zhal gyi yig cha tshor migs la yang rgyal rtse(10ba〉khungs 'bum nas zhus dag 0yin/yum gyi sngags/ oṃ mo hā n+ta kṛ ta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/gti mug gshin rje'i gshed/ oṃ mo ha ra ti hūṃ dzaḥ tsa rtsi ka /oṃ pi shu nā rnya kṛ ta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ser sna gshin rje'i gshed/ oṃ bi shu na ra ta lha hūṃ dzaḥ phag mo oṃ rā gan+ta kṛ ta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed/ oṃ rā gar ti hūṃ dzaḥ dbyangs can ma/ cha myun+ta kṛ ta hūṃ phaṭa/ phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed/ oṃ rgyu ra ti hūṃ dzaḥ go rī ma'o/ /bdud rtsi'i bum par mi gsal yang bu lugs kyi phyag bzhes la 'dug pas legs par mngon/ oṃ ya mā ra dzā sa to me ya sogs gshin rje spyi'i 'phreng sngags/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi yig brgya bzla/gsum pa ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis zin bris gnang ba'i maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod kyi phyag len 'phyugs med du bkod na legs par mthong bas stegs bu'i khar me tog gi tshom bu dbus su yab yum gnyis/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du re re bkod pa'i mthar/ byang shar du mtshamasa'adzin gyi me tog shar du mchod yon/ mer zhabs bsil/ lhor me tog /lho nub tu mar me/ nub byang du dri/ byang du zhal zas rnams gru bzhi cha snyoms par bsham pa ni spyi mchod/ de'i nang du phyogs bzhin sbos/ mar me/ zhal zas rnams g.yas skor du/ shar nub tu lhag po re dang bcas pa'i sgos 90

gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i zhal lung / the)mchod/ byang shar du 'das gtor/ mer 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma dang bcas pa bsham/ rgyun gyi thugs dam la mchod pa rgyas par ma grub kyang / rten gyi drung du mchod pa sbreng (11na〉tsar du bshams pa'i nang ngos su gtor ma ci 'byor bsham/ tshom bu ma grub kyang ting nge 'dzin tsam gyis bskyed pa phyag len du mdzad/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa grub pa'i mthar/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor ba'i stang ka dang khyuḥdzhaiḥs bsangs/ su bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang :las rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas(khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ steng thog rim par phub pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ hūṃ lasaye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnamasadangs shing thogs pa med pa bzang zhing rgya che ba 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ a lha āḥlhanas shasta āḥlha gi bar so so'i sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ rgyun gyi thugs dam la 'di bzhin dang / dus bzang lta bu la rgyas par byed na 'dir rol chen dang gaṇ+ḍi rat+na tshar gsum gyis byin dbab/ de nas skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bdag bskyed rdzogs pa'i mthar/ slar mchod pa byin rlabs man chad byed/ maṇ+ḍal hrīḥrdziḥs bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e las nam mkha'i khams cho me 'byung gi rang zhin de'i dbus su ye las rlung gi (11brko kyil 'khor sngon po zhes pa nas/ phyogs bzhir e las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor me me zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod/ bsdus pa la spro na/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ raṃ baṃ lo / las 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du paṃ las pad ma zhes pa man brjod kyang rung ngo / /de nas gnas so sor me tog gi tshom bu bkod par bsams la/saḥrdziḥsogs yab yum lnga'i sngags sbrel ba tshar gcig dang oṃ āḥ:tshar bzhi brjod la/ so so'i sngags kyi lha bskyed pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥdhīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ de ṣa ra ti nu da da tru ṭa hūṃ hūṃ —91—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)dzaḥswā hā/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed dmar po yum rdo rje ro langs mas 'khrud pa/ oṃ mo hān+ta kṛ ta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mo ha ra ti hrī dzaḥ shar du gti mug gshin rje'i gshed dkar po rdo rje spyod byed ma nag mos 'byud pa/ oṃ pi shu nān+ta kṛ ta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pi shu na ra ti hūṃ dza: lhor ser sna gshin rje'i gshed ser po phag mo ser mo phag zhal can mas 'khyud pa/ oṃ rā gan+ta kṛ ta hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rā ga ra hi hūṃ dzaḥ nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed dmar po dbyangs can ma dkar mos 'khyud pa/ oṃ i rgyu n+ta kṛ ta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ i rgyu ra ti hūṃ dzaḥ byang du phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed ljang gu go rī ljang sngon mas 'khyud pa ste dpa' bo rnams ni zhes pa nas g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis 'khyud pa'o/ /oṃ āḥ& shar lhor mu men gyi bum pa bzhi mnyam rnam pa gser btso ma'i khu ba lta bus gang ba/ oṃ āḥ& lho nub gser gyi sogs/ oṃ āḥ〉 (12na)nub byang du byu ru'i sogs/ oṃ āḥ/ byang shar du dngul gyi bum pa ga bur shel dkar bzhu ba lta bus gang ba ste bzhi ga'ang thod pa nas kha bcad pa'o/ /gtso bo'i thugs kur paṃ las pad ma dang e dmar po las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bo hūṃ dmar po yongs su gyur pa las dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa'i rkang brgyad bzhogs je 'phel du song ba'i lte bar nye sa la gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ dmar por bsam/ /lha rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ nas dgug gzhug gi bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī rak+ta ya mā ri sogs sngags dang phyag rgya rim pa bzhin sbyor/ de bzhin du tshig rkang dang po dang gsum pa man thams cad la sbyar zhing / lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ me tog /mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa'i dbang du byas nas gong du byin mas kya gsal kha med mtheb srin gyis spyi bo nas gtor zhing / mchod do phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/—92

gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i zhal lung / 6)mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las/ skyob pa'i nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba'i bdag (12bskod drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥ// bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi zhal du oṃ āḥlha/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan bi rwa pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥlha/ grub chen zlosdi he ru ga'i zhal du oṃ āḥlha/ grub thob kyi 'khor lo sgyur ba dpal 'dzin gyi zhal du oṃ āḥ// bram ze bir ḍi pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ paṇa chen ma ti ga lha'i zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ paṇa chen ga snyir ma ti'i zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ rdo rje gdan pa ni dzirlu ka de wa'i zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ paṇ+ḍita re be rgyu pra bha ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ chag lo chos rje dpal gyi zhal du oṃ 40PROB/ go lung pa mdo bde dpal gyi zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ shong lo rtsa ba blo gros brtan pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥlha/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan bka' babs dang po dpyal dag gsum pa dwa nā sho la dang bye brag thugs sras lo tsā ba dang ra kha brag pa nas brgyud pa sogs rnam grangs mang yang 'dir gtso che shos gtsin las yige ra 'gas nas mdzad do/ /legs pa'i blo gros kyi zhal du o āḥ&/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge'i zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥlha/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥ// semasadapa' chen po dkon cog rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi zhal du oṃ āḥlha/rje btsun rdo ring (13na)pa r+ṣa po'i zhal du oṃ āḥ// rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥ&/'jam dpal dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ āḥsnyi/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi zhal du oṃ āḥ// rigs kun bdag po mgon po bsod rnams mchog ldan gyi zhal du oṃ āḥ// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ snying ga'i thad nas 'thor zhing i hrīḥniḥ nas/ oṃ rgya ra ti hūṃ dzaḥ dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod cha(33

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tsho gos rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥlha/ rang gi lce rtse/ dpral ba/ spyi bor reg la oṃ āḥ&/ 'di'i skabs su nang mchod nas blangs te gtor ma skyong zhing / bar phud zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad/ lte ba tsam nas 'thor zhing / oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya dpal gur gyi mgon po sogs lcam dral bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥlha/ rmi shrī dharma pā la tsa tu rmu kha mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kā la yak+ṣa yī/ ka li yak+ṣa yak+ṣa bu tra ye/ ru dra bha tra ye/ ru lu rak+ṣa sī/ gnod sbyin lcam dral pu tra ming sring 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal ྾/ oṃ ra smo pra ṇa āt+pa gnod sbyin beg tse lcam sring (13ba 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal ྾/oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje'i lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du ྾/gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi ྾/ phyogs stong bsto lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ 'jigs byed dgu /rgyal chen bzhi/ gza' dgu /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad rnams kyi zhal ྾/ gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ spyo byed/brjed byed/ ma mo/ mkha' 'gro/ zhing skyong / pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi ྾/ bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis ྾/ thur du phyogs par gtor zhing / gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ 'gro ba gas drug /lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig /oṃ āḥ&/ oṃ badz+ra a skṛ ta su dwa na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+pa ko3nya/ dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyis gtso bo la bstod par bsam zhing / dril stabs sum skor byed cing gdangs dang bcas/ a ye kye kye bdud rtsi'i bum par migs la yang gtso tsho bstod pa༄ lugs ltar bkod gshin rje'i gshed dmar po/ /bla ma srin po'i gzugs rang bzhi/ kho bo khyod mthong rnam par 'jigs/ /bla ma khro bo'i rang bzhin spongs/ /khyod kyi gar mdzad sa steng dang / /sa bla dang ni sa 'og g.yo/ /chags—94

gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i zhal lung / thenapas brgyan pa'i khro pa'i yid/ /gar (14nasgo dzad khyod nyid ro langs lags/ /sku lus sbom thung dmar po ste/ /rnam pa sna tshogs skur sprul pa/ /rdo rje dbyangs can ma yis btud/ /gar mdzad khyod ni bde ba che/ /hrīḥrdziḥgasang sngags dag gis ni/ khyod ni sa gsum 'khrul pa sel/ /rje btsun snying rje'i khro bo lags/ /gar mdzad khyod ni 'jig rten gzigs/ /rdor dril dang bcas stid rgya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pā dza badz+ra su bhā wa ā khru ko3hi/ de nas sgra dang brag cha'i tshul gyis/ gtso bos kyang 'khor rnams la/ /gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje'i gshed po shin tu 'jigs/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /sku yi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /ser sna rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje'i gshed po rab tu 'jigs/ /sems kyi rdo rje rab tu gsal/ /rin cen rdo rje khyod phyag mtshal/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ khyab bdag chags pa'i chos 'byung gnas/ /dbyangs mchog kun gyi mchog gi mchog /gsung gi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje'i gshed po las kun byed/ /sku yi rdo rje rab gsal ba/ /phyag na ral gri khyod phyag 'tshal/ /yang 'khor rnamasakyis gtso bo la/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun rab mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal/ ces pas bstod/gtor ma dang po gyi/zla bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las byung (14ba tha'i thod pa'i nang du go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ pi ra shum mu las bdud rtsi lnga/ de dag gi steng du oṃ yig dang / a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ 'og gi rlung bskyod pas me 'bar nas rdzas rnams skol zhing gcig tu gyur te/ oṃ dang zla ba rdo rje dang bcas pa'ang lhung bas kha dog dri ro phun sum tsho gis par bsams la/ lag pa g.yon ma bstan te oṃ zhes pas sbyangs/ lag g.yas pa bstan te āḥyis rtogs/ gnyis ka phan tshun bsnon te mthe'u chung sbrel/ mthe bong lag mthil du bkug /sor mo lhag ma gshibs te cung zad thur du bskyangs pa 'dab chags spyi'i phyag rgyas sbyar/ lag gnyis —95

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)bsnol te rgyab sbyar ba'i srin lag sbrel/ mthe'u chung dang gung mo gnyis bkug pa mthe bong gis mnan/mdzub mo gnyis bsgreng ba 'chi med rnam rgyal gyi phyag bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang 'di gnyis bu lugs la gzhan zhin ston/rgya bstan te hūṃ gis sgron ma ltar bya/ mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab nas cung zad ma reg par bkug pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bstan te oṃ āḥ& gis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te thim par bsams la/ de dag gi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can las 'od byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / rdo rje thal mo kha gyen tu phye la/ oṃ rak+ta mu ku ṭā ya/ rak+ta dza ṭā ya/rak+ta mu ji ya/ rak+ta sha rī rā ya/ rak+ta bhu dzā ya/ rak+ta mu 〉mā lwa bha ra ṇ+ḍa ya/ rak+ta ra thas ma rā bhā ya/rak+ta pa dha sa nā ya/ rak+ta bha ra ṇa bhā ṣa ṇa ya/ i rda ba la/ kṛ h+ma (15na)gri hā/ ma ma bigha rna/ ha ra ha ra/ tsa tu rmā ra sgri bā ra ya ni bā ra ya/ khru sa ya tru sa ya/ bh+ra ma ya/ bh+ra ma ya/ hrīn+da ༷ba/ bhin+da bhin+da/ nā sha ya/ nā sha ya/ sho ṣa ya/ sho ṣa ya/ ts+tsha da rtswa da/ bhe da bhe da/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul oṃ shrī rak+ta'i mjug tu chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ sngags gsham du 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod 'bul/ dril stabs sum skor dang bcas gong bzhin bstod/ thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma gnyis pa'ang yi ge bzhi pas sngags rgyas sngar ltar byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas khro bo gshin rje'i gshed lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa spros te/ phyogs skyong rnams kyi snying ga nas lcags kyus btab/ mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings te bkug par bsam/ lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur las/ g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung dang / g.yas pa'i mdzub mo sbrel ba lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas la/ ཿhrīḥdzhaiḥwi kṛ tā nan hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ sarba dus khyu ā din sa pā ri wā ri wā ra ā ku rgyu ya dzaḥswā hā/ gtor snod kyi mthar g.yas skor gyis shar du dbang po sa srungs la zhen pa/ lhor gshin rje ma he la zhen pa/ nub tu chu lha chu srin la zhen pa/ byang du lus ngan gter la gnas pa/ dbang ldan du dbang ldan khyu mchog la zhen pa/ mer me —96

gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i zhal lung / (thadalha ra skyes la zhen pa/ bden bral du srin po ro langs la zhen pa/ rlung du rlung lha ri dwags la zhon pa/dbus su tshangs pa/ mdun du zla ba/ rgyab tu nyi ma/ ga 'gas g.yas su nor 'dzin ma/ g.yon du thagasabazang ris/ de rnams la (15ba)srid pa gsum na spyod pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba bsams la/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur phur bu 'dzin tshul/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas thal mo brkyangs pa'i mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan/ sor mo dbus ma gsum brkyangs pa'i phyag rgya bcas te/ rang gi snying ga nas khro bo gshin rje'i gshed phyag na tho ba dang phur bu thogs pa spros te/ oṃ hrīḥrdziḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/sngar gyi phyag rgyas phur bu brdung tshul bya/ hūṃ sarba du sna spro ā din sa pa ri wā ran ki lwa ya hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/snying ga dang mgrin pa dang rkang pa'i bar du phur bus btab pas grub pa'i bcud len grub pa bzhin du skad gcig gis stong pa'i ngang las/ zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi sku gnyug ma'i shes rab mas 'khyud pa/ g.yon brkyangs kyis gnas pa/ sgrub pa po'i bsam pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣe ka ta sam ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur bsazhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed re res dbu brgyan par bsam/ oṃ a lha pra ti ts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ pā thu bra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ zhes mchod yon dang zhabs bsil phul/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyi 'od zer gyis gsal bar bsams nas rdor thal gyen phye mthar se gol bcas/ isgru na maḥ'adi rnams bdud rtsi'i bum par mi 'dug rung / bu lugs dang rgyal rtse gzungs 'bum mthun par byung ya na maḥhrīḥ ya mā ya na maḥ ྅: wa ru ṇa ya na maḥwi/ ku be rā yan maḥkṛ/ sha nā ya na maḥta/ asna ye na maḥ ā/ ni ri ta na maḥn/ bā ya be na mas/ tsa sgru ya na maḥ// arka ya na maḥ&/ ba surnya rā yi na mtsho bzhu/ be+e me tsi tri ṇi maḥ(16na spu/ sarba bhū ter bh+yo na maḥhā/ hā hā hā/ hrī hi hi/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phi phi 4 pha swā hā/ lan gsum gyisa'abul/ oṃ da sha di ka lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra pu 〉 nas shaga'i bar gyis mchod/ sngags mjug tu 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod dbul/ dril bu bsil zhing / bdud bzhi po ni rnam par 'joms/ /dpa' bo gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa/ gshin rje mthar byed phyag 'tshal zhing / phyogs skyong bco lnga'i —97

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)tshogs la 'dud/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyisabadag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'tshe dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog khres gtore ma gtsang sar gtang //rdor dril bcas 'byud rgya la gnas pas/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten la bde skyid 'byung ba dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnal 'byor don du gnyer ba bdag gi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bsrung ba dang skyob pa dang / sba ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig (16ba༄dz+ra muḥ'ajig rten pa'i mgron rnams gshegs par bsams la/ gyi rdziḥrjod cing rol mo drag tu bya/ 'di 'am 'das gtor gyi 'og tu chos stong rnams la gtor bsngos bya/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rak+ta ya mā ri maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri lhar a: nas shasta pra ti byu bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥ/ gis nang mchod dbul bstod pa bya/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya brjod/nongs pa bzod par gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ smon lam shis brjod bya/ bzhi pa bzas/ lnga pa nyal ba/ drug pa ldang ba/ bdun pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i rnam bshad sogs las shes par bya'o/ /de ltar mthu stobs dbang phyug bi ྅ pa'i/ /bzhed srol ma dros mtsho ru legs gtams pa/ /rgya bod mkhas grub bka' babs chu bo bzhi/ /tshad med skal ldan zla ba'i ma mar 'khyil/ /ljongs 'dir dri med ring lugs legs spel ba/ /thams cad mkhyen —98

gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i zhal lung / 6)nges bu ston lo tsā dang / /bgrang yas dkyil 'khor mgon po e waṃ pa'i/ /smin grol gdams pa'i gter mdzod tshar pa rje/ /mgon 'di'i rdo rje'i tshig gi gsang ba rnams/ /'dzin mdzad kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi /rnam bshad dpang por byas las rang bzo dang / /lugs gzhan srol bkag mun mda' 'di na med/ /tshig nyung blo dman rnams kyis rtogs dka' dang / /ngal ba'i khur gyis mnar ba'i spros pa can/ /ma yin mtha' gnyis ma lhung dbu ma'i lam/ /'di ko 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i zhas lung lags/ /dge bas sgrib gnyis lha chen nyi ma'i bu'i/ /g.yul las rnam par (17na)rgyal ba'i ba dan lce/ /srid pa'i rtse mor phyar nas lus can kun/ /gzung 'jug gshin rje'i gshed po 'grub par shog /ces rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi rū pa chen po'i bzhed srol 'jam dpal gshin gshed dmar po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i zhal lung 'di ni rang nyid kyi dran pa gso ba dang / rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje yab sras kyi ring lugs 'dzin pa'i 'dus pa'i grwa rnams su phan par gyur na snyam pa'i kun rtog gis yid drangs te dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mgon po rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba chen po/ thams cad mkhyen pa zur chos dbyings rang grol/ mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug mkhan chen zha lu pa gsum gyi bka' drin las chos tshul 'di la blo gros kyi 'jug pa cung zad shar ba'i za hor gyi ban rgan ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig 'dzin gyi btsun pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa dza / // maṅga lo//—99

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun bzhugs/na mo gu ru : ya mā rā khyu/ bka' drin mnyam med dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho spro dang bsdu ba'i byed po rje btsun bka' 'gyur pa mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /zung 'jug 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i go 'phang ma thob pa de srid du rjes su gzung du gsol/ /rab stims rgyal kun yab gcig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /rab dmar rjes chags nyams ldan dus kyi dgrar/ /rab khros srin po'i gzugs can khro bo'i dbang / /rab brjid gar dgu'i rnam rol mgon des skyongs/ /'phags yul paṇa grub yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /rgyan mchog grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur pa'i dpal/ /dpal ldan chos skyong khyod zhabs byang chen lam/ /lam bzang mngon gyur de srid spyi bor mdzes/ /ngal ngal 'phags pa'i yul bgrod mkhas rnams bstan/ /(2na〉nga yang chos 'di'i gnad la zhun thar bcad/ /gsal gsal blo gros yangs pa'i 'jig rten mig /mang mang brgyud par bcas rnams phyag gi yul/ /bka' dang dgongs 'grel ba ched srol ma nyams shing / /bka' babs rnam pa gsum las nyer 'ongs dbang / /bka' brgyud chu bos smin mdzad gnas gsar ba/ /bka' drin mnyam med bla mas rtag tu skyongs/ /zab mo'i byin rlabs stsol ba'i zha lu pa/ /zab rgyas grol ba'i lam ster zur chen rje/ /zab gsang spros med dran tshe mgon khyod kyi/ /zab lam rnal 'byor bsgom la gcig tu spro/ /de phyir mtho ris dbang gi chu bo'i rgyun/ /rgyun chad med pas rang rgyud smin pa'i thabs/ /thabs shes zung 'jug dkyil 'khor cho ga'i tshul/ /tshul ldan dam pa'i phyag bzhes ji bzhin 'god/ /de la 'dir 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed lha lnga'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas (2ba'i ba cing mchod pa dang / bdag 100

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ 6)nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang slob ma rjes su 'dzin par byed pa la sa'i cho ga sta gon gyi cho ga dngos gzhi'i cho ga dang gsum/ dang po la sa brtag pa/ bslang ba/ sbyar ba/ bzung ba/ phur ba gdab pa dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ gtsug lag khang / kun dga' ra ba/ rgyal po'i pho brang / skyed mos tshal sogs sngar nas longs spyod bzhin pa'i gnas su mi dgos shing ma dul ba'i sar byed na rgyud sde spyi'i khog dbug rnams las 'byung bas 'dir ma spros/gnyis pa bslang ba la snang ba dang mi snang ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ gnas dang sa'i bdag po la slong ba yul dus gnas skabs dang bstun/ gnyis pa ni/ de nas dkyil 'khor 'dri rgyu'i sa gzhi'i dbus su dri bzang gi thig le'i steng du tshom bu gcig bkod/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa/malji'i khar gtor zlum la chu chang nang mchod kyis bran/ rang skad cig gis zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed yab yum mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur bsam/ gyi sgriḥs bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las gyur ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par bsam/ rma a lha mi nyu nas shasta sa nyu gi bar so so'i sngags rgyas byin gyis brlab/ gtor ma oṃ 〉ho hūm̐/ oṃ lha3 zhes phyag rgya dang bcas brlab/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ (3na)de sha gra ma snyi ta k+ṣe tra pa ti ā ga rngu ya dzaḥzhes tshom bu la thim pas dngos su gyur par bsam/ oṃ de sha nas pa ti'i mjug tu bra kṛ ti ka sa pa ri wā ra rda pa li kṛ hā kṛ hā kha kha khā hi ji hi swā hā/ gong gi sngags gsham du a lha nas sha lta pra tī ts+tsha swā hās mchod/ mtheb srin gyis nang mchod gtor te oṃ mi lha gis dbul/ rdor dril spos bcas 'dzin pas/gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am ni g.yin/ /de dag rnams la sa 'di ni/bdag zhu khyod kyis stsal du gsol/ zhes sogs pa btab pas/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba ci bder gyis shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam/ mchod yon gyi rgyas/ oṃ a lha swā hā/ g.yas—101

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)pa'i khu tshur gyi mtheb mdzub kyis phyir se gol gtog cing / a pa ra sba rna la zhes brjod de gtor ma dor ro/ /gsum pa sbyang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gang du bya ba'i sa der slob dpon rdor dril 'dzin pas zhal dkyil 'khor shar la gzigs te bzhengs pa'i phyag tu las kyi rdo rjes yungs skar sogs grub rim bzhin 'bul/ hrīḥlha'i zla zhing byang shar nas 'go brtsams te g.yas skor du rim pa ltar yungasagar dang sbyin sreg gam mi rus kyi thal ba gtor/ tsan+dan bu lugs 'jig rten shar mdzad dang gur kum gyisasbran pa'i dung chu ku shas 'thor zhing mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ltar mngon par 'du bgyis pa'i ba byung lnga shar nas brtsams te 'byung / dbus su slob dpon zhal shar du phyogs pas/ phyag gnyis saganon gyi phyag rgyas sal reg la/ oṃ (3ba'i kho/ /sa nam mkha'i rang bzhin du bsam/ hūṃ lo hūṃ/ sa rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsam/ oṃ me di ni brdzi bha wa badz+ra ban+ta hūṃ/ sa rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i stong par bsam/ sa'i phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dri bar bya'o/ /zhes brjod/ bzhi pa sa gzung ba ni/ sa gzhi'i dbus su slob dpon stan bshams pa la bzhugs shing slob ma rnams gral la gdud pa'i mdun rdor dril rol chen gyi cha lag rnams bsgrigs/ stegs kyi khar sngon 'gro gtor ma bshams pa las kyi rdo rjes chu chang nang mchod kyis rim gyis sbyangs/ phyag gsum sa 'a na 'grengs te thal mo 'dud pa dang bcas sngon 'gro gtor ma byin rlabs mdzad pa zhu/ zhes brjod/ oṃ sa ho hūṃ/ oṃ gnyu zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pasabarlab/ khyuḥrdziḥs bsangs/ hūṃ sarba du / nas bzung yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod ltar la/ gtor ma btang zhing 'byud rgya byas nas/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du 'jam dpal
