gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na/ dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' — 102

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ thenaba'i srung ma khyad par can khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma (4na)rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang / de nas kyang bdag cag rnal 'byor pa 'khor dang bcas pa byang chub ma thob kyi bar gyi bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang / byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzad du gsol/ oṃ 〉lha zhes pas rang dang sgrub grogs kyi gnas gsum bsrungs/ badz+ra mu tshitshes dang / lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa sal reg ste/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs su gyur pa'i gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba'i 'gegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig /hrīḥsgribarjod cing rdo rje gsor dril bu drag tu dkrol gtor ma phyir dor ro/ /mchod pa byin rlabs gnas khang byin rlabs dor ba'i gzhan ma maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod las byung ba ltar dang skyabs 'gro nas bzung bzlas pa'i bar sgrub thabs skud rtsi'i chu rgyun du bdag bskyed sa sbyang pa'i gong du byung yang 'dir bu lugs kyi phyag len bde bar snang bas 'di'i rjes su 'brangs ba'i na bya/ de nas san ji la'i steng du gar chas su zhugs te 'khod par phyogs bzhi nas sgrub grogs ji ltar 'os pas rdo dril 'dzin cing lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas 'grengs/ phyogs bzhi ga'am bsdu na slob dpon gyi mdun phyogs su mchod pa tshar gcig bshams/ mchod pa gong bzhin byin gyis brlab/ mchod 'phreng gi tshigs bcad rnams la thal mo sbyar/ sarba ta thā ga ta la pad kor/ mchod sngags so so la so so'i phyag rgya'i mthar se gol gtog pa thams cad la 'gre bas/ 'dzam bu'i gling dang gling gzhan na/ /mchod (4ba〉rgon tsho gis kyis bkang ba yang / /bla ma gshin rje'i gshed po la/ /zhus pa med par byas te 'bul/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī rak+ta ya mā ri sa pa ri wā a: pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ /de bzhin du nyer spyod rol mo'i bar 'don pa bsgyur sha ltal rol chen/ kha dog bus mdzad phe 4ri sprin bsam yas kyi phyag yi bsto/ bzang zhing dri zhim reg na bde/ /srab 'jam yang mdzes lha rdzas las byung ba'i/ /na bza'i mchog 'di rdo rje'i sku la 'bul/ /bgres pa med pa rdo rje'i sku thob shog /spar+sha'i phyag rgya bcas la/ /sngags ma sdug tu oṃ bang wa sa se oṃ sa// /gzung 'dzin nga rgyal bcom pa'i stag lpags la/ shes rab khrag dang thabs —103

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)kyi sder bzhi ldan/ khren tu dpa' mtshan sham thabs 'di phul bas/ /ma lnga zhe pa'i nga rgyal ma lus zad bar shog /spar+sha'i phyag rgyas sngags mjug tu oṃ byā gh+ra tsarma wa sa se u lha/ /nyon mongs sha khrag zad pa'i thod pa lnga/ /thabs shes ma bral rdzogs pa'i ye shes kyi/ /rdo rjer brgyus pa'i cod pan 'di phul bas/ /bde gshegs rigs lnga'i cod pan ldan par shog /rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya mgo ba'i gnas lngar bzhag la/ /sngags mjug tu oṃ badz+ra shu ska ka pā la mā la mu ku ṭa gis lha/ /bdud rigs gshin rje bsad pa'i mgo bo'i 'phreng / khrag 'dzag lnga bcu rgyu mar brgyus pa 'di/ khro rgyal sku yi do shal du phul bas/ /yi ge lnga bcu dag pa'i gsung thob shog /rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgyas dpung pa g.yas pa'i thad nas g.yon du bskor ba'i tshul/ /sngags mjug tu oṃ sad rak+ta muṇ+ḍa mā la bha ra ṇa sa nyu/ /dug lnga lce gnyis ldan pa gdug (5na)pa'i sbrul/ /mgo la yid bzhin nor bus rab brgyan pa'i/ /gdengs ka can rnams sku yi rgyan du 'bul/ /dug lnga ye shes lnga ru gnas 'gyur 3|ga /sngags mjug tu oṃ a gyi nā g.yon pa'i mdzub gung srin gsum bkug mthe bong mthe'u chung gnyis brkyangs pa'i rgyab nas g.yas kyi sor mo lnga cung zad bkug pa'i tshul ga rā dzā bhu dzi ga ā le ka ra u3 gzugs kyi mchod pa khyad par che/ /sgra yi mchod pa yid 'ong ldan/ /dri yi mchod pa tshim pa'i mchog /ro yi mchod pa bla na med/ reg bya'i mchod pa bde mchog ldan/ /mchod pa rnam pa lnga rnams kyis/ /rab 'byams zhing rnams yongs bkang ste/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod//sngags mjug tu oṃ pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pā dza me gha sa mu dra snya ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ /zhing 'di rin chen sna bdun gyi/ /mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang nas/ /dngos grub 'dod pa sbyin pa'i phyir/ /nyin re shes rab can gyis mchod/ /sngags mjug tu sa sna rat+na pū dza me gha sa mu dra lpa ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ /lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal te/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyis/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ /sngags mjug tu oṃ aṣ+ṭa maṅga la dra bya pū dza me gha sa mu dra snya ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/oṃ sarba bid pā ra nas oṃ badz+ra lpa ra ṇa kho/ /lag gnyis thal mo brkyangs pa kha gyen bstan pus mo — 104

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ 6)g.yas g.yon gyi steng du ba 'ag nas/ rdul yab lag gnyis thal mo brkyangs pa kha gyen bstan pus mo g.yas g.yon gyi steng dug yabs sbrang yab bsil yab dang / khyams dang skyed mos tshal (5bskog dang / /gzims mal dang ni gdan khri dang / /myur 'gro rta dang glang po dang / /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing / /rta babasadang ni bla bre sogs/ bza' btung ro mchog sna tshogs dang / /glu gar la sogs mtha' yas mchod/bum pa bzang po 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /rin cen lag dang nam mkha' mdzod/ /blo yis blangs nas dbul bar bgyi/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub sna(ga /nag rdo rje khu tshur las g.yon pa'i gung srin gnyis kyi rgyab tu g.yasapa'i gung srin gnyis sbyar pa'i mdzub mo gnyis kyis bsnol pa'i steng nas mthe bong gnyis bsnol nas mnan/ mthe'u chung brkyangs pa'i tso/ po ra ri med pa yi/ /bum pa sto che bra chad pa/ /mchu 'phyang mgrin ring gdan ldan par/ /snying por bcas pa'i sman sogs gzhug /mgrin pa ras bzang dag gis dkris/ /'dab mar ldan pa'i lcug ma yang / /dri dang ldan pa'i kha rgyan can/ /bdud rtsir ldan pa yis kyang mchod/ /gzhan yang mchod pa'i rnam pa ni/ /bla bre gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / /ba dan sil snyan rol mo yis/ /gus pas dkyil 'khor pa la mchod/ rol chen bya/ /bla med mchog gi mchod pa sbyar ba 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan pa/ /dam tshig gsang pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ nang mchod mthor/ gtso 'khor lnga yab yum la maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod bzhin nang mchod dbul//de nas shar phyogs pa rnams kyis dril stabs sum skor dang bcas gti mug rdo rje sogs blo ka gcig gis bstod/ /dri chu dang tshom bu 'god tshul mthong brgyud kyi phyag len bzhin byas nas(6na)ma badz+ra bhū mo nas thams cad kyis yongs su gang pa zhes pa'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba ltar la bla ma dang dkyil 'khor kyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /de nas g.yas rdo rje dang bcas maṇ+ḍal bzung g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /dril gsil gyi tshe maṇ+ḍal dril bu la skor tsam byed/ /g.yon sngon 'gro'i gzhi bca'/ /pus mo g.yas btsugs te rdo rje slob — 105

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)dpon la dbul zhing / /des mtshon 'bul lugs 'og ma rnams la 'gre/ /i rda gu ru maṇ+ḍal kai ni rla ta ya mi/ /de bzhin du lho nas ser sna rdo rje sogs kyis bstod pa dang maṇ+ḍal gong ltar phul te /mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs/ /kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ nub nas 'dod chags rdo rje sogs dang maṇ+ḍal phul te/ /zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung / /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyang mdzad/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /byang nas phrag dog sogs dang maṇ+ḍal phul te/ semasacan kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchogo kha lo sgyur/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /de nas thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu/ /gshin rje 'jomasapa'i dkyil 'khor 'jigs/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo ni/ /sdig pa thams cad zad byed pa/ /mgon po dkyil 'khor bri bar (6bsgodzod/ ces brjod/ /slob dpon gyis maṇ+ḍal rnams kyi kha nas me tog blangs te nam mkhar 'thor/ /i rda gu ru sogs brjod de maṇ+ḍal gyi kha gsos rten gyi drung du dbul/ /rgyas par spro na 'di ltar legs zhes kho bo'i bla ma khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po'i gsung las thos pa ltar bkod kyis spros pa chung ba dang slob dpon gcig bus mdzad pa sogs la bstod pa rnams lhan cig pa'i mthar maṇ+ḍal dang gshin rje 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor sogs kyi mjug tu gzhi bca' man tshar gcig byas pas khyab bo/ /thams cad shar du phyogs pas/ /sems can mtha' dag nyon mongs pas gzir ba la bltas la/ /nyon mongs pa slar khros pas khro bo'i rnam 'gyur dang ldan par bsams nas/ /rdo rje slong ba'i khro tsho khu tso las mthus)sbreng de yo du 'degs pa phyag rgyas/ hūṃ badzo tilgabasgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa nam mkhar gnas par bsam/ /rang gtso bo las chad pa'i gtso bo gnyis par gsal ba'i mig g.yas g.yon ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba/ hūṃ las mig 'bras bskal ba'i me ltar bsam/ /rdo rje'i lta bas g.yon skor dang g.yas skor gyis blta zhing / badz+ra : lti ma ṭa/ bgegs thams cad bskrad cing rdo rje ra ba dang gur la sogs par bsam/ 106

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ (thadarkang mthil gnyis su hūṃ hūṃ las rdo rje 'bar bar bsam/ /skabs 'di nas gar rgyas bsdus ci rigasapa 'phreng ba dang gur gang rung nas blangs na legs shing mi spro na rdo rje'i lte bas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i lte ba nas brtsams te sna tshogs rdo rje'i 'gros gcig bya ba'am/ /ma grub na khyiḥsgyi'i rjod cing rdo rje gsor dril bu (7na)gsil/ /dbang ldan nas brtsams te skor ba gcig byas la/ /rang gi rkang mthil gyis yongs su bzung ba'i ri rab kyi rtse mo nas 'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi bar du sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsams nas bgegs la bka' bsgo bar bya ste gdangs dang bcas/lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kun tan cig /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /bsrung pa'i 'khor lo sbyor ba po/ /rdo rje gzugs ni 'bar ba yi/ /lus gsum las skyesa'ags par bya/ /gal te kha gcig bdag las 'da'/ /'jig par 'gyur gyi gzhan du min/ rdo rje'i gnas su/ 'khor lo/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ ral gri bcug la brjod/ rol mo drag po dang / lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos yungs kar gyi chun pos brab/ gu gul gyis gdugs/ /hrīḥrdzi mi zla zhing bgegs bskrad do/lnga pa phur bu gdab pa ni/ /de nas phur pa bcu 'am gcig ka ṭo ra'i nang 'brus bkang bar btsugs pa mchod g.yog gis bteg /mchod pa dang bcas gshams pa gong ltar brlab/ nang mchod dang hrīḥrdziḥbasangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ /stong pa'i ngang las phur bu rnams hūṃ dang rdo rje dbyug pa las stod phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dbyug pa dang g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ lte ba man chad rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rnam par gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par 〉 thugs kar hūṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang (7ba)bzhin gyi gnas nas phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed kyi ye shes sems dpa' oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥ/tha hoḥs bstim/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha zhes pa nas bzung ste dbang bskur gyi lha cod pan du gyur te gtso bos dbu brgyan par bsam/ oṃ sī rngu ra ti arnya nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ sngags gsham du 'bru gsum —107

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)gyis nang mchod dbul/ phrag dog rdo rjes bstod/ dril gsil bya/ oṃ khyuḥsgrigs dzaḥsu hā'i bar sngon 'gro gtor ma'i phyogs skyong dgug sngags dang / rang gi snying ka nas khro bo gshin rje'i gshed nas/zhags pas bcings te bkug nas/ phyogs mtshams brgyad dang / steng gi shar gyi shar dang / 'og gi nub kyi nub rnams su hūm̐ ring po las grub pa'i khron pa rnams su bcug par bsam/ las kyi rdo rjes slob dpon la tho ba dang phur bu gtad pa bzung ste rdo rje'i 'gros dang bcas bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong de rnams kyi spyi bor phur bu btsugs/ g.yas pas rdo rje 'bar ba'i tho bas brdung bar bsam ching / skyed gha gha ghā ta ya sarba du nyi phaṭa/ gī lwa ya ki lwa ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa hūm̐ hūṃ hūm̐ badz+ra gī lwa ya bsgo dha rod ā dzñā ba ya ti sarba sgru na kā wa wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra gī lā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing dbang ldan/ shar/ me/ lho/ bden bral/ nub/ rlung / byang / steng / 'og rnams su btab/ mthar bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas bzung ste rkang mthil gyi bar du phur bus btab nas/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la sbrags pas/ lus sgul bskyod med/ ngag rlung rgyu ba med/ sems rnam par rtog (8na)pa med par 'od gsal gyi ngang du gnas te 'gro ba rnams bgegs dang bral bar bsam/ de nas gdan la 'khod de/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi thams cad paṃ las rdo rje'i ra ba/ hūṃ las rdo rje'i dra ba/ la las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser pos phyogs bcings/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar pos mtshams bcings te/ thams cad kyang rdo rje 'bar ba'i rang bzhin can gyi 'od zer rnon pos khyab par bsam mo/ gnyis pa sta be/na la sa lha lhag gnas/ lha lhag gnas/ bum pa lhag gnas/ 11ba ma lhag gnas dang bzhi/ dang po ni phyag len gyi skabs sa bcad gnyis pa dang phyogs mtshungs su mdzad pa 'jug pa bde bas/ gnyis pa lha lhag gnas la lha gnas mi 'chol ba'i phyir las thig gdab cing cho gar mi gtogs pa'i ba9|mas bya ba/ lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga dngos/ gsol ba gdab pa dang gsum/dang po ni/ gang du bya ba'i gnas khang phyag bdar dang byi dor byas/ gnam sa bar gsum gyi rgyan rnams ji tsam shong ba bkod pa khyad par du 'phags pas mdzes par bya/ de'i nang du dkyil 'khor sgo — /08

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ 6)rkyang /nang pad+ma 'dab brgyad/rta babs snam bu bzhi/phyi bdar/rdo ra/me ri dang bcas pa'i spyi thig bcin du btab/mchog dang 'brel pa'i lha mar 'bebs rgyu med na skabs 'dir dri thig tshom bu bkod na 'jug pa bde zhing tshom bu bkod tshe de'i steng du sa lha'i tshom bu stegs sa 'god//de'i steng du mnyis bteg pa'i maṇ+ḍal la dri bzang gisabyugs pa'i khar sa lha'i tsho me bu dgod/ras bris la brten na steg bu lta bu'i sa der maṇ+ḍal chung ba zhig las lha'i tshom bu dang de'i steng du mnyis bteg pa'i maṇ+ḍal che 8ba)bar lha tshogs kyi dri thig tshom bu 'god/dwags shang zhi byed bo dong pa sogs ma dag pa'i phyag len 'chol bar spyod pa la mtha' ci bkag/rang phyogs kyi mkhas rlom mang po yang sa lha dang lha sta gon gnyis mi dgosapa sor bzhug gi phyag len mdzad mod/de ltar na thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha pa chen pos 'dus pa mi bskyod pa'i dbang don de nyid rab gsal gyi bar ma'i shog ldabs bcu gnyis pa'i mdun 'phreng gnyis 'og tu thig gdab pa ma gtogs pa'i lhag gnas rnams ni ras bris kyi cho ga la yang bya'o//zhes bka' rtsal pa ma gzigs pa 'dod yon la ha cang g.yengs pa'i skyon du 'dug pas spyan zur tsam ldang bar la la lo//de dag gi mtha' phyi rol dur khrod kyi thad tsam nas byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog nas bzung sgos mchod kyi bar bsham lugs maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod kye rdor gyi lhan thabs nor bu'i phreng bar/spyi mchod zlum po rang sgo mchod gru bzhir bshad//gong dkar ba dang zha lu ba gnyis sgos mchod mi mdzad pa ye shes kyi lha la bkres stogs mi yong bas i pas khan na mo/ji ltab/de yang 'dod snam gyi thad tsam gyi nang gi shar gyi mchod pa ni yab/nub ni yum/shar gyi phyi ma ni 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed kyi yin pas/lha so so'i g.yas su zhal zas/mdun du mar me/g.yon du spos yong ba ma phyugs pa byed/rtsa thig gi nang gi byang shar du sa lha'i sgos mchode/spos/mar me/lha bsgos/gtor ma de'i 'khris su sngon 'gro gtor ma cung zad che tsam dang bcas pa/de dag gi mdun ngos dbang ldan nas brtsams te nyer spyod lnga sbreng bum pa'i lha dang /dbang lha/gtor mgron sogs thams cad kyi thun mong la khyab pas nor 'phreng du gsal bar bshad/shar pa'i bdud rtsi rol mtshor mi gsal/tshar du bshams pa las thams cad pa'i mchod pa/byang shar du 'das gtor/shar lhor 'jig rten pa'i gtor 9nasgo 'jog/rgyas par spro na phyag drug pa/rnam sras/las gshin/dmag zor ma/gur zhal/beg tse rnams kyi gtor ma bdun tshar du ༷sgrig/dbang bskur byed na slob ma'i grangs dang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)mnya pa'i so shing / ku sha /srung skud/ khyor chu'i snod kyi dung phor/ zhal zas ma gtogs pa'i mchod pa/ ku sha'i 'thor yab la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa rnams tshang bar gsog /dri bzang gi lde gu /zhu 'bul gyi chas/ maṇ+ḍal/ me tog /spos re dang bcas pa slob dpon gyi mdun du bum pa gnyis mgul chings kha rgyan dang ldan pa/ gzungs rdor/ dung chos/ sgrub pa po thams cad kyi mdun du g.yas nasarim pa bzhin rdor dril/ gos zungs/ nang mchod kyi ka pā la rnams kyang bsham mo/ /gnyis pa lha lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga dngos la/ las kyi rdo rjes sngon 'gro gtor ma mañdzi la sogs pa'i steng du bzhag /chu chang gis sbyangs la phyag btsal te/ dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma bsang sbyang byin rlabs mdzad nas 'bul ba zhu/ zhes brjod/ sgrub pa po rnams kyis rdo rjes nang mchod 'thor ba'i stang ka byas la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma byin rlabs 'bul ba sogs gong bzhin bya/ gnas yo mchod rdzas rnams maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod ltar la gaṇ+ḍi rat+na tshar gsum gyi mthar rol chen gyis byin 'bebs/ lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba gdab pa na/ phyag gsum btsal la maṇ+ḍal bsham/ phyag gsum btsal nas me rtag dgram/ phyag gsum btsal nas zhu 'bul bya/ /phyag (9ba)gsum btsal nas me tog bsdu/ phyag gsum btsal nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ /phyag gsum btsal nas gral la 'dug /ces sdom tshig tu mdzad bu lugs la phyag 'tshal nyer gcig mdzad pa mi 'thad pa ma yin mod/'dir kye rdor lhan thabs nas nga 0 2 na pa bde ṣ+ka legs par ma' nas bkod/ pa ltar/ /las kyi rdo rjes maṇ+ḍal me tog dri bzang gi chu dang bcas pa gral gsham du khyer la phyag gsum btsal te/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun pa/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi ri/ gzhi dbang chen dag pa gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe 〉lha/ phyi lcags ri khor yug mu khyud kyis bskor ba'i dbus su hūṃ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang pa med pa 'di nyid/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pas gtso mdzad/ /'dir 'dus pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun rnams la — 110

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ 6)rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas par zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes sogs brjod cing dbul/ yang phyag gsum btsal nas bla ma'i phyag tu me tog gis gang ba'i ting phor du reng bu btsugs la dbul/ g.yin rnams la g.yas skor du me tog sil ma dgram/ yang sngar gyis gnas nas phyag gsum btsal nas snyim pas me tog dang bcas pas 'grengs te cung zad 'dud pasang ga tu/in+d+ra : tis mdzad pa'i sa'i ṭi'i 'grel pa las byung kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod pa'i sprin phung gis/ /mkha' 'gro lnga yi ma poms lgo pa dang 'don pa bsgyur/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma (10na skoms mchod pa dang / /yon bdag shegs zhi tshogs gnyis gsag bya'i phyir/ /gnyis med ting 'dzin dag la gnas par mdzod/ /ces lan gsum brjod cing me rtag 'thor tsam bya'o/ /yang phyag gsum btsal nas/ bla ma ma gtogs pa gzhan rnams kyi me tog phyed tsam re g.yon skor kyis bsdu/ yang phyag gsum btsal nas/ kun gyis thun mong du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ zhes brjod cing tshogs pa thams cad kyi maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun la/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi nas ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la tshogs kyi rdo rje slob dpon zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes sogs brjod cing maṇ+ḍal me tog gis phyur bur gang ba de nyid bla ma'i drung du khyer/ bla mas kyang sngar gyi tshom bu rnams kha gso ba'i tshul gyis/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi nas ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas bdag cag rnams kyi rgyud byin gyis brlab pa dang / /cho ga'i skabs dbye bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod de me tog gi snod reng bu dang bcas pa maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bzhag la/ /bla ma'i sku 'dra la sogs pa'i rten gyi drung ngam/ /dkyil 'khor gyi mdun gang rung du 'bul lo dkyil lor sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel ba'i bdag bskyed kyi rnal 'byor las gzhi spos kyis sogs gsung mkhan yod 'dug pa dbye ba ma (10ba)phyed par dkyus la shor pa'i skyon no/ de nas phyag gsum btsal nas/ las rdo rje nyid rang gnas su 'khod/—111 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (3)bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/bla mas thugs dam zab mo'i rim pa la 'jug par zhu/zhes bskul te skyabs 'gro nas bzung bzlas pa'i bar dkyus ltar bya/bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag dang sems can dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par mdzad du gsol/zhes gsol ba gdab/dkyil 'khor gong du bsdus grub pas skabs 'dir 'od gsal gyi dkyil 'khor mi dmigs par bsam pa las bsdu mi dgos/nang mchod la bdud rtsi ril bu ma btab na gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlab/mchod pa rnams kyang gong bzhin brlab/rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyis phyogs de/rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ra ba/gur/bla bre/ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lor bsam/rang gshin rje'i gshed du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas sa 'og nas paṃ las byung ba'i sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ lus phyed 'thon pa phyag g.yas pa dam bca' khas len pa'i phyag rgya dang g.yon pas bum pa 'dzin pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥrdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas spyan drangs/maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu'i steng du bdag la zhal phyogs pas bzhugs par bsam/oṃ sgo thi wā de khyu zhes mtshan sngags 11na〉sngon du 'gro ba'i a: nas shasta'i bar dang ga rje ra ṇis rol mo dbul/oṃ bri thi wi de khyu oṃ u lha/zhes pas nang mchod gtor/gtor ma sbyangs la/oṃ u lha gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsam/lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin dang oṃ bṛ thi wi de phyir a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/bus mo g.yas pa sa la btsugs te spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu bcad gtubs su gsil zhing /skyob pa sa pas rgyas thams cad kyi//spyod pa'i tshu lnga dang khyad par dang //sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la//lto mo khyode ni dpang du gyur//skyob pa shākya seng go yis//ji ltar bdud kyi dpung bcom pa//da ltar bdag gisabadud kyi dpung //bcos nas dkyil 'khor bri bar bgyi/zhes lan gsum gyi mthar/dpal ldan bla ma dam

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ (thadapa zhes pa nas 'tshal na zhes pa'i bar sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin brjod la/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngob grub kyang stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig /ces gnang ba thob par bsam/ slar yang gong ltar mchod la/ lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas sa la reg ste/ badz+ra muḥsa'i lha mo de nyid la thim par bsam/mchod gtor dman pa rnams bsdu'o/ /des sa bcad dang po sa lha sta gon 'dir blangs pa song nas/ /lha sta gon dngos bya ba la mdun bskyed kyi maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las nam (11ba)mkha'i khams zhes pa nas phyogs bzhir e las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar brjod/ las kyi rdo rjes bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa'i dri bzang gi chus lha lnga'i gnas su gru bzhi/ bum pa bzhi'i gnas su zlum po'i thig le bya/ me tog gi tshom bu 'god pa dang bstun te slob dpon gyis dbus su hrīḥrdziḥ dang / shar nas brtsams te/ oṃ mo hān+ta kṛ ta hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sogs bzhi dang / /de rnams kyi steng du slar yang me tog cung zad re bsnan la/ glu de ṣa ra ti sogs dang mtshams bzhir oṃ sa lha ste sngags rnams lan gsum re brjod/ /nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor/ /rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ /oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs te/ /dri'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bzhugs par gyur pa las dbus su bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed ces pa nas ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ yig dmar por bsam gyi bar sgrub thabs sa chog dang 'brel nas nam mkhar bteg pa'i lha mor bzhengs pa'i phyag len sor bzhag pa yin la/ sa bcad dang po'i skabs dor ba dang ras bris la brten tshe dri dang thig le thog ma nas bkod zin pa la dmigs te sngags tsam brjod rjes sngags rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus su bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed ces pa nas bzung ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bskyed rjes lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po mgrin par sa dmar po thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ zhes pa 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha zhes sogs dbang bskur dang ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya dgos pa skabs thob dbye/ ltar gsal btab/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed kyis phyogs bzung ste/— 113

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)(12na)srung ba'i 'khor lor bsam gyi bar sa lha ltar brjod/ /mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlab/ /bla ma dang dkyil 'khor pa'i gtso bo tha mi dad par mos la/ /mchod 'phreng ni sa gzung ba'i skabs nas len cing rgyas par spro na mdun bskyed kyi mchod 'phreng len rung bas dal brel skabs dang sbyor/ /bla ma brgyud pa la nang mchod 'bul ba nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol gyi bar maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod ji lta ba bzhin bya/ /chos skyong rnams kyi gtor ma phul/ /phyogs skyong gi gtor ma brlab pa nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod ltar brjod/ /gsum pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ /zhwa phud rdor dril spos bcas 'dzin pas/ /lce hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rjer bsam/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hā/ /bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed rdo rje/ /rig pa'i rgyal mchog khyod la 'dud//slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dkyil 'khor 'dri bar bdag 'tshal lo/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /bka' drin gnang bar mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnasadang / /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /'byung po byang chub bstan gnas dang / /sems can bstan la ma ho dga' ba/ /gang su rdo rje'i spyan ldan rnams/ /bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje 'chang chen che ge bdag gsang 4'a shul bur brjod na leg mod kyang (12bskra 'dra'i rnam dbye yod med sna tshogs yod pas rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag cag gis/ gshin rje'i gshed dmar dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji ltar nus pa'i nyer spyad kyis/ /'gro ba sbyang phyir bri bar bgyi/ /deng bdag slob mar bcas pa la/ /rjes su brtse bar nyer bzung nas/ /'dus pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /nye bar gnas par mdzad par rigs/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas/ /rig pa 'dzin pa khyod rnams dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig /ces gnang ba byin par bsam/ /gsum pa bum pa lhag gnas ni/ /pad nyi la gnas pa'i rdo rje dbyug pa lngas mtshan pa'i rnam rgyal dang / /las bum la rdo rje dbyug pa'i mtshan ma gdags/ /mgrin par ras bzang po'i chings srog bdun ldan gyis — /14

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'bor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ 6)dkris/ /hrīḥrdzi'i zlas te yungs gar brdeg gu gul gyis bdug /bum rdzas nyer lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga blug /chu gtsang mas dgang / ku shas kha brgyan/ /steng du dung chos gzungs rdor bzhag la/ /gyi rdziḥsabasangs/ /swa bhā was sbyangs/ /stong pa'i ngang las po las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyisakyi steng du baṃ las rin po che'i bum pa bu lugs la rnam rgyal chen po mtshan ma'i gnas rnams su lha bskyed pa'i phyag len mdzad pa mi yid pa ma yin mod 'dir bdud rtsi'i chu rgyan bzhin 'dug pa bde bar byas te bkod/ gnyis sto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ khag yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa dkris pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba/ rnam rgyal bum par sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang / phyogs bzhir nyi (13na)ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ las thams cad pa'i bum par pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du ya las zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed dmar po yum rdo rje ro langs mas 'byud pa/ de bzhin du shar du k+ṣa las gti mug gshin rje'i gshed sogs/ /lhor ma las ser sna gshin rje'i gshed sogs/ /nub tu ma las 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed sogs/ /byang dang las bum du da las phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed sogs dang / shar ltor mu men gyi bum pa zhes sogs sgrub thabs bzhin bskyed/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ zhesasogs nas dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥzhes pa'i bar lha sta gon bzhin las/ lhag por las bum gyi phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed la'ang gtso bo nyid kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī rak+ta ya mā ri sa pa ri wā ri zhes re re nas sngon du 'gro ba'i a lha nas sha lta'i bar dang / gaṇ+ḍi ra ṇis ral chen bya/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī rak+ta'i mjug tu oṃ mi lha gis nang mchod de dbul gtso 'khor rnams la bstod/pad kor sngon du 'gro bas gzungs thag blangs nas/ bdag gi zhal nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba gzungasathag la 'khril te song ba lha rnams kyi sku la phog pas ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la/ rnam rgyal la lha so so'i sngags dang / las bum la saḥdhīḥ dang hūṃ bzla/slar yang gong bzhi mchod bstod dang 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya dang ma 'byor ba dang —115

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)zhes sogs kyi mthar/ pad kor gyi lag (13ba)pas dung chos kyi chu bum pa gnyis su blugs la/ oṃ 〉〉 mchod yon phul pa'i rkyen gyis lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du bsam mo/ /de nas grub na skabs 'dir sbyin sreg kyang bya'o/ /bzhi pa slob ma lhag par gnas pa ni/slob ma lhag gnas rim pa ni/ khrus byas phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ nges 'byung blo bskyed nang dbang bskur/gsol btab sngags la spro ba bskyed/ rgyun bshags byas te hrīḥhiḥs bsrungs/ gnas gsum byin rlabs mchod pas mchod/ so shing khyor chu ku sha sbyin/ /srung skud g.yon bcings chos zab bshad/ rmi lam bsgo zhing maṇ+ḍal phul/ /gsol gdab sdom gzung rang gnas btang / zhes pa ltar las/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol tu mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams khrus byas/ /phyag dang maṇ+ḍal slob ma sta gon gyi yon du zhes sbyor ba khyad par yin/ phul la/ gnyis pa nges 'byung 'di dag gi snga phyi'i 'tshams sbyor gyi bshad pa ni sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel gyis mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed kyi dkyil chog /rje dkon cog lhun grub kyi kye rdor gyi dbang gad/ gi blo bskyed du gzhug pa ni/ /rang gi bslab ldan 'khor bzhi po/ /theg chen blo chen rnams la ni/ /de bzhin gshegs thar rtse ba'i 'phreng ba sogs phyogs 'di la brda byang ba'i mkhas pa rnams kyi gsung las shes par bya/ pas gsungs pa yi/ /yang dag cho ga rjes su gnang / kha cig gsang sngags sgrub don gnyer/ /dkyil 'khor du ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gzhan ni bsod nams 'dod/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten pha rol gzhol/ /blo bzang phal cher dad byas nas/ /'jig rten pha (14na)rol don gnyer 'jug /'jig rten 'di 'bras dor nas ni/ /'jig rten pha rol gos gnyer na/ /gang phyir tshe 'di bde blag 'grub/ /'di yis 'jig rten pha rol min/ /de phyir 'jig rten pha rol gyi/ /don du yid ni brtan par gyis/ zhes pa'i don bshad/ /gsum pa nang dbang bskur ba ni/ /bla ma yab yum sgoms par zhugs pa'i sgras/ slob ma rnams slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma ra gshin rje'i gshed kyi gzugs su gnas pa la/ /slob dpon gyi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rang gi zhal nas zhugs shing byang sems kyi rang — //6

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'bor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ 6)bzhin du zhu bar gyur pa rnams kyis dbang bskur te hūṃ zhes brjod pas pad+ma nas phyir dbyung ste rang rang gi gral la 'khod par bsam mo/ /bzhi pa gsol ba btab pa ni/ /mā ma ki bu lugs la ro langs ma dang lhan cig sbyor zhes pa tshol tsos par ma'/ dang lhan cig sbyor/ /bdag gi ston pa dga' chen khyod/ byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag ni bdag la stsol/ thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ /lnga pa spro ba bskyed pa ni/ /bu tshur shog cig theg chen po'i/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ khyod la yang dag bstan (14ba)par bya/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje sngags kyi mthu yis ni/ /ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa/ /gang gi shākya seng ge sogs/ /mchog rnams kyis ni bdud kyi sde/ /mi bzad chen po stobs chen bcom/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen 'thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces bu lugs la lan gsum brjod par bshad kyang mi dgos par sems brjod/ /drug pa rgyun bshags ni/ /sgrub thabs nas byung ba ltar thun mong ba'i sdom pa bzung / /bdun pa bsrung zhing gnas gsum byin rlabs ni/ /hrīḥrdziḥs bsangs nas/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dri'i chus/ /gnas gsum du reg cing / /hūṃ snyam zhes brjod pas snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje/ /mgrin par skyalas pad+ma/ /spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo bsgom/ /yang mas rim gyis oṃ 0lha zhes brjod pas phyag mtshan de rnams yig 'bru de dag gis mtshan par bsams te byin gyis brlab bo/ brgyad pa mchod pa ni/ mgo bor me tog /mdun du spos/ snying gar dri/ mdun du mar me rnams so so'i sngags kyis mchod do/ /dgu pa so shing ni/ a shwa rta la sogs pa'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa ma gas shing drang ba srog chags med pa/ dri bzang pos byugs/ rtse mo la me tog btags hrīḥkhriḥbazlas la slob ma la byin/ des — 117

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)kyang kha shar du bltas(15na)la so shing gi ra bar so shing rtse nas 'chos te/ oṃ badz+ra hā sa hā zhes brjod cing kha shar du bltas la bltos pa med par dor ro/ /rtse mo shar lho nub byang steng 'og tu bstan na zhi rgyas dbang drag rig 'dzin sa 'og 'grub cing dkyil 'khor du ma lhung na dngos grub med ces bsgo bar bya'o/ bcu pa khyor chu ni/ oṃ hrī cha shu zla sarba dharma sarba pā paṃ ni tsā su /shodha ya sarba bi ka lhun abanaya3/ zhes bzlas pa'i chu khyor bar lan gsum 'thung du bcug go /bcu gcig pa ku sha ni/ hūṃ las skyes pa'i ku sha chung ba sngas dang / che ba stan gyi dod du byin gyis brlab la hri:phyi bzlas shing sbyin no/ /bcu gnyis pa srung skud ni/ srung skud dmar po lus tshad dang mnyam pa sum bsgril du byas la/ rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum bor te/ slob ma'i dpung pa g.yon par bcings shing hrīXḥbazlas la rdo rje dri chu dang bcas pas bsrung ngo / /bcu gsum pa chos bshad pa ni/ /'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ /res 'ga' 'byung ngam mi 'byung srid/ /u dum wā ra'i me tog bzhin/ brgya lam na ni res 'ga' 'byung / /gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni shin tu dkon/ /bskal ba bye ba du ma sa /sngon chad sdig pa ci mchis pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ba yis/ /de dag thams cad zad 'gyur na/ /grags pa mtha' yas gsang sngags kyi/ /spyod tshul gnas na smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i (15ba)gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /spyod mchog 'di la gang rnams kyi/ /blo gros shin tu dri med pa/ /de rnams kyi ni sdug bsngal kun/ /'byung pa'i ngan 'gro yang dag bcad/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /de ring rnyed pa mnyam med rnyed/ /gang gis khyed rnams rgyal ba kun/ /bdag nyid chen po sras bcas kyis//bstan pa 'di las thams cad ni/ /yongs su bzung zhing skye 'gyur pa/ /de yis khyed rnams theg chen las/ /legs par skye ba nyid du 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po phyir 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /gang la khyed rnams 'gro 'gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes brjod/ /bcu bzhi pa rmi lam brtag par gdams pa ni/ do nub ku sha'i stan la gos dri ma med pa gyon te lha dang — /18

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ thenabla ma yid la dran bzhin pa'i ngang nas gnyid log ste rmi lam gang byung ba de nga la smra bar gyis shig /ces brjod/bco lnga pa sdom pa bzung pa'i phyir maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang / /dam pa bdag la stsal nas ni/ /mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gi /de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom pa gsang mchog rtag tu ni/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /slob dpon bdag 'gyur gsung du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ /sdom pa gzung ba'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag che ge mo zhes bya ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ (16na)ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub semasani bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims bslab pa rnam pa gsum/ /dge ba dang ni chos sdud dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis so so brtan bor gzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon cog gsum mchog bla na med/ /sdom pa sangasargyas rnal 'byor 'byung / /deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje chen po'i rigs bsdus pa/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /de nyid kyis ni rab tu gzung / /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin cen chen po'i rigs mchogo ni/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du lan drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rab tu sbyin/ /pad+ma chen po'i rigs dag pas/ /byang chub chen po 'byung ba la/ phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam chos so sor gzung bar bgyi/ /las chen rigs ni bsdus pa la/ /sdom pa thams cad yang dag ldan/ /mchod pa'i las ni gang nus bzhin/ /kun nas so sor gzung bar bgyi//sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa yang dag bskyed bgyi zhing / /sdom pa ma lus bzung bgyis nas/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi/ ma grol ba rnamasabadag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung bgyi/(16ba)/sems can mya ngan 'das la —119

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)'god/ ces lan gsum rjes zlos bya/ rjes chog ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la brlab/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī rak+ta ya mā ri re re nas sbyar pa'i a: nas gaṇ+ḍi ra ra ṇi'i bar gyis mchod sngags mjug tu oṃ ā hūṃ zhes pas nang mchod gtor/ /gtso 'khor gyi bstod pa bya/ /rdo rje rdo rje khu tshur gyi mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel mdzub mo brkyangs te rtse sprad pa/ gtsug tor ram/ /rdo rje shugs kyi phyag rgya spyi bor ldog ste/ /oṃ badz+ra be gwa kra ma hoḥzhes dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg /sta gon gyi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar byon te/ /ji srid sang spyan ma drangs kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes brjod/ slar yang gong bzhin mchod bstod byas la/ yig brgya'i mthar/ ma 'byor ba dang zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ gtor mgron rnams la bris sku sogs rten yod na phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa sogs kyis brtan bzhugs bya/med na oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ ces sogs gyi mthar mtheb srin gyis se gol dang //lag pa gnyis bsnol ba'i mtheb srin gyis se gol phyir gtog te/ /badz+ra muḥs rten med pa'i ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ /dam tshig pa rnams dza:lha baṃ ho ཿ sa rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ /rang gi dpral bar oṃ zhes sogs kyis/ /rang gi gnas gsum bsrungs la/ /sta gon gyi mchod gtor dman pa rnams bsdu'o/ /gsum pa dngos gzhi la thig tshon gyi cho ga /bum pa 'bul zhing dkyil 'khor brgyan pa/ /sgrub cing mchod nas dbang bskur ba dang gsum las/ (17na)dang po ni/ /thig tshon byin rlabs so sor bshad kyang skabs 'dir gnyis ka phyogs mthun du mdzad pas/ rang gi mdun du cog tse lta bu'i steng du rdul tshon kha dog dang mthun pa'i rin po che dang dri bzang yungs spur gyi phye ma bsres pa la/ ya/ k+ṣe/ ma/ me/ da/ bris pa dkyil 'khor phyogs ma 'chol bar bkod pa'i khar kha dog dang mthun pa'i thig skud dpa' bo'i rin gyis nyos pa'i ras bal gzhen nu mas bkal ba'i srad bu tshon dri zhim po dang yungs kur gyi phye ma bsres pas kha dog bsgyur ba kha dog re re la'ang lnga lngar byas la/ ring ba slob dpon dang slob ma'i lag pas bzung ba'i cha ma gtogs dkyil 'khor nyis 'gyur/ sboms su kun dril na sgo'i nyi shu cha 'byung bar byas pa kha dog dang mthun pa'i tshon so so'i khar bzhag /de'i — 120

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'bor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ 6)mdun du mchod pa bsham/ thig tshon bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi lnga'i steng du thig tshon sngon po ya las zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dmar po yum rdo rje ro langs mas 'khrud pa/dkar po k+ṣe las gti mug gshin rje'i gshed dkar po tsartsi kā nag mos 'gyud pa/ ser po ma las ser sna gshin rje'i gshed ser po phag mo ser mo phag zhal can mas 'byud pa/ dmar po me las 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed dmar po dbyangs can ma dkar mos 'byud pa/ /ljang gu da las phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed ljang gu go rī ljang sngon mas 'byud pa ste zhes sogs kyis gtso 'khor yab yum lngar bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ dbang (17ba)bskur/ rang gi mig gnyis dza las byung ba'i zla ba dang nyi mar bsgoms la/ o dwa stu stsi a rku sha dza/ mig gnyis la bkod par bsams nas sngags de nyid tshar gnyis brjod/ yang sngags de tshar gsum brjod cing / 'bur ba'i lta stangs kyi lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/ rdo rje bsdu pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas spyan drangs la/ oṃ 〉pra la mo ho ya ma a ri su tsakra su pra na ma hūṃ/zhes dang / de bzhin du mo ha'i gnas su pi shun dang / rā ka dang / i rā rgyun dang / de ṣa rnams bcug la byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ nam mkha' nas thig tshon gyi ye shes pa yang yang byon nas thim par bsam/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ gtso 'khor la bstod/ lha rnams zhu ba lasabyung ba'i thig tshon du bsams la/ slob dpon rdor dril thogs pa'i lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur gyi mdzub mo gnyis kyis tshoni rnams mnyed cing / oṃ badz+raḥ tra sam ya hūm̐/ gsum mam bdun/ gyi sgyiḥ/ gsum mam bdun/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sam ya hūm̐/ gsum mam bdun/ oṃ mo hān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du tsi tra'i sngags dang dpa' bo bzhi'i sngags gsum mam bdun bdun bzla zhing tshon nyed/ yang tshon so sor diḥ ring po tsheg drag can re bris/ slob dpon gyis rdor dril bcas me ltar 'bar ba'i dam rgya bcas la rdo rje nang bsdams kha gyes pas srin lag bus mo'i bar du mthe bong gshibs te bsgrengs pa/ bden pa gang gis sems can rnams rdul tshon mang zhing sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' (18na)rnams sems can la chags — 121 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)pa dang rjes su chags pa'i bden pa des rdul tshon rnams 'bar bar gyur cig hiḥrdzi/ zhes sbar/ thig skud rnams slob dpon gyi lag par blangs te/ gti mug gshin rje'i gshed bu lugs la phrag dog gzhin rje'i gshed dang 'dam ka snyug kyi nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i slob ma la thig skud sngo dkar ser dmar ljang gu'i rim pas thig sna gtad de brkyangs la dpon slob gnyis ka rdor dril 'dzin pas/ oṃ 〉rgya n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmā ྅ ra ྅ ra a nu ga taḥsarba dharmaḥ.a t+ya n+ta a nu pra bisgyu sarba dha rmaḥlha/ zhes brjod la dang po so so dang / de nas lhan cig tu bsgrims pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang gnyis su med par bsams la/ rdo rje la dkris te dri bzang gis byugs gser gyi snod du bzhag nas nyer spyod lnga rol chen gyis mchode/ hrīḥsgri'i zlas pas bsrung / de nas slob dpon langs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi nub tu gnas pas sno sogs kyis grogs la thig sna gtad/ des kyang snogasum brjod cing drangs la lte bar bzung ste/ slob dpon gyi g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mtheb sran gyis/ oṃ skyabadz+ra sa ma ya gu tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing / thig gi sgra dang / sems can don la khyed rnams kyi/ /dus yin de phyir 'dir spyon cig /ces pas bskul/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa' de bzhin gshegs pa rnams thig la thim par bsams la/ /tshangs thig dang po gdab pa nas bzung ste thig rnams g.yas skor gyis gdab dgos pa las/ gdab pa'i go (18ba)rim ni/ nub shar lho byang me dbang ldan/ rlung srin rlung dbang me srin po/g.yas skor rgyab 'gros tshangs logs gdab/ /me rlung srin po dbang ldan nas/ /rgyab 'gros spangs te zur thig gdab/ /gnyis pa sdebs dang po slob dpon dang / /phyi ma slob mar shes par bya/ zhes pa ltar ro/ /mthar slob dpon bden bral dang / slob ma dbang ldan du gnas bzhin pas/ thig skud la nyer spyod rol chen bcas pas mchod/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sta gon thugs kur gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/bsdu rgya phyir bstan nas dgrol zhing / oṃ unyu/ badz+ra muḥthig gi ye shes pa sta gon gyi lha'i thugs skar gshegs bsdu rgya dang bcas dam tshig pa bdag nyid la dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥ/ thig skud rdo rje la dkri ba phyag — 122

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ 6)len no/ /de nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs nas/ /oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma hūm̐ oṃ skya lha/ zhesabarjod cing thig gi 'og nas rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas nang du zhugs la/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su gnas pas/ /rang gi mig g.yas g.yon hi/hi/las nyi ma dang zla ba/ /mig 'bras lha las khro bo'i rdo rjer bsam/ /khyuḥgyi zhes brjod cing khro bo'i lta bas shar sgo nas g.yas skor gyis bltas pas khro bo'i rdo rje 'phros te thar pa'i sgo'i gegs su gyur pa rnams bcom nas sgo rnams phye bar bsams la/ dri'i chus sgo bzhi'i nang gi rtsa thig lag gnyis khro bo'i khu tshur gyi mdzub mos (19na)phyis la/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i gegs su gyur pa thams cad dbyi ba yang bgyi'o zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su zhal shar du phyogs pas 'dug la:/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /'jam dbyangs rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /'khor lo'i nang du yang dag gnas/ zhes brjod cing / /g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa rnams rim pa bzhin sgo tshad gcig tsam bris la thod pa'am ting phor lta bu bkab bu lugs tshorgo pas brtags mi bzhed cing bsrung / me tog la sogs pa lngas mchod de/ dbus kyi khung bu 'og nas dkar po sogs kyis rim pas bkang la/ slob ma la sogs pasadabus nas rin pas blangs/ /rtsig pa spel ran pa na khebs bsal te sbrel/ mtshan ma brtags la/dman nam mkha' lha la mtshan gtor phul te bsrung ngo / /tshon gyi kha dog ni/ dbus kyi sna tshogs pad+ma ni/ /phyogs bzhi dmar la me rlung ser/ /bden bral ljang la dbang ldan sngo/ /lte ba ljang gu ge sar ser /phyogs mdog shar dkar lho phyogs ser/ /nub dmar byang ljang dbus sngo ba'o/ /sgo dang rta babs me ri'i bar/ /dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun par bri/ pad+ma'i lte ba rang phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhir/ /nyi ma la gnas pa'i dbyug pa thams cad dkar po yin la/ /gtso 'khor mi nor ba'i phyir du (19ba)rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyis mtshan par 'dri na'ang lha bskyed pa'i tshe rdo rje dbyug pa kho na yin pa lung sbyor las bshad/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhir/— 123

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)mer bum pa sngon po/ srin por ser/ rlung du dmar/ dbang ldan du dkar po bu lugs rdo rjes mas par ltag pa kho na dri ba don la gnas par mthong / /rnams kyi steng du thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas bsgom don dang mi 'dzol ba gnad du che/ ba de 'dri/ de ltar legs par bris zin pa dang / ye thig dang tshon lhag ma rnams bsdus te/ mchod bstod byas la/ ye shes pa rnams sta gon gyi lha'i thugs kar gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam/ ye shes kyi thig nam mkhar bteg pa bris pa'i dkyil 'khor la gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥlha baṃ two zhes brjod do/ /ras bris la brten na thig tshon gyi phyogs rnams dor te ras bris byin rlabs can bshams pa las gzhan snga phyi'i phyag len rnams 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa bum pa 'bul zhing dkyil 'khor brgyan pa ni/ spos dang rol mor bcas pas slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal dang / las kyi rdo rjes las bum bzung la yig brgya brjod cing dril bu gsil/ dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum byas la/ lha so so'i sngags kyi mthar bdag gam slob ma la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes brjod/ lha de dang de'i mtshan ma'i thad nas bum chu phul ba'i tshul byas te dkyil 'khor kyi shar du ji ltar rigs pa'i gdan la bzhag /las bum la hrīḥdhīḥbazlas te/ phrag dog gshin rje'i (20na)gshed kyis dkyil 'khor gyi las kyi bar chad thams cad bsrung du gsol/ zhes dbang ldan du 'god do/ /de nas spyi mchod dang sgos mchod thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol tu zlum por bsham pa tsam ma gtogs gzhan mchod gtor gyi bkod pa phal cher sta gon skabs su bshad pa dang mtshungs shing 'dir sa lha'i mchod gtor mi dgos/ sngon 'gro dang phyi rol pa'i gtor ma/ slob ma'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i mig dang / me tog /dbu rgyan/ rdor dril/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan/ nyer spyod lnga'i mchod pa la sogs pa nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar tshang zhing bkod pas mdzes par bsham mo/ gsum pa sgrub cing mchod nas dbang bskur ba la/ sgrub mchod dngos dang bdag nyid 'jug cing slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ slob dpon gyi g.yas su cog bu lugs dang gong dkar ba sogs pa'i bkod lugs gzhan 'dug kyang 'dir tshar lugs sor bzhag tshe'i khar/ g.yon nas brtsams nang mchod ka pā — /24

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ (thadala'i stegs kyi zur phyir ston/ /dril bu'i zhal rdo rje la bstan pa/ rdo rje/ ḍā ma ru zur bslang / me tog phor ba/ de dag gi phyir bum pa gnyis kyi phyi nas rten/ khebs zur blta ba byas pas mdzes par g.yogasapa sogs phyag len ltar bya/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / gnas mchod byin rlabs nas brtsams te sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa rdzogs par bsgom pa nas/ nang mchod byin rlabs kyi bar thams cad sta gon bzhin byas la/ sngar (20ba)bshad pa'i rdo rje shugs kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su zhugs par bsams la/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gshin rje'i gshed yab yum gyi rnam pas 'khod par bsam/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las e las nam mkha'i khams nas/ e las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod/ dbus kyi mtshan ma ya las dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa las rang dang tha mi dad pa'i bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dmar po yum rdo rje ro langs mas 'khrud pa/ de bzhin du shar gyi mtshan ma k+ṣe dang dbyug pa las gti mug gshin rje'i gshed dkar po zhes sogs kyi rigs 'gros dang sbyar te lha lnga dang / mtshams kyi mtshan ma rnams yongs su gyur pa las shar lhor mu men gyi bum pa zhes pa nas a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra āt+pa ko ྅ lha gi bar sgrub thabs bzhin dang / yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs nas zhal mkhyen rab rje bde gshegs rnams rang nyid la bcig nas zhu ba'i lha tsho gos phyir spros/ rten brten par gyur pa rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs par bzhen/ du zhugs pa byang chub kyi sems su gyur te yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i thig le cha gnyis su bsam/ cha gcig rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du lha so so'i gdan dang bcas par (21na)bsam/ thig le cha gcig cha dgur gyur pa lha lnga bum thod dang bcas pa rnams su gyur pa ni/dbus su bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed yab yum/ shar du gti mug gshin rje'i gshed — 125

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()yab yum zhes sogs kyi lha lnga dang /mtshams bzhir bum pa la gnas pa'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi dang bcas pa'o//zhes ming tsam brjod pas gsal gtab/de nas gyi spyi yarjod de/yum gyi mkha' nang gi gtso bo yab yum dpag tu med pa spros/sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang dang rnam par shes pa'i phung po sbyangs/chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la bkod/tshur 'dus rang la thim pas/rang nyid zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed dmar po yum rdo rje ro langs mas 'byud pa/de bzhin du/oṃ me sa kṛ ta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/gti mug gshin rje'i gshed dpag tu med pa spros/sems can thams cad kyi gti mug dang gzugs kyi phung po sbyangs/me long lta bu'i ye shes la bkod/tshur 'dus shar gyi gti mug gshin rje'i gshed la thim pas/gti mug gshin rje'i gshed dkar po sogs kyi gsal gdab/oṃ pi shu nān+ta spo ta ྾/ser sna gshin rje'i gshed ྾/sems can thams cad kyi ser sna dang tshor ba'i phung po sbyangs/mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la bkod/tshur 'dus lho'i ser sna gshin rje'i gshed la thim pas ser sna sogs/oṃ rā gan+ta kṛ ta ྾/'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed ྾/sems can thams cad kyi 'dod chags dang 'du shes kyi ྾/so sor 21bskyog pa'i ye shes ྾/tshur 'dus nub kyi 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed la thim pas/'dod chags sogs/oṃ smin kral ྾/phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed ྾/sems can thams cad kyi phrag dog dang 'du byed kyi ྾/bya ba grub pa'i ye shes ྾/tshur 'dus byang gi phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed la thim pas/phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed ljang gu go rī ljang sngon mas 'khyud pa/dpa' bo thams cad kyang zhes sogs nas/ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar dang /oṃ āḥlha mkha' nang gi bum thod bzhi dpag tu med pa spros/sems can thams cad kyi yul drug gi sgrib pa sbyangs//zag pa med pa'i bde ba la bkod//tshur bos dal 'khor gyi mtshamasakyi bum thod bzhi la thim pas/shar lhor mu men gyi bum pa nas kha bcad pa'o/oṃ 〉lha/mkha' nang gi gzhal yas khang dpag tu med pa spros/ma dag pa snod kyi 'jig rten sbyangs/dag pa bde can gyi ye shes la bkod/tshur 'dus gzhal yas khang la thiX pas/'byung bzhi lhun po dang bcas pas steng du

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ (tha)bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du tshud pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bsam/ zhes brjod/ de nas gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ dbang bskur ye shes pa bstim pa rnams sta gon bzhin dang / wo dang po'i tshe sta gon gyi lha la rdo rje gsor zhing gyis brjod pas bgegasabaskrad/ mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i a: nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod la/ dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥs bstim/(22na tha rtan byed kyi bzlas pa bya mi dgos/ de nas mchod pa bsangs sbyangs gyis byin brlabs nas//dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul//bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ rnam lnga 'dod lag pa gnyis pa da kor snying ka /nu ma g.yas/ nu ma g.yon/yang snying ga rnams su skor du grags pa dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī rak+ta ya mā ri sa pa ri wā ra'i bar brjod/ a: pā dza me gha sa mu dra lpa ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī hūṃ zhes pa'i 'bru gnyis kyi dang po la lag pa gnyis las g.yas nang du bsnol ba kha phyir bstan pa'i se gol dang / rdo rje khu tso las mdzus mo gnyis rtse sprad pa'i tshul gyi phyi ma la 'bru gnyis kyi dang po la lag pa gnyis las g.yas nang du bsnol ba kha phyir bstan pa'i se gol dang / phyi ma la g.yon nang du bsnol ba kha nang du bstan pa'i rtse gol ga kho /g.yon nang du bstan pa'i se gol gtog /mchod yon gyi gnas su/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo zhes dang / a lha gyi gnas su/ pā du phyag rgya gong spus zhabs bkru pa'i tshul/ pu po /rdo rje khu tshur kha gyen du bstan pa'i tshul/dhu pe rdo rje khu tshur thur du spub pa'i tshul a lo ke /rdo rje khu tshur las mthe thong gnyis bsgreng pa'i tshul/ /ga rje rdo rje khu tshur dkrol ba las thal mo gnyis phyir bstan te phyung pa'i tshul/ni ga du/ gong bzhin las thal mo gyen phye nas btegs pa'i tshul/ shag zhesabasgyur rdo rje khu tshur la gung mdzub gnyis brkyangs te sil snyan dkrol pa'i stang ka dang se gol gcig gtog tshul/ /rol chen gaṇ+ḍi ra ṇis bya/ kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim reg na bde zhes pa nas bzung / sbrul rgyan 'bul ba'i bar sa bzung pa'i skabs ltar bya/ /'dod yon (22bsko ni/ /'dzam bu'i gling dang gling gzhan na/ /gzugasamachog tshogs kyis bkang ba yang / /bla ma gshin rje'i gshed po la/ /zhus pa med par byas te 'bul//sngags mjug tu rā g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyi steng nas g.yas pa'i mthil phyir bas pa'i tshul pa/ gzugs mchog gi — /27

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)gnas su/ sgra snyan/ dri mchog /ro mchog /reg 'jam rnams bsto/ rū pa'i gnas su sha lta/ garnye/g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyen du bstan nas dung chos 'dzin tshul dang g.yas sor mo bzhi brkyangs mthe bong cung zad bkug pa'i tshul/ rā rdo rje bsdoms pa las thal mo kha phye ba'i tshul/ sa/ spar+sha rnams 'don par bsgyur ro/ /rin cen sna bdun ni/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur nu ma g.yon thad nas phyir tshan/ 'dzam bu gling dang gling g.yin dag /'khor lo rin cen rdo rje khu tshur las nu ma gnyis kyi thad du mtheb mdzub rtse sbyar ba g.yas nas g.yon ma'i steng du skor bas phyir bstan pa'i tshul/ bkang ba yang /stong gsum la sog bas de bzhin te/ /sdom pa med par byas te 'bul/ /sngags mjug tu tsakra lag pa'i rgyab gnyis rtse bsnol mthe bong gcis lag mthil du bkug nas lte ba'i tshul/ rat+na ྾/ 'khor le'i gnas su/ nor bu/ glang po/ rta mchog /bud med/ khyim bdag /blon po/ zhes dang / tsakra'i gnas su/ ma ṇi rin cen khu tshur las gung srin mthe'u chung bsdoms pa'i tshul/ ha sti gong ma 'di gshed skor gyi lugs srol/ a shwa rdo rje khu tshur kha sbyar pa las gung srin gnyas lho sor rtse sbyar ba'i bar gnyis ma 'byar bar gdeng / /mthe bong gnyis sgreng tshul/ g.yon pa'i lag mthil du g.yas pa'i gru mo btsugs rdo rje khu tshur gyi gung mdzub brkyang pa'i tshul sti rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis kha sbyar pa'i rgyab tu mdzub mo gnyis rtse sprad pa'i tshags bar pa bcug mthe bong g.yas kyis g.yon mnan pa'i tshul/ gro ha sba (23na)ti rdo rje bsdoms pa las gung mo sbyor nas brkyang / /mthe bong dang mthe'u chung gnyis rtse ma sbyar bar brkyang pa'i tshul/ pa ri ṇa g.yon rdo rje khu tshur g.yas de'i mdun nasalag mthil kha spub pa gyen du bslang ba pus mo g.yas pa'i thad du mchog sbyin pa'i tshul ya ka zhes bsgyur/ /lha yi dbang po sogs bkra shis rdzas brgyad gong ltar/ oṃ sarba bid nas/ /snya ra ṇa kho zhes pas mchod pa'i yo byad rnams nye bar mkho ba dpag tu med pa blos sprul la/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa nyi shu pa 'di kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa kun rnam par dag bya'i phyir/ mi gtsang rnyog sel rin chen rdul yab mchog /gus pas blo yis blang nas dbul bar bgyi/ /dgyes shing 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ sngags mjug tu rā dzā wa ra ṇi〉/ dkyil 'khor pa kun nyer 'tshe bral bya'i phyir/ /mi mthun phyogs 'joms nor bu'i sbrang yab mchog /tshig rkang mtha' ma gnyis kun la sbyor/ /sngags mjug tu ma sha ka wa ra ṇa mo/ dkyil 'khor pa kun bsil pa myong ba'i phyir/ /tsha gdung gzhil byed yid 'ong bsil yab mchog /sngags — /28

phan rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu nur/ the)mjug tu gsum ga la g.yon pa'i lag mthil du//g.yas pa'i gru mo btsugs te bsgrengs nas rnga yab g.yab tshul bya rdzi nam/dkyil 'khor pa kun brtan par bzhugs pa'i phyir//yangs shing mdzes pa yid 'ong gzhal med khang /sngags mjug tu bī ṣi /dkyil 'khor pa kun bde bar rol pa'i phyir/ljon shing me tog rnam bkra skyed lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur snying gar bzhag ste g.yas pa'i gung mo dang 'dzus mo gnyis kyis pho brang zlum po 'bul ba 'a tshul/mos tshal//23bsngags mjug tu༄5 na ྾/dkyil 'khor pa kun thun 'tshams nga la gso'i phyir//dar zab la sogs bde ster gzims mal mchog/sngags mjug tu sha ya ā sa rdo rje khu tshur gnyis g.yasagayon du bsgreng ba ni gzams cha g.yog pa'i tshi/nar/ dkyil 'khor pa kun rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs phyir/ /rin cen du phyag rgya de nyid las gzhal med khang gru sto 'bul pa' tshi/ mas brgyan pa'i seng ge'i khri/ /sngags mjug tu rdo rje khu tshur gnyis 'bas te seng ge'i gdan 'bul pa'i tso du 'jog khas ྾/dkyil 'khor pa kun 'gro don la gshegs phyir//rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan myur 'gro cang shes khyu//rta'i phyag rgyas la la/sngags mas ga tu tu rī ga a shwa mo/dkyil 'khor pa kun theg chen sar gnas phyir/shin tu stobs ldan glang chen du ma'i tshogs//glang tsho phyag rgya tsos la//sngags mjug tu ga dza ྾/dkyil 'khor pa kun 'gro ba'i re skong phyir//'dod dgu 'byung ba'i yid bzhin rin po che//rin po tsho phyag rgya dang tsos/sngags mjug tu tsit+na ma ṇi ྾/dkyil 'khor pa kun gos rgyan sogs spyod phyir//'dod pa'i dngos ster dpag bsam shing ljon pa//sngags mjug thal rdzo kho bung//lpa prik+ṣa sko/dkyil 'khor pa kun gzhal yas khang brgyan phyir//gdugs 'khor ri dwags mchog mdzes rta babs bzang /sngags mjug ti tor rin ོ khu tso las srin lagadang mthe'u bsnol gung rma gnyis mnya par brkyang pa'i tso/khaṃ ྾/dkyil 'khor pa kun steng du rab brgyan nas//char sogs bla ba'i gnod sel bla bre mchog/sngags mjug tu yi tā na spo/lag mthil g.yon mnya gas dang g.yas dpral ba'i thad nas thur du sgrub pa'i tshul//dkyil 24na tshe ma bor pa kun ljags dbang tshim byed cing //sku lus rgyas byed bza' btung ro sna tshogs/ro'i phyag rgya bcas la/sngags mjug tu a nā pā ni mo/dkyil 'khor pa kun sgrub la snyan gsan phyir/2/sngags kyi rang bzhin snyan pa'i glu dbyangs dag/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)sngags mjug tu gti ྾/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis g.yas g.yon kha'i thad nas 'byed 'dzum gyi tshul gong dkar ba pi waṃ brdung pa'i phyag rgya mdzad / /dkyil 'khor pa kun sgrub pas mnyes bya'i phyir/ /lha yi ting 'dzin gsal byed gar dag gis/ /sngags mjug tu mkhur tshos g.yas g.yon dang dpul ba gsum gyi thad du pad kor re byas mthar dpral bar thal mo sbyar pa sa zad g.yon du skor tso ni rtar/ dkyil 'khor pa kun rtag tu mchod bya'i phyir/ /zad pa med pa'i gter gyi bum pa bzang / /sngags mjug tu bha dra gha thal mo khong stong ṭa/ /dkyil 'khor pa kun rgyun mi chad mchod phyir/ /ci 'dod rgyun ldan 'dod 'jo'i ba mchog kun/ /sngags mjug tu kā ma gnyis gung sring mthe'u chung gsum rtse sprad mthe bong gnyis gshibs te brkyangs mdzub mo gnyis so sor gdangs mkhrig ma sbyar bas dhe nu'i/dkyil 'khor pa kun brel ba med pa'i phyir/ /gang 'dod 'bras 'byung rin chen yal ga'i 'go /sngags mjug tu rat+na rdo rje bsdoms pa las kung mo dang tha ma bzhi gshibs bsgrengs ladha sta/ dkyil 'khor pa kun rang gi 'bras spyod phyir/ /mtha' dbus med par gang ba nam mkha' mdzod/ /nam mkha' mdzod gyi phyag rgya/ /kha gañdza lo/ nag po ra ri med pa sogs gong ltar byed nam mkha' mdzod spyi khyab las zur du mi 'dren 'di thebs nyi shu'o/ de rjes nang mchod rgyas pa/ bstod pa (24ba〉gong bzhin byas la/ /bzlas pa'i tshe lha rnams kyi sku la dmigs te/ /dkyil 'khor kyi lha so so'i sngags ci mang bzla/ /mjug tu 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ skabs 'di'am 'og bdag 'jug tshar nas sngar sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa lta bu'i cho gas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma rnams rgyas par phul/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par bya ste/ dpon slob thams cad zhwa gyon rdor dril rol cha dang bcas sgrub khang gi phyir 'thon dzi5dus kyi dang gis phyir 'gro ma thub na yol bas4da/ slob dpon khri'u shing la khrus bzhugs/ gzhan rnams de la phyogs pas/ rang bzhan gyi dkyil 'khor bsrung ba'i hrīḥhiḥkha yar bzla/ stegs la phyi rol pa'i gtor ma/de'i g.yas nas chu gnyis dang / g.yon nas nyer spyod lnga bsham/ chu chang gis sbyangs/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor ba'i stang ka dang bcas/ mchod gtor brlab/ gtor snod kyi mthar zhes sogs — 13(/

skyon rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khar gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ the)nas sba ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig gi bar brjod/ las kyi rdo rjes zhal zas nas g.yas skor du mchod pa rnams gtor snod kyi nang du rim gyis bsdu/ mthar mchod yon gtor snod la bskor te 'gro phyogs su bsgrengs la/ slob dpon gyis mchode yon gyi phyag rgya dang / hrī༅ shu rtse sarba dha rma sarba pā baṃ ni tsā su saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi ka lhan a pa na ya hūṃ zhes brjod/ yig brgya'i mthar/ oṃ 〉lha zhes pa nas gsum bsrungs la lag pa g.yas (25na〉sa la brkyangs te/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa sgrub khang gi phyogs mtshams su gshegs/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs zhes sogs gong bzhin btang / / gtor ma ring du dor/ /saḥdhīḥbazlos shing rol mos mtshams bcad/ nye reg bya/ slob dpon gyis rting mnan nas nang du 'ong / sgrub khang gi sgo nang du/ las bum gyi chus bsangs/ spos kyis bdugs/ oṃ badz+ra ye gwa kra ma hūṃ yig brgya rol mo dang bcas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba bdun nam gsum bya/ shar sgo nas/ oṃ pra tī ts+tsha badz+ra hos me tog phul/ oṃ pra ti gro: sto/ i rma satwa ma hā bā la/ rang gi mgo la bcings globadz+ra.ut+pa bu rdo rje khu tshur rgya pa sprad pa las mthe'u chung bsnol/ /mdzus mo gnyis bsgreng pa hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya'i lta pal/ mthub mo dril zhing sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūṃ gis sgo bzhi phye/ shar sgo nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pā da ban+ta na kwa ro mi zhes phyag bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar du 'grengs te 'dud pa dang bcas pas/ bdag las dang po ba'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / bying ba dang / rgod pa'i dbang du gyur pa dang /cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa dang / mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor ba dang / nyams pa la sogs pa dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub pa la skyon du gyur pa gang lags pa de dag thams cad bzod par mdzad de lhag chad bskong bar mdzod la/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi bka' drin rgya chen po stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo/ /gnyis pa la bdag nyid 'jug cing slob ma rjes su 'dzin (25ba)pa dang gnyis / dang po dkyil stsor kyi gtso bo dang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma tha mi dad pa/ cho ga dpod pa sogasaslob dpon gyi bya ba rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang dbang rdzas 'grem mkhan de'i thugs ka nas phye ba'i gshin rje'i gshed kyis mdzad par bsam pa gsung rgyun no/ /dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa dang zhugs pa la dbang bskur ba gnyis/ dang po — 131

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)ni/ slob dpon gyi mdun cog khar/ maṇ+ḍal snod ka ṭo ra me tog dang bcas pa/ dbu rgyan bzhi sgoms su 'jog bu lugs la rin 'byung zhal rang la bstan pa'i steng du cod pan gyis mdzes par mdzad/ las kyi rdo rjes tshogis pa thams cad la las bum gyi chu dang / maṇ+ḍal gyi me tog bkram la/ slob dpon gyis sna drangs te/ thamasacad kyas bum chu cung zad 'thung zhing ku shas 'thor ba'i stang ka byas nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ zhes sogs sngags dang bcas brjod / maṇ+ḍal dri bzang gi sman dang bcas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun pa/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi nas/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes maṇ+ḍal dbul/ /mā ma ki dang lhan cig sbyor/ zhes sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ rang skad cig gis gti mug gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ zhes brjod/ ā ṇa sa ra hūm̐ zhes pas me tog gi 'phreng ba blangs/ sngags de nyid dang bcas/ mig dar 'ching ba'i stang (26na〉ka rdo rje khu tshur las gung mdzub gnyis brkyang te mig g.yas g.yon gyi bar skor tsam bya/ /slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi tshe dngos su mig dar 'ja bas phyag rgya mi dgos/ byed/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ga nas phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed dpag tu med pa spros te dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par bsams la/hrīḥdzhaiḥbarjod cing las bum gyi chu gtor/ dkon cog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs kyi rgyun bshags dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal steng du me tog spungs nas me tog 'bul ba'i stang ka dang bcas/ maṇ+ḍal ri rab gling bzhi/ nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du thun slong ma yin pa'i sdom pa zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol sogs 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang / zhes sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ rdo rje thal mo'i bu lugs la mthe bong gnyis kyi bar du 'phred la bsnyal/ bar du bcug nas rigs lnga'i sdom bzung rnams sta gon — /32

gzhan rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ (thadabazhin no/dga' ba la dga' khyod su yin/zhes 'dri/des/bde chen bdag ni skal bzang lags//zhes lan gdab//rang gi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du don dam byang tso sems kyi mtshon byed dbyug pa dkar po rdo rje'i rtse mo can//mi mgo rlan pa ser pos mtshan pa dang bcas par bsam/oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta 26ba)u pā da ya mi/zhes dang /snying gar me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje bzhag la/oṃ su ra te sam ya sto 〉siju badz+ra ya thā su kho/zhes brjod pa brtan bu lugs la 'di'i 'og tu gsang bar gdams pa mdzad/ par bya'o/ /a kho khyi ra hūm̐ zhes sgo phye nas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du khrid par bsam/dkyil 'khor la mgo 'dud tsam bya/phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la rdo rje snying gar 'jog pa'i tshig mjug tu rdzong gong gsum dal bu gsal yang ngo ma tshar gnyis mi dkrol bas phyi ma'i lugs su byed/deng khyod slob ma 'jug pa'i cha yol ba nges par gsal yang bdag 'jug gi skabasa'adir rtsi rol mtshor mo mdzad pa'i phyags snang med/yol ba bsal na legs par mngon/bu lugs la dkyil 'khor la bskor ge dang phyag bya ba snang yang bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du mi gsal bas btang stoms su bzhan/de bzhin rdo rje mgo dang snying gar 'jog pa'i tshag mjug tu rdzong gong gsum dal bugs la yang der tshar gnyis mi dkrol bas phyi ma'i lugs su byed/bta shegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/de bas na ngas khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ye shes gang gis khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang 'thob par 'gyur na/dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/zhes brjod/nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la gzhag pa ni/rdo rje spyi bo dang /'di ni rdo rje'i dam tshig ste/khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje 'di/gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig la/'di smras na ni spyi bo 'gems/zhes brjod/phan yon nyes dmigs gnyi ga'i sgo nas dam la gzhag pa ni/snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang /khyod 27na ) kyi snying la yang dag zhugs//gal te tshul 'di smras na ni//de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/zhes brjod/mna' chu blud pa'i sgo nas dam la gzhag pa ni/dung chos su dri bzang po'i chu la/3rma badz+ra u dka'/bdun bzlas pa kha la btungs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)la/ bum pa'am dung chos yod pa rnams kyis dbus su bya zhing med pa rnams kyis srin mdzub kyis lte thog tu 'a rdzog tshul las dung gi phyag rgya byed/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngosagrub ster/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thungs shig rma badz+ra u da ka bras4ཿ/ zhes brjod/ bla ma bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la gzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi ngas 'di gyis shig ces gang bsgo ba khyod kyis bya dgos so/ khyod kyis nga la brnyasapar yang mi bya ste khyod ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar lhung bar gyur ta re/zhes pas dam la bzhag go /maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab ces sogs nas/ ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ zhes sogs brjod pa/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ rdo rje gshin rje'i gshed po bsgyur na legs sems dpa' bdag la dbab tu gsol/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ rang nyid 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed dmar po g.yas dbyug pa dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku can du gsal ba'i spyi (27bstan ra paṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa'i dbus su ha:/ snying gar lo las dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i dbus su snya/ lte bar raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po rno zhing 'bar ba'i dbus su 〉 rkang 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de la dzhai drag cing bzod par dka' ba 'bar ba'i gzugs brnyan rlung gis bskyod pas rkang mthil nas zhugs te lte ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor dang mnyam par phyin nas/ de'ang des bskyod nas shin tu drag tu 'bar ba'i sa'i dkyil 'khor bsregs/ dpral ba'i chu khol/ de las bdud rtsi'i tshogs babs/ 'byung po tshim par gyur nas/rkang 'og gi rlung gis 'degs bzhen par bsam/ de'i tshe gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te rang gi ba spu'i bu ga sogs lus kyi cha thams cad sib sib thim par bsam/ gtso bos mdzad par bsam cing rdo rje gsor dril bu gsol — /34

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ the)zhing rol chen bya/khyu:nyil a be sha ya dzha m+bha ya ra ra na/tsā la ya/tsā la ya//ā:haḥdzhaiḥ/phaṭa ces mang du brjod cing dbab bo/bdag 'jug gi tshe rdzas kyi dud pa mi mdzad/phebs pa rang 'dod chagasagashin rje'i gshed du dmigs pa'i lte ba la ā dmar po bkod la/brten pa'i phyir spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag nas/ti nga badzā 8na tshe tshes brjod la//'di nas mi la gul bar yar ro zhes po'i bar spradag 'phunagitshe mi mdzad mgon po rdo rje chos kho po/snang ba mtha' yas bde ba che//smros shig 'dod chags chos po//dge dang mi dge legs par 'dri/zhes brjod la dri bar bya'o/de'ang gsung rabs las dge ba dang mi dge ba smra ba'o/thugs babs na 'jig rten gsum du gtogos pa shes so//sku babs pas nam mkha' la 'phar ro//de'i tshe mgo bo'i steng du le las byung ba'i dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/des mnan par bsgoms na mi 'gul bar 'gyur ro//de nas sngar gyi me tog gi 'phreng ba de snya las rin po che'i me rtag tu mos/gtso bo'i dbu la me rtag phul bar bsams la/oṃ pra tī ts+tsha badz+ra ho/zhes brjod cing dbul/cha bra ti gros skye mo satwa ma hā bā la/zhes pas me tog mgo la 'ching /mig tu oṃ bsam/oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' dang /khyed kyi mig ni 'byed par brtson/rdo rje'i mig ni bla med pa/thams cad mig ni 'byed par mdzad/ces pas gdong g.yogs bkrol la/he badz+ra pā shu/zhes brjod cing mig dar 'grol pa'i phyag rgya snga ma las go ldog ste bya/bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi tshe dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bstan nas ngo sprod tshulas lugs rgyud sdo thams cad la lugasa'abyung bzhed cing /bu lugs kyis rnal 'byor rgyud la lugs ldog dang /bla med la lugs 'byung du mdzad pas skabs 'dir 28bdagongs pa gcig tu gnas so//chen po mngon sum du mthong bar bsam/zhes brjod do//gnyis pa zhugs pa la dbang bskur ba la/bum dbang /gsang dbang /sher dbang /tshig dbang dang bzhi las/dang po la thun mong ba rdo rje slob ma'i dbang dang thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gnyis/dang po ni/gong gi maṇ+ḍal bsdus pa'i mjug tu rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)yon du zhes sogs sbyar nas maṇ+ḍal dbul/ sangs rgyas shes rab chen po yis/ rdo rje sems dpa' dbang bskur ltar/ bdag la'ang mgon pos dbang bskur zhing / mchog kyang bdag la stsal du gsol/zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ hrīḥdhīḥs bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gnyis ka mi dmigs te stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yang dag dbyug pa las skyes pa'i zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed dmar po g.yas dbyug pa dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ yum ro langs ma dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par snyad mar po/ thugs dar hūm̐ sngon po/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i kha rgyan gyis de nyid dbang bskur tshul dang bcas/ oṃ badzi bha wa a bhi ṣañtsa mi/ zhes gsung zhing / dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ cod pan du gyur pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par byas nas dbang rdzas kyi lha'i dbu rgyan (29na)thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bsam/ dbang rdzas kyi yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur bsam/ slar yang thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa kū la sa pā ri wā ra a: nas sha p+ta 'a bar gyis mchode/ dril bu gsil/ thal mo sbyar te/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la/'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang / yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal/ de ltar 'di la gnang bar zhu/zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rdo rje tsa rtsi kā la sogs pa'i yum rnams kyis bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur bar bsams la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ gsang gsum gnas byung sbyin bu lugs la ba po shis gang zhig ma sogs spros pa che bar 'dug pa mi legs— /36

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ (thadapa ma yin mod 'dir bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bzhin bkod/ par bya/ zhes rnam rgyal bum pa nas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i khu tshur gyis chu blangs la/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣañtsa mi/ zhes brjod cing dbang bskur/ lus gang dri ma dag ste/dbang (29ba)gi lha rnams las dbang lha gnyis pa rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par chad de byung ba/bdag gi spyi bor dbu brgyan par bsam 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zin bris kyi dgongs pa bsto dbang lha thog mar spyan drangs pa de re re nasami bstim pa'i dbang du byas kyi spyan 'dren mchad bstod so sor spro na dbang gi lha rnams rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par byon te rang gi dbu bas zhes brjod do/ /mo/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥs rang nyid la gnyis su med par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra pur+sha a / lha/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe mi3/ oṃ badz+ra ga rnye a ༷ lha/ oṃ badz+ra ni wi du bu lugs la chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa rol mo'i bar dang / /bdud rtsi rol mtshor nyer spyod rol mo byung yang / /kun ma' mkhyen bu'i zin bris po sto bkod skya lha/ de ltar na zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgo nas chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed gyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /'di nas bzung rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi bar thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i lhan thabs sor bzhag bkod na legs par mthong bas/ smiḥrdziḥs bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rin po che'i cod pan gnyis ka mi dmigs te stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du me dang dbyug pa las skyes pa'i ser sna gshin rje'i gshed ser po g.yas dbyug (30na)pa dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ yum phag mo ser mo phag zhal can gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ud mar po/ thugs kur hūm̐ sngon po/ oṃ badzi bha wā adhi ṣañtsa mi/dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ dri ma dag dbang lha gnyis pa byon dbang lha bsdu tshe dbang bskur lugs mi bskyod pa'i lugs sgos byed/ te/ zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par byas nas dbang rdzas kyi lha'i dbu brgyan/thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ser sna gshin rje'i — 137—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (3)gshed kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥdabang rdzas kyi lha yab yum snyoms par zhugs/zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rin po che'i cod pan du bsam/rdo rje can rgyas par spro na gong gi dbang lha tshur bas zhas yi 'dren mgo snyod byed/kyis sangs rgyas la sogs/dbu rgyan mgo la 'ching zhing /charat+na mu kuṭa a bha ṇiñtsa badz+ra rā ga ta badz+ra sha li ho/ku shas spyi bor reg la/oṃ badzi bha wā a bhi khiñtsa mi/lusagang /dri ma dag dbang gi lha rnams mi bsdu tshe dbang lha rnams las gnyis po zhig byung nas zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par byon te rang gi dbu brgyan/thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad ser sna gshin rje'i gshed gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥs rang nyid la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/nyer spyod lngas mchod/de ltar na ser sna gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgo nas cod pan gyi dbang thob/nga rgyal dang ser sna dang tshor ba'i phung po gnas 30bgyur/mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ser sna gshin rje'i gshed kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag/saḥdziḥs bsangs/su bhā was sbyangs/bdag dang dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te stong par bsam/stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du me dang dbyug pa las skyes pa'i 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed dmar po g.yas dbyug pa dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/yum dbyangs can ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/mgrin par ā dmar po/thugs spur hūṃ sngon po/oṃ badzi bha wa a lha ṇiñtsa mi/dbang rdzas la dbang bskur dri ma dag dbang lha gnyis pa byon te zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par byas nas dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbu brgyan//thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas//phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥ/dbang rdzas kyi lha yab yum snyoms par zhugs//zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer bsam//rdo rje can sogs//sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje yi//dbang gis de ring khyod dbang bskur//'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid//rdo rje rab tu 'grub pa'i phyir/zhes brjod cing rdo rje snying ga mgrin pa/dpral bar reg la/slar snying gar bzung /8
