gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ the)spyi bor ku shas reg cing / oṃ badzi bha wa a bhi ṣañtsa mi/ lus gang / dri ma dag /dbang gi lha rnams (31na gi sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par byon te rang gi dbu brgyan/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/ dzaḥlha baṃ horang nyid la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ nyer spyod lngas mchode/ de ltar na 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag /'du shesakyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ma' du byas/ 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /gyi sgri:sa bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ bdag dang dbang rdzasadril bu gnyis ka mi dmigs te stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las po las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du me dang dbyug pa las skyes pa'i phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed ljang gu g.yas dbyug pa dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ yum go rī ljang sngon ma gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i spyi bor chadakar po/ mgrin par mi dmar po/ thugs ker hūṃ sngon po/ oṃ badzi bha wa a bhi ṇiñtsa mi/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ dri ma dag /dbang lha gnyis pa byon te/ zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par byas nas dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbu brgyan/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥ/ dbang rdzas kyi lha yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu (31ba tha las byung pa'i dbang rdzasadril bur bsam/ /rdo rje can sogs/ dril bu dkrel/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti ri/ a bhi ṣañtsa mi/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya sto/ ku shas spyi bor reg /oṃ badzi bha wa a bhi ṇiñtsa mi/ lus gang / dri ma dag /dbang gi lha rnams zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par byon te rang gi dbu brgyan/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza:/ dzaḥ/ baṃ hos rang nyid la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de ltar na phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag /'du byed kyi phung po — /39

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)gnas gyur/ bya ba 'grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /hrīḥdzhaiḥs bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ bdag nyid mi dmigs te stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du k+ṣe dang dbyug pa las skyes pa'i gti mug gshin rje'i gshed dkar po g.yas dbyug pa dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/yum rdo rje spyod byed ma nag mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i spyi por oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par snyad mar po/ thugs gar hūm̐ sngon po rdo rje can sogs/ rdo rje dril bu bsnol te spyi bor dkrol/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa alhi ṣañtsa mi badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a bhi khiñtsa mi/ lus gang / dri ma dag dbang gi (32na〉sna rnams zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par byon te rang gi dbu brgyan/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad gti mug gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/ dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥs rang nyid la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de ltar na gti mug gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag /gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ gti mug gshin rje'i gshed kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag go /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dang mtha' rten gnyis las/ dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o sogs kyis dbul/ /gang gi bdag ni khyod drin las/ /rang dang gzhan don nus gyur pa/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang / /snying rje'i gter gyi bdag la stsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ shrī tsho ྅ ཿsa bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i thad du dbang stegs pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du shing stan gyis bteg pa'i paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ bdag nyid hūṃ dang rdo rje dbyug pa las skyes pa'i zhe sdang ga thon rje gshed bsdu na dkyil 'khor gyi shar du — 14()

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lta lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ 6)dbang stegs pad+ma 'dang brgyad kyi steng du rang nyid gtso bo'i skur gyur zhes pas kyang 'thus/sku mdog (32ba/dmar po zhes sogs nas ye shes kyi me 'bar pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin gtso bo yab yum gyi mngon rtogs brjod/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlakhas/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥlha baṃ hos gnyis su med par bsam/ ku shas bum chu spyi bor gtor/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni nas/sbyin par bya/ oṃ badzi bha wa a bhi ṣañtsa mi/ dbu rgyan la lag pa reg tsam bya zhing / oṃ badz+ra rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣañtsa badz+ra rā ga ta badz+ra sha li ho rdo rje snying gar bzung / sangs rgyas bus la dmu rjos bskyed chog rgyasapar mdzad la skyon du mi 'gyur mod 'di tsam gyis don tshang ba'i phyir bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyi dgongs par sor bzhag go /kun gyi rdo rje yi nas/ 'grub phyir bzung / dril bu dkrol te/ oṃ badz+ra a rti pa ti nas/ sa ma ya sto gyi bar/ rdo dril bsnol nas spyi bor dkrol zhing / oṃ badz+ra satwa ri a bhi ṇiñtsa mi/ badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa sogs/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje/ khams gsum pa yi ral gri che/ sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag byas pa/ las kyi ral gri mchog lta bu/ bdud las rgyal bar bya phyir bzung / rdo rje lan gsum gsor/ snying gar bzung ste/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyoms tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o/ /rang gi sems thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi rdo rje/ de bzhin (33na tshe/gegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi dam tshig yin no/zhes ngo sprad/ snyalas byung ba'i dril bu/ shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin nyid/ rdo rje dril bu rab grub phyir/ bu yis yang dag gus par gzung / khyod kyis slob ma bsdu bar gyis/ dril bu lan gsum dkrol ste zur g.yon du bzung la/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag mchog sems dpa' che/ /srid pa'i dam pa byed par 'gyur/ rang gi ngag skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba grag stong gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gyi gsung gi dam tshig yin no/ /zhes ngo sprod/ rdo dril thugs kar bsnol te bzung / rang zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed — /4/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)dmar po g.yas dbyug pa dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje ro langs ma gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor pa'i sku can du bsam/ /phyag rgya dang 'byud pa'i tshul byas la/ /yid kyis lus brten de nyid kyis/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu bshad/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad brten/ /des na phyag rgyar rab tu grags/ /cheXg pa ni phyag rgya'i dam tshig yin la/ shes rab stso drug lon pa la/ /lag pa dag gis yang dag 'byud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon gyi ni dbang du brjod/ /tha mal pa'i bde ba ni ma dag pa'o/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha yab yum gyi sku snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i rnal 'byor du byas te/ 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad la longs spyod cig /gzhan thams cad kyang de bzhin du shes (33ba)par gyis la mchod par gyis shig /de ltar byas pas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba 'di ni mi 'da' ba'i phyir dam tshig yin no/ /zhes bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos ngo sprad par bsam/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la sogs dang dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni nas sbyin par bya hāḥdzhaiḥdang / / oṃ badz+re bha wa a bhi ṣañtsa mi/ oṃ dī ṣa ྾/ oṃ badz+re ྾/ thog mar yab bzhi dang de rjes yum bzhi so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa a bhi ṣañtsa mi/ zhes btags/ dbang gi chu rgyun des lus gang / dri ma dag /rtsa ba'i dbang lha rnams re re 7sa nas dbang lha spyan drangs tshe dbang bskur gyi lha rnams cod pan du gyur pa ni kho brjod/ rdzogs par byon nas rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par gyur te rang gi spyi bor dbu brgyan/slar yang bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad gshin rje'i gshed rigs lnga'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/ dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥs rang nyid la gnyis su med par thim par bsam pa tog gtor te/ oṃ su prati ṣ+ṭha badz+re su hā/ zhes brjod cing rab tu gnas par bsam/ nyer spyod lngas mchod do/ gnyis pa mtha' rten ni/ dmar ba nyid ni zhes sogs kyis lha dang dkyil 'khor gyi rnam dag sgrub thabs ltar brjod la/ don bsam/ de nas rang nyid skad cig gis zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed dmar po yum dang bcas pa'i skur bsam/ zhes dang / semasacan kun la phan don phyir/ /'jig rten kun tu thams cad ni/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur — 142

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ the)(34na tha/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu skor/ zhes brjod cing / bdag 'jug gi tshe rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bca'/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi tshe 'khor lo sogs rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan 'grim zhing / chos kyi gnas su rdo rje/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ sna tshogs rnams 'don pa bsgyur ba ni rjes gnang ngo / brtul zhugs kyi tshe gyi sgriḥ dang las bum gyi chus bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ rang dang dbang rdzas rdo rje/stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor pa'i sku can du bsam/ zhes brjod/ yan lag lhag ma rnams byed mi dgos/ dbang rdzas kyi rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer bsam/ zhes dang / rdo rje bslang ba gsor zhing / 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu gzung / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya ti la e ṣa sto ra ya mi/ badz+ra sa twa hi hi hi hi hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ rdo rje spyi bo'am snying gar bzung la sgo gsum tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa thams cad gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rjes btul nas/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku gsung thugs la zhugs par gyis shig /ces ngo sprad/ phyag len la dbang rdzas dang slob ma gnyis ka rdor sems su bskyed pa mdzad kyang / slob ma gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal can la/ rdor (34ba thams phu bo'i rdo rje ster ba yin/ de nas bla ma shākya thub pa'i rnam par 'phos nas/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis chos gosagrwa ri dwags kyi rna ba lta bu snying gar 'dzin cing g.yas pas mchog sbyin pa'i phyag rgyas rang gi gsang mtshan nas lung ston par bsams la/ dngos su rang gi lus kyi phyag rgya de ltar byas te/ oṃ 'dir ni ngas khyod lung bstan bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa mchog tu grub bya'i phyir//srid pa'i ngan 'gro las bton nas/ /kye che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba/ /ta thā ga sirnyi sa ma ya sto lhar bhu wa suḥ/ gang 'di dag las byung ba'i phyag rgyas lung ston par byed pa de la de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung — /43—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)ston par mdzad de/ de nyid las byung ba'i phyag rgya'i mthu dang sngags 'di'i stobs kyis so/ /zhes brjod de lung bstan pa'o/ /de nas/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig /khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ de bas 'dod la chags bral nyid/ /khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/ /ma hā sam ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ces pas nyan rang gi yid byed kyi sems bcom par bsams te gsang ba brjod pa'o/ /de nas/mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor mthong zhing zhugs pa yis/ /sdig pa kun las nges par grol/ /de ring khyed rnams legs par gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di yis ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba khyed la med/ srid pa shin tu 'grub bya'i phyir/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya gang yin pa/ /gang zhig bskyed pa (35na〉mom gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med/ /byang chub sems ni gtang mi bya/ /dam pa'i chos ni sun mi dbyung / /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis/ /de yang nges par bstan mi bya/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya rnams/ /nam yang 'dor bar mi bya'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /rang gi bdag nyid dor nas ni/ /dka' thub kyis ni mi gdung zhing / /ci bde bar ni bde bar gzung / /'di ni ma byon rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /da ni khyod nyid dkyil 'khor gyi/ /slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang //lha rnams kyang ni mthun par dgongs/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ /khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ zhes pa'i don bshad de dbugs dbyung sbyin pa'o/ rjes gnang la sogs lnga po 'di dag ni slob ma'i dbang tsam don du gnyer ba la cod pan gyi dbang sogs dbang lnga'i rjes sam/ skabs 'di'i dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i rjes la sbyar ba yang bshad do/ de nas rtogs pa bskyed pa ni/ phyi rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor gang yin skabs dang sbyar la dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag /lam bskyed pa'i rim pa dang mnyam med snying rje'i rnal 'byor/ rtsa brgyud rnal 'byor rnams bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul (35ba)pa'i sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ zhes brjod/ slob — /44

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'bor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ 6)dpon nam bum pa'i dbang ngo / /gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang ni/ slob mas rig ma dang maṇ+ḍal phul bar bsams la/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab sogs nas/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar sogs kyis dbul/ byang chub rdo rje sogs dang / /e ma sangs rgyas slob dpon che/ /e ma chos dang tsho gos kyi gtso/ /bdag la dam tshig de nyid stsol/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ā kho phyi ra hūm̐ gis mig dar 'ching / bla ma gshin rje'i gshed dang rig ma ro langs ma snyoms par zhugs pa' sbyor ba byas pas/ dga' ba'i sgras sangs rgyas yab yum dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ rjes su chags pas byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur ba/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor brtan pa de nyid srin lag dang mthe bong gis gtsir te/ rang gi lce thog tu bzhag par bsams la/dngos su nang mchod bdud rtsi lcer bzhag la/ /btung ba rin chen 'di de ni/ lus kyi rdo rje rab gsal byed/ bu khyod rtag tu shes nas skye/ yid las byung ba'i chu 'thung mdzod/ /〉〉ཿsa sbyin la/ des kyang a ho ma hā su kho/ zhes brjod cing blangs nas myangs pa mgrin par mid/ yum gyis kyang rang gi pad+ma ra gnas pa'i thig le byin par bsams la/ slar yang btung ba rin cen sogs brjod cing myang ba sogs gong bzhin byas pas (36na/mchog tu dga' ba'i bde bas rgyud gang zhing / yul sna tshogs la dmigs pa'i rtog pa rags pa rnams 'gags nas/ gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la rgyas par bsgoms la/ oṃ skya nyu gis mig dar bsal/ de ltar na khyod kyis byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag /lam srog rtsol rlung gi rnal 'byor dang /rten 'brel rdzas kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ zhes rtogs pa bskyed de gsang pa'i dbang ngo/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab sogs nas/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar sogasakyis 'bul/ ji ltar bla med dpa' bo yis/ /mgon dang dbang ni bskur ba ltar/ /mgon pos bdag la dbang bskur zhing / /bdag la don mchog stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/— 145

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)ā kho khyi ra hūm̐ gis mig dar bkab/ bla mas rig ma'i lag pa bdag gi lag par gtad par bsams la/ gzung ma yid 'ong 'di de ni/ bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags/ rdo rje rjes chagasasbyor ba yis/ /bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni 'tshang rgya min/ /'gro gsum 'di yang dag pa yin/ /de bas 'khor bar (36bskyor bral ni/ /khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /ces brjod la sbyin par bsam/ /des tsan dan la sogs pas byugs/me tog gi 'phreng bas brgyan/ gos med par byas te pad+ma rgyas pa ston cing / dri chen dri chu za ba dang /khrag dang khu ba de bzhin sha/ bud med gus mchog de bzhin du/ /bha ga pad mar tsuspa na/ /bu khyod spro ba yin nam ci/ /ji ltar bde bar bus smros shig /ces dri ba byas par bsams la/ des kyang / /dri chen dri chu sogs za ba/ /lha mo ci'i phyir bdag mi spro/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus bya/ /bha ga nyid la tsuspa na/ che'i/lan btab pas mnyes te/ e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ /gang zhig cho gas bsten byed pa/ /de yi mdun na bdag gnas so/ /sangs rgyas bsten pa la sogs pa/ /pad mar bya ba ji bzhin byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ /bha3 ma k+ṣa hoḥ/ zhes brjod par bsam mo/ /rang nyid gshin rje'i gshed dmar po dang / rig ma ro langs mar bsgom pa lha'i 'du shes/ hūṃ las byung ba'i yab kyi rdo rje dang / a las byung ba'i yum kyi pad ma gsal 'debs pa sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs 'di la (37na༄rten nas lhan skyes mngon du bya'o snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes gsum dran par byas la/ 'o dang 'khyud pa la sogs pas skad cig dang po la dga' ba'i ye shes/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i rtsa btsal te/ rdo rje dang pad+ma snyoms par zhugs pas skad cig gnyis pa la mchog dga'i ye shes rim gyis bsrubs pas/ byang chub sems kyis gsang gnas kyi bar gang ba khyad par gyi dga' ba'i ye shes/ nor bu'i rtse mo'i mthar thug pa'i bar gang nas/ phyir ma 'dzags pa chags pa dang chags bral gyi mtha' spangs pa lhan cig skyes pa'i — /46

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ (thadadaga' ba'i ye shes te de la ci nus su gnas par byas te/ rnal 'byor pa yis ji srid du/ /byang sems 'byin par mi byed pa/ /de srid thob 'gyur rgyun mi 'chad/ /dga' ba las skyes bde g.yin ci/ /dngosagrub kun gyi gter gyur pa/ /byang chub sems ni lhung gyur na/ /phung po rnam shes rgyal ba la/ /ma smad dngos grub ga la yod/ /mkha' khams rdo rje kun spyor dang / /reg pas kyis ni med byung che'i/ /bde ba skyed par byed pa gang / /de ni mchog dga' byed pa po/ /dga' bral dag gis dbus su ni/ /mtshon pa ltos la brtan par gyis/ /pad ma'i nam mkhar rdo rje yis/ /lte ba mnan pa'i gnas dag tu/ /rdo rje'i skyil krung dag gis sems/ /nor bu'i nang du sen bltas pas/ /(37ba〉pe shes bskyed pa gang yin te//ye shes ngo bo zhes pas brgyan/ /gas pa ma yin chags bral yin/ /dbu mar dmigs pa ma yin no/ /gang tshe rnal 'byor ye shes mthong / /de la gnas bya 'gyur mi bya/ /thun nam yang na nyin gcig gam/ /zla phyed zla ba lo dang ni/ /bskal ba bskal ba stong du yang / /ye shes mngon sbyor gyi gnas bya/ zhes brjod la ye shes ngos gzung du bcug la/ /rlung nus pa can gyis mkha' gsang gnyis kyi rtse mo nas byang chub kyi sems gyen du drangs te/ lte bar dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ mgrin par khyad par gyi dga' ba/ spyi bor lhan skyes ma pha du byas par bsams la/ lus thams cad la bde bas khyab pa la sems gzung ngo / /'bru gsum gyis mig dar dkrol/ de ltar na phyag rgya'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag /lam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed de shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo / bzhi pa tshig dbang ni/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nas/ tshig dbang zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar sogs kyis dbul/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ ā kho sogs kyis mig dar 'ching / dbang gsum pa'i dus su myong ba'i lhan cig (38na)skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes des mtshon pa'i don gyi lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes dbang bzhi pa nyid tshig gi sgo nas ngo sprad ni/ rgyud las/ de ltar bzhi pa de bzhin yang / /zhes gsungs pas/— /47

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)dbang gsum pa'i dus su yum dang zhal sbyor gyi lha'i skur bsgom pa/ de nyid goms pa'i stobs kyis gnyis snang gi rtog pa thams cad 'od gsal lha'i skur gnas gyur te/ rang dang snod bcud kyi snang ba thams cad lha sku zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa can gsal lam 'gags pa mngon du gyur pa sprul pa'i sku dang /dbang gsum pa'i gnas skabs su phyag rgya la brten pa'i bde ba de nyid rgyun goms pas/ sngar gyi bde ba las ches khyad par du 'phags pa 'jig pa med pa'i bde ba chen po yang dag par rig pa 'khor 'das thams cad bde ba chen po'i rnam par mngon du gyur pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / dbang gsum pa'i dus su bde ba'i ngo bo stong par bsgoms pa'i don goms pa las/ gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma thams cad dag ste/ thob bya 'bras bu dang / thob byed lam dang / lam de sgom pa'i sems la sogasapa'i rtog pa dang bral zhing khams bco brgyad dang / kun gzhi'i rnam shes la sogs pa don dam par ma grub pa thams cad stong pa 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bu/ rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba mngon du gyur pa ni chos kyi sku dang / de gsum dbyer med zung 'jug (38bachu 'dres nas lha sku bde ba dang bcas pa'i snang ba mi 'dor zhing / /de dag gi ngo bo yang stong pa nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/chos rnams kyi shin tu gsal la zhugs pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ 'bras bu nyid dbang bzhi pa zhes bya ba yin no/ de mngon du byed pa'i thabs ni/ lus mnyam gzhag gi spyod lam dang ldan zhing / ngag rlung rgyu ba sor bzhag /sems kyis lus yum dang bcas pa'i lha'i skur gsal ba dang / de'i sems rgyud zag med kyi bde bas gang ba dang / de dang 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs kyi skye 'jig 'gro 'ong / rtag chad/ 'khor 'das/ bde sdug la sogs pa'i gnyis snang thams cad dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid nam mkha' lta bu ste/ de gsum dbyer med pa'i ngang las ma yengs par mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ /'di nyid gsal zhing stong pa dang / /rig pa de nyid ma 'gagasapa/ /rang rig ye shes skad cig ma/ /'dir ni thog ma dbus mtha' med/ /srid med mya ngan 'das pa med/ / bdag med gzhan yang med pa ste/ /'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ /'di nyid gsal zhing stong — /48

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ (thadapa nyid/ /'di las mtshone te shes par bya/ /'di yi rang bzhin sku gsum dang / /ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can/ /sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /sangs rgyas(39na gi zhan du bstan pa med/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes sku/ /gzhan du btsal bas rnyed ma yin/ zhes gsungs so/ /de nas oṃs lha gis mig dar bkrol/ de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang yos dag /lam shin tu spros med dang / /rnam rtog 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang / gos bu ngo bo nyid sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed de dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de nas spro ba bskyed cing dam tshig bsrung bar gdams pa ni/ /mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor mthong zhing zhugs pas na/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /de ring khyod rnams legs par gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba khyod la med/ /mi tshugs pa dang ma bcings pa/ /gang la'ang 'jigs med dga' bar gyis//srid pa shin tu zhi bya'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las khyed 'das/ srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /ston pa'i mchog tu yang dag 'gyur/ /dngos grub dam tshig sdom pa 'di/ /khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bya ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /mchog tu rtag pa'i bka' yin no/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'da' (39ba〉pe bya/ /de bzhin khros nas spun rnams la/ /nyes pa brjod par mi bya'o/ /sems can rnams la byams pa'i sems/ /nam yang nges par spang mi bya//byang chub sems ni dor mi bya/ /rang gzhan chos la mi snang ngo / /yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba nyid ni bstan mi bya/ /bdag nyid phung po smad mi bya/ /chos rnams ngo bo sun mi dbyung / /gdug pa'i byams pa rtag tu spang / /chos la tshad gzung mi bya'o/ /dad ldan sems can bslu mi bya/ /rtag tu dam tshig bsten par bya/ shes rab rang bzhin bud med rnams/ /skyon gyi nyes pa mi brjod do/ /rnal 'byor slong mos mi rgyu zhing / /rnal 'byor spang bar mi bya ste/ /rtag par rgyun du gsang sngags bzla/ /rtag tu dam tshig la sogs bsten/ /gal te bla ma smod de bzhin/ /dam tshig bag med par gyur na/ /de tshe — /49

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)dkyil 'khor nges bris la/ /bde gshegs rnams la sdig pa bshags/ /deng khyod skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /gang phyir 'di la legs par gnas/ /dam tshig lha rnams dang mnyam par/ /gnas par 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can bcas pas/ /kun gyi tshe ldan deng dbang bskur/ /khams gsum pa yi rgyal po che/ /rgyal srid bdag por bstan pa yin/ /de ring bdud las rnam par rgyal/ /grong khyer mchog tu rab zhugs (40na〉〈/ /de ring khyod kyi sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob pa 'di la the tshom med/ /'di ltar yid ni rab dngas rdo rje nyid du gyis/ /rang gi dam tshig mi zad bde ster bsten par gyis/ /de ring 'gro la bde myur rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyed rnams phyin par 'gyur/ zhes brjod la don bshad de dam tshig dang sdom pa'i bsrung mtshams phyed par bya'o/ de nas gnas skabs de dag tu thob pa'i dam tshig la bsrungs sdom bgyid snyam pas/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' bsgo ba'i/ /gsung ni de ltar bdag gis bgyi/ zhes lan gsum dang / /dbang yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu/ /oṃ badz+ra bhū mi sogs kyis maṇ+ḍal rgyas par phul te/ /lus dang longs spyod thams cad kyang 'bul/ /cha shas nas longs sbyod du gsol snyam pas/ /deng nas brtsamasate bdag bran du/ /khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /khyod kyi slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ zhes dang / gnyis pa slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa ni/ tshig zur rnams rig pasakha bsgyur zhing mtshams sbyor gyi bshad pa rnams sta gon skabs khungs smos pa bzhin blangs te/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa sogs dbang don lam gyi rim par dril lo/ /skabs 'dir 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma 'bul tshul ni/ /sngar sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ji lta ba (40ba tha zhin no/ grol ba'i nyin lta bu/ 'das gtor ma gtogs gzhan gtor ma rnams steng du khyer la/ sngags dbyangs kyis sna drangs pa'i spyi stob rnga brdung zhing 'bul ba sogs mthong ba brgyud pa ltar bya'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga la/ mchod pa kha gso ba'am gsar du bsham pa gang rung skabs dang sbyar ba byin rlabs chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo'i bar gyis dbul/ bstod pa rnams — /5()

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ 6)gong ltar byed/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad ces sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba sogs kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ me tog dang bcas rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar te/ bdag las dang po ba'i rten kyi gang zag tu gyur pas/ mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa sogs dang / sems sgrib pa dang ma bral ba'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin ma gsal ba bying rgod du gyur pa dang / cho ga lhag pa dang / ma tshang ba thams cad bzod par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bzod par gsol/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa' nas/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs nas/bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/(41na gis brjod/ gtor mgron gyi ye shes rnams bris 'bur gyi rten yod na phyogs bcu na sogs kyis brtan bzhugs dang / med na oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad sogs kyis gshegs gsol bya/ sang nang sngon 'gro gtor ma/ maṇ+ḍal zhu 'bul sogs kyi rjes su skyabs 'gro nas bzung bzlas pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin du bya/ oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma hūṃ zhes rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su zhugs par mos/ mdun bskyed la dmigs te chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mar pa nang mar/ bskod pa sho lo ka gcig gis bstod nas sngags rgyas dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg pa la mchod bstod byas/ sbyan 'dren gyi dus bstim pa bu lugs kyi phyag bzhed laganang ba legs mod/ e waṃ pa'i phyag bzhes la mi mdzad pa re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag go/de nas mdun bskyed sgrub pa sogs sngar ltar ro/ /sgrub mchod grol rgyu'i nub mtha' ma la mchod pa rnam gsar du bsham/ mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba sogs rgyas par bya/ yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzla/ bum pa gnyis dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i khyams g.yas g.yon du spyan drangs/ slob dpon rdo dril 'dzin pas shar sgo'i thad du 'grengs/ slob ma rnams kyis mtha' bskor/ bdag las dang po pa sogs 'dod gsol rgyas par bya/ rdul tshon dang bum pa'i lha la dmigs te/ gdangs dang bcas nas/ oṃ khyed — 15/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)kyis sems can don kun mdzad sogs lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya phyir bstan te/ (41ba〉badz+ra mu ras bris la brtan bzhugs su bra ti — dang bcas me tog 'thor 0las gshegs gsol byas na rangaganas 'jig /mdun bskyed dang bum pa'i lha'i ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ rdo rje bsdu rgya dang bcas/ dam tshig pa bdag nyid la dzaḥlha baṃ lho rgyas gnyis su med par thim par bsams la rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par yis thugs dar hūm̐ zhes gnas gsum bsrungs/ lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos/ chos thams cad ni skye ba med pa'o/ chos thams cad ni dngos po med pa'o/ zhes de kho na nyid kyi don dran bzhin pa'i sgo nas/ /rdo rje'i rtses thog mar bris pa'i dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa nas brtsams te a k+ṣa ro brjod cing khor yug tu bshig shar gyi tshangs thig nas gtso bo'i mtshan ma'i bar bu lugasalashar sgo nas gtso bo'i mas ma'i bar bsdu bar bshad/ du ri mo bya/ de bzhin du phyogs gzhan gsum la yang 'gre /lha mtshan gyi rdul tshon nas cung zad blangs pa rang gi spyi bor 'jog /las kyi rdo rjes tshon rnams bsdus te byin rlabs rten dang slong ba la spyin pa sogs byar rung zhing lhag ma rnams rgyas par spro na rdul tshon spyan 'dren pa'i cho ga dang bcas chu bo chen por dor/ thig shul rnams bum chus bkrus te rjes mi mngon par byed/ rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badz+ra gī li ngor lugs la ma gsal yang bu lugasakyi phyag len legs par mthong nas de don bzhin bkod/ uta gī lā ya/ sarba bisnan badz+ra dha ra ā nywa pa ya hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa spo zhes phur bu phyung / rdo rje bsdu/42na)rgyas/ phur bu'i lha rang gi lag gi rdo rje la thim par bsams/ oṃ ru ru sgru ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sirnya lo tsā ni sarba a rba swa tha nā su hā/ zhes 'o mas phur shul bkru khung bu dgang / bgegs thams cad kyi rma dang zug rngu thams cad zhi nas sgrib pa dag ste/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bsam/ bkra shis rgyas par brjod de me tog sil mas phyogs kun tu char phab/ bsngo ba smon lam bya'o/ /'bum phrag gsum pa'i rgyud mtshor bi rū pa sha/ mkhyen dpyod ri bo bsgril las nyer thon pa/ /gshed dmar gdams pa'i sa srungs gom pa'i 'gros/ /bla med rnal 'byor sal lhod por rgyu/ /rgya gar mkhas gzhung tshangs pa'i rol klung nas/ /gangs can — 152

gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun/ (thadaskad gnyis smra bas drangs pa'i tshal/ /smin byed chu bo ma nub gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /skal bzang khyab 'jug dga' ba'i zhababs su bsil/ /rnam gsum bka' babs ga ṇi ga 'dreb(dpal be'u sa/ /thug ba(gar ri mo rab bkra bu ston rje/ /su la'i ljongs 'dir rgyas mdzad e waṃ pa/ /brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes zhi kha mosadapyad de bkod/ /dge tshogs ston mtshan zla ba nya gang las/ legs byas 'dzad pa med pa ke pu ras//srid zhi'i dkar min 'bras kyi tsha gdung kun/ /rab gzhil phan bde'i 'od snang 'bar bar shog khyad par skye ba kun tu dge ba'i bshes/ /gdan gsum tshang (42ba tha'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /rjesabazung tshad ma bzhi ldan nges gsang lam/ /snyan brgyud gdams pa'i chos kyis 'tsho bar shog /sbyang gzhir bgos pa'i sgrib gnyis kun dag nas/ /sgo gsum sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan du/ /rab bsgyur tshe 'dir zung 'jug go 'phang mchog /mngon gyur mkha' mnyam 'gro kun 'dren nus shog /'jam dpal 'gro la rjes chags dmar ba'i zhal/ /gdangs pa'i mgrin las ha har ba ched pa'i sgras/ /yid srubasamya ngan khang bur brgyal ba'i gtam/ /snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis kun khyab bkra shis shog /ces 'phags yul grub dbang kun kyi 'khor los sgyur ba bi rlu ba'i bzhed srol 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i smin byed kyi rim pa gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir bka' babs sum ldan du zhugs pa'i dbang gi chu bo kun 'dus kyi srol 'byed shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che dang /khyab bdag e waṃ pa kun dga' bzang po gnyis kyi bzhed pa cung zad mi mthun pa bu lugs kyi phyag bzhes ngo mtshar med du byung ba'i yul du snang na'ang / rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje yab sras rnams phyi ma'i lugs bzhin mdzad pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'bor gyi cho ga mtho ris dbang gi chu rgyun zhes pa 'di ni rang gi brjed byang dang / kha'u brag rdzong pa'i rjes 'jug gsang sngags kyi 'dus sde mang por phan pa'i (43ba)lhag bsam gyis kun nas blangs te/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos — /53

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)dbyings rang grol/ rigs kun khyab bdag zha lu mkhan chen rin cen bsod nams mchog grub gsum gyi bka' drin la brten nas chos tshul 'di nyid kyi dbang byin rlabs nyams 'khrid rgyab brten lung rnams thob cing khong du chud par byas pa'i za hor gyi ban rgan ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes bag yod ces pa chu glang nag pa zla ba'i dkar cha'i bzang po gnyis pa'i tshes la rang byung 'phags pa'i gtsug lag khang pho brang dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson rig pa 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa phyogs dus kun tu dag par gyur cig /maṅga lo//

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil lha lnga'i sgrub thabs lo paṇa zhal lung / 6)dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil lha lnga'i sgrub thabs 31 paṇa zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs/na ma pir ma gu ru :tsakra se wa rā ya/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang phyug rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po rin cen bsod nams mchog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa ma thob kyi bar du rjes su gzung du gsol/ /gar gu'i nyams ldan in+d+ra ni la'i ri/ /mdzes sdug 'tshams sprin mdangs kyis nyer 'byud pa/ /e waṃ zung 'jug bla ma he ru rkaḥ/ /mnyam sbyor rdo rje btsun mos deng 'dir skyongs/ /au ṭi bi shā'i nags su 'ja' lus sku/ /brnyes nas mngon sum mkha' sbyod sar gshegs pas/ /grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba dril bu pa/ khyod zhabs byang chub bar du bsnyen la spro/ /'jig rten mig gcig mal lo bzhed pa'i gzhung / khreng rta'i srol 'byed bla chen sa skya ba/ /sgra sgyur mar do chos kyi dbang phyug lugs/ /'dzin mkhas (2na)gze ba blo ldan seng ge rgyal/ /bka' babs dbang chu'i gaṅgā rnam dpyod stor/ /legs 'khyil kun mkhyen bu ston dzaḥ/ /zab lam gnad kyi mdud 'grol btsong kha pa/ /phyogs 'dir mkhas shing grub rnams phyag gi yul/ /rang rgyud tha rgod smin byed drod gsher chus/ /grol nus rtog pa'i sa bon yongs sbrum nas/ /zung 'jug snye ma ster mdzad rdo rje 'chang / /rin cen bsod nams mchog grub rigs kyi bdag /ma rgyud rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i snying po'i bcud/ /dbang dang byin rlabs dmar 'khrid zil mngar gyis/ /rang blo'i bum bzang 'geng ba'i yongs 'dzin tshogs/ /bsams kyin lam zab nyams len bsgom la brod//sngon rabs mkhas mang bzhed gzhung la brten nas/ /ma dag rnyog dri dpyad gsum ke ta gas/ /nyer bgrungs khrag 'thung lha lnga sgrub pa'i thabs/ /'khrul med lo paṇa zhal lung deng 'dir spel/ /de la — 155

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)'dir grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje dril bu pa'i/ /(2ba)bzhed srol dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i zab don dril bu ba phyi dkyil gyi sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim pa nyams su blang ba la mnyam par bzhag pa dang ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis/ dang po la bskyed rdzogs gnyis las/ dang po la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis kyi/ dang po la skyabs sems/ rdor sems/ dag gsum/ phung khams skye mched brlab pa/tsho gos zhing dang lnga'i/ dang po ni/ srod thun gyi mthar chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor gyi ngang la nyal te/ thor thun la rnal 'byor ma'i glus bskul ba'i rkyen gyis he ru ga'i nga rgyal gyis langs nas khrus kyi rnal 'byor spro na bya/ stan bde ba la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas skyabs yul rnams gsal btab ste/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchos kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan gsum gyi mjug tu/ bla ma dang dkon cog rin po che rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tā gsol/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lam gyi rim pa bsgom par bgyi'o/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ gnyis (3na)pa rdor sems ni/ rang gi spyi bor baṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ dang rdo rje las dpal he ru gaḥsku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar/ steng zhal ser po/ rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang lngags brgyangasapa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis thod pa dang kha ṭaṃ ga /g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis zhags pa dang tshangasamago 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gyis dus mtshan dang 'jigs byed mnan pa/ rang 'dra'i yum rtsa phyag gnyis kyis rdo dril 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing / de 'og gnyis rdo rje/—156

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil lha lnga'i sgrub thabs lo paṇa zhal lung / 6)phyag lhag ma yab dang 'dra ba zhabs gnyis yab kyi rked la 'khril ba/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur bsam/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par 'a thugs gar hūṃ/ mdzub mo gnyisamadud/ gung mo gnyis rtse sprad/ /mthe bong gnyis kyang rtse sbyar te sor mo lhag ma brkyang ba 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bzhag nas g.yon du bskor/ mig gyen du blta ba dang bcas gdong bsgyur rkang pa g.yas pas g.yon pa mnan te/ h+pha/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha rnams pad gar dang bcas thugs gar g.yas steng du bsnol ba mdzub mo lcags kyu ltar cung zad gug pa'i rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra a lha nas shasta prati ts+tsha ri (3bsko bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥs bstim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi dzi〉 tu mo/zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba tā thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sam ya shri ye hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las yab la mi bskyod pa dang yum la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs gar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng du hūṃ sngon po'i mthar yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes lhung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ hūṃ las bdud rtsi babs/ he ru gzhi sku gang / sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi sku gang / yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pa nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam par bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas mthen nas shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar bsam/ he ru ga'i yig brgya ci nus su bzla/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ sku gsung thugs rtsa — 157

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)ba dang yan (4na〉pag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad 'thol lo/ /bshags so/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang lhung ba'i dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru gaḥyab yum 'od du zhu nas spya bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus shel gong lta bur bsam mo/ /gsum pa dag pa gsum gyi rnal 'byor ni/ shrī he ru gaḥhe ni kun gyi 'byung gnas su gyur ba'i sems te/ rgyu'i bdag nyid du brtag par bya bas stong pa'i chos kyi bdag med pa dang / ru ni gang zag gi bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gi dra bas bkod pa'i bdag dang bral pa'i gang zag gi bdag med pa dang / de kho na nyid kyi yul yul can gnyis mi mthun par so sor gnyis su mi gnas pa dang / shrī ni yul stong pa nyid ji 'dra ba de bzhin du rjes su zhugs pa'i gnyis su med pa'i ye shes e waṃ gyi don no/ zhes pas yid dag par bya'o/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gi he ru gaḥsngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa la/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud par bsam/ shrī he ru ko3 lha/ zhes pas lus dag par bya'o/ oṃ a ā/ i i/ u skyu/ ṛ 2 / '-i lī/ e i/ 6( 61/ e aḥ/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa khyu ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha/ k+ṣa/ hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa/ yi ge'i 'phreng ba g.yon du lte ba'i (4ba)phyogs su lan gsum bskor ba lasa'od zer kha dog lnga 'phro ba/ de dag las mkha' 'gro ma lnga dpag tu med pa sna bug g.yas nas spros te bgegs thams cad bcoms/ g.yon nas nang du zhugs sngags 'phreng la thim par bsams zhing ā di kā di lan gsum brjod pa ni ngag dag byed do/ bzhi pa phung khams skye mched byin gyis brlab pa ni/ra pa lhad kyi phung khams skye mched thams cad gdod ma nas rnam par dag pa ye shes kyi lha'i rang bzhin du yod pa so so'i rnam pa ji lta bar bsam/ lnga pa tshogs zhing ni/ phyag rgya dang bcas pho/ rang gi snying gar paṃ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig sngon po las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams dang / 'gro ba drug gi sems can rnams kyang lhar — 158

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil lha lnga'i sgrub thabs lo paṇa zhal lung / (thadabyas pa phyag rgya dang bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā jaḥs spyan drangs/de thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs su gyur cing bla ma rnams gcig tu 'dus gtso bo'i rigs bdag tu bzhugs par bsam/ /he ru gaḥdapal dpa' bo che/ /rnam rtog rdo rje'i dbang phyug dang / /rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi/ /rdo rje phag mo de la 'dir / /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo sgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing / /'jig rten bya ba la 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snying ga'i hūṃ las spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo (5nasgo chod rdzas thogs pa rnams kyis mchode par bsam/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo ge ni a lha pra la lha/ de bzhin du/ a lha gyi gnas su/ pā spya nas/ shabha'i bar bcug /lta ru pa badzi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ pa'i gnas su/ sha lta nas/ spar+sha'i bar bcug /thugs ga'i hūṃ las byung ba'i snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhis thob pa'i nang gi bdud rtsi lngas mchod par bsam oṃ sarba badz+ra kā ma ni sarba bha tsā sho dha ya gu tho badzi ṇi hūṃ swā hā/ mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhi phag mo la thim/ phag mo he ru gaḥ dang snyoms par zhugs par zhugs pa'i bde ba nyams su myong bar bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā pa ṇa rā ga ṇa pā dza badz+ra swa bhā wa ā khru ko3 lha/ gur las byung ba'i rgyud bshags lan gsum dang / semasacan thams cad kyi sgrib pa thams cad bsal ba'i phyir nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo skor bar bskul lo/ /rgyal ba mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa rnams 'gro ba kun la phan pa dang bde ba'i don du bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed du bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs so/ /bgrod dka' srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /bdag gis 'gro rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /rang gi bdag nyid skad cig mar/ /sangs rgyas rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ zhes yan lag bdun pa'i rjes su yig brgya brjod/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥs tshogs zhing rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam sems can thams cad khyad par du 'phags pa'i bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /thob zin pa'i bde (5ba tha dang mi 'bral bar gyur — 159

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)cig /nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la rten brten pa gnyis kyi/ dang po rten la srung 'khor/ 'byung ba/ gzhal yas khang dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ ma su bhā wa shu snyiḥsarba dharmāḥ su bhā wa shu sgo3 lha/ /chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa gzung 'dzin dang bral ba sems tsam gyi ngo bor bsam/ /oṃ shā n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko ྅lha/ chos thams cad stong par bsam/ de'i dgos pa ni 'dzam bu gling pa'i mngal skyes khams drug ldan 'chi ba dang chos mthun pas rang nyid kyi 'chi ba chos skur 'byer ba'i gnad do/stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nyid nā da shin tu dkar ba la dmar ba'i mdangs chags par langs nas nam mkhar gnas par bsam pa ni gzhi la 'chi ba 'od gsal gyi gzhen pa'i rlung sems las bar do grub pa ltar rang nyid kyi bar do longs skur 'byer ba'i gnad do/ /de'i 'od zer las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du hūṃ las sna tsho gos rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa shar dkar/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ lte bar hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid he ru gaḥsngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bsam/ phyogs g.yon dang mtshams g.yas skor du g.yon pa'i mthe bos mdzub mo mnan pa mdzub mo phyir btad pa'i se gol gtog cing — sngags tshan bzhir bcad pa lan gnyis bzla/ zhes brjod cing spro ba mnyam du thugs ga'i hūm̐ las (6na〉〉 bcu steng 'og phyogs mtshams su 'phros pa las/ khar dang steng du khā gdong ma sngon mo/ byang du 'ug gdong ma ljang gu /nub dang 'og tu khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lhor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas rdo rje tho ba dang g.yon rang 'dra'i lte ba man chad phur bu'i dpal mdung rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa can thogs pa/ nyi ma'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs par bsam/ 'dir sgrub thabs spyi dang chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rjes su — 160

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil lha lnga'i sgrub thabs lo paṇa 'al lung / (be)'brangs pa yin cing lwa ba pas mdzad pa'i bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs su thams cad sku mdog dmar mor bshad pa'ang yod pas gang bder bya'o/ /pho nya bcu zhal phyir phyogs kyi mdun du hūm̐ ring po las grub pa'i dong gru gsum pa/ gting zab pa bcu'i nang du khro mo rnams kyi sku'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus phyi rol gyi bgegs rnams rang dbang med par bkug par bsam/ rang nyid khro bo'i lta ba dang ldan pabs bka' bsgo ba ni/ 3 6 gha gha/ ghā ta ya/ ghā ta ya/ sarba du/ — hūm̐ phaṭa kyi lā yā gī lu ya sarba pā paṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūm̐ hūṃ badz+ra ki lwa ya badz+ra dha rod ādzñā pa ya ti sarba dus bisnrun kā ya wā t+ta badz+ra gī lwa ya hūm̐ phaṭa /ces bsgom shing phur bu btsugs te pho nya (6bsgoms kyis/ oṃ badz+ra mut+na ra badz+ra ki lā ya a koṭa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa bgegs rnams kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar du phur bus btab pas bgegs rnams kyi sems 'od gsal du thim zhing lus dang sgrib pa lhan cig tu bsregs bcos thal bar bsam/ sngags bzhi pa'i 'od zer las grub pa'i rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi pa phyogs kyi mdog can/de dang dus mnyam du sna tshogs rdo rje'i hūṃ dang bcas pa las skyes pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ de'i 'od zer steng du 'phros pa las rdo rje rtse lnga pa phur bu'i mde'u can gyi mdo'i dra ba/ de'i 'og rdo rje ra ba'i steng du rdo rje'i gur/ gur dang ra ba'i mtshams su rdo rje'i bla bre rnams sra zhing mkhregs pa dum bu gcig tu grub par bsam/ oṃ me di ni badz+re bha wa badz+ra 5 hūṃ/ gis rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / oṃ badz+ra pra kā ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ rdo rje ra ba dang / oṃ badz+ra pa ñtsa ra hūṃ/ gis rdo rje'i gur dang / oṃ badz+ra bi dwa nā hūṃ/ gis rdo rje'i bla bre dang / oṃ badz+ra sar dzā la lha/ gis rdo rje'i mdo'i dra ba rnams so/ /sgo mtshams ma rnams rdo rje ra ba la thim pas chu la chu thim pa'i zegs ma phyir 'phros pa ltar rdo rje ra ba'i gur khang du bsam/oṃ badz+ra pra kwa ra hūm̐/ de'i phyir rol tu sna tshogs pad+ma'i gur khang du bsam/ oṃ pad+ma pra kā ra hūṃ/ de'i phyi rol tu 'khor lo 'bar ba'i gur khang du bsam/ oṃ tsakra pra kā ra hūṃ/ de'i phyi rol tu rdo rje me bskal pa 'jig pa'i me dpung lta bur bsam/ oṃ badz+ra tha la a na la rka hūṃ hūṃ hūm̐/ zhes brjod do/ /gnyis(7na)pa 'byung ba bskyed pa ni/ rang nyid lha'i sku sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas/ srung 'khor gyi dbus na ma mkha'i — /61

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)dbyings chos 'byung gi nang du sngar gyi nā da'i 'od zer las byung ba'i ye las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du lo las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi zur bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du su las rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin gyi lhun po gru bzhi pa rtse mor lcog brgyad kyis mdzes pa/ /gsum pa gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma gser dang ldan pa'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa phyogs kyi mdog can/ de'i lte bar lco las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i rim po che'i rtsig pas bskor ba'i steng na/ rin po che'i pha gu dmar po la rin po che zur gsum pa dang gru bzhi pa la sogs pas spras pa/ de'i steng na gnas pa'i gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi khar mu tig gi do shal dang do shal phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i phyi ngos su bya 'dab la 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i shar bu/ de'i steng du pad+ma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyi mda' yab la gnas pa'i gser gyi bum pa nas thon pa'i rgyal mtshan (7bskong ba dan brgyad brgyad kyis mdzes par byas pa/ phyi'i steng gi zur bzhi lag dugs bzhis brgyan pa/ gzhan yang gos dang / 'phan dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa rgyan du mas spras pa/ rtsig pa'i 'gram nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar pos bskor ba la bzhugs stangs dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rig ma bcu drug gis mchod pa byed bzhin pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams dang rtsig pa'i phyi nang gi zur bzhir zla phyed la gnas pa'i rin po che dmar po'i steng du rdo rjes brgyan pa/ nang ka ba brgyad kyis gdung bzhi bteg cing dbus phyur bur phub pa'i rtse mor rdo rje phyed pa'i tog gis mtshan pa/ sgo bzhi khi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi pa/ pad+ma dang chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang / ri dwags gnas pa/ rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon —162

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil lha lnga'i sgrub thabs lo paṇa zhal lung / (ba)du bum pa bzang po las skyes pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing la rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun dang / bar bar du grub pa dang / sprin gyi gseb nas byung ba'i lha me tog gi 'phreng ba bzung ba rnams kyis kun nas mdzes par byas pa/ srung 'khor gyi phyi rol dur khrod brgyad du phyogs skyong brgyad/ shing brgyad/ zhing skyong brgyad/ klu brgyad/ sprin brgyad/ me brgyad/ ri brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ rnal 'byor pa brgyad/gzhan yang dur khrod du rgyu ba rnams kyis gang ba'i nang gi lho snam shar dkar/ byang ljang / nub dmar/lho ser/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar dang bcas pa/ mu khyud la gri gug gi phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i lte bar dus mtshan dang 'jigs byed/ phyogs bzhi ro dang zla ba/mtshams bzhir zla ba'i gdan re re/ gnyis pa brtan pa lha la mngon byed lnga las gtso bo bskyed pa/'khor bskyed pa/ phung khams skye mched brlab pa/ go cha/ ye shes pa drang pa/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab/mchod bstod/ dag pa dran pa dang brgyad kyi/ dang po ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu so gnyis kyi ngo bo skar ma'i rnam pa lta bu'i/ a ā nas/ /e aḥ phrag gnyisabarjod la/ /zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i bdag nyid mar me'i rnam pa lta bu'i/ ka kha nas/ ya ra la wa ḍa khyu/ phrag gnyisabarjod de/ zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi bar du sngar gyi nā da/ de las hūṃ dngul chu'i mdog lta bu las rdo rde dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūṃ gyis mtshan pa/baṃ las gri gug baṃ gyis mtshan pa sor rtogs ye shes/ de las dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ lha lngar byas/ de dag dang gdod ma nasagrub pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams spyan drangs/ hūṃ la thim pas rkyen byas te/ nyi zla phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa gcig tu gyur pa bya grub ye shes/ de yongs su gyur (8ba)pa las sku rdzogs pa chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngo bo dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yon zhal dmar po/ rgyab zhal ljang khu/ g.yas zhal ser po/ zhal — /63

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ drag cing 'jigs su rung ba/ dbu skra ral pa nag po thor tshugs su bcings pa'i rtse mor nor bu rin po che/ mtshogs mar sna tshogs rdo rje/lte ba la rigs kyi bdag po/ g.yon du zla ba phyed pa/ dbu re re la rdo rje nag po'i 'phreng bas stod smad nas brgyan pa'i thod pa skam po lnga lngas brgyan pa/ de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i phreng ba dang dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs bcings pa/ phyag bcu gnyis kyi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa//g.yas gyi gnyis pa na cang te lā gsum pa na rtse gsum/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug /g.yon gnyibs pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /gsum pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ bzhi pa na 'gas pa/ lnga pa na tshangs pa mgo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa khrag dang bcas pa'i na bza' phyag g.yas pas lag pa g.yon pa dang / g.yon pas rkang pa g.yon pa dang bcas te brkyangs nas bzung pa'i sdigs mdzub kyi rtsa gnyis smin ma'i thad sor gnas pa/ mi lpags kyi na bza' gsol ba/ mi'i rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal phrag par 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya drug dang nye ba'i phyag rgyas brgyan cing gar gyi nyams dgu (9na skong ldan pa/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis(dang dpe byad brgyad cu khag brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma dang g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bstan nas mnan cing steng phyogs su gdugs dkar po phub pa'o/ de'i pang du yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ gcer mo dbu skra sil bu thur du grol zhing thod pa skam po lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ thod pa'i dum bus spud pa'i ska rags can/phyag rgya lngas spras shing mi'i rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ g.yas gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis bdud thams cad la bsdigs par mdzad pa/ g.yon pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khrud pa'i thod pa khrag dang rgyu mas gang ba bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas yab la 'khrud pa/ gnyis ga'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ yab kyi — /64

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil lha lnga'i sgrub thabs lo paṇa zhal lung / 6)thugs dar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i thugs gar sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ting nge 'dzin sems dang hūṃ yig sngon po 'od 'phro bar bsam/ gzhi la pha ma'i khu khrag gi dbus su bar do'i rnam shes zhugs te nying mtshams sbyar nas skye ba len pa ltar rang nyid kyi skye ba sprul skur 'khyer ba'i gnad do/ /gnyis pa 'khor bskyed pa ni/ shar gyi 'dab mar mkha' 'gro (9bsgo sngon mo/ byang du lwa ma ljang gu /nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ /lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ /thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma spyan gsum dang ldan cing mche ba gcigs pa/ gcer mo skra grol zhing thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ dum bu lnga bcu'i do shal dang phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ḍā ma sa g.yon gnyis thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang kha ṭaṃ ga bsnams pa thams cad kyang zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ mtshams rnams su bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du ka pā la byang chub sems kyis gang ba bzhis kha brgyan pa'o/ /gsum pa phung khams skye mched byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ ā:/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi ni nī kā ya wā t+ta badz+ra su bhā wa ā khru ko nya lha/ zhes skad cig mas bskyed pa'i sngags brjod/ lha thams cad kyi mig gti mug rdo rje/ rna ba zhe sdang rdo rje/ sna phrag dog rdo rje/ lce 'dod chags rdo rje/ lus ser sna rdo rje/ yid dbang phyug rdo rje/ gzugs kyi phung po rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor ba'i phung po'i rdo rje nyi ma/ 'du shesakyi phung po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug /'du byed kyi phung po rdo rje rgyal po/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po rdo rje sems dpa'/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig pa nyid dpal he ru gaḥ sa'i khams lhung byed ma/ chu'i khams gsod byed ma/ me'i khams 'gugs byed ma/ rlung gi khams gar gyi dbang phyug ma/nam mkha'i khams pad+ma'i dra ba can ma/ dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par sa(10na skom ra po/snying gar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par bsam/ bzhi pa go cha bgo ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi snying gar rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo oṃ ha dkar po/ mgo bor rnam snang gi ngo bo na ma hi ser po/ spyi gtsug tu pad+ma — 165

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)gar dbang gi ngo bo swā hā hu dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis su dpal he ru dzi'i ngo bo ṣa ḍa he nag po/ mig gnyis su rdo rje nyi ma'i ngo bo hūm̐ hūṃ ho dmar ser/ yan lag thams cad la rta mchog gi ngo bo phaḍa nya ljang gu /zhes dpa' bo'i go cha dang / yum rnams kyi lte bar rdo rje phag mo'i ngo bo oṃ baṃ dmar mo/ snying gar gshin rje ma'i ngo bo lha oṃ sngon mo/ khar rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo hri oṃ dkar mo/ mgo bor skyong byed ma'i ngo bo hre hri ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu skrag byed ma'i ngo bo hūṃ hūm̐ ljang gu yan lag thams cad la tsaṇ+ḍi ga'i ngo bo phaḍa phaḍa dud khas mtshan par bsam dpa' mo'i go cha bkod pas gtso bo yab yum zhal sbyor pa'i tshe sngags yig rnams rdo rje lu gu rgyud du bcings pa'o/ /lnga pa ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/ phyag rgya dang bcas/ h+pha/ rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar phyag rgya dang bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi ni a: nas shasta'i bar gyis mchode/ dzaḥlha baṃ hos gnyis su med par bsam/ yo ga shuḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shu rje3 nya/ drug pa dbang bskur rgyas (10ba)gdab ni phyag rgya dang bcas/ h+pha/ slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rnams bsdu rgya dang bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi ni a: nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ yum bzhi phag mo dang bcas pas rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegasakun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe gta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ che lta u dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa'/ yum la mi bskyod pa/ mkha' 'gro ma la rtag pa/ lwa ma la rta mchog—166

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil lha lnga'i sgrub thabs lo paṇa zhal lung / 6)dum skyes ma la pad+ma gar dbang / gzugs can ma la rdo rje nyi mas dbu brgyan par bsam/ bdun pa la phyi mar/ nang ma rdzo/ gsang ma rdzo/ de kho na ṣ+ka kyis ma rdzo pa/ bstod pa/ dag pa dran pa dang drug gi dang po ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchode par bsam/so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi ni a: sogs kyis tshogos zhing (11na skor mchod/gnyis pa nang mar ni/ bdud rtsi ril bu bto na bas mi dgos shing med tshe 'og nas 'byung ba'i gtor ma ltar brlab/ bsdu na lag pa g.yon bstan la oṃ/ zhes stong par bsam/ g.yas bstan la snya zhes thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan par bsam/ /gnyis ka bstan te hūṃ/ zhes sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang bar bsam/ lag gnyis bkan pa'i srin lag gnyis dkris pa'i bar nas gung mtheb sbyar ba mdzub mo gnyis kyis mnan pa bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan la/ha ho myi zhes lan gsum brjod pas ye shes bdud rtsir bsam mo/ /oṃ/ mar do phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ mi lha/sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du oṃ u lha/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal du oṃ unyu/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu ba'i zhal du oṃ tso// rus sbal zhabs kyi zhal du oṃ byu/ dza byu ra pa'i zhal du oṃ lha lha/ nag po spyod pa'i zhal du oṃ 〉lha/ gu tho pa'i zhal du oṃ u lha/ rnam rgyal zhabs kyi zhal du cha mi lha/ tai lo pa'i zhal du oṃ sko/ nā ro ta pa'i zhal du cha lha/ bal po pho mthing pa gcen 'jigasamed grags pa'i zhal (11ba)du oṃ sa// gcung ngag gi dbang phyug gi zhal du oṃ byu/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs kyi zhal du oṃ 〉lha/ mal gyo lo tsā ba blo gros grags kyi zhal du oṃ ri/ sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po'i zhal du oṃ 〉lha/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo'i zhal du oṃ unyu/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ 〉lha/ ༷ paṇ+ḍita kun dga' rgyal mtshan kyi zhal du oṃ ulha/—167

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa'i zhal du oṃ gnyu/ khro phu rin po che bsod nams seng ge'i zhal du oṃ skya nyu/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge'i zhal du oṃ u lha/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston lo tsā ba'i zhal du oṃ u lha/ thugs sras sgra tshad pa rin chen rnam rgyal zhal du oṃ mi lha/ rje kun dga' rin cen gyi zhal du oṃ snya lha/ bzang po rin rgyal ba'i zhal du oṃ ā lha/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po'i zhal du oṃ mi lha/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa'i zhal du oṃ u:/ mdo khams pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhal du oṃ snya lha/ rje shākya kun dga'i zhal du oṃ 〉lha/ kun bzang rtse pa dbang phyug rgyan mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ 〉lha/ paṇa chen bsod nams mchog ldan gyi zhal du oṃ skya lha/ rdo rje 'chang rin cen bsod nams mchog grub kyi zhal du oṃ mi lha/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ u lha/ gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag gnang ba'i bla ma dam pa yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ sa//yab kyi nye snying / yum dang mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la nang mchod dbul/ bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal (12na〉cur rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa ste rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ unyu/ oṃ kā li de rlu/ khyad par dpal ldan dmag zor gyi rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ u// shrī dharma pā la tsa tu rmu kha/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ lha lha/ chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bka' sdod chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ ā:/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing / tsha rtse dang nye ba'i tsha smyo/'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ tshong spyod dang nye ba'i tsong spyod de yul sum cu rtsa gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul pa'i skus 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ ā:/ zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags lasaskyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang / gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams — /68

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil lnga lnga'i sgrub thabs lo paṇa zhal lung / (thadakyi zhal du 'o0lha/ gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed pho nya/'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ ā lha/ bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang / gnas bdag /gzhi bdag /grong (12ba/bdag /yul bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du cha lha/ 'gro ba gas drug /lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhig bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig rang gi lce thog tu bdud rtsi myangs la/ rang gi lus la gnas pa'i lha thams cad kyi zhal du oṃ u lha/ oṃ a mṛ ta su da na badz+ra sa bhā wa āt+pa ko3lha/ zhes brjod/ /gsum pa gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ /yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rje nag po la bya dmar bo las byung ba'i nor bu dmar po bya dmar pos mtshan pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas byu pad+ma'i 'dab ma gsum pa sdi ser po las byung ba'i ze'u 'bru dkar po sdi ser pos mtshan pa/ oṃ shrī ma hā su kha badz+ra he he ru ru kai unyu hūṃ phaṭa/ yab kyi yum la tsuspa na dang yum gyis kyang yab la tsu skra na byas la/ phan tshun snyoms par 'jug pa'i dga' ba brtsams nas/ /dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong nas zag pa med pa'i bde bas mnyes pa bsam/bzhi pa de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ de ltar mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa thams cad skye med mnyam pa nyid du bsam/ lnga pa rkang brgyad kyis bstod pa ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te wi re shā ya rdu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā ga lpa asne bang sno bha ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pa sa mu gu ṭi smra ṭā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ skye/ rda zhag ka rā lo gra sgyi ṣa ṇa mukhā ya hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bhu su rā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pa ra shu pā sho du rta shā la kha ṭ+wāṃg dha ri ṇi hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa/ (13na)rma byā gwa ji 8 pa ri khyo rā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mahā dhū dhu me kā ra la pu ṣā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rnal 'byor ro gcig bdud rtsi 'thungs pas rnam par dag pa'i thugs/ /gnas la sogs pa yul du bgrod pas rnam par dag pa'i sku/ /dpal gyi gnas kyi dbus mchog dkyil 'khor lo'i mgon po dang / bla ma mchog la spyi bos btud de rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /— 169—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)drug pa dag pa dran pa ni/ lus dran pa nye bar bzhag pa mkha' 'gro ma/ tshor ba dran pa nye bar bzhag pa lwa ma/ chos dran pa nye bar bzhag pa dum skyes ma/ /sems dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gzugs can ma/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru gaḥdang rdo rje phag mo'o/ gnyis pa rdzogs rim ni/lus skyil krung lag pa mnyam gzhag bcas la rlung nang du 'dren pa dang bstun nas/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa sna bug gnyis nas snying ga'i hūṃ la bstim ma/ yum yang lte ba'i e la bstim/ yab nyid kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal kyang rung la rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bsgom bzhin pa'i ngang nas rang gtso bor gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus su a ba sgru tī phra zhing drang ba rlung sems 'dres pas gang ba/ g.yas ro ma me'i rang bzhin kā li'i rnam pa'i rak+tas gang ba/g.yon rkyang mchu'i rang bzhin ā li'i rnam pa'i thig les gang ba/ dbu ma la brten pa'i lte ba sprul pa'i 'bor lo/ 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i snying por phag mo'i ngo bo a dmar po me'i rang bzhin (13ba〉bgo gyen du lta ba/ nang skor la a ga tsa ṭa ta pa la sha /phyi skor la ā li kwa li dang / dbyangasakyi yi ge ring po drug /snying ga chos kyi 'bor lo 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar he ru ku'i ngo bo hūṃ dkar po thig le'i rnam pa mgo thur du lta ba/ phyogs bzhin/ oṃ u hri tre/ g.yon skor dang mtshams bzhin/lī rlu rlu lha g.yas skor du gnas pa/ mgrin pa longs spyod gyi 'khor lo 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i lte bar/phag mo'i rang bzhin/ e dmar po mgo gyen du lta ba/ nang gi 'dab ma la/ ya ra la wa/ phyi skor ṛ 2 bla lo lwa spangs pa'i ā li bcu gnyis/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar he ru ga'i rang bzhin nya dkar po mgo thur du lta ba/ 'dab ma la ā li phrag gnyis gnas par bsams nas lte ba'i e gi me 'bar ba dbu ma'i nang nas song bas/ hūṃ la bsnun pas byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun babs nas/ e gi me cher gsos 'og gi dpyid dang thig le kha sbyor dang / me'i nus pa snying ga nas kyang gyen du song bas mgrin pa'i e bskul ba'i mes/ spyi bo'i nya la bsnun de las kyang byang chub kyi rgyun babs pas mgrin pa'i me cher gsos pa steng gi dpyid dang thig le kha sbyor du bsgom — 170

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil lha lnga'i sgrub thabs lo paṇa zhal lung / 6)mo/ /de ltar 'bar bas ro ma'i nus pa 'phel bas lus drod kyis gang / 'dzags pas rkyang ma'i nus pa 'phel bas gang / 'bar 'dzag dbu mar 'dres pas sems mi rtog par gyur par bsam zhing / de (14na tshe pa goms pas du ba la sogs pa'i rtags 'byung la/ de las skyes pa'i ye shes dang / bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor bsres nas bsgoms pas/ mthong ba'i lam gyi ye shes kyang myur du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /'dir 'phags pa rin po che'i sgrub thabs las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bris pa yin cing dril bu rim lnga nyams 'khrid du thob pa rnams kyis de bzhin du nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor la bzlas pa/ nyer bsdu/ gtor ma/ nyal ba/ ldang ba/ khrus/ zas kyi rnal 'byor dang bdun gyi/ dang po ni/ cha khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su bhā wa nas ko lha nyi/ stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las phreng rdog re re'i ngo bo yang su hā hu dmar po re yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i/ g.yas gnyas pad+ma dang ḍā ma sa g.yon gnyis dril bu thod pa dang bcas pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thogs pa/ nyi ma la g.yas brkyang pas bzhugs pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa rmongs byed ma dkar mos 'khyud pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par snyathugs skar hūṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa phyag rgya dang bcas/oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥlha baṃ lhos bstim/ oṃ a bhi 'i ṣañtsa mis dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra (14ba)a lha nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchode/ sngags mjug tu/ oṃ 4 〉 gis nang mchod dbul/ oṃ pad+ma nirti shwa ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzla/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs te 'od gsal du zhu ba las byung ba'i phreng ba'i rnam par bsam/ rang gi thugs ska'i sa bon las sngags kyi yi ge rnams rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'og tu phyung / rdo rje'i bu ga nas yum gyi bha gar thon/ de las brgyud de yum gyi zhal nas rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ga'i sa bon la thim par bsam/ zhal bzhi dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis kyang zlosapar bsam zhing / yab kyi snying po ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kai hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ shā zhi ni dzā la saṃ ba raṃ swā hā/— 171 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)nye snying ni/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum gyi snying po ni/ oṃ sarba bu d+dha ḍā ki ni ye badz+ra wa rje nī ye hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa/nye snying ni rma badz+ra be+e ro tsa ni ye hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dpa' mo bzhi'i sngags ni/ oṃ ḍā lka ni ye hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ lwa me hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍal ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi ṇi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzla'o/ phyi mchod dang rnal 'byor ro gcig mas bstod/ gnyis pa nyer bsdu ni/ thugs spu'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis snod bcud thams cad 'od du gyur pa dkyil 'khor pa la/ de dur khrod la/ de gzhal yas khang la/ de lha mo bzhi la/de gtso bo yab yum la/ yum yab la/ de thugs ka'i ye shes sems dpa' la/ de nyi bcas lha la/ de zhabs kyu la/ de ha'i khog pa la/ de mgo bo la/ de zla (15na sko65la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la/ de yang 'od gsal du gyur pa'i ngang nas rang nyid skad cig gis he ru gaḥzhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur bsam/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i go cha sngar bzhin bgo ste se gol phyogs bzhir gtog cing sum+bha brjod la bsrung / byang chub sems kyis zin par byas la dngos po thams cad bde mchog tu shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa gtor ma ni/ sum+bha sa bsangs/ swa bhā bas stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las 'og tu yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ a las thod pa'i skyed bu gsum gyi steng du a las skyes pa'i thod pa'i nang du/ dbus su hūm̐ las dra chu hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ shar du oṃ las dri chen oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ lhor tre las rak+ta tre gis mtshan pa/ nub tu e las shu kra e gis mtshan pa/ byang du kho las klad pa khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ dbus su bī las sha chen bī gyis mtshan pa/ shar du rlu las ba lang gi sha phe gyisamatshan pa/ ltor lī las glang po che'i sha lī gyis mtshan pa/ nub tu shrī las rta'i sha shrī gyis mtshan pa/byang du lha las khyi'i sha two gyis mtshan pa/ rlung bskyed pa las me sbar te skol bas sa bon gyi yi ge dang bcas pa zhu nas kha dog nyi ma lta bu/ de'i rlangs pa las grub pa'i hūṃ dkar po las byung ba'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin kha 'og tu bltas pa zhu bar rnam par blta zhing de'i (15ba)bcud dang ro mnyam du bsam/ de'i steng du a ā nas/ ha k+ṣa yongs su gyur pa las/ oṃ lhas lha gi yi ge steng nas — 172

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil lha lnga'i sgrub thabs lo paṇa zhal lung / 6)steng du gnas pa de las dkyil 'khor gyi lha spros/ 'gro don byas/ snyoms par 'jug pa sngon du 'gro bas zhu ba rnams yi ge gsum la thim/ yi ge gsum yang bdud rtsir zhu nas thim pas ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du bsam/ oṃ u lha/ lan gsum brjod/ phyag rgya dang bcas/ h+pha/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ lasa'od zer yos pas rang bzhin rgyas grub pa'i dkyil 'khor/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma dang / chos skyong srung ma dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / mkha' 'gro dang / 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar phyag rgya dang bcas/oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma la ya sto 'gyas gdan phul/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod/ lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa dkar po nas 'bru tsam 'khod pa'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs te gsol bar bsams la rdo rje thal mo kha phye nas oṃ badz+ra a ra li ho dzaḥ& baṃ ho badz+ra shā kyi nu sam ya sto/ la dra shu ca dang pos gtso bo/ gnyis pas yum/ gsum pas rnal wor mabazhi la dbul/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod cing / rnal 'byor ro gcig mas (16na tha stod de 'dasagator dbul/ 'jig rten pa la/ oṃ kha kha ji hi khā hūṃ/ sarba yak+ṣa rā k+ṣa sa/ bhū ta pre ha/ pi shā tsa/ rna da/a pa smu ra/ badz+ra ḍa ka ḍā ki rgyu da ya/ i me baṃ lo/ gro hā — / sam ya rak+ṣa / ma ma sarba sirnyi m+me pra ya tsā rtsa/ya thre bi/ ya the gi : dza tha/ dzi gha tha/ pi pa tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sa rbu kātra/ sa phyi kho/ bi shu d+dha ye/ sa ha yi ka bā wastu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis dbul/ phyi nang gis mchode/ lha yi tshogasarnams ma lus dang / /klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /gnod spyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /'byung pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /yi dwags tshogs rnamasam lus dang / sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /spyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyisabazhesapa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' — /73—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)stod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag (16ba)po'i phyogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing / /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngosagrub bdag la stsol/ /srung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing cho me 'phel dang / /bde legasathams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /oṃ yo ga shuzloḥsarba dha rmā yo ga shurnyo ྅ lha/zhes brjod de pad gar gyi phyag rgyas mnyes par byas la phyag rgya nye bar sdud pa na 'khyud pa'i ltang ka /yig brgya dang ma 'byor ba sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ mthe bong dang ming med kyis se gol gtogs la/ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ rmi lam ni/srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags rdul (17na thar ldan/ /'od zer sngon po stong ldan nyi ma brgya stong ldan/ /rnam mang sku dang cha lugs rjes chags sems par ldan/ /snye ru ka dpal de dang lhan gcig gar byed shog /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /des brjod gsung yang mchog tu tshad ma ste/ /bden pa'i 'di dag gis ni lha mo rnams/ /bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni he ru gar gyur nas/ /sems can thams cad he ru ga'i/ /go 'phang mchog la 'god par shog zhes brjod ni/ phun sum tshogs pa bya'o/ /bzhi pa nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni//gong gi bsdu chog ltar la nā da yang 'od gsal la thim pa'i ngang la nyal lo/ lnga pa ldang pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ nang par rnal 'byor mas rgyud bskul bas langs te he ru ga:yab yum du gsal lo/ /drug pa khrus — /74

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil lha lnga'i sgrub thabs lo paṇa zhal lung / (tha)kyi rnal 'byor ni/ /dbang bskur pa'i cho ga bzhin no/ /bdun pa zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ skad cig ma'i sngags brjod nas lus dkyil gsal gdab/ kha zas gtor ma ltar byin brlab pa'am/ de tsam ma nus na phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ mi nyu ha ho gyi zhes pas brlabs la g.yon pas bza'o/ gsang las yang gsang rnal 'byor ma rgyud kyi/ /rtser son 'khor lo bde mchog zab mo'i lam/ khrag 'thung khyab bdag rdo rje dril bu pa'i/ /lugs 'di skal bzang bsod nams zong gis(17ba〉sgrubs/ /'phags yul grub pa'i dbang phyug mtha' klas pa/ /bshul nyer gshegs nas he ru gaḥdapal gyi/ /grong khyer cher bgrod bcu gsum rdo rje'i sa/ /mngon du gyur pa'i lag rjes mang zhig bzhag /ljongs 'dir 'jig rten mig gcig bka' drin las/ /mi 'dra'i 'chad nyan rnam pa bgrangs yas kyang / /zab don gnod kyis zung 'jug sar brnyes pa/ /sa skya'i bla chen yab sras tsam du 'khums/ /rtsa bshad che mthun dgongs pa yongs bkral par/ /'gran med mkhas rnams yang rtser legs son pa/ /kun mkhyen bu ston 'jam mgon btsong kha pa/ /thub bstan mkha' la nyi zla zung bzhin mdzes/ /de phyir gong ma'i ba ched srol pha mtha' yas/ /rjes 'bangs dpyod ldan 'grel lugs de bas mang / /blun rmonges rang bzo'i mun mda' zad pa med/ /mthong tshe bdag 'dra'i blo dman mgo bo 'khor/ /'on te bde mchog 'khor lo 'tshams sprin gos/ /rab mdzes dam pa'i zhabs pad bsten pa'i mthus/ /ma 'dres so sor 'byed nus spobs pa'i mgrin/ cung zad bteg nas smra ba'i skal bzang thob/ /mi 'dzad dge ba'i rdzings kyis 'khor ba'i mtsho/ /bsgral te ma dang mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i grong / /mu med 'gro rnams bsus nas bde ba che/ /sku gsum rin cen nor la spyod par shog /ces grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje dril bu pa'i bzhed gzhung dpal 'khor lo sdom pa phyi dkyil (18na sko lnga'i sgrub thabs lo paṇa zhal lung zhes bya ba 'di ni dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis bskul bas 'tshams sbyar ba la brten nas thugs sras lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs kyi dgongs pa gtso bor bzung ste rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag zha lu pa chen pos mdzad pa'i mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i dpal ster la gzhi byas/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa/ zha lu shar chen ye — 175

shes rgya mtsho/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho gsum gyi gsung rab la'ang zhib mor dpyad de za hor gyi bzhes kun dga' zhes pa shing stag khrums kyi zla ba'i khrag 'thung rnam par rol ba'i tshes la pho brang po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o// maṅga le//
