dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' po'i grong 'jug (thadadapal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs/na ma shrī pa ra ma su kha su de wā ya/ dpal ldan khrag 'thung tshogs kyi dbang phyug 'khor lo sdom pa gdan gsum tshang ba'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar mkhan zha lu pa chen po rin chen bsod nams mchog grub tshe dbang lhun grub dpal bzang por byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su mchi'o/ /brtse ba chen pos rjes su gzung du gsol/ /ma nub mtho ris dbang gi chu bo yis/ /bgrangs yas gdul bya'i sgo gsum dri bkrus nas/ /sku bzhi'i 'bras bzang smin mdzad rigs brgya'i bdag /rin cen bsod shen mas ma chag grub gtsug na mdzes/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung mngar po'i chang / /btungs pas zag med bde bas cher myos pa'i/ gsang chen snyan pa'i rgyang glu len mkhas pa/ /rdo rje dril bu pa zhes grags pa 'bar/ /paṇa grub ba ched srol ma nyams lha yi skad/ /ljongs 'dir sgyur byed mal gyo mar do sogs/ /lo chen chos mig ldan pa'i legs bshad ror/ /ci dgar (2na)spyod pa'i phyag len pha mtha' yas/ /khyad par rdo rje 'chang dbang mi yi gzugs/ /'dzin mdzad sa skya'i rje btsun rjes 'brangs dang / /bu ston lo tsā kun mkhyen btsong kha pa/ /skal bzang yongs kyi spyi bos btud bya'i gnas//mkhyen ldan gsang sngags 'chang rnams he ru ga'i/ /grong khyer chen por bdag 'jug g.yin khrid kyang //blos byas rjes gnang bskul nas rmongs pa'i mgo /bskor mthong rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i sngon 'gro bzhin/ /de phyir rnam g.yeng khol por dal 'byor rten/ /'dzad par 'dod min gzur gnas blo ldan rnams/ /yang dag lam la bkri ched dbang chu'i gzhung / /dpa' bo'i grong khyer 'jug pa'i sgo 'di dbye//de la 'dir grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje dril bu pa'i bzhed srol dpal 'khor lo bde mchog phyi dkyil lha lnga'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar byed pa la sa'i cho ga /sta gon gyi cho ga /dngos — 177

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)gzhi'i cho ga dang gsum/ dang po las brtag pa/ bslang ba/ sbyang ba/ gzung ba (2brkong bzhi'i/ dang po ni/ dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra ba dang rgyal po'i khab sogs gnas khang dul ma'i rigs la gnasakhang du lo ma'i rigs la mi dgos shing sngon chad longs ma spyad pa'i sar bya na dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga du ma nas 'byung ba las shes pa'i dbang du bgyis nas ma spros so/ gnyis pa sa bslang pa la snang ba dang mi snang ba gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ khang pa'am yul gyi bdag po la rin btsal te bslang ngo / /gnyis pa mi snang ba las bslang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gang du bya ba'i sa gzhin/ gtor ma dang chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod sbreng tshar nang mchod dang bcas bsham/ gtor mar chang chu nang mchod spro na/ rang nyid skad cig gis he ru gaḥ sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum rdo rje phag mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du bsam/ mchod pa dang gtor ma byin gyis brlab/ rdo rje khu tshur las g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung g.yas pa'i mdzub mos sbrel ba lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ k+ṣe tra pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā da rngu ya dza:sa spyan drangs zhing phyogs skyong 'khor bcas skad cig gis 'od gsal du zhugs/ 'od gsal gyi ngang las zung 'jug gi sku 'khor lo sdom pa'i lhan thabs dang shes rab lhan cig skyes pa'i bdag nyid du bsam/ /rdo rje thal mo kha phye nas/ k+ṣe tra pā la sa pa ri wā ra rda ba kla grihā ma ma shan+ti ku ru swā hā/ /phyag rgya dang bcas se gol gtog cing lan gsum/k+ṣe tra pā las pa ri wā ra a lha nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ sngags mjug tu oṃ skya(3na)nyu gis nang mchod mtheb srin gyis 'thor/ rdor dril spos bcas 'dzin pas/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po 'am ni gzhan/ /de dag rnams la sa 'di ni/ /bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol/lan gsum brjod/ zhes gsol btab pas gnang ba byin nas rang gnas su gshegs par bsam/gsum pa sbyang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sar slob dpon he ru rka'i chas dang ldan pa zhal shar du phyogs nas bzhengs pa'i phyag tu las kyi rdo rjes rdzas rnams rim bzhin phul ba dang bstun sa bzla zhing dkyil 'khor bri gzhin dbang ldan nas brtsams te yungs/ chu/ thal ba/ ba byung / dri bzang bdud rtsi — 178

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug (tha)dang bcas pa gtor zhing byugs/ sa gzhi'i dbus su slob dpon skyil krung sa gnon gyis 'khod de/sa gnon gyi phyag rgya sa la reg la/ oṃ bhu kho/ sa nam mkha'i rang bzhin du bsam/ hūm̐ lo hūṃ/ sa rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsam mo/ /bzhi pa sa gzung ba la blos gzung ba dang cho gas gzung ba gnyis kyi dang po ni/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du sa'i phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bri bar bya'o/ /zhes brjod/ gnyis pa cho gas gzung ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su sngon 'gro gtor ma/ mchod pa sogs mdun du stegs mdzes par bkod pa dang bcas pa'i gdan bshams pa la slob dpon dang / sgrub grogs rnams phyogs so sor 'khod/las kyi rdo rjes gtor ma (3bskong chu nang mchod kyis rim gyis sbyangs te phyag gsum btsal nas langs thal mo 'dud pa dang bcas/ /sngon 'gro gtor ma byin rlabs mdzad pa zhu/ zhes byin gyis brlab/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ ma hā bhū ta ga ṇa sa pa ri wā ra ā da rgya ya dzaḥs spyan drangs/phyogs skyong 'khor bcas skad cig gis 'od gsal du zhugs nas lhan cig skyes pa'i bdag nyid du bsam/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub lha/ga gi bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i go 'phang 'thob par bya ba'i phyir du dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i srung ma khyad par can khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad bsrung pa dang / de nas kyang bdag cag rnal 'byor ba 'khor dang bcas pa byang chub ma thob bar gyi bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang / byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzad du gsol/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs su gyur ba'i gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad sa'i phyogs — 179

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)'dir ma (4na)gnas par gzhan du song zhig /g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyi mtheb mdzub kyis phyir se gol gtog cing / sarba bi na la zhes gtor ma dor/ sa bzla zhing rol chen drag tu bya'o/ gnas yo byin rlabs dang ma ṇ+ḍal zhu 'bul 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dang skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar rdzogs par bya/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ rdor dril spos bcas 'dzin pas/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /mgon po bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje 'chang chen he ru ga'i/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor 'bri bar byed/ /bdag gis bsgrub bya bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod la/ bdag nyid ngo bo nyid kyis dag pa'i bde mchog gi gzugs su rdor dril 'byud rgya dang bcas gnas pa las/sa gar mdzad na slob ma rnams bzhengs/ slob dpon sa na ja la'i steng du 'khod par phyogs bzhi nas sgrub grogs mkha' 'gro ma'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa rnams kyis/ slob dpon gyi phyogs bzhi'am mdun du mchod pa tshar gcig bshams/ gong bzhin brlab/ mchod 'phreng gi tshigs bcad rnams la thal mo sbyar oṃ sarba bī ra sogs la pad kor/ mchod sngags dang bstun pa'i so so'i phyag rgya'i mthar se gol gtog pa thams cad la 'dra/ 'dzam bu'i gling dang gling gzhan na/ /mchod yon tsho gos kyis bkang ba yang / /bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa la/ /zhus pa med par byas te 'bul/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo (4bsko ni a: nas shasta'i bar 'don nga bsgyur/ /e ma ho mchod pa bla na med/ /rang byung mchod pa chen po ste/ /gzugs kyi lha mo me long 'dzin/ /gzugs kyi mchod pa spyan la 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra bī ra yo gi ni rū pa/khyad par gzugs kyi lha mo me long gnas su/ /sgra yi lha mo yi wang / dri yi lha mo dung chos/ ro yi lha mo zhal zas/ reg bya'i lha mo na bza' la sngags rim pa bzhin/ spar sha'i bar gyis mchode/ gtso 'khor lnga'i sngags mjug tu 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod dbul/ oṃ bcom ldan dpa' bo'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal/ bskal pa chen po'i me dang mnyam pa'i 'od/ /ral pa'i cod pan mi bzad pa dang ldan/ /mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa 'jigs pa'i zhal / /stong phrag phyag na 'bar ba'i 'od zer can/— 180

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug (thanadagra sta zhags gdengs mdung dang kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin/ /stag gi pags pa'i na bza' 'dzin pa can/ /sku chen dud kha bgegs mthar mdzad la 'dud/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bstod/ shar phyogs pa rnams rdo dril maṇ+ḍal thogs te 'das nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma khyad par bla ma dang / /dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dbul bar bgyis che khi/gdang dang bcas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegasapa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /lan gsum 'og ma rnams 'gre/ i dam gu ru maṇ+ḍal kai nir ya mi/ zhes rkang pa g.yon sngon 'gro'i gzhi bca' dang bcas pas bla ma la maṇ+ḍal dbul/ slob dpon gyi maṇ+ḍal (5na)gyi dbus nas me tog cung zad blangs te i rda gu ru sogs brjod cing bla ma dkon cog la 'bul/ maṇ+ḍal kha gsos te rten gyi drung du 'jog /des 'og ma rnams la 'gre/ byang nas/ maṇ+ḍal/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad rnam par spongs/ /kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ i rda sogs/ nub nas/ maṇ+ḍal/ zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung / /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ i rda sogs/lho nas/ maṇ+ḍal/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ /kun tu bzang po thugs kyi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ i rda sogs/ slob dpon gcig pu yin na sgrub grogs mkha' 'gro ma'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa yid kyis sprul zhing spros pa chung bar 'dod na phyi nang gi mchod pa sngags mchode/ rkang brgyad/ maṇ+ḍal tshar gcig gi mthar phyogs bzhi nas gsol ba gdab par bsams nas gsol gdab tshar gsum re'i gsham du i rda gu ru sogs brjod pas chog go /slob dpon bzhengs te 'khor rnams kyang zhal mthun par phyogs nas/ khro bo'i khu tshur kha gyen du bstan pa'i mthe'u chung sbrel mdzub rtse sprad de gyen du 'degs par rdo rje slong ba'i phyag rgyas/ hūṃ badzo timobasgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa nam mkhar gnas par bsam/ rang gtso bo (5ba tshe pas gtso bo gnyis par chad nas sa'i steng du babs te mig gnyis su ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang — 181

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)zla ba/ mig 'bras nyu thung las khro bo'i rdo rje 'bar ba/ rkang mthil gnyis su aḥlas sna tshogs rdo rje 'bar re rer bsam/ rdo rje khu tshur g.yas steng du bzhag pa rgyab sprad pa'i mthe'u chung sbrel mdzub mo gnyis bsgreng ba rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya thugs gar bcas te/ nyon mongs pa la khros pa'i bsam pas khro ba'i lta bas blta zhing / kro dha phri 1hiḥ lan gnyis dbang ldan nas brtsams nas g.yon skor dang g.yas skor du bltas pas bgegs thams cad tshig cing bros par bsam/ rdo rje'i 'gros sam hūṃ zhes pa tsam gyis dbang ldan du song ste/ 'byud rgya la gnas pa'i gdangs dang bcas/ /oṃ sko/lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyen/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang /srung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor byed/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzugs kyis ni/ /lus gsum las skyes dag par bya/ /gal te nga las bka' 'das na/ /'di dag bshig bya gzhan du min/ rdo rje'i gnas su/ 'khor lo/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ ral gri rnams 'don pa bsgyur mthar/ nga bzla zhing dal mo drag po dang yungs kur gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug go /skabs 'dir gur ram 'phreng ba lta bu nas blangs te sa gar rgyas bsdus ci rigs dang mi spro na/ shar du g.yon brkyang / byang du g.yas brkyang / nub tu sa ga /lhor zlum po/ dbus su mnyam pa/ kha sbyor/ rus sbal/ rtse gcig /bung ba'i dra ba ste stang stabs brgyad (6na)bya/ rdo rje'i 'gros kyis dbang ldan du song ste/ ma 'grub na/ hūm̐/ zhes dkyil 'khor gyi zhis ga la g.yon du skor ba gcig bya/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang ra gur dang me ris 'khor bar bsam/ snod 'brus bkang bar seng ldeng phur pa bcu btsugs pa/ khas ro lhas bsangs/ swā bhā was stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las/ g.yas skor g.yon skor du se gol gtog cing sa lan gnyis bzla/ zhes brjod cing spro ba dang mnyam du hūṃ las phur ba bcur gyur pa ni shar dang steng du khwa gdong ma/ zhes pa nas/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i me bskal pa 'jig pa'i me dpung lta bur bsam pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin la khyad par sgo mtshams ma rnams rdo rje'i ra ba la thim pas zhes pa'i tshab tu phur bu la/ zhes bsgyur ro/gnyis pa sta gon la sa lha/ bum pa/ lha/ slob ma sta gon dang bzhi'i/ dang po ni/ sa gzhi'i dbus su dri'i — /82

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lug kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug (thadathig le dang me tog gi tshom bu mchod pa dang bcas pa bsham/ khaṇ+ḍa ros bsangs/ su bhā was stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dkar ngo/'i lde bar baṃ las ma'i lha mo dga' ba dang ldan pa'i thugs can/ ser mo na bza' dkar po can/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas mi 'jigs pa spyin pa/ g.yon gser gyi bum pa bsnams pa/ /rang gi lag pa g.yas su a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ g.yas pa'i mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan pa/ rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya sa gnon gyi tshul du sa la lan gsum gdab/ ṭak+ki na(6bstu lha yo 〉 de'i sgra dang hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis bkug pa'i lha mo ye shes pa h+pha phyag rgya bcas la/ badz+ra sa mādzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥlha baṃ ho tshos bstim/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ /mgrin par 'a thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i dbang gi lhas/ chabadz+ra a bhi dzin mi/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri mdag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam snang gis dbu brgyan par bsam/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod pa'i khyad par sa'i lha mo'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig /thal mo khong stong tshigs bar pa bcug pa snying ga nas rim gyis g.yon skor du bteg pa mthar dpral bar 'grol zhing se gol gtog pa/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang sngags brjod/ /oṃ bṛ thi sa de byi a lha nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ mgon po bdag gis ci zhig bgyid/ /rdo rje 'dzin bka' bdag la gsol/khyed kyi bka' yi don du ni/ /bdag ni bum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes bka' nod pa la/ /rdo dril sprosabacad 'dzin pas skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sdebacoms pa//de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar bya phyir dkyil 'khor bri/ lan gsum/ zhes gsol ba btab pas lha mo de mnyes te gnang ba byin nas sa de nyid la thim par bsam/ /rdor bsdams nang bcing sa der reg cing / oṃ badzi bha (7na lo hūṃ/ lan gsum/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsam/oṃ badz+ra dṛ rte byu lan gsum/ sa rdo rje'i rang bzhin du brtan par bsam mo/ /—183

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)gnyis pa bum pa sta gon ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ /ji ltar rang gi mtshan ma yi/ /mtshan ma de dag thams cad la/ /de la sngags ni mngon par bsngags/ /rang rang gi ni sna tshogs spras/ /gos bzang rnams kyis mgrin par bcings/ kha ni lo ma zung gis bkab/ /ku sha'i chun po 'og tu sbyar/ /tshon gyi skud pas rnam par spras/ /'khor lo'i dbus su bzhag bya ste/ /yang dag mchod pa'i cho ga ni/ /bdug pa phul nas lhag gnas bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rnam rgyal bum pa'i phyogs bzhir mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i kha dog dang mtshungs pa'i gri gug gi yu ba byas pa/ shar gyi mtshan ma'i steng du gtso bo'i mtshan ma rdo rje sngon po/ las bum la gri gug gi yu ba dmar po bris pa'am 'bur du byas pa gdags/mgrin par ras bzang po'i chings srog bdun ldan gyis dkris/ nga bzlas te yungs gar brdeg /gu gul gyis bdug /bum rdzas nyer lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga blug /chu gtsang mas sum gnyis dgang / ku shas kha brgyan/ steng du dung chos dang gzungs rdor bzhag la/ bum pa gnyis/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hes bsangs/su bhā was stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baṃ baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sto ba yangs pa/mchu 'phyang pa/ mgrin pa ring ba (7bsgob khyer dang ldan pa/ rtsa ba dang nag po med pa mgrin par ras dkar po zung gis dkris pa'i bro ba bdun ldan byu ru dang bcas pa'i kha dog lnga'i srad bus dkris pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa de dag gi nang du oṃ tā ste tā ste ma hā tā ste swā hā/ lha'i chu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa dang / rin po tshe lnga/ sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ dri lnga/ snying po lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga rnams kyis yongs su gang zhing /oṃ ma lpa brik+ta ye swā hā/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan par bsam/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i steng gi dung chos kyi chu la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta u da ka ṣ+ṭha hūm̐/ lan bdun/ dung chos kyi chu rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chur bsam/ de rnams phyi bum pa dang dung chos kyi rnam pa la nang : las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa nas gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ rnam rgyal dang rnam rgyal chen po'i pad+ma'i lte bar dus mtshan dang nas/zla ba'i gdan re re/ las bum gyi lte bar ro dang nyi ma'i gdan/ rnam rgyal dang rnam rgyal chen po'i lte — 184

dpal 'bor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug 6)bar a ā nas/ mnyam nyid ye shes de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po zhes pa nas/ kha brgyan pa'o/ /las bum du pad+ma nyi ma mi ro'i steng du paṃ dang gri gug las skyes pa'i dum skyes ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ḍā ma ru g.yon gnyis thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ g.yas brkyang gis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs par bsam/ bum pa'i mtshan ma rnams kyang lha so so'i skur bsam/ lha thams cad kyi mig nas rgyas gdab kyi rjes su brlab/phyi mchod nas/ de (8na)kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin la/ spro na mchod 'phreng tshigasabacad ma dang mi bskyod rdo rje sogs kyis phyag rgya dang bcas bstod kyang rung las kyi rdo rjes bum pa la phyag gsum btsal te pad kor dang bcas me tog 'bul/ slob dpon gyis pad kor sngon du 'gro bas gzungs thag blangs nas/ g.yon gyis bzung g.yas kyi ming med kyi steng du 'phreng ba 'dzin pas/bdag gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril te song ba lha rnams kyi sku la phog pas ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs pas rnam rgyal dang rnam rgyal chen po las bum dang bcas pa yongs su gang bar bsam/ rnam rgyal gnyis la lha so so'i sngags dang las bum dang mchod yon gyi dung chos rdzas bdun ldan la khaṇ+ḍa ro he bzla/ las kyi rdo rjes slob dpon la phyag gsum btsal te pad kor sngon du song ba'i snyim par slob dpon gyi me tog dang bcas pa'i gzungs thag gnang ba bsdu zhing rnam rgyal gnyis dang las bum la slar yang gong bzhin mchod cing bstod la/ bcom ldan 'das bum pa'i lha tshogs khyed rnams kyis bdag sogs rnams la mngon par dbang bskur ba dang dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs thams cad bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol zhes 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya dang ma 'byor ba dang zhes sogs kyi rjes su pad kor gyis mchod yon rnam rgyal che chung dang las bum du oṃ badz+ra a: 〉lha/ mchod yon phul pa'i rkyen gyis lha rnams chags pa chen po'i mes zhu/ (8ba)byang chub kyi sems kyi chur bsam/ gzhal yasakhang 'od du zhu nas bum pa dang dung chos kyi rnam par bsam mo/ /rnam rgyal che chung gnyis nas ku shas — 185

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)blangs te las bum la blug /labs bum nas ku shas rnam rgyal che chung gnyibs ka la sdugs/ 'i〈cog pa bde bar 'dod na mchod pa man chad lha sta gon dang phyogs gcig tu mdzad pa'ang snang ngo / /gsum pa lha sta gon la lha gnas mi 'chol pa'i ched du las thig gdab cing cho gar mi gtogs pa'i gshoms/cho ga dngos/ gsol ba gdab dang gsum gyi/ dang po ni/ gnas khang phyag bdar dang gnam sa bar gsum gyi rgyan bkod pas mdzes par byed cing gang du bya ba'i sa der dkyil 'khor sgo rkyang / nang pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ rta babs snam bu bzhi/ phyi pad ra/ rdor ra/ me ri/ dur khrod dang bcas pa spyi 'gro ltar gdab/ de dag gi mtha' phyi rol dur khrod kyi thod tsam nas byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog /byang du mchod yon/ nub byang du zhabs bsil/ nub tu me tog lho nub tu bdug spos/ lhor mar me/shar ltor dri chab/ shar du lha bshos rnams gru bzhin bsham pa ni spyi mchod/ de'i nang 'dod snam gyi thod tsam nang gi shar gyi mchod pa ni yab/ nub ni yum/ shar gyi phyi ma la ni mkha' 'gro ma yin pas/lha so so'i g.yas su zhal zas/ mdun du mar me/ g.yon du spos/ rtsa thig gi byang shar du sngon 'gro gtor ma/ de dag gi mdun ngos dbang ldan nas brtsams te nyer spyod sbreng tshar du las thams cad pa'i mchod pa/ byang shar du 'das gtor/ mer 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma 'jog /rgyas par spro (9na)na sgos kyi chos skyong rnams pa bdun tshar du bsham/ slob ma'i grangs dang mthun pa'i so shing / ku sha/srung skud/ khyor chu'i dung phor/ nyer spyod/ ku sha'i 'thor yab/ dri'i lde gu /zhu 'bul gyi chas/ maṇ+ḍal/me tog /spos reng sogs mkho ba'i rdzas dang yo byad thams cad mngon par 'du bgyis/ slob dpon gyi sku mdun du bum pa gnyis rdor dril nang mchod 'thor nas gos zungs dang / slob ma rnams kyi mdun du rdor dril/ gos zungs/ nang mchod kyi ka pā la rnams g.yon nas rim pa bzhin bsham mo/ /gnyis pa lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis kyi dang po ni/ las kyi rdo rjes malji'i steng du sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhag la chang chu nang mchod kyis sbyangs te/ dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma bsang sbyang byin rlabs mdzad nas 'bul ba zhu/ 186

dge ri pe bar lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug 6)zhes brjod/ sgrub pa po rnams kyis rdo rjes nang mchod 'thor pa'i tshul byas nas sngon 'gro gtor ma sgrub thabs bzhin 'bul/ nang mchod 'thor ba dang khaṇ+ḍa ro his bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par bsam/stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang hūṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mtshan nyin thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du hūṃ las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūṃ zhu ba las byung pa'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/rol mo rnams dwangs (9ba〉deng thogs pa med pa bzang zhing rgya che ba/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab par bsam so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas oṃ a: 〉lha nas sha lta'i mthar ghaṇ+ḍi ra ṇi tshar gsum gyis byin dbab/ lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba gdab pa ni/ phyag gsum btsal nas maṇ+ḍal bsham/ gsum btsal nas me tog dgram/ gsum btsal nas zhu 'bul bya/ gsum btsal nas me tog bsdu/ gsum btsal nas maṇ+ḍal dbul/ gsum btsal nas gral la 'dug /ces sdom tshig tu byung ba ltar las kyi rdo rjes maṇ+ḍal me tog dri bzang gi chu dang bcas pa gral gsham du khyer la phyag gsum btsal nas/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi mi lha/ gzhi dbang chen dag pa gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe u lha/ phyi lcags ri khor yug mu khyud kyis bskor ba'i dbus su hūṃ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pas gtso mdzad/ 'dir 'dus pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun rnams la rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas par zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes sogs brjod la dbul/ phyag gsum btsal la bla ma'i phyag tu me tog gis gang ba'i ting phor reng bu btsugs pa dbul/ gzhan rnams la g.yon skor du me tog sil ma dgram/ yang sngar gyi shul nas phyag gsum btsal snyim pa (10na〉ye — 187

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)tog dang bcas 'grengs te cung zad 'dud pas ngag tu/ kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod pa'i sprin phung gis/ /mkha' 'gro lnga yi tshogs rnams mchod pa dang / /yon bdag bgegs zhi tshogs gnyis gsag bya'i phyir/ /gnyis med ting 'dzin dag la gnas par mdzod/ ces me tog 'thor tsam dang bcas lan gsum brjod/ /phyag gsum btsal la bla ma ma gtogs pa'i gzhan rnams kyi me tog g.yas skor gyis bsdu/ phyag gsum btsal la/ kun gyi thun mong du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes brjod pas tshogs pa thams cad kyis maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun pa khyad par/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la tshogs kyi rdo rje slob dpon zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes sogs maṇ+ḍal me tog gis phyur bur bkang ba de nyid bla ma'i drung du phul bas bla mas kyang sngar gyi tshom bu rnams kha gso ba'i tshul gyis khyad par/ ma tshang ba med pa'i 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas bdag cag rnams kyi rgyud byin gyis brlab pa dang / cho ga'i skabs dbye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod nas me tog gi snyed reng bu dang bcas pa maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bzhag ste bla ma'i sku brnyan la sogs pa'i drung ngam dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du dbul lo/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum (10ba tha tsal te rang gnas su 'khod do/ /bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ bla mas sems can don du sems dge bas/ /rnal 'byor pa yi tshogs bcas rnams/ /tshul bzhin cho ga la gnas pa'i/ /rnal 'byor la ni nyer gnas mdzod/ /bshags pa dang sdom pa ston du 'gro ba can gyi lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas pa zhu/ zhes bskul te/ skyabs 'gro nas bzung bzlas pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag dang sems thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes 'dod — 188

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' po'i grong 'jug 6)don la gsol ba gdab/ nyer bsdu byas te rang he ru gaḥzhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal la gnas pas/ gnyis pa sta gon dngos la mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las ri rab kyi steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar oṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa phyogs kyi mdog can zhes pa nas/ zla ba'i gdan re re/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin gtong /las kyi rdo rjes bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa'i dri bzang gi chus gtso bo'i gnas su gru bzhi/ 'dab ma brgyad la zlum po'i thig le bya zhing slob dpon gyis so so'i sngags brjod pa dang bstun tshom bu dbus dang / shar nas rim bzhin g.yon skor du 'god cing mtshams bzhir g.yas skor dang oṃ sa lha ste sngags rnams lan gsum re brjod/ me tog gi tshom bu rnams lha so so'i sa bon gyi (11na tha ger bsam/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las lha so so'i phyag mtshan du bsam/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las lha so sor sku yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo bde mchog /ces pa nas/ kha brgyan pa'o zhes brjod/ dzaḥlha baṃ ho nam mkhar bzhugs pa dkyil 'khor sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ lha thams cad kyi mig gti mug rdo rje nas/ rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan par bsam/ yab yum gyi snying po/ nye snying / lha mo bzhi'i sngags gyisamachod/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad bar mos la/ mchod phreng sa bzung ba nas len cing rgyas par spro na mdun bskyed nas blang / nang mchod nas/ bzlas pa'i bar phreng ba brlab pa ma gtogs sgrub thabs bzhin dang / yi dam chos skyong rnams la gtor ma phul/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma brlab pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar rnams sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o/ /gsum pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rdor dril spos dang bcas pa 'dzin pas/ lce hūṃ las skyesapa'i rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsam/ bcom ldan khrag 'thung rdo rje mchog /dam pa rigs rgyal khyod phyag 'tshal/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor ni/ /mgon po bdag ni 'dri bar 'tshal/ /slob ma rnams la brtse phyir dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la/— 189

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)che bas bka' drin mdzad par rigs/ /'gro ba'i tshogs ni don mdzad pa'i/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams dgongs su gsol/ /'bras (11ba)gnas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /gang g.yin sngags kyi lha nyid dang / /'jig rten skyong pa'i lha rnams dang / /'byung bo rdzogs byang nyer gnas dang / /bstan la mngon dga'i sems can ni/ /gang zhig rdo rje'i ming can rnams/ /rdo rje 'chang chen he ru gaḥ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji ltar 'byor pa'i yo byad kyis/ /'gro ba'i don phyir 'dri lags pas/ /deng bdag slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs brtse ba ru dgongs nas/ /dkyil 'khor bcas pa thams cad kyis/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ /oṃ me di ni sogs sngags tshan lnga dang oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lā rka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūṃ/ zhes brjod do/ bzhi pa slob ma sta gon la/ khrus byas phyag dang maṇ+ḍal dbul/ /nges 'byung blo bskyed nang dbang bskur/ /gsol gdab sngags la spro ba bskyed/ khri yin bshags sdom gzung khaṇ+ḍa sa bsrung / /gnas gsum byin rlabs mchad pas mchod/ /so shing khyor chu srung skud dang / /ku sha sbyin zhing chos zab bshad/ /rmi lam bsgo zhing rab gnas btang / /zhes pa ltar bco lnga las/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor shar du slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gcig nas nyer lnga'i bar zung du ma gyur pa rnams khrus dang gos gtsang ma bgo zhing phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul lag tu me tog thogs te/ gnyis pa nges 'byung gi blo bskyed du bzhug pa ni//rang gi bslab ldan 'khor bzhi po/ /theg chen blo can rnams la ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gsungasapa yi/ /yang dag cho ga rjes su gnang / kha cig gsang sngags sgrub don gnyer/ /dkyil 'khor du ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gzhan ni bsod nams 'dod/ /(12na)gzhan dag 'jig rten pha rol gzhol/ /blo bzang phal cher dad byas nas/ /'jig rten pha rol rdor gnyer 'jug /'jig rten 'di 'bras dor nas/ /'jig rten pha rol 'bras gnyer na/ /gang phyir re 'dir bde blag 'grub/ /'di yis 'jig rten pha rol min/ /de phyir 'jig rten pha rol gyi/ /don du yid ni brtan par gyis/ /zhes pa'i don bshad do/ /gsum pa nang dbang bskur ba ni/ /las thams cad pas slob ma bsangs//— /90

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug 6)bla ma yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras/ zhes du zhugs thugs gar mes zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma ra he ru gaḥsngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bsams pa la slob dpon gyi thugs ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rang gi zhal du zhugs shing byang sems kyi rang bzhin du zhu bar gyur pa rnams kyis dbang bskur hūṃ zhes brjod pas pad+ma nas phyir phyungs te rang rang gi gral la 'khod par bsam mo/ /bzhi pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rnal 'byor ma dang zhal sbyor bzhugs/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa'i rgyal/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum bo ni bdag la stsal/ /thar pa chen po'i pho brang du/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol//zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab bo/ /lnga pa spro ba bskyed pa ni/ /bla mas slob ma gcig gtso bor byas nas/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po (12bski/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje sngags kyi mthu yis ni/ /ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa/ /gang gis shākya seng ge sogs/ /mchog rnams kyis ni bdud kyi sde/ /mi bzad wo po stobs 'a bcoms/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor nasamya ga 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen 'thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod do/ /drug pa bshags pa ni mgur las byung pa'i rgyun bshags lan gsum brjod do/ /bdun pa sdom pa bzung ba ni/ /thal mo sbyar te slob dpon la/ /'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang / /stsal nas mgon pos bdag la ni/ /'khor lo'i lha yi bdag nyid dang / /slob dpon gyi ni las rnams dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig gi /sdom pa gsang ba bla na med/ /rtag tu sems can kun don dang / /slob dpon du 'gyur bdag la gsungs/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor la phyogs te rdor —191

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)dril bzung nas rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams ni/ /byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin cing / /dam tshig sdom dang gsang ba yi/ /'khor lo 'dir yang 'jug par 'tshal/ zhes gsol ba btab nas bla mas slob ma la/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba chen po'i rigs dag pa'i/ /gsang ba yongasasu 'dzin par ni/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam/ /zhes 'dri/ slob mas kyang / /bdag ni rab tu de 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod pa la slob dpon (13na)gyis/ /gong nas gong gi sdom pa ni/ /bu khyod kyis ni gzung bar bya/ /'khor ba las ni bsgral ba yi/ /thabs ni de las ga' na med pas/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /sdom pa rtag tu bskyang bar gyis/ /des ni gnod pa rnams bsal nas/ /byang chub bde nges thob 'gyur ro/ /zhes sdom pa bsgrags te slob mas slob dpon gyi spyan sngar sdom pa 'dzin snyam pas/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrimasakyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'o dkon cog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por zungs/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin cen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin ni dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams(13bcad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /—192

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug 6)sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol pa rnam ba(bdag gi bdagrol/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbug bas dbyung nyid / /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /ces lan gsum gyis sdom pa gzung ngo / brgyad pa bsrung zhing gnas gsum brlab pa ni/ /las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis bsrungs la/ /slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dri'i chus gnas gsum du reg cing hūṃ urma/ zhes brjod pas slob ma'i gnas gsum du zla ba la gnas pa'i snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po/dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po re bsams la/ yas rim gyis/ oṃ unyu/ zhes brjod pas phyag mtshan de rnams yig 'bru de dag gis mtshan par byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ /dgu pa mchod pa ni/ las thams cad pa bzla zhing / mgo bor me tog spyan la mar me/ mdun du spos/ snying gar dri/lag par zas mchog rnams rang rang gi sngags kyis sbyin no/ /bcu pa so shing ni/ a shwa t+tha la sogs pa'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa ma gas shing drang ba srog chags med pa dri bzang pos byugs shing rtse mor me tog bcangs pa de nyid las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis bsangs pa slob ma la sbyin/ des dkyil 'khor gru bzhi par ba lang gi lci bas byugs pa'i sa phyogs su kha shar ram byang du bltas la rtse mo nas bca' zhing skyugs sman drangs pa ltar skyon dag par bsams (14na)te/ oṃ badz+ra hā sa hā zhes brjod nas bltos pa med par de'i steng du dor bas rtse mo bdag nyid la bstan na mchog gyen du mkha' spyod/thur du sa 'og phyogs bzhir bltas na zhi rgyas dbang drag mtshams su 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub 'grub ces ngo sprod do/ /bcu gcig pa khyor chu ni/ hūm̐ lan gsum bzlas pa'i dri'i chu khyor pa gsum/oṃ hrīḥbi shurnya sarba dha smoḥsarba pā pa ni tsā a su sho dha ya/ sarba bi ga lha na a ba na ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod la blud do/ /bcu gnyis pa srung skud ni/ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i srad bu dmar po las tshad dang mnyam pa rang gi lha'i sngags bzlas pa mdud pa sum ldan dpung pa g.yas par lan gnyis su bskor la/ /oṃ burnya mi tri rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa/ swā hā/ zhes dang / las thams cad pa dang sum bha brjod pa'i nang mchod kyis kyang bsrung — 193

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)ngo / bcu gsum pa rmi lam brtag pa ni/ hūṃ dang jiḥlas skyes pa'i ku sha las thams cad pa bzlas pa che ba stan dang / chung ba sngas kyi dod du/ oṃ badz+ra ti kyā baṃ/ zhes brjod la sbyin na/ stso bzhi pa chosabashad nas spro ba bskyed pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wā ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ /bla med byed par nusapa yin/ /bskal pa bye ba du mar ni/ /sngon chad sdig pa byas pa gang / /dkyil 'khor 'di'ang mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na (14ba〉skyes ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas nas ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ga 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa/ /bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnamasakun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg chen du/ /bang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur//theg pa chen po cher 'byung pa'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams der ni dong bsan//rang byung skal pa chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/zhes pa'i don bshad la spro ba bskyed do/ /bco lnga pa rmi lam brtag pa gdams pa ni/ rtsa sngags kyis bsrungs la khang pa'i nang ngam dkyil 'khor gyi mthar nyol la nang par nga la rmi lam smros shig ces brjod/ slob dpon gyis kyang srung pa'i don du rtsa sngags bzla'o/ /mchod pa rnams kha gsos la brlab/phyi nang mchod pas mchod/ rnal 'byor ra gcig mas bstod/ sa chog skabs kyi sngags rgyas dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg /sta gon gyi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar byon te/ ji srid spyan ma drangs kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes brjod/ slar yang gong bzhin mchod bstod byas la yig brgya'i rjes su ma 'byor ba dang / zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ bris sku sogs rten yod na gtor — 194

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug (thadamagyon rnams phyogs bcu na sogs kyis brtan bzhugs bya (15na〉yed na oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ ces sogs kyi rjes su/ /lag pa gnyis bsnol pa'i mtheb srin gyis se gol phyir gtogs te/ badz+ra muḥs rten med pa'i ye shes pa rnams rang gi gnas su gshegs par bsam zhing /dam tshig pa rnams bsdu rgya dang bcas dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥs rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/g.yon pas se gol gtogs pa dang bcas sum+bha sa bsrungs la mchod gtor dman ma rnams bsdu'o/de yang sa'i cho ga ni spros pa chung bar 'dod na gnas khang rnying bar ma byas kyang chog cing sa ma dul bar ni ras bris la'ang dgos la/ rdul tshon mi spro na stegs bu lta bu'i khar maṇ+ḍal la dri thag gi tshom bu dgod pa tsam ma gtogs mchod pa bsdu ba'i bar bshad ma thag pa ltar la/ rdul tshon gyis 'bri ba'i tshab la ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor dgram pa tsam mo/ /rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen pos gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa'i dbang don de nyid rab gsal gyi par ma'i shog ldebs bcu gnyis pa'i mdun 'phreng gnyis 'og tu thig gdab pa ma gtogs pa'i lhag gnas rnams ni ras bris kyi cho ga la yang bya'o/ zhes bka' stsal bas rjes 'brang la la dag bum pa dang slob ma sta gon min pa mi dgos par bzhed pa dwags brgyud pa lta bu'i spyan bltos yin mchis/ dkyil 'khor ka ba lta bur gzar thang du mdzad pa kho bo'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub ni nam yang mi bzhed pa sogs kyis kyang ra pho dkar po lug khyur mi 'gre ba'i rgyur song ngo / gsum pa dngos gzhi la thig tshon gyi cho ga bum pa 'bul zhing dkyil 'khor brgyan pa (15ba'i ba cing mchod nas dbang bskur ba dang gsum gyi dang po thig tshon byin gyis brlab pa ni/ thig tshon byin rlabs so sor bshad kyang phyogs gcig tu byas na 'jug pa bde bas stegs kyi khar rin po che dang dri bzang yungs gar rnams kyi phye ma bsres pa'i rdul tshon dbus su sngon po la hūṃ/ shar du dkar po la oṃ/ byang du ljang gu la zhe/ nub tu dmar po la e/lhor ser po la tre bris/ dpa' bo'i rin gyis nyos pa'i ras bal gzhen nu mas bkal pa'i srad bur tshon dri zhim po dang yungs gar gyis sbags pa kha dog bsgyur pa kha dog re re la'ang lnga lngar byas pa/— /95

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)slob dpon dang slob ma'i lag pas bzung ba'i cha ma gtogs tshad dkyil 'khor nyis 'gyur/ sboms su kun dril na sgo'i nyi shu cha 'byung bar byas pa kha dog dang mtshungs pa'i tshon so so'i khar bzhag /mdun du chu gnyis nyer spyod bsham/ thig tshon bsangs sbyangs/ stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang lasathig tshon sngon po hūṃ las rdo rje sems dpa' sngon po phyag g.yas rdo rje bsgyings pa dang bcas pas thugs gar gtod pa/ g.yon dril bu bsnyems pa dang bcas pas dkur 'dzin pa/ shar du dkar po oṃ las rtag pa dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu bsnyems pa dang bcas pas dkur 'dzin pa/ byang du ljang gu kho las rdo rje rgyal po ljang gu g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje bsgyings pa dang bcas pa dkur 'dzin pa/ g.yon dril bu thugs gar phyogs pa/ nub du dmar po e las pad+ma gar dbang dmar po g.yas pad+ma bsnyings pa dang bcas pas dkur 'dzin pa/ g.yon dril bu thugs gar phyogs pa/ lhor ser (16na)po tre las rdo rje nyi ma ser po g.yas rin po che bsgyings pa dang bcas pas dkur 'dzin pa/ g.yon dril bu thugs kar phyogs pa/ lnga ga'ang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur bsam/ thal mo sbyar nas nam mkhar blta zhing / oṃ u pra ci badz+ra sa twa su tra swā tsakra ṇa ya hūṃ/ badz+rasatwa'i gnas su shi shwa ha/ badz+ra rā dza/ pad+ma sī rti shwa ra/ badz+ra su rla rnams bcug /rang gi mig gnyis su ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba mig 'bras rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsam/ mig gi dzo ma 'gugs pa'i 'khor ba'i lta stangs byas la/ oṃ pra sta drin e ku sha dzaḥ lan gsum brjod/ sta gon gyi lha'i cod pan gyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi thig tshon bkug ste dam tshig gi thig tshon so so la thim pas ngo bo rigs lnga la rnam pa thig tshon so sor bsam/ slob dpon rdor dril thogs pa'i lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur gyi mdzub mo gnyis kyis tshon so so had pa dang bcas/ /oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ye hūṃ/ lan bdun bzla zhing mnye/ rdul tshon so so la smiḥre bris la slob dpon gyis rdor dril dang bcas rdo rje thal mo nang bsnam kha phye ba'i srin lag dang gung mo'i bar du mthe bong gnyis gshibs te bsgrengs pa me ltar 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas la/ /bden pa gang gis sems can rnams rdul mang zhing sangs rgyas dang — 196

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug (thadabyang chub sems dpa' rnams sems can la chags pa dang rjes su chags pa'i bden pa des rdul tshon rnams 'bar bar gyur cing / snri11/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ slob dpon he ru dar gsal ba'i lag tu thig skud rnams blangs nas (16ba〉so sor brkyang ste bsgril la/ slob ma phag mor gsal ba la thig sne gtad de brkyang zhing gnyis ka rdor dril 'dzin pas/ oṃ gi(a rgyo n+ya a nu ga ṣāsarba dha phyaḥpa ra sba raḥ a nu pra big sarba dha smoḥ a dun a nu pra biṣ+ṭi sarba dharmāḥlha zhes phyogs gcig tu bsgril pa rdo rje la dkris te/ oṃ badz+ra gan+ta unyu/ zhes dris byugs gser gyi snod du bzhag la mchod/oṃ ga nyu/ oṃ shrī tsho ha ha rnyu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sam ya snyu tre ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa bzla/ sngar bzhin mchod/ sgrub grogs dang bcas pa langs te/ slob dpon rdor dril 'dzin pas thig skud nas bzung ste bden bral dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pa la/ sno rjeḥsno zhes thig sna btang / slob mas kyang sna snosno zhes thig sna drang / gnyis ka'i g.yon pas khu tshur gyis lte ba'i thad du bzung ste thig gi sgra/ma lus 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas la sogs khyed rnams kyis/ /'gro don mdzad pa'i dus yin na/ /de phyir khyed rnams 'dir sbyon cig /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya gyu tre ma ti kra ma hūṃ/ slob da pon shar du mngon par phyogs pas tshangs thig dang po gdab/ de bzhin du lho nas byang du phyogs pas tshangs thig gnyis pa/ me nas byang shar du phyogs pas shar gyi rtsa thig /rlung nas lho nub tu phyogs pas nub kyi rtsa thig /de nyid nas dbang ldan du phyogs pas byang gi rtsa thig /me nas lto nub tu phyogs pas lto'i rtsa thig /steng nyid nas rlung du phyogs pas zur thig dang po/ bden bral nas dbang ldan du phyogs pas zur thig gnyis pa gdab cing thams cad du slob mas slob dpon la rgyab mi (17na)bstan pa'i tshul du 'gre /thig 'debs pa'i tshe slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis thig skud steng nas bzung la 'og nas gcus te gyen du gdab pa gnam thig dang de nas sa thig gong ltar gdab cing las thig rnams byin gyis brlab par bsam/ de nas thig gzhan rnams spyi dang 'dra bar btab la/ /dbus su seng ldeng gi phur bu btab pa la thig skud nyis — 197

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)bltab tu byas pas rtsa thig nang nas pad+ma 'dab brgyad mu khyud dang bcas pa dang phyi'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i ra rtse nas dang / de nas cha phran gnyis nas dang / de nas bzhi dang yang bzhi nas bskor ba rnams las thig go /mthar bden bral dang dbang ldan du gnas bzhin pas chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sta gon thugs gar gshegs nas kyang / slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ bsdu brgya phyir dgrol zhing /badz+ra muḥs/ thig gi ye shes pa sta gon gyi lha'i thugs gar gshegs par bsam/ bsdu rgya dang bcasadam tshig pa bdag nyid la thim par bsam zhing dzaḥlha baṃ sngos rang la bsdu/ thig skud rdo rje la dkris la 'jog go /rang he ru kur gsal ba'i mig gnyis su ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba/ mig 'bras hūṃ las rdo rje'i lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan par bsam la/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel mdzub mo brkyang nas rtse sprad la rdo rje shugs sam rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor ldog ste/ oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma hūm̐/ nub nas dbus su rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas zhugs te dri chus sgo (17ba tha zhi'i nang gi rtsa thig lag gnyis khro bo'i khu tshur gyi mdzub mos dbyi la/ lhaḥlhaḥzhes brjod cing khro bo'i lta bas bltas pas thar pa'i sgo'i bar chad bcoms par bsam/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i gegs su gyur pa thams cad dbyi bar bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod/ phur bu btan la dbus su 'dug ste/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis tshone bzung nas/ 'di ni me long dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni sgrol byed pa/ /dpal ldan bde chen rgyal po ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /'khor lo'i nang du yang dag gnas/ /zhes pas tshon dkar po dang / de bzhin du me long gi gnas su mnyam nyid dang ser po sogs 'don pa spos la bu ga bkang / dbang ldan du rtsig pa lnga rim pa bzhin sgo tshad gcig bris pa ting ngam thod pas bkab bo/ /de nas rang ngam ri mo mkhan la sogs pas phyogs mdog shar dkar/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad/rtsig pa phyi nas dkar ser dmar ljang nag pa'i rtsig pa lnga sbrel ran pa na khebs phye ste sbrel/ mtshan ma — 198

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug 6)ngan na sta gon gyi lha la mchod gtor phul nas bsrung ngo / /gzhan rnams spyi dang mthun pa'i srung 'khor gyi phyir dur khrod brgyad/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su pad zla'i lte bar rdo rje sngon po dang gri gug pad 'dab kyi phyogs bzhir zla ba'i steng du gri gug mtshams bzhir zla ba la gnas pa'i bum pa'i steng du ka pā la bri'o/ de nas slob dpon rdor dril 'dzin pas dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor/ chad na bsang/ lhag na (18na〉dbyi/ ma tshor ba rnams yig brgya bzlas pas kha bkang zhid tshon lhag ma la chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs tshon lhag gi ye shes pa sta gon gyi thugs gar gshegs par bsam zhing dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa bum pa 'bul zhing dkyil 'khor brgyan pa ni/ slob dpon gyis spos dang rol mor bcas pas rnam rgyal dang las bum las kyi rdo rjes bzung la yig brgya brjod de dril bu dkrol zhing dkyil 'khor la skor ba lan gsum byas nas lha so so'i sngags mthar/ bdag gam slob ma la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhesabarjod/ lha mtshan so so'i thad nas bum pa 'bul pa'i stang ka bgyis te dkyil 'khor gyi shar du ji ltar rigs pa'i stan la 'jog /las bum la khaṇ+ḍa ro hi bzlas te/ dum skyes mas dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi las rnams bsgrub pa'i bar du gcod pa thams cad srung du gsol/ zhesadabang ldan du dgod do/ /mtha' dris byugs/ spyi mchod dang sgos mchod thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi mthar zlum por bkod pa tsam min pa mchod gtor gyi 'god lugs phal cher sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra/ sngon 'gro dang phyi rol pa'i gtor ma me tog /mig dar/ dbu rgyan/ rdor dril/mig thur/ me long / mda' gzhu/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan/ kha rdzog /tshangs skud/ rgyan drug /ḍā ma sathod pa/ gsang rdzas/ slob ma'i mchod pa sbyang chas sogs der dgos pa'i rdzas dang yo byad rnamasabargyud ldan bla ma'i phyag len ltar bkod pas mdzes par bsham mo/ /gsum (18ba〉bsgrub cing mchod nas dbang bskur ba la sgrub mchod dngos dang bdag nyid 'jug cing slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ slob dpon gyi g.yas su stegs kyi khar g.yon nas brtsams te nang mchod ka pā la'i —199—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)stegs zur phyir ston/ dril bu'i zhal rdo rje la bstan pa/ ḍā ma ru zur bslong pa/ me tog phor pa/ de rnams kyi phyi bum pa gnyis kyi phyi rol nas rten khebs zur bltab byas pa mdzes par g.yogs pa sogs tshar lugs sor bzhag bris pa yin cing / bu lugs dang gong dkar ba sogs la 'god lugs gzhan yod/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gnas yo byin rlabs/ maṇ+ḍal zhu 'bul nas bdag bskyed nyer bsdu'i bar bya/ sngar gyi rdo rje shugs kyi sngags rgyas/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su zhugs pa he ru gaḥyum bcas kyi skur bsam rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la/ las bum gyi chus khaṇ+ḍa ro he dang nang mchod kyis sum bhas bsangs/ su bhā was/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa ches/pa nas bzung / kha brgyan pa'o/ de rnams las sprul pa nam mkha'i khams khyab par spros/'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ thams cad dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus rang rang gi gnas su 'khod par bsam/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor la chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥs nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ lha thams cad kyi mig gti mug rdo rje nas/rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan (19na)par bsam/ de nas bum pa bsang sbyang nas rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan pa'i bar bya/ yab yum gyi snying po/ nye snying / lha mo bzhi'i sngags kyis mchod/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab/ chu gnyis kyi rdzas dang 'bul tshul kun mkhyen bu rin po ches mdzad pa'i bde chen rnam rol las shes shing mchod phreng gi rim pa snga phyi mang du 'dug kyang thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha pa chen po'i gsung las byung ba ltar/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags na/ /bzhes te bdag la bka' drin stsol/ /lag pa gnyis pad kor snying ga /nu ma g.yas/ yang snying ga /nu ma g.yon/ yang snying ga rnams su rnam lnga 'dod kor du grags pa dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka pañtsa ḍā ki ni maṇ+ḍa la bī ra yo gi ni'i rjes su rdo rje khu tshur las mdzub mo gnyis rtse sprad pa'i tshul gyis badz+ra a: pra tismo 〉lha/ zhes pa'i gi dil lag pa —2()khri

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug (tha)gnyis las g.yas nang du bsnol ba kha nang du bstan pa'i se gol dang hūṃ zhes g.yon nang du bstan pa'i se gol gtog go /mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil bcug /pā rdu/ phyag rgya gong bzhin zhabs bkru ba'i tshul/ ting 'dzin pir gyis bris pa'i smin legs gzungs/ /'khri shing gzhen nu bzhin du lus phra zhing / /bzhin ras rgyas pas zla ba'i mdzes pa 'phrog /ut+pal sngon po'i mig can mchu sgros dmar/ /spel legs me tog phreng ba 'dzin mdzad ma/ /'dod pa'i bde la chags pa mang sprul te/ /dkyil 'khor pa rnams dgyes pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ /nyer spyod lha mo'i bde (19ba thas mchod par bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur kha gyen du bstan nas gtor ba'i phyag rgya dang / badz+ra pu 〉 pra titsā āḥ// zhes me tog dang de bzhin du bdug spos nas zhal zas kyi bar la tshigs bcad dang sngags snga ma bzhin du brjod la/ khyad par ni/ spel legs me tog phreng ba 'dzin mdzad ma/ zhes dang / puspro zhes pa'i gnas su rim bzhin/ dri zhim bdugs pa'i spos snod 'dzin mdzad ma zhes dang / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha thur du bstan nas spos btul ba'i phyag rgya dang / sgrub zhes bdug spos dang / rin chen 'od 'bar snang gsal 'dzin mdzad ma/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mthe bong gshibs te bsgreng pa'i phyag rgya dang di pe/zhes pas mar me dang / stong gsum ngad ldang dri mchog 'dzin mdzad ma/ /rdo rje khu tshur brkyang pa'i thal mos dri byug pa'i phyag rgya dang / nga/ zhes dri dang / ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas 'dzin mdzad ma/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha gyen du bstan nas thal mo brkyang pa'i phyag rgya dang / ni we du zhes pa rnams bcug la zhal zas kyi bar dbul/ yid 'ong rol mo'i cha byad mtha' yas las/ /byung ba'i gdangs snyan mi 'dra du ma can/ /thos pas lus sems gdung ba zhi byed pa/ /sna tsho gos rol mo'i sgra yis mchode par bya/ /badz+ra shasta pra tī ts+tsha ā lhaḥsu hā zhes rol mo dbul/ phul byung gzugs mdzes yid 'phrog rgyan gyis spras//lang tsho rab rgyas glu dang gar la mkhas/ /dbang po drug la med byung bde ba ster/ /kun gyi dga' bskyed mchod pa'i lha mo ni/ /pi waṃ gling bu rnga sdum dzo rnga mas/ /gdangs (20na sgon sgra yis rna ba'i dga' ston 'gyed/ /rab 'byams mchod pa'i sprin gyis bdag mchod na/ /dgyes bzhin bzhes te —201 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)mchog rnams stsal du gsol/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis pi wang brdung ba'i tshul dang badz+ra bī ṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ gling bu bsgyur pa'i tshul dang / badz+ra baṃ she hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sor mos mchan khung gi thad du rnga mṛ rta ga brdung pa'i tshul dang / oṃ badz+ra mṛ ti ge hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa/ sor mo 'og tu rdo rje chen po'i rdung pa'i tshul dang / /badz+ra mu ra dze hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ pi wang zhes pa nas dga' ston 'gyed ces pa'i tshig rkang gnyis kyi gnas su/bzhin mdzes 'dzum dang ldan pa'i 'gying bag can/ /snyan pa'i glu len mdzes pa'i gar bsgyur ma/ /zhes bcug la/ gong gi tshig rkang bzhi dang mtha'i tshig rkang gnyis snga ma bzhin du sbyar ba'i rjes su rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha phyir bstan te kha 'gram gnyis su bzhag pa bzhad pa'i tshul dang / badz+ra hā su hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis dkur bzhag ste bsnyem pa'i tshul dang / badz+ra lu phya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ting shagasadakrol ba'i tshul dang / badz+ra gī ti hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa/ gar bskor ba'i tshul dang / badz+ra ni t+ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ de bzhin du 'og ma gnyis la'ang sbyar la/ khyad par ni/ me tog sdong bu dri zhim bdug sposadang / mar me'i sdong bu dri yi chos 'dzin/ /sngar gyi me tog nas dri'i bar gyi phyag rgya bzhi rim pa bzhin byas la/ badz+ra sgro hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+radhū pe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra di pe hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra garnye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ dri med me long sbrang char snod dang ni/ /sna tshogs gos dang chos kyi (20ba〉khyung gnas 'dzin/ /g.yon pa'i rdo rje khur tshur kha nang du bstan pa'i steng du g.yas pa'i lag mthil bstan te bzhag pa me long gi phyag rgya dang / rū pa badzi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sngar gyi zhal zas kyi phyag rgya'am/ yang na rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba ro'i phyag rgya dang / rā sa badzi rnyu hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje khur tshur gnyis kyis gos 'bul ba'i tshul dang / spar+sha badzi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe'u chung rtse sprad la brkyang mdzub mo gnyis dang mthe bong gnyis brkyang bskyed pa chos 'byung gi phyag rgya dang / dha rma khyu tu badzi nyu hūṃ phaṭa/ ces rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ rab stims zhing na ji snyed gzugs mchis pa/ /yongs su gyur pa las byung lha mo ni/ /bzhin ras 'dzum zhing sku yi mdzes pa ston/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje ma yis mchod pa yis/ /gang shar gzugs kyi snang ba thams cad ni/ /gzugs kyi rdo rje mar ni shar ba'i mthus/ /mi 'gyur bde ba chen —202

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug 6)po rab stsal te/ /bde stong mchog gi ting 'dzin rdzogs par shog /sngar gyi me long gi phyag rgya dang / rū pa badz+re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces gzugs dang / de bzhin du tshigs bcad gzhan rnams snga ma bzhin du brjod la/khyad par ni gzugs zhes pa 'og ma bzhi la rim pa bzhin sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg bya zhes pas brjod nas/ bzhin ras 'dzub zhing sku yi mdzes pa ston/ /zhes pa'i gnas su/ snyan pa'i pi wang brdung zhing glu len ma/ /zhes pa gcug pa'i rjes su sngar gyi pi wang brdung pa'i tshul dang / shasta brdzi/ hūṃ phaṭa/ces brjod/ de bzhin du 'og ma gsum la'ang shes par bya'o/ /bzang po'i dri yis phyogs kun (21na)rab 'gengs ma/ /badz+ra — badzi rnyu hūṃ phaṭa ces dang / /bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma/ /badz+ra rā sa badzi/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang / 'jam mnyen reg bya mchog gis yid 'phrog ma/ /sparnye badz+re rnyu hūṃ phaṭa/ ces 'dod yon lngas mchod do/ /dri med gser gyi rtsibs stong 'od 'bar ba/ /rin cen i n+t+ra ni la'i tog gis mdzes/ /sna tshogs phra bkod mu tig chun 'phyang gis/ khor yug brgyan pa'i gdugs kyis mchod par bya/ /g.yon de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur byas pa'i mthe bo'i steng du g.yas pa kha thur du bstan pa brkyang la/ badz+ra ts+tsha tre ga bra ti ts+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ zhes gdugs dang / drang zhid ldem pa'i rin cen yu ba ni/ /zla phyed rdo rje rin cen rtse mo can/ /dar lce gsum pa rlung gis bskyod pa na/ /sil sil 'brol ba'i dril chung sgra sgrog cing / /sum khug 'byog gi 'gying dang rab tu ldan/ /mdzes pa'i srog chags mtshan ma yod mod kyis/ /mi mthun phyogs las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan dang / /rab mdzes ba dan rnams kyis mchod par bya/ /g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyi steng du g.yas pa'i gru mo btsugs pa'i rdo rje khu tshur phrag pa g.yon gyi phyogs su 'byer ba dang / /lag pa gnyis brkyang la srin lag gi tshigs dbus ma bkug nas/ /ba dan rtse gsum pa'i tshul du bsgrengs te lag pa gnyis brkyang nas steng du btag pa ltar bzhag la/ /oṃ badz+ra ke tu ba taṅka pri la hūṃ swā hā/ zhes rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dbul/ /nam mkha'i rgyan gyur rin thang med pa'i gos/ /sna tsho gos dar gyi sham bu g.yo ba can/ /tsan+dan (21bsngal gyi snying po'i dris bgos pa/ /rab 'byams bla bre'i sprin gyis mchode par bya/ rdo rje —203

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)khu tshur gnyis kyis nam mkha' la bla bre 'dogs pa'i tshul lam/ yang na g.yon pang par mnyam gzhag byas g.yas kha thur du bstan te bla bre bskyed pa'i bsam pas nam mkha' la yongs su bskor la/ /badz+ra ba tā na pra tismo3 swā hā/ zhes bla bre dbul lo/ /dzam bu chu bo'i gser las legs byas shing / /rtsibs stong ldan pa'i dpag tshad lnga brgya pa/ /nyi ma gnyis pa lta bur mkhar 'phags te/ /dpag tshad 'bum lam nyi ma gcig gis gcod/ /de'i mthus nam mkha'i lam nas dpung tshogs bzhi/ /gling bzhi lha gnas dang por bgrod byed pa'i/ /'khor lo rin cen phul bas 'gro ba kun/ /chos kyi srid la dbang sgyur thob par shog /lag pa'i mkhrig ma gnyis bsnol te rgyab sbyar la sor mo rnams gcig la gcig 'byud de/ mthe bong gnyis lag mthil du bkug la/ badz+ra tsakra rat+na pra twe ts+tsha hūm̐ phaṭa zhes 'khor lo/ /rin cen be+eḍū tsho yi zur brgyad las/ /spros pa'i 'od kyis dpag tshad brgya yi bar/ /mtshan mo'ang nyin mo bzhin du snang byed cing / /tsha bas gdungs tshe 'od kyis bsil ba ster/ /der ni dus min 'chi dang nad rnams sel/ /yid la gang bsams phal cher 'byung 'gyur pa'i/ /nor bu rin cen phul bas 'gro kun gyi/ /chos ldan re ba yid bzhin 'grub par shog /khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo gnyis tshigs bcag ste mthe bong gnyis rtse sprad la tsakra rat+na'i gnas su/ ma ṇi rat+na zhes nor bu dang yid 'ong lta na sdug pa'i bud med ni/ /lus dang kha nas dri zhim rab tu (22na〉khyung / /gang gis reg la bde ba mchog ster zhing / /gling der bkres skom mya ga sel bar byed/ /bud med skyon lnga spangs shing yon tan ni/ /rnam pa brgyad dang rab tu ldan gyur pa'i/ /btsun mo rin chen phul bas 'gro ba kun /zag med bde ba che la spyod par shog rdo rje 'byung ba las/ rdo rje thal mo las/ /mdzub mo'i rtse mo bkug nasani/ /gung mo mnyam pa'i tshigs su sbyar/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang mor bshad/ /ces pa'i phyag rgya dang /s+t+ri ra sno/ zhes btsun mo/ gzhan la mi 'tshe chos ma yin pa spangs/ /yang dag tha snyad las la skyo ba med//sa yi bdag po'i yid la bsams pa rnams/ /ma smras par yang shes nas bsgrub par byed/ /dpung rnams 'gro dang gnas dang ldog pa yi/ /bya ba kun la rab tu mkhas gyur pa'i/ /blon po rin chen phul —204

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug 6)bas 'gro ba kun/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin skong bar shog /rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis dang / /tha ma bzhi gshibs te bsgreng ba'i phyag rgya dang / /pa ri ṇa ya ka rat+na zhes blon po dang //yan lag bdun gnas gangs kyi ri bo 'dra/ /rang bzhin glang po stong gi stobs dang ldan/ /nyi ma gcig gis 'dzam gling lan gsum 'khor/ /cang shes skud pa yis kyang bkri bar nus/ /g.yin la mi gnod mi 'khrug dal gyis 'gro/ /pha rol sde las rgyal bar byed pa yi/ /glang po rin chen phul bas 'gro ba kun/ /theg pa mchog gi bzhen pas 'gro bar shog /lag pa g.yon pa'i thil du g.yas pa'i gru mo bzhag ste bsgrengs la g.yas pa'i khu tshur 'og tu glang po'i rnam par byas pa'i (22ba)gung mo glang po'i sna ltar byas la/ ga dza ra sno/ zhes glang po dang / /me tog ku mud bzhin du rab tu dkar/ /lha yi gtsug rgyan nor bu sogs kyis brgyan/ /mdog dang dbyibs dang bong tshod phun sum tshogs/ /bsgo na nyin gcig 'dzam gling lan gsum 'khor/ /lus la nad med gzi brjid chen po can/ /yongs su ngal ba med pa'i bzhen pa ni/ /rta mchog rin chen phul bas 'gro ba kun/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs dang ldan par shog /khu tshur gcer pa'i gung mo gnyis dang srin lag gnyis brkyang mthe bong gnyis rna ba ltar byas la/ a shwa ra sno/ zhes rta mchog /rdo rje rin chen mthon kha ma rgad dang / /gser dang dnguladang spug la sogs pa ni/ /zad pa med pas sa phyogs rab 'gengs pa/ /de yi 'byor pa shin tu brtan pa ste/ /g.yo dang sgyu med gzhan la gnod pa med/ /skye bo thams cad rab tu dga' 'gyur ba'i/ /khyim bdag rin cen phul bas 'gro ba kun/ /gsung rab rin cen mdzod kun 'dzin par shog /thal mo gnyis bkan la snyim pa'i tshul du byas pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dpral bar bzhag la/ grog pa ti ra sno/ zhes khyim bdag ste rin cen sna bdun gyis mchod do/ /'khor lo'i skabs kyi sngags kyi thog mtha' phyi ma drug la'ang sbyar ro/ /rin cen sna bdun 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad rnams ni mdo dran pa nyer gzhag las gsungs pa'i don bsdus pa'o/ /bdud rtsir 'grub na lag mchod kyang bya/ gsang mchod/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa/ rkang brgyad bod skad ma'i rjes su dril stabs sum skor dang bcas/ /—205

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)mi (23na〉skyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchag dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad rab tu dag /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung / /las kyi mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo/ rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ mi rtag nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chagasapha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin cen mkha' 'gro rab tu zab/ /rdo rje mkha' 'dra dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rin cen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod/ gzungs thag nas bzung mdun bum dmigs pa phyogs gcig gis/ bzlas pa bum pa dang dung chos kyi rnam par gyur pa'i bar sngar bzhin/ de nas dbyug pa'i rtse rdo rje bcings pa lag tu gtso bo yab yum nas rim bzhin mtshan ma so so'i thad du 'dzin cing shar nas nub tu phyogs pas rang rang sngags brgya rtsa sogs bzlas la byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ /chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang gos zungs kyis mchod/ hūṃ/ mche ba gcigs shing 'jigs pa che/ /sgyu ma'i me tog phreng bas brgyan/ sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa/ /khrag 'byung dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod/ yig brgyas brtan par bya zhing gtor ma dang po dkyil 'khor pa dang gnyis pa dur khrod na gnas pa'i phyogs (23ba〉skyong la 'phrin las 'chol ba'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin la mdun bskyed la 'bul rgyu yin pas gsar du gdan 'dzoms pa dang gshegs gsol mi dgos shing / sgos kyi chos skyong gang yin gzhi bdag dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul/ sgrub grogs dkyil 'khor bsrung du bcug de nas gtso bo las gnyis pa bye na sgo khar du stegs kyi bar gtor ma g.yas na chu gnyer dang g.yon nas nyer spyod lnga bkod pa chang chu sbran/ dpon slob thams cad zhwa gyon rdor dril dang bcas sgrub khang gi phyir thon/ dus gnas kyis phyir 'gro ma thub na yol bas g.yob/ khri'u shing la slob dpon bzhugs shing dmangs rnams de la kha phyogs nas rang gzhan gyi dkyil 'khor bsrung phyir sa kha yar bzla/ rdo rjes —206

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug 6)nang mchod 'thor ba'i tshul dang bcas/ mchod gtor rgyas bsdus gang rung gis brlab pa nas yid la bde ba kun 'grub shog gi bar sngon 'gro gtor ma ltar la/ gang du bcom ldan 'das lhan cig /'ongs pa'i phyogs kyi bdag po rnams/ /gang yang rjes su 'brang bcas 'dir/ /'khod pa de dag thams cad rnams/ /bdag ni rjes su bzung pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar rigs par gyon pa yi/ /dri dang me tog sogs gtore ma/ /so sor bzhes te sems can rnams/ /'byams pa 'a sems kyis bdag cag la//gegs med par ni mdzad du gsol/ /las kyi rdo rjes zhal zas nas g.yas skor du mchod pa rnams gtor snod kyi nang du rim bzhi blug /slob dpon gyis nang mchod kyi rgyun 'byer pa'i phyed gtor nang du blug /phyed (24na)kyis gtor lam phye/ mchod yon gtor snod la bskor te 'gro phyogs su sbrengs la slob dpon gyis mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ hrīḥm shu d+dha sarba dha rma sa rba pā paṃ ni tsā su saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi ga lhan a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ yig brgya'i mthar/ slob dpon gyis mchode g.yog gi gan bang gsum du bdud rtsi reg la/ oṃ yi:hūm̐/ zhes gnas gsum bsrungs la lag pa g.yas pa sa la brkyang ste/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs mgron rnams sgrub khang gi phyogs mtshams su gshegs/ gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba'i sogs bya/ gtor ma ring du dor/ sa brjod rol mo drag tu byas nas mtshams bcad/ kha rna mig sna kha lag mgo lte ba rnams su gnyis gsum reg /ces pa ltar nye reg bya/ slob dpon gyis rjes mnan te nang du log /sgo'i nang du las bum gyi chus bsangs/ spos kyis bdugs/oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma hūṃ/ dkyil 'khor la yig brgya rol mo dang bcas nas skor ba gsum mam bdun bya/shar nas oṃ pra ti ts+tsha badz+ra sgo ste sa me tog dbul/ oṃ pra tī gro k+ṇi sto mo satwa ma hā bā la/ zhes rang gi mgo bor bcings/ rdo rje khu tshur rgyab sprad pa las mthe'u chung sbrel/ mdzub mo gnyis bsgrengs pa hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya'i lte ba la mdzub mo dral zhing zhabs g.yas brkyang nas oṃ badzo sa ṭa sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūṃ/zhes nub/ lho rnams su gnas nas sgo dbye/ oṃ pra ṇa mā ma sarba ta thā ga tā na/ zhes phyag bya/ shar sgor 'grengs te 'phud pa dang bcas/ bdag las dang po ba'i rten gyi gang zag (24ba)du gyur pas ting nge —207

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)'dzin ma gsal ba dang / bying ba dang / rgod pa'i dbang du gyur pa dang / cho ga lhag chad du gyur ba dang / mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor ba dang / nyams pa la sogs pa dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub pa la skyon du gyur pa gang lags pa de dag thams cad bzod par mdzad de lhag chad kha skong bar mdzod la/bdag sogs sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi dka' drin rgya chen po stsal du gsol/ zhes sogs gsol ba gdab bo/ /gnyis pa la bdag nyid 'jug pa dang slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa gnyis las/ dang po la dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa dang zhugs pa la dbang bskur ba gnyis kyi dang po la phyi 'jug dang nang 'jug gnyis las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon gyi mdun stegs khar maṇ+ḍal me tog snod bcas/ dbu rgyan bzhi sgroms kyi rin 'byung gi zhal ras la bstan pa'i steng du dar dpyangs kyis mdzes par byas pa 'jog pa bu lugs la mdzad/ las kyi rdo rjes tshogs pa thams cad las bum gyi chu dang me tog bkye zhing bsdu/ slob dpon gyis sna drangs te thams cad kyis bum chu cung zad 'thung zhing ku shas 'thor pa'i stang ka byas la/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hes khrus bya/ de yang sgom don la rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa/ cho ga dpod pa sogs slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang / dbang rdzas 'grem mkhan de'i thugs ka nas bye ba'i he ru gas mdzad par mos pa dam pa rnams kyi phyag len du gnang ba ltar bya/ maṇ+ḍal dri bzang gi sman dang bcas tsho me bu bdun ma la (25na khrid par ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du 'jug pa'i chos zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ zhes sogs gyis maṇ+ḍal dbul/ me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /rdo rje 'chang chen ngo bo nyid/ /dmigs med bde chen ston pa po/ /slob dpon chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don dam smra ba'i seng ge rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ /nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa/ /srid pa'i nyes brgya bskyed rtsa nyon mongs chod mdzod la/ /rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid 'grub par mdzod/ /ces gsol ba gdab/rang nyid dpal 'khor lo bde mchog zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs gar bsnol nas —208—

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug (thada'adzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs par bsam/ khaṇ+ḍa ro he bzlas pa'i mig dar dmar po/ oṃ tsuk+ṣa da ba raṃ ā na ya hūṃ/ zhes lag pa g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur las gung mdzub gnyis brkyang ste mig g.yas nas g.yon gyi bar sgor tsam byas te mig dar 'ching ba'i stang ka byed/ a kho khyi ra hūm̐ gis me tog phreng ba 'dzin du bcug la slob dpon gyis khaṇ+ḍa bzla zhing las bum gyi chus bsangs kye/dga' ba la dga' khyed su zhig slob mas/ bde chen bdag ni skal bzang lags/ /zhes rigs ngesapar byas nas/ /dkon cog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /lan gsum/ rdo rje thal mo'i bar 'phred la bzhag la/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams (25ba) cad sogs lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung /rang gi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba/ de'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rnam pa can du bsam/ oṃ sarba yo gtsit+ta u pa da yā mi/rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa snying gar bzhag ste/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya ri hoXsirnyi badz+ra ya tha su sna/ rdo rje mgo bor bzhag nas/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs gyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing / ma dad par yang ma yin no/ zhes gsang bar gdams/ khaṇ+ḍa ro he dang /a kho khyi ra hūṃ gis yol ba slob ma dbang bskur pa'i dus ltar bsam na legs so/ /gnyis pa nang 'jug la dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i phan yon bsgrag pa ni/ mgo bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de lta bu'i ye shes bskyed bar bya yi/ khyod kyis kyang dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mdun du brjod par mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ ma gsangs pa'i nyes dmigs bsgrag pa ni/ /rdo rje mgo bor bzhag ste/ /'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje yin te/ /tshul 'di 'ga' zhig la smras na mgo bo 'gasapar byed do/ /ye shes (26na)babs pa gsangs ma gsangs kyi phan yon dang nyes dmigs bsgrag pa —2(19

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)ni/ snying gar rdo rje reg la/ /he ru da: dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par mdzad/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /thod par gnas pa'i bdud rtsi lnga dri bzang dang 'dres pa la/ oṃ unyu/ bzlas pa byin la dam tshig bsrungs ma bsrungs kyi phan yon dang nyes dmigs bsgrag pa ni/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu yis 'grub/ /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha hūṃ/zhes phung / bla ma bka' gnyan par gdams pa ni/ rdo rje mgo bor bzhag ste/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi dpal he ru gaḥng yin gyi/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ khyod sang la brnyas par yang mi bya ste/ mi bde ba ma spangs par dus byas nas dmyal bar lhung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes dam la bzhag go /maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nas/ ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes sogs brjod/ thal mo sbyar te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyisagasol ba gdab rang skad cig gis he ru gar gyur pa'i spyi bor baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po bum pas mtshan pa la yi ge ha dkar po/ snying gar lo las sa'i dkyil (26bskor thor gru bzhi pa ser po rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa la hūṃ sngon po/ lte bar raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa dmar po rno zhing 'bar ba la a dmar po/ rkang pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis zur du mtshan pa la dzhaiḥdamar po drag cing bzod par dka' ba 'bar ba'i gzugs can du bsam la/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rlung gi ba dan la phog /rlung g.yos pas me sbar/ dhiḥrkang mthil nas zhugs/ sum mdo'i me dang 'dres/ de'i 'od kyis snying ga'i sa'i dkyil 'khor bsregs/ de'i bde sdud kyis dpral ba'i chu khol snying gar me chu 'thabs pa'i bde drod kyis nyams dpag tu med pa skyes/ gzhan yang thugs ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang sems gdod ma nas grub pa'i dpa' bo dang —210

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug 6)rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te rang gi lus la thim par bsam/ yab yum gyi snying po nye snying dang / a be sha yi/ /ri bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tswal ya/ tsā la ya/ hūṃ/ mi②brgya 'am nyer gcig /bdud rtsi lnga/ sha lnga/ bud med kyi 'dom dkris kyi ras zla mtshan gos pa ga khu bsal/ byi la'i brun/ gu gul rnams bsres te thod par ro sol gyi dud pa btang langs te g.yas brkyang bya/g.yas ḍā ma ru g.yon dril bu gsil zhing rol mo drag tu dkrol ba slob ma la dbang bskur dus kyang bya/ rdo rje mgo bor rgya gram du bas ste/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra(27na gis brjod/ mgon po rdo rje chos wo po/'od dpag med pa bde ba che/ /'dod chags chen po chos srungs shig /dge dang mi dge gang yin dri/thal mo snying ga /mgrin pa/ dpral bar 'jog cing / chan ma te hūṃ/ na ma mi hūṃ/ na mo na ma hūṃ swā hā/shar sgo nas phyag byas par mos la thal mo snying ga'i g.yon du sbyar nas/ sarba bī ra yo gi ni saḥ/ pā dza u bsnya na yā/ ā h+ma ni ni rlu ta yā mi/ oṃ sarba ta tha gā ta bī ra yo ni rna ḍā gi rgyu sdi a dhi ti ṣ+ṭhan+ta mo/ mkha' 'gro ma mar me gcig las gnyis mchod kyi tshul du byung nas snying gar ma me has rang mkha' 'gro mar gyur bar bsam/ /khyad nas dbral bar/ oṃ sarba bī ri yo gi ni saḥpā dza yadza ā d+ma ni ni rlu ha yā mi/ sarba sna ga ta sa ra yo ge nī mā ma sdi a bhi khiñtsa hu me/ lā ma gnyis la sogs/ nub nas lkog mar/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo ge ni saḥ pā dza pra ba rta na ya ā tī ni rla ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo ge ni khaṇ+ḍa ro hi du bra brta ( paṃ/ dum skyes ma gnyis pa sogs/ lho nas spyi bor/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo ge ni saḥ pā dza skadze ṇi ā — sum̐ ni rlu ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi ni rū pi n+ya sdi ga rma snye paṃ/ gzugs can ma gnyisapa sogs zhes phyag bya/ bla mas gsung bar bsams te/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /lha mo rnams kyi chos khrung nyid/ /rin cen sna tshogs khang brtsegs ma/ /he ru gaḥ dpal pho brang mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du/ /bdag gi slob ma (27ba〉gzhug par bgyi/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dgu /bsod nams ji ltar de bzhin shog /'di yi dngos grub gang 'grub dang / /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur / /'di yi bsod nams ci yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /de —211

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)nas sngar gyi me tog phreng ba de tre las skyes pa'i rin po che'i me tog tu bsam/ gtso bo'i dbu la me tog phul bar bsams la/ oṃ pra hrī ts+tsha badz+ra lhos zhes dbul/ oṃ pra ti grihā sto/ i me sa twa ma hā bā la/zhes me tog mgo bor 'ching / snying gar nyi ma la hūm̐/ dpral bar raṃ/ mig gnyis la oṃ re re bsams/hūm̐ gis bskul/ sngar gyi sdig sgrib bsregs/ oṃ gyis 'od gsal bar byas nas ma rig pa'i bsgribasagayogs dang mig dar lhan cig bsal bar bsams te/ oṃ he ru dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur te/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ dzñā na tsak+ṣu badz+ra hūṃ swā hā/ zhes mig dar 'grol pa'i phyag rgya snga ma las ldog ste bya zhing slob ma la dngos su 'grol/ dkyil 'khor lta bar bskul ba ni/ oṃ/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /de ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ khyed ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skye/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang / /grub kun khyod la mngon du gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyangs pa dang //sngags kyi dngos grub brtson par gyis/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor chen po rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum ltar mthong bar (28na)bsam/ de'ang slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi dusadakyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sgrub thabs ltar brjod nas bstan te bu lugs kyi rnal 'byor rgyud la lugs ldog dang bla med la lugs 'byung / sa lugs rgyud sge thams cad la lugs 'byung du mdzad pas skabs 'dir dgongs pa gcig go /de'i nang nas khyod kyi lha 'di la me tog phog pas de'i rigs yin no/ /zhes ngo sprod/ gnyis pa zhugs pa la dbang bskur bar bum dbang / gsang dbang / sher dbang / tshig dbang dang bzhi las/ dang po thun mong ba rdo rje slob ma'i dbang dang thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gnyis kyi dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal bsdus pa'i mjug tu rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du zhes sogs sbyar nas dbul/ ji ltar sangs rgyas mkhas rnams kyis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag kyang mgon pos dbang bskur zhing / mchog kyang bdag la stsal du gsol/zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā kha kha ji hi ji hisarba pā paṃ da ha na bha smin ku ru swā —212

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug 6)hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phyag rgya dang bcas ting nge 'dzin gyi sbyang ba bya/ khaṇ+ḍa ro lhas bsangs/ shā n+ya lhas/ rang dang rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gnyis ka mi dmigs pa stong par bsams/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i thugs kyi bde mchog 'khor lo/ sku mdog sngon po phyag g.yas rdo rje bsgrengs pa dang bcas pas thugs gar gtad cing g.yon dril bu bsnams pa dang bcas pas dkur 'dzin pa la rang 'dra'i shes (28ba)rab mas 'khrud pa/ phyag rgya dang bcas/ h+pha/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shesapa phyag rgya dang bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥlha baṃ sngos bstim/ h+pha/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros /dbang gi lha rnams slo badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi tismo tu me/ zhesagasol ba btab pas yum rnams kyi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sam ya shri ye hūṃ/ zhes dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur/ rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan par bsams/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ thabs shes rab snyoms par zhugs pas byang sems kyi rang bzhin du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum chur bsams/ phyag rgya dang bcas/ h+pha/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugasaka nas 'od sa pas gshegs pa dang gshegs ma/ sems dpa' dang sems dpa' ma/ khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs/ phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ /thal mo sbyar te/ /rdo rje can gyisa'agro skyob phyir/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ba/ /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal/ /de bzhin 'di la'ang stsal du gsol/ /che'i/gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ yum bzhi phag mo dang lngas me tog dang gur kum la sogs pa'i char 'bebs bzhin pas bum pa'i chus khrus gsol/ sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ lha mo rnams kyisamachod par bsam/ me tog 'thor ba dang bcas/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las nges 'byung ba/ he ru rkaḥdapal 'jigs (29na)byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku/ khes rab phag mo'i pad+ma ra rdo rje rol mdzad pa'i/ /bden pa 'dis kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bum pa mgo bor bzhag —213

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)ste/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyi phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba
