sbyin par bya/ /oṃ pañtsa ḍā gi ni bī ra sto/ a bhi sa khiñtsa me/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he sogs lha so so'i sngags mthar/ oṃ badz+ra u da ga a bhi khiñtsa hūṃ/ su ra sdo/ a lha/ zhes rnam rgyal bum pa nas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i khu tshur gyis chu blangs la 'thung / zhes dbang bskur/ lus gang / sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam/dbang gi lha rnams mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas rang gi lus la thim par bsam/ lus ngag yid gsum mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin du bsams pa la/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ dbang rnam pa lnga las mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang gi dri ma sbyangs rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas bsgyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i sa bon dang bag chags bzhag /mi bskyod pa la brten pa'i dngos grub dang 'phrin las sgrub la dbang ngo/ khaṇ+ḍa sa bsangs/ shā nu lhas rang dang dbang rdzas rin po che'i cod pan gnyis kyi mi dmigs pa stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'bor steng du hūṃ dang rin po che las skyes pa'i yon to bde mchog 'bor lo sku mdog ser po g.yas rin po che bsgyings pa dang bcas pa'i skur 'dzin cing (29ba)g.yon dril bu thugs gar phyogs pa la rang 'dra'i shes rab mas 'khyud pa/ spro/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/zhes pa nas/ rang bzhin du zhu ba las byung pa'i dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du bsam/ spro/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor nas/ sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs pa'i bar dang rin cen can gyis 'gro skyob phyir/ sangs rgyas nas/gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ zhes dbu rgyan mgo bor bcings la/ yon tan dpag med 'byung bar gnas/ /yid bzhin rin chen sna tshogs rgyal/ /ngo mtshar gzi brjid chen po'i mchog /cod pan gyisani dbang bskur ro/ oṃ sa badz+ra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṇiñtsa hūṃ/ su ra ta sto/ a nya/ ku sha spyi bor reg la/ oṃ badz+ra u da /a bhi ṇiñtsa hūṃ/ su ra ta ri/ a snya/ bum chu 'thung / zhes dbang bskur/ lus gang / sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rna ltag g.yas su rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan par —214

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' po'i grong 'jug 6)bsam/ dbang gi lha rnams rin chen 'byung ldan gyis rnam pas rang gi lus la thim par bsams/lus ngag yid gsum rin cen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin du bsams pa la gong ltar mchod/ dbang rnam pa lnga las rin cen 'byung ldan dbu rgyan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna'i dri ma sbyangs/ tshor ba'i phung po gnas bsgyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin cen 'byung ldan gyi sa bon dang bag chags bzhag /de la brten pa'i dngos grub dang 'phrin las sgrub pa la dbang ngo / /khaṇ+ḍa sa bsangs/ shār+ya n+ya tā sa rang dang dbang rdzas rdo rje gnyis ka mi dmigs pa'i stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ (30na)las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du e dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i gsung gi bde mchog 'khor lo sku mdog dmar po g.yas pad+ma bsgyings pa dang bcas pas dkur 'dzin cing / g.yon dril bu thugs dar phyogs pa la rang 'dra'i shes rab mas stid pa/ h+pha/ thugasaka nas 'od zer 'phros nas zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rjer bsam/ h+pha/ bla ma nas sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangasapa'i bar dang / /pad+ma can gyis 'gro skyob phyir/ sangs rgyas nas/ gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ /deng ni khyod nyid dbang bskur bya/ /'di de sangs rgyas thamasacad de/ /rab tu grub phyir rdo rje long / badz+ra a bhi ṇiñtsa mi/ zhes rdo rje snying ga mgrin pa dpral bar gtugs nas lag pa g.yas su sbyin pa thugs gar bzung / spyi bor ku sha reg la oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṇiñtsa hūṃ/ su ra ta ste / a snya/ zhes dbang bskur lus gang / sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las ltag par 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ dbang gi lha rnams 'od dpag med kyi rnam pas rang gi lus la thim par bsam/ lus ngag yid gsum 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin du bsams pa la gong ltar mchod la dbang rnam pa lnga las 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang thob/'dod chags kyi dri ma sbyangs 'du shes kyi phung po gnas bsgyur so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/'od dpag med kyi sa bon dang bag chags bzhag /de la brten pa'i dngos grub dang 'phrin las sgrub pa (30ba)la dbang ngo / khaṇ+ḍa sa bsangs/ shā myu tā sa/ rang dang dbang rjas dril bu gnyis ka mi dmigs—215

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)pa stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du kho dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i dam tshig bde mchog 'khor lo sku mdog ljang gu g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje bsgyings pa dang bcas pas dkur 'dzin cing g.yon dril bu thugs kur phyogs pa la rang 'dra'i shes rab mas stid pa/ spro /thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros nas/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bur bsam/ h+pha /bla ma nas/ sa mā dzas spyan drangs pa'i bar dang / sna tshogs can gyis 'gro skyob phyir/ sangs rgyas nas/gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ dril bu spyi bor dkrol zhing / oṃ / dril bu rdo rje rab ldan pa/ shin tu dpa' bo nyid dbang bskur/ rdo rje dam tshig gnas pa khyod/ bdag po'i dbang bskur rgyal mnos shig /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa snya /'byud rgya bya/ bcom ldan bzung ngo bdag la ni/ yang dag nye bar gyur bar mdzod/spyi bor ku sha reg la oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣañtsa hūm̐/ su ra ta / / a lha/ zhes dbang bskur/ lus gang /sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rna ltag g.yon par don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ dbang gi lha rnams don yod grub pa'i rnam pas rang gi lus la thim par bsam/ lusangag yid gsum don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin du bsams pa la/ gong ltar mchod/ dbang rnam pa lnga las don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog gi dri ma sbyangs 'du (31na)byed kyi phung po gnas bsgyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i sa bon dang bag chags bzhag /de la brten pa'i dngos grub dang 'phrin las sgrub pa la dbang ngo / khaṇ+ḍa bsangs/ ri tā sa/rang nyid mi dmigs pa stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor kyi steng du oṃ dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i sku'i bde mchog 'khor lo sku mdog dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon dril bu bsgyings pa dang bcas pas dkur 'dzin pa/ rang 'dra'i shes rab masa'abyud pa/ h+pha/ thugs ka nas 'od zer los nas/ sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs pa'i bar dang / 'khor lo can gyis 'gro skyob phyir/ sangs rgyas nas/ gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ rdor dril bsnol te spyi bor dkrol/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a ti pa stu a bhi khiñtsa mi/ he ru ka na ma a bhi ṣi ga ta/ kye dpal che ge mo —2/6

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug (thanazhes gsang mtshan shub bur brjod/ slob ma la dbang bskur dus ming gdags spyi bor ku shar reg la/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṇiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra ga sto/ a lha/ zhes dbang bskur/ lus gang / sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las dpral bar rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/dbang gi lha rnams rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam pas rang gi lus la thim par bsam/ lus ngag yid gsum rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin du bsams pa la/ sngar bzhin mchod/ dbang rnam lnga las rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug gi dri ma sbyangs/ gzugs kyi phung (31ba)po gnas bsgyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes ma' du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi sa bon dang bag chags bzhag /de la brten pa'i dngos grub dang 'phrin las sgrub pa la dbang ngo / /zhes dag pa sbyin no/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la dngos dang mtha' brten gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/maṇ+ḍal bsdus pa la khyad par ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du zhes sogs kyis dbul/ kye ho snying rje'i gter bdag la/ khyed kyi bka' drin gang gis bdag /bdag dang gzhan don nus gyur pa'i/ /rdo rje slob dpon dbang bskur stsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol gyi lho sgo la mngon du phyogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i shar du 'khor lo/ lhor rin chen/ nub tu pad+ma/byang du ral gyis mtshan pa'i dbus su rin po che'i khri'i steng du rang nyid 'khod pa'i g.yas su gdugs/g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ steng du bla bre/ mdun du mchod rdzas/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang bcas par bsams pa yid kyis bsgom zhing slob mar dbang bskur dus dbang stegs dang bcas pa 'grub na dngos su bya/ khaṇ+ḍa sa bsangs/ shā n+ya tā sa/ stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid hūm̐ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i dpal bde mchog nas/ gnyis ga'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin rgyas par bskyed/ h+pha /thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros bsgoms pa dang (32na/'dra ba'i ye shes pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥlha baṃ spos bstim/ spro: bla ma dang —217

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ gshegs pa dang gshegs ma//sems dpa' dang sems ma/ khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ bde gshegs can gyis 'gro skyob phyir/ nas/ bā ra ri/ a bhi khiñtsa mi/ oshrī badz+ra he he sogs/ lha so so me sngags mthar/oṃ badz+ra yu da ga a bhi ṣañtsa hūm̐/ su ra ta sto/ a lha/ spyi bor bum chu ku shas gtor/ zhes dbang bskur/lus gang / sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par bsam/ dbang gi lha rnams ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bor rang gi lus la thim par bsam/ sngar bzhin mchod/ cha su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ zhes me tog 'thor/ dam tshig gsum sbyin pa ni/rdo rje g.yas su bzung la/ khaṇ+ḍa sa bsangs/ byu lhas rdo rje mi dmigs pa stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las nyu dang rdo rje las skyes pa li rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i skur bsam/ de nyid zhu ba las byung pa'i rdo rje/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che//kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje bsnyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ oṃ mahā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje lan gsum gsor/ dril bu g.yon du bzung la/khaṇ+ḍa sa bsangs/ shā rgya lhag dril bu mi dmigs pa stong par bsam/ stong pa'i (32ba)ngang las snyadang dril bu las skyes pa'i rdo rje bsnyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa'i skur bsam/ de nyid zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bur bsam/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod sa kyang ni rtag tu gzung / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa.ā lkogadril bu gsil/ rdo rje bcas pas 'khyud rgya byas la / /yid kyi lus su rten byed pa/ /dam tshig phyag rgyar grags pa yi/ /dkur ni nye bar gnas gyis la/ /phyag rgya rtag tu brtan par gyis/ /ye shes phyag rgyar byin brlabs nas/ /'dod pa thams cad longs spyad de/ /dngos grub thams cad sgrub par gyis//sngar bzhin mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' wo po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo/ ta | ka gcig gam lngas bstod/—218

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' po'i grong 'jug 6)gnyis pa mtha' brten la dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid ni/ thams cad dngos po gcig nyid du/ /sprul sku'i mdzad pa rdzogs gyur pa/ /dur khrod yin te lus su dag /ye shes snang bas kun khyab cing //bdud bcom 'od dang rdo rje ldan/ /mi mnyam med pas zur bzhi pa/ /'phags pa'i bden pa ngos bzhi nyid/ /dran pa dbang po sgo bzhi ste/ /bsam gtan rnams kyas ba ba sa nyid/ /tshon sna lnga po sangs rgyas te/ /dge ba'i spyod pa shir+sha ka /dra tsho gos byang chub yan lag bdun/ /ba dan dril bu gsung rab sgra/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi kha khyer te/ /gzungs ni 'dod pa'i lha mo'o/ /pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos te/ /rnam (33na)thar brgyad kyi ka ba rnams/ /sna tsho gos chos 'khor rgyal po'i gnas/ /'khor lo gdugs kyi rnam par mdzes/ /chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig phyir/ /rtse mo rdo rjes brgyan pa nyid/ ces dang / lha'i de nyid ni lus dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ni mkha' 'gro ma sogs sgrub thabs bzhin/ slob dpon gyi de nyid ni /dkyil 'khor ting 'dzin phyag rgya deng / /stang stabs 'dug stangs bzlas brjod dang / /sbyin sreg mchod pa las sbyor ba/ /slar bsdu ba yi rnam pa ste/ /phyi yi de nyid bcu yin no/ /zhes brjod/ mig dbye ba ni/rang gi mig gnyis su pra mi shes pa'i rab rib 'dus pa la/ pra las skyes pa'i gser gyi thur ma mar dang sbrang rtsi 'dus pa'i mig sman bsnyugs pa'am rdo rje mig sman 'byug tshul byed cing / ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra ni tā a pa ha ra pa tu lo hri: ches/phar rab rib bsal/ tshur mig sman byugs pas ye shes kyi spyan dbye bar bsam/ me long bstan pa ni/ ā las skyes pa'i me long a / yis bsngags pa bstan pa'am/ lag mthil la lta tshul byas la/ 69las skyeb(pa'i me 31nga snang/rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du mang //rgyu dang las la kun tu byung / /rang bzhin med cing gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos ni shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skye/ zhes brjod la chos(33ba)kyi mtshan nyid bstan no/ /ā las skyes pa'i dril bu ā bzlas pa dkrol zhing / thams cad nam mkha'i —219

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam sbyor ba yi/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /zhes sgra thams cad nam mkha' ltar shes par gyis shig /hoḥlas skyes pa'i mda' gzhu la hong zlas pa bzung ste/ chos nyid gzhu yi ye shes mda'/ /phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun tu phongs/ /bdud sogs bcoms pas de bzhin gshegs/ /thams cad rjes su mnyes par gyis//zhes phyogs mtshams steng 'og tu mda' 'phen tshul byed/ spyir chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang ni/ oṃ badz+ra he tu mo rkang pa gnyis kyi bar du me las skyes pa'i 'khor lo/ oṃ badz+ra bha ga raṃ/ lag pa g.yas su raṃ las skyes pa'i dung lag pa g.yon du a las skyes pa'i dril bu dang po nyi/ deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyis cho me kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis pa yi sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /skye bo yongs la rtag tu gshod/ /de ltar byas na sems can la/ phan thogs drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun kyang / /khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar byed/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /sngags dang rgyud ni 'dzin gyur pas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams dang / /lha rnams kyis kyang mthun par bsrungs/ sems can kun la rjes brtse bas/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /nan tan bskyed de bri bar bya/ sgrub (34na)pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ zhes brjod/ dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i rjes gnang ni/ khaṇ+ḍa sa bsangs/ shā sgo lhas 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ rin po che/ pad+ma/ ral gri rnams stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las rnam snang mi bskyod pa/ rin 'byung / 'od dpag med/ don grub rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i phyag mtshan de dag gi rnam par bsams la rang nyid rigs lnga so so'i skur bsams te/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur pa'i/ /chos kyi 'bor lo rab tu skor/ /chos kyi gnas su/ rdo rje/ rin cen/ pad+ma/ las kyi 'bor lo/ zhes bsgyur/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i rjes gnang ni/ zhi rgyas dbang dang dgug pa dang / /sdang bar byed dang rengs sogs dang / /bsad dang bskrad pa thams cad dang / /las de rnams ni sgrub par gyis/—22(lha

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' po'i grong 'jug (thadaral gris mig sman sa 'og dang / /rkang mgyogs da len mkha' la bgrod/ /mi snang la sogs grub pa'i tshogs/ /ci dga' ba ni bsgrub par gyis/ zhes brjod/ khas blang ba ni/ bla ma'i zhabs la phyag btsal te/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ de ltar bdag ni bgyid par 'tshal/ /zhes brjod/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs ni/ khaṇ+ḍa sa bsangs/ shā rgya tas rang dang rdo rje mi dmigs pa stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur bsam/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rjer bsams la rdo rje bslang pa gsor zhing / 'di de sangs (34ba)rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na bsnams/ /khyod kyas kyang ni rtag tu gzung / phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /rdo rje spyi bo'am snying gar bzung la/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya/ ti yi e ka༈ dha ra yā ma badz+ra sa twa cis hi hi hi hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ khaṇ+ḍa sa bsangs/ shā rgya lhag stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las dbang rdzas rnams lha dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i gtso bo yab yum gyi sku rgyan cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bsam/ de rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas so sor bsam/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang ḍā ma sa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni lha yi sku/ shes rab ḍā ma ru yi skra/ kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rje dang bcas shing / /dril bu sil sil sgra sgrog pa/ /tshangasapa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang rnal 'byor snod/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis//oṃ shī badz+ra he he ru ru kai hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki ni dzā la she wa raṃ swā hā/ zhes bdud rtsi 'thung / mchod pa'i rjes gnang ni/ pad kor sngon du 'gro bas sgeg mo sogs brgyad kyi las rgya byed cing de dag tu bsgom pa ni/ /deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ sras dang bcas pa rnam rol cing / /rdo rje bsnyems pa'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /dga' ston bde ba'i mchod pa gyis/ sgeg mo/ a/ sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'phang / /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /ngas ni bcom ldan 'bral mi 'gyur/ /phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ phreng ba ma/ oṃ/ lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ khyod kyis glu ni blang bar gyis/ de yis bde gshegs dngos grub kyi/ /bde ba myur du myong bar 'gyur/ glu (35nasgo/ gī /de nyid thal mo gar gyis —221 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byas/ /sangs rgyas la ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar gyis/ gar ma/ hoḥ rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul pas/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tsho me gyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis/ bdug spos ma/ u/ sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur nas/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan par ni/ /bde gshegs sku ni thob par gyis/ /me tog ma/ lja/ sems can ma rig ldongasapa la/ /chos kyi me ni legs spar nas/ rdo rje chos dang 'dra ba mā /chos kyi rnam par 'bar bar gyis//mar me ma/ pra/ khyod kyis rgyal la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bgos/ dri chab ma/ zhes brjod/ lung bstan pa ni/bla ma shākya thub pa'i rnam par 'phos nas g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis chos gos kyi drwa ri dwags kyi rna ba ltar 'dzin pas dril bu 'chang / g.yas mchog sbyin pa'i phyag rgyas rdo rje bsnams te rang gi gsang mtshan nas lung ston par bsams la/ oṃ/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir/ /srid dang ngan 'gro rnams las brtan/ /kye/ che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa sirnyi sam ya skye bhu rtu wa swaḥ gang la tshig 'dis lung bstan pa/ /de la sangs rgyas byang chub sems/ (35ba tshe mthor dang bcas pa mgrin gcig tu/ /byang chub chen por lung ston te/ /phyag rgya sngags 'di'i mthu yin zhes/ /slob ma dad pa rab tu bskyed/ ces brjod/ nyan rang yid byed kyi sems spang bar gdams pa ni/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig /khams gsum na ni gzhan med pas/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral ba/ khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/ /ma hā sam ya ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags kyi rjes gnang ni/ rmi ༷ཿha ha hūṃ rnyu phaṭa/ me tog mgo bor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la sbyan lags kyis/ /'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod/ lan du/ bcom ldan gzung ngo bdag la ni/ /yang dag nye bar gyur bar mdzod/ /oṃ hrīḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ slob ma lha la dbul ba ni/ /gdugs bzung nas dkyil 'khor la skor ba byed cing / /sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin —222

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug 6)gyur pa'i/ /slob ma 'di ni phul ba lags/ /zhes brjod/ /gzengs bstod cing dbugs dbyung ba ni//bla mas mchog gsang dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir/ /zhugs pa dang ni mthong ba yis/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol nas/ /de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yod med de/ /mi thub chugs pa yod min pas/ /cis kyang ma 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir/ srid pa'i duḥkha las khyod 'das/ /gang zhig skyes pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangasargyas nyid du dogs med pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni spang mi bya/ /dam chos smad par mi bya ste/ /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /mi shes pa'am (36na)rmongs pa la/ /gsang ba de nyid bstan mi bya/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /sangs rgyas kun dang mtshungs gyur pa'i/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /rang bdag yongs su spangs pa yi/ /dga' thub kyis ni gdung mi bya/ /ji ltar bde bar bde bzung nas/ /'di ni ma byon rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes thal mo sbyar te/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de bzhin du ni bdag gis bgyi/ /zhes khas blang ngo / /de ltar dbang bzhi las phya rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ gtso bor lus dri ma 'khrud/ bskyed rim khyad par can sgom pa la dbang bar byas/'bras bu sprul sku 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes dag pa brjod do/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang ni/ rig ma mtshan ldan dang maṇ+ḍal bsdus pa la khyad par gsang ba'i dbang bskur zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar sogs kyis 'bul/ /skyob pa skyabs med rnams kyi skyabs/ /'khor lo sdom pa bdag la skyobs/ /rgyu med par ni thugs rje che/ /mgon med bdag la mgon mdzod cig /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ /sngon chad bha ga'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba mtshon byed du/ oṃ tsak+ṣu bha ji wa ra ma na ya hūṃ/ zhes mig dar bcings te/ bla ma yab yum sgrub thabs las byung ba'i tshig brjod de gsal gdab/ bcom ldan 'das kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po nas/yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dung kha zhes pa'i bar dang / yab yum gnyis kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par snyad mar po/ thugs kur hūm̐ sngon po (36ba)mkha' gseng sgrub thabs ltar —223

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)brlab/ 'khyud rgya dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swā bhā wa ā khru ko3lha/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgra dang thugs ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis rigs lnga yab yum spyan drangs spyi bo nas zhugs/ chags pa'i mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud de/ rdo rje nor bur lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba brtan par byas pa'i byang sems/ rang nyid 'od dpag med du gyur pa la/ /'das pa'i rdo rje sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /de bzhin du ni byang chub sems//mdzes pas bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ hrīḥha ha nyu nyu phaṭa/ ces bdud rtsi sbyin/ des kyang sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa' blos/ a ho ma hā su kho/ zhes myang / rig mas kyang gcer bur pad+ma na gnasapa'i byang sems/ 'di de dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams/ /dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste/ /khams lnga ldan pa'i ro rtogs byed/ /bde ba de gang myang bar bya/ /oṃ sarba burnya ḍā ki ni ye badz+ra war+ṇa ni ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ces bdud rtsi sbyin/ des kyang a ho ma hā su kho/ de ltar myangs pas mgrin par rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis 'dus pa'i rtsa 'dab bcu drug byang chub sems kyis gang / de nas brgyud de lus thams cad gang bas gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin skyes par bsam/ oṃ lha lha zhes mig dar bkrol/ de ltar dbang bzhi las bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gtso bor ngag gi dri ma zhabrud/ bdag byin brlabs (37na)kun rdzob sgyu ma'i rdzogs rim sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so/ /zhes dag pa brjod do/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ maṇ+ḍal khyad par/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du zhes sogs kyis dbul/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyong ba'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar/ tsak+ṣu bhan+ta sa mig dar 'ching / rang nyid thugs kyi bde mchog 'khor lo bum dbang gi skabs ltar gsal ba'i snying gar oṃ ha dkar po nas/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa lha ljang gu /sku gsung thugs gong ltar —224

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug 6)brlab/ h+pha/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥlha baṃ lho ches bstim pa de'i lag tu rig ma gtad/ /bla mas sangs rgyas thams cad dpang por byas te rig ma'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas/ lha mo 'di ni phyag rgya che/ /mtha' yas bde ba sbyin pa mo/ /rnam pa kun tu phyag rgya'ang / /bu yis bla med mchod par gyis/ /zhes phyag rgya gtad pas/ rig ma des skra bshig gos dang bral bar byas nas dri ba ni/ bshang gci la sogs za ba dang / khrag dang khu ba de bzhin sha/ /rtag par bud med mchog gus pas/ /bha ga'i pad+ma ra 'o byed pa/ /bu khyod spro bar byed dam ci/ /bu yis ji ltar bde bar smos/ lan du/ bshang (37bsko/ la sogs bza' ba dang / /bud med la yang rtag gus bgyi/ /bha ga nyid la 'o byed pas/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /zhes brjod pas lha mo de mnyes nas gcer bur pad+ma rgyas pa kha phye ste bstan la/ e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ /ci ste cho ga bzhin bsten na/ /de yi mdun na nga gnas te/ /sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa/ /bya ba thams cad pad+mas byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du na yang dag gnas/ bhañdza mok+ṣa hoḥ/ zhes gsungs par bsams la/ rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog dang rig ma phag mor gsal ba/ phung khams skye mched/ go bgo ba/ gsang gnas byin brlab 'du bya ba rnams sgrub thabs bzhin byed/ /yum gyi g.yon gyi char song ba'i rtsa'i rtse mo khyoḥdamar po dang ldan pa/ /mdzub mo dang lces mid ces bya bas bskul nas/ /pad gor dang bcas/ /oṃ ṣi shi shi ha ha ha swā hā/ /'byud rgya bcas la/ /chasarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā gaṇa badz+ra su bhā wa ā khru ko3lha/ zhes brjod/ snyoms 'jug gi dga' ba'i sgra dang rang dang bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ gshegs pa dang gshegs ma'i cho ga oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs lus la thim pas snyoms 'jug gi dga' bzhi nyams su myong ste/ gang la thog ma dbus mtha' med/ /bdag med g.yin yang med pa ste/ /srid med mang na 'das pa med/ /'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ ces 'od gsal gyi bde ba myong nas yang hūṃ zhes btsan thabs kyis gyen du drangs (38na)pas/ gsang bar dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ dpral bar khyad dga'/ gtsug tor du lhan —225

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)cig skyes dga' brtan par bsam/ shes rab ma mnyes te de'i mgo bor lag pa bzhag nas/ deng nas gzung ste bu khyod kyis/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rmi 'drar sems can thams cad kyi/ /don ni bdag nyid kun gyis byos/ zhes rjes su gnang ba sbyin la 'bru gsum brjod cing mig dar phye/de ltar dbang bzhi las kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/gtso bor yid kyi dri ma 'brud/ phyag rgya chen po don dam 'od gsal gyi rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang /'bras bu sangs rgyas gyi chos sku 'thob pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so/ /zhes dag pa brjod do/bzhi pa tshig dbang ni/ maṇ+ḍal khyad par/ dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du zhes sogs kyis dbul/ thal mo sbyar te/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ de ring rin cen bzhi pa yang / /bdag la bka' drin rab tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba mtshon byed du/ tsak+ṣu bhan+ta sa mig 'ching / dbang bzhi pa bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya ba ni/ 'di skad du/ 'gro ba ma lus pa'i don phun sum tshogs par byed pa/ rtog pa'i rnyog pa dang bral ba nyid kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rig pa dang tha mi dad pa/ thub pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba'i (38brko kyil 'khor gyi bdag nyid yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu bstan pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi tshig gis sbyin par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa gang yin pa ste/ zab pa dang rgya che ba la mos pa la ni blos mtshan mas shes pa ni/ du ba las ni mer shes shing/ /chu skyar las ni chur shes ltar/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan gyi/ /rigs ni mtshan ma dag las shes/ zhes gsungs pas/ dga' ba ni snang ba'i ye shes te bum dbang / mchog dga' snang ba mchod pa ste gsang dbang / khyad dga' snang ba nyer thob ste shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / lhan cig skyes dga' ni thams cad stong pa 'od gsal ba ste dbang bzhi pa/ de yang dri ma dang bcas pa yin cing / de dper byas nas/ don gyi dbang bzhi pa ni/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i lus dkyil 'khor gyi dbang chog las/ /dbang gsum pa'i skabs su lus 'dod lha yab yum du snang bzhin pa dang / sems de kho na —226

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' po'i grong 'jug (tha)nyid la zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po gnyis yod pa de bzhin du/ don gyi dbang bzhi pa yang phyi nang gi chos brtan g.yo kun gyi bdag nyid bdag med pa'i de kho na nyid kyi bdag nyid du gnas pa la/ yul can bde ba chen po chu la chu bzhag pa bzhin du ro gcig tu zhugs pas gnyis snang phra mo yang med pa'i thugs lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mi zad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mtha' yas pa dang / sogs kyi don lus yongs su dag pa'i sgyu ma'i skur song zhing de gnyis po ngo bo gcig tu tshogs pa'i zung 'jug /rdzogs rim gyi rim pa lnga pa bsam mi (39na/byab kyi rim pa de nyid don gyi dbang bzhi pa yin la/ de nyid tshig dbang gis ngo sprad pa'i thabs kyi lam goms par byas pa las mngon du 'gyur ro/ zhes tshig gis brda sprad pa'i lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas phyi'i snod bcud thams cad rten dang brten pa rim gyis bsdus te de nyid 'od gsal stong pa nyid dang bde ba chen po gnyis dbyer ma mchis pa'i spros bral gyi ngang la cung zad cig mnyam par bzhag la 'bru gsum brjod cing mig dar phye/ /de ltar dbang bzhi las don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa'i bag chags zhabrud pa'i nus pa bzhag /bden gnyis dbyer med zung 'jug gi rdzogs rim bsgom pa sogs la dbang bar byas/ 'bras bu zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas so/ /zhes dag pa bshad do/ /don bsdus te khas blang ba ni/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang maṇ+ḍal khyad par/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du zhes sogs kyis dbul deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags kyi/ khyod kyi slob mar gzung ba dang / /chu sa yas kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /gnyis pa slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa ni/ /rdor dril dang bcas pas de kho na nyid bskul ba dang bden stobs brjod pa ni/ oṃ/ nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha (39bsgo med pa'i mchog /sems dpa'i rdo rje tshe rang bzhin/ /bde mchog 'khor lo bdag grub mdzod/ /kun mchog yon tan chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi —227

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa ste/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pa/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod/ khren tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /'dod nas grol ba de bzhin bshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems dpar bdag grub mdzod/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya mchog /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje bsnyems bdag bdag grub mdzod/ /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ /sems can kun gyi yid la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi yab nyid dang / /'dod chagasamachog gi dam tshig mchog shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa gang gis ye shesamachog /bden pa de yis mgon khyod kyis/ /bdag gi 'dod pa yongs rdzogs mdzod/ /'di rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab rje sogs kyi phyag bzhes la bdag 'jug la'ang mdzad/ thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes rgya mtsho sogs slob ma la dbang bskur pa'i dus min pa mi mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs dkon cog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i kye rdor dbang gi mtshams sbyor sogs bla med dkyil chog gi bshad pa khungs btsun pa'i yig char brten (40na)nas sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa sogs dbang don lam gyi rim par dril zhing rang nyid dang slob ma 'don pa kha spos la dbang rnams bskur te/ me tog 'bul ba'i sngon du bar snang gi kha dog dri ba/ dkar ser dmar ljang gi dbye bas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi dngos grub 'grub tshul/ me tog dor bas rang gi lhas rjes su 'dzin tshul/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa la dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad gyis shar du 'khor lo/lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gri bris pa'i khar slob ma bzhag la/ hūṃ bzlas pa'o/ yungasakur/ chu/ kham phor/ gtso bo'i snying po bzla zhing nye reg hūṃ bzlas pa'i spos mar bsregs pas bdugasapa'i sbyang ba bya ba spyi dang 'dra bar dbang rnams bskur ro/ /mchod pa kha gsos la byin gyis brlab/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya la bla ma dang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems —228

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug (thadadapa'i tshogs dang bcas pas bdag sogs sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ he ru ska'i yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang sogs dang / bdag las dang po pa'i zhes pa nas/ ma tshang ba thams cad bzod par mdzad du gsol/zhes pa'i bar gyi bzod par gsol/ phyogs bston bzhugs pa'i (40ba〉ngas rgyas nas/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ zhes dkyil 'khor la me tog 'thor tshul bya/ /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /bde mchog 'khor lo 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sal 'god par shog /che ba'i che mchog ma blo kagasum/ /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur tam sogs/ 'dir ni rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden gang gis sogs/ deng 'dir rnal 'byor pa bdag cag sogs bya'o/ /sang nang par sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bzung / bdag bskyed gtso bo la bsdu ba'i bar gtong / mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'bor la chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bdud rtsis mchode/ phyag rgya dang bcas/ hūṃ badz+ra sti smra mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa nam mkhar bzhugs par bsam/ slar yang gong bzhin mchod/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor sbyang nas gzung / bkra shis kyi bar sngar bzhin bya/ grol rgyu'i nyin lta bu 'das gtor min pa gzhan rnams steng du khyer te rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas spyi stob phyag len bzhin lag tu bstar ro/ /gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga (41na〉pa/ lhag chad skong phyir 'grub na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 'bul/ tsho gis 'khor bya bar gsungs pa rgyud sde rin po che'i dgongs pa dang mthun pa zhig byung na lugs 'di la gal che bar snang mod sgrub pa po yin min la ma bltos pa'i grid pa'i gson dge lta bu'i thams cad tshogs nas longs spyod pa sogs rnam par ma dag pa'i lag len la phan yon las nyes dmigs che bar —229

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)mngon pas rdo rje 'chang e waṃ pa yab sras tshul de la dgongs te btang snyoms su 'jog pa gnang bar bden kha 'bul lo/ /gshegs gsol gyi tshe/ bstod pa'i rjes su phyi rol pa btang / nang du zhugs/mchod yon dbul/ bum pa gnyis dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i khyams g.yas g.yon du spyan drangs/ he ru spu'i yig brgya bzla zhing / rol chen dang bcas dkyil 'khor bum pa/ nang gtor dang bcas par skor ba bdun nam gsum bya/ slob dpon rdor dril 'dzin pas shar sgo'i thad du 'grengs/ slob ma rnams kyi mtha' bskor la/ bla ma dang zhes sogs 'dod gsol dang bdag las dang po pa zhes sogs bzod gsol rgyas par bya/ rdul tshon dang bum pa'i lha la dmigs te gdangs dang bcas nas/ oṃ/ /khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ sogs kyi mthar badz+ra nuḥs /bdag mdun bum gsum gyi ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la dzaḥlha nga ho gnyis su med par bsam/ lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos/ chos thams cad ni skye ba med (41ba)pa'o cho ge thamasacad ni dngos po med pa'o/ /zhes de kho na nyid kyi don dran bzhin pas thog mar bris pa'i dbang ldan gyi rtse gang nas brtsams te rdo rje'i rtses 'khor yug tu kha sno ro brjod cing bshig shar sgo nas gtso bo'i mtshan ma'i bar mas rim gyis bsdu zhing gtso bo'i mtshan ma nas spyi bor 'jog /tshon rnams las kyi rdo rjes phyags te byin rten dang don du gnyer ba yod na cung zad ster rung / rgyas par spro na rdul tshon spyan 'dren pa'i cho ga dang bcas chu bo chen por dor/ thig rjes chus bkrus te mi mngon par byed/ hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo gnyis bsnol pa'i skam pa'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra gī lā ya/ mu lwa ya/sarba bi lhan badz+ra dha ra ā dzña pa ya rta hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa lha zhes phur bu bton/ rdo rje bsdu rgyas/ phur bu'i lha rnams rang gi lag gi rdo rje la thim par bsam/ oṃ ru ru spu ru dzā la tiṣ+ṭha sirnya lo tsa na sarba a the swā dh+wa ni swā hā/ zhes dpal dang phur khung 'o mas bkru zhing khung bu dgang / bgegs thams cad kyi rma dang zug rngu thams cad zhi nas sgrib pa dag ste/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bsam/ /phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa'i shis brjod rgyas par bya zhing dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi kun me tog sil ma —230

dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lugs kyi phyi dkyil cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug 6)gcal du dgram mo/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro bye ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /dbang phyug rigs kyi khyab bdag he ru daḥ/ /dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i gsang chen las/ khres rab rgyud don snying po'i yang rtser son/ /bskyed dang rdzogs (42na)pa'i them skas la 'dzegs nas/ /zung 'jug zhing khams gshegs pa rab mang yang / /mngon sum mkha' spyod gnas byon dril bu ba/ /grub dbang yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur pa'i dpol/ /ljongs 'dir bde mchog mkhan por khas 'che ba/ /dwags shangs rnal 'byor par rloms mang na yang / /gsang mtha'i smin grol rgyud bshad 'khrul med du/ /srol 'byed sa skya'i 'jam dbyangs rim byon tsam/ thub bstan mkha' la gsal byed nyi zla bzhin/ /ma pham mgon po bu ston rin cen grub/ /brtan pa'i 'khor lo blo bzang grags pa zhes/ /ma rgyud ring lugs snang ba 'od du 'bar/ /sngon byon dam pas spel pa'i 'chad nyan gyi/ /bshad sgrub nor bu rgyal mtshan rtser 'chang ba/ /deng dus 'chal pa'i lag len 'dam rdzab tu/ /chud pas sngar gzhung phal cher dri mas sbags/ /ci phyir spyi dang zur bka'i rnam dbye bral/ /sta gon sgrub mchod med par dbang bskur byed/ /bklags lung ngang nas bum chu sbyin la brtson/ /thig tshon cho gas dben zhing gang dran 'dri/ /ras bris shar gyi lha rnams dbu mjug ldog /sgo med gru bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dbyibs can bzhengs/ /rtsam pa'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad tshom bu sogs/ /rdo rje theg pa ming tsam gyur par ltos/ /bstan rjes ma zhugs skye bos mi dge'i las//bsags kyang bshags sla cho sel nyan brten nas/ /sdig lhung lcags kyus rdo rje dmyal ba sa /'khrid pa'i blo ngan tshul la su zhig dga'/ khrag (42ba)'thung lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor 'dir 'bad mthus/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /skye bar rjes bzung nye ba'i lam bzang por thos bsam sgom pa tshul bzhin sgrub nus shog /grangs med bskal ba gsum sgug dus ring gis/ skyid lug bya dka'i spyod pa rlabs chen la/ /bltos min snyigs ma'i tshe gcig thung ngu'i yun/ kha sbyor bdun ldan sa der gom 'grod shog /bde wo gar gyi rnam rol he ru gaḥ /stong nyid snying rje'i nyams can phag mo yum/ /zung 'jug gdod nas snying dbus rdo rje sems/ /zhugs te mkha' khyab 'gro ba 'dren —231—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)gyur cig /ces dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dpa' bo'i grong 'jug 'di ni dbu mdzad blo bzang yon to gyis don gnyer — pos bskul ba'i ngor slob dpon rdo rje dril bu ba'i bzhed gzhung mal gyo lo tsā ba la brten nas sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma rdo rje 'chang dang zhal mi gnyis pa rnams dang yar ngo'i rjes su 'brangs nas gze ba blo ldan sogs kyis bkral ba'i legs bshad kyi dgongs don thams cad mkhyen pa bu'i thugs sras sgra tshad pa rin cen rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog snying po don gsal gzhir bzung ste rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po rin cen bsod nams mchog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i dkyil chog mi 'gyur bde chen dpal ster gyi phyag len gtso bor byas zha lu shar chen ye shes rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i (43na)dkyil chog bdud rtsi'i char rgyun dang rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen pos mdzad pa'i lus dkyil rin cen bang mdzod lha i pa'i mchod phreng rnams nas legs cha blangs te rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub sogs yongs 'dzin dam pa chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bor bsten pa'i bka' drin gyis rdo rje theg pa'i chos tshul la smra ba'i spobs pa cung zad rnyed pa za hor gyi ban+de 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis kun dga' zhes pa shing stag dbyu gu zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba gsum pa'i tshes la rang byung 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi zhing khams dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa sa blo dwa wa ṣ+ṭha bha wan+tu/ /maṅga le//—232

nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi lag len la sgro 'dogs gcod tshul/ 6)nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi lag len la sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang sems 'dzin bzung 'brel du gtong tshul mthong grol lde mig bzhugs/su sti sirnyi/ mkha' spyod zhing gi rdo rje btsun mo yi/ /nye lam nā ro sta pa'i thugs kyi bcud/ /'jam mgon sa skya'i bla chen gser chos mchogo /slob bshad 'dzin mkhas rim brgyud gsang ba'i gtam//gnad 'gag sgro 'dogs bcad nas snying po sa /don bzang nyams su bstar byed grol lam khrid/ /rtogasadaka'i mtsho las sgrol nus phyag bzhes grus/ /dam pa'i bzhed srol nor bu 'di na 'dren/ /de la 'dir bde bar gshegs pas gsungs pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag gi mchog tu gyur pa nges gsang rdo rje theg pa'i yang rtse rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde'i nang nas shin tu zab pa rnal 'byor gsang mtha' 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud kyi bcud phyung ba rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi lam zab mo rje btsun rdo rje btsun mo nyid kyi 'phags yul paṇa grub kun gyi gtsug rgyan nā ro ta pa la dngos su gnang / des kyang 'phags bod kyi slob ma grags chen gzhan su la'ang ma stsal bar bal po pham mthing ba gcen 'jigs med grags pa dang gcung ngag dbang grags pa mched gnyis la chig brgyud du gnang ba rje btsun sa skya pa chen por bka' babs pas lcags ri mi 'da' ba'i gser chos bcu gsum mam klu pa'i gser chos (2na)bcu bzhir grags pa'i nang tshan nas mchog sgrub kyi man ngag shin tu zab pa nā ro mkha' spyod kyi skor zhes grags che bas/ thos lo'i ming tsam don du gnyer ba'i dbang dang byin rlabs dbye ba mi phyed par rang bzo'i sis ra'i byin rlabs dang yig rnying gi lung kha yar dge zhal bo jo dwags shangs phyogs su'ang thor bu byung / sa skya'i rjes 'brang gong dkar ba phyogs la gsan yig rgya mtshor byin rlabs gsan tshul 'dug kyang deng sang dar so med/ rdzong chung bar lung rgyun tsam las byin —233

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)rlabs khrid dang chag med kyi rgyun phyis rim gyis nub/ ngor pa rnams la thun mong ba'i khrid ma chad tsam mus phyogs su yod par grags rgyu mtshan de dag la brten gdams pa yongs su rdzogs pa tshad ma bzhi ldan tshad med kha'u brag rdzong pa'i lugs 'dzin rnams las gzhan du med par snang bas gdung brgyud rim pa dang yar klungs pa khu dbon las snyan nas snyan dang zhal nas zhal du brgyud pa'i mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs can rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje'i gsung rgyun thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis reg zig tu mdzad pa'i khrid yig chen mo 'dir/ bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs gcod pa bskyed rim gyi bya ba dang bcad don nyams su len pa sems 'dzin gyi bya ba gnyis zung (2ba〉khrel du mdzad pa'i dbang du btang zhing / gsang 'dus bde mchog 'jigs byed sogs la'ang 'di dang dbyibs 'dra rung byung na ding sang 'khrid rkyang las rnam bshad gtong ba'i rgyun phal cher nub/lugs srol 'dir gdul bya dbang po rab 'bring yan la zung 'brel du gnang ba'i phyag srol ma nub cing / /mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig tu khrid rkyang gi tshul du mdzad 'dug pa dus kyi dbang gis mi rnams blo'i mthu yin pas lam 'di la mos shing dbang po rtul ba'i rigs rjes su 'dzin par dgongs pa chos rgyun spel mi nus pa'i nyams len tsam byed pa la des skabs don nges par yang 'grub/ rjes 'brangs su rlom pa la las sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang bcad don nyams len gnyis ngos ma zin pa'i 'dra 'dres sna tshogs kyis phyag len 'chal ba'ang byung tshod du snang ba de 'dra'i nyes pa khegs shing 'chad nyan gyi rgyun la phan pa'i ched du rnam bshad dang sems 'dzin zung 'jug ma 'dres par gtong ba'i phyag len la/ spyir dwags brgyud pa sogs rtsing por spyod pa mang po byin rlabs kyis dbang go gcod pa sdom gsum du/ rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs ni/ /mar pa lho brag pa la med/ ces lo paṇa yongs grags rnams kyi dbang go byin rlabs kyis gcod pa med par gsung shing de dang phyogs mthun par thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che dang rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa sogs tshad ldan gyi mkhas grub thams cad bzhed pa yin la/ khyad par lugs srol —234

nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi lag len la sgro 'dogs gcod tshul/ the)'di la sa skya'i 'jam mgon rjes 'brang rnams kyi phyag bzhes su sngon 'gro 'khor lo sdom pa lo nag dril gsum lta bu yab bka' yum bka' gang rung gi rdul tshon dang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor ci rigs par dbang bzhi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa thob pa/ gal te bde mchog (3na〉she rigs kyi dbang ma thob kyang kye rdor bka' babs bzhi sogs mdor na bde dgyes kyi rigs gang yang rung ba'i dbang thob pa'i snod ldan rnams la thog mar rgyun 'byer gyi mngon rtogs 'dzin du bcug /yang ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu gang rung dang 'brel na/ de min dus gang yang rung bar ri ra'i dkyil 'khor du rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam gyi yi ge'i steng nas phyag len 'khrul pa med pa'i byin rlabs bya/ de nas bzung rgyun 'khyer gyi nyams len dang bcas dam bca' gang byas kyi oṃ gsum ma chag med du bzla/ 'di pa'i gdul bya dbang po rab 'bring tha ma tha ma'i tha ma ste bzhir bshad pa thams cad kyi thun mong du nyams su blang bya/ rje brtse ba chen pos nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myang / /chad med bla ma bdag lhar bsgom/ /'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs/ /ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin/ /bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor dang / /spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te/ /de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go /zhes pa 'di nyid 'chad pa la sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang / sems 'dzin gnyis ka byung zhing / dngos bstan 'di la sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i rtsa ba byas/ bcad don nyams len la go bde sdoms tshig tu byed na/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum dang po la/ /thun mong thun mong min pa'i thun mong bar/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' ma rtag las 'brasadang / /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs thun mong ma yin par/ /skyabs sems rdor sems bla ma'i rnal 'byor khrid/ /dngos gzhir bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi bskyed pa'i skabs/ /bya ba byed can gnyis las phyi ma'i grangs/ /nga rgyal rnam pa gnyis kyi rnam pa la/ /(3ba〉skye dang bye brag lus dkyil sems 'dzin pa/ /rdzogs pa'i rim par gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum/ /gnyis pa mchog nyid dngos dang brgyud nas ston/ /phyi mar chags can chags bral rnam pa gnyis/ /chags bral rlung sems dbu mar bsdu bsgom zung / /—235

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)bsgom par bde ba dang ni stong pa bsgrub/ /gsum pa gos bu yan lag bdun ldan thob/ /bsam mi khyab bya mjug sdud tshar chos ston/ /zhes go bde bar brjod nas mthun mong ba'i sngon 'gro gsung ngag dang blo sbyong sogs zhu myong na btang snyoms su bzhag /dmigs rkang dang po rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyal ba/ldang ba/ bdud rtsi myang ba gsum la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad nas bcad ngor nyams su len pa'i sngon 'gro'i sa bcad bzhi po blangs te skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed kyi dmigs pa gtong / nyal ldang bdud rtsi gsum gyi dmigs pa 'ang de ga'i dus su nyams su len dgos pas nyan chos can gyis mi chog cing des mtshon rnam bshad kyi go don so so'i dmigs pa gang byung gi tshe nyams su len dgos/nub gnyis par tshad med pa'i rnal 'byor gyi skyabs 'gro la sgro 'dogs bcad nas rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyi sems 'dzin gtong / khrid ma grol bar thun bzhi nges par dgos shing dmigs rkang sngon ma tsho ma chag pa'i steng gsar ba la nan tan gyis sgom/ /nub gsum par bla ma'i rnal 'byor la sgro 'dogs bcad nas maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid du grags pa gnyis bral 'chad dus kyi zhal shes dang po dang gnyis pa'i sems 'dzin gtong / bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong de thob nyin thun gcig tsam las star chags su bsgom mi dgos/ /nub bzhi par mthar thug gi sbyang gzhi ngos bzung ste gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro ma dbang du 'dus par brten lhan skyes kyi rnal 'byor mas byin gyis brlabs pas rtogs pa nang nas 'char tshul la sgro 'dogs (4na)bcad nas bcad don mngon rtogs rgyun 'khyer tshig zin ltar bshar nas bzlas pa dam bca'i grangs dang mthun pa chag med dgos tshul yid bzlas zhar byung rdzogs rim rnams kyi ngo grangs tsam byas nas nga rgyal gyi sems 'dzin gtong / 'di nas bzung thun mthar bsam mi khyab thun mong ba'i mthug sdud re'ang mdzad/ /nub lnga par skye shi bar do gsum sbyong ba dang bdag gi gzhi sbyang bar sgro 'dogs bcad nas rnam pa spyi'i sems 'dzin gtong / /nub drug par gzhi bsgyur ba'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'i mtshon don yan la sgro 'dogs bcad nas spyan dbus ma'i sems 'dzin gtong / /nub bdun par dbu skra nas dga' ba bcu drug rgyas tshul yan la sgro 'dogs bcad —236

nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rnal 'byor brgya gcig gi lag len la sgro 'dogs gcod tshul/ 6)pa'i spyan g.yas g.yon nas zhal gyi bar gyi sems 'dzin gtong / /nub brgyad par rigs bdag dang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus tshul la sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i mgul pa nas nu 'bur bar gyi sems 'dzin gtong / /nub dgu par 'gro ba dag pa dang dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs par sgro 'dogs bcad nas phyag gnyis kyi sems 'dzin gtong / /nub bcu par pho nya gsum bsre dang go cha bcing pa gnyis la sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i rked pa nas zhabs kyi bar gyi sems 'dzin gtong / /pho nya gsum bsre 'di la tshogs bshad pa rnams la ma grags pa'i lus dkyil gyi man ngag yod pa slob ma gcig gam snod dang ldan nges gsum las mi mang bar gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang bcas ster ba las khrom tshogs su mi mdzad pas dus der mang ma grol nas gnang ngam slar khrid rdzogs pa'i rjes la btang kyang chog /nub bcu gcig par ngag bzlas dang yid bzlas gnyis la sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i thod skam nas (4bsgo gul rgyan gyi bar gyi sems 'dzin gtong / /nub bcu gnyis par zhar byung rdzogs rim dang por sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i dpung rgyan nas ye shes kyi me dpung gi bar gyi sems 'dzin gtong / /nub bcu gsum par zhar byung rdzogs rim gnyis par sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i lus dkyil gyi gtso mo'i spyan dbus ma'i sems 'dzin gtong / zhan byung 'di gnyis la tshig mang ba med kyang de nub nas bzung yid bzlas kyi mjug tu dmigs pa nan tan bsgom dgos pas rnam bshad kyang tshar gsum tsam mdzad/ zhub bcu bzhi par spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la sgro 'dogs bcad nas spyan gnyis nas zhal gyi bar gyi sems 'dzin gtong / zhub bco lnga par kha zas nas sbyin sreg gi bar la sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i mgul nas zhabs kyi bar gyi sems won gtong / zhub brgya drug par tshes bcu dang gtor mar sgro 'dogs bcad nas rgyan cha lugs kyi sems 'dzin gtong / /nub bcu bdun par gang zag dbang po rab kyi grol tshul la sgro 'dogs bcad nas 'khor gyi lha so drug gi spyan dbus ma'i sems 'dzin gtong / /nub bco brgyad par gang zag dbang po 'bring sis ra'i sgrub par sgro 'dogasabacad nas spyan gnyis nas zhabs kyi bar gyi sems 'dzin gtong / /nub bcu dgu par gang zag dbang po —237

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)tha ma 'chi khar rnal 'byor mas rjes su 'dzin pa dang myur ba 'pho ba'i phan yon 'chi ltas bzlog thabasasogs la sgro 'dogs bcad nas rgyan gyi sems 'dzin gtong / /'pho ba yod tshul tsam gsungs pa lasadamigs pa mang po la mi 'dzad don gnyer can re gnyis la skabs 'dir mi ston par rdzogs rim gyi 'ja' lus bsgrub pa'i mjug tu gnang zhing (5na〉de yang dus gcig la yab yum gang rung gi 'pho dmigs gcig phab nas cig shos slar mdzad/ 'dir khrid bsgom mkhan gcig gam mang mtha'ang gsum tsam gyi dbang du byas nas lus dkyil gyi sems 'dzin bkod pa yin gyi/ khrid bsgom mkhan mang po yod na lus dkyil khrom chos su mi gtong ba'i stabs sems 'dzin bdun po'i tshab la dngos gzhi'i sems 'dzin rnams phral nas zhib tu gtong ngam yang sems 'dzin bdun du bcad nas nyi ma gnyis la thun gcig po de ga bldabs pa'i gtong lugs skabs thob sbyar/ 'di mi gsum tshun la zhag nyer lnga dang de las mang bar zhag nyer gsum tsam la grub pa'i 'bring po'i dbang du byas kyi sems 'dzin la gnad du bsnun pa'i zla lhag tsam byed na sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i bshad pa'ang cung zad nyung du btang nas grangs mang du spel/ bsdus pa zhag bcu gsum tsam la sgrub pa byed na sgro 'dogs gcod pa'ang dkyus ring du byas nas sems 'dzin dang lhan du rdzogs pa byed/ rdzogs rim la sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang sems 'dzin zhes nyis sbrags su gtong rgyu med pas khrid gzhung bzhin/nub nyi shu pa rlung sems dbu mar bsdu ba/ nub nyer gcig pa rlung lus la gnas pas bde ba bsgrub pa/ /nub nyer gnyis pa rlung sems la zhugs pas 'ja' lus bsgrub pa/ nub nyer gsum pa 'pho ba/nub nyer bzhi pa zhal shes gsum pa thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang bcas chig brgyud las snod ldan gnyis gsum la ston kyang re re nas ston pa las lhan cig tu ye mi gnang /nub nyer lnga pa phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa sogs la brten nas 'bras bu grub pa dang tshar chos rgyun gyi nyams len (5ba)snying po la dril tshul bstan pa yin/ chos nyid dngos su ston pa rje btsun yab dang thun mong ba'i rtsa dbu ma'i skabs su yod pa yongs grags kyi khrid 'di la par bkab mi mdzad cing —238

nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi lag len la sgro 'dogs gcod tshul/ 6)brgyud 'debs su/ lte ba'i pa khror rlung lnga'i ti la ka zhes sogs kyi dgongs don gyi nyams khrid kyang rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa dang kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i yi ge la bltos dgos pas sa skya tshang kyi rna bar ma grags pa yin/ chags can pho nya'i lam ni ding sang dngos su mi mdzad kyang / 'bras bu thob pa'i skabs las rgyal bltos dgos tshul zur tsam bstan no/ /dbang po rab 'bring lus 'dis mkha' spyod bgrod/ /tha ma bar dor dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bsu/ /ches myur 'da' kha'i lam gyis skad cig 'pho/ /yang tha skye ba brgyud nas dngos grub 'thob/ /a ho ma dang mkha' 'gro'i zhal gyi rlangs/ /mngar po 'thul 'di nā ro ta pa nas/ /snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan 'dzin nus pa'i/ /mkhas dang grub par brgyud kyi gzhan du min/ /'di don nyams su blangs na gnas skabs dang / /mthar thug don chen 'grub par nges rnyed kyang / /gal chung chos su byed pa bdag 'dra la/ /skyed bu gser du song ba'i dbul po bzhin/ /tshe 'di bde sdug re dogs rmi lam tsam/ /'khor ba'i ngang tshul bsams na snying rlung ldang / /de bas chos brgyad zing long rgyab bskyur nas/ /gtan 'dun sgrub pa'i rus pa snying la bcug /mtshan nyid kun ldan rdo rje'i slob dpon bsten/ /dbang khrid zab mo'i gnad la sgro 'dogs bcad/ /chag med bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug rnal 'byor gyis/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor stong par ma (6na) log tsam/ /rang gi dran pa gso dang skal mnyam 'gar/ /phan 'dod lhag pa'i bsam pas nyer drangs nas//bkod pa'i dge 'dis gsang chen slob bshad kyi/ /bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams len la sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang sems 'dzin zung 'brel du gtong tshul mthong grol lde mig ces pa 'di yang rang nyid kyi brjed byang du 'bri 'dun yod pa'i steng rigs kun bdag po mkhan chen zha lu pa rin chen bsod nams mchog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bstan rgyun la phan pa 'dug tshul gyi legs so gnang bar brten/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa'i dpal ldan bla ma rnam gsum gyi bka' drin la brten nas chos tshul 'di la blo mig yangs pa'i slob bshad pa za hor gyi brnyes lcags phag —239
ṭ+wāṃ ༵

lam zab nang ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor mtho ris dbang gi chu bo/ (thanalam zab nang ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor mtho ris dbang gi chu 21 zhes bya ba bsdo kyigs/bdag med mkha' 'gro'i zhal gyi tsha drod rlangs/ /dpal ldan chos skyong gdams pa nying khu'i bcud/ /sa skya'i bla chen thugs kyi bum bzang du/ /legs su la lam zab nang ma'i rgyun khyer spel/ /de'ang bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya par lcags ri mi 'da' ba'i gser chos bzhi dang bcu gsum sogs mang du bzhugs pa'i gser chos bzhi'i nang tshan lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor lus dkyil dang 'brel ba nyams su bstar bar/ bde ba'i stan la lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas tshig dmigs pa bstun nas/ 'di ga sger du nyams su len na skyabs 'gro dmigs pa dang bcas pa lam dus dang 'dra zhing / slob bshad pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes su lam dus dang sbrel nas mdzad pas rdor sems song mtshams 'di ga'i sgos kyi semasabaskyed nas 'go brtsams pa yin/ bdag gis nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ga'i go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i phyir du lam zab nang ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i rim pa la 'jug par bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ rang skad cig gis (2na)kye rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas dpal he gdan gsum tshang ba ru ka dang bla rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma kun 'dus ma tha mi dad pa mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru ṣ+ṭhaḥ na ma yī he ru ke saḥs phyag bya/ phyi mchod ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams na mchod rdzas su 'os pa yod do cog phung por sbungs shing 'khor bar skye ba'i gzhi rgyu nyen mongs dug gsum yin pas gti mug skye ba'i yul btang snyems pa'i 'gro ba thams cad yod par mos/ 'jig rten gyi khams na lha dang mi la sogs pa bdag pos yongs su bzung ba dang ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i yo byad ci mchis pa dang bar ma'i sems can thams cad rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo bdag gti mug —241 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)dang bral bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gsum brjod/ sngon las4la rkyen dbang gis dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas gnod pa byas pa la brten zhe sdang skye ba'i yul thams cad bsam/ bdag la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs gdon thams cad rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul la/ /bdag zhe sdang dang bral bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol lan gsum/ (2ba thad ga gi dngos brgyud du ma'i sgo nasaphan bas pa dang lasakyi dbang gis yid du 'ong ga 'dod chags skye ba'i yul gyi sems༅ thams go bsam/ lha dang gnyen grogs 'khor 'bangs thams cad rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /bdag 'dod chags dang bral bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gsum brjod/ bdag gi sngar rang dang rgyud tha dad pa'i gang zag gi dngos po rnams phul zin kyang rang nyid dbang ba'i bdog pa mchod rdzas su 'os pa mtha' dag ser sna med par mdun du spungs par bsam/longs spyod kyi dngos po thams cad rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /bdag ser sna dang bral bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol gsum/ nang gi 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ma rig pa'i dbang gis bdag tu 'dzin pas mchod pa ni/ mdun du blos 'byud sgo pa skad cig gis grub bar mo thod pa'i skyed bu gsum gyi steng du lag pa g.yas pa'i ral ye shes kyi ral gri rno ngar can lam gyi byung bar mos gyis rang gi thod phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yang shing rgya che nga pa bcad smin 4 mos kyi thad du reg tsas mo/ /de snyed bu'i steng du dpral ba rang la bstan nasabakal ba'i nang du ral gris rkang mgo rkang ngar brla'i bar rim pa bzhin du bcad de bskyur ba lag pa la'ang 'gre g.yas g.yon lag pa g.yon pa/ mgo bo'i lhag ma ro smad ro so sor nang cha dang cas pa stod sogs lus kyi cha shas rnams bcad nas du ma bur btonas4 ling bsgyur bar6bskyur ba'i steng du lag pa g.yas ral gri dang bcasapa'ang 'phangs/ rang rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i kye rdor zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug sa dang gdan sogs ma' rtog ji lta g.yum bcas su gyur par bsam/ phyag rgya dang bcas (3na ti oṃ āḥ/ ha ho gyirgyas par spro na nang mar ltar byin gyis bsas/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ gdan snying nas spros pa'i mgo pa'i lha mo rin po tsho tso can zhig gis thod pa'i nang gi rdzas bod rtsi kha dog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs sa pa dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa ka pā la zhig gas bcus nas phul bas thugs rgyud bde bas tshim bdag la bde chen ye shes lhan skyes me shes stsal —242

lam zab nang ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor mtho ris dbang gi chu bo/ 6)bar bsam mchod lha rnams snying gar bsdu zhing thod pa gdan bcas 'ja' ltar yal bar bsgom/ gsum tshang ba'i bdag nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/rang gi snying ga nas rig ma pad+ma can dang dung can ma sogs mtshan ldan gyi rig ma snyan pa'i glu len cing bde ba'i gar byed pa du ma gcig la gcig thim pa mthar rdo rje bdag med ma la bstim yid du 'ong ba cig sprabs te yum la thim pas he ru ka yab yum snyom 'jug gi bde bas mnyes shing tshim par bsam/ de kho na nyid kyi mchode pa ni/ mchod thamasacad sems kyi rnam 'phrul sems kyang skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba gsal stong zung 'jug spros bral du thag gcad sdo/la mchod mkhan mchod tshul thams cad gang du'ang ma grub pa 'dzin med du bsam/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs sogs kyis slar yang snying ga nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis cho ga dang bstun nas mchod cing bstod nas mchod lha rnams snying gar bsdu bstod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma gzhir gnas rten dkyil 'khor bzhi la dbang bzhi bskur nas 'bras bu sku bzhi'i rten 'brel phyin ci ma log par bsgrigs nas bdag rgyud la yon tan skyed par mdzad pa yin snyam pa'i bcos min gyi mos gus drag po byed dang dpal he ru ka dbyer ma mchis pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag rgyud byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ /(3ba tshe tshes lan nyer gcig bdun gsum sogs skabs sbyar gyis gsol ba drag tu btab pas bla ma he ru ka de nyid 'od du zhu/ rang gi smin mtshams nas thim pa'i rkyen gyis skad cig gis rang gi lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje zhes pa nas bzung ste snying po ye shes rlung ngo bo nyid kyi sku zhes pa'i bar sems pa chen pos mdzad pa'i lam dus kyi lus dkyil sor bzhag la/ de nas te lus rang bzhin du grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur ces pa btags nas brjod cing bsgom/ de ltar bya rang lus dpal kye rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa nang zab mo lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa mngon sum lta bur gsal ba'i sbyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ de nas rim pa bzhin du 'jam gon ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug khri chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags/—243

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)kun mkhyen klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ rje btsun kun spangs chen po/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa/ khyab bdag kun dga' bzang po/ grub chen burnya shrī/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ tsho gis sgom kun dga' dpal/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇa chen/ rje btsun rin po che/ slob dpon rin po che/ dpal brtse ba rin po che/ rnal 'byor (4na te bang phyug birlu pa/ de'i dbu gtsug tu sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang ste brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kye zhal brgyad phyag bas drug pa so so'i sku la lus dkyil gyi rten brten pa thams cad gsal ba mtho brtsegs kyi tshul du reg pa ma 'byar ba'i tshul du bzhugs par gsal 'debs rdo rje yum bcas lus dkyil dang bcas pa'i rnam par bsam/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan bdun nam gsum la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pas gsol ba btab pas bla ma so so'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems kho rang dpa' bo mkha 'gro chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs 'od zer 'ja' tshon lta bu'i rnam par bkug pa bla ma so sor cha tshang ba re thim par mos skyabs yul thams cad kyi byin brlabs bsdus rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la thim par bsam/ de nas rdo rje 'chang kye rdo rje yum bdag med ma dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas birnya pa'i dbu gtsug tu thim/ de bzhin du rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gong ma gong ma 'og ma 'og ma la thim par bsam/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag la dbang dang dngos grub zab mo stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas rtsa ba'i bla ma yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems rang gi spyi bo nas babs pa bde chen 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams la bla ma'i sku'i byin mas rang gi lus la bzhugs thim pas gsal rnam snang dang 'dab ma'i lha mo so gnyis nan tan du gsal 'debs/ des mtsho ni rtsa 'khor 'og ma'i skabs rnams kyang rags 'gre bar byas pa bum dbang / bum dbang gi bum dbang (ldan)rlung ro dgu phrugs su phud/ bum pa can 'dzin pas bum dbang gi gsang dbang gsang dbang smin mtshams yan chad 'dir ma zad rtsa —244

lam zab nang ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor mtho ris dbang gi chu bo/ 6)'khor 'og ma rnams kyi skabs su'ang byang sems dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa bsgom byang sems kyis gang bum dbang gi sher dbang bshes dbang / spyi bo'i gnas su bde drod 'bar bas yul snang stong gi ting 'dzin rtsal/mos sprul skugs su shar ba dga' ba'i ye shes dbang bzhi pa'i bum dbang gi rdzo dbang lam mngon du byas pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag bum dbang thob lus rtsa gnas gyur 'bras bu sprul sku thob par bsam rlung ma thugan dal bus ga sto ba'og cha yang wa/ bla ma yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas byung ba'i byang spyi bonas6 bsto rgyud pa 'og tshor 'dra sems longs spyod 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams la thim pas gsal bar byas pa bum dbang gsang dbang gi bum dbang / bum pa can 'dzin pa gsang dbang gsang dbang gi gsang dbang / mgrin pa yan chad byang sems kyis gang ba sher gsang dbang gi sher dbang dbang / 'dzin gdangs 'gag med du shar ba mchog dga'i gsang dbang gi tshig dbang ye shes dbang bzhi pa'i lam mngon du byas pas ngag gi sgrib pa dgagasang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag yi ge gnas gyur/ 'bras bu longs sku thob par bsam/ bla ma yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas byung ba'i byang sems chos kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams la thim pas gsal bar byas pa bum dbang sher dbang gi bum dbang bum pa can 'dzin pa gsang sherd gig4dang dbang /(ldan〉steng ga yan chad byang sems kyis gang ba sher dbang / sher dang gi sher dbang / snying gar bde drod 'bar bas lus bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin gshis cir yang ma grub pa dga' bral gyi dga' ba'i ye shes dbang bzhi pa'i lam mngon du byas pas yid kyi sgrib pa dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/yid bdud rtsi gnas 'gyur/ 'bras bu chos sku thob par bsam/ bla ma yab yum bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin byang chub kyi sems su nub sprul pa'i 'khor lo dang bde skyong gi 'khor lo mig tu gti mug rdo rje la sogs dbang po dang yan lag gi lag g.yas par gzhin rje gshed so gos lha rnam ba(la thim pabs gsal bar byab/pa bum dbang mig dbang gi bum dmu / bum pa can 'dzin pa gsang rig da4gi g.yod mu dbang / lte ba yan chad byang sems kyis gang ba sher rdzo dbang gi sher dbang dbang / lte gsang gnyis su bde drod 'bar bas bde stong mchog bde stong shin tu rnam dag kyang zer ting nge 'dzin bsgom bya/ sgom byed dang bral bas lhan skyes—243—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)kyi ye shes dbang gzhi pa'i lam mngon du byas pa la/ sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa dag dbang bzhi pa thob/lus ngag yid gsum bya byed dang bcas pa rlung gnas gyur/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob par bsam/spros bral gyi ngang du ci nus su mnyam par bzhag /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / zhes sogs smon lam ci rigs pa'i rgyas gdab bo/ /grub dbang 'khor los sgyur ba bi ྅ pas/ /rdor 'dzin bye ba'i gtsug rgyan brtse ba cher/ /legs gdams bla med rgyud sde'i snying po'i bcud/ /(5ba/sprum zab nang ma'i nyams len mthar thug 'di/ /mkhyen rtogs ma dros mtsho chen 'khyil ba las/ /snyan brgyud tshad ma'i chu bo bzhi 'bab pa/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal/ /brgyud par bcas pa'i ba ched srol ji bzhin bkod/ /dge 'dis slob bshad chos kyi nyi ma yis/ /blo gsal rnam dpyod 'dab stong yongs bzhad pa'i/ /legs bshad bcud kyis skal bzang bung ba rnams/ /ci dgar myos pa'i snyan brgyud glur len shog /ces lam zab mtho ris dbang gi chu bo 'di yang rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag zha lu mkhan chen tshe dbang lhun grub rab brtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ lam zab nang ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'khyer bde ba zhig bris shig ces bkas bskul ba dang du blas te/ dpal ldan bla ma khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po grub mtha' stogs te mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i dus dran gyi chos la gsang chen slob bshad 'dzin pa za hor gyi brnyes mkhas grub du ma'i yi ge dang phyag len gsung sgros la brten nas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa ngag dbang nam mkha'o// sarba maṅga lo// //—246

lam zab phyi ma'i nyams len gnad sgril 'jug bde/ (thanalam zab phyi ma'i nyams len gnad sgril 'i5rgyag bde bzhugs/su sti bra dzā saḥ bdag med rdo rje btsun mo'i zhal gyi drod/ /ma yal bdud rtsis myos pa'i bi rū pa'i/ /gser chos lam zab sa skya'i bla chen las/ /nyer brgyud gnad sgril nyams len 'jug bde spro//de yang bde ba'i stan la lus gnad dang ldan pas skyabs 'gro spyi ltar bya/ bdag gis nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ga'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i rim pa la 'jug par bgyi 'os sems bskyed/ dngos gzhi ni su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zlo zhu ba las byung ba'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang rgyan la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus/ seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma bcom ldan 'das kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug /zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ (2na yas dkar/ g.yon dmar ba/ steng zhal du ba'i mdog can/ /zhal lhag ma gnyisaganyis nag pa/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa'i rtsa zhal gyi spyi bor sna tsho gos rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i/ g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha ser po/ de gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang dmar po/ lnga pa na rnga mo thal kha/ drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na sha ra bha sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi la gā pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/ bzhi pa na rlung gi lha —247

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)ljang gu /lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/brgyad pa na nor sbyin ser po/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan cing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas (2ba)gnyis brkyang ba'i brla la/ g.yon gnyas bskum pa'i sor mo gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing / sgeg pa la sogs pa'i gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa/ de'i pang du yum rdo rje bdag med ma sngon mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug nam mkhar brkyang ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / g.yon pas bdud mtha' dag gi khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam bo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabasagayon brkyang zhing g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khril ba/ bde stong zung 'jug gi rang bzhin yab yum gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bla ma he ru ka de nyid kyi gnas gsum du pad nyi'i gdan la/ oṃ āḥlha dkar dmar mthing kha'i mdangs can/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin 'od dang gzi brjid 'bar bar bsam/ gzhan yang bla ma'i gzugs kyi phung bo rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor ba rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'du shes 'od dpag med/ 'du byed don yod grub pa/ rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa/ thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po/ sa'i khams sangs rgyas spyan ma/ chu mā ma gi /me gos dkar mo/ rlung sgrol ma/ nam mkha'i khamasachos kyi dbang phyug ma/ spyan byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po/ snyan phyag na rdo rje/ shangs nam mkha'i snying po/ ljags 'jig rten dbang phyug /lus sgrib pa rnam sel/ yid 'phags pa 'jam dpal/tshig kun tu bzang po/ rtsa rgyus byams pa/ phyag ngar g.yas pa gshin rje gshed/ g.yon pa (3na po zhan gyis mi thub pa/ zhal rta mgrin/ rdo rje bdud rtsi thal sbyor/ dpung pa g.yas pa mi g.yo ba/ g.yon pa 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ /pus mo g.yas pa dbyug sngon can/ g.yon pa stobs po che/ spyi gtsug 'khor lo sgyur ba/ zhabs mthil gnyis gnod mdzes rgyal po/ /gzhan gzung bya'i yul gzugs sgra sogs ni/—248

lam zab phyi ma'i nyams len gnad sgril 'jug bde/ (thadasags rdo rje/ sgra rdo rje/ dri rdo rje/ ro rdo rje/ reg rdo rje/ chos kyi dbyings rdo rje ma ste/ gdan gsum sgo ba'i lha'i bdag nyid du bzhugs par gyur/ de nas rje btsun bla ma de'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas brgyud pa'i bla ma/ rgyud sdo bzhi'i lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems/nyan rang / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/de yang rdo rje 'chang dbu gtsug /g.yas su birnya pa nas grub chen burnya shrī'i bar/ g.yon du bdag med ma nas rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi bar mtho brtsegs kyi tshul rgyab tu sde bzhi'i lha tshogs dang byang sems/ de'i rgyab tu sprul sku'i cha lugs can gyi sangs rgyas nyan rang / de'i rgyab tu dpal mgon lcam dral sogs chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs par bsam/ gang drin mas bstod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa gsum bdun nyer gcig sogs skabs dang sbyar/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de bzhin du rdo rje bdag med ma/ dpal ldan birnya pa/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rjes sa skya paṇ+ḍita/ tshogasasgom (3ba)kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bu d+dha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ musachen 'khor lo sdom pa/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / rje btsun rdo ring ba chen po/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ khyab bdag rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ ces so so'i mtshan bcug nas gsol ba gdab/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag gi blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/chos lam du longs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lam la 'byul pa sel bar byin gyis brlab tu —249

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)gsol/ lam gyi bar chad zhi bar byin gyi rlabs tu gsol/ chos min gyi bsam pa skad cig kyang mi skye bar byin gyis byin gyi rlabs tu gsol/ byams dang snying rje 'byongs par byin byin gyi rlabs tu gsol/ci snang sems su rtogs par byin byin gyi rlabs tu gsol/ sems snang sgyu mar rtogs par byin gyi rlabs tu gsol/ gnas lugs brjod bral rtogs par byin gyi rlabs tu gsol/ mdor na mkha' mnyam sems can kun gyi don du zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu btab/ 'jig rten gyi khams na lha dang mi la sogs pa bdag pos yongs su bzung ba dang ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i yo byad ci mchis pa bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ bdag nyid kyis bdag tu bzung ba'i bdog pa'i dngos por mchis pa thams cad (4na)kyang bltos pa med par 'bul lo/ /dgra gnyen bar ma'i 'gro ba 'di dag kyang bka'i bran dang 'bangs kyi phyir du 'bul/ zhes brjod/ mdun du thod pa'i skyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ lag pa g.yas par ye shes kyi ral gri zhig byung bas rang gi thod pa bcad pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba de dpral ba rang la bstan nas skyed bu'i steng du bkal bar bsam/ de nas rkang pa g.yas g.yon/ lag g.yon ro smad ro stod rnams rim gyis gtubs nas ling ling bskyur ba'i mthar lag pa g.yas pa ral gri dang bcas pa brgyangs te 'phangs pas thod pa gang bar bsam/ rang rlung semasatsam las grub pa'i kye rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yum bcas kyi skur bsgoms nas/ oṃ āḥ& nya ho saḥs rdzas de dag bdud rtsi kha dog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa/ 'khor 'das kyi mgron thams cad tshim par byed pa'i nus mthu dang ldan par bsam/dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams kyis/ bdag gis mngone par bshams pa'i mchod pa rgya chen po 'di bzhes su gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo rin po che rgyan gyis spras pa zhig spros nas/ thod pasabadud rtsi bcus te/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥ/ zhes phul bas zag med kyi —250

lam zab phyi ma'i nyams len gnad sgril 'jug bde/ the)bde bas tshim zhing dgyes/ bdag la bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes da lta nyid du stsol bar bsam/mchod lha rnams snying gar bsdu ba 'og tshor 'gre/ yang lha mo dpag tu med pa spros/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥ// zhes phul bas zag (4ba〉sted kyi bde bas tshim nyid dgyes/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi dngos grub da lta nyid du stsol bar bsam/ yang spros/ rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs byang sems dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥlha zhes phul bas zag med kyi bde bas tshim zhing dgyes/mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub da lta nyid du stsol bar bsam/ yang spros/ sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku nyan rang 'khor dang bcas pa'i phyag tu phul bas rdzas de dag so so la mkho ba'i yo byad chos gos lhung bzed/ 'khar gsil/ po ti sogs su gyur par longs spyad pas mnyes/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub da lta nyid du stsol bar bsam/ yang spros/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma la sogs pa las bzhi sgrub mdzad kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ zhes phul bas zag med kyi bde bas tshim zhing dgyes/ 'phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med du sgrub par bsam/ yang spros/ rigasadrug gis bsdus pa'i sems can rnams la phul bas/ de dag gi lus la reg pa dang lce thog tu myang ba tsam gyis sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa dag /stong pa nyid dang snying rje gnyis su med pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skyes/ lus he ru ka phyag bcu drug pa'i rnam par gyur nas dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/lha mo rnams snying gar thim par bsam/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag la dbang dang dngos grub zab mo stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab pas/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin oṃ yig 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs dang bcas pa byung / rang gi dpral (na thar thim pas lus thams cad gang bas lus kyi dri ma thams cad dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i dngos spub stsal/ mgrin pa'i āḥdang yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas gsung rdo rje'i bdag nyid byang sems bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin āḥyig 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs dang bcas pa byung / rang gi mgrin par thim/ lus thams cad 251 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)gang bsang ga gi dri ma dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi dngos grub stsal/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin hūṃ yig 'od zer sngon po'i tshogs dang bcas pa byon/ snying gar thim/ lus thams cad gang bas yid kyi dri ma dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/thugs kyi dngos grub stsal/ slar yang yi ge gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'ja' 'od kyi rnam pa can 'phros/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim lus thams cad gang bas sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag /dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal bar bsam/ de nas chos skyong sogs phyi ma rnams nang ma nang ma la rim gyis thim/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams rim gyis rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim pas/ de nyid gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha'i rang bzhin byin rlabs kun 'dus kyi yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ byang sems bde ba chen po'i rnam par zhugs te/ rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa dang / rang gi lus ngag yid gsum bya byed dang bcas pa dbyer med du 'dres/ bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor (5bskonas gyur cing / byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ de yang / mchod yul/ mchod mkhan/ mchod rdzas thams cad sems las ma 'das shing gnyis snang gi bag chags kyi shes pa bslad pa'i dbang gis sna tshogs su snang yang sems las 31gas su grub pa cung zad tsam yang med la/ sems gsal rig tsam du ngos zin pa gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid/ de la brtags pa skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba/ stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin/ gsal tsam na stong / stong tsam na gsal ba/ gsal stong zung 'jug spros bral gyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag /mjug tu skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang zhes sogs bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas gdab/ 'di na nyams len snying po bsdus pa yin gyi/ sgom don gyi dmigs rim zhib cha mtha' dag bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rab las shes par bya zhing tshig sbyor rgyas pa spro na'ang de
