nyid las len no//gsang chen rgyud sde'i nying khu gcig bsgril nas/ lam zab gdan gsum tshang ba bla ma'i khrid/ /nyams —252

lam zab phyi ma'i nyams len gnad sgril 'jug bde/ 6)su bstar bas tshe 'dir zung 'jug sku/ /rnyes byed dpal ldan chos skyong thugs kyi bcud/ /bshul 'dir 'phags yul grub dbang mang gshegs kyang / /ljongs 'dir brtse chen snying po kho na yi/ /gser chos mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs me tog thod/ /ma snyigs 'ching ba'i rjes gongs pha mtha' las/ /thun mong gdams par dbang phyug ral pa'i rtser/ /zhabs sen zla tshes blo gros rgyal mtshan zhes/ /slob bshad chos kyi nyi ma 'od po ches/ /skal bzang snying gi 'dab stong ci yang bzhad/ /spu phyogs brjod srin pos (6na〉bslad par ma nus pas/ /legs bshad sī tar rtag tu brtse ba'i lha/ /zab gsang gnad mangs sgrib gnyis laṅka'i mgrin/ /gcod pa'i 'phong rkyen dga' byed deng 'dir 'grub/ /dge bas skye bar tshad ma bzhi ldan chos/ /ston pa'i bshes gnyen mchog gis rjes bzung ste/ rang sems dag pa'i khyab bdag kye rdo rje/ /ring min mngon gyur don gnyis lhun grub shog /ces dpal ldan sa skya'i gser chos lam zab phyi ma'i dmigs rim gnad bsgril 'jug bde zhes pa 'di ni mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab dang dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa gnyis kyi nyams len du dgos tshul byung ba ltar/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i bka' drin las/ slob bshad 'dzin pa za hor gyi bzhes yongs 'dzin zhes pa chu byi hor zla drug pa'i yar ngo'i bzang po gnyis pa'i tshes la bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson 'jam dbyangs grags pa rang gis bgyis pa sirnyi ra stu//sarba maṅga lo//—253—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i 'khrid kyi zin bris bstan pa rgyas byed ces bya ba las bum dbang gi rmi lam man gyi zin bris kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bzhed pa ma nor ba bzhugs/dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung du gsol/ /grangs yas bskal par bsags pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /rnyed dka' rnal 'byor dbang phyug ba ched pa'i bcud/ /yang snying gsang chen slob bshad bdud rtsi'i gter/ /'di 'dra 'thung ba'i shes ldan skal ba bzang / /sbyang gzhi ma dag 'khrul pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /sbyong byed dbang bzhi'i lam gyi byed po yis/ /sbyangs sa sku bzhi ma rga par legs hrūb pa/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs kyi mchog /'di snang tshe 'di'i chos brgyad rgyab bor nas/ /lam mchog snying po nyams su len pa yi/ /brtson pa'i dka' thub bsten na tshe 'di la/ /zung 'jug bde chen gling der bgrod par nges/ /gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid yig kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bzhed pa tshar ba rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis zin bris su mdzad pa la/ bum dbang gi bar do'i khrid grub mtshams nas 'phror lus 'dug pa'i/ rmi (2na'am gyi khrid man chad kyi zin bris/ 'a zhwa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po 'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan gyi gsung rgyun gsung ngag slob bshad kyi khyad chos rnams kyis legs par brgyan te 'dri ba la/ drug pa rmi lam ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi nyams len gyi tshod 'dzin pa ni rmi lam yin la/ de ji ltar nyams su len pa'i tshul la sbyor dngos gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lus ha cang drag shul dang ngal dub tu ma song bar/ ngag gi smra brjod kyang bag gis —254

lam gos bu dang bcas pa'i 'khrid kyi zin bris bstan pa rgyas byed ces bya ba/ 6)nyung bar/ yid kyi rtog pa rgya 'byams su rgya cher mi spro bar/ gnyid 'thug po'i rgyu zas bcud can dang /yer ba'i rgyu ja gar po sogs spangs nas spyod lam thams cad 'jam la cha mnyam pa bya ba dang nyin phyed yan la nyin mo'i snang ba gang shar la rmi lam gyi snang bar 'dug nges rmi lam 'di ci nas kyang 'dzin thub pa zhig bya snyam pa dang / ngag tu yang rmi lam yin zhes pa yang yang brjod cing 'dun pa drag tu btang / nyin phyed tshun nas drag drags na sang 'byams kyi rgyu byed pas/ 'dun pa dang brjod pa gnyis ka ran tsam bya gnyis pa la/ bzung ba/ sbyang ba/ bsgyur ba/ de (2bskon na nyid la blo bzhag pa dang bzhi/ de dag la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ srod thun gyi rnal 'byor bsdusanas/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs lta bu'i skyabs sems mdor bsdus dang / bdag gnas rnal 'byor srung ba'i rim pa rnams sngar ltar bya/ spro na rmi lam zin par bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa sogs bya/gnyis pa ni/ gshogs g.yas pa phab ste bde bar nyal ba'i mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i 'dab ma la mdun nas g.yas skor gyis a nu tar lte bar oṃ dang bcas pa gsal gdab/ kha dog dkar dmar yid yul du gang 'char ba byed/ thog mar mdun gyi a la dmigs pa gtad de/ a 'di yang rmi lam gyi yi ge yin/ snang ba 'di yang rmi lam gyi snang ba yin/ rmi lam gyi snang ba la gang sbyang sbyang dang bsgyur bsgyur yin/ des na rmi lam cis kyang zin pa bya snyam pa byas nas rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa'i ngang du gnyid kyis mtshams sbyar de 'phral gnyid du song nas zin na des khyab/da dung yer ba'am rtog pa 'phro na/ g.yas kyi nu nas oṃ gyi bar la'ang re re nas rim bzhin du sems bzung / des kyang ma zin na smin mtshams su thig le nag po 'od kyi rang bzhin sran ma tsam pa reg la ma 'byar ba'i tshul du g.yon phyogs su 'khor ba zhig gsal 'debs/ de yang lam gzhan du rmi lam gyi 'gegs bzhin gsungs kyang / 'dir rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi ba ched pas/ sad 'byams dang 'khrul mas gnyis yod pa'i/ dang po ni/ sngar gyi thig le nag pos kyang sel/ des ma sel na/ thig le mtha' nag pa dbus skya sing nge g.yon skor du shugs drag tu (3na tshe mdor ba zhig bsams la sems —255

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)gtad pas sel/ des kyang ma sel na thig le nag kyang g.yon 'khor sngar ltar las 'od zer nag po sol ba'i phye lta bu thib thib byung nas rang lus thams cad g.yogs pa lta bu la sems gtad pas sad 'byams de grol 'gro na'ang / 'dis ha cang shes pa bying ba sogs su 'gyur bas dpogs chog lta bu ste ye ma zin na ma gtogs mi byed par bla ma snga ma rnams gsung ngo / /'khrul 'byams sel ba la blo 'das kyi spyod pa ni/ mi med pa'i dben cing yangs pa'i sar lus gcer bur byas la/ rgyug mchong sogs lus kyi spyod lam ma nges pa sna tshogs bya/ ngag gi kun co la sogs pa brjod bya ma nges pa sna tshogs dang rmi lam yin zhes mang du brjod/ yid la rmi lam gyi snang ba yin snyam pa rtse gcig tu byas pas sel/ yang na brag la chu 'thab kyi brag rtse dang / gad g.yang dang mkhar mthon po'i rtse lta bu g.yang tha chod pa'i gnas su bsdad la/ zhed snang de kha rmi lam gyi snang ba yin bsam pa yang yang byas pas sel lo/ /gnyis pa sbyong ba ni/ de ltar bzung bas rmi lam gyi skabs su 'di ltar rmi lam gyi snang bar 'dug snyam pa shar ba'i tshe/ de gang sbyang sbyang dang bsgyur bsgyur yin pas/ ri rab kyi rtser phyin nas gling bzhi blta/ de nas kyang nyi zla'i steng du phyin nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten blta/ de nas rim gyis mngon dga' lta bu dag pa'i zhing khams su blo gtad la rmi lam bzung bas sangs rgyas mjal ba dang chos nyan pa sogs la bslab bo/ /gsum pa bsgyur ba ni/ de ltar 'byongs pa ltar/ rang gi lus kyang gcig las gnyis dang gnyis (3bsti5sa gsum sogs mang por sgyur te sangs rgyas mchod pa dang / ngan song du phyin la sems can gyi don byed pa sogs su bsgyur ro/ /bzhi pa de kho na nyid la blo bzhag pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ bden min rdzun min thams cad du/ /thams cad chu yi zla ba ltar/ /thams cad rnal 'byor mas shes bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bden pa ma yin te gnyid sad pa'i rjes su de dag byung ba'i shul tsam yang mi snang /rdzun pa'ang min te rmi lam gyi gnas skabs su nyams su myong du yod pa'i phyir ro/ /mdor na snang ba thams cad bden med kyi rgyas btab nas 'khor 'das dbyer med du bsre'o/ /de tshod 'dzin pa sgyu —256

lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i 'khrid kyi zin bris bstan pa rgyas byed ces bya ba/ (tha)lus la/ ma dag pa'i rgyu lus dang / dag pa'i sgyu lus/ gnyis bsdug kyi sgyu lus dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ khams gsum gnas lus longs spyod sna tshogs su shar ba 'di thams cad sems la las dang nyon mongs pas bslad skyon sna tshogs dang 'phrad pa'i dbang gis med bzhin du shar ba 'di dag go /gnyis pa ni/ lam zam mo nyams su blangs pas bskyed rim brtan pa'i lha'i rnam pa dang / nyams myong snang ba gsum gyi lam sogs su 'char ba rnams so/ /gsum pa ni/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad ye gdod ma nas bden par grub pa skra'i rtse mo tsam yang med bzhin du sna tshogs su snang ba ste/ dper mtshon na me long du gzugs 'char bar byas la de rkyen ma tshogs pa'i tshe na rang bzhin gyi rkyen gyis rgyus stong / tshogs pa'i tshe gzugs brnyan du snang / de ma thag 'gags pas gnas pa med pas ngo bos stong / de yang 'di lta bur thim song pa'am brjod du med pas mthar 'bras bus stong / de bzhin du rang gi (4nabs kyang pha ma'i 'du 'phrod med pa'i sngon du skye ba rgyus stong / rkyen sna tshogs tshogs pas da lta lus su grub pa de yun du mi gnas par 'jig pas ngo bos stong / mthar phung po sbyangs pa'i tshe 'di 'dra zhig tu thim brjod du med pas mthar 'bras bus stong ste/ de dngos su nyams su myong bas na/ bstod smad bde sdug sogs thams cad la 'dzin pa spangs te 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lam du bsgyur ro/ /de ltar na nyin mo sgyu lus dang mtshan mo rmi lam ste de gnyis zung du 'jug pas bar do'i grub mtha' stogs/ de yang me long gi gzugs la bstod smad sogs kyi rnam pa yang yang mang du byas la bslab bo/ /de ltar gzhi chos can 'khor ba'i gnas tshul gyi rjes su/ lam bgrod pa'i rim pa ni/ lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum gyi sgo nas mdor bstan pa nas bshad ma thag pa yan gyis legs par song la/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyis bshad pa ni/ gang zag rab tshe der sa drug pa man chad mngon du byas nas grub mtha' snyegs/ 'bring 'chi ba 'od gsal/ mtha' mar bar dor snang ba bsgyur/ shin tu mtha' mas smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar te/ skye ba blangs nas lam lhag ma la bslab pa ni/ bum dbang gi lam gyi rim pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /de rtsa'i 'gros thim/ bskyed rim gyi —257

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)lam mngon du byed do/ /sa drug mngon du byas nas grub pa'i mtha'/ /stogs byed bum dbang dang 'brel khrid rim rnams/ /'khrul med brgyud pa'i gsung sgros ltar bkod kyi/ /skal bzang tsho gos rnams dga' ba'i gar byos shig /bum dbang nyams 'a gyi rim pa rje bla ma'i gsungs rgyun rnams legs par grub bo/ /lus thabs rgyud la dbang bzhi dang 'brel ba'i lam bsgom pa'i gnyis pa gsang (4ba tshe dbang gi lam la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum/ dang po la khyab byed kyi ga dmasang ga dang / khyab bya'i ga dmasang ga gnyis sam/ yang na khrid kyi sngon 'gro dang / thun gyi sngon 'gro gnyis/ dang po la/ dbang zhu ba/ len pa/ bsag sbyang gsum las phyi ma sngar ltar byed/ gnyis pa la sbyang ba gsum/ sgom pa gsum/ gnad la dbab pa gsum/ dang po'i gsum gyi dang po ni/ yan lag lnga sbyong bya/ gnyis pa smra brjod bzhad bgad klog dbyangs sogs nga ro drag po rnams nyung bar byed/ gsum pa ni gsal stong 'dzin med la 'jog /bar pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ sangs rgyas chas tshogs ma sngon du btang nas/ de kho na nyid ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje bsgom/ gnyis pa ni hūṃ re brjod nas srung 'khor dang lha gsal gdab/ gsum pa ni/ spyi bor bla ma zhal brgyad par bsgoms nas/ bdag rgyud byin gyis brlab par gsol ba 'debs shing rang la bstim/ tha ma'i gsum ni/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun ldan/ ngag rlung dgu phrugs su 'bud pa yid skyo chod de gzhag go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ khams gsum 'dus pa dang po rlung gtum mo drod rtags kyi lam 'khrid pa zhes gsungs pa 'di la spyir/ dus 'khor las srog rtsol 'dus pa la sgyu lus/ bde mchog dang 'dir rang byin rlabs sam tsaṇ+ḍali gtum mo rnams su rnam grangs su gsungs pa las/ rtsa rgyud las/ 'byung ba nyid kyis lhung bar byed/ rngubs pa nyid kyis dbang du byed/ dgang ba nyid kyis dgug par byed/ /zhi ba yis ni rings par byed/ ces pas/ 'byung 'jug gnas gsum gang ba dang bcas pa'i bzhi la kun rdzob tu pha rol 'joms pa'i las bzhi dang / nges don du (5na)rdzogs rim rlung gi rnal 'byor du gsung ba la/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis man ngag bdun du mdzad de/ srog —258

lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i 'khrid kyi zin bris bstan pa rgyas byed ces bya ba/ (thadartsol rdor bzlas phyir dbyung ba gsum/ nang du 'jug pa mnyam gzhag gnyis/ gnas pa/ kha sbyor te bdun/ gtum mo bco brgyad/ 'phrul 'khor 'phrin las so gnyis dang bcas pa rnams su 'dus pa las/ dang po srog rtsol ni/ thog mar g.yon nas rlung rgyu ba'i tshe sgo bstun la nyams su len dgos shing / gal te g.yas nas rgyu ba dang thug na nu ma bcud la bor ba'i gdams pas g.yon du rgyu ba'i thabs byed/ bla mas khrid gnang ba'i dus kyang de ltar mdzad pa'i phyag len du mchis/ de nas thog mar g.yon nas nang du zhugs/ nang du gnas/ phyir thon pa gsum la gcig tu byas pa rlung ma 'khrul pa'i grangs 'phreng ba lta bur bzung ba'i mang mtha' la tshad bzung med/ nyung mtha'ang brgya rtsa tsam bya/ grangasanyi shu tsam rjes rlung sna bug gang nas rgyu yang khyad med do/ /de ltar bsgoms pas gang zag mchog la ting nge 'dzin khyad par can dang mngon shes grub pa sogs byung / 'jug pa sel ba'i nyams myong rgyud la skye ba dang / tha ma'ang bkru bshal gyis snod dag pa ltar bum can gyi dus rlung las su rung ba'i yon to bskyed do/ /de las kyang rdzogs rim gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi yon to bskyed par 'dod pas rlung la sngon bdag gis sbyin pa ni/ dang po ni g.yas kyi rtsol ba'i rlung la sems gtad la/ phyir 'gro'i rlung rang gi ngos nas cung zad bcos pa phyir ring du btang / nang du 'jug gnas gnyis thung ngur bya/ de sngar ltar grangs bzung des bar chad sel/ de la goms nas gnyis pa ni/ srog (5bsko rlung g.yon nas nang du 'jug pa dang gnas pa rang babs kyis ring du btang / phyir 'gro ba thung bar byed/ des tshe sgrub mchog tu 'gyur zhing mi rtag pa yang rim gyis skye/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ thog ma'i 'byung 'jug gnas gsum gyi rlung gi gdangs 'bru gsum du bsgyur zhing nang 'jug oṃ nas 'go 'dzin no/ /phyir btang gi yan lag gsum las/ dang po ni/ lag g.yas pa khu tshur du byas pa'i mdzub mo gung mo'i rgyab mnan pa'i gung mos sna bug g.yas mnan g.yon nas cung zad tshur rngub pa'i ngos phyir drag tu btang zhing nan tsam bya/ 'jug gnasang la gso tsam gyi cung zad byed/ gnyis pa ni/ sna bug gnyisaka nas drag tu gtong zhing / gtong lugs sngar dang 'dra/ thog mar khru gang tsam/ de nas stong gsum —259

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)gyi mthar sleb pa tsam byed/ gsum pa ni/ kha nas sgra bcas su so yar mar sprad pa cung zad reg tsam byas nas/ si'i sgra dang bcas gtong ba gong dang mtshungs/ nang du 'jug pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/lte ba'i khyil khyil gyi thad du bya gsar gyi sgo nga tsam gyi phyi dkar nang dmar ba dbus su a shad dmar po nas 'bru tsam pa gsal btab/ sngar lta bu'i log pa khu tshur gyis g.yas kyi sna bug bkag /g.yon nas yun ring du rngubs la rlung rnams a shad la sib sib thim par bsams shing rngub pa'i shugs rdzogs pa dang / mgo g.yas skor du gcu zhing mchil ma'i rta dang bstun rlung gang thub bzung / gnyis pa ni/ sgo nga'i tshab tu chos 'byung gi sngon po gsal 'debs pa dang / mthar chos khrung stong gsum gang bar dmigs pa sogs tsam ma gtogs gzhan thams cad gong ma dang mtshungs (6na)so/ /rlung phyir dbyung drags pa'i bgegs sel lam bogs 'don ni/ lus thabs 'gal gyis 'phrul 'khor byas/ ming gzhan me tog drug bcings yang zer ro/ /spyi bo nas rlung sngon po spos reng gi dud pa 'di pa thur du sang / 'og sgo nas khru gang tsam pa la sngo khyil le yod par sems gtad nas steng rlung cung zad gnon/ yang nang du 'jug drags pa'i bogs 'don gegs sel ni/ skyil krung byas la lag g.yasakyis rkang pa g.yon pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung / g.yon gyis g.yas pa bzung nas/ gsang gnas nas rlung sngon po yar song spyi bo nas khru gang tsam yod pa la sems gtad do/ /bdun pa bum can ni/ lte bar a shad sgom steng rlung thog mar gnon pa bgegs chung bas/ mchil ma sgra med du mid nas lte bar sleb pa tsam du gnon/ 'og rlung kyang then nas kha sbyor du 'dzin/ grangs tshad pus mo g.yon nas g.yas su bskor ba dbus su se gol gtog pa re la gcig tu brtsis pa'i rab grangs med 'bring drug cu rtsa bzhi/ tha ma ma nges so/ /rlung gi rnal 'byor bdun po'i dmigs rkang re'i gsham du 'dzin med du 'jog go /gnyis pa gtum mo'i dmigs pa la/ sa skru ṭi nas rnam grangs nyer dgu gsungs/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis bco brgyad du bsdus pa yin/ de yang / rtsa thig rlung me bzhi ga 'dzom na gtum mo 'thug po/ /gnyis 'dzom na gtum mo gang ba/ me gcig pu la gtum mo gcer bu yin/ rang lugs 260

lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i 'khrid kyi zin bris bstan pa rgyas byed ces bya ba/ 6)bco brgyad la 'khor lo la ma brten pa lnga/ brten pa gsum/ man ngag gi gnad las byung ba bcu yod pa las/ lnga po la/ me gso (6ba)pa/ tshangs pa'i thog rtsa'i rnal 'byor/ srubs shing gi rnal 'byor/theg le'i rnal 'byor las/ de re re la'ang / lam sbyong ba/ lta ba skyong ba/ nyams byung rgyal du skyong ba/thun grangs ma nges pa/ thun tshad ma nges pa/ yid 'jug yul brtag pa/ khams tshone bzung ba zasaspyod lam lcag gis bskul ba dang brgyad kyis bsdus so/ /lnga po'i dang po ni/ rang lhar bsgom/ lag pa gcig gis cig shos kyi nya nas bzung ste bsnol/ rkang pa yang phan tshun bsnol te tsog pur bsdad pas gru gsum drug 'byung ba'i lus thabs 'gal gyi 'phrul 'khor bya/ 'og sgo'i nang du rlung dkyil sngon po zla gam bcad kha yar bstan pa/ gsum mdor me gru gsum/ lte 'og k+ṣa dmar po mgo thur bstan lte bar e dmar po mgo gyen bstan bsgom/ 'og rlung then tsam gsum byas rjes nar gyis then pa/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ de las k+ṣa la me 'bar bas a las thig le dmar po hrel mo sran ma tsam gnyis byung k+ṣa la thim pas/ me la mar khu thigs pa ltar drag tu 'bar/ des rkyen byas e las khams thigs pas me dang de gnyis skra shad 'jigs pa ltar song ba dang steng rlung mnan te bzhag go /gnyis pa ni/ 'og sgor rlung gzhu'i dbyibs can mde'u thur bstan bsam/ rtsa dbu ma mda' snyug tsam pa spyi gtsug bar thal le bsgom/ spyi bor nya dkar po mgo thur bstan bsgom/ 'og rlung sngar bzhin byas pa'i rkyen gyis gzhu'i 'chang bzung yar bstan te mda' rtsa nang nas gyen du song ba snya la phog pas/ de las khams 'jags te lus thams cad khyab pa'i bde ba la sems gtad rlung sngar bzhin bzung / 'di thun re la lan re las mi byed gsung / (7na gi sum pa ni/ 'byung 'jug gnas gsum la brten nas rim pa bzhin ro rkyang dbu gsum gsal btab/ ro rkyang gi ya mtha' smin mtshams kyi thad tsam/ dbu ma spyi gtsug /mar sna gsum kha gsang gnas la thug par bsgom/ rkyang ma nas rlung 'jug pa'i tshe oṃ/ dbu ma'i sgor gnas pa'i tshe āḥ ro ma nas 'byung ba'i tshe hūṃ gi rdor bzlas byed do/ /bzhi pa ni/ lag pas pus mo gnyis bsdams te tsog pu bya/ lte ba e rtsa dbu mar sna de'i —261—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)steng zug pa/ lte ba'i ltag tsam nas ro mas dbu ma la lan gsum du dkris/ de ltag rkyang mas g.yon skor du lan gsum dkris/ de gnyis kyi g.yas g.yon du then pa'i rkyen gyis dbu mas a srubs pas me dmar phrom phrom byung des dbu ma gang / de nas rim rgyas lus thams cad gang bar dmigs so/ /lnga pa nang gses la bzhi las/ ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'dod na snying ga'i nyi zla kha sbyor ni/ snying sgong lkogs lta bu'i nang du thig le dkar po sran ma'i phyed tsam dang / de steng thig le dmar po sran phyed tsam kha sbyar ba'i nang du sems hūṃ sngon po gsal btab/ de nas thig le'i nang nas sing zer ba'i skad cig byung bas rkyen byas ga'u'i steng du bug pa chung ngu gcig byung de la sems gtad de/ der mig gis blta ba lta bu bya/ kha nang nas sgra med du rlung rngubs pas ga'u la thim/ bug pa nas 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan rta rnga tsam pa nar gyis byung nas rgyab mdun du gsum dang / g.yas g.yon du sum dkris g.yon gyi sna rgyab phyogs su song nas steng gi phyed tsam du sleb par bsams te/ rlung kha sbyor du bzung / phyir gtong tshe 'od zer de (7ba)grol nas sngar gyi byung shul du rang gnas su thim mo/ /gsal bar 'dod na/ lte ba'i dpa' bo 'ba' zhig pa ni lte bar thig le dkar po sran chung tsam pa 'tsher ba 'gril ba gsal ba ste/ cho sogasum ldan bsgom/ rlung kha nas sgra med du rngubs de la thim par bsams te/ kha sbyor du 'dzin no/ /bde ba bskyed par 'dod na/ gsang gnas bde ba'i thig le ni/ rtags kyi nor bu'i nang ngam/ bud med la bha ga'i nang du thig le dmar po yungs skar tsam chos gsum ldan bsgom/'og rlung cung zad 'then la rlung thams cad de la thim par bsams te/ kha sbyor ro/ /bde ba chas nas 'dzag gegs byung dogs nas smin mtshams su shes pa gtad pas sel lo/ /smin mtshams skra dkar gnon pa 'joms pa'i thig le ni/ thabs 'gal gyi phyag rgya bcas/ lce rtse rkan phugs su sbyar nas cung zad gzhibs/ spyi bor lha dkar bde ba'i rang bzhin mgo thur bstan/ lce chung gi thad tsam du sum dkar po mgo thur bstan/ snying gar hūṃ sngon po mgo gyen bstan/ de rnams byang sems dkar po dar skud lta bur sbrel ba/ rtsol ba'i rang nang du 'jug pas lhag pa'i phyogs su song nas nya sros pas des —262

lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i 'khrid kyi zin bris bstan pa rgya byed ces bya ba/ thenathig le bde ba'i rang bzhin shel dkar zhu ba lta bur byung ste/ thig le dar skud lta bu'i lam brgyud nas sum la thim pas sum bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du rgyas/ de nas kyang sngar ltar babs te hūṃ tshim par bsams shing / lce rtses rkan phugs dal bus gzhibs/ spro na rlung g.yon nas 'jug pa dang mnyam du kha sbyor ro/ /mchil pa gzhan du mi 'dor ro/ /'di lce chung ba bzho ba'i gdams pa zer ro/ /'khor lo la brten par/ gcig la (8na〉rten pa rno/ gnyis la brten pa myur/ gsum la brten pa brtan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ lte ba'i rtsa 'khor lo gsal btab/ 'og sgo'i rlung dang / sum mdo'i me sngar ltar bya/ rtsa 'khor gyi lte ba e/ 'dab ma nang du brgyad la a ka tsa ṭa sogs yi ge thams cad dmar por bsgom/ 'og rlung 'then tshul sngar rnams ltar byas pas/ rlung gis me spar/ de las yi ge rnams lasakyang me sor bzhi tsam 'bar bar dmigs nas kha sbyor du bzung ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ lte ba man chad kyi dmigs pa dngos gzhi snga ma la/ e oṃ du bsgyur/ snying ga'i rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar hūṃ sngon po bsgom/ hūṃ dang oṃ gyi bar du rtsa dbu ma phra mo zhig gsal gdab/ 'og rlung 'then pa sogs sngar ltar byas pas/ lte ba'i yi ge rnams las me 'bar dbu ma'i lam nas zhugs te me lces hūṃ la reg pas/de la thig le dkar po babs te skra shad 'dzings pa ltar bsam mo/ /gsum pa ni/ 'og sgo'i rlung dkyil nas bzung me k+ṣa yig gi bar sngon ma rnams ltar gsal btab/ de nas rtsa dbu ma sbom phra sdom gyi ba thag tsam la sbugs sdong yod pa dmar po yar sna tshangs bug /mar sna lte 'og tsam du sleb pa/ g.yas su ro ma rak+tas gang ba dbu ma las kyang cung phra ba me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ /g.yon du rkyang ma sbom phra ro ma dang mnyam pa khams dkar pos gang ba chu'i rang bzhin dkar po/ /gnyis ka yar mar gyi sna dbu ma dang mnyam pa gsal btab/ lte bar ro rkyang lasagyes pa'i rtsa bzhi bzhi ste brgyad/ de las drug cu rtsa bzhi/ dbus su e/ 'dab ma brgyad la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du a ka tsa ṭa sogs (8ba)dang / phyi ma la mdun nas g.yon skor du ā li phrag gnyis/ g.yas bskor du ha k+ṣa spangs pa'i kā li phrag gcig mgo gyen bstan/ rtsa yig thams —263

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)cad dmar po/ /snying ga'i rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su hūṃ 'dab ma brgyad la mdun nas phyogs bzhi la g.yas skor gyis sne e dzi kho/ shar lho nas g.yon skor gyis lo mo paṃ lha mgo thur bstan thams cad sngon po/ mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus su oṃ/ 'dab ma la mdun nas g.yon skor gyi ā li mgo gyen bstan thams cad dmar po/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab kyi dbus su nya 'dab ma la mdun nas g.yon skor ā li/ g.yas skor gyis ka nas ta'i bar mgo thur bstan thams cad dkar por gsal btab/ 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum gsum tsam byas rjes 'og rlung then pas rlung g.yos me 'bar nas ro ma'i nang brgyud nas g.yas skor gyis lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gyi nang gi ljan ljin snyigs ma thams cad bsregs/ rim gyis spyi bo'i bar de ltar byas la me nya la reg pas lha las thig le dkar po babs pas rkyang ma'i nang brgyud g.yon skor gyis spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor thams cad gang yi ge rnams kyang je gsal du song / rim gyis lte ba'i bar de ltar byas nas thigs pa gcig k+ṣa la phog pas/ de las me 'bar e nas nya gi bar dbu ma'i nang du thal gyis song bas/ nya las thig le babs/ smin mtshams kyi thad tsam du 'bar 'dzag byas/ de bzhin du mgrin pa/ snying ga /lte ba gsum da'i 'og tsam du re re nas 'bar 'dzag la sems gtad nas bum can kha sbyar bzung / de rjes bum can drug cu rtsa bzhi'i grangs can bcu gnyis dang / grangs med bcu gnyis sbrel te bzung / /grangs can la dmigs pa de ga dang grangs (9na/yed la 'dzin med du 'jog go /man ngag gi gnad kyi dmigs pa bcu las/ gsum sngar gyi thig le'i grangs bzhi'i nang du 'thon nas/ slad du bdun las/ me dmar skya ni me tog drug bcing byas la skad cig gis lus kyi nang thams cad me dmar skyas gang bar bsam la bum can bzung ngo / bshad ma thag pa'i gtum mo 'thug pa'i/ me skya gnyis la grangs can grangs med bcu gnyis re 'dzin dgos pa ni dmigs bsal te/ spyir btang la thun tshad ma nges par gsungs so/ /me 'bar ba ni rkang mthil gnyis su raṃ dmar nag me 'bar la khad par bsam/ rkang pa'i mdzub mo brkyang bskum byas pa'i rkyen gyis raṃ las me 'bar long bu dang brla sha'i rtsa bo che'i nang brgyud sum mdo'i me dang 'dres pas/ de —264

lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i 'khrid kyi zin bris bstan pa rgyas byed ces bya ba/ 6)las me stag dmar phrom byung bas lus thams cad gang bar bsgoms pa kha sbyar bzung ngo / thig le'i thab mo ni/ sum mdo'i me gnas 'gyur ba las/ sum mdor steng du thig le dkar po dang 'og tu dmar po mtheb tshigs tsam pa gsal gdab/ rlung kha sbyar ba'i rkyen gyis de gnyis 'thabs pa las me stag sngar ltar bsam mo/ me'i 'khor lo ni/ me'i srog shing phra mo spyi gtsug nas gsang gnas kyi bar thal le yod pa bsgom/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa dmar nag rtsibs stong du ā li yi ge nyis gshibs su g.yon skor du bsgom/ kha sbyar ba'i rkyen gyis 'khor lo 'khor bas lte bar 'khor lo las me dmar lhab lhab 'bar bar bsam mo/ cher 'bar ba ni/ sngon ma'i dmigs pa de ga nas mgrin pa man mes gang ngo / drag tu 'bar ba ni sngon ma'i steng du lus thams cad gang ste/ lus (9ba)kyi rnam pa ma zhig tsam nas lcags bsregs lta bur bsam mo/ /thams cad du 'bar ba ni/ gnas khang nas brtsams te snang srid mes dmar 'ur gyis 'bar bar bsgom/ bco brgyad po thams cad kyi mjug tu lta ba bskyang ngo / /de ltar nyams su blangs pas lta ba bzhi 'char te/ lam bsgom pa'i stobs kyis bha ga'i yi ge sogs su rlung sems 'dus pa'i rkyen gyis phyi rol gyi rkyen la ma bltos par dug gsum drag po skyes pa ni nyon mongs rang byung / ro rkyang mas snar rlung sems 'dus pas spu gri'i rang stobs su 'gyur te/rnam rtog drag po skyes nas sems gnas su mi stod pa tsam 'byung ba ni rnam rtog rang byung / rdo rje'i lus la rtsa 'phreng la yod pa'i nang dang / dbu ma dang ro ma'i mas sna rtsa khang steng lta bur rlung sems 'dus pas phyi rol gyi zas spyod la ma bstos par shes pa rmugs pa dang bying ba sogs 'byung ba ni snrel zhi rang byung / snying ga'i : sogs su rlung sems 'dus pas gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa 'gags nas stong gsal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin dang / lus shing bal ltar yang ba nyams su myong ba ni/ gsal shing yang la rang byung gi ting nge 'dzin te sngon ma gsum ni lam bsgoms pa las byung ba'i nyams yin kyang /sgro skur gyis bsdus pas skyon can yin la/ phyi ma ni mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes yin no/ /lta ba de lta bu spyod pa gsum gyi sgo nas nyams su blangs pas/ nang gi rlung sems mkha' 'gro yab yum bcus byin —263

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)gyis brlabs/ de la brten yul nyer bzhi'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang du 'dus/ cir snang grogs su 'char/ sems nang du gnas/ phung po lnga thul/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga zin gtum mo'i me (10na)'bar/ thig le mang du kha 'dus/ grub mtha' ma 'dres la yongs su rdzogs pa mthar phyin pa ni/ gang zag mchog gi lam mo/ 'da' ka ma 'ong gsal ba ni/ sbyang ba bsgom pa las la sbyar ba gsum las/dang po ni/ rtsa dbu ma dmar po phra sbom ran pa yar snar lha thur bstan/ mas sna e gyen bstan bsgom/rtsol ba'i rlung phyir bus te nang du rngub pa'i tshe e nang byung ste lha la thim/ srog gi rlung rngubs pa'i tshe nya las byung ste e la bstim pa yang yang byas pas 'chi khar ro rkyang gi rlung dbu mar 'dus te/ de'i rkyen gyis 'od gsal ma bu 'phrod pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ gsang dbang gi rang byung ye shes ston pa'i bla ma la tsaṇ+ḍali lta ba rang byung gi ye shes rnams yang yang dran par byas shing / thim rim gyis du ba smig rgyu la sogs ā li kā lir gsal 'debs shing rang byung gi ye shes su ngo shes pa'o/ /gsum pa la gnyis las/ sngon ma ni bum dbang gi skabs kyi 'od dang sgras 'pho ba de ka yin la phyi ma ni gling dang skye gnas la/ sbyang ba zhes pa don bum dbang gi skye gnas 'dam pa de ka yin no//bar do ni/ dngos gzhi bum dbang gi skabs dang 'dra ba la/ yang ba'i gnas gsum sogs bar do'i snang ba thams cad kyang gsal la rangs pa rang byung gi ye shes yin snyam pa yang yang bya'o/ /rmi lam ni dngos gzhi 'dra ba la a nu ta ra sogs kyang rang byung gi ye shes yin snyam pa dang / rmi lam du yang rang byung gi ye shes de nges par 'char bar byed snyam pa dran 'dun yang yang bya'o/ /sgyu lus kyang dngos gzhi 'dra ba la nyin mo'i snang ba 'di yang / me long (10ba〉rtor rang byung gi ye shes yin bsam pa yang yang du bsgom par bya'o/ /rjes ni de dag gi khams 'dus pa dang po chod/ nā yi ge'i 'gros thim/ yi ge gnas 'gyur/ longs sku'i go 'phang mngon du byed do/ /bdun pa'i sa de mngon du gyur byed pa'i/ /gsang dbang lam gyis bgrod pa'i sgros rnams kun/ /zhakhrul med gdams pa'i gnad ltar bris pa na/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal sten/ gsang dbang gi lam nyams len rje bla ma'i —266

lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i 'khrid kyi zin bris bstan pa rgyas byed ces bya ba/ 6)gsung gi nying khu de tsam mo/ /lus thabs rgyud la dbang bzhi dang 'brel ba'i lam bsgom pa'i gsum pa ni/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lam mam/ pho nya'i lam mam/ shes rab ye shes kyi lam zhes pa rnam grangs yin la/ de la yang / sbyor dngos mjug gsum/ dang po la khrid kyi sngon 'gro dang / thun gyi sngon 'gro gnyis/ dang po ni/ bsag sbyang sogs sngar dang 'dra/ gnyis pa la yang / sgom pa gsum/ gnad la dbab pa gsum ste drug po gsang dbang gi skabs ltar ro/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la rig ma dag pa/ lusang ga mnyam pa/ byin rlabs mnyam pa/ 'dod pa mnyam pa/ man ngag las byung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dngos dang / ye rgya gnyis las phyi ma'i dbang du bya zhing / rig ma de lus dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa dbang thob cing snod du rung ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/rang kye rdo rje dang rig ma bdag med mar gsal bas lus mnyam/ de gnyis gas rtsa sngags brjod pasang ga mnyam mo/ /gsum pa ni/ rang gi rig ma'i mkha' sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs/ rig mas kyang rang gi gsang gnas dngos gzhi sgrub thabs ltar (11na〉pa rdo rje'i rked par oṃ gyi phreng ba dang / bug pa phaṭa kyis bkag par bsam mo/ /bzhi pa ni/ bdag kyang rig ma 'di la brten nasadaga' bzhi bsgrub snyam pa dang / rig mas kyang / bdag la brten nas bde chen bsgrub par bsam mo/ /lnga pa la/ dbab pa/ bzung ba/ bzlog pa/ 'grems pa/ mi nyams par bya ba dang lnga las/ dang bo ni/gzugs mdzes pa la blta ba/ chags pa'i gtam gyis sgra la nyan pa/ lus kyi dri la sdom pa/ mchu 'jib pa sogs rol mang ba/ 'khyud pa sogs reg bya la spyod pa rnams byas nas/ rig ma yang chags myosakyi rnam 'gyur 'byung zhing / rang la bde ba cher 'byung / bde ba ha cang ches pas khams phyir 'dzagasadogs na/ rje btsun gong ma'i gsung sgros las/ bgrad pas mtha' bsrung / gsang thub pa gces gsung pa/ lag pa khu tshur byas snying gar bsnol/ sto ba sga tshigs la sbyar/ nywa bzhi sgril/ rkang pa'i mdzub mo bskul/ mig gyen du blta/ kha nas hal hal lam hūṃ hūṃ brjod do/ /de ni bya ba mang la bde ba chung bas/dga' ba'i ye shes zer/ gsang thub pa ni de ma thag snyoms 'jug mi bya ba'i don no/ /yang rdo rje dang —267

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)pad+ma 'du byas pas byang sems spyi bo nas rim bzhin babs te nor bu'i rtse'i bar du byung bar bsam zhing / de'i ngo bo gang du yang ma grub pa'i 'dzin med kyi ngang la 'jog go /gnyis pa rgya mtsho ri rab la skam zhes pa'i sto ba sgal tshigs la sbyor/ gling bzhi dbang du sdud ces pa yan lag gi mdzub (11ba)mo bskum/ ro 'dzin rang gnas su bzlog ces pa ni lce rkan phugs su sgril/ dbang po'i mchog gyen la bzlog pa ni mig yar sgril la bzung ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ ngag stobs hūṃ gis drang pa hūṃ drag tu lce rtse sgril zhing brjod pa yin la/ ting nge 'dzin hūṃ phaṭa kyi mda' gzhus 'phul ba hūṃ gis yar drangs shing phaṭa kyis 'phul bas yar bzlog par bsam mo/ /bzhi pa ni/rlung gi ska rags bcings pa lag pa gnyis khu tshur gyen bstan gyis sked pa la rgyab bdun du shugs drag pos g.yas skor g.yon skor byed/ zhags pa 'phen pa ni lag gnyis drag tu bshad pa 'am/ yang na mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'i stangs ka shugs chen po byed/ gtan shing gi 'khor lo bskor ba ni/ lto ba g.yas skor g.yon skor shugs cher byed byis pa'i spyod lam ni/ rdo rje skyil krung dang / lag pa me tog drug bcing gi skabs lta bu byas la gan rkyal dang kha bub byas ske g.yas gcu g.yon gcu byed pa yin no/ /lnga pa ni/ de ltar byas pas mi nyams la gal srid bde ba ches pa 'am/ grib dang gdon gyi dbang gis 'dzags na khrus bya ba ni/ rab dbang bzhi zhu/ 'bring sāts+tsha 'debs/ tha ma'ang rnam 'joms kyi khrus chog bya'o/ khyad par zhal shes la/ sla nga me 'jam tsam gyi steng du bzhag /nang du gu gul dang yungs gar gnyis blug pas me zhu byung ba'i steng pad+ma rak+ta gri kwang btab/ de steng thal chen gyis g.yos nas ril bu rdo rje'i bug par shongs tshod byas nas bcug pas 'dzag pa'i rigs thams cad chod do/ /lam bsdus pa ni/ sngon 'gro thur sel dbang du bya ba/ dngos gzhi dbab bzung / rjes kha ba 'gem mo//(12na skong po ni/ pus mo gnyis gru mo 'og tu tshud par byas/ lag mthil g.yas g.yon nyi zlar bsgom pa bsnol nas pus mor bkab nas/ rlung ring po thung ngu / shin tu thung ngu sbrel nas mdun du rngubs nas kha sbyor 'dzin/ de bzhin du/ g.yas/ mdun/ g.yon/ mdun te lngar bya/ yang mdun nas phyir —268

lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i 'khrid kyi zin bris bstan pa rgyas byed ces bya ba/ 6)ring thung shin tu thung ba bus rjes 'brel nas nang du rdul pa yang ring thung shin tu thung pa ste gsum bya'o/ /mthar mgo snyed skyed pa bya/ gnyis pa ni/ gzugs la blta ba sogs lnga bzhag /gzhan rig ma dag pa nas dbab pa'i bar sngar ltar la bzhugs stangs bshad ma thag pa'i tsog pu bya/ gung mdzub g.yasaganyis 'jib tshe mig g.yon gdangs/ cig shos kyang de las bzlog pa byas pas 'dzin no/ /gsum pa ni/ glang chen hing zhes pa/ rkang mthil gyi sbo sar btsugs rting pa'i steng du phongs tshos bzhag /he hong gis lte ba/ de bzhin du hūṃ hūṃ/ ha ha gi /hi hi gis byang sems spyi bo'i bar du drang ngo / /seng ge rnam rolazhes pa mthe bong / mdzub mo/ gung mo/ srin mdzub/ mthe'u chung gi rim pa ltar/ mig /rna ba/ sna/ yasamachu/ mas mchu rnams bkab la mgo g.yas skor gsum/ g.yon skor gsum/ yang ma nges par rgyun ring bar 'khor ro/ /de ltar nyams su blangs pas lta ba dga' bzhi la/ phyi go rim la bltos pa ni/gzugs la blta ba nas reg bya'i bar dga' ba/ 'bol dang ka ko la sbyor ba mchog dga'/ slob pas dga' bral/ de las rtsa thig rlung gsang / gnas bzhi kha sbyor ba lhan skyes kyi dga' ba'o/ /nang gnas la bltos pa'i phyi nang (12ba)gnyis kyi phyi ni/ khol bu dang / phal cher dang / thams cad dang /snang ba thams cad kyi bzhi ga bde bar song ba rim bzhin dga' ba sogs so/ /nang ni snying mgrin lte gsang bzhir sleb pa la rim bzhin dga' ba sogs so/ spang bya ni/ chos brgyad kyi rtogs pa cung zad 'gags pa/ phal cher 'gags pa/ rig ma la chen pa tsam 'gags pa/ dag pa gsum la chen pa 'gags pa rnams kyang sngar ltar rim bzhin no/ /ngo bo la bltos pa ni bde ba cung zad skyes pa/ cher skyes pa bde ba mi rtog pa dang ldan pa/ bde stong zung du 'jug pa rnams sngar ltar ro/ /phyi ma'i gcig po ni skyon med do/ grub mtha' ni/ lta ba de spyod pa gsum gyis nyams su blangs te lam du byas pas/rnal 'byor ba de'i ngo bor khams gsum thams cad bde stong zung 'jug gi rol bar 'char ba ni grub mtha' bde stong rgya chung ngu'o/ /'da' ka ma nam 'chi ba'i tshe rdo rje sems dpa' 'byon par gyur ba la/sbyang bsgom las sbyar gsum las/ dang po ni/ gsang ba bde stong ston pa'i bla ma/ lam dkyil 'khor —269

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)'khor lo/ lte ba bde stong zung 'jug rnams yang yang dran par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ snang mched thob gsum gyi phra ba'i thim rim byung dus bde stong gi lta ba cis kyang nyams su myong bar bya snyam pa la bsgom mo/ gsum pa ni/ sgra dang yi ges 'pho ba bum dbang gi skabs ltar ro/ /thim rim dang bar do'i snang ba thams cad ngo bo bde stong zung 'jug la thig le mu tig gi rdog ma lta bur spyad/ rmi lam sgyu lus kyi snang ba thams cad bde stong zung 'jug tu thag bcad cing bsgom mo/ /de rnams kyis khamasa'adus par bar ma'i lam chod/ khams bdud (13na tshe'i 'gros thim/ sa brgyad pa dang dgu pa ma ro zhe du byas/ bdud rtsi gnas gyur/ 'bras bu chos sku mngon du byed do/ /legs pa'i blo gros sa de mngon gyur pa'i/ /thabs mchog shes rab ye shes lam gyi 'gros/ /zag med bde ba mchog gi dga' ston gyis/ /zung 'jug mgron de ring nas ring bsu bzhin/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi nyams len rnams gsung sgros ltar bkod zin to/ /khams 'dus pa tha ma skyon med gnyug ma ye shes kyi lam gyis khrid pa'am/ dbang bzhi pa'i lam mam rdo rje rba rlabs kyi ni/ rdo rje stong pa nyid dang / rba rlabs ni lam de bsgoms pas snang ba thamasacad bde stong mchog gi lam du bsgyur nas stong pa nyid las gzhan ma yin pa'i phyir/ de skad ces bya ste dper na rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs dang lha ba'i 'phreng ba la sogs pa ji snyed 'byung yang de las khrung zhing thim kyang de la thim pas chu bur chu yi yin te/ de las tha dad min pa bzhin no/ /de nyams su len pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum/ dang po ni/ khrid kyi sngon 'gro sngar dang 'dra/ a gyi sngon 'gro bsgom pa gsum dang / gnad la dbab pa gsum sngar byas rjes/ rab 'phrin las sum cu so gnyis lugs 'byung lugs ldog 'tshol ba dang bcas pa'i tshar gsum grub par bya/ ma grub na yan lag lnga sbyor ba bya'o//gnyis pa dngos gzhi la 'og rlung bskum pa lus kyi rba rlabs ni/ lag gnyis pus mo'i steng du bkab/lte ba rgal tshigs la sbyar/ sna nas rlung drag tu phyir 'bud pa gsum nang du rngub pa gsum byas kha sbyar bzung tshe 'og rlung dal bus drangs la drag tu 'then 'phongs mtshos g.yas g.yon re mos kyis 'degs —270

lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i 'khrid kyi zin bris bstan pa rgyas byed ces bya ba/ (tha)'jog byas mnan/ de bzhin du g.yas (13ba〉na yon du'ang de 'dra re bya'o/ /gsum ga la kha sbyar ba phyir gtong tshe 'og rlung sngon du gtong / de goms pas 'og rlung btang kyang steng rlung mi 'chor ba 'byung bas bum can zhabs rtsags ma zer ro/ /thun grangs med tshad med du nyams su blangs pas/ lus la bde ba dang sems la rtogs pa 'char/ de'i rkyen gyis khams 'dzag pa byung na/ ro stod drag tu gcu ba dang / mig gyen du bltas pas sel lo/ /gnyis pa ngag 'dren pa zhi drag gi rba rlabs las/ dang po ni/rdo rje skyil krung khu tshur snying gar bsnol/ lus cung zad skur bar byas la/ so bar nas rlud gi gdangasa.i'i rnam pa la sgra med du rngubs/ shugs rdzogs pa dang lus bsrangs te mgo bo snyed skyed pa gnyis bya zhing /'og rlung kyang rdzogs par 'then nas kha sbyor lta ba'i ngang du bzhag /spro na g.yas g.yon du byas kyang chog /drag po ni 'dug stangs sngar las rlung gi gdangs hūṃ gi sgrar bsam sgra bcas su 'dren bzhin sngar dang 'dra/ gnyis ka la rang lhar gsal ba'i rdo rje'i rtse nas rlung 'od zer kha dog lnga pa byung nas lte ba brgyud rim gyis spyi bor thim par bsam mo/ /gsum pa ting nge 'dzin sems kyi rba rlabs la/ rig ma dag pa nas rdo rje'i rtser dbang pa'i bar sher dbang ltar la/ byang chub kyi sems de gnyis 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa rlung gi rang bzhin du gyur nas ro ma'i lam nas g.yas skor gyis lte ba'i 'khor la g.yas su lan gsum bskor bas khams dkar po'i nus pas nam langs pa ltar/ dmar po'i nus pas nyi ma shar ba lta bu dang / rlung gi nus pas rgyu ma phus brgyangs pa ltar byas/ de nas bor rtsa 'khor bar rigs 'gre/ de nas 'od zer spyi bo nas phyir song ste snod (14na bzhal yas khang du gyur/bcud kyi sems can la dbang bskur te lhar gyur/ sems can de rnams kyang 'od zer gyi rnam par byas nas 'od zer lnga ldan dang mnyam du mar byung / rkyang ma nas g.yon skor du thur la spyi bor rtsa 'khor nas gsang gnas yan sngar ltar byas/ yang dbu ma'i lam brgyud spyi bo'i bar du song bas rim bzhin mas nas rang lus 'ja' 'od du gyur pas bsam zhing 'dzin med du 'jog /las rgya dngos su yod na bdag rgyud g.yin rgyud gnyis ga'i rgyud dag pa'i dbang du byas na/ rig ma la yang dmigs pa —271—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)de dag byed cing spyi bo nas phyir spro ba de mi dgos so/ /de lta bu'i 'od kha dog lnga ldan de ro mar drangasapas ro ma dbang du 'dus/ rtsol ba la dbang thob/ rnam par thar pa mtshan ma med pa mngon du byed/rkyang mar drangs pas rkyang ma dang / srog la/ smon pa med pa gsum la sngar ltar byed/ dbu mar drangs pas dbu ma dang rlung gnas pa/ rnam par thar pa stong pa nyid la sngar ltar ro/ /de dag las byung ba'i lta ba ni/ chos thams cad shin tu rnam par dag pa mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi ni/ rgyu mthun gyis ni skra dkar 'joms/ /rnam smin gyi ni stobs rab ster/ /skyes bur byed pas stobs rab 'phel/ /dri ma bral bas 'chi med ster/ /zhes pa ltar/ khams dkar dmar lte bar byed pas/ lte ba me long gi ngos ltar 'jam pa sen mos kyang bzung bar mi nus/ skra dkar dang gnyer ma med pa'i gzhen sha chags pa/snying gar byon pas sred med kyi bu'i stobs sam glang po che khyu mchog gis kyang 'gran par mi bzod pa dang stobs 'phel/ mgrin par brtan pas lces gdong (14ba/bebs pa/ spyi bor brtan pas lo stong thub pa 'byung ngo / /sems la phan gdags pa ni/ yang sngar gyi gnas bzhi por rim par brtan pas/rang gi rig pa bde stong du 'char/ snang ba thams cad bde stong / myangs ba'i ro thams cad 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bde stong zung 'jug 'ba' zhig tu 'char ro/ /lus sems gnyis ga'i yon tan ni yang rim pa ltar/ mthong na mi mthun pa med cing yid du 'ong ba/ mngon shes cung zad 'char/ro thams cad la longs spyod par nus/ rdzu phral sna tshogs ston nus so/ /spyod pa gsum sngar ltar spyad pa dang / lha dang bla mas lung bstan pa'i pad+ma can sogs gzhung nas byung ba bzhin du spyod pa bskyangs pas grub mtha' bde stong rgya chen po mthar 'bras bu'i dbang slangs ba la brten nas bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa mngon du byed do/ /'da' ka ma phyag rgya chen po nas 'pho ba la sbyang bsgom sbyar gsum las/ dang po ni/ bla ma chos thams cad shin tu rnam par dag pa'i lta ba ston pa'i bla ma/ lam lta ba mas bstan gyi dga' bzhi yang yang dran par bya/ gnyis pa ni/ lta ba bde stong mchog tu gyur pa yang yang dran par bya'o/ /gsum pa la/ yi ge dang sgras 'pho ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bu gar gur zhag —272

lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i 'khrid kyi zin bris bstan pa rgyas byed ces bya ba/ 6)pa sngar ltar rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi yi ge dang bcas pa gtum mo 'thug po ltar bya/ ro rkyang gi nang du ha k+ṣa spangs pa'i kā li thur bstan dkar po/ /ā li gyen bstan dmar po/ /de yang ka kha a gha ā zhes pa lta bu ā (15na 'di ltar yod pa re re gsal gdab/ rtsol ba'i rlung phyir song ba'i tshe/ stod rlung rnams spyi mgrin gyi 'khor lo la thim/ srog nang du 'jug tshe snying lte'i 'khor lo la thim par bsam/sgras 'pho ba ni/ dngos gzhi de ba la srog rtsol gyi tshab tu hi ka kha a gag ha dang ka hi byed do/ /phyi dbugasachad pa'i tshod kyi tshe grogs kyis gsal btab pa la brten nas sngar gyis nyams myong gis rkyen byas pas 'bras bu thob pa ni phyag rgya chen po nas 'pho ba'o/ /bar do dang rmi lam rgyu lus gsum ni/ bde stong zung 'jug gi ye shes la rnam byang sogs de dang de'i skabs su gyur pa'o/ /sa bcad phyi ma rnams dang / lam dang 'bras bu brnyes tshus ni gzhung bzhin no/ /sku bzhi mngon gyur zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang //'grub bya bzhi pa'i lam gyi rim pa rnams/ /dpal ldan chos skyong ngur smig rnam rol ba'i/ /mkhasagrub dam pa'i gsung rgyun 'di bzhin bkod/ /dbang bzhi pa'i lam nyams len gyi rim pa mtha' dag ma tshang ba med par bshad zin to/ /thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i nyams len kun/ /legs par bshad pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi /gsung ngag gzhi lam 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i nye ba'i lam/ /tshul 'di kha ba'i ljongs su 'byog mi dang / /rje btsun brtse ba chen po sa skya pa/ /brgyud par bcas pas nyi zla lngar gsal yang / /deng dus yongs su rdzogs pa nyin skar bzhin/ /tshogs bshad tshig gi sbun pa'i bshad yams tsam/ /ma yin snying po'i nyams len slob bshad ces/ kha'u brag rdzongs bzhed srol 'khrul med kyis/ /phyogs dus kun tu khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /'di dag rnams ni mus chen sems dpa' chen pos bdag chen rdo rje 'chang la thun mong ma yin par stsal ba'i slob bshad dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i yang thun mong ma yin pa yab 'jam dbyangs chos rje nas brgyud pa'i zab gnad rnams dang bcas te dmigs rim rnams phyogs gcig tu za hor ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos bkod pa yin gyi/ lung sbyor sogs rgyas par spro dgos pa rnams —273
mi mdzad pa

zab lam 'pho ba'i man ngag mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i them skas/ (thadazab lam 'pho ba'i man ngag mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba bsdo/gas/na mo badz+ra ḍā gi snu/ dpal ldan phun tshogs zab don 'byor pa'i mdzod/ /lhun grub skal bzang gdul bya smin mdzad pa'i/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po ras chen pa/ /zab don gdams pa'i gter gyur phyag gi yul/ /ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs ga tho ne nu'i mkhyen dpyod can/ /dus kun bkra shis dam pa'i chos kyi mdzod/ /kun dga'i dga' ston stsol ba'i rdo rje 'dzin/ khyab bdag bla ma rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs/ /rnal 'byor dbang mo'i zhal lung byin rlabs kyi/ /drod ldan mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs zil dngar can/ /'da' ga'i nyams len them skas la brten nas/ /mkha' spyod bsgrub pa'i gdams pa bshad kyi nyon/ /de la 'dir 'da' ka ma'i nyams len rnams kyi nang nas zab pa las kyang ches zab pa 'pho ba ni gu mar grags pa'i zab khrid nyams su len par byed pa la/ yid ches shing khungs btsun par bya ba'i phyir brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang / de las 'ongs pa'i gdams pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ dbyangs can mas rjes su bzung ba'i paṇ+ḍita chen po bo dong pa 'jigs med grags pa'am phyogs las (2na)rnam rgyal zhes mtshan gyi rnga dbyangs phyogs bral gyi rna bar 'god pa gang de'i slob ma'i mchog grub pa'i dbang phyug ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po de/ rje bo dong pa zhing khams gzhan du 'phos pa'i rkyen gyis thugs skyo nas 'du 'dzi'i rnam g.yeng mtha' dag bskyungs te rdo rje phag mo'i bsgrub pa zhig mdzad pas/ bsgrub pa 'thon khar dngos nyams kyi mtshan ma la/ byams chen chos rjesarjes su 'dzin par 'dug pas gtsang byams chen du song zer ba zhig byung bas lung bstan tshad mar mkhyen te byon pa na/ chos rje grags pa ba'i brang khang du byams chen chos rje gdan drangs 'dug pa'i lam du bsgug sdod byas pas/ dar cig nas byams chen chos rje phebs byung bar rgyu mtshan zhus pas/—275

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)khyod spyo ba'am 'brul pa zhig yin pa 'dra gsung bar zhabs la 'jus te nan gyis gsol ba btab pas/ 'o na do nub brtag pa byed pas skugs shig gsungs/ sang nang par tsha ba sogs bdag rkyen thugs la btags nas/ khyod kyi lung bstan de rnam dag yin par 'dug kyang de nga dang las 'brel che bar mi 'dug pas phan mi thogs/ bde chen steng du a mo sngags mkhan ma bya ba yod pas des rjes (2ba〉kyi 'dzin pas song gsung pa ltar byon/ bu mo zhig 'dug par gtam dris pas/ a ma grong chog la byon nas med/ don gal che bar yod na zhag gnyis gsum las mi 'gyangs bas 'dir sgugs nged kyi 'tsho ba 'dren gsung pa ltar de nub bzhugs pa'i rmi lam du/ lcags phag nag po zhig rmis/ nang par bu mo la gshad pas a ma 'byon pa'i rtags yin zer/ nyi ma gung la zin tsam la a ma yon bdag gi glang la zhen nas byon byung bar phyag btsal zhing rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ khyod spyo ba'am 'brul ba zhig 'dug /'on kyang do nub brtag pa byed pas sgugs gsungs/ sang nang par nga dang las 'brel che bar mi 'dug pas/ shangs na bu mo lo bcu drug tsam lon pa'i mtshan ldan zhig yod pas/ de'i drung du song rjes su 'dzin zhes lung bstan pa ltar shangs kyi mda' nas lha phu'i bar du btsal yang ma rnyed/phyir 'tshol kyin log byon pas/ thang mgo brag sne zhig tu bu mo spa thums 'khur ba zhig dang phrad pa lung bstan dang mthun byung nas phyag btsal zhing na bza' nas 'jus te lo rgyus zhus pas/ khyod rnal 'byor pa spyon pa zhig 'dug pa lam du 'gro ba mi gtong bar/ gzhan gyis mthong na nged rang gnyis la 'phyas smod kyang byed zer/ nan gyi gsol ba btab pas/ 'o na gsang sngags zab mo'i chos zhu bar tshogs kyi 'khor lo dgos pas a yod gsung bar/ da lta ma mchis pas zhag gcig gnyis kyi bar rtsol ba zhig byed lags zhus pas/ des mi 'ong ba lta dgos gsungs te shug pa zhig rgyab song bas/pha ri tshu ri nas rdzi bo bu tsha bu mo mang po bos byung ste/ de rnams kyi mdzar ba blug pa'i snod kyi nang nas/ sha /chang/ zan sogs longs (3na snyad r+ṣa po spungs byung ba la tsho gos kyi 'khor lor mdzad gdams pa zab mo rdzogs par gnang / khyad par zab mo 'pho ba'i man ngag 'di/ dbus gtsang ru —276

zab lam 'pho ba'i man ngag mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i them skas/ 6)bzhi/ nyang long kong gsum sogs su/ la phrad la ru thob/ lung phrad lung du thob gsungs nas/ bu mo sogs thams cad 'ja' yal pa ltar gyur/ de nas lung bstan ltar phyogs med du 'gro don mdzad pas/ 'pho ba btab pa rnams la spyi gtsug rdol te 'jag ma btsugs chog pa byung bas 'pho ba 'jag btsugs mar grags/ yar lung gad pa steng du bu mo zhig nang mi dang ma mthun par gyur pa la gdams pa 'di bstan pas mkha' spyod du song ba sogs lo rgyus shin du mang / rje ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po nas bzung ste rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du brgyud pa zam ma chad/ gdams pa'i chu bo ma nub/ byin rlabs kyi drod ma yal ba'i lo rgyus ngo mtshar ba mang yang 'dir ma spros so/ /gnyis pa la de las 'ongs pa'i gdams pa dngos ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ nyin re bram ze gsod pa dang / /mtshams med lnga yi byed pa dang / /brku 'phrog 'dod la spyod pa yang / /lam 'di yis ni dag 'gyur te/ /sdig pas gosapar mi 'gyur zhing / /srid pa'i skyon las ring du grol/ /zhes phan yon rgya cher bsngags pa dang mthun pa'i nyams len la/ sngon 'gro sbyang ba'i rim pa dang / dngos gzhi las la sbyang ba gnyis/ dang po la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa gsum las/ dang po sngon du 'gro ba skyabs sems kyi rim pa ni/phyag len ltar rgyas bsdus skabs su sbyar bar bya/ gnyis pa ni/ rang gi lus man shel gyi mdog ltar dwangs gsal rnyog pa med pa'i sum mdo nas spyi gtsug (3bston bar rtsa dbu ma phra sbom mda' smyug tsam pa/ phyi dkar nang dmar/ bar sngo ba 'ja' tshon lta bu/ sum mdo'i thad du pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar rang sems kyi ngo bo yi ge āḥdakar po dngas shing 'tsher ba snum la 'gril bar gsal btab/ spyi bor rje btsun rdo rje phag mo mkha' spyod ma sku mdog dzi wa ga'i me tog ltar dmar ba/zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ phyag g.yas pa rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug gi rtse thur du bstan pa 'dzin pa/g.yon gyis thod pa dkar po rak+tas bkang ba nam mkha' la 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis bsnams pa/ yab dpa' bo sbas pa'i tshul gyis kha ṭ+wāṃ ga phrag par bkal ba/ zhabs gnyis bgrad pa/ zhal dang bha ga nas rak+ta 'bab pa/ lang tsho dar la babs shing nu 'bur zung dang ldan pa/ bde ba skyed pa'i nyams —277

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)can/ thal ba spangs pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par mos/ de nas 'jam rlung cung zad bzung ste rtsa lam nas rnam shes bskul bas/ 'phar yed med 'dar lheb lteb yod par bsam/ yar bltas pa'i rkyen gyis dad pa dang mos dung sogs byas te gsol ba gdab pa ni/ chos sku rdo rje lang chen la gsol ba 'debs/ /longs sku rdo rje phag mo la gsol ba 'debs/ /sprul sku mkha' 'gro ni gu la gsol ba 'debs/ /ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas grub bya bral chos rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtshungs med bsam gtan klong pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /drin can bkra shis rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs/ /rigs 'dzin kun dga' tshe mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /rje btsun ye shes grub pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dbyangs bkra sa kun dga' la gsol ba 'debs/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam (4na 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /'phyugs med mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba btab cing rlung gis bskul ba dang / a a hi ka ces brjod pa'i sgra dang bcas te/ a yig de nyid dbu ma'i lam brgyud lte bar slebs/ de nas snying ga mgrin pa spyi bo'i bar du 'phos nas/ slar yang hika ka zhes pa'i sgra dang bcas te 'bebs so/ /sbyangs pa'i dgos pa ni gdan bzhi las rim la sogs pas ma phog par 'pho ba sbyong ba mchog yin no zhes pa ste/ thog ma nas nyams 'og tu tshud par ma sbyangs na ji lta ba mi 'byung ngo / /mjug gi nyams len spyi ltar la/ de ltar nan tan du nyams su blangs pas 'byongs pa'i rtags spyi gtsug zla ba/ phrig pa/ chu ser 'bab pa/ thod mtshams na ba/ shes pa bzi thom me ba/ brgyal ba sogs byung na thal gyi dogs pa yod pas mtshams 'jog cing / thal bar nye ba'i rtags byung na spyi gtsug tu rin po che 'gebs pa dang / rlung 'bud pa/ rkang mthil brdung ba/ rdo tshan sogs kyi gdugs bya/ gcig pur sbyangs na thal nyen che bas grogs med par mi byed/ 'byongs rjes rgyun du nyams su blangs na tshe la gzan pas ma gsung ngo / /dngos gzhi las la sbyor ba ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ dus la bab na —278

zab lam 'pho ba'i man ngag mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i them skas/ 6)'pho bya ste/ dus min lha rnams gsod par 'gyur/ lha rnams bsad pa tsam gyis ni/ /dmyal bar ngesapar sreg par 'gyur/ /de bas 'chi ba'i mtshan ma ni/ /mkhas pas 'bad de shes par bya/ /zhesagasungs pa ltar/ phyi nang gsang ba'i 'chi ltas kyi mtshan ma rnams byung na/ 'chi bslu nye'u 'don pa/byu gtor ma'i cho ga gsung (4ba)rab bklags/ spom thag sogs dge ba rgya chen pos bzlog pa'i thabs la 'bad/ 'chi bslu byas kyang mi bzlog pa'i mtshan ma brtan po mthong na nyams su blang bar bya dgos pas/ sngon 'gros rgyud dag par byas nas/ dngos gzhi la/ phaṭa ces brjod pas rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba snying ga nas rgyangs te 'thon de nyid kyis rang gi phung po rnying pa/ che ba/ tsho ba/ snum pa de la gzigs nas phaṭa ces brjod pa'i gyi gug gis mgo bo gtubs te/skyid po ri rab tsam pa gsum gyi tshul du byas pa'i steng du rim pa bzhin du phaṭa kyi sgra dang bcas pa gri gug gi smin mtshams nas bregs te thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba stong gsum dang mnyam pa zhig btsugs pa'i nang du/ rked pa yan gyi lus kyi cha shas rnams gtubs te blag pas sha'i ri bo/ rus pa'i gram grod/ khrag gi rgya mtsho chen por gyur par mos te/ cha āḥ〉 ha lho hrī༅ga brjod cing / g.yasapa'i gri gug gis dkrugs/ g.yon pa'i thod pas 'phyar bas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par mos/ phem rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ mgron rigs bzhi rnams spyan drangs shing bkug pas mdun gyi steng 'og bar gsum gang bar mos/ de nas lus thams cad la rim pa ltar mchod pa 'bul ba dang sbyin pa rgya chen po btang bas thugs mnyes shing tshim par bsam/mchod yul mchod rdzas mchod pa po thams cad la mi dmigs pa'i rgyas btab ste cung zad mnyam par bzhag /de nas dkyus ltar las lus smad gzhu'i dbyibs can gyi rnam pa rtsa dbu ma'i yar sne rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa (ldan7na pad+ma'i nang du tshud par bsam/ gzhung ltar bskul gsol gyi rkyen gyis/pad+ma nas byung ba'i 'od zer dmar po'i sne la khams dmar bo sran ma tsam sba thag btang ba lta bu nar gyis byung / a yig la reg pas khyab len gyis lcags 'dren pa ltar dang / dkyus bzhin lte ba sogs—279

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)nas yar rim pa ltar song ba dang dus mnyam par/ rkang mgo rkang la thim/ rkang brla la thim/ brla khog smad la thim/ khog smad dbu ma la thim/ de'i tshe rnam shes dang rtsa thams cad lhan cig tu hika dang bcas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs kur 'phos par mos shing / de nas phaṭa lan gsum gyi dang pos thugs rgyud bskul/ gnyis par gar stabs dang bcas te 'byon par mngon du phyogs gsum pas mkha' spyod kyi gnas su skar mda' 'phangs pa ltar gshegs par bsam mo/ /gsum pa mjug gi rim pa ni/ gang zag gzhan la phan gdags par 'dod na/ phung po nyal stabs can de blos drang por yod par bsams/ dmigs pa kha spo ba ma gtogs khyad par med la/ dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gyis rgyas btab bo/ /glen lkugs dang dud 'gro sogs la dmigs pa zur du bya ba ni man ngag zhal shes ltar ro/ /gsol 'debs spros pa che bar 'dod na/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rje btsun rdo rje 'ams / /rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje phag mo dang / /bde chen ye shes bskyed mdzad ni gu ma/ /snying nas gsolab 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs/ /'jigs skrag bar do'i 'phrang las bskyab tu gsol/ /zab lam 'pho ba wongs par byin gyis rlomes/ /'phyugs med dag pa mkha' spyod gnas mchog der/ /thogs (5ba)med drongs shig bla ma yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gros rjes bzung ras chen dpal 'byor bzang / /chos brgyad 'ching ba kun grol bya bral rje/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i dbang phyug bsam gling pa/ /snying nasagaso lob 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs/ /'jigs skrag bar do'i 'phrang las bskyab tu gsol/ /zab lam 'phob longs par byin gyis rlobs/ /khrugs med dag pa mkha' spyod gnas mchog der/ /thogs med drongs shig bla ma yi dam lha/ /mkhan chen dam pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / /ras chung rnam sprul bkra shis rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /gdams pa'i bang mdzod kun dga' tshe mchog rje/ snying nasagasol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs/ /'jigs skrag bar do'i 'phrang las bskyab tu gsol/ /zab lam 'pho ba ldongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /'phyugs med dag pa mkha' spyod gnas mchog der//thogs med drongs shig bla ma yi dam lha/ /ngag gi dbang phyug ye shes grub pa'i zhabs/ /gsang chen —280

zab lam 'pho ba'i man ngag mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i them skas/ thenabastan pa'i nyi ma ā nan+da/ /gang shar rang sar grol ba'i rig pa 'dzin/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs/ /'jigs skrag bar do'i 'phrang las bskyab tu gsol/ /zab lam 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /khrugs med dag pa mkha' spyod gnas mchog der/ /thogs med drongs shig bla ma yi dam lha/ /dal ba'i rten bzang rnyed dka' 'jig pa sla/ /srid pa bar do'i 'phrang ring 'jigs pa che/ /mtha' med 'khor ba sdug bsngal mtshor shes nas/ /gam skyabs mchag rnams la snying nas gsol 'debs na/ /da lta nyid du mkhyen brtse'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /myur ba nyid du byin rlabs mthu dpung skyed/ /'dug sa 'di nas mkha' spyod gnas su khrid/ /skad cig nyid la bde chen sa ru sbyor/ zhes gsol ba btab kyang rung ngo / /deng sang bla ma ma bsten par dpe cha la bla ma bcol nasanyams len byed pa mang bas/ de ni brgyud pa'i byin rlabs med cing chos la dbang bza' ba dang rang gzhan gnyis gar phan par mi 'gyur la/ rgyun med chos kyis rgyal khams gang nyen yod pas snod min la bka' rgya gal che'i/ smras pa/ tshe 'dir kha sbyor bdun ldan ma wa zhe byed pa'i/ /lam bzang rdo rje theg dang mjal gyur yang / /blo dang brtson pa zhan pas don med dang / /'jig rten pha rol bgrod pa'i skye bo mang / /stobs dang 'byor pa'i bsod nams phun tsho gos shing / /tshig bshad snyan (6na tha'i pi waṃ brdung mkhas kyang / /nyams len drod rtags 'thon pa'i gnad med na/ /bar do'i 'phrang der ngal zhing dub pa mang / /dpe 'khyam sna tshogs bsdus pa'i bshad yam dang / /'grig 'grig rang bzo'i kha bshad mang po yis/ /mi shes blun po'i mgo bo bskor ba dang / /'brul med brgyud pa'i zab chos 'di mi 'dra/ /de phyir skal ldan mang por phan pa'i ched/ /man ngag yi ge'i 'phreng bar spel ba la/ /chosasrungs mkha' 'gros bzod par mdzad nas kyang / /dus kun dge ba'i bkra shis char du phob/ /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu mas ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po la dngos su stsal ba'i zab lam 'pho ba'i man ngag yi ger bkod pa mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i them skas zhes pa 'di ni/ rgya chen rgyud sde rgya mtshor rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa'i zha lu ri phug gi slob dpon rin cen bsod nams mchog grub —281

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)la nyams khrid bgyis skabs bskul ba ltar za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo// zhes pa 'di ni zla 12tshes17la zha lu ri phug du sbyar/—282

nye brgyud tshe khrid 'chi med rdo rje'i srog shing khrigs su bsdebs pa/ thenanye brgyud tshe khrid 'chi med rdo rje'i srog shing khrigs su bsdebs pa bzhugs/ /na ma ā yum na sirnyi pra yas phun tshogs 'chi ba med pa lang tsho'i bcud/ /skal bzang snying gi yol gor legs 'khyil ba'i/ /byed po bla ma mgon po tshe dpag med/ /chos kyi 'bor lo'i pad mtshor brtan par bzhugs/ /bsod nams bye ba'i chu gter bsrubs pa las/ /sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i wo byed dbang / /wen las 'od stong rgya mtsho'i gos ga ༅/ /yongs khyab rje bas bla ma rdo rje lang //dpal ldan gsang ba gsum gyi 'byor ba'i mdzod/ /zung 'jug dbang gi rgyal por mnga' sgyur ba'i/ /bde chen lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mchog /rab rgyas drin can bla mar phyag bgyid do/ /tshe dpag med mgon mes po'i thod yangs las/ /legs 'ongs ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gaṅgā'i klung / /'thung mkhasapad 'byung dzaḥs skyugs pa'i chab/ /nyer bsten nor 'dzin dpal ldan rdo rje las/ /gsung ngag lam las nye bar 'ongs pa dag /ches zab thugs kyi rgya mtshor rab sim pa'i/ /rje tsun bla ma las 'ongs snyan brgyud kyi/ /tshe khrid bri la chos srung gnang ba stsol/ /de'ang nye brgyud tshe khrid 'chi med rdo rje'i srog shing 'di nyid bri ba la/ yid ches shing khungs btsun par bya ba (2na〉sgo rgyus dang / de las 'ongs pa'i gdams pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes zhes bya ba/nyi zla'i khri stan gdugs rgyan drug sogs dang ldan pas mtshan nyi zla dngos grub dang / g.yin yang lasakyi dbang mo cher grags pa la/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi dbang zhus pas/ yi ge hūṃ du bsgyur te mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal du mid pa dang / phyi sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi ngo bo 'chi med tshe'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i dbang / nang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi ngo bo phyag rgya chen po mchog gi —283—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)dngos grub kyi dbang / gsang ba dpal rta mgrin gyi ngo bo lha srin bran du 'khol ba'i dbang rnams thob pa las/ de gsum ga'i don 'dus pa'i tshe sgrub 'chi med rdo rje'i srog shing 'di nyid/ slob dpon chen pos grub chen dpal ldan rdo rje zhes 'ja' lus kyi sku brnyes pa de la dngos su gnang / de nyid kyis 'bras spungs nyi 'od 'khyil bas gzims chung du thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dpal bzang po la gnang / dam pa de nyid la rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag 'khon ston rdo rje 'chang chen po dpal (2bskor1ra lhun grub kyis gsan/ de nyid kyis las ldan gyi slob ma du mar spel yang / mkhyen dpyod dang ldan pa de gnyis ma gtogs phal cher gyis gsung rgyun 'dzin pa ma byung zhing / sngon chad gsung ngag ma gtogs yi ge'i ris su bkod pa mi snang ba nas/ chos 'di mi nub cing gzhan la phan pa'i phyir du yi ge'i ris su bkod pa'o/ /gnyis pa de las 'ongs pa'i gdams pa la rang nyid kyi tshe bsgrub pa dang / slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ paṅgān+ta spo ta kyi sngags kyis bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma dang ru dra bsnol ba'i steng du rang nyid skad cig gisadabang drug pad+ma rta mgrin g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ rta mgo ljang zhus rta skad 'tsher ba/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ bgegs gtor bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas khyad par du byas par gyur/ oṃ sarba bi na sogs lan gsum brjod cing / hrīḥ gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs rnams gnas 'di sa /ma 'dug gtor ma 'di khyer gzhan du dengs/ /gal te mi 'gro dbang chen khros pa'i bkas/ /thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par 'gyur/ /sum+bha sogs kyis bgegs bskrad/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams ma lus rdo rje dang / khro bo kha dog sna lnga'i me dpung gis/ /bar mtshams med par gtams pa'i srung ba yi/ /'khor lo'i gur khang mtshams las ma 'da' zhig /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swāhā/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa dkyus bzhin byas/ tshogs zhing ni/ rang nyid dbang chen —284

nye brgyud tshe khrid 'chi med rdo rje'i srog shing khrigs su bsdebs pa/ 6)du gsal ba 'od du (3na〉nu ba las mgon po tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i thugs ka las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i tshe dpag med kyi lha tshogs rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a lha nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ gang drin ma dang / 'jig rten 'dren pa/phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang sogs brjod/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ byin 'bebs ni/ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas/ /bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med/ /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub ma lus pa/ /dus 'dir bdag cag rnams la stsal du gsol//sgrub pa'i dam rdzas snod bcud ma lus par/ /tshe bkrag gzi mdangs nus pa'i rtsal kun phob/ /dbang chen bskur la sdig sgrib bar chad sol/ /re ba'i 'bras bu tshe yi rigs 'dzin stsol/ /ye shes rang snang grub pa'i pho brang nas/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug gsang ba ye shes kyis/ /lhag ma rnams rigs 'gre/pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas khang chen nas/ /slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng tshe dbang rtsal/ /mtho brtsegs rdo rje gsang ba'i gzhal med nas/ khung 'jug sku brnyes dpal ldan rdo rje'i zhabs/ khru 'dzin nyi 'od 'khyil ba'i gzhal med nas/ /rgyal ba kun dngos bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde/ /byang chub shing khrod de wi ko ṭi nas/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang 'bon ston chos kyi rje/ /spyi gtsug pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng nas/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon/ /sgrub rdzas mchod gtor rnams byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang gi thugasaka nas spros pa'i raṃ yaṃ kho gyis sgrub rdzas mchod gtor rnams kyi ma dag pa'i nyes skyon rnams sbyangs/ngo bo zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi la/ /(3bsgom pa rang rang gi bde las dang nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥ&/ rten bskyed pa ni/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du baṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid yi ge hrī:dmar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mnyam gzhag gi steng na 'chi ba med pa tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo —285

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan dang mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyis spras pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa sgeg pa'i nyams can/ 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugasakur hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer los pas/ bde ba can nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shesapa spyan drangs/ dzaḥ& baṃ sngo gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ zhes pa nas/ snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ i rnyiḥrā ga badz+ra ji nas shabha dang / rū pa nas spar+sha'i bar gyis mchode/ 'jig rten 'dren pa sogs kyis bstod/ tshe nyams pa gso ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra ha/ ka ra ri/ sha ra ri/ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ a ma ra ṇi rdzu wa khyi ye swāhā/ gzungs ring dang bcas bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ de nas tshe 'gugs pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas te/ 'chi ba med pa'i mgon po tshe yi lha/ /tshe yi khra gi gsang ba ye shes ma/ /'byung ba lnga la dbang sgyur lha mo lngas/ /'chi med tshe (4na tshe yi 'phrin las dus la bab/ /drag mo'i lasamadzad sngon mo 'bum de yis/ /'byung ba nam mkha'i bcud bsdus tshe srog khug /gdon bgegs lha 'dresa'akhyer ba'i tshe srog khug /brtan g.yo'i tshe dang bsod nams dbang du sdus/ /de bzhin du thams cad lasamadzod ljang mo 'bum sde/ dbang gi las mdzad dmar mo 'bum sde/ zhi ba'i las mdzad dkar mo 'bum sde/ rgyas pa'i las mdzad ser mo 'bum sde/ 'byung ba rlung / me/ chu sa zhes 'don pa bsgyur ro/ /sra brtan rdo rje lta bu'i tshe srog khug /legs tshogs dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i g.yang skyobs shig /nyamasadang zad dang 'thor dang yar ba yi/ /tshes gsos tshe khug tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /zhes brjod/ tshe bcing zhing sba ba bsrung ba rnams bya'o/ /gnyis pa slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa la/ rten bcas shing bsgrub pa dang / dbang bskur ba dngos/ dang po ni/ stegs bu phyag bdar legs par byas pa'i steng du tshe bum kha rgyan dang ldan pa/ g.yas su tshe chang / g.yon du tshe ril/ mdun du mchod pa/ gzhan yang rdor dril/ ḍā ma sa mda' dar/ me long / las bum/ me tog sogs tshogs par byas/ slob dpon gyis bdag bskyed blangs shing mdun bskyed kyang bsgrub/ las bum du rta mgrin bskyed cing sngags cung zad —286

nye brgyud tshe khrid 'chi med rdo rje'i thog shing khrigs su bsdebs pa/ 6)bzla'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ku me rdo rjes las bum gyi chu brim zhing / slob ma rnams gral du 'khod/ de nasaslob dpon gyis bgegs gtor btang zhing mtshams bcad/ spyi dang bye brag gi chos bshad/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol gdab/ sdom bzung gi bar dkyus bzhin byas/ de nas lha ngo bstan zhing byin rlabs kyi gzhi bkod/ bgegs bsangs/ slob ma lhar bskyed/ byin dbab cing (4ba〉rtan pa'i don du tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod/ de nas badz+ra sa ra ha'i sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum byas rjes/ dbang dngos kyi don du slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhesalan gsum gsol ba btab/ de nas tshe 'gugs pa nas bzung ste dam tshig dang sdom pa gso ba'i bar grub rgyal ma'i dbang chog thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dkyus ltar byed/de nas mda' dar dang bcas te tshe 'gugs grub rjes/ bum pa slob ma'i mgo thog tu zhag nas/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i mtshan nas brjod de bka' bsgo zhing lha mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du slob ma la bstim/ tshe chang 'di nyid zhal du gsol ba la brten nas sogs brjod cing / tshe chang dang /tshe yi ril bu zhes sogs brjod nas tshe ril byin/ de nas tshe bcing ba ni/ tshe rten 'od dkar po'i dbus su rnam par shes pa yi ge ṇi'i rnam pa nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor gyi nang du yod pa de nyid/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi thag pas bar mtshams med par bcings par bsams la snying gar rdo rje reg cing / nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor dag /mi byed sra brtan rdo rje yi/ /lu gu rgyud kyis nyer bsdams pas/ /nam yang mi g.yo brtan par gyur/ /zhes dang/ sngags bzla/ de nas tshe spa ba ni/ mda' dar snying gar bzhag cing / thugasaka las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu rang la thim/ de yang gas de 'od/de yi ger de yang 'ja' yal ba ltar bsams la/ gang gis gnod par mi nus pa'i/ /gdod nasadag pa'i stong pa nyid/ /skye ba med pa'i klong yangs su/ /mi 'gyur brtan pa'i tshe sbas so/ /zhes dang /sngags bzla/ de nas tshe bsrung ba ni/ skad cig gis(ldan〉slob ma tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i smin mtshams kyi rtsa sgor dpal rta mgrin gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa 'jigs su rung ba me dpung 'bar —287

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)ba'i dbus na bzhugs pas bar chad thams cad bsrung bar bsams la/ smin mtshams rtsa yi sgo 'phar du rta mgrin khro rgyal dbang gi lha/ /bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid kyis/ /tshe yi bar chad thams cad srangs/ /sngags bzla zhing li khri byug /tshe spel ba ni/ rab yangs mdun gyi nam mkha' la//rtsa ba'i bla ma tshe dpag med/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma sprin ltar 'thibs/ yid dam lha tshogs 'khor gyisabaskor/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro gar stabs bsgyur/ /chos skyong srung ma bran du 'khol/ /snyan pa'i dbyangasakyi 'brug stong ldir/ /bkra shis me tog char du 'bebs/ /'dir 'dus skal ldan chags rnams la/ /'chi med tshe yi bkra shis shog /dpal 'byor snyan grags bkra shis shog /bde chen ye shes bkra shis shog /bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /g.yin yang bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa ci rigs pa bya/ gtso bos ji ltar dang / maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs dkyus bzhin bya'o/ /'di nyid mdor bsdu na/ ye shes pa 'bebs pa yan chad sngar dang 'dra ba la/ dbang dngos kyi skabs su tshe bum la brten nas bskur ba/ tshe chang la brten nas bskur ba/ tshe ril la brten nas bskur ba/ tshe bsrung ba/ tshe spel ba tsam byas kyang yong zhing / de las cung zad rgyas par byed na tshe 'gags pa bsnan pas chag /tshe bum la brten nas tshe bsring ba'i skabs su 'byung ba lnga lhan cig tu bsdu ba dang / yang shin tu bsdu ba byed na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag mtshan bum pa'i nang du zhes sogs kyi skabs su de (5bsko'i 'gros kyis dbang gi tshig thams cad bsdud kyang rung ngo / /gsum pa mjug gi cho ga ni/ gtang rag /gshegs gsol/ dge ba bsngo ba/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /'chi med tshe yi man ngag pad+ma'i gzhung / /dpal ldan rdo rje las 'ongs gdams pa'i bcud/ yongs 'dzan bla ma mchog las brgyud pa 'di/ /gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pas yi ger bkod//dge des dus min 'chi ba'i mun pa'i tshogs/ /tshe dpag med mgon thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis/ /srid pa'i pha mthar bskrad de rdo rje yi/ /rang bzhin sra brtan tshe srog 'grub gyur cig /ces nye brgyud tshe khrid 'chi med rdo rje'i srog shing khrigs su bsdebs pa 'di yang / pho brang gong ri dkar po'i dkon gnyer —288

dpon dge steng bla ma byams pa kun dga' 'byung gnas kyis ring mo nas bskul ba ltar/ za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos dpal ldan 'bras spungs su sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so// sarba maṅga lo//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (3)rnam rgyal 'joms sogs la dgos pa'i gso sbyong gi cho ga bzhugs/su sti sid+dhi/'dir rnam rgyal 'joms sogs kyi skabs thog mar gso sbyong blang ba'i rim pa ni/rnal 'byor pa rnams snga bar khrus byas nas rten la kha phyogs par langs te/rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas spyan drangs par bsam/dngos su phyag bya zhing /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku//rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid//dkon ma rdzo gsum gyi rtsa ba ste//bla ma rnams la phyag la'i lo//bla ma'i sku ni rdo rje'i sku//mdzes shing lta bas cho go mi shes//bsam gyis mi khyab yon to ldan//bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo//bla ma'i gsung ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs/'gog med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan//mu stegs log lta 'joms mdzad pa//bla ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo//bla ma'i thugs ni nam mkha' 'dra//bde gsal mi rtog ngang tshul ldan//rnam thar gsum la legs gnas pa'i//bla ma'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/bla ma sangs 2na rgyas bla ma chos//de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te//kun gyi mdzad pa bla ma yin//bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa//thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po//bsod nams yon to rgya mtsho'i zhing //de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/dag pas 'dod chags bral bar gyur//dge bas ga song las grol cing //gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa//zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo//grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston//bslab pa dag la rab tu gnas//zhing gi dam pa yon to ldan//dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo//ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che//skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che//'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che//bla med dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo//chos sku nam mkha' ༷༷na du dbyer med kyang //gzugs sku 'ja' tshon

rnam rgyal 'joms sogs la dgos pa'i gso sbyong gi cho ga 6)bzhin du so sor gsal//thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i//rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo//sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyob//'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub 'od srungs dang /thu kya thub pa go rta lha yi lha/sangs 2brgyas dpa' bo bdun la phyag 'tshal lo/bskal pa grangs med 'das pa'i dus kyi tshe//phongs gyur 'gro ba mtha' dag skyob pa'i phyir//smon lam khyad par can rnams btab gyur ba'i//bde bar gshegs pa brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo//phyogs bcu'i 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas//phyogs bcur chos kyi 'khor lo legasabaskor bas//phyogs pas 'gro kun yongs su skyob mdzad pa'i//phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//sngon gyi smon lam byang chub rjes spyad pas//mtshan tsam thos pas sgrib pa kun sel ba//'phrin las mnga' ba kun mkhyen 'jig rten mgon//sangs rgyas sum cu lnga la phyag 'tshal lo//mthun pa'i smon lam mchog tu med byung zhing //spyad pa spyod tshe na yang mched gyur la//bskal bzang gcig la mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i//rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong la phyag 'tshal lo//thabs mkhas thugs rje shākya'i rigs su 'khrungs//gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa//gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku/shwakya'i rgyal po khyed la phyag 'tshal lo//rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba//ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra//grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lham me ba//mgon po mchog gyur khyed la phyag 'tshal lo//mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal//gser mdog 'dra ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo//rdul bral khyod 'dra srid pa gsum ma mchis//mnyam med mkhyen chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo//'gro ba'i gnyen gcig ma lus rkang gnyis gtso//dus gsum bde gshegs kun gyi ngo bo nyid//gser gyi mdog can lha yi lhar gyur pa//dam tshig gsum bkod rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo//thugs3na ) rje kun la snyoms pa'i bcom ldan 'das//mtshan tsam thos pas ga 'gro'i sdug bsngal sel//dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla//be+eḍūrla yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo//'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpa/ med//dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms mdzad

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()cing //mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs//sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo//sku gyur pa ni thams cad la//mas mchog sum cu gnyis mnga' zhing //rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grags ldan pa//rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal lo//rdzogs sangs gang du bltams pa dang //gang du byang chub la reg dang //zhi ba'i 'khor lo bskor ba dang //zag med mya ga 'das phyag 'tshal//bde gshegs gang du bzhugs pa dang //'chag pa dang ni bzhengs pa dang //seng ge lta bur gzims pa yi//gnas de la yang phyag 'tshal lo//steng dang 'og dang bar dag dang //phyogs dang phyogs mtshamasarnams su yang //skur bcas sku ni med pa yi//mchod rten rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin//ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid//so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba//dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo//rgyal ba'i bstan pa mkha' ltar yangs pa'i lam//don dam dmigs med spros pa kun las 'das//dbyangs kyi mtshan tsam kun mkhyen ngo bo nyid//dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo//dpal ldan lha mo ston ga'i zla ba'i mdog/zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku//ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma//3bsgom par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo//rnam rgyal 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag/mi g.yo 'dod pa'i rgyal po dbyug sngon can//stobs po che dang lha yi bu gnyis te//rnam rgyal lha tsho gis rnamasal phyag 'tshal lo//gang thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi//rdo rje rin cen kun nas 'bar ba'i mthus//bdud bzhi'i stobs rnams rnam par 'joms mdzad pa//rdo rje rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo//dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku//'gro drug sems can rnams la spyan ras gzigs//nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i bcu gcig zhal//gzi brjid 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo//thugs rje'i dbang phyug 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs//don yod zhags pa khro rgyal rta mgrin dpal/ral gcig ma dang lha mo khro gnyer can//'phags pa lha lnga'i tsho gos la phyag 'tshal lo//'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs/9/sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel//nam mkha'i

rnam rgyal 'jo pas sogs la dgos pa'i gso sbyong gi cho ga 6)snying po byams pa kun tu bzang //nye ba'i sras li brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo//skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar//rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dbu la brgyan//thugs rje can gyis 'gro la gzigs//spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo//gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po//ye shes sgron mes rab brgyan cing //'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel pa//'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo//stobs po che la drag shul che//rig sngags rgyal po dge ba po//'dul dka' ma lus bo pa mdzad pa//rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo//lha dang lha min cod pan gyis//zhabs kyi pad+ma 4nasgo gas cing //phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma//sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo//gang la sems kyi dam pa rin cen de//skyes pa de yi sku la phyag 'tshal zhing //gang la gnod pa byas kyang bder 'brel ba//bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi//dgra bcom blo mchog dbang po kun dul ba//bstan pa'i srid du legs par brtan bzhugs nas//bstan pa 'dzin dang spel dang srung mdzad pa'i//dgra bcom gnas brtan bcu drug la phyag 'tshal//zab mo rten 'brel bcu gnyis legs bsgoms pas//rang byung rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni//brten pa med pa'i tshul gyis thugs chud pa'i//'phags pa rang rgyal rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//rdzu 'phrul stobs dang mngon par shes pa'i dpal//nye bar thob nas thub pa'i bka' bawo du//bstan pa rin cen bang mdzod legs bsrung ba'i//rdo rje chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pas//tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes nas//sgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'bebs pa//nor sbyin rnams la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo//mkha' ltar khyab pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas la//bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa'i//lus 'di zhing rdul mnyam par rab sprul nas//rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo//ji snyed su dag sogs nas/bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod//ces pas phyag bya/de nas rang gnas su 'khod de rol mo ji snyed pa 'bul dkrol bya zhing /me tog dam pa sogs4bskos/rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshe spru mchod par bgyi/zhes brjod/rol mo bzhaX ste/'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)sogs nas/ thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /zhes pas yan lag bdun pa byas la/pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la gtsugs nas
