thal mo sbyar te/ don yid la dran bzhin pas/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rta cang shes lta bu/glang po chen po/ bya ba byas shing byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i bka'/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i thugs/legs par rnam par grol ba'i shes rab can de rnams kyis sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang / phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang / mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub lhag par rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ gso sbyong nges par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi pas kyang / dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du gso sbyong nges par yang dag par blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes pa lan gsum gyis sdom pa blangs la de'i bslab bya 'di rnams bslab snyam pas/ deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing / gzhan gyi nor ni blang mi bya/ /'khrig pa'i chos kyang mi spyad cing / /(5na)rdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o/ /skyon ni mang po nyer bsten pa'i/ /chang ni yongs su spang bar bya/ /khri stan chen po mi bya zhing / /de bzhin dus ma yin pa'i zas/ /dri dang 'phreng ba dang ni rgyan/ /gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya/ /ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni/ /srog gcod la sogs mi byed pa/ /de bzhin srog gcod la sogs spang / /bla med byang chub thob par shog /sdug bsngal mang 'byug 'jig rten rnams/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'don par shog /cesalan gsum brjod/ /gso sbyong gi tshig 'di rnams blo ngo dang bstun pa'i bcos bslad ma byed cig /de nas/ oṃ a mo gha shi la/ sam+bha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ ma hā shudhi satwa/ pad+ma bi bhū ṣi ta bhu dza/ dha ra dha ra/ sa man+ta a wa lo gi te hūṃ phaṭa/ ces tshul khrims rnam dag gi gzungs bdun nam nyer gcig bzla/ khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing / /tshul khrims rnam par dag dang ldan/ /rlom sems med pa'i tshul khrim ba(—294
/ces sogs kyi 1za sto gyi brdzi'ur

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)dze tā ri lugs kyi rje btsun rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs 'chi med dpal ster bzhugs/na mo gu rngo ṣa bi dza yā yi/ rab dkar zla ba zhun ma'i mdangs 'dzin pa/ /mtshan dpe'i lang tsho rgyas pa' 'jo sgeg can/ /mdzes sdug lha mo'i gzugs kyis tshe sbyin ma/ /gtsug tor rnam par rgyal mas dge legs stsol/ /'phags yul mkhas grub dbang po dze ta ri'i/ /ba ched gzhung ma dros klung chen las phabs pa/ /legs bshad yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chab/ /rnam dpyod skal ldan shing rtas 'di na 'dren/ /a ho mtshan tsam thos pas 'chi bdag dpung / /pha mthar skrod na tshul bzhin nyams blangs tshe/ /'chi med dngos grub ster ba'i yid bzhin nor/ /bdud rtsi'i bum bzang thob 'di e ma mtshar/ /de la 'dir gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs nyams su blang bar bya ba la/bdag skyed la brten nas bzlas pa bya ba/ mdun skyed stong mchod kyi tshul du tshe'i dngos grub zhu ba/slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa rjes gnang gi rim pa dang gsum las/ dang po la/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das (2na sgoms la/ dam pa'i chos rnams la/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la/ zhes grangs gsum mam bdun gyi mthar/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis rlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ sems skyed pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o/ /lan gsum brjod/ tshogs zhing ni/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das mar gsal ba'i thugs ga'i sne yig las 'od —296

dze tā ri lugs kyi rje btsun rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs 'chi med dpal ster/ 6)zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu la rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bskor ba/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes rdo je bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bya/ thal mo sbyar te/ dpal ldan lha mo sogs kyis phyag bya/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta urdzi ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra a lha nas sha lta'i bar brjod/ thal mo sbyar te rgyun bshags bya zhing tshad med bzhi bsgom/ dngosabazhi ni/ oṃ shā n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3lha/ stong pa'i ngang las tha las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sne yig dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che las grub pa'i sa 'dzin gyi steng du them skas dang (2ba)bcas pa'i khri la sna tsho gos pad+ma/ de'i steng du rin po che las grub pa'i mchod rten bang rim zlum po gsum pa/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bum rten dang bcas pa'i bum pa zlum po sgo dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du bre/ gdugs rim pa bcu gsum/ char khebs/ tog rnams brtsegs shing / me tog gi 'phreng ba dang dar gyi lda ldis mdzes par byas la/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa dang rgyal ba myong kha pa chen po'i gsung rab rnams su lha drug gi skyed chog gsungs pa ni/ spyir btang la dgongs kyi/ thams cad la dgos pa'i nges pa med pas/ thugs sras lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal dang / 'dul ba 'dzin pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i tshe dpag med lha dgu'i mngon rtogs sogs su cho ga gsum skyed las med pas shes nus la/ dze ta re'i rgya gzhung du'ang de byung bas/ thams cad la lkugs pa'i rigs 'gre byed mi dgos so/ /de lta bu'i bum pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje lte bar sa gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus sne la thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog dkar mo/ zhal gsum/ phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar/ g.yas ser/ g.yon sngo zhing cung zad khros pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas dang pos sna tsho gos rdo rje thugs gar 'dzin pa/ gnyis pas pad dkar gyi steng na 'od dpag med/ gsum pas mda'/ bzhi —297

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon gyi dang pos sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas rdo rje'i zhags pa/ gnyis pas gzhu/ gsum pa skyabs na gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ bzhi (3na)pas mnyam bzhag gi steng na bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin po che'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs gsol ba/ rin po che sna tsho gos kyis brgyan pa/ 'od zer dkar po'i 'phreng bas bskor ba'o/ /de'i g.yas su zla ba la spyan ras gzigs dkar po/ g.yas rnga yab dang g.yon pad+ma 'dzin pa/ g.yon du nyi ma la phyag na rdo rje sngon po/ g.yas rnga yab dang g.yon la la gnas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa/ gnyis ga'ang zhi ba'i nyams can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing dar gyi na bza' gsol ba/ mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ shar du mi g.yo ba sngon po/ g.yas ral gri 'phyar ba/ ltor 'dod rgyal sngon po/ g.yas lcags kyu 'phyar ba/ nub tu dbyug sngon can sngon po/ g.yas dbyug pa 'phyar ba/ byang du stobs po che sngon po/ g.yas rtse gsum 'phyar ba/ bzhi ga'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing skra gyen du brdzes pa/ rin po che dang sprul gyis brgyan pa/stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ gtso mo'i steng gi phyogs gnyis nas gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu gnyis kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas bcom ldan 'das ma la sku khrus gsol ba dang bcas pa'o/ /de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs skar hūṃ sngon po/ dbral bar t+t+waṃ ser po/ lte bar hrī:dmar po/ brla gnyis la e āḥljang gu /gtso mo'i thugs kar hūṃ yig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha (3ba)dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nas/ shasta'i bar gyis sngar ltar mchod/ dzaḥ/ baṃ hos gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzas spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arnya sogs kyis —298

dze tā ri lugs kyi rje btsun rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs 'chi med dpal ster/ 6)gong ltar mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi mjug tu/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sam ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ spyan ras gzigs la 'od dpag med/phyag na rdo rje dang khro bo bzhi la mi bskyod pa/ lha'i bu gnyis la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta chu bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i arnya pra la swāhā/ zhes pa nas/ sha rdi'i mthar dharma ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pa'i bar gyis mchod/ dpal ldan lha mo ston ga'i zla ba'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku/ /ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma/ /rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ gtso mo'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du ༷ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba sngon po'i nang du : yig gi steng du bla ma/ mdun du pha ma/ g.yas su slob ma/ g.yon du spun grogs/ rgyab tu g.yog 'khor rnams dang bcas pa'i mtha' skor du sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sku lus kyi nang thams cad gang / bdag (4na skong bsrung bya rnams kyi 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'od zer phyir 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ rgyal ba sras bcas byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus/ thugasagar thim pas bdag dang bsrung bya rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams ye shes rgyas par gyur ces pa shub bur brjod nas/ legs so ster ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas gzungs ring tshar gcig bzla/ de nas phyag rgya bkrol te gzungs sngags skabs sbyar bzlas rjes/ oṃ a mi te/ a mi tod bha be/ a mi ta bi kā rnye/a mi ta gā te/ a mi ta gā mi ni/ a mi ta ā yu da te/ ga ga na girti ka re sa khyu k+ṣe sha k+ṣa yaṃ ka rī ye swāhā/ zhes pa'ang cung zad bzla/ gong gi legs so ster ba'i phyag rgya dang sngags 'a nyid rgya gzhung na yod pas ma chad pa gal che/ de nas/ oṃ āḥ/ lha hrīḥ.e āḥm ma sa spru sa/tsa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru swāhā/ zhes lan gsum bzlas pa'i mthar bdag skyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ ces—299

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)brjod/ de la mchod bstod gong ltar bya/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes dang / yig brgya brjod/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can sogs kyi mthar mtheb srin gyis se gol brdab/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par gyur ces brjod cing bsam mo/ /gnyis pa mdun skyed stong mchod la brten nas tshe'i dngos grub zhu ba ni/ spyir rgyud sde dang 'brel ba'i mdun skyed sgrub pa la lus dkyil min phyin dkyil 'khor sogs dmigs rten zhig nges par dgos kyi/ dmigs rten med par mdun skyed 'don pa ni dpe cha bshad sbyang byas pa'i phan yon tsam las mi (4ba/sung la/ khyad par je tā ri lugs kyi rnam par rgyal ma dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba ma yin pas/ stong mchod dam rjes gnang gang rung dang ma 'brel par dkyil 'khor gzhan gyis rgyas btab nas/ mdun skyed kyi rnam gzhag byed pa ni/ zhwa dpe lham la bkab pa ltar mi mkhas pa zhig gis rang bzo byas pa ste/ mkhas grub tshad ldan gyi lugs min no/ /de'i phyir blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis nya dang nyung ma ma bsres par rigs pa'i dwangs snyigs phyed par bya'o/ /des na lag len gyi rim pa la stegs bu sogs ma rnga ne par 'du byas/ rdo tshon gyis bris pa'i bum gdan gyi steng du bcud ldan gyi bum pa mgul chings dang bcas pa bzhag /de'i steng du rab gnas dang ldan pa'i mchod rten tshad ldan bzhugs su gsol/ phyi mchod dang / lha bshos/ mar me/ spos/ ba dan/ gdugs/ lda sti sogs ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa stong gi grangs ldan/ shar du lha'i gtor ma/ lhor cha gsum/ skabs su gang bab par gtor ma stong dang de bsham pa'i snod/ gzhan yang so so'i mdun du me tog dang rol mo sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bsham mo/ sngon 'gro gso sbyong blang ba ni/ phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag yin yang rab tu byung ba rnams kyis ma byas par chad lhag tu mi 'gyur bas re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag /mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang / su bhā was sbyang / stong pa'i —300la

dze tā ri lugs kyi rje btsun rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs 'chi med dpal ster/ 6)ngang las ma las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me rta ge /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyis ma khyab pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ (ldan〉dz+ra a swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pā ju swāhā/oṃ badz+ra puspro swāhā/ oṃ du paṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dri paṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra gas swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ni wi du swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra shabha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra sto ra ṇi ta sogs dang / so so'i phyag rgya bya/ mthar rol mo rnams 'bud dkrol bya zhing byin dbab/ mchod pa byin brlab 'og ma rnams la sto ra ṇi dang rol ོ mi dgos/de nas gong gi bdag skyed rdzogs par btang / mdun skyed sgrub pa ni bum pa dang mchod rten la dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang / swā bhā was sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las po las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rje las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ sto ba ldir ba/zhabs zhus pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgu'i/pa bcingasapa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tsho gis kyis yongs su gang ba'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du zlo yig dkar po zhes sogs kyi mchod rten lha dgu dang bcas pa skyed pa nas/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyasadang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin byas la/ting shag rdung zhing / ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / zhes sogs blo ka gsum gyi mthar/oṃ sa spru ta thā ga ta urdzi ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ bdag skyed kyi skabs ltar bstim/ dbang lha spyan drangs/ mchod la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di lamangon par dbang skur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab gong bzhin bya/spos dang mar me la sogs(5ba)pa spar la mchod pa byin gyis brlab/ thal mo sbyar te/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la dbul/ /—301 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta chu ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra a bra titsā swāhā/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil sogs la tshigs bcad dang sngags 'don pa bsgyur te/ shasta'i tshe rol chen bya/gdugs mchog ji snyed/ 9tre ka /ba dan ji snyed/ pa rta ka /spro na/ lda ldi ji snyed/ ba ḍi da pra byu swā hā/zhes pas mchod/ 'di la chu gnyis/ nyer spyod rol mo rnams kyi steng du gdugs/ ba dan lda ldi gsum las med pas/ gzhan nas rgyas bkab kyin rgyu mtshan med pa'i nyi ma 'phul thabs kyi gang dran mang po gdags par mi bya'o/ /dpal ldan lha mo zhes sogs kyi mthar/ rnam rgyal 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag /mi g.yo 'dod rgyal dbyug sngon stobs po che/ /gnas gtsang lha yi bu dang bcas pa yi/ /rnam rgyal lha tsho gos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ de nas bdag skyed ltar dmigasapa dang bcas gzungs ring tshar gcig bzlas te legs so ster ba'i phyag rgyas me tog bzung ste mdun skyed la me tog 'thor/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i/ mchod yon nas/ lda ldi'i bar gyis mchod/ stong mchod dngos ni/ dpal ldan lha mo sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas 'og gi bum pa yongs su gang bar gyur ces brjod cing / oṃ na mo zhes pa'i skabs thal mo sbyar la mgo bo dud pa'i sgo nas phyag bya bar mos te gzungs ring tshar bcu re ston pa'i rjes su gong ltar mchod bstod tshar (6na)re bya/ las kyi rdo rjes mchod pa rnams la gso/ de 'dra ba lan la phar byas pa'i gzungs lnga brgya tsam song ba'i tshe/gzungs bzla ba dang sbrags nas skor ba'ang stong grub par bya/ mchod bstod kyi tshe gang babs kyi rang sar 'bod do/ /gtor ma gtang ba ni/ mang nyung ji ltar 'tsham pa zhig gis phyi rol du gtor cha bcu tshar bsham/ ril bu bcu bcu blug pa chu dang sbyar/ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥ/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ a kā ro mu kho sarba dharmā ṇa ā du nu dzin tā da oṃ āḥ/ pa ru swāhā/ stong gis bsngo/—302

dze tā ri lugs kyi rje btsun rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs 'chi med dpal ster/ 6)sngags bcu'am brgya'i 'tshams su ting shag rdung zhing /mchod sbyin gtor ma dam pa 'dis//'phagasapa'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig/dam can thugs dam skongs gyur cig/gas drug gtor masatshim gyur nas//lan chags bu lon khyer ba dang /bla med byang chub myur thob shog/ces brjod/lha la gtor ma dbul ba ni/gong ltar byin gyis brlab/gzungs kyi mthar a kwa ro lan gsum btagasapas dbul/bdag skyed kyi skabs ltar mchod bstod bya/bcom ldan 'das ma nas/stsal du gsol gyi bar brjod/gtor ma gzhan gsum ni/cha gsum gyi cho gas ga lhas nang dang gcig phyi rol du gto ngo //rjes cho ga ni/mar pa rnams kha gso/byin gyis bas/mar yon phal ḍā mar yon bla bre dang /mar yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste//mar yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byasanas//bdag nyid chen po rnam par rgyal ma mchod//oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sngon du 'gro bas/6bsgo: nas/pa ḍi da'i bar gyi sngags rnams 'don pa bsgyur cing so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/langs te phyag 'tshal zhing dpal ldan lha mo sogs kyis bstod/slar yang tsog pur 'dug ste/bcom ldan rnam par rgyal ma la/mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa'i mthus//bdag sogs rnams dang yon bdag la//'chi med dngos grub stsal du gsol//sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i gdon//nad rims dusamin 'chi ba sogs//sngon las 'phral rkyen kun zhi zhing //'chi med dngos grub stsal du gsol//srid dang zhi ba'i yon tan kun//legs thob mi nyams gong du 'phel/khyad par tshe la dbang 'byor ba'i//'chi med dngos grub stsal du gsol//ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob par//lha mo khyed kyis rjes bzung ste//'chi bdag g.yul las rab rgyal ba'i//'chi med dngos grub stsal du gsol//dpag bsam shing dang bum pa bzang //yid bzhin nor 'dra'i lha khyod kyis//thugs rje'i 'chi med bdud rtsi yis//snying gi bum bzang gang bar mdzod//ces 'dod don zhu/me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te yig brgya brjod//ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa sogs kyisabartan bzhugs bya/ba po shis brjod cing rol mo/ sgra dang me tog sil ma dkram par bya'o//gsum

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)pa slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa rjes gnang gi cho ga dang / gong du dgos pa'i gso sbyong blang ba/ bstod pa rgyas pa/ 'dod gsol rgyas pa sogs bya bar spro na/ tshad ldan mkhas pa'i yi ge gzhan las blang bar bya'o/ /lugs 'di la dbang gi rnam gzhag kyang med pas/ dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i rnam rgyal ma zhig 'dod na/ da rā ṇa ā tsār+ya'i lugs kyi rnam rgyal lha mang gi yi ge las (7na〉nas par bya'o/ /gsang sngags kyi chos 'di nges par bla ma bsten pa'i zhal lung la rag las dgos pas/ nag po 'gro shes su 'bri ba sogs phri snon gyi rang bzo ma byed cig /smras pa/ mdzes mdzes lha mo'i gzugs can yid 'phrog ma/ /gsal gsal zla ltar dkar ba'i bzhin ras can/ /ldem ldem pad dkar steng na 'jo sgeg mkhan/ /sil sil gdu bu'i sgra ldan rnam rgyal ma/ /dung dung snying nas mi phyed dad pa dang //yang yang mchod cing gsol ba btab pa'i 'bras/ /ring ring 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub de/ /bzang bzang skal bar ldan pa bdag gis thob/ /nam yang 'chi ba med pa bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ khri spyan chad med par 'thob pa'i man ngag mchog /mchog tu rnam par dpyod pas legs bkod tshe/ /tshe 'dir lhag pa'i lha mchog 'grub gyur cig /dze tā ri lugs kyi rje btsun rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs mchod bstod kyi yi ge 'chi med dpal sbyin zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po 'khon ston chos kyi rgyal po dpal 'byor lhun grub sogs yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i bka' drin las/sngags gsar rnying theg pa gong 'og mtha' dag gi so so'i lugs srol dang rang skad ma 'dres par khong du chud pa'i za hor brje ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos/ myos byed ces pa shing lug rta chen gyi zla ba'i rgyal ba dang po'i tshes la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /(7ba)yo na mo bha ga wa te sa spru twe lo kya pra ti bi shig ya/ burnya ya te na maḥ ta du thā/ oṃ zlo ne zlo sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ a sa ma sa man+ta a ba bhā sa lpa ra ṇa ga ti/ ga ga na su bhā ba bi shudhe/ a bhi ṣañtsa n+tu phe/ sa spru ta thā ga lha su ga ta ba ra pa tsa na a mṛ ta a bhi ṣe ka ra/ ma hā mu drwa mas pa diḥ ā ha ra ā ha ra/ ma ma ā yum dha ra ṇi/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ ga ga na su bhā —304

dze tā ri lugs kyi rje btsun rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs 'chi med dpal ster/ the)ba bi shudhe/ — ṣa bi dza ya pa ri shudhe/ sa ha sra ra smi sa spyo de tai/ sa spru ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki ni/ dzi1ra mi tā pa ri pā ra ṇi/ sa spru ta thā ga ta mā te/ da sha bhā mi pra ti sti te/ sarba ta thā ga tā lha da ya a 〉 na a dhi nyi te/ mu dre mu dre ma hā mu dre/ badz+ra kā ya saṃ ha ta na pa ri shudhe/ sarba dzin ā ba ra ṇa bi shudhe/ pra ti ni warta ya ma ma ā yur bi shud+dhi/ sa spru ta thā ga ta sa ma ya/ a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhi sti te/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu ni/ bi mu ni bi mu ni ma hā bi mu ni/ ma ti ma ti mahā ma ti/ ma ma ti su ma ti ta tha tā/ bhū ta ko ṭi pa ri shud : / bi sgru ṭa/ bud dhi shud : / he he dza ya dza ya/ bi dza ya bi dza ya/ sma ra sma ra/ ྅ ra lpa ra/ snya ra ya snya ra ya/ sa spru bud dha a nga na a dhi sti te/ shu khye shurnye/ bu rje brnye/ badz+re badz+re ma hā badz+re/ su badz+re badz+ragar+bhe dza ya gar+bhe/ bi dza ya gar+bhe/ badz+radzā lā gar+bhe/ badzo tho be/ badz+ra bha be/ badz+re badzi ṇi/ badz+ram+bha ba tu ma ma sha rī raṃ/ dzo sa tā nāñtsa kā ya pa ri shud dhin+ta ba tu/ me sa dwa sa spru ga te pa ri shun+ta sa dzo ta thā ga tā: / sa mā shā sa yas/ pu ju pu ju si tho si tho/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ bi bo dha ya bi bo dha ya/ mo tsa ya mo tsa ya/ bi mo tsa ya bi mo tsa ya/ sho dha ya sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/ sams na mo tsa ya mo tsa ya saman+ta ra smi pa ri shud : / sa spru ta thā ga tāX da ya adhi gi na a dhi tī te/ mu dre mu dre ma hā mu dre/ ma hā mu drwa ma stu pa deḥswāhā/ oṃ ༷ swā hā/ oṃ a skṛ ta ā yung de swāhā/ oṃ āḥlha lha khyuḥ.oṃ aḥrak+ṣa rak+ṣa phe sa spru sa/ : swā hā/ / —305

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)rdo rje mi 'brug pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ngan song tsha gdung kun sel ga bur gsar pa'i chu 〈snan bzhus/sa/na ma shrī mañdza ye(ster gur we/ zung 'jug dbang gi rgyal po'i za ma rtag /skal bzang 'gro la stsol ba'i rdo rje la4 / /bsam bzhin srid 'dir ngur smig zlos gar can/ /'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa gtsug na rgyal/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho spro ba'i byed po mchog /dpal ldan rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /dngos grub 'byor ba'i 'phrin las lhun grub pa/ /drin can bla ma mchog des rtag tu skyongs/ /rdo rje'i rigs rnams kun gyis bdag nyid che/ /phan bde'i dpal gyi mchog sbyin stsol mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan mi zhabrug 'khor lo'i lha tsho gos kyis/ /mtha' yas 'gro la dus kun shis par mdzod/ /(2na yon song sdug bsngal tsha gdung kun sel zhing / /dag pa'i zhing mchog kun+da'i 'dab stong sgo/ /rab 'byed sgrub thabs zla gzhen gsar pa yi/ /ga bur thig pa'i chu rgyun deng 'dir spro/'dir rdo rje mi 'byug pa'i cho ga mtshan nyid dang ldan pa nyams su len par 'dod pas/ sta gon rnam pa bzhi la nye bar mkho ba'i dri thig tshom bu spyi mchod/ sgos mchod/ gtor ma/ bum pa/ bum rdzas/so shing sogs/ tshul 'di la nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad mngon par 'du byas te/ thog mar bdag skyed sgom pa ni/ khrus byas/ theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong kun 'grub na bya/ mchod pa rnams a skṛ ta hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ (2ba〉〉 bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che lasagrub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du bzhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog: /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog /zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thog pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/—306

rdo rje mi 'khyug pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 6)yo badz+ra a: swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pu/ swā hā zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra shasta swā hā/ zhes pa'i mthar/ yo dharma ra ṇi ta sogs rol mo dang bcas pas byin dbab/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ rang rdo rje mi 'khrug par gsal ba'i thugs kur pad zla'i steng du hūṃ sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros pas/bla ma dang rdo rje mi 'khrug pa'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar te/ na mo gu ru saḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra a khyo sa maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wa re khyeḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra a snyo sa maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā a: pra titsā swāhā/ zhes sogs (3na skos shasta bra titsā swā hā/ zhes pas mchode/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gyisargyun bshags bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig khres sogasatshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shā rgyu tā dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa ād+ma ko3lha/ rang dang bsgom bya'i lha gnyis gang zag dang chos kyi bdag mtha' dag gis stong pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag dang lha'i de kho na nyid dbyer mi phyed par rtog pa gnyis su snang ba thams cad dben pa'i rang gi sems don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems de nyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam par gyur/de'i steng du na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ /spya ka ni rka ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/to ṭa ni hre ṭa ni/ tra sa ni tra sani/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba da rna pa ram pa rā ṇi me sarba sa tā swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyi rang gdangs kyi sgra dril bu'i sgra bzhin grags par gyur/ sngags kyi gdangs grag pa de nyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yig 'bru bris pa'i rnam pa can du 'khod bar gyur pa las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar sngags kyis mtshan par gyur/ zla ba phyag mtshan sngags (3ba)dang bcas pa'i 'od zer gyi mthu las rgyal ba thams cad mchod cing / thugs rje'i char rgyun gyis dmyal ba sogs kyi sdug bsngal thamasacad sbyangs/ /tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi zhakhrug pa sku mdog in+d+ra ni la'i lhun po la nyi ma shar ba —307—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)ltar rab tu dngas shing 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas sa gnon dang / g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pa/ spyan dkyus ring ba'i spyan gnyis sems dpa'i lta stangs kyi 'gro ba mtha' dag la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs shing zhal 'dzum zhing rab tu zhi ba/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings shing lhag ma cung zad lcang lo'i tshul du 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs gsol ba/rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya gnas gsum du reg pa/ kai ka ni/ tshar re re brjod cing byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom (4na〉ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrug pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs pa la oṃ a lha swā hā zhes pas mchod yon phul/ dza2PROB baṃ ho de rnams rang nyid la thim pa 'od du zhu/ rang gi thugs kar pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dbus su hūṃ las mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ shar du oṃ las rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ lhor tre las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ nub tu hrīḥlas 'od dpag med dmar po ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ /byang du āḥlas don yod grub pa ljang khu g.yas skyabs sbyin g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras shing 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba'o/ /de nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra asnye sna bh+ya maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/bstod pa rgyas par spro na mnyam nyid ma sogs kyi bstod cing / 'byer bde ba'i slad du/ chos dbyings rnam dag mkha' klong yangs pa las/ /dpal ldan longs (4ba〉spyod rdzogs sku'i bcu gnyis bdag /—308

rdo rje mi 'brug pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 6)dngos grub kun gyi 'od stong rab 'gyed pa'i/ /rdo rje'i rigs kyi bdag por phyag 'tshal bstod/ /kun gsal lan brgyar me lces rab bzhu ba/ /byed pos pir gyis lhun por byugs pas kyang / khyod sku'i cha shas la 'gran skal ba yis/ /dben par ston pa bcom ldan sku la bstod/ /khyod sku mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po yis/ /nam yang yid gcugs mdza' ba ma btang tshe/ /rlung gi rgyal mtshan mdzes ma phrag dog gis/ /lha lam gzhon nur 'khyud pa'i ngal ba bsten/ /sgrib gnyis zad par spangs kyang rgod pa sogs/ /chags pa'i nyams kyi rnam 'gyur ci yang ston/ /sna tsho gis spros pa'i 'ching las rtag grol kyang / /dar zab rin chen rgyan gyis mngon par mdzes/ /gang gi rnal 'byor me yis sgrib pa'i shing / /ma lus sreg kyang thugs rje'i char rgyun gyis/ /'jigs rung ngan song tsha gdung kun sel ba'i/bcom ldan mi 'khrug pa la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rang gi thugs ga'i zla gdan la sngags 'phreng dkar pos bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ /rgyal ba sras bcas mchod cing / /de dag gi yon tan ma lus pa gzungs sngags la thim/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen 'gro drug gi sdug bsngal ma lus pa sbyangs par gyur par bsams la/ kai ka ni ci nus bzlas pa'i (nasgo thar/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis rlab tu gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab bdag gi snying kha nas ye shes pa rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur par bsam mo/ /de la mchod bstod gong ltar byas la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya lan gsum gyi mthar/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis 'khod par bsamasal dkyil 'khor gyis las rnams bya'o/ /sta gon las lha'i tshom bu a mṛ tas bsangs/ shu n+ya twasasbyangs/ rang gi lag pa g.yas pa sa la reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshom bu'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhi ba'i nyams can/ phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i bum pa 309

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ bdag la zhal phyogs te bzhugs par gyur/ de la oṃ bri thi bi de da zhes pa re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i — pra titsā swā hā/ zhes sogs chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas (5bsgo chod/ gtor ma chu gtsang gis bran la oṃ āḥ& lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ bri thi de sa sngon du 'gro ba'i a kā ro'i sngags lan gsum dang mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas phul la/ /spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul gyi khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur/ shwakya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sdo bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor 'dri/ /zhes lan gsum gyis mkhyen par gsol bas/ /rig pa 'dzin pa khyed dkyil 'khor gyi las bde bar gyis shig /ces gnang ba byin par bsams la/ lag pa g.yas pa sal reg ste/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥsa'i lha mos de nyid la thim par bsam/ lha sta gon ni/ tshom bu gong ltar bsang sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang lasa3 las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba drwa ba dang / gur/ bla bre/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar lho ser nub dmar/ byang ljang (6na rko bus sngon po'i lte bar zlo las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i ga655 yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa ba'i na du dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng rin po che'i pha gu ser pos bskor ba/de'i steng du rin po che'i bra srul gyi steng du gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas byung ba'i drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa dang / dril bu dang zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang /rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du bya 'dab las 'thur du 'phyang ba'i mda' yab dang /steng du langs pa'i rin po che'i drwa mig seng mi'i pu shus bskor ba/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol tu 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la gnas pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod pa byed pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi —310

rdo rje mi 'byug pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 6)mtshams dang zur bzhin zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i rdo rjes mtshan pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dang / de'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bres shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje phyed pa dang / nor bu rin po che'i tog gi spras pa/sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor pad+ma la (6bskonas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang / g.yas g.yon na ri dwags pho mo dang bcas shing / snam bu so so la rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi lha rnam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba/ de'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi zhabrug pa zhes pa nas skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar gyis gong ltar gtso bo bskyed/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du she las dpal be'u — gis mtshan pa las pad+ma can dkar mo g.yas dpal be'u 'dzin pa/lhor paṃ las pad+ma paṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od ldan ma dmar mo g.yas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ nub tu tsho las/gdugs oṃ gis mtshan pa las mdangs ldan ma sngon mo g.yas gdugs 'dzin pa/ byang du she las dung she gyis mtshan pa las dri med ma ljang khu g.yas dung 'dzin pa/ mer rtsa las 'khor lo rtsa gyis mtshan pa las 'jigs byed ma dkar mo g.yas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ srin por she las rgyal mtshan lha gyi mtshan pa las rnal 'byor ma sngon mo g.yas rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ rlung du kai las bum pa kai gis mtshan pa las dkar sham (7na〉pa dmar skya g.yas bum pa 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan du mo las gser nya paṃ gyis mtshan pa las yid gzhudas ma ljang khu g.yas gser nya 'dzin pa thams cad kyang 'kha gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan thugs kar 'dzin zhing g.yon pa dkur brten pa/ nu 'bur zung gis mdzes shing lang tshod ra la babs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tsho gos kyi na bza' can/ zla ba la rgyab brten cing / sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /de thams cad kyi dpral bar —311—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)oṃ la sogs pa yi ge gsum gyis brlab/ rang gi snying kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi khrug pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi rnam par oṃ sa mā dza: sprin bral mkha' la yid 'ong 'ja' tshon bzhin/ /chosadabyings ngang las gzugs sku'i rnam rol gyis/ /grangs med 'gro ba'i don mdzad lha'i 'khor lo/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ zhes brjod/ las sngags lan gsum gyis sngagasapa'i mchod yon gyi snod dam tshig gi phyag rgyas bzung la 'dzub mo g.yob cing / dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'das/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /mchod pas(7ba thad ga la dgyes par mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā badz+ra khyo sa e khya hi/ zhes dang / oṃ me ga la shrī dza d+ma dza swā hā/ de bzhin du sngags kyi thog mtha' 'dra bar sbyar la/ mig la pad+ma/ me ga la tsha tre ga /me ga la she kha /me ga la tsakra/ me ga la dh+wa dza/ me ga la ka la sha /me ga la nya tsha swā hā/ zhesapa rnams re re'i mthar e khye hi/ zhes brjod cing / so so'i mthar bzed zhal gyi nang du mchod yon cung zad re blug cing spyan drangs/ oṃ āḥci t+ta kri ta hūṃ phaṭa ces lan gsum gyis phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ zhes sogs kyi gsham du/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pra ra wa sa ṅgā raṃ a lha pra titsā swā hā/ spro na/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyisani/ /zhes sogs sngags dang bcas pas khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ zhesasogs kyi mjug tu/ oṃ pad+ma kurma la e sto/ zhes pas gdan phul la/ oṃ badz+ra pur+sha āḥsnyi/ zhes sogs kyis mchod/ thal mo sbyar te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya lha t+ta pra ṇa men badz+ra ba ka ro mi zhes pas phyag bya/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga to za wa yo swā hā/ zhes brjod pas lha thams cad mnyes par bsam/ dzaḥ/ baṃ ho zhes pas bstim/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/thal mo sbyar te/ 'jig (8na)rten khams ni dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas 'gro ba'i don kun mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta —312

rdo rje mi 'khrug pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga thenabadz+ra aklo bh+yo maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ra a: pra tismo swā hā/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar du 'don pa bsgyur la so so'i sngags dang phyag rgya/ mthar sto ra ṇi rol wo dang 4sa pa bya/ spro na/gos zung gzhan nas khrung ba ltar phul la/ bkra shis rtags brgyad ni/ /mgon po thugs rje chen po zhesasogs kyis 'phul ba'i yang na/ phun tshogs bkra shis dge mtshan ma lus kun/ /gcig tu rab 'khyil yid 'ong dpal bes /dngos bshams yid sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rma ga la shri dzad+ma dza pu dzi te hūṃ/ de bzhin du tshig rkang 'og ma gnyis 'dra ba'i/ stong gsum kun la thogs med dbang sgyur ba'i/ /gser sbyangs las grub 'khor lo rtsibs stong 'di/ /sngags kyi thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ shrī 0 dze'i tshab tu tsakra/ rnyog bral yid bzhin dal 'gro 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /mnyen 'jam 'dab stong 'dzum pa'i pad dkar 'di/ pad+ma/'dod dgu'i char 'bebs nor bu'i tog gis mdzes/ /srid pa'i rtse mor bsgreng ba'i rgyal mas 'di/dh+wa dza/ rin chen phra tshom gyis spras(8bsgo ba can/ /lha rdzas dar gyi sham bu g.yo ba'i gdugs/ tsha tre ga /zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i btung ba yis/ /mngon par gang ba'i bum pa bzang po 'di/ /rab snyan tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi sgra chen po/ /phyogs bcur sgrog pa'i dung dkar g.yas 'khyil 'di/ 0 kha/gzugs kun gsal mthong 'dren byed rab ldan pa'i/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser las grub pa'i nya/ nya tshar/ zhes phyag rgya med pa rnams la nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas dbul/ rgyas par spro na 'dod yon lnga spyi 'gro ltar dang / rgyal srid bdun gyi sngags kyang sarba ta thā ga ta me/ so so'i sngags sbyor lugasaspyi dang mthun/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di ltar/ be+e ḍūr ser po'i brtan pa 'phrog byed pa'i/ /gzi 'od 'bar ba'i rtsibs stong 'khor lo 'di/ /mi zhabrug dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i tshogs la 'bul/ /ji snyed phan bde'i mchog de stsal du gsol/ /bsam pa tsam gyis 'dod pa'i don rnams kun/ /rab ster nor bu dbang gi rgyal po 'di/ /mi 'khrugs dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i tshogs la 'bul/ /ji snyed phan bde'i mchog de stsal du gsol/ /sngo bsangs ri dwags mig can skyengs byed pa'i/ /sgyu rtsal nyams—313

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (3)ldan thun mtshams mdzes ma 'di//mi 'byug dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i tshogs la 'bul//ji snyed phan bde'i mchog de stsal du gsol//blo gros chu gter che las chos kyi srid//rba rlabs gyen 'phyur khyim bdag rin chen 'di//mi 'khrug dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i tshogs la 'bul//ji snyed phan bde'i mchog de stsal du gsol//bser 9na skon lhun por rgyan gyi 'phyang mo yug/'dzin byed stobs ldan gnyis 'thung dbang po 'di//mi 'khrugs dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i tsho gos la 'bul//ji snyed phan bde'i mchog de stsal du gsol//rdul gyi rgyal mas ngal ba'i gnas bsten par//byed po cang shes yid 'ong rta mchog 'di//mi 'brug dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i tshogs la 'bul//ji snyed phan bde'i mchog de stsal du gsol//dpa' rtsal stobs kyis ra ci'i sras po yang //zhus par byed pa'i phun tshogs dmag dpon 'di//mi 'khrug dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i tshogs la 'bul//ji snyed phan bde'i mchog de stsal du gsol//rdo dril 'dzin pas/bdag bskyed kyi bstod pa rnams kyi rjes su/chos dbyings mnyam nyid ma'i//yang na/grangs med 'gro la byang chen stsol ba'i slad//mdzes sdug yid 'ong sprul pa'i lha mo brgyad//mkha' la dbang po'i gzhu ltar rnam bkra ba'i//bgrang yas lha yi tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo//spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/mi 'khrug rgyal po bcom ldan 'das//rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod//bdag ni snying brtser gyur nas su//slob ma rnamasal brtse ba dang /khyed rnams la yang mtshon pa'i phyir//sang ni dkyil 'khor 'dri bar 'tshal bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa lags//de bas gnang bar mdzad pa'i rigs//sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon brtse dang //byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom dang //gsang sngags lha gzhan gang rigs dang //'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams 9brkong //nya gang 'byung po mthu chen dang //gang du lha yi spyan mtsho ba'i//sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams//bdag la dgongs par mdzad tu gsol//rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni//sang ni dkyil 'khor bzang po'i ming //mi zhabrug dkyil 'khor ci kyi nus sa//cho ga bzhin du 'dri lags na//bdag dang slob mar bcaX pa la//thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas su//

rdo rje mi zhakhrug pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga thenachags pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du/ /byin gyis brlab pa mdzad du gsol/ /zhes snyan gsan lan gsum phab pas/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod g.yin don rgya che bar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ /bum pa sta gon ni/ /bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sa las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum la/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ /nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ rang gi snying kha'i hūṃ las zhes sogs nas sngags kyis bsangs pa'i mchod yon thogs te gong ltar tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ phyi 'brang gi (10na〉bgegs bskrad/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan te mnyes par bsams/ dzaḥ/ baṃ ho lha rnams bum pa'i nang du byon te/ so so'i gdan gyi steng du 'khod/ ces sam/ mtshan sngags re re bzhin sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rigs kyis bstod/ /rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungasathag la brten te song ba bum nang gi lha rnams la phog pas de rnams kyi thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar bsams la/ gzung thag nas bzung ste/ gzungs ring dang lha mo brgyad kyi sngags brgya rtsa re/ chas bo ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes pa dang / a mṛ te nyer gcig bzlas la gong ltar mchod/bstod pa bya/ 'dod don zhus te/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ ma 'byor ba zhes sogasakyis bzod par gsol la/ dung chos kyi chu bum par blug ste/ oṃ āX/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par bsam/ cha gsum btang la nye reg bya'o/ /slob ma sta gon ni/ lus bya ba rnams gzhud las yang ba ltar bya/ myang 'das kyi bsam pa bskyed pa ni/ gsang (10ba〉ba spyi rgyud las/ kha cig gsang sngags bsgrub don gnyer/ dkyil 'khor —315

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)du ni 'jug par 'gyur/ de bzhin gzhan gyi bsod nams 'dod/ gzhan dag 'jig rten pha rol gzhol/ /blo bzang phal cher dad byas nas/ 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer 'jug /'jig rten 'di 'bras dar nas ni/ /'jig rten pha rol gos gnyer na/ /gang phyir tshe 'di bde blag 'grub/ /'di yisa'ajig rten pha rol min/ /de phyir 'jig rten pha rol gyi/ /don du yid ni brtan par gyis/ zhes pa'i don bshad/ /khyad par can gyi don zhu ba'i slad du/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /zhes so gos kyisagasol ba btab/ sems bskyed pa'i slad du/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ zhes sogs kyi rgyud dag par bya/ skyabs sems khyad par can gyi slad du/ byang chub snying por mchos kyi bar/ /sangasargyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /tsho gos la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro la phan don dang / /byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing / /de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang / /rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ /bar chad bsrung ba'i slad du/ bum pa'i (11na'i gtor te/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ byin gyis brlab pa ni/ khyed rnams skad cig gis mi zhakhrugs par gsal ba la dri chu rdo rje dang bcas ste/ oṃ āḥ& zhes brjod pas khyed rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma as mtshan pa/ snying khar hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ mchod pa'i slad du/ oṃ badz+ra pu zhe āḥ// dhu pe/ a lo ke/gha rje zhes mchod/ so shing ni bum chu gtor zhing / a skṛ tas byin gyis brlabs nas byin te dngos grub kyi ltas brtag go /khyor chu ni/ a mṛ te bzlas pa'i khyu shu rmi sngags kyis lan bdun byin no/ /bsrung skud ni/ a mṛ tas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bsrung skud dmar po/ /mdud pa gsum ldan dpung bar gtso bo'i sngags bzla zhing bcings/ bum chu gtor/ yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya'o/ /ku sha ni/a mṛ ta bzlas pa'i ku sha chung ba g.yas su dhi dang / che ba g.yon du ha zhes pas sbyin/ spro ba skyed pa ni/'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /ces sogs brjod/ rmi lam brtags shing ngan na bsrung ba bya ba —316

rdo rje mi 'khrug pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 6)yang dkyus bzhin no/ /mjug chog dang / lha 'dre grwa pa rnams phyag len ltar bya/ dngos gzhi la brisasku rabs gnas can 'gram spyi sgos kyi mchod pa (11bskong / nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad phyag len ltar bsham/ khrus sogs sngar ltar bya/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis oṃ āḥlha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod par bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung / /mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs nas rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed de gnas gsum byin brlab kyi bar sta gon bzhin bya/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren gyi tshe dngos gzhi nyin sbrel yin na/ nyi ma snga phyir/bde bar shes dgos la/ mchod yon gyis spyan drangs/ phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad pa nas ye shes pa bstim pa'i bar lha sta gon bzhin du byas la bum bskyed kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar gyi mchod bstod bya/mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi thugs dar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du so so'i sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer kha dog dkar po 'phros pas bdag dang dmigs yul gyis gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang / sdug bsngal thams cad sbyangs nas 'od zer rnams slar 'dus te lha rnams kyi thugs dar thim par bsams la/ lha so so la dmigs te gtso bo la gzungs ring dang / 'khor rnams la/ oṃ ma ga la shri 0 dza swā hā/ zhes sogs re re nas kyang brgya rtsol bzlas la/ mthar thal mo (12na spur te/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor ba thams cad brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ mchod bstod lha sta gon gyi skabs ltar bya/ rgyas par spro na/ nam mkha'i mdangs ltar kun nasagasal ba'i sku/ zhes sogs kyis bstod/ bum bskyed/ phyi rol pa/ nye reg rnams bya/ bdag 'jug blang / slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa la/ slob ma rnams khrus bya ba nas/ yan lag bdun pa'i bar bya/ oṃ tsak+ṣu/ — wa ra ma nā ya hūṃ/ zhes pas gdong bcings/ āḥṇa khyi ra hūṃ/ zhes me tog gi phreng ba byin/oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes bgegs bsangs/ rigs nges pa'i slad du/ /kye dga' ba la dga' khyod su —317

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)yin/ zhes dri/ bde chen bdag ni skal bzang lags/ zhes lan gdab/ rang gi snying khar zla ba'i dkyila'akhor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa nya gang ba/ de'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba zhig byung bar mos/ su ra ti sa ma ya sdi sngo sirnyi badz+ra a thā su zhe/ zhes brtan par bya/ gsang bar gdamasapa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad (12ba yo) rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /āḥkho sa ra hūṃ/ zhes rdo rje dang bcas nang du khrid par mos/ ye shes dbab pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /rdo rje mi 'khrug pa bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ khyed rang skad cig gis mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon g.yon mnyam bzhag gi steng na rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i skur gsal ba'i thugs dar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ sngon po/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi thugs gar phog /thugs rgyud bskul te thugs ka nas 'od zer pho nya lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rkar phog pas de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo hūṃ yig sngon po bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste/ khyed rang (13na8 thugs ga'i hūṃ yig la gnyis su med par thim/ de bzhin du mdun bskyed slob dpon dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nasade 'dra ba du ma byung ste khyed rang gi thugs gar thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos/ gzungasaring gi mthar/ glo badz+ra a we sha ya a āḥ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes rdo rje dang bcas brtan par bya/ spyi bor dam rgya dang kai ka ni tshar gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rdo dril 'dzin pas/ yang dag dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni zhes sogs lan gsum brjod/ nam mkha'i kha dog dri/ oṃ pra titsā badz+ra hoḥ—318

rdo rje mi 'khrug pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 6)zhes me tog gtor/ oṃ pra ti gra pre mo satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes me tog bcing / rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ zhes sogs nas he badz+ra pa shu'i bar gyi mig ras bsal/ dkyil 'khor dbang po 'di la ltos//nga ni dad pa rab tu skyed/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs//'gro ba'i phun tshogs dngos grub kyang / /thams cad khyod la mngon du 'gyur/ /dngos grub phyir ni dam tshig srungs/ /gsang sngags rig la'ang brtson par gyis/ lha ngo bstan/ dngos gzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs kyi (13ba'i kyil 'khor gyi dbus su rin po che'i khri la sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du khyed rang bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrug pa zhes sogs kyis bdag bskyed kyi skabs bzhin bskyed/de'i steng du bla bre/ g.yas su gdugs/ g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ mtha' skor kun tu dung la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar bsam/ slob dpon gyi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros bas dbang gi lha rdo rje mi zhabrug pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba bdun gyi nam mkhar/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes spyan drangs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon bar dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / kai ka ni'i rjes su oṃ badz+ra a bhi khiñtsa mi/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag nas bdag nyid rdo rje mi 'khrug pa'i skur gyur pa brtan par mos/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag ste/ chasarba ta thā ga to ji wa ya swā hā/ zhes cod pan gyi dbang bskur nas/ de la/ badz+rapu nye āḥsnyi/ zhes sogs kyis mchod/ mtha' brten ni/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs dang / (14na)ma me ga la shrī dzā du dzo swā hā/ de bzhin du/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / pad+ma/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa/ /gtong ba dri yis legs bgos chu/ /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tsha tra ba phar phyin lnga po la yang tshigs bcad so so'i mjug tu rim pa ltar/ shaṃ kha/ tsakra/—319

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)dha dza/ ka la sha /nya tsha/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi sarba pā paṃ saḥ shān+ti ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin tu sbyar te/ sarba bighā na shān+ti ku ru swā hā/ sarba ro ga shān+ti ku ru swā hā/ sarba du ni na shān+ti ku ru swā hā/ sarba gra he shān+ti ku ru swā hā/ sarba dz+wa ra shān+ti ku ru swā hā/ sarba bya dhi/ sarba snga kyi pa dra bre/ sarba a kā la a mṛ kyi/ sarba du ra su ba ni/ sarba du ra mi te/ sarba tsit+ta ku le saḥ shān+ti ku ru swāhā/ zhes pas bkrus/ byab pa ni chu kha nang du cung zad bzung / rdo rje dang bcas pas sgros byab cing gzungs kyi mthar rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi sarba pā paṃ saḥ.a pa nā ya swā hā/ de bzhin du g.yin rnams la'ang sbyar te mthar kha'i chu snod du pho/ bsrung ba ni/rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi sarba pā paṃ saḥrak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ zhes sogs sbyar la/ gnas bdun du rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag go shes par bya ba'i slad du bkra shis kyi rdzas rnams la bum chu gtor te bsang sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las mo las byung ba'i bkra shes kyi rdzas brgyad rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang (14brko pa la 'byor rgyas par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ me ga la an+ta saḥ& phaṭa/zhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ rim pa bzhin du byin la/ sngon bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la gzugasakyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phyag tu phul ba zhes sogs tshigs lhug pa dang / me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yi zhes sogs tshigs bcad rnams dkyus ltar brjod/ rdo rje slob ma rnams spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig /gtso bos sogs dang gtang rag deng nas sogs byas rjes cho ga mchod bstod 'dod don zhu ba bzod gsol rnams bya/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang zhes pa nas bzung ste/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes me tog gtor/ smon lam ni/ gdod nas dag pa stong gsal nam mkha'i dbyings/ /mi 'brug dkyil 'khor 'ja' tshon ltar bkra ba/ /mchod bstod sgom dang bzlas pa la sogs pa'i/ /grangs med dge ba'i tshogs kun bsags pa'i (15na〉mthus/ /tshe rabs kun tu dal —320

rdo rje mi 'brug pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 6)'byor rten thob nas/ /yang dag dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rjes bzung ste/ /skyes bu che 'bring chung gsum lam gyi gnad/ /zhabrul med brtson pas nyams su len par shog /thun mong lam gyis rgyud sbyangs sngon song nas/ /rnam dag dbang gis dri ma kun bkrus te/ /ye shes mchog gi sa bon legs thebs nas/ /rang gi rgyud ni yongs su smin par shog /dam tshig sdom pa mig gi 'bras bu ltar/ /legs par bsrungs shing mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi/ /rnal 'byor sgoms pas tshe 'dir bcom ldan 'das/ /mi 'khrug rgyal po'i go 'phang thob par shog /gal te rten 'dir mngon du ma gyur na/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gags par gyur pa'i dus/ shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams der/ /skyes nas theg mchog chos la spyod par shog /mdor na bdag dang dmigs pa'i yul la sogs/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyams pa'i sems can kun/ /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs rgyal pos rjes bzung ste/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /smon lam rgyas par spro 'dod na/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i rang bzhin rnam dag ma bya'o/ khres brjod ni/(15bsgom dag lha yi lam la bcom ldan 'das/ /lha mo brgyad sogs grangs med 'khor tshogs kyis//snyan pa'i glu dang rol mo'i sgra dbyangs sgrogs/ /bkra shis me tog phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'gengs/ /'jigs rung khro bos bdud sde'i dpung tshogs bskrad/ /sna tshogs sgeg mos kun bzang mchod sprin spro/ /phul byung dag pa rab stims bkra shis kyi/ /phyogs dus kun tu dge legs rgya mtsho stsol/ /sangs rgyasa'ajam dpal dzñā na gar+bha dang / dzñā na shān+ta burnya'i mtshan can zung / /ku swā li pa dharmā kirti'i zhabs/ /a ti sha sogs dngos dang brgyud pa yi/ /bka' drin mnyam med bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzod/ /med byung mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bkra shis shog /'dab stong lte bar chu shel dbang po'i steng / /in+d+ra nī la'i lhun po nyin byed kyis/ /lan brgyar 'byud pa'i mtshan dpe'i gar mkhan mchog /bcom ldan mi 'khrug lha yi bkra shis shog /phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi pad+ma'i gdan steng du/ /lang tsho dar bab mdzes sdug lha mo'i tshogs/ /bkra shis rtags kyi mdzes pa'i phyag —321 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)mtshan can/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /gzhan yang bkra shis kyi tshigs su gcad pa ci rigs pa bya'o/ /de dang 'brel bar gshin po rjes su 'dzin na/ zhag sbrel dang nyin gcig gi khyad par shes (16na)par byas la/ sbyang chas rnams bshams/ rten a khru tas bsangs/ shu n+ya tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ni las tshe las 'das pa che ge mo rang gi phung po dang khams dang skye mched thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gson po'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur par bsam/ rang gi thugs da'i hūṃ dang tshe 'das kyi snying kha'i ni las 'od zer 'phros pas/ tshe 'das kyi rnam shes gang na gnas pa nas bkug par bsam zhing lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas te rje btsun rtsa ba dang rgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangasargyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / gsang sngags rigs sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo khro mo rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi zhabrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tsho gos rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyisabarlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba khams gsum skye gnas bzhi rigs drug gang na gnasakyang skad cig la 'dir ma mis par gyur cig /chaṭak+ki hūṃ dza ye khol na gsum dang / oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ne sarba pā baṃ a pa nā a hūṃ/ rnam shes a thung gi rnam par bkug ste rten la stim/ gtor ma rten la bskor zhing / oṃ sarba bisnan sogs lan gsum/ (16ba)ting lo dang chang bu lan gsum bskor zhing /rdo rje gsor rgyang ni lan gsum brjod/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i gson gyi dus na tshe gnas pa dang / gshin gyi dus na sdig pa sbyong ba la bar du bcod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad gtor ma lam brngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu la lam brgyags kyi tshul du khyer la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig /gong ltar rje btsun rtsa ba dang sogs nas bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyi/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo gson gyi dus na tshe gnas pa dang / gshin gyi dus na sdig pa sbyong ba la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i rigs gang —322

rdo rje mi 'khyug pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga the)yin pa de dag la rgyud sdodang mthun pa'i sbyang ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pas/ des tshim par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis mgo bo tshal ba brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re gu gul yungs gar rol mo dang bcas bya'o/ /de ltar zhi ba dang / zhi drag phyed ma dang / drag po'i sbyang ba rnams kyi skabs/ khro bo spyan 'dren sogs spro na/ gzhan las byung ba ltar bya'o/ /tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib thams (17na༄da kai yig nag po'i rnam pas sna sgo nas 'thon te/ sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam pas til la thim par bsams la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya swā hā/ zhes brjod pas mer bsreg cing chur dor/ rten la kai ka ni bzla zhing bye ma 'am yung skar gyis brab la/ mthar che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig /ces brjod/ dkyil 'khor la me long bstan te/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / 'di ni khrus mchog sogs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sogs sngags dang bcas pas bkru/ de dag sku la sogs/ sngagasadang bcas pas sku phyis la/ chus bum par blugs te/ rten dngos sam me long la gzugs brnyan char du bcug la/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i sogs drug dang / gzungs kyi mthar che ge mo'i sarba pā paṃ saḥ shān+ti ku ru swā hā/ zhes sogs kyi bkru/ tshe 'das kyis byed par bsams la/ bdun rnam dag dang / gtso bo rgyal ba sogs lan gsum re brjod/ rang dang chos 'brel med na dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos mdzad par bsams la/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ cheXgasogs kyi skyabs sems 'bogs/ dbang bskur bar spro na/ gong gi bdun rnam dag bzhag la/ mtha' rten rnams dor nas 'dug pa dang dngosagazhi'i dbang tsam bskur/ (17bsgo 'das lhar gyur pa la chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ gzung 'dzin rdo rje brtan pa'i sa/ /me long ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /bdud 'dul chen po'i phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal mi bskyod rdo rje la/ zhes pas bstod/ zas gtad byed na/ kha dog dbyibs legs sogs kyis dbul/ byang du bsreg pa ni/ stong nyid ye shes 'bar ba'i mes/ /tshe 'das sgrib pa'i bud —323

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)shing dang / /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa/ /ye shes snang bar 'bar gyur cig /ces dang / kai ka ni brjod cing bsreg go /lam sbyang bstan pa ni/ dril bu bsil zhing me tog gtor la/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du/ /dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba/ /dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyi/ /rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pa/ /tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam/ /mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam/ /bla na med pa'i khyad par lam/ /byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam/ /rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la/ brten nas sdig pa kun sbyangs nas/ /'phags pa'i lam der 'gro bar shog /oṃ ra sne ra rnye ma hā ra twe rat+na /bha we/ rat+na ki ra sne/ rat+na mā la bi shudhe shodha ya sarba pā paṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing / tshe 'das kyi rnam shes a dkar po dri ma med pa'i rnam pa can de shar phyogs mngon par dga'i ba'i zhing na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i thugs gar 'pho (18na)bar bsam la rol mo bya/ pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar/ /srid gsum dri mas ma gos pa/ /srid pa'i pad+mo las byung ba'i/ /mngon dga'i zhing du skye bar shog /oṃ pad+me pad+me pad+ma je we ma hā a bhi nan+ti la swā hā/ zhes brjod cing rol mo bya'o/ /'di nas nying mtshams sbyar ma thag /dag pa'i zhing khams ma ro zhe dga' sa /pad+ma'i snying po dam pa la/ /brdzus te skye ba len par shog /ces dang gzhan yang smon lam gang shes bya/ /lta ba'i rgyas btab/ rjes kyi cho ga rnams gong bzhin byas te/ phyogs kun tu me tog sil ma gtor/ /bkra shis kyi glu dang rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya'o/ /smras pa/ shin tu rtogs dka'i gsang chen rgyud sde'i don/ /gong 'og lam gyi bgrod tshul khyad par sogs/ /ma phyed bya ba'i rgyud dang bla na med/ phan tshun bsres pa'i tshig tshogs ngal ba'i gnas/ /'byul pa'i smig sgyu rnyog bral chu klung du/ /mngon par zhen pa'i skom tshad gdung ba yis/ /mnar ba'i 'gro rnams rmad byung legs bshad kyi/ /gaṅgā'i chu rgyun 'di ko da 'thungs shig /ma tshang 'gal dang ma 'brel bzlos pa sogs/ /nyes mang 'phel dang 'gribs pa mi mnga' ba'i/ /sngon med chu shel (18ba)dbang po'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ /byed po dbyangs can dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyi/ /de skad lhar bcas—324

rdo rje mi 'khrug pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 6)'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ /gnyen gcig rdo rje 'chang 'bang 'khon ston rje'i/ /zla med bka' drin mchog gi legs bskyangs pa'i/ /za hor bzhes 'bras spungs chosi sder sbyar/ /de lta'i rnam dkar dge tshogs gru rdzings kyis/ /phan bde'i nor gyis dbul ba'i lus can kun/ /mtshan bcas mtshan med rnal 'byor chu gter che/ /brgal te rnam 'dren nor bu thob gyur cig /ces jo bo chen po dpal mar me mdzad kyi bka' srol las nye bar 'ongs pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'brug pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ngan song tsha gdung kun sel ga bur gsar pa'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba 'di yang / nor 'dzin gyi khyon kun la dbang sgyur ba lugs gnyis la blta ba'i rnam dpyod kyi rtsal dang ldan pa rang gi gam du nye bar bcar ba'i phyag mdzod sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan gyis bskul ba la brten nas/dze tā ra'i rgya gzhung dang / 'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa'i gsung rabs rdo rje 'chang chen po'i lam gyi rim pa gnyis kyi dgongs pa gtso bor byas/ phyogasa'adi la tshad mar gyur pa'i mkhas pa (19na)rnams kyi legs bshad la brten nas ngag 'don gyi go rims mtha' dag khrigs chags su bsgrigs/ dmigs pa dang mtshams sbyor gyi rim pa rnams rgyas par bkod na yi ge mangs bas 'jigs nas khungs thub kyi yig cha gzhan dang mthong rgyud kyi phyag len la kha 'phangs te/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang 'khon ston chos kyi rgyal po dpal 'byor lhun grub sogs yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i bka' drin las gsang sngags gsar rnying gi rgyud sde'i don ma 'dres par khong du chud pa'i a wa dhu tī ba/ za hor gyi btsun pa/ ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes nyin 'byed dbang po nya khyim du spyod pa'i phyogs/ phyi ma'i bzang po dang po'i tshes la dga' ldan pho brang me tog mngon par bkra ba'i lding khang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni su dhī ā yu diḥ'o// maṅga lo //—325

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i lha tshogs rnams kyi sgrub 'phrin bsnyen pa rjes gnang sogs kyi nyams len mchog thun dngos grub 'dod dgu'i snye ma g.yur za zhes bya ba bzhugs/na mo gu ru rnga skṛ du shrī su rā ya sta smi/ gang la brten na rnam 'byed shes rab mchog /'bad med lag rtser stsol ba'i yid bzhin nor/ /rgyal ba'i yab cig 'jam dbyangs bla ma la/ /gus pas 'dud do ngag gi dngos grub stsol/ /blo chen tshangs sogs rgan pos rtogs dka' ba/ /skal bzang dga' ba'i thub bstan shing rta che/ /smad byung grags pa ta'i ra yi rgyud/ /srid rtse'i bar du brdung mkhas khyod min su/ /gang gi legs par bshad pa zab mo'i don/ /phan tshun gab dkrugs thor bur bzhugs pa rnams/ /lag len khrigs su bya ba'i rim pa dag /'khrul med yi ge'i phreng bar deng 'dir spel/ /de'ang rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs bsgrub par 'dod pa'i skyes bu gang zhig /gnas yid du 'ong bar byi dor legs par byas la/ rje btsun gyi sku bris 'bur rab gnas can dang / g.yin yang dkon mchog gi rten gsum gyi mdun du ci 'byor ba'i mchod gtor rnams bsham/ rang nyid stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa sogs dang / dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ zhes pa nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa'i bar gyi skyabs su 'gro ba dang (2na)sems bskyed pa sngon du btang nas/ rang 'jam dbyangs su gsal ba'i snying pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i dbus su/ ༷ las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su seng shes bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri/pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la dhīḥhrīḥyongs su gyur pa las/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'jam dbyangs dmar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dbyangs can ma dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud —326

rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i lha tsho gis rnams kyi sgrub 'phrin/ 6)pa yab rdo rje'i skyil krung dang yum pad+ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ gnyis ga'ang rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa'i spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad/ mgrin par 'od dpag med/ thugs kar mi bskyod pa/ mig tu sa'i snying po/ rna bar phyag na rdo rje/ snar nam mkha'i snying po/ lcer 'jig rten dbang phyug /lus sgrib pa rnam sel/ yid kun tu bzang po/ phung po lnga sku lnga/ 'byung ba bzhi yum bzhi/ phyag zhabasakyi sor mo nyi shu khro bo khro mo bcu/ sgal tshigs sems dpa' sems ma bcu drug /yan lag bzhi sgo ma bzhi/ tshigs chen bcu gnyis mchod pa'i lha mo bcu gnyis su gyur pa rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ/ /mgrin par āḥ(2ba)thugs gar dhīḥ& gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ sa myu la mā la su gu ru burnya bo dhi sa pa ri wā ra arnya nas sha sna'i bar gyis mchod/ sku gsum mnga' bdag mtshan dpes brgyan/ /sku gcig la sogs grangs med skus/ /rnam kun 'gro rnams sgrol mdzad pa/ /rje btsun sku yi byin rlabs stsol/ /zhes gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ spyi bo'i oṃ yig dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ /rgyal ba sras bcas kyi sku'i yon tan thams cad gzugs sku'i rnam par spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang sems su gyur pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ lus gang / bum pa'i dbang thob/ sdig sgrib dag /'bras bu sku rdo rje dang /sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can bzhag /gsung dbyangs rdzogs nas 'gro ba rnams/ /ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob par/ /chos kyi 'bor lo bskor mdzad pa/ rje btsun gsung gi byin gyis rlomes/zhes gsol ba gtab pas mgrin pa'i āḥyig dmar po las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi yon tan thams cad ā li kā li sogs yig 'bru'i rnam par spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs pa sogs sngar ltar rigs 'gre/ mgrin par thim/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag sgrib dag 'bras bu gsung rdo rje dang / longs spyod rdzogs sku 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can bzhag /bdud bzhi gtan 'joms yang dag mtha'/ /rnam kun mngon gyur thugs rje yis/ /'gro ba ma lus sgrol mdzad pa/ /rje btsun thugs —327

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)kyi byin rlabs stsol/ /(3na tshe zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thugs ka'i hūṃ yig mthing kha las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi thugs kyi yon tan thams cad/ rdor dril ral gri glegs bam sogasaphyag mtshan gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs sogs sngar ltar rigs 'gre /snying gar thim/ shesarab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid sgrib dag 'bras bu thugs rdo rje dang / chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i nus pa khyad par can bzhag /ji ltar mgon po khyed kyi ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rnams/ /gzhan phyir mngon du mdzad pa ltar/ /mgon pos bdag la stsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ /snying ga'i bla ma yab yum gyi yum yab la thim/ /yab thugs ka'i dhī la thim/ dhīḥtsheg drag la thim/ tsheg drag nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag /tshig dbang thob/ lusangag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa'i sa bon dag /'bras bu zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ /oṃ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las re las me/hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lta bu'i nang du/ a las ral gri'i 'khor lo nyis brtsegs kha dog sngon po go skabs med pa rtsibs drug pa phyogs kun tu khyab pa'i bar mtshams rnams su ral gyis gtams shing /ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su/ paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ dhīḥlas ral gri lha tshig mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ 'gro ba'i mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun 'jam dpal dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas shes (3ba)rab kyi ral gri 'phyar zhing / g.yon āt+pala'i yu ba mtheb srin gyis thugs dzir bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad gar kha phye ba'i steng na sher phyin gyi glegs bam bsnams pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgulargyan/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub sogs kyis spras shing / dar gyi na bza' gsol ba/zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs rkar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la dhīḥsngon po las thugs kyi 'jam dbyangs sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis ral gri dang glegs bam —328

rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i lha tshogs rnams kyi sgrub 'phrin/ (ba)'dzin pa rgyan cha lugs gtso bo dang mtshungs pa'i thugs gar pad ma 'dab ma bzhi'i dbus su rang dang 'dra ba'i 'jam dbyangs sngon po/ shar du dkar po/ lhor ser po/ nub tu dmar bo/ byang du ljang gu /gtso bo'i mgrin par zla ba'i gdan la dhīḥdamar po las gsung gi 'jam dbyangs dmar po ral gri dang glegs bam 'dzin pa/ rgyan cha lugs gtso bo dang mtshungs pa'i thugs gar pad ma 'dab ma bzhi'i dbus su rang dang 'dra ba'i sna tshogs mkha' 'gro dmar mo/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngon mo/stor rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo/ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu /spyi bor zla ba'i gdan la dhīḥdakar po las sku'i 'jam dbyangs dkar po ral gri dang glegs bam 'dzin pa/ rgyan cha lugs gtso bo dang mtshungs pa'i thugs gar pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi'i dbus su rnam snang dkar po/ shar du mi bskyod pa sngon po/ lhor rin 'byung ser po/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po/ byang du don grub ljang gu /bdag nyid kyi lce pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i dbus su ral gri'i yu ba dhīḥs mtshan pa nang du bstan la/ rtse mo (4na tshe pa as mtshan pa phyir bstan/ de'i shar du 'jam dbyangs dkar po mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang ut+pal dkar po 'dzin pa/ lhor 'jam dbyangs ser po ral gri dang glegs bam 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'jam dbyangs dmar po nor bu dang rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ byang du 'jam dbyangasaljang gu gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ lha nyer gsum po rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugasagar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyis gnas nas/ 'jam dpal dbyangs lusadakyil gyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ ji ltar mkha' la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig /grangs med rdzing bur 'char ba ji bzhin du/ /'jam mgon lha yi 'khor lo'i tshogs rnams kun/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis gnab('dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ mañdzu sto ṣa kā ye bhi rma ṇ+ḍalwa ni de wi badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ thugs ga'i 'od kyis dbang gi lha oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ ji ltar mgon po khyod kyis ni/ /sngon tshe 'gro la dbang bskur ltar/ /de bzhin thugs rjes bdag la yang / /dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar sngon tshe —329

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)'gro rnams la/ /dbang bskur dam pa mdzad ji bzhin/ /de ring ye shes bdud rtsi'i chus/ /bu khyod la ni dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ ār+ya mnyu shri ye sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sam ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chus gang bas spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus gang / dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa las/ gtso bo la rin 'byung / thugs ka'i lha rnams la mi bskyod pa/ mgrin pa'i lha rnams la 'od dpag med/ spyi bo'i (4ba〉sna rnams la rdo rje sems dpa'/ lce steng gi lha bzhi la rim bzhin rnam snang / rin 'byung / 'od dpag med/ don grub rnams kyis dbu brgyan cing / dbang gi lha rang nyid la thim par gyur/ rin chen snod du 'khyil ba'i rnyog bral mtshor/ /chu skyes lang tsho rgyas pa'i ge sar ldem/ rmad byung dri bsung mngar ba'i bdug spos dang / /mun pa'i go skabs 'phrog pa'i mar me'i phreng / /bzang po'i sman gyi dri chab chal chil g.yo/ /ro mchog brgya dang ldan pa'i lha yi bskos//sna tshogs snyan pa'i rol mo'i bye brag rnams/ /'jam mgon lha yi 'khor lo'i tsho gos la 'bul/ /gong gi sngags gsham du a lha nas shasta'i bar dang / gzugs mdzes 'gying bag ldan pa'i lus phra mas/ /snyan 'gyur pi wang brdung zhing dri mchog dang / /bza' dang bca' ba'i khyad par ci yang thogs/ /zag med bde ba chen po'i reg byar bcas/ /rgyal srid rin chen bdun dang bkra shis kyi/ /rtags brgyad rdzas brgyad la sogs mchod pa'i tshogs/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin 'di/ /'jam mgon lha yi 'khor lo'i tsho gos la 'bul/ /gong gi sngags gsham du rū pa nas/ spar+sha'i bar dang / sa bha rat+na lha tha bha wa āḥ&/ de nas gtor ma spyi 'gro ltar byin gyis brlabs te phul/ gzhen nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po/ /sogs dang / rgyas par spro na bstod sprin rgya mtshos bstod/ gzhan yang skabs su 'os pas de ltar bya'o/ /mtshams sprin lang tsho rgyas pa'i mtshan dpe'i sku/ /grangs med 'gro la rjes su chags pa'i nyams/ /rgyal sras gzhe zhe nur ston pa'i ngag gi lha/ /rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /dri med rab dkar shel gyi phung po la/ /(ldan sko tshogs tshon gyis kha dog bsgyur ba ltar/ /gcig las du mar snang ba'i sprul bsgyur mkhan/ /thugs kyi lha tsho gos rnams la gsol ba —330

rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i lha tshogs rnams kyi sgrub 'phrin/ 6)'debs/ /chags bral chags pa'i nyams ldan nu 'bur rgyas/ /rked skabs rked med bzhin du rnam par phra/ /dngos grub dngos su ster ba'i mkha' 'gro lnga/ /gsung gi lha tshogs rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /grangs med gdul bya'i lcags khams ji snyed pa/ /rigs dang 'phrin las sna tsho gos du ma'i rtsis/ /khyab bdag 'khor lo'i gser du sgyur byed pa/ /sku yi lha tshogs rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i 'phrin las sa/ /nyes pa'i skyon sel mthun pa'i yon tan spel/ /ljags steng rigs bzhi'i zur phud lnga pa la/ /gus pas lus btud snying nas gso le ba 'debs//rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dam pa la/ /gdung shugs drag pos thugs dam rgyud bskul zhing //mi phyed dang ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na/ /sgrib med ye shes spyan gyis legs par gzigs/ /dug gsum nyon mongs chu gter chen por bying / /las ga mi mthun rlung shugs drag pos ded/ /nyesabargya'i chu srin gdug pas rab gtses pa/ /bdag 'dra'i nyam thag 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs/ /mi shes rmongs pa'i rgyu tshogs char sprin gtibs/ /yang dag lta ba'i go skabs mun pas bsgribs/ /ngan 'gro'i g.yang la 'phyan pa'i 'gro rnams la/ /tshad med thugs rjes gzigs shog 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /duḥkhas mnar ba'i 'gro rnams yal dor na/ /ring nas 'gro rnams sgrol ba'i thugs bskyed kyis/ /rlabs chen spyod pa'i khur chen khyer ro zhes/ /snyan pa'i grags pa brjod pa'ang gtam du (5ba)zad/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba gsum/ /thams cad lus pa med par gcig bsdus pa//ngag gi rgyal po 'grub pa'i mgon khyod la/ /rnam 'dren kun gyi yab ces grags min nam/ /de phyir thugs rje chen po'i mtshon rnon gyis/ /mi shes rmongs pa'i dra ba rab chod la/ shes bya thams cad gzigs pa'i go 'phang mchog /'bad med lag rtser stsol cig lhag pa'i lha/ /zhes gsol ba drag tu 'debs/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ spyi bo'i sku gsung thugs kyi zla ba la gnas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi lha lnga phrag gsum dang / ljags steng gi lha bzhi ste/ lha bcu dgu'i thugs gar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs drug pa lte ba bcas pa'i dbus su dhīḥ rtsibs la a a ra pa tsa na zhes pas bskor ba la —331—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)dmigs pa gtod dgos te/ rgyas par 'khor lo bcu dgu ste zhes pa'i lugs so/ / de'ang zhi ba'i las bsgrub na/ gong gi mngon rtogs kyi skabs su dhīḥdakar ba las thugs kyi 'jam dbyangs dkar po zhes pa dang / 'dab ma bzhi'i dbus dang phyogs bzhin/ rang dang 'dra ba'i 'jam dbyangs zhes lnga ka dkar por bskyed la/ gsung dang sku la yang 'don pa bsgyur lugs rigs 'gre zhing / ljags kyi skabs su/ de'i phyogs bzhi'i 'jam dbyangs dkar po zhes brjod/ spyan 'dren mchod bstod sogs dngos gzhi dang 'dra la/ gsol 'debs kyi mjug tu/ khyad par rmonges pa'i mun pa stug po dang / nad gdon bgegs dang nye bar 'tshe ba kun/ /ma lus byang zhing zhi ba'i dngos grub rnams/ /thogs med 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab sngags mjug tu ma ma sarba dz+wa ra : bi na ya ka shan+ti ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes bzlas pa bya zhing / thugs rgyud bskul bas/ lha tsho gis rnams kyi thugs (6na po las 'od zer 'phros/ rang 'dra dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ bum pa'i chu spyi bo nasablug pas/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs gang yin pa de dag par bsam/ rgyas pa'i skabs su sa bon dang lha rnams ser por bsgyur ba sogs rigs 'gre sngar ltar/ phyag mtshan rin po che dang rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ gsol 'debs kyi skabs/ las rtsod rtsom dang thos bsam sgom pa yi/ /chos kun rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab dang / /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor la sogs pa/ /rnam par rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba gdab cing / sngags kyi mjug tu/ ma ma dzñā nā yu5khyu pu spyi ku ru swāhā/ zhes bzlas pa bya zhing / thugs rgyud bskul bas gang 'dod pa'i don 'grub par bsam/de'ang shes rab gtso bor 'dod na phyag mtshan glegs ral/ nor lha nor bus mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ting 'dzin 'phel bar rdor dril sogs skabs thob kyis 'don pa spo/ dbang gi skabs su/ tshe dang /longs spyod/ gang zag gsum las/ sa bon sogs dkar por bsgyur ba rigs 'gre zhing / dud pa'i phyag mtshan bum pa dmar po'i 'chi med kyi bdud rtsis gang ba lte bar ral gris mtshan pa dang /gnyis pa la rgyal mtshan gyi rtse nor bus brgyan pa dang / bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ gsum pa la —332

rgyud sdo rnam bzhi'i lha tshogs rnams kyi sgrub 'phrin/ thenalcags kyu 'dzin par 'don pa bsgyur/ gsol 'debs kyi mjug tu/ byu ru'i rdul mang brtsegs pa'i lhun po la/ /nyin byed 'bum gyis 'byud pa'i
