mdangs 'dzin pas/ /bdag la 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub/ ma lus dbang du bsdu ba'i dngos grub stsol/ zhes dang / gzhan (6bsko nyis la tshig rkang gsum pa 'don pa bsgyur te gsol ba gdab sngags mjug tu a su ka wa sha ku ru swāhā/ zhes bzlas pa bya zhing thugs rgyud bskul bas/ gang 'dod pa'i dngos grub dbang du bsdus par bsam mo/ /ma sdug tu mchod bstod bya/ thugs ka'i lha rnams 'jam dbyangs sngon po la thim/ mgrin pa'i rnams dmar po la thim spyi bo'i rnams dkar bo la thim/ ljags steng gi rnams ral gri la thim/ de bzhi yang gtso bo la thim/gtso bo yang thugs ga'i dhīḥl thim/ de tsheg drag la thim/ de mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag /bsngo ba smon lam ci rigs pa bya'o/ /man ngag dpag bsam ljon pa las/ /zhabrugasasdebs me tog rab rgyas shing / /don bzang 'bras bu smin pa 'di/ /don gnyer legs bris dga' ston mtshar/ /zhes 'jam dbyangs lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs 'dod 'jo'i gter zhes bya ba 'di'ang /bka' bcu pa bstan pa dar rgyas kyis nan gyis bskul ba la brten nas ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i gsung ngag gab 'khrugs thor bur yod pa rnams bsdebs te sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig sngags 'chang ba'i ban+de wā gi rgyu'i ming can no/ /rab sngon 'bras ldan dus kyi lha lam ngos/ /zla gzhon dkyil 'khor rgyas lta'i na chung ma/ /rmad byung lang tsho'i dpal las mdzes sdug gi /cha shas yongs rdzogs dbyangs can lha der 'dud/ /bdag sogs grangs med lus can tshogs rnams kun/ /deng nas rnam 'dren go 'phang ma thob par/ /slu med rin chen gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ /dngos grub dga' ston rgya mtsho stsal du gsol/ /bdag nyid ngag dbang lha (7na〉rgor gsal ba yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i hrī las 'od 'phros pas/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus tshangs sras ngag gi lha/ /thogs med spyan drangs mdun gyi mkha' la bzhugs/ /oṃ swa ra su sti arnya pra la hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du sha rdi'i bar gyi mchod/ skyabs gsum la 'dud sdig bshags dag la —333

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)smon/ /gzhan phyir 'jug pa byang chub sems mchog bskyed/ /'gro rnams sdug bsngal de rgyu rab bcomasanas/ /gnas skabs mthar thug bde ba'i dpal thob shog /cha shā n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa lha khyu ko3rnya/chos kun rang bzhin grub pas stong nyid dang / /paṃ las rab dkar sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan can/ /'dab brgyad lte bar a yi 'phro 'du las/ /bsil sbyin mkhan po'i dkyil 'khor nya gang steng / shel dkar mdangs ga bdag gi sems nyid hrī/ /'od kyis 'phags tshogis mchode cing 'gro rnams kyi/ /chos kun lta la rmonges byed mun tshogs bcoms/ shes rab 'od rgyas tshur 'dus yongs gyur las/ /rang wo rgyal ba kun yum dbyangs can lha/ /zla gzhen 'bum gyi khengs pa 'phrog byed pa'i/ /dkar 'jam rgyu rtsal kun rdzogs sgeg mo'i lus/ /be+e ḍūr dkar po'i lhag phran gzhen nu de/ /byed pos sug par byas snyam zung gi phyag /tshangs dbyangs 'bum sde zil gyis gnon byed pa'i/ /stong gi rgyud ldan dri za'i pi wang de/ /g.yon phyogs dkur brten g.yas pa'i sor mos brdung / /bgrod byed phan tshun yid gcugasamadza' bo ltar/ /mi phyed dam bcings tsog pu'i tshul du bzhugs/ /grangs med rin chen dar gyis legs brgyan pas/ mig skya'i nor kun sdus snyam yid la grang / /in+d+ra nī (7ba)la'i phung po dus mtha'i mes/lan brgyar bzhu ba'i khu ba mngon byugs lta'i/ /zur phud spyi bor bcings pa'i lhag ma ni/ /sil bur 'phyang bas sku stod rab tu khebs/ /chu shel dbang po mkha' dbyings la 'ongs tshe/ /'di bas lhag pa'i rab sngon kun gsal zhig /yod snyam blta phyir mgo skyes rtser 'ongs bas/ /thor tshugs rnam par mdzes pa'i dpal du gyur/ /chos kyi 'khor lo gyen du bslang ba'i nang / /srog gi ngo bo e dkar nā da las/ /'od zer sna bug g.yas nas lcags kyu'i dbyibs/ /los pas lho phyogs chu gter chen po'i 'gram/ /spang ljongs mar gad zhun ma bkram 'dra'i dbus/ /rkang 'thung phreng 'khrigs 'dab stong rnam par ba 'ad/ /dri za'i tshogs kun gar bsgyur sgra snyan sgrog /yid 'ong dga' ba'i tshal der legs bzhugs pa/ /thogs pa med spyon dam ye dbyer med dang / /slar mchod ngag dbang shangs bug lam brgyud de/ /'khor lo khab len rdo dang lcags phrad bzhin/ /rang gi sna bug g.yon drangs lha la thim/ /—334

rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i lha tshogs rnams kyi sgrub 'phrin/ 6)de las snying gar shes rab 'khor lo ni/ pad dkar 'dab brgyad kun phan dkyil 'khor steng / /sems nyid lha gis tha mar bcu drug dbyangs/ /mar me'i phreng ltar dkar gsal 'od mdangs kyis/ /lus kyi nang khengs mi shes mun pa bsal/hrī las hrī 'phros zhaX thon lte bar zhugs/ /mgal me ltar 'khor grangs med 'od zer gyis/ /srid gsum gnas rnams kun tu 'phros pa yis/ /phun tshogs yon to shes bya'i gnas kun dang / khyad par rig gnas bcu phrag ma lus pa'i/ /'chad rtsod rtsom dang gzhung mang 'dzin pa sogs/ /kun bsdus snying gar thim pas don rnams 'grub/ /ces (8na〉snyen pa bya zhing de nas snod gtsang mar dkar gtor bshams la/ /thugs ga'i 'od kyis ngag dbang dbyangs can lha/ /spyan drangs zag med bdud rtsis tshim par gyur/ /swa ra su skyi hrī ā kā ro sogs kyis 'bul lo/ /mdzes sdug lang tsho med byung tshangs sras lha/ /lar rtsod rtsom dang gzhung mang 'dzin pa sogs/ /phul byung ngag gi dngos grub ma lus pa/ /thogs med 'grub pa'i dga' ston stsal du gsol//lhag pa'i lha mo dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs shes rab kun phan gsar pa zhes bya ba 'di yang / rang dang skal mnyam 'ga' la phan pa'i phyir du/ bcu phrag rig gnas 'dzin pa'i tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i rdo rjes bris pa'o/ /rab dkar kha ba'i sa 'dzin dkar po'i 'od/ /rta bdun gos su gyon tshe mas dpe'i mdangs/yid la dpyang thag ri mo 'dri byed pa'i/ /'phags mchog phyag na pad+mas dge legs stsol/ /gang gi sgrub thabs lhag phrag gzhen nu yis/ /dngos grub ge sar bdud rtsi'i zil mngar can/ /dri bzung zad mi shes pa'i lcags kyo yis/ tags ldan gnyis 'thung sna yi zhags pa 'bigs/ /skyabs 'gro semasabaskyed spyi dang mthun par byas la/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las po las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nya gang ba'i steng du/ rang gi sems nyid yi ge hrīḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs be+eḍūr+ya'i lhun po nyi ma bye ba'i 'od kyis stid pa lta bu'i dkar gsal 'od kyi gzi mdangs can/ zhal —335

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)gcig phyag bzhi dang po'i snyim pa thugs gar zum zhing /(8ba〉na yas 'og mas man shel gyi 'phreng ba dang / g.yon 'dab stong dkar po rnam par bzhad pa'i 'khri shing 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs lhag ma sil bur 'phyang ba/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi phras legs par spud pa'i rgyan gyis dbu dang phyag zhabs rab tu spras shing / lha rdzas kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs lhab lhub tu mdzes par zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis dbang gzhu ltar bkra ba'i gur khyim gyi dbus na bzhugs par bsam par/ po ṭa la nas thugs rje chen po 'khor bcas spyan drangs la/ rnam par dag pa'i bde ba chen po'i nyid / gru 'dzin spo na 'phags ma chag thugs rje'i lha/ /mi phyed dad dang mos pas spyan 'dren na/ /brtse bas dgongs la gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /dzaḥ& baṃ sngo gnyis su med par gyur/slar yang 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ bdud rtsi'i chus spyi bo nasadabang bskur/ lus gang / dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa las/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ zhi byung bzang po'i sman gyi mngar ba'i ro/ /chu ga kho byu po khrod du bro ba lha'i/ /ma rdzo yon zhabs bsil dba' rlabs 'phyo ba 'di/ /dza hu'i bu mo'o rgyun bzhin rnam par 'bul/ /mchod sbyin brgya pa'i khrus kyi rdzing bu la/ /lha mi'i 'dam skyes tshogos kun byed po yis/ /gcig tu bsdus sam kun gsal zhu ba'i dbus/ /mi lhung 'phreng ba brgyus ltar rnam par 'brel/ /brang 'gros stid pa'i rkang 'thung dbang po sogs/ /grangs med ljon pa'i phung po rgod ma khas/ /mngon par bsregs pa'i dud pa glang po'i grogs/ /sna yi lam du dgyes pa bskyed phyir (9na lko.u la/ /gser mngal can gyis dus kyi me dpung phreng / /nor 'dzin khyon 'dir bsgrigs snyam bcu gnyis bdag /lha las bskor ba'i zol gyis byed pa lha'i/ khun tshogs stug po'i dgra las rgyal 'di 'bul/ /gang zhig myangs tshe bdud rtsi'i za ma tog /waṃ med gnas nas gling 'dir 'phos 'dra ba'i/ /ro brgya'i gan kyi ma ma 'dod dgu'i dpyid/ /bshosabaza' tshar du dngar ba'i phreng 'di 'bul/ /sna tshogs glu dang grangs med rol mo yi/ /snyan 'gyur rna ba'i bcud len lang tsho'i dpal/ /dbyangs bdun rgyud las nyer drangs mchod pa'i tshogs/ /dngos —336

rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i lha tshogs rnams kyi sgrub 'phrin/ 6)bshams yid sprul blo yis blangs te 'bul/ /de nas thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar yi ge drug gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/'phags pa mchod/ rigs drug gi sdug bsngal sbyangs/ thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang la bkod par mos nas 'byer sogasum dang ldan pas/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ khyiḥ zhes bzlas brjod bya'o/ /mthar/ dge ba 'di yis myu du bdag /ces sogs brjod cing smon lam gdab pa/ /zhes pa 'di yang er khe tha'i ji'i gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas/ a wa dhū ti pa wā gī shwa ra su dhī swā ga ras sbyar ba'o/ /na ma ār+ya tsa la ni lā ya/ rin chen be+e ḍūr brtsegs pa'i lhun po la/ /nyi ma 'bum gyis stid pa'i gzi mdangs can/ /rgud pa'i dpung 'joms bcom ldan mi g.yo ba'i/ /sgrub thabs ut+pal chun po deng 'dir spel/ /de la 'dir bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba sngon po'i sgrub thabs nyams su blang bar bya ba la/ (9ba tshe gnas yid dang mthun par stan bde ba la 'dug ste skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar bya/ tshogs zhing ni/ rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo bar gsal ba'i thugs kar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ sngon po las 'od zer 'phros pas bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ na ma gu ru saḥ na ma ār+ya a tsa la maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wā ri dzñāḥ zhes phyag bya/ gong gi sngags mthar ji nas sha rdi'i bar gyis mchode/ rgyun bshags bya zhing tshad med bzhi bsgom pa spyi ltar ro/ /dngos gzhi ni/ oṃ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi sems kyi ngo bo yi ge hūṃ mthing nag /de las 'od zer sa 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba sku mdog mthing nag /zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser 'bar zhing dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yasaye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon thugs skar sdigs mdzub bsgreng —337

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)ba/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ rin po che dang sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ bgegs kyi rgyal po gan rkyal du skyel ba'i steng du zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsams la/ de'i thugs kar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du (10na ྅ mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes sems dpa' mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa ma dzaḥs spyan drangs sngar ltar mchod/dzaḥ& baṃ sngos gnyis su med par bstim/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/thugs gar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par mos te/ thugs spu'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ pañtsa kū la'i sngags kyi mthar mchod/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pasade rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs te oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas sdig sgrib thams cad dag lus thams cad bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gang / chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par bsam/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs dar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs kyi nus pa thams cad bsdus te/ sa bon sngags 'khor dang bcas pa la thim pas/ bdag byin gyis brlabs par bsam la/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces ma yengs par 'bum phrag bcu sogs bzla bar bya'o/ /thun mtshams su bdag bskyed kyi ye shes ba mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ zhes brjod la sngar bzhin mchod/ bcom ldan 'dasabadag dang sems(10bcan thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ badz+ra mus rang gnas su gshegs/ nyer bsdu ni rang nyid lhar gsal ba 'od du zhu nas sngags 'khor la thim/ de hūṃ la thim/ de'ang zhabs kyu khog pa/ khog pa mgo bo/ de klad kor/ de nā da/ de'ang mi dmigs —338

rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i lha tshogs rnams kyi sgrub 'phrin/ 6)pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag /de las langs te bsngo ba smon lam ci rigs pa gdab/ yi ge bcu pa'i bsnyen pa them nas dmigs pa skor gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin dang sngags kyi nyams len brgya rtsa'i nang bzhin bya'o/ /gong 'og rgyud sde'i man ngag bdag mdun sogs/ /'khrul med gnad kyi nyams len mi shes par/ /spros 'dod 'brel med gzhan gyi rgyas 'gebs sogs/ /ngal ba'i dka' thub lhur len tsam du zad/ /de phyir nyams len tshar zhing khyer bde ba/ /mkhas grub dam pa'i phyag len ji bzhin du/ /bkod pa'i dge 'dis 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /rdo rje gtum pos rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /ces bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba sngon po'i sgrub skor la/ mnyam med jo bo chen po dang / lo chen ba ri'i bka' srol gnyis las/ dpal snar thang pa'i man ngag brgya rtsa'i lugs kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i sgrub thabs ut+pal chun po zhes bya ba 'di ni bkra shis sgo mangs gra tshang gi 'chad nyan pa 'phrin las kyis bskul ba'i ngor 'jam mgon grub pa'i dbang po dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi phyag len ji lta bar/za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gdong kha pa dbang rgyal lo/ /na mo gu ru dzo wā gi shwa rā ya/ thun mtshams lang tsho'i rang bzhin dhīḥyig gzugs/ /thabs shes lus(11na)phra'i mngal du lci ba'i dpal/ /mtshan dpe'i snang ba mi yi srid pa can/ /'jam mgon bsdu me kha pa der gus btud nas/ /gang der brtan pa'i 'khor los dpal mgrin nas/ /dngos su stsal ba'i zab don chos kyi ri'i/ /dgongs don ji bzhin 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi/ /sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim pa deng 'dir 'god/ /de'ang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshogs zhing tshad med bzhi bsgom pa spyi 'gro ltar sngon du btang / rang nyid tha mal du gnas pa'i snying sgo nga lta bu'i rtse mo gyen du bstan pa'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rgyas pa'i steng na yi ge dhīḥdamar ser tsheg drag dang bcas pa las 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dab/ /'od zer ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros pas/ rgyal ba sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rnams bsdus nas —339

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rang la thim/sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/shes rab kyi snang ba la bkod/tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/skad cig gis rang nyid tha mal gyi snang byu dag nas/rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri mkha' la 'phyar zhing /g.yon me tog ༄ la la'i yu ba mtheb srin gyis thugs gar bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad du kha phye ba'i steng na shes ra kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam bzhugs pa/zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung can/rin po che'i dbu rgyan/snyan o/mgul rgyan/dpung rgyan/phyag gdub 11bsko khas gdub rnams kyis spras shing /lha rdzas kyi dar gyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs lhab lhub tu 'phyang ba/ral pa'i zur phud g.yon du spud pa/zhi 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams ldan/sku las skyes pa'i 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/de'i spyi bor oṃ/mgrin par āḥ/thugs kar hūṃ/de las 'od 'phros/rang bzhin dag pa'i gzhal yas khang nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs/dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par gyur/oṃ ār+ya wā gi shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra arnya nas/shabha'i bar gyis mchode/bstod pa ni/rab dkar chu skyes rgyas pa'i lte ba la//chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i steng //bcu drug lang tsho'i gzi ldan 'gying bag can//'jam mgon gzhen nu'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo//ji snyed 'gro 'di'i yid ngor 'char ba'i gdangs//ma 'dres so sor snang ba'i tshangs pa'i dbyangs//skal bzang rna ba'i rgyan gyur ngag gi tshogs//'dod 'jo'i dbang phyug gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/kun gsal zhags pa'i tshad kyis gzhal dka' ba'i//phul byung mkhyen pa'i rnyog bral chu gter ngos//rab 'byams shes bya'i snang brnyan ma lus kun//gsal bar 'char byed thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/zhes dang /gzhan yang /gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po/zhes sogs kyis bstod/de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/thugasagar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge dhīḥdamar ser tsheg drag dang bcas pa'i mtha' skor du a ra pa tsa na'i sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 4/2na ) zer 'phros/sangs rgyas byang sems/nyan

rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i lha tsho gis rnams kyi sgrub 'phrin/ 6)thos rang rgyal/ phyi nang gi mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta sogs kyi thos bsam sgom gsum 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi shes rab rnams bsdus te/ rang nyid la thim par bsam la bzlas pa bya/ mthar yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bskang / dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ces sogs kyi smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs pa brjod par bya'o/ /'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi sgrub thabs 'di'ang / bka' bcu dar rgyas kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o/ /na mo mu ni sgru ya/ gser gyi lhun po mtshams sprin ga tho ne nu yis/ /lan brgyar 'byud pa'i dpal la dgran bzod pa'i/ /kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen la phyag btsal nas/ /gang gi sgrub thabs cung zad spel bar bya/ /yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bris sku dang ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa bshams te/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshogs zhing tshad med bzhi bsgom pa spyi ltar bya/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang sems yi ge thu ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa dbu gtsug tor dang ldan pa/ zhal 'dzum bag can/ phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag /zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyi bdag nyid du gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shesapa spyan drangs/ dzaḥlha baṃ sngo gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a lha nas/ shabha'i (12ba)bar gyis mchod/ mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal/ /gser mdog 'dra ba khyod la phyag 'tshal la/ /rdul bral khyod 'dra srid pa gsum ma mchis/ /mnyam med mkhyen can khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thugs kar zla ba'i steng du sngags kyi 'phreng ba las 'od zer gyi spro bsdudang bcas te/ /oṃ mu ba mu ne ma hā mu na ye swāhā/ /zhes bzla bar bya/ mjug tu smon lam ci rigs pa gdab bo/ /zhes pa yang mgon po skyabs kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dpal snar thang pa'i bka' srol ltar sbyar/ /—341

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi las byang dbang chen dgyes pa'i rol gar zhes bya ba bzhugs/dpal ldan rgyal kun 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i gar//'jigs rung khro bo'i nyams kyi rol ba can//dbang chen rta mchog dpal la gus btud nas/khyun 'byer 'phrin las rim pa deng 'dir 'dri/skyabs 'gro ni/bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam sems can kun//bla ma sangs rgyas chosadang dge 'dun sogs//phyi nang gsang gsum skyabs yul dam pa la//zol med rtse gcig sems kyis skyabs su mchi//'khor bar 'khyams pa'i 'khrul bas 'gro ba rnams//ya gral kun bzang sa la 'god pa'i ched//dpal chen khro bo'i dbang po legs bsgrubs nas//bla med byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do//sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs brjod/tsho gos zhing ni/mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal rta mgrin gyi rigs bdag tu rdo rje slob dpon bzhugs par gyur/dzaḥ& baṃ sngo rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs la//phyag 'tshal dngos 'byor mchod pa 'bul//sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags//dge tshogs 3na thun la yi rang zhing //nges pas chos 'khor bskor ba dang //bskal brgyar mi 'gyur brtan par gsol//rang gzhan dge rtsa ma lus pa//kun mkhyen ye shes thob phyir bsngo/srung 'khor ni/rang nyid skad cig gis dpal chen rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yasardo rje dang g.yon zhi mdzub kyi rtse la me 'bar ba/dur khrod kyi mas kyis brgyan pa/chadapung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i gyi las khro bo'i tsho gos dpag tu med pa 'phro bar gyur/hūṃ/thams cad bde gshegs rgyal ba'i rang bzhin la//nga bdag gzung 'dzin rdul tsam mi dmigs kyang //dbang wo 'du ba'i lha tsho gos ma gtagos pa//log 'dren bar gcod bgegs rnams phyir dengs shig/ā+oṃ / bha gos brjo/hūṃ/rdo rje gas po ri rab rtse brgyad /sa//'bar ba'i lha wo dbang wo bka' steng du//

rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi las byang dbang chen dgyes pa'i rol gar/ 6)shin tu gtum drag khro rgyal 'jigs pa'i sku/ /sku las khro tsho gos mtshone cha'i 'od zer 'bar/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /bdud sde dpung bcas 'da' bar ma byed cig /ā+oṃ gyi pa ṅgān+ta krita badz+ra kro dha ha ya sgyi wa gnod byed thams cad hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ byin 'bebs ni/ chos sku 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang nyid las/ /longs sku rta mgrin khro bo'i lha tshogs kyis/ /gnas mchogo 'di ru byin chen myur phob la/ /rnal 'byor bdag la dbang bskur dngos grub stsol/ /sman rag gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ sman rag gtor mchod rnams ngo bo zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi/ (13bsgom pa so so'i byed las can du gyur/ā+oṃ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ/ ā+oṃ ma hā rak+ta hūṃ/ ā+oṃ ma hā bha lin+ta hūṃ/ a nas shabha'i bar brjod/ dngosagazhi ni/ chos kun skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba/ ma rtogs 'gror brtses kun khyab dbyer med pa'i/ /rang gdangs rdo ra me dpung cher 'bar ba'i/ /srung 'khor dbus su pad+ma nyi ma dang / /klu chen brgyad po bsnol ba'i khri steng du/ /bdag nyid khro bo rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal/ /zhal gsum rtsa zhal dmar po g.yas pa ljang / /g.yon zhal dkar po spyan gsum dmar la zlum/ /mche gtsigs ljags 'gril smin ma sma ra 'gyug /dmar ser dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa'i khrod/ /dbu gsum las thon rta mgo ljang zhung can/ /g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ral gri dang / /g.yon gsum sdigs mdzub mdung thung rgyu zhags 'dzin/ /zhabs brgyad g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang brdzis pa'i tshul/ /thod skam dbu rgyan khrag 'dzag mgo 'phreng can/ /glang chen mi lpags stod g.yogs stag sham dkris/ /rin chen rus pa byugs rdzas sprul la sogs/ /tshangs skud dur khrod chas kyis rnam par spras/ /mgur nas long bu'i bar kun khro chung gtams/ /bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /'jigs rung gar dgu'i nyams kyis bzhugs par gyur/ spyan 'dren ni/ khyoḥ chos kyi dbyings las g.yo med kyang / /bde chen dbang drag rol pa yi/ /bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar klong nas/ /dbang gi rgyal po gshegs su gsol//ta la gh+ri wa e gye hi dzaḥsnyi baṃ hoḥ bzhugs gsol phyag mchod ni/ 'gyur med gdan la brtan (14na)—343

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)par bzhugs/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang ba sman rag dang / /gtor ma 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /ha la sgyi dra ma hā pañtsa rak+ta bha smra ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ā+oṃ ha ya sgyi wa sa pa ri wā ra a : nas shasta'i bar brjod/ 'jigs rung dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i sku/ /mi bzad drag sngagasang ro sgrog pa'i gsung / /mkhyen brtse nus pa dpag par dka' ba'i thugs/ /khro rgyal dbang po'i sku gsung thugs la bstod/ /'jab bgrang pa ni/ rang gi sku dang thugs ka sogs/ /gnas las me 'od 'phros pa yis/ /bde gshegs nus mthu bdag la thim/ /gdug pa'i tshogs rnams tshar gcod gyur/ /ā+oṃ hrīḥpaṅgān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya sgyi ba hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ bsnyen pa dngos/ thun mtshams la zho dun bh+yo/ tri ga nan/ dza dzaḥ sa ma ya sto/ las sngags/ sa ma ya dzaḥs ma ya bzlog /sa ma ya bh+yo/ sa ma ya ga tubs/ sa ma ya byer/ sa ma ya rbad/ sa ma ya rbad rbud phaṭa ya/ 'byung po mā ra ya dzaḥ dzaḥrnams sbrel nas nyer gcig bzla/ pad+ma sa twa sa ma ya zhes sogs yig brgya bzlas/ ha ya lha wa a nas shabha'i bar gyis mchode/ srung 'khor lha bcas mi dmigs pa/ spros med stong pa'i ngang du yal/ /slar yang zhas gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /chu las nya ldang lta bur gyur/ /smras pa/ snyigs dus bdud sde'i dmag dpung tshogs/ /thal bar rlog byed rta mchog dpal/ /pad+ma'i zab chos yin pa'i phyir/ /snga 'gyur dgongs don ji bzhin bkod/ /bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i kha skong la/ /med (14ba)du mi rung tshogs mchod dag /'gro 'dul gling pa'i gsang 'dus las/ /blangs pas 'grub bo shes ldan kyai/ /dge tshogs gangs kyi ri bo la/ /'gran pa'i ches dkar 'o mtsho des/ /'gal rkyen dri ma drungs phyung nas/ /dngos grub dga' ston 'phel gyur cig /rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs 'di snye mo zhu yas kyi gter yin na'ang / las byang snga 'gyur gtsang ma zhig cher mi 'dug pa dang / gter gzhung dngos cha tshang yang dkon pas/ /bla ma'i ngag dang rat+na gling pa'i gsang 'dus nas brgyan te/ tshogs mchod ma gtogs tshang zhing 'byer bde dbang chen dgyes pa'i rol gar zhes pa 'di'ang rgya bod kyi yi ge'i rigs du ma dang ri mo sogs la blo gros kyi rtsal dang ldan zhing tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i drung yig ngag dbang dge —344
sa kyis ba 'a ldan pho =

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs srid zhi'i gdung sel bzhugs/rgyal kun thugs rje'i rang gzugs snying rje'i lha/ /dran pas srid zhi'i gdung sel 'jig rten dbang / /khyed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim pa rnams/ /tshad ldan mkhas pa'i gzhung bzhin 'di na spel/ /de la 'dir thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs yi ge drug ma'i sgrub thabs nyams su blang bar bya ba la/sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum las/ dang po sngon du 'gro ba la/ gnas khang yid du 'ong bar/ 'di nyid kyi rten dang ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa bsham/ bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas pa spyi 'gro ltar ram/ 'byer bde bar 'dod (15na sko/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma bya/ de nas tshogs gsog pa ni/ rang skad cig gis thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas thugs rje chen pos sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru saḥ na mo sarba ta thā ga ta ārla lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍal la: zhes pas phyag rgya/ oṃ ārla lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra a: nas shabha'i bar gyis mchode/ rgyun bshags lan gsum bya zhing tshad med bzhi bsgom/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ shā n+ya tā'i sngags brjod de 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas nya gang ba'i steng du/ rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo yi ge hrīḥdakar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid thugs rje chen po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs sku mdog gangs ri la nyi ma shar ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kur thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas nang bum chu shel gyi phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad pa 'dren pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / g.yon 'og mas me tog pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma rnam par rgyas pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin —346

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs srid zhi'i gdung sel/ the)pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ gdu bu/ 'og pags se mo do/ do shal sogs kyis mdzes pa/ lha rdzas kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs lhab lhub tu gsol ba/ ri dwags kra ṇa swā ra'i pags pas nu ma bkab (15ba)pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'ja' zer 'khrug pa'i dbus na dngas gsal rnyog pa med pa 'od kyi rang bzhin can du bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kur hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer los pas/po ta la nas ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim/slar yang thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra samā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa kū la sa pa ri wā ra arnya nas shabha'i bar gyis ma chene/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba bstsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ zhes dbang bskur/ lus thams cad bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang / dri ma thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu 'khyil ba las/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ mchod pa rnams a mṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ zlo las rin po che'i snod yangasashing rgya che ba'i nang du/ rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin sa dang bar snang gi khyon thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥ& gis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ ārla lo kai shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra a lha nas sha sna'i bar gyis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos (16na)sku mdog dkar/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ saḥyig dkar po'i mtha' skor du/ yi ge drug ma'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams mchod pas mnyes par byas/de rnams kyi byin rlabs dang nus pa thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas rang la bstim/ 'od —347

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)zer rnams 'gro ba rigs drug so so'i gnas su 'phros/ rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal dang / de'i rgyu las nyon bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag par byas/ sems can thams cad kyang thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang la bkod/ stod bcud thams cad rten dang brten pa'i rnam par shar ba snang ba sku'i 'khyer so/ /sgra thams cad sngags kyi gdangs sgrar shes pa grag stong gsung gi 'byer so/ /chos thams cad snang stong dbyer med du shes pa dran rtog thugs kyi 'khyer so ste/ 'khyer so gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ zhes pa'i yi ge drug ma ci nus su bzla/ skabs 'gar oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ saḥzhes pa'i yi ge bdun ma dang / oṃ āḥ/ smi:ma ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhes pa'i yi ge bcu ma yang bzla bar bya'o/ /mjug chog ni/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba 'od du zhu nas/ thugs ga'i sngags 'khor la thim de nyid kyang lha rdol thim/ ra btags khog pa la thim/ khog pa mgo bo la thim/ mgo bo gi gu la thim/ gu gu yang nam mkhar 'ja' yal ba ltar je phrar song ste mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du bzhag /stong pa'i ngang las chu las chu lhar rdol ba'i tshul du skad cig gis thugs rje chen (16ba)por gsal ba'i sgo nas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ces sogs smon lam ci rigs pa bya'o/ e ma ngo mtshar med byung dam pa'i chos/ /bya sla tshegs chung don che sgrub pa'i thabs/ /sngon med dpag bsam yongs 'du gsar pa 'di/ /don gnyis grub pa'i bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal/ /'di 'dra 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khor yug kun/ /bsod nams stobs kyi dpung pas dbang sgyur ba'i/ /dpal ldan gong ma chen po'i rgyal khab tu/ /grangs med dge legs spel ba'i byed po'i ched/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i ded dpon rdo rje 'chang / /ngur smrig gar gyis rol pa 'khon ston rje/ /spyi gtsug pad mtshor bsten pa'i rgyal khamasapa/ /za hor rigs kyi brnyes yi ger bkod/ /dge des gnam gyis bskos pa'i tshangs pa che/ /sras bcas blon 'bangs 'khor bcas sku tshe dang / /chab srid mnga' thang yar ngo'i zla ba ltar/ /'phel zhing rdo rje lta bur brtan gyur cig /—348

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs srid zhi'i gdung sel/ (tha)rab dkar gangs kyi ri bo mdzes sdug gi /phun tshogs lang tsho rgyas pa'i 'jo sgeg can/ /dusagasum rgyal ba'i yum gcig 'chi med lha/ /tshe byin yid bzhin 'khor los rtag tu skyangs/ /rgya gar mkhas gzhud mes po'i thod yangs las/ /lo chen skal ldan shing rtas drangs pa'i klung / /skyug mkhas blo gsal rgya mtsho drang srong che'i/ /legs bshad gaṅgā chu rgyun zad pa med/ /gang de'i gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin 'khor lo'i mgon/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i bsod nams mchod sdong che/ /rnam kun mchog dang ldan pa'i rdo rje 'chang / /byang chub bar du snying gi pad mtshor rol/ /de la 'dir rje btsun (17na〉skol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim pa gangs can gyi ljongs su jo bo chen po di paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na dang / gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin cen grags/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrī ste/ paṇa grub chen po bzhi'i gdams pa so so las 'ongs pa'i nang tshan/bla ma ba ri ba'i lugs nyid gtso bor byas pa'i rgyun khyer gyi rim pa brjod pa ni/ sngon 'gro dngos rjesakyi rim pa gsum las/ sngon du 'gro ba/ skyabs sems tsho gos gsog tshad med bsdom pa rnams las/skyabs sems ni spyi dang 'dra/ /tshogs gsog pa la/ rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i tī yig las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ma la bla ma 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru saḥ na ma ārla tā ra sa pa ri wā re saḥsngags mjug tu a: nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyun bshags dang tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa spyi ltar bya/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ su bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las tha las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid two yig dkar po las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can/ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang / g.yon me tog ut+pal dkar po'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo gsum du gyes pa'i snyan gyi thad gar me tog 'bras bu —349

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)gang bu gsum gyis dus gsum (17ba)gyi sangs rgyas mtsho ni pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i zur phud ltag par bcings pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhal ras kyi spyan gsum dang phyag zhabs kyi spyan bzhi ste spyan bdun dang ldan pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol la sku drang por brten pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugasaga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyi bdag la mngon par dbang bskur bstsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī hūṃ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ oṃ ārla tā ra sa pa ra wā ra a lha nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma/ zhes sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi thugs kur 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa lte ba mu khyud lnga sbrags dang bcas par bzlas bya'i sngags dang dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po sogs kyis bskor bar gsal gdab/ spyi bo'i rigs bdag gnas 'gyur ba'i mgon po tshe dpag med kyi thugs dzi'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi spro bsdu las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun dang / rang gi thugs ga'i sngags 'khor las babs pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par (18na thas ma/slar yang rang gi snying ga'i two yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer dkar ser dmar mthing ljang gu mchen kha'i tshogs rnams rim pa bzhin du 'phros/ 'od zer de dag gi gur khyim bskal pa'i rlung tsam yang mi thar pa'i rang bzhin can du gyur pa'i bar mtshams thams cad me tog ut+palas khebs pa/ rang nyid kyi phyi rol tu gdon bgegs rnams kyis glags lta bar mi nus pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo btsan po rno ngar dang ldan zhing me phung 'brug par gsal gdab/ gong gi bdud rtsi'i rgyun spro —350

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs srid zhi'i gdung sel/ 6)bsdu dang bcas pa'i dmigs pa gsal ba'i ngang nas/ oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re ma ma ā yur ༅ na pu spyi ku ru swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla/ thun mtshams su sngar ltar mchod bstod bya/ yi ge brgya las byin rlabs brtan cing lhag chad kha bskang / mjug tu dge ba bsngo ba dang / bkra shis smon lam spyi ltar bya'o/ /de ltar bsam pa tsam gyis dus min gyi/ /'chi ba'i yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ /'dod pa'i re skong dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon/ /rje btsun 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo yi/ /sgrub thabs rgyun khyer nyams su blang bde ba/ /kho po'i blo gros rin chen yol ge'i nang / /legs bshad beḍūr dkar po zhun ma'i mtsho/ /kun yid dga' ba'i 'dzum rlabs g.yas su 'khyil/ /dge des rtsod pa'i dus kyi gnam skos lha/ /'khor bcas sku tshe nyi zla dang mnyam zhing / /'jigs chen brgyad sogs mi mthun kun zhi nas/ /bsams don lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces rje btsun sgrol dkar tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs rgyun 'byer du tshig nyung ba gtso bor byas pa 'di ni/ tshe khrid zla ba'i chu rgyun gyi snying po bsdus pa'i dgongs(18brkon ltar/ gnam bskos sa'i tshangs pa'i rgyal khab tu dge legs spel ba'i slad du/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs 'dzin pa za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni smon 'gro paṇa chen no/ /—351

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs shes rab snang ba rgyas byed ces bya ba/oṃ su sti sirnyi/ mtshams sprin rdul mang brtsegs pa'i lhun po la/ /rta bdun bye ba'i 'od kyis legs 'khyud pa'i/ /rab mdzes mtshan dpe'i gar mkhan ngag gi lha/ /'jam mgon zur phud lnga pasartag tu skyongs/ /gang des dngos su byin brlabs dze tā ri/ /rdo rje gdan pa lo chen ba ri'i zhabs/ /saskya'i rje btsun khu dbon las 'ongs pa'i/ /sgrub thabasang ga 'don gsal bar 'god byed na/ /gang zhig gsung rab rgya mtshor 'jug pa la/ /blo gros rnam par rmongs pa lcags kyi khams/ /rnam dpyod gser sbyangs bco mar bsgyur nus pa'i/ shes rab snang ba rgyas byed bshad kyis nyen/ /de la 'dir 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim pa/ spyi bka' sgrub thabs bsdus pa che 'bring chung gsum gyi nang na bzhugs pa dang / zur bka' rgyal ba btsong kha pa la 'jam dbyangs kyis dngos su gnang ba'i chos skor gyi nang du bzhugs pa sogs rnam grangs mang du yod pa las/ da lam 'dir bla ma ba ri bas rje btsun sa skya par gnang ba'i 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa nar grags pa'i sgrub thabs 'bri bar bya ba la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa gsum las/ dang po la/ gnas khang yid du 'ong bar khrus dang gtsang sbra dang ldan pas/ bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba spyi 'gro ltar dang / sems bskyed pa ni/ (19na〉bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya/ de'i phyir du 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi lam gyi rim pa nyams su blang bar bya'o zhes brjod/ tshogs zhing ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'phags pa 'jam dpal du gsal ba'i thugs gar pad zla'i gdan la dhīḥyig dmar ser las 'od zer 'phros pas/rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa 'jam dpal la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs —352

'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs shes rab snang ba rgyas byed/ thenakyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru saḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ārla mnyu shrī sa pa ri wā ri saḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārla mañdza shrī sa pa ri wā ra a lha nas sha rdi'i bar gyis mchode/ rgyun bshags dang tshad med bzhi bsgom pa spyi ltar bya/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ swa bhā was/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang gi snying sgo nga lta bu'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ dhīḥdamar ser gur kum gyi mdog lta bu/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi lus thams cad gang bas sdig pa dang sgrib pa mi shes rmongs pa'i mun pa thams cad bcoms/ dri ma med pa'i 'od ltar gyur pa las/ skad cig gis rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas mi shes rmongs pa gcod pa'i ral gri dang / g.yon pas ut+pala'i yu ba thugs gar bzung nas me tog snyan gyi thad gar kha phye ba'i steng na/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung (19ba)du bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyisaspras shing dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ gzhen nu bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod ltar mdzes pa/zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ ral pa'i cod pan stod du bcings pa'i lhag ma rnams thur du 'phyang ba zur phud lnga'i tshul gyis g.yon du spud pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ dngas gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i sa bon lasa'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa 'jam dpal la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs da'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dza sa spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa kū la sa pa ri wa ra a: nas shabha'i bar gyis mchode/oṃ sarba ta tā ga ta a bhi ta thu hu me cheXg gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnamasakyis ni ga khrus gsal ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yi/ /de bzhin bdag gi sku khrus gso le/ /chasarba ta thā ga ta —353

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)a bhi ṣe ka ta sam ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārla mnyu shrī sa pa ri wā ra a: nas sha rdi'i bar gyis mchode/ gzhen nu'i sku lus yong ba'o/ /ye shes sgron me rab gsal zhing / /'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel ba/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ rang gi (20na snying gar pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ dhīḥdamar ser gyi mthar a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ zhes pa'i sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba/ lce'i rtsa bar lhag ga po gre phugs su bstan nas nyal thabs su gsal btab pa la dmigs nas bzlas pa bya zhing / skabs 'gar sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pas/rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mchod/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi mi shes rmongs pa'i mun pa thams cad bsal/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyi 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab thams cad bsdus nas mi skyo ba'i bar du bzla/ bzlasapa'i rjes su sngar ltar mchod bstod bya zhing yi ge brgya pas byin rlabs brtan par bya/ thun mthar dbugs thengs gcig la lha'i rgya rtsa gcig bgrangs te/ lus thams cad lhar gyur par bsam/ thun bsdu ba ni/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba 'od du zhu nas thugs ka'i sngags 'khor la thim/ de nyid kyang dhīḥl thim/ lhaḥgu gu la thim/ gu gul nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar bsam nas cung zad mnyam par bzhag /slar yang chu las chu lhar rdol ba'i tshul du 'jam dbyangs kyi nga rgyal dang ma bral ba byed/mjug tu dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam bkra shis sogs spyi ltar bya'o/ /e ma dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon pa las/ /phun tsho gos 'dod pa'i re ba skong byed na/ /rgyal kun yab gcig 'phags mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /bsten na mchog thun dngos grub cis mi thob/ /de phyir gang de'i sgrub thabs sngon byon gyi/ /mkhas grub dam pa'i phyag srol ma nyams pa/ /ma tshang kha bskangs gab dkrugs rnams bsdebs nas/ /bklags pas don grub nyung ngu rnam gsal 'di/ /rigs kun khyab (20ba thad ga dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon/ /ngur smrig gar gyis rol ba bla ma rje'i/ /rdo rje'i gsung gis 'tsho —354

'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs shes rab snang ba rgyas byed/ 6)ba'i ldum bu ba/ /za hor brnyes byang phyogs tal khar sbyar/ /dge ba des kyang 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /mi shes rmongs pa'i dgra las rnam rgyal nas/ /ji lta ji snyed chos kun gzigs pa yi/ /dpal ldan stobs bcu'i go 'phang thob gyur cig /ces 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs shes rab snang ba rgyas byed ces bya ba 'di yang / gnam skos sa'i tshangs pa 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po'i gser yig pa sha ji dha ra khon chin gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub sogs tshad thub kyi rdo rje slob dpon du ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni smon 'gro paṇa chen no/ /na ma wa rā su kha shu'i yaḥ thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i chu gter cher/ /gcig las du mar snang ba phyag rgya'i gar/ /mtshan bzang nyi ma 'bum gyis dpal 'bar ba'i/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug he ru ka dpal rgyal/ /mgon des thun mtshams bla gos zol sbyor gyi/ /a mong gdul bya'i snang ngor bshesaganyen tshul/ /ston mdzad chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa/ /bgrang yas dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /khyod gsung rdo rje'i tshig gi rnga bo che/ /rmad byung 'chi med dpal ster snyan pa'i sgra/ /spel legs tshig sbyor dbyu gus rab bskul na/ /ma yengs sgra 'dzin glags te legs par nyon/ /de la 'dir rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis/ chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po la dngos su gnang ba'i 'jam dbyangs kyi chos skor zhes/ zhwa ser cod pan 'dzin pa rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i zab chos su byed pa'i nang tshan dpal 'khor lo sdom pa (21na po kar po'i sgo nas tshe bsgrub pa'i rim pa la/ thog mar lugs srol 'di nyid kyi brgyud pa dang phyag len gyi rim pa zam ma chad pa las byung ba'i/ smin byed tshe'i dbang gi rim pa thob pa sngon du btang nas/ nyams su blang ba'i tshul la/ rang don du bsgrub pa dang / gzhan don du bsgrub pa'i rim pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ phyi nang gi mchod gtor rnams mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bshams/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /theg pa gsum po thams cad dang / /rnal 'byor gsang sngags—355

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)mkha' 'gro ma/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag tu skyabs su mchi bar bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni heru gar gyur nas/ /sems can thams cad he ru ga'i/ /go 'phang mchog la bgod par bgyi/ /tshogs bsags pa ni/ rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum bla ma rigs kyi bdag po'i rnam par bzhugs pa dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru saḥ na ma shrīḥtsakra sa sba ra gi ta maṇ+ḍa le saḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ tsa kra sa lnga ra si ta sa pa ri wā ra arnya nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyun bshags bzhir tshad med bzhi bsgom/ lha bskyed pa ni/ oṃ shā rgya tā dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3lha/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mi dmigs (21ba)pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems kyi ngo bo hūṃ dkar po dngul chu'i mdog ltar 'tsher ba dang / khriḥdamar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa zhal sbyor gyi rnam pa can du grub pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dusa3 dkar po de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog shel dkar gyi lhun po la nyi ma shar pa ltar dkar zhing dri ma med pa'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum la rjes su chags pa'i nyams can/ bung ba ltar gnag pa'i dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs bcings pa'i rtser zla tshes dang mtshogs ma'i steng du sna tsho gos rdo rjes brgyan pa/ phyag gnyisakyis 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dmar por re re bzung nas yum la 'byud pa/ dar gyi stod g.yogs lhab lhub tu mdzes shing rus pa'i rgyan drug dang rin po ches spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ de'i pang na yi ge hrīḥdamar po de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa lang tsho dar la bab cing nu —356

'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs shes rab snang ba rgyas byed/ the)ma dang bha ga rgyas pa/dbu skra snum zhing nag pa sil bur phab pa/phyag gnyis kyis 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsis bkang ba'i thod pa re re bzung ste yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing /zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil mo krung gi tshul gyis rked pa nas 'khril pa/pañtsa li da'i stod g.yogs dang rin po che sna tshogs kyis mdzes shing /thal ba spangs pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/yab yum gnyis ga'ang 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 22na tshe sda)nga bag sgeg pa'i nyams kyis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūṃ/thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer sa pas rang bzhin gyis gnas nas/bcomoldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/dzaḥlha baṃ hol gnyis su med par thim/yang 'od 'phros rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/oṃ pañtsa kū la sa pa ri wā ra a nas rdi'i bar gyis mchode/de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor bcas kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas/ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyisani//de bzhin gshegs pas khrus gsol ltar//lha yi chu ni dag pa yi//de bzhin bdag gis khrusabagyi'o//oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/zhes gsung zhing bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyisadabang bskur bas/lus thams cad gang dri ma thams cad dag/lha rnams bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid du gyur pa spyi bo nas sku la zhugs pa'i chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/mchod pa ni/oṃ tsakra sa sba ra gi ta sa pa ri wā ra a: nasashabha'i bar gyis mchode/oṃ āḥ& ha he hrī:phyag rgya dang bcas pas nang mchod byin gyis brlabs/mchod do sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥ//rgyal ba rdo rje la4 /rje bas 'jam dpal dbyangs/grub wo dpa' bo rdo rje/chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po/rje chos bzang 22ba / dpal ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub/paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo//mkhas grub chos ldan pa/mar ston sems dpaX chen po tshul khrims rin chen/rdo rje 'chang sngags

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)rams pa dge 'dun bkra shis/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ spyan snga chos dpal gzhon nu bzang po/ /'jam dbyangs snang mdzad rdo rje/ rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor 'phrin las kyi zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ oṃ saḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa oṃ āḥlha/ chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi zhal du / oṃ āḥlha/ oṃ a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko ྅lha/ zhes bdud rtsi myang /bstod pa ni/ mdzes shing lta bas mi ngoms mtshan dpe'i sku/ /rab snyan drug cu'i dbyangs can tshangs pa'i gsung / /mkhyen brtse nus mnga' bla med ye shes thugs/ /gsang gsum dpal ldan bde mchog 'khor lor bstod/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bdud rtsisagang ba'i bum pa dmar po/ /de'i dbus rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i lte ba'i nang du/ rang gi sems kyi ngo bo hūṃ dkar po/ /de'i steng du bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gzhung bzhin gsal gdab/ hūṃ gi mthar mdun nas brtsams te/ rmiXs ha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ tshol srungs shig zhes pas g.yasaskor du bskor bar bsgom/ snying ga'i yi dam yab yum gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'khor 'das kun gyi tshe bcud bkrag mdangs ma lus pa bsdus te phyag gi bum pa dang thod pa gang / de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te hūṃ yig la thim pas/ tshe yar pa 'khugs/ nyams pa sos/ 'chi med kyi dngos grub thob (23na)par bsams la bzlas pa ci nus su bya/ thun mtshams gtor ma 'phul bar 'dod na/ gtor ma gong gi nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ phe/ rang gi thugasaga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog dkar po yab yum mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ yab yum gyi ljags hūṃ dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa dkar po nas 'bru tsam 'khod pa'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs nas gsol bar gyur par bsams la oṃ badz+ra a ra la ho/ dzaḥ/ baṃ sngo badz+ra ḍā ki n+ya sa ma ya stoX shu sngozhes lan gsum gyis 'bul/ mchod sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥ& btegs la nang mchod 'bul/ bstod pa ni/ chu skyes 'dab stong bzhad pa'i ze'u 'bru'i rtser/ /rta bdun bdag po'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas—358

'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs shes rab snang ba rgyas byed/ 6)steng / /bde stong zung 'jug nyams kyi 'jo sgeg can/ /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub ster la 'dud/ /brjod du med pa stong pa sems kyi mkhar/ /snang ba lha skur shar ba'i 'ja' ris can/ /rang bzhin med kyang don kun bsgrub nus pa'i/ /ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar mkhan/ /chu shel pad dkar dung dang zla 'od kyis/ /bskrun par nus min lang tsho dar ba'i sku/ /'dod bral shes rab ma la rjes chags pa'i/ /zag med bde chen 'gro la ngom pa bzhin/ /mnyen 'jam phyag gis bum bzang legs bteg nas/ /'gro la 'chi med dngos grub ster ba dang / /lhan cig rgyal yum rdo rje rnal 'byor mar/ /mnyam sbyor 'khyud pa'i rtse dga' khong nas dgod/ /dbang sngon ltar mthing dbu skra'i thor tshugs rtser/ /'gro la lhag bsam mtshon pa'i zla tshes (23brkokar/ /'dzum ldan zhal gyis bsus pa'i ma 'dris 'gro /dkyus ring sman gyis rtag tu brtse ba bzhin/ /ut+pal nag klung lta bu'i smin 'byogs shing / gang kyi gzengs mtho snyan shal ring du 'phyangs/ /rab dmar mchu sgros 'dab ma rgyas pa'i nang / /tshemasadakar ze'u 'bru'i mu tig 'phreng ba dgod/ /spros pa kun bral stong gzugs phyag rgya'i sku/ /sna tshogasarin chen rus pa'i rgyan gyis spud/ /sgrib bral mtshan dpe'i snang brnyan ston pa'i ched/ /phyi nang gsal ba dar gyi na bzas mdzes/ khres rab lha mor shar ba'i mtshon rnon gyis/ /dug lnga'i g.yul las rgyal yang ma tshim par/ /gnyis med gnyis su snang ba'i lus phra mar/ /mi phyed mdza' ba'i phyag rgya dam por bcings/ /nges pa'i don du chos sku'i rang bzhin can/ /gdul bya'i snang ngor bzhin lag sprul sku'i gzugs/ /'chi med tshe yi mchog sbyin bcom ldan 'das/ /'khor lo sdom pa yab yum la phyag 'tshal/ /bsnyen cing mchod bstod gsol btab lha lam ngos/ /thugs rje'i chu 'dzin dkar po 'khrigasapa las/ byin rlabs 'dzad mi shes pa'i char rgyun gyis/ /tshe dpal bsod nams myu gu smin par mdzod//tshe rabs kun tu dal ba'i rten bzang thob/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bshes gnyen mgon gyis zin/ /zab rgyas dam pa'i chos la longs spyad nas/ /'gro ba kun gyi mgon du 'gyur bar shog /ces bstod cing smon lam du byas nas/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ oṃ yo ga shu d+dha sarba dharmā yo ga shu d+dha ྅ha/ zhes gtor —339

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)mgron gyi lha rnams rang nyid la bsdu/ nyer bsdu bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ /yum yab (24na〉pa thim/ yab bum pa la thim/ bum pa rdo rje la thim/ rdo rje sngags 'phreng la thim/ sngags 'phreng hūṃ yig la thim/ /de nyid kyang zhabs kyu nas rim bzhin nā da'i bar du thim nas/ mthar spros bral gi ngang du cung zad mnyam par bzhag /slar yang lha'i skur langs te smon lam ni/ srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags dul bar ldan/ /'od zer dkar po stong ldan nyi ma brgya stong ldan/ /sna mang sku dang cha lugs rjes chags sems par ldan/ /he ru /dpal de dang lhan cig gar byed shog /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / des brjod gsung yang mchog tu tshad ma ste/ /bden pa de dag gis ni lha mo rnams/ /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sgos can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni he ru gar gyur nas/ /sems can thams cad he ru rka'i/ /go 'phang mchog la 'god par shog /ces bkra shis dang smon lam ci rigs pa bya'o/ /gnyisapa g.yin don du sgrub na/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du bum pa bcud ldan mdun rang la bstan te bzhag /mchod gtor sogs gzhung bzhin bshams/ shā n+ya lhas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las: lasabyung ba'i bum pa/ sto ba che ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul ba dkris pa/ nang thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma zhesapa nas bzung ste/ mchod bstod kyi bar gzhung bzhin bya/ de nas gzungs rdor gzungs thag rigasalnga'i rang bzhin du mos te/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros gzungs thag la 'khril (24ba)nas lha'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ yab yum gyi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ 'byung ba sogs brten pa snod kyi yon tan rnams dang / sangs rgyas byang sems/ nyan rang /tshangs pa/ dbang phyug /khyab 'jug /'khor los sgyur rgyal sogs g.yo ba bcud kyi gang zag rnamasakyi tshe dang bsod nams sogs mdor na srid zhi'i legs tshogis thams cad bsdus te/ lha dang bum chu la thim par mos nas/ bzlas pa bya zhing thun mtshams su mchod bstod byed/ de ltar bsgrubs pas —360

'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs shes rab snang ba rgyas byed/ (thadadangos grub kyi ltas bzang ba byung ba dang / lha yab yum rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur par mos nas/ bsgrub bya la ster zhing rang nyid kyis longs spyod pa yang rung ngo //smras pa/ rgyal kun yab gcig zur phud lnga po gang / bshes gnyen gzugs kyi rnam rol btsong kha pa'i/ /thugs bcud zab las ches zab bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /brgyud ldan bla ma'i mkhyen yangs yol gor gtams/ /tshig nyung don rgyas rdo rje'i gsang ba'i gsung / /gab dkrugs bsdebs shing ma tshang kha bskang nas/ /blo ldan nyams su len pa khyer bde ba'i/ /sgrub thabs 'di ko sngon med yid bzhin nor//'brel med gzhan gyi rgyas bkab 'dra chos dang / /dpe 'khyams sna tshogs bsdus pa'i 'grig 'grig tshig /rtog ge'i rigs pas bsgrubs pa'i rang bzo dag /ma yin dam pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin du bris//de 'dra rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /bshes gnyen dam par shar ba 'khon ston rje'i/ /zhabs rdul gtsug tu bsten pa'i dwa ri dra/ /za hor rigs kyi bzhes yi ger bkod/ /(25na ji ge bas grangasamed lus can ma lus kun/ /'chi bdag bdud kyi g.yul las rnam rgyal te/ /'chi med grub pa stobasabacu mnga' ba yi/ /bla na med pa'i go 'phang mchog thob shog /ces dpal mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa'i zab chos thun mong ma yin pa/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi chos skor gyi nang tshan bde mchog dkar po'i sgrub thabs chog sgrigs su bkod pa sgrub thabs dpag bsam ljon shing zhes bya ba 'di ni/shar dwags po'i yul nas rig pa'i gnas du ma la thos bsam bgyi 'dod kyi 'dun pa mi dman pa'i rnam dpyod can/ lcang ra sde pa mgon po tshe dbang rab brtan dang / kong yul gyad kyi grong khyer ljon pa'i nags tshal gyi 'phreng ba tshar du dngar ba'i sa'i cha nas phan bde sprul sku ngag dbang bstan 'dzin 'phrin las kyi gsung gis bskul ba dang du blangs te/ za hor gyi rigs las bya btang rnam g.yeng can ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi chos grwar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ban ngag dbang 'phrin las so/ /srid zhi'i chos kun gdod nas stong pa'i gshis/ /rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lor rnam ba pob/ /—36/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)zag med bde chen mchog tu ro gcig pa'i/ /dpal ldan he ru ka dpal la btud de/ /mgon khyod sgrub thabs tshangs pa'i ral klung las/ khung ngu rnam gsal yan lag brgyad ldan chu/ /lnga rigs khyab 'jug dgyes bskyed zhabs bsil du/ /bsgreng ba'i skal ldan shing rta 'di na'o/ /'dir dpal 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs nyams su blang pa la/ 'di nyid kyi bris sku rab gnas dang ldan pa'i drung du (25bskong mchod bshams/ gtor ma 'bul bar spro na'ang de nyid kyang mngon par 'du byas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs sems ni/ sangs rgyas chas dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /theg pa gsum po thams cad dang / /rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag tu skyabs su mchi bar bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni he ru dar gyur nas/ /sems can thams cad he ru ga'i/ /go 'phang mchog la 'god par bgyi/ /rdo rje semasadapa'i sgom bzlas ni/ /rang gi spyi bor paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyem ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ga'ang rus pa rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ thugs kar zla gdan la hūṃ gi mthar yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis bskor bar mos la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag g.yin sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sngags 'phreng sa bon dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sangasargyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs kyi bdud rtsi bsdus nas yi ge rnams la thim de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas thim pa/ rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs te sdig sgrib thams cad bkrus shing phyir thon te dag par bsams la/ he ru ga'i yi ge brgya pa ci nus su brjod/ bdag ni mi shes rmonges pa yis/ /zhes sogs kyi mthar/ rdo rje sems dpas/ dam tshig dang nyam chags thams cad phyir dag go /zhes gsungs nas rang la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur par —362

'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs shes rab snang ba rgyas byed/ (thanabasam mo/ /dag pa gsum gyi rnal 'byor ni/ rang skad cig gis he ru gar gsal bar mos nas/ shrī he ru ko3gi/ lan gsum brjod/ dbyangs gsal oṃ dang hūṃ phaṭa kyi thog mtha' can lan gsum brjod/rang gi lte bar dbyangs gsal lan gsum bskor ba las he ru da'i tshogs 'phros/ sna bug g.yas nas thon bgegs bskrad/ sna bug g.yon nas zhugs te sngags 'phreng la thim par gyur bar bsam/tshogs zhing ni/ rang he ru gar gsal ba'i thugs gar hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bla ma dang 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen gnas/ /zhes pa'i blo ga'i mthar/ he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rnam dag rdo rje'i dbang phyug dang / /rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi/ /rdo rje phag mo de la 'dud/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtog pa 'ching gcod cing / /'jig rten bya ba la 'jug ma//de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes phyag bya/ oṃ tsakra sa bar/ a lha nas sha rdi'i bar dang / oṃ āḥbadz+ra ā da rnye hūṃ/ oṃ ā mi dz+ra li ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥ badz+ra ga rnye hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra rā se hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ badz+ra spar+sha hūṃ/ (26ba) yo ā badz+ra dharme hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ de bzhin du bdud rtsis kyang mchod par bsamasal/ oṃ sarba badz+ra k+ṣa mi ni sarba bhak+ṣa sho dha la gu tho badz+ra ṇa swā hā/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs te bde ba chen po bskyed pas lha thams cad kyis kyang bde ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur bar bsams/dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ zhes pa nas bzung ste/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog ces pa'i bar gyis rgyun bshags lan gsum bya zhing / tshad med pa bzhi spyi 'gro ltar bya/ tshogs zhing rnams rang gi smin mtshams su thim par bsams la/ 'chi ba chos sku dang bar do longs sku'i lam khyer ni/ oṃ su bhā wa shudzñā sarba dharmāḥsu bhā wa shud+dhi3nya/ thugs rka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis brtan g.yo thams cad sbyangs te 'od du gyur ba rang la thim zhing / rang yang stod smad nas rim gyis thugs ka'i hūṃ la thim/ hūṃ gi lha ni ha'i lus pa/ de mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da —363

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)la/ nā da yang 'od gsal du thim par gyur/ oṃ shu rgya tā dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3lha/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang gi sems nā da'i gzugs gyen du bsgreng ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags par gyur par bsam/ srung 'khor ni/ lha bha'i sngags brjod cing / sngags tshan dang po shar du kha dog nag po/ /gnyis pa byang du ljang gu /gsum pa nub tu dmar po/ bzhi pa lhor ser por gyur pa las 'od zer los pa yongs su gyur te/ sna tsho gis rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i ra ba/ dra ba/ gur/ bla bre dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor du gyur/ oṃ me di ni badz+ra bha wa badz+ra ban+ta hūṃ/ (27na sta blo badz+ra pra ka ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pañtsa ra hūṃ baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra be tā na hūṃ re hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra swā ra dzā la tre paṃ khri/ oṃ badz+ra tha la a na lārka hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ lha bha sngar bzhin brjod/ rten brten pa gsal 'debs shing skye ba sprul skur khyer ba ni/nang du yaṃ raṃ — lo lha rnams las 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ paṃ las pad+ma'i steng du dbyangs dkar po phrag gnyis dang gsal byed dmar po phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar la me long lta bu'i ye shes dmar mdangs mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/de'i dbus su rang sems nā da'i gzugs can de zhugs pas thig le nas lha'i bar rim par grub pa'i hūṃ yig rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ de las 'od 'phros 'gro ba rnams 'khor lo sdom pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams spyan drangs sgoms par sbyar bas zhu nas nā dar thim pas hūṃ lhan cig skye dga'i rang bzhin ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ oṃ āḥ/ oṃ sarba bi ra yo gi ni kā la wā ka tsi t+ta badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3lha/ chabadz+ra shurnya mi bo dharmāḥ badz+ra shu rtse3lha/ zla ba dbyangs gsal hūṃ bcas yongs su gyur pa las rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor grub pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du gzhal yas khang rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ dpral bar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phreng ba (27ba tshe sna dzin pa/ zhabs 364

'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs shes rab snang ba rgyas byed/ 6)g.yas brkyang pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo dang / g.yon bskum pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma mnon pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/ ral pa'i thor cogs sna tsho gos rdo rjes mtshan cing / rdo rje'i 'phreng ba la brgyus pa'i thod skam lngas dbu brgyan pa/ dbu'i g.yon du zla ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ drang srong khros pa'i nyams can gyi mche ba gtsigs la/ gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang / rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i mgo 'phreng lnga bcu 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa'o/ /de'i pang du yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ spyan gsum pa/ gcer mo skra grol ba/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khrud cing / g.yas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i gri gug 'phyar ba/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab kyi brla'i steng du 'khril ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i thod dang lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /yab kyi gsang gnas hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ byā ser po las byung ba'i nor bu dmar po byā ser pos mtshan pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas āḥdamar po las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa sdi ser po las byung ba'i byang sems dkar po phywa ser pos mtshan pa/ yab kya lte bar zla gdan la oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa ni ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ thugs kar zla gdan la / sarba burnya ḍā ki ni badz+ra war+ṇa ni ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ mgrin par nyi gdan la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kai hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ḍā ki ni dzā la saṃ bha raṃ swāhā/ dpral bar nyi gdan (28na〉pa/ oṃ khyoḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ yum gyi lte bar nyi gdan la oṃ shrī badz+ra sogs/ thugs dar nyi gdan la oṃ hrīḥha sogs/ mgrin par zla gdan la oṃ be+e ro sogs/ dbral bar zla gdan la oṃ sarba bzhi sogs yab kyi skabs ltar go ldog nas brjod/ sngagasarnams kyang phan tshun zhal sbyor du gyur/ oṃ shrī ma hā su kha badz+ra he he ru ru kai āḥ/ phaṭa swā hā/ zhesasgomasang par zhugs pas/ yas babs mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi rgyud la skyes pa'i bde stong dbyer med du sbyar bas yang dag pa'i ting 'dzin dpa la he ru ka yab yum gyi lha snang la rang bzhin med par me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar gyur par bsam/ rang gi thugs gar zla ba la rdor sems kyi ngo bo oṃ ha —365

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)dkar po/ /mgo bor nyi ma la rnam snang gi ngo bo na ma hi ser po/ /spyi gtsug tu nyi ma la pad+ma gar dbang gi ngo bo swā hā hu dmar po/ /phrag pa gnyis su nyi ma la he ru ga'i ngo bo po ṣa ṭa ha nag po/ /mig gnyisasu nyi ma la rdo rje nyi ma'i ngo bo hūṃ hūṃ ho:dmar ser/ dpral bar nyi ma la rta mchog gi ngo bo phaṭa ha ljang gu/ yum gyi lte bar nyi ma la rdo rje phag mo'i ngo bo oṃ baṃ dmar mo/ /snying gar nyi ma lag shin rje ma'i ngo bo lha yom sngon po/ /mgrin par zla ba la rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo hri mo dkar po/ /mgo bor nyi ma la skyod byed ma'i ngo bo hre hri ser po/ spyi gtsug tu nyi ma la skrag byed ma'i ngo bo hūṃ hūṃ ljang gu /dpral bar nyi ma la tsaṇ+ḍi ma'i ngo bo phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur par bsam mo/ /ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ h+pha rang gi thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbang gi lha dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs (28ba spun drangs/ oṃ ji bra tismo hūṃ swā hā zhes mchod yon phul/dzaḥ& baṃ ho:sa gnyis med du bstim/ gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ yo ga shu d+dhāḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shu sgo3lha/ oṃ ā hūṃ sarba bi ra yo ga na sa badz+ra shu rtse3lha/ oṃ ji bra la swā hā/ de bzhin btage gas pa rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sgo mtshams mas bgegs bskrad/ dpa' pos shis pa brjod/ dpa' mos rdo rje'i glu len/ gtso bosadabang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ yum gyis bum pa thogs te dbang bskur bar gyur par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sam ya shri ye hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur lus gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi bor gnas pa las/ yab la rdor sems dang / yum la rnam snang gis dbu brgyan par gyur par bsam mo/ mchod pa ni/ yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod lhas phul bar bsams te/ oṃ tsakra sa sba ra sa pa ri wā ra a lha pra la swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pā hūm̐/ añtsa mā byu/ prok+ṣa ṇi/ badz+ra pu 〉 nas sha rdi'i b.ragyis mchode/ bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ o.āḥsnyi/ ha ho hri zhes phyag rgya dang bcas byin gyis brlabs/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ rmi ༷ཿha ha rnyu hūṃ phaṭa oṃ āḥ&/ oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa ni ye nyu hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā oṃ āḥ&/ chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs yul —366

'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs shes rab snang ba rgyas byed/ 6)lha gzho bdag dang bcas pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥ&/ oṃ a skṛ ta su da na badz+ra su bhā wa ud+ma ko3nya/ zhes brjod lce thog tu yang myang ngo / (29na tha stod pa ni/ in+d+ra ni la'i lhun po la/ /byu ru'i 'khri shing gisa'abyud pa/ /sngon med gar dgu'i rol gar mkhan/ /bcom ldan yab yum la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa'am rgyas par spro na rgya skad bod skad kyi bstod pa dkyus ltar ro/ /bzlas pa ni/ bgrang 'phreng la nang mchod gtor/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'phreng ba skad cig gis pad+ma gar dbang du gyur pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros ye shes pa dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ a lha nas sha lta'i bar dang / rang sngags 'bru gsum btags pa'i nang mchod 'bul/ oṃ swā hā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa nyer gcig bzla/ de nyid zhu ba las 'phreng ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ rang gi thugasaskar nyi gdan la sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs spros/ 'gro ba'i don byas tshur 'dus te spro bsdu'i ngang nas/ yab yum gyi snying po dang nye snying bzla zhing thun 'jog khar he ru ga'i yi ge brgya pa bzla'o/ /gtor ma 'bul bar spro na cho ga rgyal ba rnams las lha mang nyung ma gtogs 'phri bsnan dgos pa med cing rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la ma byas pas chog go nyer bsdu ni/rang gi thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa gzhal yas khang la thim/ de gtso bo yab yum la thim/ yab yum gnyis kyang thugs ka'i hūṃ la thim/ hūṃ yig yongs su su gyur pa las rang dpal he ru ka yab yum du gyur pa'i thugs gar zla ba la rdor sems kyi ngo bo oṃ ha dkar po nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo phaṭa phaṭa dud ka rnams kyis mtshan pa'i bar brjod/ smon lam ni/sems can kun (29ba)gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni he ru kur gyur nas/ /sems can thams cad he ru ga'i/ /go 'phang mchog la 'god par shog /smon lam shis brjod rgyas par spro na yi ge rnying pa las shes par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i chu gter las 'ongs pa'i sgrub thabs tshig nyung don tshang rta ljang can/ /rnam g.yeng mun pas sgrib par nus min pa/ /phan bde'i snang ba'i 'od stong chesadakar 'di/ /'od gsal 'chi med gdung gis mngon mtho zhing / /bsod nams dpung pas sa chen —367

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)legs skyong ba'i/ /lha rigs rnam dpyod yangs pa'i ngag gi dbang / /dga' ldan rab tu brtan de'i rgyun khyer du/ /mdo rgyud gzhung dang tha snyad rig pa'i gnas/ /smra ba'i mgrin pa gzengs su nyer mtho bar/ /mkhas rlom gzhan gyis rgol bar nus min pa'i/ /ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos yi ger bkod/ /pha mtha' las 'das dge ba'i lha lam ngos/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa las/ /byin rlabs char gyis 'gro kun lus ngag yid/ /rab brlan bde chen myu gu smin rgyas shog /ces bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa yum bcas kyi mngon par rtogs pa tshig nyung ngur byas pa'i rgyun khyer kun 'dus nor bu'i mgrin rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ ru bzhi'i rgyal khams las lho rgyud bde bar skyong ba'i nor 'dzin dbang po lha ngag dbang dga' ldan rab brtan gyi rgyun khyer nyams len du shin tu bsdus pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas/ dril bu lha lnga'i mngon par rtogs pa las nye bar btus te za hor gyi bzhes dga' ldan pho brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /mi bzad mthu (30na〉sgrobs rdo rje 'bar ba'ogazis/ /bgegs dpung rnam par 'joms la ches dpa' ba/ /lha mchog zhabs zung snying gi pad mtsho mā /bkod nas sgrub thabs rgyun khyer nyung ngur 'dri/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rgyun khyer gyi sgom bzlas bya ba la/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum gyi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ tshogs zhing ni/ rang gi snying ga'i nang du pad nyi gnas pa'i hūṃ ljang sngon las 'od 'phros/ lus gang / sdig sgrib dag 'od zer sna bug nas phyir 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi dwa ra ṇa sa pa ra wā re khyoḥ zhes phyag bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi rā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra a lha nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pa nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar dang / sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs brjod/ dngos gzhi la/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las po las —368

'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs shes rab snang ba rgyas byed/ 6)pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i gur khang me dpung dang bcas pa'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs dar 'dzin cing / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten (30ba)pa/ khro gnyer cung zad bsdus shing yid tsam 'dzum pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyisaspras pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugasagar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ gong ltar sngags kyis mchod/ dzaḥ/ baṃ hos bstim/ yang 'od 'phros rigs lnga 'khor bcasaspyan drangs/ pañtsa kū la sa pa ri wā ra a lha nas sha rdi'i bar gyis mchode/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sam ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ lus gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur/ sngar ltar sngags kyis mchod/ gang thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyis/ /rdo rje rin chen kun nas 'bar ba'i mthus/ /bdud bzhi'i stobs rnams rnam par 'joms mdzad pa/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod/ rang gi thugs kar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba la dmigs nas/ na ma shuṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha nga brnya — / ha na ha na/ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pa bya/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ zhes brjod/ sngags kyis mchode cing bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ gis lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor (31na tha dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag blo rmongs pas ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ rtse—369

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)gol dang bcas oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs par bsams la dge ba bsngo'o//rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rgyun khyer shin tu nyung ngur byas pa zhig dgos zhes spel nag dngos grub kyis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'o/ /na ma stu ra ha ri tā ya/ mdzes sdug lang tsho'i dpal ldan 'jo sgeg can/ /ye shes 'od snang bkra ba'i bde stong sku/ /bya grub mar gad mdog la dbang gzhu'i mdangs/ /brjod bral rgyal ba'i yum mchog la btud nas/ /khyod nyid bsnyen cing gsol ba btab pa las/ /byin rlabs 'dug byed sgrub thabs a ti sha'i/ /lugs srol 'brul ba med pas nyams len dag /blun rmongs rang bzo'i bsre bslad bral 'di'o/ /rje btsun seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi sgrub thabs nyams len rgyun khyer bya bar 'dod pas/ bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi 'dug stang gis 'khod de skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar bya/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru saḥ na ma ārla tā ra maṇ+ḍa le saḥzhes phyag bya gong gi sngags gsham du a lha nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ zhes sogs kyis rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med (31ba)bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā wasastong par sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo rta yig ljang gu de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog mar gad kyi ri bo la nyin byed kyi 'od kyis phog pa lta bur ljang zhing / dri ma med pa'i shel ltar dngas la 'od zer 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon ut+pala'i yu ba mtheb srin gyis thugs rkar 'dzin pa 'dab ma snyan gyi thad gar kha phye ba/ dbu skra mthon mthing ral pa'i zur phud phyed bltab par thor cog gi tshul du bcings —370

'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs shes rab snang ba rgyas byed/ 6)shing phyed lan bu'i tshul du g.yon phyogs nas thur du 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras shing / dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs srab mos nu ma bkab pa/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs can/zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis zla ba'i rgyab yol la brten pa snang la rang bzhin med pa 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ 'og min gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ na ma ārla tā ra maṇ+ḍa le bh+ya lde/phyag bya/ a lha nas shabha'i bar gyis mcho ne/ mdun du bzhugasapa'i ye shes sems dpa' de nyid kyi phyag skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i 'og tu bdag dang bskyab bya thams cad chud par mos te phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi bstod pa ci nus su 'don/ de nas dzaḥlha baṃ two zhes brjod pas dam tshig (32na)pa dang ye shes pa ngo bo dbyer med gcig tu bstim/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ mthing kha mtshan par mos nas/ thugasaga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzak+ṣa spru spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta'i mthar mchod pa lngas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /zhes sogasakyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bdud rtsi'i chus spyi bo nasadabang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ de ltar bstod pa'i nus bsngags kyis 'grub par byed pa yin pas thugs skar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tī yig gi mthar/ oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags gyen bsgreng gi rnam pa can gyis g.yas skor du 'khod par bsams la kog dar lta bu'i tshul gyis/ bul ba dang / myur ba dang / mi gsal ba sogs kyi skyon spangs nas bzlas te thun 'jog khar yi ge brgya pas byin rlabs brtan par bya/ de nas ye shes pa phyung nas mdun du bzhugs pa la mchod bstod gsol 'debs sngar ltar byas te rang gnas su gshegs/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i gdan pad zla nas yar 'od du zhu/—371 —
