rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)sku'i stod nas mar 'od du zhu thugs ga'i zla gdan sngags 'khor dang bcas pa la thim/ de nyid tī la thim/ de yang klad kor la thim/ de nyid nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba (32ba〉ltar gyur te/ stong pa'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par bzhag /de las skad cig gis lhar gsal ba'i sgo nas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ces sogs smon lam ci rigs pas mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ smras pa/ dran pa tsam gyis 'jig pa brgyad skyob cing / /dngos grub kun stsol bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal/ /bcom ldan ma ni bsnyen dang gsol gdab pa/ /tshul bzhin shes na 'di phyi'i phan bde'i dpyid/ /'on te mun nag 'dom par 'jal ba yi/ /mi shes rmonges pa'i rang bzo'i tshig sbyor gyis/ /blang dor dmigs bu bral ba'i skye bo rnams/ /don med ngal ba'i 'khor lo bskor de nongs/ kho bos yongs 'dzin du ma'i zhal gyi lung / /snying dbus bsten pas rgya bod mkhas grub kyi/ /lugs srol ji bzhin shes pas 'khrul med du/ /yi ger bkod 'dis dpyod ldan dga' ba bskyed/ /rab dkar dge ba'i chos kyi rnga bo che/ /sgo gsum 'bad pa'i dbyug gus bskul ba las/ /'gro rnams phan bde'i sa mos rgyas byed pa'i/ /sgrub thabs chu shel dbang po deng 'dir shar/ /mtha' dang zad pa'i tshad bral mkha' mnyam gyi/ /'gro rnams sdug bsngal de rgyu las grol ba'i/ /kun mkhyen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i lhag bsam gzings/ /rje btsun thugs rje'i rlung dang phrad gyur cig /rje btsun seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi sgrub thabs kun+da'i gnyen gyur zhes pa 'di ni/ er te na da las bā dur dang tshe dbang bstan 'dzin gnyis kyis bskul ba ltar/'di nyid la lugs srol mi 'dra ba mang du yod pa'i nang nas/ mnyam med (33na)jo bo chen po las brgyud pa dpal snar thang pa'i bka' srol bzhin za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sngags ban ngag dbang 'phrin las so/ /

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas/ 6)spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhus/sa/na mo lo ke shwa rā ya/ thugs rje'i 'od kyis phan bde'i ku mud tshal/ /rgyas mdzad phyag na pad+ma chu shel dbang / khyod kyi sgrub thabs ga bur thigs pa'i rgyun/ /dmigs med 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor 'di na spel/ /de yang thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i sgom bzlas nyams su len par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tsho gis zhing tshad med bzhi bsgom pa spyi ltar byed/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ /stong pa'i ngang las po las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nya gang ba'i steng du/ rang gi sems nyid yi ge hrīḥdakar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongasasu gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun spyan ras gzigs sku mdog shel dkar ltar dwangs pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ba rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar zhing / g.yas 'og mas nor bu chu shel gyi phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad pa dang / g.yon 'og mas me tog pad ma dkar po'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad du kha bye ba/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' gsol ba/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa sgeg pa'i nyams ldan (33ba)mthon mthing ral pa'i thor tshugs kyi lhag ma sil bur 'phyang bas sku rked yan chad khebs pa mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyi bdag nyid can/ 'ja' tshon ltar rnam par bkra ba'i gur khyim gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs gar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ lho phyogs gru 'dzin ri bo'i spo nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ spros bral nyer zhi'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /grangs med lus can —373

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)thar pa'i khang bzang du/ /'khrid phyir phyag na pad+ma'i rnam rol gyis/ /thogs pa med par brtse bas gnas 'dir gshegs/ /oṃ ār+ya lo gī shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra a gye hi/ dzaḥ/ baṃ ho: gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thug ga'i 〉ཿlas 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sam ya shri ye hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur lus gang / dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rdzas rnams dngas shing thogs pa med pa/ ngo bo zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi la rnam pa rang rang gi byed las khyad par can du gyur/ oṃ āḥlha (34na〉na lag brgyad ldan rdzing bur 'khyil 'dra ba'i/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil lhag pa'i lha la 'bul/ /'chi med dga' ba'i tshal la co 'dri ba'i/ /rnam bkra me tog lhag pa'i lha la 'bul/ /chu 'dzin gsar pa'i lang long ltar 'khrigs pa'i/ /dri zhim bdug spos lhag pa'i lha la 'bul/ /nyi ma zla ba'i 'od ltar rab gsal ba'i/ /mar me'i tshogs rnams lhag pa'i lha la 'bul/ /sman bzang sna tshogs 'thul ba'i nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /dri chab ma lus lhag pa'i lha la 'bul/ /lha mi'i bza' dang btung ba kun bsdus pa'i/ /bsgos bzang dam pa lhag pa'i lha la 'bul/ /dri za'i pi wang lta bur snyan pa yi/ /rol mo'i tshogs rnams lhag pa'i lha la 'bul/ /sngags kyi mthar a lha nas shabha'i bar brjod/ rab dkar chu skyes bzhad pa'i lte ba la/ /zla ba zhun mar 'khyil pa'i gdan steng du/ /mtshan dpe'i lang tsho rgyas pa'i zlosagar can/ /'jigs med rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gag pa med pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi gdangs/ /zab don dam pa'i chos su nyer 'char ba'i/ /skal bzang rna ba'i bdud rtsi bla na med/ /yan lag drug cu'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /skye 'gag gnas bral gdod nas stong pa'i dbyings/ /'gyur pa med pa bde chen chos sku'i klong / /ma bsgribs shes bya thams cad kun gzigs pa'i/ /zag —374

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas/ the)med ye shes thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rang gi thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sems kyi ngo bo khyiḥdakar po gyen du langs pa/ de'i mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du yi ge drug pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po byung / rang gi lus thams cad gang / sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams (34bcad dag /'od zer ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ khyad par oṃ las 'od 'phros/ lha'i gnas su phog /lha rnams 'chi'am lhung byed kyi sdug bsngal sbyangs/ 'phags pa mchog gi go 'phang la bkod/ de bzhin du ma la sogs pa'i yi ge lhag ma lnga pos kyang / lha ma yin/ mi/ dud 'gro/ yi dwags/ dmyal ba rnams rim pa bzhin 'phros pas/ 'thab rtsod/ skye rga na 'chi/ glen lkugs/ bkres skom/ tsha grang bco sreg gi sdug bsngal rnams sbyangs te/ thams cad kyang 'phags pa'i go 'phang la bkod par bsam pa'i dmigs pa'i spro bsdu dang / mig gi yul du snang ba thams cad thugs rje chen po'i sku'i rnam rol/ rna ba'i yul du thos pa thams cad yi ge drug pa'i gdangs kyi sgra/ yid kyi yul du snang ba thams cad 'brul ba'i sems kyis btags pa tsam ma gtogs/ don dam par grub pa cung zad tsam yang med par bsam pa ste/ 'byer so gsum dang ldan pa'i ngang nas ye shes drug pa bzla zhing / thun 'jog khar pad+ma satwa sam ya zhes sogs yi ge brgya pa brjod/ mdun bskyed ni/ rang gi sems nyid ces pa dang /rang nyid ces pa dang rjes/ bdag bskyed ltar mchod pa yan chad dkyus bzhin byas/ de nas/ ljagasahūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/ sngags kyi mthar oṃ rda baṃ kla ta kha kha ji hi khā hi/ bdun nam nyer gcig dang / sngagasamachod kyang phul rjes/ rgyal kun snying rje chen po'i zlos gar ni/ /rgyal sras (35na gi zhen nu'i tshul du legs shar ba'i/ /'gro ba'i skyabs gcig rje btsun pad dkar 'dzin/ /bdag la sku gsung thugasakyi byin gyis rlabs/ /srid pa'i phun tsho gos tsha sreg me 'obs dang / /gnyen grogs 'khor bar 'ching ba'i lcags sgrog tu/ /mngon sum snang yang ma mthong chen chags can/ /rab rmongs bdag la thugs—375

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /yang dag dge ba'i bshes la rgyab kyis phyogs/ /mi dge'i grogs kyi rjes su nan tar slob/ /ngan song g.yang sar gom pa 'dor byed pa'i/ /blang dor mig bral bdag la thugasarjes gzigs/ /rang nyid legs 'dod sems kyis nyer drangs kyang / /rtag tu nyes byed mi dger spyad pa'i mthus/ /gtan mdun rlung la bskur ba'i smyon pa la/ /thugs rjes gzigs dang 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang / /dal 'byor rnyed dka' don che 'jig par sla/ /tshe 'di'i bde ba 'grub kyang sdug bsngal rgyu/ /dgra gnyen nges med 'gyur ba'i chos can du/ /rtogs nas mi dge spong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /lha mi'i dpal 'byor ma lus yongs thob kyang / /slar yang ngan song gnas su lhung byed pas//srid pa'i phun tshogs glog gi gar mkhan du/ /rtogs nas nges 'byung skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /grangs med skya bar phan btags gnod pas skyabs/ /drin lan gzhal dka'i mar gyur 'gro ba rnams//'dor ba dman pa'i lam du rab shes nas/ /rgyal sras spyod la bslab par byin gyis rlomes/ /grangs ring bskal chen gsum du skye dgu rnams/ /sdug bsngal zo chun 'khyud mo ltar 'khor ba/ /bzod (35ba than bsam pa mchog gis nye ba'i lam/ /gsang chen rdo rje'i theg par 'jug par shog /mtha' yas gdul bya 'dul ba rgyud sdebazhi'i/ /lha tshogs kun gsal mtha' ltar brjod bral yang /gangs can 'gro ba'i lha skal spyan ras gzigs/ /de bsgrub de yi go 'phang thob par shog /phyi rol gzugs kun lha dang lha mo'i sku/ /sgra rnams ma lus grag stong sngags kyi gdangs/ /sems nyid ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngo bo mā /rjen par rtogs nas chos skur grol bar shog /mdor na bdag la deng nas byang chub bar/ /re sa gzhan du med na tshe 'di yi/ /snang ba 'gags tshe mgon khyod dngos byon nas/ /gru 'dzin gnas der 'khrid la sras su mdzod/ gnas skabs lugs gnyis bsam pa'i don rnams grub/ mthar thug bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ /dus rnams kun tu bkra shis dga' ston gyis/ khyab par mdzod cig 'jig rten dbang phyug zhabs/ zhes dang / gzhan yang dpal ldan zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa gsol 'debs sogs gang shes kyi sgo nas gsol ba drag —376

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas/ the)tu btab pas/ mdun bskyed kyi spyi bo'i oṃ yig dkar po las/ 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po byung /rang gi smin mtshams su thim/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /sku'i dngos grub thob pa'i nus pa bzhag /de bzhin du mgrin pa'i āḥyig dmar po/ thugs ga'i hūṃ yig mthing kha/ lte ba'i swā yig ser po/gsang gnas kyi hā yig ljang gu rnams las 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun dmar/ mthing / ser/ ljang rnams rim pa bzhin byung / rang gi mgrin pa sogs(36na tha'i na thim/ ngag yid kyi sgrib pa dang yon tan 'phrin las kyi mi mthun phyogs rnams dag /gsung gi dngos grub sogs thob par bsam/de nas/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar/ sogs/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /bdag gi snying ga'i dbus su rtag bzhugs la/ byang chub ma thob bar du 'bral med du//brtse bas rjes su 'dzin par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ mdun bskyed kyi lha rang gi spyi bor byon/ rtsa dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ rang gi snying ga'i sems kyi ngo bo hrīḥyig dang gcig tu 'dres/slar yang rang gi thugs ka las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud rnams la phog /snod bcud rnams ltar gsal ba 'od du zhu/ rang la thim/ rang thugs ga'i hrīḥ hrīḥ tshig drag /de'ang 'ja' yal ba ltar bsams la cung zhig mnyam par bzhag /de ga'i ngang nas thugs rje chen po'i skur bzhedas te rgyun gyi spyod lam la 'jug go /rjod byed lo 'dab khur gyis mi lci zhing / /brjod don a ma'i gos bu rab smin pa'i/ /sngon med sgrub thabs rkang 'thung dbang po 'di/ blo gros dga' ba'i tshal las rnam par 'ongs/ zhes thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba bla ma gangs ras dbang phyug dang / nang so dngos grub gnyis kyis bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /na ma pi kho pad+ma shukla dha rā ya/ bde gshegs zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor (36ba)'khor lo yi/ /gsang gsum mi shigs sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /'jig rten dbang phyug phyag na pad+ma dkar/ khyod kyi sgrub pa'i rim pa 'dir bshad bya/ /'dir thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs yi ge drug pa'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang —377

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas/ (thadahoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa kū la sa pa ri wā ra arnya nas/ shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta (37ba〉sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes gsungs zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus thams cad bdud rtsi'i chus gang / lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ oṃ lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra a lha pra la ya swāhā/ de bzhin du gong gi sngags so so'i mgor sbyar te/ pā du nas shabha'i bar gyis mchode/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar/ zhes sogs kyis bstod/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs dar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar yi ge drug pa'i sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas la mchod pa phul zhing dngos grub rnams tshur 'dus bdag la thim/'od zer khams gsum gyi sems can la phog pas/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal sbyangs te thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang la bkod par bsam pa'i ngang nas yi ge drug pa ci nus su bzla zhing /thun 'jog par 'dod na/ thal mo sbyar te/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i lha tsho gos rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi bka' drin ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ bsngo ba smon lam ci rigs pa bya/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor dang gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par rang la thim par bsam zhing shis pa brjod la gnas gsum du oṃ āḥlha gis mtshan par bsam mo/ gsol 'debs dang smon lam rgyas par spro na/ 'jam mnyen pad dkar bzhad pa'i ze'u 'bru'i steng / /cha shas (38na〉(ngas su gang ba'i zla gdan la/ /legs bzhugs lta bas mi ngoms mdzes pa'i sku/ /mig gi bdud rtsir gyur la —379

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()gsol ba 'debs//'dzum ldan zhal gyis 'gro kun thad par bsu//dkyus ring spyan gyis dus drug g.yel med gzigs//chos dbyings mtsho ni pa'i dbu skra'i thor tshugs can//'od dpag med kyis brgyan par gsol ba 'debs//rtsa phyag thal sbyar g.yas pas shel dkar gyi//'phreng bas ngan song 'gro rnams mtho ris 'dren//g.yon pas srid zhir chags pas gos min pa'i//puṇ+ḍa ri ka 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs//mi phyed zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung can//rin chen rgyan dang dar zab na bzas mdzes//mthong bas don dang ldan pa'i mtshan bzang gis//ngo mtshar dpal kun 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs//thos pa tsam gyis srid zhi'i gdung ba kun//ma lus zhi mdzad tshangs dbyangs chosakyi sgra//ri mo g.yas su 'khyil bar mgrin pa nas//skal bzang rna bar sgrog lagaso lo ba 'debs//nam mkha' lta bur zab gsal thugs kyi dbyings/bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyis//grangs med gdul bya'i re ba yongs skong ba'i//yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal por gsol ba 'debs//chos dbyings bde stong klong du ro gcig kyang /khrim dang sras su snang ba'i sgyu ma'i 'phrul//thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can/rje btsun gtso 'khor gsum la gsol ba 'debs//lus na lhar gsal ngag gi bzlasabarjod dang //gsol ba 'debs shing yid kyis ting nge 'dzin//'bad pas bsgoms pa'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus//tshe rabs kun tu dal ba'i rten thob shog dge 34tha'i shes kyis rjes bzung theg pa che'i//gdams pa'i chos kyi snying po nyams blangs pas/khrid mtsho sgrol ba'i gru gzings la brten nas//'gro rnams 'dren pa'i ded dpon byed par shog/rang don spangs nas gzhan don khur khyer bas//don gnyas lhun grub stobs brgya mnga' ba'i rtsal//rab rdzogs rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa yi//ye shesamachog gi rgo/ 'phang ma' gyur shog/ma gyur rgyud lnga'i skye rgu mtha' dag dang //khyad par gangs can bod kyi rgyal khams su//'thab rtsod mu ge nad yams rgud pa'i tshogs//rab zhi phan bde'i dpal la spyod par shog/thub bstan bshad dang sgrub pas legs 'dzin pa'i//bshes gnyen khrims ldan 'dus pa sder bcas kun//rnam gsum 'khor lo'i bya ba ༷ba 'phel zhing //mthun pa'i rkyen rnams ma lus

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas/ (thadatshang bar shog /nor 'dzin skyong ba'i rje blon 'bangs 'khor rje/ /tshe dang bsod nams mnga' thang 'byor pa kun/ /rab rgyas mi mthun phyogs las rnam rgyal zhing / /sdebazhi'i dga' ston dpal la spyod gyur cig /ma 'dris kun la mdza' ba'i bshes gyur kyang / /gangs can bod kyi lha skal 'jig rten dbang / /khyod kyi thugs rjes gnas skabs mthar thug tu/ /bde zhing skyid pa'i dpal la spyod par shog /ces gsol 'debs smon lam du bya'o/ /thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs phan bde'i gter mdzod ces bya ba 'di ni/ ra sa 'khrul snang gi bya 'dabs su dus bzang po la yi ge drug pa'i nyams len byed pa po rnams la phan pa'i ched du sgrub thabs gsol 'debs (39na 〉 spron lam dang bcas pa zhig dgos zhes byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos bskul ba'i ngor/slob dpon chen po lhan skyes rol pa'i rgya gzhung gi rjes su 'brangs te za hor gyi bzhes dga' ldan pho brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dpal lo/ /bskal par bsags pa'i brnag dka' nyes tshogs kun/ /byin rlabs mtho ris chu bos nyer 'khrud pa'i/ /ga bla'i yab gcig khyab bdag rdo rje sems/ /dza lan+ta rar rtag bzhugs dngos grub stsol//sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig po gsum mam bdun/ tshig tsam min par skyabs 'gro sems bskyed pa/ /nyams su blangs rjes dngos gzhi 'di ltar ro/ /rang gi spyi bor paṃ las pad+ma dkar/ /a las cha shas gang ba'i zla dkyil gdan/ /hūṃ dkar lasagrub bcom ldan rdo rje sems/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /gnag snum dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga thugs kar 'dzin/ /phyag g.yon dril bu dku la brtan nas bsnams/ /dbu rgyan snyan rgyan mgul rgyan gdu bu dang / /do shal dpung rgyan 'og pag se mo do/ /rin chen rgyan mdzes srab 'jam lha rdzas las/ /legs grub stod g.yogs pañtsa li ga'i gos//zhabs gnyis skyil krung gnas gsum yi shes mtshan/ /'od 'phros ye shes dbang lha nyer byon nas/ /gnyis med dbang bskur mi bskyod dbu brgyan gyur/ /thugs gar zla steng hūṃ yig dngul chu'i mdog /—381—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)mtha' skor yi ge brgya ba'i sngags kyis bskor/ /de las (39ba tha dud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhabs g.yas kyi//mthe bong nas babs rang gi spyi bor bzhugs/ /sdig sgrib nyes lhung dri tshogs nad gdon kun/ /rnam pa rnag khrag dud khu bshang gci sogs/ /mi gtsang rdzas kyi gzugs can rkang mthil dang / /'og gi dbang po'i sgo gnyis lam nas thon/ shwa 'od drag po'i sne yis spur ma bzhin/ /thogs med ded pas rang lusadangs shel ltar/ /phyi nang gsal sgrib med par gyur bsam zhing / /rtsegacig ting 'dzin ngang nas sngags 'di yi ge brgya pa bzla/ /bdag ni mi shes nyen mongs rmonges chen gyis/ /mi bzad dkar min las kyisarab mnar ba/ /mgon po bcom ldan rdo rje sems khyod kyis/ /byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab pas de don ltar/ rnam smin nag po'i gos kun rab dag par/ /gyur zhes zhal gyis bzhes nas 'od phung du/ /mngon par zhu ste rang dang gnyis med gyur/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpas rjes bzung ste/ /sgrib gnyis de rgyu bcasapa drungs phyung nas/ /tshe 'dir sku gsum go 'phang thob gyur cig khel rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyi nyams len khyer bde ba 'di ni er ti na dwa las hong tha'i jis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar pa 'jam dbyangs so/ /phyag na pad dkar 'chang bas mngon sum du/ /rjes bzung grub brnyes dpal ldan dpal mo'i zhabs/ /rnal 'byor dbang po'i phyag bzhes ji bzhin du/ /smyung bar gnas pa'i phyag len zur rgyan 'di/ /de'ang thugs rje chen po (40na skyon ras gzigs kyis mngon sum du rjes su bzung ba'i dge slong ma dpal mo nas nye bar brgyud pa'i smyung bar gnas pa'i rim pa 'di nyid rgya bod kun tu grags che zhing / khyad par bod yul 'dir mkhas grub mang pos thugs nyams su bstar ba'i phyag len gyi rgyun ma nyams pa gnyags dpon rin che bsod nams bzang po sogs mkhas pas mdzad pa'i khungs thub kyi yig cha mang na'ang / dus kyi dbang gis gong ma'i gsung rab rnams la thos bsam byed pa ches nyung zhing / smyung gnas ras par grags pa sogs mdo rgyud kyi gsung rab gang la'ang ma sbyangs —382

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas/ 6)pa'i blun bo snying khams can mang pos rnyed bkur tsam gyi ched du spel ba'i log chos ma dag pa'i rgyun la smyung gnas len pa'i tshe theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong len dgos pa'i de'i tshig la sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du zhes pa'i brjod bya dang / deng nas sgog gcod mi bya zhing zhes sogs kyi spang bya bsnyen gnas dang cha mthun yod pas de la 'khrul nas smyung gnas kyi nyi ma brkyang ba'i skabs bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa 'bogs zhing / bsnyen gnas kyi ming du 'dogs pa sogs ni shin tu mi rigs te/ sgra bshad kyi dbang du byas na/ bsnyen gnas 'di gang zag tha mal pa/ 'dod pa dang nyes par spyod pa gnyis ka las dben par spyod mi nus pa de dben pa gnyis la sbyar ba'i don du gsungs pa yin la/ 'dis dgra bcom pa dang nye bar gnas par byed pa'i phyir ram/ ji srid 'tsho ba'i sdom pa dang nye bar gnas par bya ba'i phyir bsnyen gnas zhes bshad la/ smyung gnas ni khug pa'i skabs zas su ma zad mchil ma tsam yang mi mid pas smyung ba ni stogs pa'i don yin pas phyogs mi (40ba)mtshungs par ma zad/bsnyen gnas ni so so thar pa rigs brgyad kyi nang tshan khyim pa'i phyogs kyi sdom pa gcig yin pasabyang chub tu sems bskyed pa la ma bltos pa'i nges 'byung gi bsam pa tsam la brten nas sdom pa thob cing / de'i nyin spang bya brgyad po spong ba las gzhan pa'i kha ton dge sbyor sogs rang blo dang 'tsham par byed pa las 'di byed kyi par bkab dang khyad par gsang sngags kyi cho ga bzlas brjod sogs byed pa'i bshad tshod med la/ smyung gnas kyi gso sbyong ni theg pa chen po'i lugs yin pas sems bskyed dgos shing / brkyang khug gnyis ka la spyan ras gzigs kyi cho ga bdag mdun gnyis ka tshar gsum re gtong dgos pa tshad thub yig cha rnams las bshad cing phyag len la yod pas so/ /theg pa che chung mdo sngags kyi dbye bas phyed pa'i tshul bdag la rnam pa gcig tu zhib mor dpyad de dgag bzhag gi gnas yin na'ang / smyung gnas ras pa 'gro ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal 'chad pa'i skabs su la phug sems ldan gyi khrod du byas te smra ba po yin 'dug pas legs nyes rtog dpyod bya ba'i yul las 'das pa'i phyir btang snyoms su bzhag ste/ dngos don gyi phyag len smyung bar gnas par 'dod —383

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)pa rnams rab bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang / 'bring lugs srol 'di ga'i rjes gnang rgyas pa/ tha ma'ang bcu gcig 'kha gyi rjes gnang gang rigs nos par byas nas rab sa ga zla ba/ de min zla ba gang yang rung ba'i yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nam gseng snga bar bcu gcig zhal gyi bris 'bur gyi sku dang mchod pa gya noms pa bshams pa'i drung du/ slob dpon rang nyid khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas (41na〉skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba spyi 'gro ltar byas te/ theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong gi cho ga tshar gsum brjod nas gso sbyong blangs/ /deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing zhes sogasatshar gcig dang tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i gzungs nyer gcig brjod/ de nas slob dpon stan mtho ba la 'khod/ slob ma rnams kyis slob dpon la phyag gsum btsal nas mdun du 'khod/ sngon 'gro'i phan yon dang brda sprod rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar nas slob dpon rang nyid kyis ji ltar blangs pa bzhin slob ma rnams rjes zlos byed du 'jug /nyin phyi ma'i zhogs slob ma rang gis rten gyi drung du len zhing / rjes su slob dpon la ma bltos par rang gis brkyang khug gnyis ka rten gyi drung du len no//bdag mdun gyi cho ga dang mid pa rgyun gcod sogs byed tshul gyi phyag len zhib cha mtha' dag gnyagasadabon rin po che dang thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho sogs mkhas pa rnams kyi gsung rab las shes par bya'o/ /smyung bar gnas pa'i phyag len la nye bar mkho ba'i zur rgyan 'di ni shes bya rig pa'i gnas spyi dang khyad par snga 'gyur bka' gter gyi tshul la mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i rigs 'dzin chen po nyang blo mchog rig pa'i rdo rje'i gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /phyag na pad dkar 'dzin pas rjes bzung ba'i/ khri spyib dbang dpal mo'i bzhed gzhud las 'ongs pa/ /smyung bar gnas pa'i cho ga'i gzhung dngos las/ /nyung ngu dang po'i las can don du spel/de'ang dkyil 'khor/ rten/ bum pa sogs mthong brgyud kyi (41ba)phyag len ltar mngon par 'du byas/nyams len dngos la sbyor dngos mjug gsum las/ dang po ni phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ pad+ma u da bha wa —384

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas/ (ba)ya swā hā/ zhes brjod khrus bya/ gso sbyong blang ba ni/ bla ma'i drung du len na des khyab cing / rten gyi drung du len tshe bla ma thugs rje chen po la rgyal ba sras bcas kyis bskor bar len pa'i mos pas phyag btsal/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ gso sbyong gi cho ga rang gi blo'am/ tha na'ang grogs shig gi lad mo byas te len dgos pas/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyasarta cang shes lta bu/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas shing byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i bka'/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i thugs/ lags par rnam par grol ba'i shes rab can de dag gis sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang / phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang /nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang / byang chub phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub nges par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir gso sbyong yang dag par mdzad pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du gso sbyong yang dag par blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum dang / deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing / gzhan gyi nor yang blang mi bya/ /'khrig pa'i chos kyang mi spyad cing / /rdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o/ /skyon (42na ji mang po nyer brten pa'i/ /chang ni yongs su spang bar bya/ khri stan che mtho mi bya zhing / /de bzhin dus ma yin pa'i zas/ /dri dang phreng ba rgyan dang ni/ /gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya/ /ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni srog gcod la sogs mi byed ltar/ /de bzhin srog gcod la sogasaspang / /bla med byang chub myur thob shog /sdug bsngal mang zhabrug 'jig rten 'di/ /srid pa'i mtsho lasasgrol bar shog /ces lan gcig brjod la/ oṃ a mo gha shrī la /bha ra bha ra bha ra/ mahā shud+dhi satwa/ pad+ma bi bhā ṣi ta bhu dza/ dha ra dha ra/ sa man+ta a wa lo ki te hūṃ phaṭa/ ces tshul khrims rnam dag gi sngags nyer gcig bzla'o/ /de nas mchod pa rnams/ oṃ sarba bid pā ra pā ra/ su ra gu ra/ a warta ya a warta ya ho/ /badz+ra skyo ra ṇa kho/ lan gsum gyis mchode pa rnams byin gyis brlab/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/—385

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /lan gsum brjod/ tshogs zhing ni/ rang thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i thugs ga'i 'od zer gyis tshogs zhing thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /bdag gis tshe rabs sngon nas da lta'i bar/ /bsags pa'i sdig pa mi dge'i tshogs rnams kun/ /'gyod sdom (42ba〉sems kyis snying nas bshags bgyid na/ /stobs bzhi'i mthu yis byang zhing dag gyur cig /ces brjod/ bdag bskyed ni/ oṃ su bhā wa shu d+dhaḥ sa spru dharmāḥsu bhā wā shurnya3lha/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hrīḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal rtsa zhal dkar/ g.yas ljang / g.yon dmar/ de'i steng ma dbus ljang / g.yas dmar/g.yon dkar/ de'i steng ma dbus dmar/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon ljang / de'i steng na khro zhal nag po/ /de'i steng na zhi zhal dmar po gtsug tor can/ phyag dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ gnyis pa gnyis phreng ba dang pad+ma/ gsum pa gnyis mchog sbyin dang spyi blugs/ bzhi pa gnyis 'khor lo dang mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ phyag lhag ma dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gnyis thams cad mchog sbyin mdzad pa'i mthil na spyan re yod pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ dar ras kyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ lasa'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/ dzaḥ/ baṃ 〉 slar yang thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ lus gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu 'khyil ba las rgyal ba rigs lngas dbu brgyan par gyur/ rang gi —386

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas/ (tha)thugs gar zla (43na〉ba'i steng du ye shes sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig /phyag gnyis pa/ de'i thugs gar zla gdan la ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hrīḥdakar po/ /de'i mtha' yi ge drug pas bskor bar bsams la bzlas pa bya'o/ /mdun bskyed ni/ oṃ su bhā wa shu snyiḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shurnyo3lha/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi thugs rka'i sa bon las mdun du zlo dkar po zhig 'phros/ de yongs su gyur pa las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i dbus su rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad zla'i gdan la/ hrī:dkar po yongs su gyur pa las thugs rje chen po zhes pa nas bzung ste rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i bar gong bzhin brjod/ shar du hūṃ las mi bskyod pa/ lhor tre las rin 'byung / nub tu oṃ las rnam snang / byang du āḥlas don grub rnams rang rang gi sku mdog dang phyag rgya can/ slar yang thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ zhes pa nas rgyal ba rigs lngas dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar las bdag la zhes pa 'di la zhes lab 'don pa bsgyur ba ma gtogs gong bzhin brjod/ char+sā ta thā ga ta lo /shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra a lha/ pā rdu/ pu be/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /ga rnye/ ni wi bye/ shabha pra titsā hūṃ swā hā/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dbu la brgyan//thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs/ /spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag mdun gnyis ga'i phyag mdzub las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bum pa ye shes kyi chus gang bar gyur bar bsams la yig drug ci nus bzla/ mjug chog la/ 'phags mchogo thugs rje'i phyag rkyang bdag sogs rnams/ /(43ba)phyi ma bde ba can gyi zhing skyes nas/ /tshe rabs kun tu dge ba'i bshes mdzod la/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba drag tu gdab/ /gtor ma oṃ āḥsnyi gis byin gyis brlabs/ ārla lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ba smra pra byu ye swāhā/ zhes gsum gyi 'phags pa la 'bul/ oṃ a kā ro mu kho sarba dharmā 'o ā du nu t+pa na tā ta/ oṃ āḥ& phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum gyis chosaskyong dang gzhi bdag la 'bul/ me long la lha'i gzugs brnyan shar bar bum pa'i chus/ 'gro ba'i sgron me spyan ras gzigs mgon la/ /dri zhim bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis khrus gsol bas/ /'gro ba'i sgrib —387

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)gnyis dri ma kun bsal nas/ /dri bral sku gsum brnyes pa'i bkra shis 3rteg /ces khrus gsol/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūṃ bdag gis nyes pa bgyis pa mtha' dag thugs rje chen po khyed la bzod par gsol gyi bdag la sgrib par mi 'gyur ba mdzad du gsol/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas 'phags pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas khrus gsol bas sgrib gnyis dag par bsams la/ bum chu 'thung / nyal ba'i dus rang lhar gsal ba'i dam tshig sems dpa' ye shes sems dpar thim/ de nyid de 'dzin sems dpar thim/ de yang mi dmigs par bsams te nyal lo/ /brkyang khug gi dmigs bsal dang lag len rnams yig cha gzhan dag dang mthong brgyud kyi lag len ltar bya/ tshes bcu drug gi skya rengs shar nas rjes chog la gso sbyong bzhag pa'i cho ga tshar gcig btang / de nas su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes pas ye shes pa mdun gyi rten la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ badz+ra muḥ tshom bu'i lha rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ nyin mo (44na)bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing / /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog /ces shis pa brjod par bya'o/ /snying nas mos kyang 'jig rten bya bas g.yeng / /mang tshig khur gyis 'jigs la bdud rtsi yi/ /rgya mtsho'i gzegs ma tsam gyi bcud 'dis kyang / /gtan bde'i 'chi med bsgrub pa e ma mtshar/ zhes stobs kyi dpung pas sa'i dkyil 'khor kun la dbang sgyur ba'i bstan 'dzin dwa yan rgyal pos smyung bar gnas pa la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge shin tu khyer bde ba 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /lhag bsam ston zla lta bur chos dkar bas/ /lus can phan bde'i sa mos ba 'ad byed pa/ /phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba'i thugs rje yis/ /lnga brgya'i lus can ma lus rjes 'dzin mdzod/ /de yang thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi skor la dpal mo lugs/ tshem bu lugs/ skyer skang lugs/khro lo lugs/ don zhags sogs zur bka'i smon grol rig gtad rjes gnang sogs dang / brgya rtsa —388

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas/ the)che 'bring chung gsum/ dpal snar thar pa'i mngon rtogs brgya rtsar grags pa sogs spyi bka'i rigs las byung ba dang / gzhan yang gsar ma rgyud 'bum du bzhugs pa'i thugs rje chen po'i rgyud dang / za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo sogs las kyang ril bu bsgrub tshul gyi kha gsal ma byung zhing / sngags gsar ma'i thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'am min kyang bdag mdun gyi (44ba〉ngon par rtogs pa bzlas brjod sogs la brten pa'i cho ga la gsang sngags rnying ma nas bshad pa'i skye bdun sgrub chen gyis rgyas 'gebs pa ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ gang phyir rgyal las ches mkhas 'ga' yang 'jig rten 'di na yod min te/ /ma lus de nyid mchog ni tshul bzhin kun mkhyen gyis mkhyen gzhan min pa/ /de phyir drang srong rang nyid kyis bzhag mdo sde gang yin de mi 'khrug /thub tshul bshig phyir de yang dam chos la ni gnod pa byed par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / sdom pa nyi shu par/ dam chos 'drar snang ston pa dang / zhes pa ltar ha cang blos byas kyi rang bzo dam pa'i chos la dbang za ba'i nyes pa chen por mthong bas snying kham gyi 'dri bar ma nus la/ 'on kyang deng sang stod smad kun tu ril sgrub dar so che bar 'dug pa bshad khungs dang chos rgyun gyi rnam dbye med par gzhan gyi lad mo lhur blangs pa'i lag len 'dra mthong tshor ni/ byin rlabs rten gyi phabs rgyun ci 'byor dang bag phye bsres pa'i ril bu bsgril bar mtshal gyi na bza' gsol/ gsher thag chod nas rin po che'i bum pa'i nang du blug /stegs sogs bkod pas mdzes par byas pa'i steng du bkang / ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa bsham/ rang nyid mosapa'i thugs rje chen po'i bdag bskyed sngon 'gro ba can gyi sgo nas mdun gyi bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ : las byung ba'i phyi bum pa la nang lha'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su ril bu rnams thugs rje chen po cho ga gsum bskyed kyis dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa dgug cing dbang bskur rgyas gdab mchod bstod rnams bdag bskyed ltar bya/ rang gi thugs ka nas sa pa'i 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril te song bas bum pa'i lha (45na sgoms kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de dag rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs nus mthu rnams bsdus te bum nang gi lha tshogs —389

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)la thim par mos pa sogs spro bsdu dang bcas nas yi ge drug pa'i bzlas brjod rgyun mi chad dang /ril sgrub zin mthar lha tshogs rnams 'od du zhu nas ril bu'i rnam par gyur par mos te rang gzhan gyis longs spyod kyi 'dug pa gzhan blo brid pa'i sgrub thabs ma yin pa'i sems bskyed kyis zin na/sdom pa nyi shu par sems dge ba la nyes pa med/ /ces pa ltar de tsam bgyis pa la rang bzo'i nyes sgrib kyis cher mi spags so snyam mo/ /gsang sngags phyi 'gyur gyi thugs rje chen po'i tshig la brten nas ril bu sgrub tshul rgyud rgya gzhung dang sngon byon gyi bla ma tshad thub rnams kyi yig cha ma mthong zhing /snga 'gyur phyogs kyi rgyas 'gebs kyang zhwa dpe lham 'gebs lta bu'i ha cang gu yangs par song dogs chos la brten pa'i rang bzo'i sdig pa la 'jigs nas ma nus mod/ 'on kyang gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba chos rje don grub rgya mtsho'i ngo ma chog par za hor gyi bzhes rang g.yin mang po'i lag len mthong tshor skyor zlos kyi tshul du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar 'jam dbyangs so/ /bde gshegs kun gyi mkhyen pa'i cha shas nya/ /yongs gang blo gros ga bur zer 'phreng gis/ /'gro kun mi shes mun sel 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /rnam dpyod kun+da bzhad pa'i gnyen du mdzod/ /mgon khyod rab dkar mdzes sku sgrub pa'i thabs/ /gser gdugs can dang nor bu gling pa zhes/ /'phags yul paṇa chen nyi zla zung gi lugs/ /tshad ldan (45ba〉pa khas pa'i tsho gos la rlung ltar grags//de phyir ma ti'i bzhed srol da smi ra'i/ /paṇa chen shākya shrī'i gsung rgyun bzhin/ /chad med brgyud ldan dam pa'i bzhed pa ltar/ /yi ger 'god la shes ldan rna ba ltogs/ /de'ang paṇ+ḍita chen po ma ti'i lugs kyi rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dkar po bsgrub thabs nyams su blang ba la/ skyabs su 'gro ba sngon du btang nas/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi gti mug gi mun pa bsal nas shes rab kyi snang ba la 'god/ de'i ched du 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs dkar po bsgrub par bya snyam du byang chub kyi sems bskyed/ rang skad gcig gis rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dkar por gsal ba'i snying dbus su 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar a dkar po las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros —390

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas/ 6)rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ na ma ārla mnyu shrī sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍal saḥs phyag bya/ārla mañdzu shrī sa pa ri wā ra a lha pra tismo ya swāhā/ nas/ sha rdi ā hūṃ gi bar gis chad/ gur las byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ su bha was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las bdud rtsi'i ma'i rgya mtsho dkar zhing dngas pa mtha' ne'u gsing gis kho ra khor yug tu bskor bar mnyen lcug 'khril ldem pad+ma 'tshal gyis khyab pa/ glang po che thal gar mche ba drug ldan dal gyis rgyu zhing pad+ma'i rtsa ba za ba/ mtsho'i steng na me tog sna tshogs pa bkram pa'i steng na chu bya skad snyan par sgrogs pas brgyan pa/ de'i dbus su paṃ ljang ser las pad+ma'i sdong po yal 'dab lo ma gser las byas (46na)pa/ 'dab ma brgyad pa ge sar dmar ser lte ba ljang ser du mtho ba'i steng na/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la yongs su gang ba/ de'i dbus su rang gi sems nyid a dkar po gsal zhing dwangs pa de las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa rnams mchode/ sems can thamasacad kyi gti mug gi sgrib pa sbyangs shes rab kyi snang ba la bkod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ nor bu chu shel dri ma med pa ltalnga dang ldan zhing thor tshugs kyi rtse mor rin po che'i tog dang / snyan gong na dri ngad phun sum tshogs pa'i ut+pal dar dpyangs g.yo ba dang bcas pa rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/mgul rgyan/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ ska rags/ do shal gyis mdzes par brgyan pa/dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs klubs pa/ 'khas rdo rje skyil mo spung gis bzhugasapa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gi mtshan pa/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo dkar po'i —391 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)lte ba'i a las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dza mi spyan drangs/ gong bzhin (46bsgo chod yon nyer spyod rol mos mar/ dzaḥ& baṃ lhos gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dza mi spyan drangs/ gong ltar mchod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sa bdag la mngon par dbang bskur bstsal du gsol/zhes gso me ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /zhes so gos kyi bum pa'i chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang / /dri ma thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa lasami bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsams la/ gong bzhin mchod/ ri bong 'dzin pa ltar dkar glegs bam ral gris phyag mtshan zhing / /rab mdzas shin tu zhi ba'i gzhen nu zur phud lnga pa can/ /dga' ba rgya chen thar mchog spyan ni pad+ma'i 'dab ltar yangs/ /blo grosang na pa bsreg mkhas 'jam pa'i dbyangs la rab tu 'dud/ ces bstod/ rang gi snying rtse mo gyen du bstan pa'i dbus su 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar a/ rtsibs la sngags 'phreng g.yas skor du 'khor bar mi dgas la oṃ wā kye rda na maḥ zhes dus grangasartags kyi bsnyen pa gzhung bzhin nyams su blangs/ thun mtshams su ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byung ba la gong bzhin mchod pa dang / maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun pa bshams la/ 'dzam bu'i gling dang gling gzhan rnams/ /nor bu rin chen gyis bkang ste/ /stong gsum la sogs ma lus pa/ /zhus pa med par byas te 'bul/ /zhes brjod la maṇ+ḍal dbul/ mtshan brjod 'dod na/ /gong bzhin bstod/ rang tha mal pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis bdag (47nasgo shes rab phun sum tshogs pa bskyed du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bkang / nongs pa bzod par gsol/ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ bsngo ba smon lam shis brjod bya'o/ /de ltar dal ba don dang ldan pa'i ne/ /dpal ldan stobs ge' go 'phang bsgrub 'dod na/ /chos kun rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab de/ /med thabs med phyir lhag pa'i lha 'di bsten/ /—392

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas/ 6)khungs dang brgyud pa bral ba'i rang bzo yis/ /'gal dum 'phreng bar spel ba ma yin par/ /rgya gar paṇa chen bod yul mkhas rnams kyi/ /phyag len zhabrul med nor bu'i 'phreng 'di long / /pad rtsa ltar dkar dge ba'i skya rengs kyis/ /'gro kun mi shes gnyid las rab bslang ste/ /blo gros nyi ma'i dngosabargya 'bar ba'i lus/ /'jig rten gsum gyi sgron mar bdag 'gyur shog /ces ma ti lugs kyi 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i sgrub thabs shes rab gsal byed ces pa 'di ni gong gi rgyal khab nas chos bsgyur ba'i lo tsā slob pa sogs mang du thos pa'i ched 'ongs pa spor kho paṇ+ḍi sa bskul pa la brten nas/dpal ldan bla ma khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo po dpal 'byor 'phrin las rab rgyas sogs yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i bka' drin la brten nas tshul 'di la blo gros kyi snang ba yangs pa za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa blo bzang dngos grub bo/ /khrag 'thung dbang chen yang gsang khros pa dang / /dbyer med drin can bla ma zur chen rje/ /chos dbyings rang grol snying gi ze'u 'bru'i dbus/ /byang chub bar du bzhugs la bdag byin rlobs/ /(47ba〉'dir gter ston sum tshogs kyi gter chos grub pa'i dbang phyug 'dar phya ru ba'i phyag tu babs shing slob dpon chen po la'ang dngos su gsan pa'i dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i sgrubs thabs rgyas pa khrag 'thung lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ 'bring po yab yum rkyang sgrub/ bsdus pa dpa' bo gcig pa gsum las/ 'bring po'i dbang du byas pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa nyams su len par 'dod pas/ thog mar sngags gsar ma'i rgyas 'gebs lhur len ma yin pa'i lugs 'di ga'i thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag len 'phyugs med kyi dbang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa nos shing dam tshig dang sdom pa la gces spras su byed pa'i sgrub pa pos nyams su bstar bya'i ngag 'don mdor bsdus la/ skyabs sems ni/ pad+ma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi pad+ma dbang chen sgom bzlas niḥ bdag gis semasacan don du bgyiḥ zhes tshar gsum brjod/ tshad med ni/ sems can thams cad bde dang ldan sems—393

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shecan sdug bsngal med gyur cig sems can bde la rtag par gnas: 'gro rnams sangs rgyas thob gyur cig mchod rdzas rnams brlab pa ni/ rang nyid thun mtshams kyi lhar gsal bas/ ā+oṃ raṃ badz+ra kro ta rak+ṣa dzol re/ tik+ta bi shwa dz+wa la phaṭa ri raṃ/ ri a/ ā+oṃ a ha ra a ha ra hūṃ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra/ pa hūṃ/ thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ ā lo ke /garnye/ ni wi bye/ shabha/ ā+oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ/ ā+oṃ ma hā ba li ta pā dza te dz+wa ra hūṃ/ ā+oṃ ma hā pad+ma rak+ta hūṃ/ dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor ni/ ā+oṃ swa bhā wa bi shuzloḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa bi shurnyo3nya/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa/48nasgo/ ma su rla maṇ+ḍal/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal/ ru tra ba/ pad+ma nyi zla bdud nag phyi chings su/ /bsnol steng rang sems gyi dmar rma sngon po/ su ra ṇa phaṭaḥ 'od sa 'phags mchode semasacan don kun byas/ bde gshegs sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rnams/ saṃ ha ra na hūṃ/ tshur 'dusayig 'brur thim pas pad+ma dmar/ /nga khrag gis gang ba'i rnam par gyur/ /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ yiḥmahā kro ta ha ya gi wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ pad+ma yongs gyur bdag nyid dbang chen sku/ /dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa/ /g.yas dkar g.yon ljang dbus dmar re re la/ /spyan gsum zhal bgrad mche gtsags ljags 'dril pa/ /khro gnyer rab bsdus kham nag dbu skra'i tshogs/ /gyen 'khyil rtsa zhal spyi bor rta mgo ljang / /rngog ma dmar po phrum phrum ser po dang / /zhur dkar rta skad drag po lhang lhang 'tsher/ /smin ma sma ra ag tshom me ltar 'bar/ /g.yas gsum pad dmar lcags kyu be con 'dzin/ /g.yon gsum bhan dmar rgyu zhags ral gri 'phyar/ /thod skam dbu rgyan tshal bus dpung par brgyan/ /skam rlon rnying pa'i do shal gsum rim can/ /sku stod zhing lpags glang chen ko rlon gsol/ /stag sham sprul rigs bzhi dang rin chen rgyan/ /byugs pa'i rdzas gsum sku yi rgyan du bkod/ khams gsum rnam rgyal rdo rje'i khyung gshog gdengs/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bzhugs/ /ā+oṃ ma hā kro ta shwa ri hūṃ phaṭa: ban+ta khrag bkang yongs su gyur pa las/ /yum chen pad+ma gar dbang sku mdog mthing / /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pas mi yi snying / /rlon pa (48ba)bzung bas yab kyi mgul nasahrūd/ /g.yon pas dud chen dmar 'khyil zhal du stob/ /khrag mig spyan gsum zhal bgrad mche —394

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas/ 6)ba gtsigs/ /ral pa mun gtibs sku rked yan chad khyab/ /thod skam dbu rgyan do shal rin chen rgyan//dur khrod chas spras g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pas/ /yab kyi rked 'khril yab yum gnyis ka yang / /nyi ma stong las lhag pa'i gzi 'od 'phro/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs/ /spyan 'dren gnas gsum byin rlabs dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra sam ye dza: zho sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pad+me shwa ri sa pa ri wā ra a lha pra titsā ye swāhā/ nas/ sha rdi pra titsā ye swāhā'i bar/ mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta 'a hi/ dzaḥ& baṃ — rlu āḥ// hūṃ badz+ra he ru ka a bhi khiñtsa hūṃ/ ā+oṃ burnya he ru ka a bhi ṇiñtsa ā+oṃ/ swā rat+na he ru ka a bhi khiñtsa hūṃ/ paṃ pad+ma he ru ka a bhi khiñtsa hrīḥ hā ga me he ru ka a bhi ṇiñtsa āḥmachod pa ni/ gong gi sngags gsham du ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta 'a hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā ba lin+ta khā hi/bstod pa ni/ khyuḥ dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas/ /pad+ma nyi zla bdud bsnol gdan steng du/ /rnam shes gnas gyur pad+ma he ru ka /zhe sdang rnam dag chos dbyings ye shesang nga / khyud drug nyon mongs zhe sdang 'joms mdzad pa/ /khro rgyal rta mgrin dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /med byung rol pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /dga' bzhi bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor na/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ /bde stong zung 'jug shes rab thabs dang rol/ /dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med khro mo'i sku/ /rgyud drug (49na)las dang nyon mongs 'joms mdzad ma/ khro mo gar dbang yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /rmad byung rol pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /bzlas pa ni/ sgyi bdag nyid khro rgyal rta mchog dpal/ /thugs kar pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi/ /ge sar la ni snying po gyi 'dab ma brgyad la sngags kyis bskor/ /'od 'phros bde gshegs rnams la thim/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bsdu/ /sems can sgo gsum sgrib pa sbyangs/ /rnal 'byor lusang ga yid la thim/ /hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha yaṃ sgyi wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭaḥ rlu ma hā kro ti shwa ri hūṃ phaṭaḥ'adzab bstod ni/ gyi pad+ma rigs kyi khro rgyal mchog /dpal chen pad+ma he ru ka /mi bzad khro rgyal rta —395—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)mchog dpal/ /dbang drag stobs chen rngam brjid gtum/ /sku mdog dmar nag 'gying zhing brjid//dbu gsum rnam thar gsum yang ston/ /phyag drug rgyud drug rtsad nas gcod/ /zhabs bzhi 'khor ba'i chos bzhi sgrol/ /dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs/ /rta mgo ljang khu rta skad la'i/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs/ /rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug stong sgrog /dregs pa pho mo dbang du sdud/ /dbang chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces dang / 'dzab kyi dngos grub blang ba ni/ smiḥ khro rgyal dbang chen rta mchog dpal/ /dpal gyi sku gsung thugs mchog las/ /mchog gi dngos grub ye shes dbyig /dus 'dir rnal 'byor bdag la stsol/ /ā+oṃ pa/ ta kṛ ta pad+me shwa ri ma hā kro ta ha ye snri wa ma ma tra ga mo du hri hri hūṃ dzaḥ zhes pa nyer gcig tsam dang / ā+oṃ pad+ma kro ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sirnyi a la la ho/ (49ba tshe pos brjod/thun mthar lhag chad kha bkang / yig brgyas byin rlabs brtan par byas/ mchod bstod bya/ ha ya sgyi wa hriḥgab/ ba mo dha ya hriḥgab/ pad+ma ban dha hriḥgab/ tsan+d+ra rak+ṣa hriḥgab/ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ gnas lngar phyag rgya dang bcas te lus bsrung / snod bcud rnams yab yum la thim/ de yum yab la yab sa: de gu gu'i bar rim gyis thim mthar 'ja' yal ba ltar rig stong gi ngang du mnyam par bzhag nas/ ā+oṃ ma hā shā n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra su bhā āt+pa ko lha brjod slar yang lhar gsal ba'i ngang nas sngags bzla zhing / dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can rnams/ /pad+ma rgyal po'i go 'phang mchog thob nas/ /ma rig ldongs ba'i skye tshogs thams cad la/ /rol ba'i rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog par shog /cesasogs bsngo ba smon lam bya'o/ /de'ang bskyed rdzogs 'dzab tshar gcod rtags sogs kyi zab mo'i gnad 'gag rnams ni brgyud ldan dam pa'i zhal lung las blang bar bya zhing / yang gsang khros pa'i bka' srung ging lnga gza' gdong gnod sbyin chen po rnams yin pas byung rgyal du nyams su blangs na rang gzhan thams cad 'phung ba'i rgyur 'gro bas na bag yod par bya'o/ /sgrub sde brgyad las pad+ma gsung gi skor/ /o rgyan bla ma'i zhal lung bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /skad gnyis smra ba lo chen be+e ro dang / /grub pa'i dbang phyug 'dar phyar gdams pa'i bcud/ /bka' gter zung la jug ma dros mtsho chen —396

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas/ thenalas/ /snyan brgyud man ngag gaṅgā hub gcig gis/ /'thung mkhas rgyal ba kun dngos tshar pa rje/ /yab sras las brgyud rim bzhin kho bos thos/ /dang por mtshan nyid kun ldan bla ma'i drung / /smin grol gdams pa'i sgro 'dogs(50na/spegs bcad nas/ /yi ger bkod las rgyun med rang bzo yi/ /ham can brtsams chos rnams dang 'di mi 'dra/ /mkha' la rdo rje srung ba'i gur ma zhig /sal dkyila'akhor bris pa'i bkrag ma yal/ /bar du mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thul le ba/ byin rlabs na bun zil dngar ci yang g.yo/ /rang la cha rgyus yod pa'i gdengs ldan pas/ /yang gsang khros pa yab yum rgyan sgrub kyi/ /las byang bdud las rgyal ba'i ba 'ad sgra can/ /bkod pas 'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog /ces pa 'di'ang ser byes slob dpon 'phrin las lhun grub kyi skye ba ngag dbang bsod nams lhun grub kyis bskul ba'i ngor gnyags dzñā na kurma ra'i sprul pa'i zlos gar zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi bka' drin la brten nas chos tshul 'di la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa dge ba za hor gyi brnyes brgyud ldan gong ma'i yi ge dang man ngag la gzhi byas mngon rtogs tshig lhug tshigs bcad du bsdebs shing gzhan ma skyabs sems bstod 'dzab dngos grub blang ba sogs yig rnying rang sor bzhag ste me rta chu stod kyis nya ba'i yar tshes dge bar dpal ldan 'bras spungs su sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /gtan gyi skyabs mchog mchog gsum rin chen la/ /byang chub de srid srid mtsho las bsgral phyir/ /som nyi rab spangs spangs rtogs yon tan rnams/ /thob phyir skyabs 'gro 'gro rnams sgrol bar mdzod/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyis mnar ba'i lus can kun/ /kun mkhyen ye shes rnyed ched byang chub sems/ /sems mchog rin chen bskyed de rgyal sras spyod/ /spyod tshul rlabs chen phyin drug lam du 'jug /rang nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug gsal ba (50ba〉pa/ /thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer rab 'phrosapas/ /rang bzhin gnas nas phyag na pad dkar 'chang / /bla ma 'od dpag med kyi dbu brgyan pa/ /rgyalab sras bcas tshogis kyis yongs bskor ba/ /thogs pa med par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/ /oṃ badz+ra puspro ā hūm̐ nas sha —397

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)bha āḥ& bar gyis mchod/ khyun bshags dang tshad med bzhi spyi ltar bsgom/ /yoshā n+ya lhas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las po las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang steng / /yaṃ las bdag nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug ni/ /sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhal dkar rdul mang brtsegs pa'i lhun po la/ /nyi ma 'bum gyis 'khyud pa'i gzi byin can/ /zhi 'dzum dgyes pa'i spyan rasa'agro la gzigs/ /dbu skra mthon mthing ral pa'i thor tshugs mdzes/ /lhag ma'i zar bu dpung pa'i steng du 'phyang / /phyag g.yas 'gro ba'i dbugs 'byin mchog sbyin dang / /g.yon pa pad+ma'i yu ba nasabazung ba'i/ /'dab ma snyan gyi thad gar rnam par rgyas/ /lha rdzas dar gyi stod g.yogs sham thabasaklubs/ /zhabs gnyis mi phyed skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /de yi gnas gsum yi ge 'bru gsum gyis/ /mtshan pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /rang bzhin gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang badz+ra sa mādzaḥ/ dzaḥ/ baṃ ho dam tshig pa yi lhar/ /ye shes sems dpa' gnyis su med par bstim/ /slar yang 'od sa rigs lnga 'khor bcas rnams/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/ /bdag la dbang bskur stsal du gsol zhes pa'i/ /tshig dang mos pas thugs rgyud skul ba'i mthus/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma la shrī hūṃ/ (51na)/dbang skur sku gang dri ma ma lus dag /chu lhag yar lud snang mthas dbu brgyan gyur/ /gong bzhin nyer spyod kyis mchode la/ /ston gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ /rang gi thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng / /la yig tha mar yig 'bru drug gis bskor/ /de las 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ /'gro ba rigs drug sdug bsngal ma lus sbyangs/ /tshur 'dus bdag la thim pas sdig sgrib dag /'phags pa'i byin rlabs ma lus thob par gyur/ /yi ge drug pa ci nus su bzla/ ye shes sems dpa' bdag las phyir phyung ste/ /mdun gyi nam mkha' mngon sum bzhugs par gyur/ sngar bzhin mchod/ /bla ma mchog dang 'phags pa'i lha tshogs la/ /mi phyed gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs/ /sku gsung thugs kyis bdag rgyud byin brlabs nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /thub bstan rgyas shing de —398

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas/ 6)'dzin tshogs rnams brtan/ /mkha' mnyam ma rgan 'gro rnams bde la spyad/ /bdag sogs rnams kyi tshe dpal 'byor pa kun/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di snang 'gags tshe bde ba can zhing du/ /mgon po khyod kyis thogs med rab drangs te/ /rgyal ba'i sras gyur theg chen chos la spyad/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub myur du thob par mdzod/ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad sogs dang / /badz+ra muXs ye shes pa gshegs par bsam mo/ /dge ba'i chu rgyun rgyun chad med babs pa/ /byang chub mtsho chen chen por ro gcig cing / /dus kun phun tshogs tshogs pa'i bkra shis kyis/ /bdag gzhan 'gro kun kun la khyab par shog /ces sgrub brgya nas gsungs pa'i thugs rje chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug la brten (51ba)pa'i nyams len 'di ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtses bskul zhing slar yang pu shud pa blo bzang dar rgyas kyis kyang bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs so/ /sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lta bu'i skyabs sems sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ rang gi spyi gtsug tu paṃ las chu skyes 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ge sar gyi steng du/ e las chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i steng du hūṃ dkar po las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog ston mtshan gyi zla ba ltar dkar zhang dri ma med pa'i shel ltar 'tsher ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhi zhing 'jam la chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ mthon mthing dbu skra gtsug gtor gyi rtser bcings shing lhag ma'i lan bu ring du 'phyang ba/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i phyag gnyis rang snang gi shes rab ma rdo rje snyems ma dkar mor 'byud pa yab rdo rje'i skyil krung dang yum pad+ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ gnyis ga'ang lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis mdzes par spras pa/ gnas gsum du oṃ āḥ/ dkar dmar mthing gsum gyis mtshan pa'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dza ཿ PROB baṃ sngosabastim mo/ yang 'od 'phros dbang lha rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa kū la sa pa ri wā —399

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)ra sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas mngon par dbang bskur bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod (52na)pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ bcom ldan 'das rdo je sems dpas bdag g.yin sems can rnams kyi sdig sgrib nyes lhung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thugs rka'i zla gdan gyi steng du hūṃ la sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas thon/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs te/ nyams chags sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad shwa 'od kyi sne la sbur ba mi chags pa bzhin phyir thon par bsams pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas te yi ge brgya pa ci nus su bzla/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ zhes sogs dang / bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yis/ /tshad med thugs rje chen po'i mthus/ /bdag gis bsagasapa'i sdig lhung kun/ /byang zhing dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /mkha' mnyam ma gyur 'gro rnams la/ /chags sdang gti mug dbang gyur te/ /log par spyad pa'i nyes kun dri/ /bzlas brjod chu bos zhagi da par shog /nyams chags mig sman ltar gnag mun/ /bcom ldan thugs rje'i zla zer gyis/ /skad cig nyid la sangs byas nas/ /phan bde'i snang ba dkar bar shog /nyes lhung sa mkhregs tha rgod dang / /rang rgyud zhing sa lhan cig tu/ /mi gnas ches dkar gshin po la/ /gtan bde'i myu gu skye bar shog /rigs kun bdag po rdo rje sems/ khyod zhal mngon sum legs mthong nas/ /yid can 'dren pa'i ded dpon du/ /'gyur bar byin gyis rlab tu gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar gsol ba bzhin zhal gyis 'ches te/ yab yum gnyis ka 'od du zhu nas thim pas rang sems dang ngo bo dbyer med du gyur par bsams te/ bsngo ba smon lam ci rigs (52ba)pa'ang bya'o/ /zhes rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas tshig lhug mjug tu smon lam 〈 ka gsar pa lnga yod pa zhig dgos zhes/ gdong kha ba blo bzang bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal gyis bskul ba ltar za tor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim —400

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas/ 6)ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o/ /rin chen ye shes bsod nams mchog grub pa'i/ /khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po zha lu pa/ /blo mchog rig pa'i rdo rje nyang ston rje/ /byang chub bar du rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs/ khyod mtshan thos pa'i mod la dbul phongs kyi/ /gdung sel 'dod 'jo bsil ba'i reg bya mkhan/ /rab dkar rmugs 'dzin 'brug gi bzhen pa can/ /dgyes zhal 'dzum gyis 'gro 'di rtag tu bsus/ /snang ba mtha' yas mar me mdzad dpal gyi/ /bzhed srol dam pa'i phyag len 'khrul med bzhin/ /rgyun 'khyer sgrub thabs rim pa nyams bstar ba/ /go sla'i ngag gi nyung ngu rnam gsal 'dri/ /de la 'dir lha gcig mnyam med jo bo chen po'i zab chos 'phags pa nga la dkar po 'brug zhen ma bsnyen par bya ba'i sgrub thabs dang zhar byung chu sbyin dang nang gtor ma la brten nas sgrub par byed pa la gzhan ma'i rgyas bkab kyi rang bzo ma yin par rtsa ba'i yig rnying dang she'u lo tsā ba'i yig cha sogs la brten nas rjes su gnang ba legs par nos/ /gnas khang yid du 'ong bar skyed khul bya/ /thugs rje chen po dang 'di'i bris sku sogs yod na dgram/ /stegs gtsang ma'i khar dkar gtor dang / bum pa zangs gzheng / sku rab gnas can sogs sta gon bya/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa bsham/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa spyi ltar bya/ tshogs zhing ni/ rang skad cig gis char lar gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ (53na)rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa ༷ la la bla ma 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru khyoḥ na ma pid+ma kro dha ār+ya bye la sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍa le saḥs phyag bya/ gong gi sngags gsham du a lha sogs btags nas mchod/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/dngos gzhi ni/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid yi ge rjo dkar po/ de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can rnams kyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa —4()/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)ra la sku mdog gangs ri'i mdog ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag nyis pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum la chagasapa'i nyams can yid tsam khros pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes shing / sma ra dang smin ma kham ser du 'khril ba/ phyag g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dang / g.yon pa rin po che'i be can bsnams pa/rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ se mo do/ 'og pag /phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub rnams kyis spras shing / dar gyi yug gon stod g.yogs kyi tshul du 'phyang ba/ pañtsa lika'i sham thabs can/ g.yu 'brug gi steng na zhabs gnyis phyed skyil gyi tshul du bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i dbus su zla gdan la rjo dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba/ de las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas nga la dkar por sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshos sa kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥlha baṃ sngos gnyis su med par (53ba)bstim/ slar yang 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ ā+oṃ pañtsa klu la sa pa ri wā ra a: nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṇiñtsa hu mo/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra bhā wa a bhi khiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nasadabang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ 'od dpag med kyi dbu brgyan par bsam/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ shel dkar tso ma'i phung po dbang bzhi yis/ /rab dkris gar dgu'i nyams ldan gnod sbyin dbang / /'dod dgu'i dngos grub char lngar 'bebs mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan ra la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying gar zla gdan la ṭ+wāṃ yig dkar po'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ khyad par khams gsum gyi dpal 'byor longasaspyod thams cad bsdus te ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub thob par bsams la/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya rdza bha la hri da ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa mi tshig gis bar ma chad par thun du bcad de/ rab 'bring mtha' gsum gyi rtags ma byung gi bar du bzla/ thun mtshams su mchod bstod bya/ ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar —402

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas/ thenaphyung ba la mchod bstod dang / yig brgya brjod cing nongs pa bzod par gsol/ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs/ rang nyid dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal la gnas pas bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas 'debs/ phyi chu sbyin la brten nas bsgrub na/ mdun du zangs gzhed gtsang ma'i nang du brlan gyis mi gnod pa'i sku rab gnas can bzhag /rang nyid thugs rje chen po kha sar pa ṇir lam gyis gsal btab/ mdun gyi (54na lhan bsangs sbyangs sgrub thabs bzhin bskyed pa'i shar gyi 'dab ma la hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje ḍā gi ma nam mkha'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/g.yas gser gyi rdo rje dang g.yon pas rten 'brel gyi nor rdzas bsnams pa/ bha ra hūṃ las rin po che hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ rin chen ḍā ki ma ser mo g.yas nor bu rin po che dang g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa/nub tu paṃ las pad+ma paṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ pad+ma ḍā ki ma dmar mo g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon lcags kyu bsnams pa/ byang du kho las ral gri kho gis mtshan pa las/ las kyi ḍā gi ma ljang gu g.yas rdo rje rgya gram dang / g.yon ne'u le nor bu skyug pa bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' gsol ba/ zhababs g.yas bskum pa'i dar stab ba(kyis ( bzhug bas pa/ gtso tshogar rnam bas kyi dpral bar oṃ/ zhes pa nas chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las zhes pa'i bar gong ltar la/ gtso bo la 'od dpag med dang 'khor rnams la rang gi rigs kyi bdag las dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas sngags brgya rtsa bzla zhing / sku gzugs la chu sbyin dbul ba'i chu mu tig gi phreng bar gyur nas gtso 'khor rnams kyi sku lus gang bas zug rngu zhi zhing bde ba dang ldan/ zhal nas mu tig gi char babs pas dngos grub thob par bsams la mchod bstod bya/ rten yod na ye shes pa la brtan bzhugs 'bul/ chu mtheb srin gyis rang gi lce thog tu bzhag nas dngos grub zhu bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal zhi nas/ dpal 'byor longs spyod zad mi shes pa 'byung ba dang phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ chu cung zad re phyogs bzhir gtor zhing yig brgya bzla/ (54ba〉〉ga ma gzhan du ma 'khyar bar longs spyad —403

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)do/ /nang gtor ma la brten nas bsgrub na/ rang thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ra la gtso 'khor lnga la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza sa spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma la ye skye gyis gdan dbul gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zlo las rin po che'i snod yangs par gtor ma 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bsams la/ oṃ āḥ/ gis byin gyis brlab/ sngags gsham du rda ba phywa de kha kha ji hi ji hi/ zhes pa lnga'am bdun gyis dbul/ mchod bstod bya/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ ces sogs kyi mthar badz+ra mu:sa ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la bsdu/ mthar bsngo ba smon lam ci rigs pa bya'o/ /'di na dam pa'i zhal lung dri ma med/ /dpyad gsum dag pas yi ger legs bkod tshe/ /rgyun med rang bzo mun pa'i mda' 'phen rnams/ /bag yang bsten la tshul chos ra bar nyol/ /dge bas 'di snang phongs pa'i duḥkha dang / /lhan cig sa lam yon tan gyis dbul ba'i/ /nyam thag 'gro kun de rgyu dang bral nas/ /sku gsum nor bu'i bang mdzod thob par shog /ces dpal mnyam med jo bo chen po di baṃ ka ra'i bzhed srol rdza la dkar po 'brug zhen ma'i nyams len 'khyer bde ba zhig dgos zhes gsol dpon gar ba blo bzang mkhyen brtses bskul ba'i ngor mkhan chen zha lu pa rin chen bsod nams mchog grub dang / nyang ston khra tshang ba blo gros mchog gi rdo rje zhes khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa'i dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi bka' drin la brten nas chos tshul 'di la blo gros kyi snang ba dkar ba'i za hor gyi brnyes (55na spur ba'i yi ge pa ni rig byed 'dzin pa tre bo ngag dbang nam mkha'o/ /na mo gu ru badz+ra ga ṇa ye/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can bsgom par 'dod pas skyabs sems sngon du btang / sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lta bu/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan steng du/ rang nyid gsang bdag sngon po g.yas rdo gcu gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa rje/ /g.yon pa sa sna sdigs mdzub dar stodag yogs/sham thabs/ sngon stag lpags gsol/ /klu brgyad sprul gyi rnam pa kyis brgyan g.yon brkyang mi dpung dbus/—404

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas/ (thadalegs bzhugs mi bskyod sprul skus dbu la brgyan/sku las me 'bar gnas gsum spyi bo ma a po mig yi ges74mtshan//hūṃ las 'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa/thogs pa med par badz+ra sa mādzaḥ/dzaḥ& baṃ hormes gnyis su med par gyur//pha tshe sngags kyi 4sa lha nas shabha'i bar gyis mchode/bstod pa lcang lo༅gyi gnas ma kho dam pa nas lta bur bstod bya/snying gar zla steng gser rdor rtse lnga yi//lte bar hūṃ mthar sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs//oṃ nā la wa ra dha bzlas pa ci tsog bya ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/smon lam shis brjod ci dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag ces sogs skabs dang sbyar rigs bya'o//phyag rdor gos sngon can gyi mngon rtogasashin tu bsdus pa 'di ni sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyi zhal 'dzin du za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa'o//chos drug mi g.yo'i gdams pa zab mo'i gnad//rjes gnang zab 'khrid ston pa'i rdo rje 'chang //rin chen gsum dngos bsod nams mchog gi zhing //mkhas grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhal lung 'dri//de'ang rje btsun mi g.yo ba 'di la gtum mo dkar po/bka' gdams lha bzhi'i nang tshan gyi sngon po//chu 55bsrung sogs mang du bzhugs pa las 'dir bka' gdams lha bzhi'i nang tshan gyi mngon par rtogs pa nyams su blang ba la/skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas/rang nyid mi g.yo ba sngon por gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer los pas/bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo mgon po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogasakyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/thal mo sbyar la/ye shes ral gris mi shes ma lus gcod//sdigs mdzub zhags pas bdud kun 'dar zhing 'ching //bgegs la mche gtsigs rngam pa khre bo'i rgyal//rje btsun mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo//zhes pas phyag bya/rang gi snying ga nasamachod pa'i lha mo spros nas mchode par bsams la/chasarba ta thā ga ta a lha pra titsā ye swā hā nas/shabha āḥ& gi bar brjod/rgyun bshags lan gsum bya zhing tshogs zhing rang la bstim/tshad med bzhi bsgom/su bhā was stong par sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rang sems kyi ngo bo yi ge hūṃ mthing kha/de las 'od 'phros 'phags ༷ 0 5 sems can gyi don byas/tshur 'dus yongs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba sku mdog zar ma'i me tog ltar sngo ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mi g.yo mnyam pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pas mas mchu mnan zhing khro gnyer bsdus pa/ sma ra dang smin ma me ltar 'bar zhing dbu skra kham ser gyen du brjes pa phyag g.yas ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pa rdo rje'i zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs gar mdzad pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sbrul dkar po'i mchod phyir thogs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs (56na)kyis spras pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang bas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dza ཿ PROB baṃ sngos gnyis su med par bstim/ yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs pa la oṃ pañtsa kū la sa pa ri wā ra a lha sogs kyis mchod/bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo bzhi'i phyag gi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis dbang bskur bas sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag /ye shes kyi bdud rtsis lus thams cad gang / chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ thugs ka nas 'od spros mchod lhas mchod bstod byas par mos nas ār+ya a tsa le sa pa ri wā ra a: sogs kyis mchod/ kye kye mtha' gnyis rnam par mi g.yo zhing / mtha' bral bde chen khro bo rgyal po'i sku/ /sprul pa'i gzugs kyis 'gro don dpag med mdzad/ /'jigs byed chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol zhing / /srid pa gsum na dgyes pa'i gar mdzad pa/ /srid pa'i chu bo skems shing mi mthun bdud rnams 'joms/srid pa'i rlung gis mi g.yo thugs rje'i mgon/ /rab brjid mi g.yo mgo la phyag 'tshal lo/ zhes pas bstod/ thugs dar nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer —406

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas/ 6)'phros pas sems can gyi mi shes pa'i mun pa tshar bcad par bsams la/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ ci nus (56ba7zla/ rje btsun mi g.yo mgon pos bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi bdud bzhi' bar gcod thams cad zhi nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab cing mjug tu dge ba bsngo/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na dkar cha bzhi las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin dbul lo/ /srid zhi'i 'jigs las bskyab pa'i slu med mgon/ /bcom ldan gtum po mi g.yo bsgrub pa'i thabs/ /mnyam med dhī paṃ ka ra'i bzhed pa'i srol/ /brgyud ldan phyag len ma nyams 'di na bkod/ /mkhas grub so so'i lugs srol mi shes par/ /gcig dpe kun la 'gebs pa'i blos byas mkhan/ /cher rlom stong pa'i 'ur skad can rnams kyi/ /don mang za zi'i skyon zlos ga la yin/ /dge des bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pas mi tshugs shing / /rab 'byams shes bya'i gnasal blo rgyas pas/ /mi g.yo chos drug zab lam nyams blangs nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces rje btsun mi g.yo mgon po'i sgrub thabs 'di ni gdong kha chos mdzad blo bzang bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal gyis bskul ba la brten nas dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag rin chen bsod nams mchog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bka' drin las chos tshul 'di la blo mig yangs pa'i za hor gyi bzhes khrid yig dang paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi yi ge la brten nas bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni rig byed pa ngag dbang nam mkha'o/ /'chi med tshe dbang rigs 'dzin thod phreng rtsal/ /gang des rjes bzung grub dbang thang stong pa'i/ /zab gter dag snang chu bo nyis 'dres kyi/ /tshe sgrub rgyun khyer nyams len 'di ltar ro/ /de la 'dir tshe dpag med 'chi med dpal ster gyi sgo nas bdag don du tshe bsgrub pa'i rim pa la/ skyabs 'gro (57na〉sems bskyed ni/ bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam sems can kun/ /deng nas byang chub snying po ma thob par/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ma lus pa/ /kun 'dus rtsa ba gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /'chi bdag bdud kyai g.yul ngo pham bya'i phyir/ /'gyur med tshe yi rigs 'dzin rab —407

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)bsgrubs nas/ /lus can mtha' dag kun bzang gdod ma'i sar/ /'god phyir byang chub sems mchog bskyed par bgyi/ /tshogs zhing ni/ rang nyid tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros/bde ba can nas bla ma dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med la brgyud pa'i bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru ā la na pā ra mi ta sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍa le 6 ཿ zhes phyag bya/ gu ru ā yu dzñā na pā ra mi ta sa pa ri wā ra a: sogs chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ gur nas byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum dang tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ dngos gzhi ni su bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rma byas bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang gi sems kyi ngo bo hrī:dmar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po ltar dmar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi steng na 'chi med kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ dbu skra gnag snum ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan rnams kyis spras pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ snang la rang bzhin med pa 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i (57ba)thugs gar hrīḥyig gis mtshan pa/ rang tshe dpag med mgon du gsal ba'i spyi bor/ rtsa ba'i bla ma zur chen rdo rje 'chang chos dbyings rang grol/ de'i dbu gtsug tu rigs kun khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog rab byung mas sa zhu ldan/ de'i dbu gtsug tu rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab byung ma yos zhu rab brtan de'i dbu gtsug tu rje btsun bstan 'dzin nyi zla ra0byung mas sa zhu bzang po/ /de'i dbu gtsug tu 'jam dbyangs kun dga' grol ra po byung mas sa zhu mchog /de'i dbu gtsug tu rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po kun bzang rab thong mags zhu chos kyi nyi ma/ de'i dbu gtsug tu grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po/ /de'i dbu gtsug tu dus gsum sangs rgyas pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ de'i dbu gtsug tu dpal rta mchog rol pa/ de'i dbus gtsug tu mgon po tshe dpag med/ de'i dbu gtsug tu sangs —408

spyan ra gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas/ thenargyas snang ba mtha' yas rnams reg la ma 'byar ba mtho brtsegs kyi tshul du bzhugs pa/ rang gi thugs ga'i khyuḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam zhi khro dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ spyi bo'i bla ma rnams la thim par mos nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ 〉hrīḥ snang ba mtha' yas 'gro kun rjes su 'dzin/ /tshe dpag med mgon sgrub la 'chi med ster/ /rta mgrin dbang rgyal 'gro ba'i bar chad sel/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs/ /thang stong rgyal po gsol btab bslu ba med/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar gcod sol/ /byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol/ /mkhasabatsun grub pa'i sar bzhugs kun spangs rje/ /'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo grol mchog zhabs/ /dpal ldan grub rigs (58na 'dzin pa nyi zla'i mas/ /gsol ba ྾/ byin gyis za/ rdo rje 'chang dngosadabang phyug rab brtan dpal/ /khyab bdag mgon po bsod na mas mchoge ldan zhabs/ /rigs kun bdag po cho medabyings rang grol rje/ /gsol bar/ byin gyis zo/ lhan 'dzin nyi zla bzang po nas slar yang sger pa ngag dbang rab byung chas o rgyan pad zhu/nyi ma bzang / lcags zam 'di la khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyis gas/ sprul sku bsod nams rab byung chas pad zhu/ dbang phyug dang / /gzhan bstan 'dzin nyi bzang nas/yang sngags 'chang chen po tsha dkar sa ya/ring pa/ rang grol ra khrung sa sa lu klu sgrub chos kyi rgyal 'di la mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyis gsan/ mtshan rje/ gsol bar/ byin gyis mo/ khri srong rnam sprul bkra shis sngags 'tshan kar mas stobs kyi rgyal/ byang bdag rigs 'dzin chen po ngag gi dbang ga4gos dang gangasazhu gsol ba/ khyab bdag sman lung blo mchog rab byung sangs rgyas gling pa lugs kyi pad zhu rdo rje'i zhabs/ /brgyud pa kun 'dus drin can bla ma la/ /gsol bsko/ byin gyis ri/ oṃ 42PROB hrīḥhrīḥ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi bum dzñā na ā yu sirnyi dzaḥ zhes gso me ba btab pas/ bdag gi bla tshe yar ba dang / rgyu 'byung ba bzhi/ 'brasabu 'byung ba las gyur pa'i snod bcud 'khor 'das kyi tshe dbang bsod nams mkhyen brtse nus mthu thams cad bsdus/ bla ma brgyud pa rnams la thim/ de rnams kyi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med —409—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)pa babs/ rang gi tshangs ru gnas zhugs lus thams cad gang bar 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsam ste bzlas pa ci nus su bya/ mjug tu/ 'chi med tshe yi dpal la longs spyod cing / /rig pa'i blo dang rnam (58ba'i pyod shes rab dang / /srid dang zhi ba'i dpal 'byor gang lags pa/ /de kun lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs kyis/ /mthu dang nus pa byin rlabs dpung skyed la/ /nad gdon 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang / /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par shog /dpon slob mi 'bral lhan cig gnas/ /sku tshe mi 'gyur sra zhing brtan/ /ja chang bzhes spro rgyun mi chad/ /skyid la tshe 'phel bkra shis shog ces sogs kyis 'dod don la gsol ba btab pas/ /snang ba mtha' yas nas bzung / brgyud pa rnams 'od du zhu/ /rang nyid la thim pas 'a med kyi dngos grub thob par bsams nas/ bla ma dang rang sems bsres pa'i ka dag gi ngang du mnyam par bzhag /de las langs te/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ces sogs kyis bsngo smon shis brjod ci rigs pa bya'o/ /de ltar dus min 'chi bdag mun pa'i smag /mthar byed tshe sgrub nyi ma'i dngos brgya'i lus/ kho bo'i blo gros dbang phyogs sa 'dzin las/ shar tshe skal ldan 'dab stong ci yang bzhad/ /dpe 'khyams lag tu son pa'i rgyun med chos/ /bum stong gcig nas gcig brjo'i rnam par thar ma yin rigs 'dzin zhal lung las thos pa/ /mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs 'thul ba'i gdams pa yin/ /dge 'dis 'gro rnams lnga pa'i 'jigs pa dang / /lhan cig srid zhi'i nyes brgya las thar nas/ /rang rig don gyi bcom ldan tshe dpag med/ /mngon sum rang ngo 'phrod pa'i bkra shis shog /ces slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis grub chen thang stong rgyal por dngos su gnang ba dang / bsam yas mchims phu'i gsang phug nas zab gter du yang spyan drangs pa'i tshe sgrub 'chi med dpal ster gyi rgyun 'byer (59na)'di ni/ 'od gsal lha yi rigs las nor 'dzin skyong ba mi'i dbang po ngag dbang rab brtan gyi gsung gis bskul pa ltar/ thugs dam spel ba'i ched du za hor gyi
