ban+de gang shar rang grol gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chang khyim pa ngag dbang mkhyen brtse'o/ /—410

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas/ (thada'od dpag med kyi nyams len rgyun khyer ni/ /sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan gsum mam bdun gyis rgyud dag par byas/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las tha las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid yi ge hrīḥdamar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa/ de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar po sprul sku'i cha byad can/ phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyi bdag nyid can du gyur/ de'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ thugs kar zla gdan gyi dbus su gyi yig la sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba dmigs la/ oṃ pad+ma dha ra hrīḥswā hā/ zhes pa'i gzungs ci nus bzla/ slar ye shes pa phyung ste mdun gyi nam mkhar rang nyid la zhal phyogs nas bzhugs par bsams la ji snyed su dag sogs kyi yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro ba'i bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyis bde ba can du skye ba'i mtshams sbyor byed pa ni gnad dam pa'o/ /zhes 'od dpag med kyi sgrub thabs 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes dkon mchog tshe ring gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas (59ba〉btsun 'jam dbyangs so/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar pad sdong zla ba'i steng / /hrīḥyig las zhabyungs 'phags mchog spyan rasagazigs/ /zha kha gcig phyag bzhi 'dzum ldan spyan dkyus ring / /rtsa phyag thal sbyar lhag ma chu shel gyi/ /'phreng ba brgya rtsa pad+ma dkar po 'dzin/ /bung ba ltar nag ral pa'i thor tshugs bcings/ /gar dbang 'od mtha' yas pa'i cod pan can/ /rin chen rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' gsol/ /kriṣ+ṭha swā ra'i pagasapas nu ma bkab/ /zhabs gnyis me phyed rdo rje skyil mo krung / /mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs mthong na mi mthun med/ /ye shes 'od lnga'i 'ja' tshon gur dbus bzhugs/ /grangs med lus su sprul nas phyag 'tshal zhing / /bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung dngos kun 'bul/ /sngar bsags sdig lhung stobs —411 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)bzhi'i sgo nas bshags/ /rnam dkar bgyis so cog la bdag yi rang / /rgyal sras slob bcas chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /'gro ba'i don du bskal brgyar mi 'dar gsol/ /ston zla ltar dkar bskrun pa'i dge ba yi/ /phung po byang chen 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ zhes pa 'di'ang mang bkur rgyal khab kyi nye 'dabs su 'khod pa'i ye shes rgya mtsho'i kha ton du za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /khyod mtshan thos pa yis kyang nyams grib tshogs/ /ba mor nyi ma ji bzhin dag byed na/ /mngon sum nyams su bstar bas 'dod pa'i don/ /'grub mdzad khro bo'i dbang po la btud nas/ /gang gi man ngag lo chen be ro yi/ /rnam sprul pradzñā ra smi'i zab gter las/ /rgyun khyer nyung ngu'i nyams len skyong bde ba/ /rigs 'dzin mgul rgyan me tog phreng mdzes spel/ /(60na tshe skyabs sems ni/ rang rig kun bzang rang ngo 'phrod min par/ /rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /'gro ba'i don du mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs/ /dag byed sme brtsegs khro rgyal bsgom par bya/ /dngos gzhi ni/ su bhā was sbyangs/chos kun ka dag stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i steng / /rang rig mthing nag hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /'phags tshogs mchode cing 'gro kun sdig sgrib sbyangs/ /tshur 'dus yongs su gyur las skad cig gis/ /bdag nyid sme brtsegs mthing nag zhal gzhig pa/ /phyag gnyi blo/thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'i tshul/ /rab khros mche gtsigs sma ra dmar ser 'byug sbrul sngon lto ser gyis dkris kham nag skra/ /gyen brdzes dbu la thod skam lnga yis brgyan/ /thod rlon 'phreng ba'i do shal se ral kha/ /sbrul gyis yan lag kun brgyan stag sham gsol/ /zhabs bgrad ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /de yi gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtsharna pa'i/ /hūṃ las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gnasamachog nas/ /ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/ dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par gyur/ /mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa'i dngos po kun/ /rig pa'i rtsal du nges pa'i cho 'phrul gyis/ /dbyer med ngo bo gcig pa'i tshul gyis 'bul/ rma u: sma kro ta badz+ra a: nas sha lta'i bar dang / ma hā pas mahā ba smra —412

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs ri bo gru 'dzin du bgrod pa'i them skas/ 6)ta/ ma hā ra snas mchod khro bo kun gyi mthu stobs ma lus pa/ /gcig bsdus rtsal sa bdud sde'i dpung tsho gos rnams/ /thal bar brlag mdzad dpal ldan khro bo'i dbang / /bcom ldan sme ba brtsegs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ 'dzab bsnyen ni/ thugs kar nyi steng hūṃ mthar 'dzab sngags kyi/ /(607phreng ba mgal me'i 'khor lo ltar 'khor las/ /'od zer me dpung tsha tsha rab 'phros pas/ /nad gdon mi gtsang grib tshogs bsreg par gyur/ /oṃ sa tsa ṭa ya tor ya tor ya swāhā/ u ṭa mi ṭa ta ya tar ya swā hā/ mo rgyu ṭa kro ta ya ta ra ya to ra ya swāhā/ a ka kro ta ya ta ra ya to ra ya swāhā/ a bhu kro ta ya tor ya tor yaswāhā/ u ba sha ta ya tor ya tor ya swāhā/ e ling e ṭa ya ta ra ya to ra ya swāhā/ la man tar ya tor ya swāhā/ as ni yis ni ṭa ya tor ya tor ya swāhā/ oṃ snur nu ma hā pra na ye/ snur tsinyi ki bi ma le/ ut+na smaḥkro tsā hūṃ phaṭa tor ya tor ya swāhā/ gsol gdab ni/ lhag pa'i lha mchog khyod kyis rigs 'dzin bdag /rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub la gegs byed pa'i/ /nyams grib mi gtsang dri ma kun sbyangs te//mchog thun dngos grub 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /smon lam ni/ ston zla ltar dkar bsod nams phung po'i rgyun/ /tshad med sku gsum rgya mtsho cher babs nas/ /'gro kun tshe 'dir snang bzhi zad sar 'byol/ /'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku mchog 'grub par shog ces grol tig gi chos sde'i khro bo sme ba brtsegasapa'i nyams len rgyun khyer me tog phreng mdzes 'di ni zab gter chos kyi sgo 'byed sprul sku gter bdag gling pa ngag dbang pad+ma bstan 'dzin gyi gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin no/ /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan gsum gyis rgyud dag par byas nas/ su bha bas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang (61na snyad rje btsun sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo spyan bdun ma g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon dus gsum sangs rgyas mtshon pa'i ut+pal rtse mo gsum pa 'dzin pa/dbu skra mthon mthing thor tshugs kyi lhag ma ring du 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' zla —413

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)ba'i rgyab yol can skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs rkar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥ& baṃ ho yang 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ bdag la dbang bskur bstsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par bsams/ oṃ ārla tā re sa pa ri bā ra a: nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis zhes sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lha yig gi mthar sngags 'phrong gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/spyi bo'i rigs bdag tshe dpag med kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis tshe'i bcud thams cad bkug nas bum pa'i nang du zhu ba'i rgyun gyis rang gi lus thams cad gang ste 'chi med kyi dngos grub thob par bsams la/ oṃ tā re tu tā re tu re ma ma ā yu nu rtso dzñā na pus ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa ci nus su bzla/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag ces sogs smon lam bya/ /sngags 'khor dang 'od zer drug sbrags sogs spro na mngon rtogs gzhung nas len no/ /sgrol dkar tshe byin yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rgyun phyir shin tu nyung ngu 'di ni byang gling bsam grub rgyal po'i 'dod pa bzhin za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i (61ba tha ge pa ni dkar brag pa ngag dbang byams pa'o/ /—414

ma ṇi ril bsgrub nyung ngu rnam gsal/ the)ma ṇi ril bsgrub nyung ngu rnam gsal bzhugs/na mo lo ke shwa rā ya/ dang po'i sems kyi zla shel gtsang ma'i ngos/ /'jig rten dbang phyug snang brnyan ri dwags gzugs/ /legs shar nor bu pad+ma'i mtshan zer gyis/ /sdug bsngal smag rum mthar byed lha gcig sngags/ /gang gi thugs rje bskul bar bgyid pa'i sgra/ /yi ge drug pa'i gdangs su shar ba'i ming / /gangs can phan bde'i rna lung mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /byin rlabs rin chen phra tshoms ci yang spud/ /de phyir ril bu snang stong lha yi skur/ /bzlas brjod dung phyung grangs kyi nus bskyed nas/ /'gro rnams myong bas grol bar byed pa'i thabs/ /nyung ngu rnam gsal g.yin ngo bsrung phyir spel/ /de'ang lha btsun byang chub 'od kyis mnyam med jo bo chen po la bdag chos gsang ba 'dus pa dang lha thugs rje chen po la mos pas de'i sgrub thabs shig dgos zhes zhus pas brten gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug gnang ba'i dbang rgyun ding sang rtsod med yongs grags su bzhugs/ bya rgyud brnye'i rigs kyi byang chub sems dpa'i skor la spyan ras gzigs kyi lha tshogs shas che zhing de dag las 'phros te spyi'i bka' abha ya lugs kyi sgrub thabs rgya mtsho/ pa tshab brgya tsha/ ba ri bas bsgyur ba'i sgrub thabs kun las btus pa nas bshad pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi skor dang / dpal mo/ zla rgyal/skyer sgang lugs sogs zur bka'i sgrub thabs rnams dang / snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches zhus dag mdzad pa'i gsar ma rgyud 'bum gyi nang nas kyang ma ni ril sgrub kyi khungs gsal bar ma rnyed cing mkhas pa mang por dri mal gyis gtan la phab kyang gsal bar ma byung /sngags rnying ma'i (62na)lugs su gter kha gong 'og gis thog drangs pa'i thugs rje chen po'i sgrub 'phrin la brten te skye bdun gyi skor shin tu rgyas na'ang de ris gsar ma ba la 'jug chung zhing khyad par mtshan nyid kyi gra sar gsar rnying la ma bltos pa'i sngags phyogs kyi spros pa ches na bka' pod kyi —4/5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)bshad nyan rnams 'ja' lus 'grub tu nye ba'i dgag bya che zhing dgos pa chung bar ma zad rnying ma la khungs bcol nas bros pas ma 'gab cing gsar ma nas khungs ma rnyed pas rang bzo'i brtsams chos 'di 'dra rnam pa gcig tu bla chen spyi'i mdzad pa yin pas skyon du mi 'gyur shas che'ang chos la dbang za ba rang nyid chos kyis phongs pa'i rgyu dang bag tsha ba cung zad dang ldan pas byed par mi spro na'ang dpal ldan mnga' ris grwa tshang gi slob dpon pas nan gyis bskul ba ngo ma chogs par 'dri ba la/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gdung sha rī raṃ gyis thog drangs 'phags pa gsum gyi ring bsrel/grub thob brgyad cu dang rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs rgya gar gyi paṇa grub dang chos rgyal mes dbon/bstan pa snga dar dang phyi dar gyi dus su byon pa'i lo paṇa sogs skyes chen dam pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rnams kyi sku gdung / sku bal ring bsrel gyis mtsho ni pa'i dam rdzas gang chags zan nam cong zhi lta bur sbyar ba'i ril bu bum pa grangs ji tsam byed pa'i nang du blug /stegs kyi steng du bum pa rnams bkod/de'i mthar ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa bsham/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang / bdag dang snang ba thams cad chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin yin pa la/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par bya/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar bya/ sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar bya/ (62ba)bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par bya'o/ /zhes tshad med bzhi bsgom/ gnas sogs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs dang / tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis sa gzhi rin po che sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin lag mthil star mnyam pa/ tha gru che ba/ yangs pa/ reg na 'jam zhing bde ba dri ma med cing 'od gsal ba/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i dri bsung ngad dang ldan pa'i lha'i me tog sna tshogs kyi gcal bkram pa/ /mtha' rin po che'i pha gus brtsegs pa/ gser dang dngul dang mu tig gi phye ma —416

ma ṇi ril bsgrub nyung ngu rnam gsal/ (thadagram bur brdal ba/ ut+pal dang ku mu da dang pad+ma 'gying zhing ldem pas khebs par gyur cing chu bya sna tshogs skad snyan par sgrog pa/ dga' zhing 'phyo la lding bas brgyan pa'i yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i mtsho dang rdzing dang lteng ka dag gis mdzes par byas pa/ rin po che dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa lha'i nor bu dang mu tig gi rgyan 'phreng dang rin po che dpyangs pa/ me tog gi mgo lcogs dang 'bras bu mdzes par chags pas g.yur za zhing ldem pa/ gser gyi dril bu g.yer kha 'khrol ba las dam pa'i chos kyi sgra 'byung ba dang ldan pa tshar du bsgrengs bas legs par brgyan pa'i sa gzhi'i dbus su rin po che'i bum pa lto ba ldir zhing 'khas zhus pa/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ lha'i gosakyis mgul pa brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan zhing nang rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i ye shes rang 'od 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang gi lte bar ril bu rnams 'phags pa thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi lha tshogs gaṅgā'i (63na〉kung gi bye ma snyed kyi rdul dang mnyam par sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can dang mnga' thang dang 'tsham par grub pa mdzes pa sha stag 'byung bar gyur cig /phyi nang kun tu yang cho rigs dang 'tsham par yang lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa zhal zas dang na bza' dang rgyan dang rol mo la sogs pa phul du phyin pa sna tshogs phung po gsum pa'i mdo dang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las 'byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho thams cad kyis rgyas par gang zhing rgyan klubs pa dang ldan par gyur cig /thugs rje chen po 'khor dang bcas pas kyang de bzhin du byin gyis brlabs shing bzhes te longs spyod par gyur cig /ces lan gsum brjod/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs dang tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis de de bzhin du gyur cig /ces lan gsum brjod/ thams cad du ni sa gzhi dag /gseg ma la sogs med pa dang / /lag mthil ltar mnyam be+e ḍūrla'i/ /rang bzhin 'jam por gnas gyur cig /bde ldan 'jig rten bkod pa ltar/ /rin chen sa gzhi me tog gcal/ /ljon shing chu mtsho ma tshang —417

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)med/ /chos sgra rgya chen ldan par shog /'jig rten 'das pa'i dge las byung / /rin chen bdun las grub pa la/ /tshad med 'od zer 'gyed pa'i gnas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas bzhugs gyur cig /rin chen du ma las grub seng ge'i khri/ /yid 'ong sna tshogs gos kyis bkab pa 'di/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rnamasal phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs gyur cig /lha dang mi yi mchod pa'i rdzas/ /dngos su bshams dang yid kyis sprul/ /kun bzang mchod sprin bla (63ba)na med/ /nam mkha'i khams kun khyab gyur cig /thog ma med pa'i bskal pa nas grangs med pa'i sems can rnams 'dren pa'i thugs bskyed pa thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs kyis che ge mo la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po skyob pa'i slad du mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du spyan 'dren zhing mchis na mchod pa'i tsho gos sbyar ba'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor 'dir gshegs shing gdan 'dzom pa chen po mdzad de byin gyis brlab par ci gnang / ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / zhes pa nas maṇ+ḍal gyi mtha' rten tshigs bcad dang bcas pa'i bar chos spyod rab gsal ji lta ba la btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra ba zhes pa/ ston mtshan zla ba'i mdog 'dra ba/ /zhes dang / shākya'i rgyal po'i dbu la/ zhes pa thugs rje chen po'i dbu la zhes sogs tshig zur bsgyur/ bsdus pa 'dod na bzang spyod las byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa bya/ /dpal ldan zla ba grags pas thugs rje chen po la bstod pa byin rlabs shin tu che ba ni/byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /dri med dung mdog mchog tu gzugs bzang ba/ /rnam dag 'od gsal zla ba'i dkyil na mdzes/ /ji ltar mkha' la nyi 'od stong 'bar bzhin/ /dpa' bo 'od zer stong 'bar lham me ba/ /srid pa gsum gyi sa mkhan ston par grags/ khams gsum 'gro ba kun gi gnyen gcig pu/ /byams mgon thugs rje'i lha khyed bdag la dgongs/ /bdag ni thog mtha' med pa'i dus mtha' nas/ /lam log lam stor srid pa'i 'khor bar 'khyams/ /sngon tshe lam log sdig pa spyad pas nongs/ /sdig pa'i las rnams ci byas rab gnong 'byod/ /dar zhing drags pa'i las de dbang 418

ma ṇi ril bsgrub nyung ngu rnam gsal/ 6)btsan nas/ /(64na tshe snyor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying gyur te/ /zhe sdang 'bar ba'i mes ni bdag rgyud bsregs/ /gti mug mun pa'i tshogs kyis shes rab rmongs/ /'dod chags rgya mtsho'i nang du rnam shes bying / /nga rgyal chen po'i re bos ༅ 'gror mnan/ /phrag dog rlung dmar 'tshis pas 'khor bar g.yengs/ /bdag tu lta ba'i mdud pa dam pos bcings/ /'dod pa me mdag 'dor 'dra'i 'obasasu lhungs/ /sdug bsngal drag po'i 'dam rdzab char ltar babs/ /me khams nyi ma'i dugs ni steng nas tsha/ /chu khams sa yi brlan ni 'og nas grang / /phyi yi bser bu'i ngad ni thad gar tsha/ /kun nas zhabrugs pa'i rlung ni khong nas ldang / /de ltar sdug bsngal shin tu bzod dka' yang / /sdom pa'i yi dam gzhig tu ga la rung / /sdug bsngal kun dang bsdos nas sdom bsrung zhing / /mos pa'i dad pas 'phags mchog mi gtong na/ /'phags mgon 'gro don mi mdzad ci la dgongs/ /byams mgon ci slad bdag la thugs mi brtse/ /bdag 'dra blun rmongs las ngan sdig po che/ /las kyi dbang gis snyigs ma'i dus 'dir skyes/ /skyes pas yod de las la yi re chad/ /yi chad 'gyod kyang las dbang bcos su med/ /lasakyi shugs ni chu bo'i rgyun dang 'dra/ /las dbang chu klung ldog par rab tu dka'/ /dka' la zhugs pasabaka' bzhin rngo ma thogs/ /lus ngag yid gsum sdig pa'i dbang du gyur/ /sdig pa'i las dbang drag po me 'bar bas/ /rnam shes dbang po'i myu gu gdungs gyur te/ /phung po sgyu ma'i lus 'dis mi bzod na/ /byams mgon thugs rje can gyis bzod lags sam/ /nyi ltar 'od gsal zla ltar mdangasagasal ba'i/ /thugs rje'i zhal nyid mthong bar 'tshal lags na/ /(64ba〉sgogs ma med nas ma rig ling tog gis/ /ldongs pa'i chu bur mig gis ma mthong na/ /'gro ba'i mgon khyed da lta ga na bzhugs//sdug bsngal drag po shin tu mi bzad pas/ zhan tu skrag cing skyi g.ya' rab 'jigs na/ /dung dung gdung ba'i smre sngags 'di 'don zhing / /nyam thag phongs pa'i nga ros 'o dod 'bod/ /byams mgon thugs rje can gyis gsan lags sam/ /nam zhig 'chi 'pho lus brjes gyur pa'i tshe/ /gnyen bshesagrogs dang phral te gshin rjes khrid/ /de tshe 'jig rten nye dus mi stongs te/ /las dbang sa bdag —419

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)'dra gcig pur khrid/ /dus der bdag la mgon skyabs ma ma mi san/ /byams mgon khyed kyis 'khor bar bdag gtong ngam/ /las kyis mnar ba'i skye bo bdag 'dra ba/ /thog ma med pa'i dus nas log brtags pas/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas las ma thar te/ /bskal ba dpag med skye ba ji snyed du/ /sngon chad lus blangs grangs med zhig gyur te/ sha rus bsags na 'jig rten gtos dang mnyam//rnag khrag bsags na rgya mtsho chen po tsam/ /las 'gro bsags na bsam 'das brjod mi lang / /khams gsum bgrang zhing skye ba bdun brgyud kyang / /byas pa'i las rnams don med chus zos te/ /skye ba grangs med ji snyed de tsam las/ /skye ba gcig gcig kho na tsam gyi las/ /bla med don du rab spyad ji tsam na/ /de tsam byas pa'i las la don re yod/ /las ni dbang btsan nyon mongs stobs che bas/ /sha khrag 'dra ba'i lus blangs 'khor bar 'khyams/ /sdug bsngal drag pos srid pa'i brtson rar tshud/ /mi bzad sdug bsngal drag po 'di 'dra na/ /nyes byas thams cad rang gi las las byung / /thugs rje chen pos las rnams rgyun bcad de/ /nyen mongs las kyi rlung 'di bzlog (65na) gsol/ /nyon mongasalas kyi rlung 'di dbang btsan pas/ /ma rig mun pa'i nang du gtan lkoms na/ /ye shes sgron me'i zer gyis mi gzigs sam/ /nyes byas las kyi 'bras bu mi bzod na/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrin las mi mdzad dam/ /dug gsum bzod dka'i nad kyis gdungs lags na/ /thugs rje thabs mkhas sman gyis mi gso 'am/ /phyin ci log gi g.yang sar lhungs lags na/ /thugs rje'i myur mgyogs phyag gis mi 'dzin nam/ /sdug bsngal drag po'i las kyi me 'bar na/ /thugs rjes bsil ba'i char rgyun mi 'bebs sam/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas su sbyangs sbyangs nas/ /nam zhig rang gi 'bras bu thob pa'i tshe/ /'phags pa'i thugs rjes ci 'tshal don ma mchis/ /sems can las 'phro btsan par bzhag na dag /'phags pa'i thugs rjes su la ci zhig bgyi/ /'phags mchog khyod la thugs rje'i stobs mnga' na/ /yal yol btang snyoms le lo ma mdzad par/ /snying nas gzigs shing thugs rje rgyal ba'i lha/ /zhes dang gzhan yang skyon gyis ma gos sogs bstod pa ci rigs pa bya/ /de nas mdo chog las —420

ma ṇi ril bsgrub nyung ngu rnam gsal/ 6)byung ba'i mtshan legs kyi smon lam 'di 'dus che bar 'dug pas/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi sngon gyi thugs bskyed dang smon lam dang thugs rje'i mthu la brten nas/ bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag nad sna tshogs kyis lus yongs su gzir te rims dang gshed byed dang byad dang ro langs dang 'jigs pa sna tshogs kyis gtses pa de dag thams cad kyi gnod pa dang nad thams cad 'phral du zhi bar gyur cig /byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du rims dang sdig pa can gyi gdon dang nad thams cad med (65ba)par gyur cig /rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag long ba dang 'on pa dang spyon pa dang sha bkra dang nad tshabs chen pos btab par gyur pa de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du dbang po thams cad yongs su tshang bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang nad thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gis bsgribs pa/ mtshams med pa lnga byed pa/bya ba ma yin pa'i spyod pa mang ba/ dam pa'i cho ge spong ba/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i las sna tsho gis byed pa/ngan song gsum dang sems can dmyal bar 'gro ba de dag sems can dmyal ba chen por skyes nas sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong ba de dag thams cad kyi mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad yongs su byang zhing zad par gyur cig /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i bar du su yang sems can dmyal ba dang ngan 'gror 'gro bar ma gyur cig /lha yul ba'i lha'i bde ba dang mi'i bde ba myong bar gyur cig /bdag cag la so gos pa sems can gang dag dbul por gyur te zas dang skom dang gos dang nor dang 'bru dang mal cha dang sposadang phreng ba dang yo byad mi bdog pa de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du dbyig dang gos dang nor dang 'bru dang mal cha dang spos dang phreng ba dang yo byad 'phel bar gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag bcing ba dang brdeg pa dang go rar gzhug pa dang mtshon cha'i tshogs rnam pa sna tshogs kyis lus yongs su gzir ba de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du bcing ba brdeg pa —421 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)thams cad las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /lus kyi gdung ba thams cad rgyun chad par gyur cig /bdag (66na)cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag mgon med par gyur pa lus la gdung ba'i me 'bar ba dang seng ge dang stag dang dom dang dred dang sbrul gdug pa'i nang du chud de srog la bab cing nyam thag pa de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du lus la gdung ba'i me thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /seng ge dang stag dang dom dang dred dang sprul gdug pa de dag kyang byams pa la gnas par gyur cig /'jigs pa med pa dang zhi ba'i gnas la gnas par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag phan tshun 'thab pa dang rtsod cing 'gyed par gyur te zhabrugs shing 'jigs skrag nas dngangs pa de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du 'thab pa dang rtsod pa dang 'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig /phan tshun byams pa la gnas par gyur cig /bdag cag la sogs pa sems can gang dag chu'i nang du son pa grur zhugs pa gling med par phyin pa srog 'dod pa chu klung dang rgya mtsho'i nang du son te smre sngags sna tshogs 'don pa de dag byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar du chu klung chen po de las dbugs 'byin pa sbyin par gyur cig /'jigs pa med par brgal bar gyur cig /'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang nub phyogs bde ba can du pad+ma las skyes nas mgon po 'od dpag med sras kyi thu bo gnyis dang bcas pas rjes su bzung ste rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig ces smon lam gdab/ rgyal ba'i sras po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /gdung shugs drag pos thugs rje'i rgyud skul na/ /dam rdzas ril bu 'di la byin rlobs la/ /'gro rnams smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i byed po yis/ /'phags pa'i thugs ka'i khyoḥlas 'od los nas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas nyan rang la (66ba〉sgogs pa/ /skyabs gnas kun gyi byin rlabs nus mthu'i tshogs/ /'od dang 'od zer bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dang / /'phags pa'i sku yi rnam par thogs med bsdus/ /ril bu thugs rje chen po'i rnam pa la/ /chu la chu bzhag bzhin du ro gcig gyur/ /ces rig sngags bgrang / thun 'jog khar me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang zhes sogs blo ka —422

ma ṇi ril bsgrub nyung ngu rnam gsal/ 6)gnyis kyis mchode/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ smon lam dang brtan bzhugs bya/ sang nang par cho ga tshar gcig gtong / zhag grangs ji tsam byed pa'i ring bsgrubs nas grol nyin thun mthar mchod pa dang bstod pa rgyas par bya/ rgyal ba'i sras po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs zhes sogs kyi tshig rkang tha ma gnyis 'don pa bsgyur ba ni/ ril bu thugs rje chen por gsal ba rnams//'od zhu gnyis su med par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas ril bu thugs rje chen po'i rnam par bzhugs pa 'od du zhu nas ril bu'i rnam par gyur/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu//zhes sogs dang su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swāhās brtan bzhugs bya zhing me tog gtor/ smon lam shis brjod ci rigs pa bya'o/ /ma ṇi ril sgrub nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes pa 'di'ang dpal ldan mnga' ris gra tshang gi slob dpon blo bzang nor bus nan tan du bskul ba la brten nas/ sngags phyogs kyi dbang rjes gnang sogs thob ma thob la ma bltos par 'jug pa bde ba'i slad du/ bde bar gshegs pa bdun gyi smon lam gyi cho ga cung zad blangs dor tshang ba'i lugs su byas te g.yar khral tsam du za hor gyi brnyes bkod par mkhas pa rnams thugs mi khrel bar gsol ba 'debs shing yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /—423—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)'jam dpal drag po'i nyams len rgyun 'byer be+e ḍār bzhun ma'i chu sbyo/na bzhugs/gang zhig bsgom dang bzlas pa tsam gyis kyang / /mi (67na〉5thun nyes sel 'jam dbyangs nag po yi/ /ngag 'don nyams su blang byar khyer bde ba'i/ /sgrub thabs be+e ḍūr zhun ma'i chu rgyun 'dri/ /de la 'dir dpal ldan sa skya pa'i lcags ri mi 'da' ba'i gser cho ge bcu gsum gyi nang tshan 'jam dpal nag po'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar 'dod pas tho rengs phyi sgo ma phye ba'i dus kha shar du phyogs la skyil mo krung bcas/ sgal tshigs drang por bsrangs nas bde ba'i stan la 'khod de sngon 'gro skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed pa ni/ bdag sogs nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan gsum sogs ci rigs pa brjod/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i go du 'jam dpal nag po'i sgom bzlas la brtson par bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ dngos gzhi ni/ su bhā bas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems kyi ngo bo dhīḥmathing nag las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing g.yon mtheb srin gyis la'i yu ba nas thugs gar bzung ste 'dab ma snyan gyi thad na kha phye ba'i steng du sher phyin gyi glegs bam bsnams pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs can/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par skad cig dran rdzogs su gsol 'debs/ gnas —424

'jam dpal drag po'i nyams len rgyun 'khyer be+e ḍūr bzhun ma'i chu rgyun/ 6)gsum brlab pa/ ye shes pa gzhug cing dbang bskur (67ba)rgyas gdab mi dgos pa brgyud pa'i gsung rgyun yin kyang ding sang mkhas rlom gzhan gyis rgyas 'gebs byed srid pas/ de rigs kyi blos byas rnams ngan skyugs bzhin spang ba gnad do/ /de ltar ting 'dzin gsal ba'i ngang nas/ oṃ pra sod/chu sod/ dur ta sod/ snying mgo la chad/ kha dza/ kai she tre rbad phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa brgya'am nyer gcig gis mtshon pa'i ji ltar rigs pa bzla/ mjug tu/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'phags pa 'jam dpal 'grub gyur nas/ zhes sogs kyi bsngo smon bya'o/ /de ltar nyams su blangs bas mthu byad nad gdon sogs nye bar 'tshe ba'i tshogs zhi bar 'gyur zhing gnad kyi gdams pa'i man ngag lhag ma rnams ni gong ma'i yig rnying dang bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o/ /khungs ldan rgya bod mkhas pa'i gser gyi chos/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i drin las legs rnyed pa/ /skal ldan mang por phan phyir nyer bkod pas/ /don ldan rnam mkhyen 'gro kun gyis thob shog /'jam dpal nag po'i nyams len rgyun 'khyer be+e ḍūr zhun ma'i chu rgyun zhes pa 'di ni gnam gyi lha gong ma rgyal po'i gser yig pa bsam blo er te na rab 'byams chos rjes bskul la brten nas za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni/ gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /—423

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan bzhugs/na mo gu ru : ta ya shrī ba shri ye/ /'od mtshan stong du 'bar ba gar gyi dbang / /sdom brtson gnasalnga rig pa'i brtul zhugs can/ lha gcig di paṃ ka ra khyod zhabs rdul/ /snying dbus ze'u 'brur byang chub bar du bsten/ /gang gi zab chos chad med gaṅgā'i klung / /bdag blo'i rgya mtshor 'bab mdzod rdo rje 'chang / /rin chen bsod nams mchog tu lhun grub pa/ /rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs la rtag tu skyongs/ khwa na (6ni tha zhis bskor rta mgrin dbang gi lha'i/ /sgrub thabs rjes gnang cho ga a ti sha'i//bzhed srol 'bru dkar rang bza' phub ma yis/ /ma bslad ngo mtshar yid ches sum ldan 'dri/ /de la 'dir mnyam med jo bo chen po nas brgyud pa'i rta mgrin shwa na bzhi skor gyi sgrub thabs nyams su blang bas rdo rje theg pa'i dbang gis rgyud smin cing khyad par 'di nyid kyi rjes gnang nad pa sogs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rten gyi gang zag gis bsam gtan gyi khang par skyang nul bya/ dkon mchog spyi dang bye brag gi rten dgram/ gtor ma dang rdo rje dril bu sogs mkho ba'i rdzas dang yo byad rnams mngon par 'du byas te stan bde ba la 'dug nas sngon 'gro ni/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed spyi ltar bya/ tshogs zhing ni/ rang nyid rta mchog tu gsal ba'i thugs gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis bla ma 'od dpag med rigs bdag tu bzhugs pa'i khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin gyi lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru saḥ na ma badz+ra kro dh+wa ha ya gi wa sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍa le saḥ zhes phyag bya/ sngags mjug tu a lha nas sha rdi'i bar gyis mchod/ gur las byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum dang tshad med bzhi bsgom/ dngos gzhi ni/oṃ shā n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra su bhā ba āt+pa rka3nya/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i stong pa —426

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ (thadanyid du bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las sngon gyi smon lam rjes su dran pas rang gi rnam shes kyi ngo bo yi ge paṃ yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du me las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur los pas 'og rdo rje'i zhis ga/ phyogs mtshams rdo rje'i ra ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol du (68ba〉sku shes kyi me kha dog sna lnga dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba bar mtshams med pas khyab par bsam/ de'i dbus su zlo yongs su gyur pa las rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du pha gu dra ba dra phyed mda' yab pu shu dang rtsa bar 'ding ba'i snam bu dang bcas pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i dbus kyi gdung zlum por bskor ba'i re'u mig dbus ma'i steng du ka chung gis bteg pa'i rgya phubs dang sgo bzhir sgo rkyang gi rnam pa can mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte ba la hūṃ dmar nag dang 'dab ma bzhir nyi ma dang ro'i gdan la shar nas rim pa bzhin du hūṃ lha hrīḥ.aḥrnams las gri gug gi yu ba la so so'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros bde bar gshegs pa mchod/ byin rlabs bsdus sems can la phog /sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gnod byed 'byung po thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus rdo rje hūṃ dang bcasapa la thim/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum phyag bzhi pa/ dbus 'kha dmar po/ g.yas zhal sngon po/ g.yon 'kha dkar po/zhal gsum gdangs shing shin tu rngam pa/ mche ba rab tu gtsigs shing ljags glog ltar 'khyug pa/zhal re re la'ang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing khro gnyer shin tu bsdus pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes shing sangs rgyas rigs lngas dbu la brgyan pa'i zhal dbus ma'i gtsugs na rta mgo ljang khu kha gyen du bltas te rta skad 'byin pas gdug pa can rnams skrag par mdzad pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse lnga —427

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)dang pad+ma dmar po bsnams (69na skong tha ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs bas gnod byed thams cad tshar gcod pa mi mgo skam po lngas dbu la brgyan cing khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i phreng ba dang phyag zhabs sbrul rgyas brgyan pa/ sku smad stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas gnyis bskum pas tshangs pa ser po dang brgya byin dkar po/ g.yon gnyis brkyang bas dbang phyug sngon po dang khyab 'jug dmar po mnan nas ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /'dab ma bzhi'i shar du rdo rje las byed ma sngon mo/ lhor gshin rje las byed ma nag mo/ /nub tu klu'i lasabyed ma dkar mo/ /byang du gnod sbyin las byed ma she'u lo tsā dang lo brgyad mchog legs rdo rje'i yig char 'di 7snyo byung zhing yig rnying zhig na ljang gur 'dug pa brtag /ser mo/ /bzhi ga'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ dbu skra dmar ser phyed rings su byas pa la sogs pa khro mo'i nyams thams cad dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi spyi por oṃ dkar po/ /mgrin par āḥdamar po/ /thugs kar hūṃ sngon po//thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya skyi pa sa pa ri wā ra a: nas shabha bra la swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥ& baṃ hos gnyis su med par bsam/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rnams bsdu rgya dang bcas oṃ pañtsa kū la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ gong gi sngags gsham du a sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṇiñtsa tu me/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa thogs (69bskos ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ zhes pa nas shrī hūṃ zhes dbang bskur bas lus gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la 'od dpag med 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ sngags mjug tu — nas shabha'i bar dang rū pa nas spar+sha'i bar gyis mchod khyoḥpad+ma'i rigs bdag snang ba mtha' yas gar/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal/ /las —428

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bsgor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ (tha)byed mkha' 'gro shwa na bzhis bskor ba/ /lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod/bzlas pa ni/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi thugs gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i rang rang gi sa bon la bzla bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer dang khro bo'i tshogs 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ byin rlabs rnams bsdus/ gdug pa can rnams tshar bcad/ slar 'dus sngags kyi phreng ba la thim pa'i spro ba dang bsdu ba'i mdzad pa can du bsam/ snying po 'bru bcu gsum pa ni/ oṃ ha ha hi hi hri hri hri hri hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ces dang gzhan yang / nye snying 'bru bco lnga pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya shrī wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ las byed ma bzhi'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra shwa na sam ya hūṃ/ oṃ ya ma shwa na sam ya hūṃ/ oṃ nā ga shwa na sam ya hūṃ/ oṃ kha rag shwa na sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes bzla/ yig rnying zhig na 'bru bcu gcig tsam 'dug pas 'di gnyis yod med brtag /bsnyen pa tshad du thengs nas las sbyor bya bar 'dod na gtso 'khor gyi sngags mjug tu las sbyor gyi sngags ring ni/ rgyal 'gong rgyal tshe la ma sha dom ro la khrag 'thung / snying khrag badz+ra sa du sa ma ya dzabadz+ra badzi tra ga rag ta 'byung ba mā ra ya snying khrag dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥ badz+ra e ku shā dzaḥ 'byung po tshe la ma sha dom/ ro la khrag 'thung / snying khrag 'byung po 'byung mo pra ti pra mo tshe la ma sha dom/ ro la khrag 'thung / snying khrag ma la ma la/ yes ye bh+yo bh+yo/ spokro swā hā/ chag ru (chan)ḍa tsa la hūṃ phaṭa/ ta ko tsa te bi dza te/ hu ya hu ya/ hu lu hu lu/ su ru te su ru te hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes sbrel nas bzla'o/ /gtor ma dbul bar 'dod na nya sha sgog btsong spangs pa'i gtor ma bshams pa chab kyis sbran/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ shā n+ya lhas sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po tsho snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥ/ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya tsho cher por bsam/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas a kā ros byin gyis brlabs/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bco brgyad mchog legs pa'i der gtor mgron spyan drangs shing lum pa ba'i der gsal kha mi 'dug kyang bya rgyud phal che ba la ye shes pa mdun du phyung ga mang bas 'di bsto 'thad dam snyam byon par bsam/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/gtso 'khor gyi sngags gsham du/ i rda ba li rta kha kha ji hi 'a hi/ lan gsum mam bdun gyis 'bul/—429

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)sngar bzhin mchod cing bstod/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ pad+ma sa twa sa ma ya sogs kyi yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang sogs dang /lhag pa dang ni chad pa dang zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /ces sogs kyi mjug tu badz+ra mu mo skes ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ rang nyid dam tshig pa'i dkyil 'khor me long la ha btab pa bzhin nā da'i bar bsdus te mthar 'od gsal gyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog /de las langs nas bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas gdab bo/ /'di'i rjes gnang la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ mjug gsum las dang po ni/ rgyas(70ba thar spro na maṇ+ḍal dri bzang po'i chus byug pa'i steng du dkyil 'khor sgo rkyang gi dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad phyogs bzhi dmar/ me rlung ser/ dbang ldan sngo/ bden bral dang lte ba ljang / dbus su zla nyi'i steng du rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/phyogs bzhir gri gug 'bri ba'am bsdu na pad+ma 'dab brgyad la thar mi ris bskor ba 'bri srol yod pa rjes gnang rgyas pa tsam las dbang dngos min pas thig tshon gyi cho ga dang slob ma grangs bcad mi dgos/ rgyas bsdus gnyis ka ras bris byas kyang rung / malji zhi khar maṇ+ḍal bzhag g.yas su gtor ma gtso 'khor lnga pa smyug rtse can rgyan ldan/ mdun nas brtsams te chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod mtshams 'dzin dang bcas sgor mched slob dpon gyi cog tse'i steng du rnam bum dang las bum/ rdor dril/ me tog /gzhan yang bgegs gtor/ mig dar/ tsam pa ka /dbu rgyan/ rdo rje/ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal sogs mkho ba'i rdzas dang yo byad rnams 'du byas/ thog mar a mṛ tas bsangs/ su lhas sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rdzas rnams dngas shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par bsam/ oṃ a lha āḥsnyi/ oṃ pā thu āḥ// oṃ badz+ra puspro āḥlha/ oṃ badz+ra ṅgā pe āḥlha/ slobadz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra — āḥ&/ oṃ badz+ra ni wi du āḥ// oṃ badz+ra shabha āḥ// dharma ra ṇi ta lan gsum gyis rol —430

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ (thanachen dang bcas byin dbab/ skyabs 'gro nas bzung bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin bya/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun du phyung ba la chu gnyis nyer spyod kyis mchod cing bstod/ 'dod don la gsol ba btab cing bzod par gsol nas ye shes pa gshegs/ rang nyid dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal (71na〉pa gnas pas bum pa gnyis a skṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā bas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las2 las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba lto ba ldir ba 'khas zhum pa mgrin pa phra ba kha g.yal ba mchu 'chang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa dkris pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tsho gos kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su sna tsho gos pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba zhes pa nas/ gar stabs kyis bzhugasapa'i bar sgrub thabs ba chin bya/ mchog legs pa'i der mi dgos pa 'dra zhig 'dug kyang slob ma lhar bskyed pa sogs la tshogs ba4 ba yid dam snya/las bum gyi nang du paṃ las pad+ma dang me las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la hūṃ mthing nag yongs su gyur pa las khro bo rtog med bgegs mthar byed sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas rdo rje gsor nyid g.yon sdigs mdzub dkur brten pa/ khro bo'i rgyan thamasacad kyis brgyan cing sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ zhes pa nas gnod sbyin las byed ma dang khro bo rtog med gnyis la don grub kyis dbu brgyan par bsam pa'i bar dang / oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya shrī wa bisnrun+ta kṛ ta sa pa ri wā ra a lha nas shabha'i bar dang rū pa nas spar+sha'i bar gyis mchode/ bstod pa'i mjug tu/'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrog cing / zhes sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song bas bum pa'i lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas dang byang cub sems dpa' rnams kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus nas thugs skar thim pas lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te (71ba)bum pa gang bar bsams la gtso 'khor lnga'i sngags dang las bum la dmigs te oṃ a mṛ ta hūṃ phaṭa/ ces ci nus su bzla/ mthar —431

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shemachod cing bstod/ oṃ āḥ& gis mcho ne yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu bsams/ las bum la ji srid dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs rnam par bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod cig /ces me rtag gtor zhing 'phrin las gzhe le/ dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs nas gtor ma 'bul zhing 'dod don la gsol ba gdab pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rang nyid ces pa dang bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsams pa dor zhing bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog /de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad bsdus nas mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs kur thim par bsam/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la mchog legs pa'i yi ger bdag 'jug dgos mi dgos brtag gsung yang rjes gnang yin pas btang snyoms su bzhag ste 'jug pa dang dbang gnyis las/ dang po ni slob ma rnams khrus nas dbyung / phyag dang yon dbul/ me tog bkye bsdu bya/ zhi bar zhi drag phyed ma/ drag po gsum gyi bgegs sgrod sngon du 'gro ba'i chos kyi phan yon dang spyi'i che ba/ bye brag tu gsan bya'i chos 'di nyid rgyud sde rin po che rnam pa bzhi las bya ba'i rgyud la rigs drug tu yod pa'i nang tshan pad+ma'i rigs kyi khro bor gtogs pa rta mgrin shwa na bzhi skor jo bo lugs su grags pa 'di yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gis nye bar bstan pa bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab kyi snying po/ (72na)de'ang bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin nas gsang ba ye shes kyi ḍā gi /slob dpon sangs rgyas zhi ba/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba/ ku swā li che chung gnyis/ chung bas dpal mar me mdzad la gnang /jo bo chen po kha ba can gyi skye dgu'i bsod nams kyi mgron du phebs pa'i tshe 'phan yul lan pa'i spyil bur ka pa shākya dbang phyug gis gdan drangs te chos gsung ba'i tshe jo bo rje chos khri'i steng nas lings kyis phog pa na dge bshes ston pas ci lags zhus pa'i lan du/ na ma bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ u ba si ka mi ma yin chen po zhig 'dug par rang la mi spron pa gsung ba'i bar chad dran —432

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ thenags brtsams kyang ma tshugs par gda'/ de nas 'di tshar gcod ces rta mgrin shwa na bzhi skor gyi sgrub pa mdzad de btul/ de nas bshes gnyen ston pa sogs slob ma du mar gnang mod 'di pa'i brgyud lugs ni jo bo rje nas yol grub thob chos dbang / mtha' bzhi grub thob rin chen smon lam/ bla ma ye shes 'od/ slob dpon legs pa shes rab/ bla ma byang chub rin chen/ slob dpon byang chub/ gzhon nu 'od/ mkhan chen byams pa rin chen/ mkhas btsun byang seng ba/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhen nu blo gros/ rdo rje 'amang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇa chen bkra shis rnam rgyal/ spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang /rje btsun ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan chos 'byor/ lo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ khri chen 'jam dbyangs ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ de sras 'jam dpal rdo rje ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug /rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag zha lu mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des (72ba thad ga la bka' drin du stsal ba lags/ zhes pa lta bus spro ba bskyed/ slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os rnams sngon du song zin pa nas slob ma rnams kyi sku'i ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar maṇ+ḍal 'phul ba zhu zhes brda sprad/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang / ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang / dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams mya ngan 'da' ba'i phyir/ deng nasabyang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du 'phags pa rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo chen po rta mgrin yi dam du bzung bar 'tshal bas/ slob dpon gyis bdag la 'phags pa gsang sngags chen mo'i rjes su gnang ba dang snying po bzlas pa'i lung stsal du gsol/ lan gsum gyi rjes zlos byed cing me tog 'thor/ bla mas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis 'phags pa'i rgyal po khro bo chen po rta mgrin yi dam du bzung ba legs so/ /zhes lan gdab/ tsak+ṣa bhan+ta sa gdong g.yogs 'ching / 'bru lngas me tog gi phreng ba gtad/ gur las byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum gyis skyabs su 'gro zhing smon pa dang 'jug pa'i byang chub —433

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)mchog tu sems bskyed/ slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'dus nas/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes dkyil 'khor gyi nang du 'khrid/ de nas sa ma ya āḥ'i rjes zlos byed du gzhug /sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa'i smon pa'i sems dung ba zhig bskyed/ de nyid gzugs kyi rnam par langs pa khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya yongs su gang ba lam gyis gsal gdab/ yang chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'i stong pa nyid dang rang gi sems ro gcig tu gyur pa'i don des byang chub kyi sems dung ba zhig bskyed/ de nyid gzugs kyi rnam par langs pa zla ba'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i rnam par gyur pa'i mos pa byas nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba tsit+ta u pa ta ya mi/ de nyid brtan par bya ba'i slad du slob dpon gyis rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa snying gar gtugs te/ cha su re te sa(73na〉ba ye sa/ sirnyi badz+ra ya thā su kho/ zhes brjod/ bla mas/bcom ldan ye shes dbang gi bdag /rta mgrin dkyil 'khor dgongs su gsol/ /thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /slob ma 'di la byin brlab mdzod/ /ces lha la gsol ba gdab cing gnang ba zhu/rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa dang ye shes 'bebs pa'i ched du slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ yig ṣi zhig na 'byung bzhi ri rab zhal yas khang dang bcas pa bskyed par bshad kyang ye shes 'bebs pas med pa 'thad dam snyam cho ga gsum gyis gtso bo mngon rtogs bzhin bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ spyi bor yang bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i rta mgrin mngon rtogs brjod de bsgom du gzhug /'phags pa'i sku las 'od zer dmar po rab tu 'bar ba'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byung ste khyed rang gi spyi bo dang mgrin pa dang snying gar zhugs pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad bya sgro la me sna sa pa ltar chom chom bsregs te lus kyi nang thams cad 'od zer dmar pos gang ba'i mos pa mdzod la snying gi dbus su zla ba'i steng du hūṃ dmar po thig le sgra dang bcas pa la sems gtod/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed gnyis dzi'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus pa dang rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rta mgrin gyi lha tshogs kha char bu yug 'tshub pa lta bu byon nas —434

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ 6)lus la thim par bsams te/ badz+ra a be sha ya a āḥ zhes brjod/ de nas spyi bo'i 'phags pa slob ma la thim pas sngar las kyang ches gsal ba'i skur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje mgo bor bzhag la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brtan par bya/ pra byu badz+ra ho zhes rjes zlos dang bcas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la me tog dor du gzhug /oṃ pra ti gra hā sto me sa stu ma hā ba la/ zhes me (73ba)tog phreng ba'i dbang bskur/he badz+ra pā shu/ zhes gdong g.yogs 'grol zhing rten brten pa'i lhar mngon rtogs bzhin bstan/ rdo rje snying gar bzung nas/ bla na med pa yang dag gi /bu khyod sangs rgyas rigs las skyes/ /rta mchog dbang gi ye shes 'di/ /bu khyod dag la gnas par gyur/ /bu khyod dbang gi dkyil 'bor du/ /mosapa'i sems kyis 'jug par gyis/ /dam tshig chen po bsrung bar gyis/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i ye shes gang / /de 'dir dngos grub mchog tu gsungs/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /slob dpon nga yi bka' ma 'da'/ /sdom pa la ni gnas par gyis/ /zhes gdams so/ /gnyis pa zhugs thal dbang bskur ba bum pa/ cod pan/ lha sngags dngos grub bsgrub pa/ thugasakyi rjes gnang sbyin pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang tha mi dad du gsal ba'i thugs ga'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rigs lnga yum sems dpa'/ khro bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ chu gnyis nyer spyod kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sprad/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ste/ khamasagasum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum pa'i/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ pad+ma ka la sha a bhi ṇiñtsa hrīḥ o badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṇiñtsa hūṃ/ /oṃ rat+na ka la sha a bhi ṇiñtsa lhaḥ o bzhi ka la sha a bhi ṣañtsa oṃ/ oṃ ga me ka la sha a bhi ṣañtsa aḥ(74na tshe zhes dbang bskur bas 'od dpag med la sogs pa rigs lnga'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags la sogs nga/'i dri ma lnga sbyangs/ 'du shes la 435

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63) sogs pa'i phung po lnga gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa la sogs pa'i ye shes lnga mngon du byed pa'i nus pa bzhag 'od dpag med la sogs pa'i rigs lnga dang de'i rigs kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang bar bya/ zhes dag pa brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na kū la mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣañtsa mo/ zhes dbu brgyan bskon/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs kyis dbang bskur bas lus gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor 'od dpag med/ dpral bar mi bskyod pa/ ltag g.yas par rin 'byung /ltag par rnam snang / rna ltag g.yon par don grub kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ slob ma la chu gnyis nyer spyod kyis mchod cing shis pa brjod/ gsum pa lha sngags dngos grub bsgrub pa'i rjes gnang ni/lag pa g.yas su rdo rje dang g.yon du dril bu yig rnying dang lum ba pa'i der pad ma yod kyang mchog legs pa'i der dril bu byung ba gtso bo'i phyag mtshan gtod pa'i bar bka' mi 'dug pas thabs shes kyi dbang de byas na 'di bzhin 'thad dam snyam/gtad la rdo rje chos su gyur snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi āḥ zhes brjod la dbang bskur/ bla ma slob ma gnyis ka dpal bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs gar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūṃ/ de'i phyi rol du 'bor lo rtsibs bco lnga la nye snying / de'i phyi rol du 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gsum la snying po rnams g.yas skor du 'khod par bsams te phrin las bzhi'i 'od zer spro/ de'i 'khor lo'i 'og tu lha mo bzhi'i sngags rnams gsal gdab/ bla ma'i thugs ga'i sngags rnams zhal nas thon/ slob ma'i sna bug g.yon du (74ba tshe sdugs/thugs spu'i 'khor lo'i yig 'bru la thim par mos shing nye snying / snying po/ shwa na ma bzhi'i sngags kyi rjes zlos thugs dang 'khor lo las sngags gsum gyi rjes slob byed pa yig rnying na yod na'ang deng sang phyag len la mi mdzad/ lan gsum byed du gzhug /slob mas me tog gtor ba dang bcas/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs zhes lan gsum gyis rjes zlos byed/ ji ltar slob dpon rin po che brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams dang / 'phags pa rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo chen po rta mgrin 'khor dang bcas pa dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang khro bo dang pho nya dang mngag gzhug —436

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ 6)dang mngag gzhug ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi mchog brnyes pa bzhin du rigs kyi bu 'di'i rgyud la'ang stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis su med par rig pa dang sngags kyi grub pa'i yon tan mtha' dag gi nus ldan dam pa mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor/ bzhi pa thugs yig cha gsar rnying phal cher na mi snang yang thugs kyi rjes gnang spyi 'gro ltar 'thad ces mdzad la cung zad rgya bsdus snang g.yig rnying gi rjes su 'brangs so/ /kyi rjes gnang ni/ dpon slob gnyis ga'i thugs gar rta mgrin mtshon gang ba'i gdan gyi 'og tu lha mo bzhi gsal btab pa'i rta mgrin gyi thugs gar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūṃ yig dmar nag yi ge lnga'i ngo bo dang bcas pa mos/ rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya dang bcas thugs ga'i ye shes sems dpa' dang ting 'dzin sems dpa' las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du slob ma'i snying gar thim par bsams te/ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥzhes pa'i mthar rol mo dang bcas snying po'i rjes su / oṃ badz+ra a be sha ya a āḥ rdo rje snying gar bzhag ste/ bcom ldan rta mgrin deng khyod nyid/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul (75na〉sna gi smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /zhes brjod/ rdo rje gnas bdun du bzhag ste/ slob ma'i spyi bor hūṃ dmar nag gsal btab pa las lus thams cad rdo rje'i go khrab kyis gtams par bsams la/ oṃ tsu zhes bsrung ba bya/ dam tshig bsdus te khas blangs/ maṇ+ḍal dbul/ deng nas brtsams te sogs dang / dge ba bsngo'o/ /gsum pa mjug ni/ gtang rag gi mchod bstod/ yig brgya sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang / med na gshegs su gsol/ bsngo ba smon lam dang bkra shis pa'i me rtag sil ma phyogs kun tu khyab par bya'o/ /bya rgyud pad+ma'i rigs kyi khro bo'o rgyal/ /rgya gar mkhas pa'i man ngag a ti sha'i/ /thugs bcud rta mgrin shwa na bzhi skor zhes/ /snyan gragasaphyogs bral bu mo'i rna lung mdzes/ /'on te byis pa nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon la/ /sbar mos bsnyeg ltar ming tsam la chen 'khrul/ /la las sgrub brgya'i rjes gnang kha bsgyur nas/ /gzhan 'drid 'phyon ma'i zlos gar ci yang rtsen/ /'di ko bka' gdams bstan pa 'byung ba'i khungs/ /dbu ru lo dgon spyan snga —437—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)mang byon gyi/ /zhal lung nyams pa med pa'i drod po che/ khyab bdag bla ma dam pa'i drin las rnyed/ /brgyud rim ma chad rjes gnang bka' ma nub/ /yig rnying khungs bcol gzhan gyi rgyas bkab med/ /gong ma'i phyag bzhes zhun thar yongs bcad pas/ /yid ches gsum dang ldan snyam yi ger bstengs/ /dge des bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gdon gyi tshogs/ /snang stong rten cing 'brel 'byung khro rgyal gyis/ /drungs phyung mya ngan 'das pa'i khang bzang du/ /lus can mtha' dag ngal gsor spyod gyur cig /ces mnyam med jo bo chen po di paṃ ka ra'i yi dam rta mgrin shwa na bzhi skor gyi sgrub thabs dang (75ba)rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan 'di ni dpal ldan bla ma khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo rin chen bsod nams mchog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rtsoms shig par gsung gis bskul ba dang du blangs nas rtsa ba'i yig rnying / she'u lo tsā ba kun dga' chos grags bco brgyad chos rje/ mchog legs rdo rje gsum gyi yig cha sogs khungs thub la gzhi byas brgyud ldan bla ma'i phyag bzhes kyis brgyan te kun dga'i lo gro bzhin can gyi gral tshes la za hor gyi brnyes pho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis so/ /bla ma bde gshegs sogs kyis skyabs sems byas la/ chos nyid 'dzin med stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /pad+ma nyi zla ru tra bsnol ba'i steng / /rang sems hūṃ gyur dregs pa tshar gcod sku/ /phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje mkha' la 'phyar/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub rtse la sdig pa 'gyed/ /dur khrod chas rdzogs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bzhugs/ /'jam dpal rta mgrin phyag rdor rnal 'byor ma/ /gnas bzhir yongs gsal ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /yak+ṣa me sbal tsha tsha skar ltar 'phros/ /lha tshogs thams cad bskal ba dus mtha'i me/ /'ur 'ur chem chem 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs/ /gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par gyur/ /sngon bskal mas spyan drangs/ rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tsho gis la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /nyams chags nyes lhung ma lus bshags/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /phyag rdor gyi thugs ga'i hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba la dmigs nas bzlas pa dang /—438

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ 6)bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas gdab bo/ /sangs rgyas chos tsho gos kyi skyabs sems sngon du btang nas su bhā was sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las pad (76na)zla'i steng du rang sems khyuḥdamar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po longs sku'i cha lugs can mnyam gzhag gi steng na tshe'i bum pa 'dzin pa/rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugasagar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥ& baṃ hos bstim/ yang 'od 'phros dbang lha gong bzhin spyan drangs/ bdag la dbang bskur bstsol zhes gsol ba btab pas ma sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣi ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/oṃ a pa ri mi ta ā ga na sa pa ri wā ra a lha nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥ& gis nang mchod dbul/ 'jig rten 'dren pas bstod/ thugs ka'i zla gdan la gyi'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ tshe bcud rnams bsdus par bsams te gzungs ring thung ci nus bzla/ mthar dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab bo/ /zhes pa'ang zur khang khyo shug gnyis kyis nan gyis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /na ma pa ra ha ye la lī tā ya/ khyod zhal mthong ba'i mod la bdud sde'i dmag /stabs cig lag cha 'tshor ba'i khro bo'i rgyal/ /rta mchog rol la nye bar bsnyen pa'i sgra/ /phyogs bral rna ba'i bcud du ches cher dngar/ /'on te rgya gar mkhas pa bde 'byung dang / /bod yul grub brnyes skyer sgang dgongs pa'i gnad/ /ma rtogs rang bzor spyod pa'i chu 'dzin gyis/ /zhabrul med don gyi nyi 'od bsgribs pas nongs/ /(76bsko mo gong ri sangs rgyas dbang chen gyi/ /gter byon dam pa'i drin las legs thosapa/ khog ser tsan dan ngad dang spang spos dri/ /dbye ba'i dpyod ldan tsho gos rnams dang du longs/ /de'ang o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam bha bas rje 'bangs nyer lnga dpal sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du smin par mdzad pa'i pad+ma gsung gi skor la rta mchog rol pa/ bde gshegs 'dus —439

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)pa/ gsang ba 'dus pa/ pad+ma dbang chen/ bdud rtsi thigs pa sogs mang du yod pa rnams kyi nang nas shin tu zab pa rta mchog rol pa gsang sgrub kyi skor ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus su gdon bgegs 'byung po'i gnyen por zab gter du sbas pa snye mo rgya gong ri ba sangs rgyas dbang chen gyis spyan drangs thang yig tu 'byung ba'i snye mo gzhu yas gnod sbyin 'bar yang 'di'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs su bzhed pa yod cing / gang ltar zab gter gdan drangs pa dang dus mtshungs su dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi chig brgyud rdo rje'i rgyas btab rin chen sna bdun du grags pa'i lnga pa dbon ston skyer sgang ba chen pos shing pho rta lo dgun zla ra ba'i tshes bcu bdun gyi tho rengs mnal lam bzung nas slob dpon chen po'i drung du byon pa na sde brgyad spyi dang khyad par rgyal bsen gyi gnyen por gyur pa'i gdams pa zhus pa bzhin gnang ba dang gter ston la sna(ga ser chig brgyud kyang gsan pa'i bka' gter zung 'jug skyer sgang lugs su grags pa 'di nyid rgyal gdon la phan no zhes pa'i snyan grags kyis yid drangs te rma khar khyi tshil gyi dpe ltar sa dge jo zhal dwags shangs bo lcags sogs grub mtha' thams cad la rlung ltar grags gzhas yig cha'ang mang du 'dug pa phal cher gter gzhung ma gzigs pa'i gsar ma'i mngon rtogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs pa mang zhing thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos (77nasgo dzad pa'i sgrub thabs gnyis gter gzhud la thugs gzhig chug pa'i rnam dpyod che na'ang gnyis gar sa bon las bskyed pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i der ye shes pa spyan drang pa dgug bstim mchod bstod byed par gsungs pa 'di nyid theg pa rim pa dgu las bskyed pa ma hā yo gar gtogs pas mi 'gal mod/ 'on kyang sngags rnying ma'i skabs su phyogs ma hā yo gar gtogs kyang nyams len a ti yo ga ltar byed pa du ma byung zhing rdzogs chen gyi dus sa bon las ma bskyed pa'i phyogs mang ba dang spyan 'dren gyis mtshon pa yod med sna tshogs kyang ye shes pa gdod ma nas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dbang du bgyis te spyan 'dren sogs kyi spros pa med pa du ma 'byung bas gter gzhung gi dgongs pa ltar lha nye bar bsnyen pa'i sgrub —440

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ thenathabs ngag 'don du bya ba la/ gzhung du mi gsal yang don la dgos pa gzhir bcas shing sems bskyed bris choge mi 'dug pas spos nas pa skyabs 'gro ni/ bdag dang mkha' mnyams sems can ma lus pa/ /khyab bdag kun bzang go 'phang ma thob par/ /dkon mchog 'dus pa'i bdag nyid rtsa ba gsum/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /lan gsum mam bdun sogs ji ltar rigs pa bya/ sems bskyed ni/ mtha' med mar gyur drin can 'gro ba kun/ /bla ma sangs rgyas sa la 'god pa'i ched/ /dbang chen rta mchog rol pa bsnyen pa'i thabs/ /zab mo'i sgrub pa nyams su blang bar bgyi/ /lan gsum gyisargyud dag par byas la/ dngos gzhi ni/ chos thams cad ngo bo ka nas dag pa spros pa'i mtha' lasa'adas pa skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i rang bzhin lhun grub 'du ma byas pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku gdangs 'gag pa med pa thugs rje sprul ba'i sku chu las nya ldang ba lta (77ba)bu'i tshul du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rang gi rig pa bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa pad+ma ra ga'i lhun po la nyi ma 'bum gyis 'khyud pa ltar dmar zhing 'tsher ba gzhal gsum phyag drug pa/ g.yas 'kha ljang gu /g.yon zhal dkar po/ dbus zhal dmar po/ zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu bgrad pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba rnon po bzhi gtsigasapa/ ljags 'dril zhing ha ha dang hūṃ hūṃ dang phaṭa phaṭa kyi sgra chen po 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dbu skra kham ser gyen du rdzes pa/ dbu re re'i steng na rta mgo ljang nag zhur dkar po phrum phrum ser ba rngog ma dmar po kha gdangs shing rta skad 'tsher ba/ rngog ma'i gseb nas me stag 'phros pas steng tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas 'og dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhir thug gi bar me'i ra gur gyis 'geng ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje/ gnyis pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'i mi mgo sum brtsegs kyi steng rtse gsar mi'i rdo rje'i tshang tu rnying mar rtsa gsum mdzad pa yin gsum gyis mtshan pa/ gsum pa na ral gri'i yu ba rang la bstan pa/g.yon gyis dang pos sdigs mdzub/ /gnyis pa na mdung thung / gsum pa na rgyu ma'i zhags pa bsnamasapa/ glang chen gyi ko rlon dang zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhis stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham —441

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)thabs can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi sor ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bus byugs pa/ mi skra'i tshangs skud dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bzhi bskum zhid g.yon bzhi brkyang pas klu brgyad kyi ngo bo sbrul brgyad brdzis pa/sgeg cing dpa' ba/ 'jigs su rung ba rgod dang gshe dang snying rje rngam pa 'bar khro zhi ba sogs gar dgu'i nyams (78na)dang ldan pa ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'i mgur gyi bum pa nas zhabs kyi long bu yan chad khro chung mtshon gang ba sdang mig tu blta ba/ kha gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ bye phrug phyag sbug tu bcug pa ltar kha bas mig che ba'i khro chung gis gtams pa/ lha thamasacad kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra dang thugs kar sa bo zhe bshad pa byin rlabs kyi bzlas lung skabs dgos kyi 'dir zhal nasa'aphros pas chog pa gter gzhung gi dgongs pa yin pa sngags 'khor gsol ma btab na lha de ngan par song dogs pa'i blo 'tshub langs mi dgos 'od zer yar 'phros/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhing khams khyab/'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la sogs pa'i zag pa med pa'i mchod pas thugs rgyud mnyes/ /byin rlabs rnams tshur 'dus bdag la thim pas sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad thams cad spangs/ yi dam gyi lha dngos dang khyad par med pa'i nus pa thob/ sngags kyi sgra dang 'od zer mar 'phros/ mnar med sogs ngan song gsum dang bde 'gro'i sems can rnams la phog /tsha grang btso sreg bkres skom glen lkugs 'gyur ba dang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal thams cad sbyangs te bde ba la bkod/ ba spu nyag ma re'i rtsa ba na rta mgrin dpag tu med pa dang sngags kyi sgra dang 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal 'gong dam sri sogs gnod byed sde brgyad 'byung po byad ma rbod gtong dang bcas par phog mgar gyi sol mal du rtsa sbur babs pa bzhin gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad rang srog rang gis bcad pa ltar skrag dngangs rengs brgyal te thal bar bun bun song / lhag ma rnams kyang stong gsum gyi 'jig rten du'ang bsdad pa'i dbang med par brlag par bsams la/ oṃ khyiḥl la badz+ra byed pa dang 'ga' zhig tu gyi dang badz+ra gnyis ka med pa'i sna tshogs snang ba gter (78ba/gzhung du 'byin 'jug gi sbas pa ma rtog par yig nag thug phrad du bzhag pa'i log rtog gis nongs 442

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ (tha)so/ /pa dhan+ta kri ta badz+ra kro ta ha ya lji ba hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ces ci nus su bzla/ bsnyen pa song nas rtsa sngags gsham du dbang du bsdu sngags/ ā+o badz+ra du na bh+yo/ tri ga nan/ dzaḥdzaḥs ma ya sdo/ las sngags/sam ya dzaḥ sam ya bzlog /sam ya sa/ sam ya gtubs/ sam ya byer/ sam ya rbad/ sam ya rba ra rbud phaṭa ya/ 'byung po mā ra ya dza dzaḥrnams spel nas nyer gcig bzla/ mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas lhar langs te/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag sogs bsngo smon shis brjod bya/ rgyan gyi nyams len la gtor ma 'bul mi dgos shing bsnyen pa la dgos pa'i gsal kha ma byung yang dbang chog tu spyan 'dren mchod bstod bshad pa'i shugs la don gyis thob pas bris 'bur gyi rten dang sgrub gtor rta mgo can bkod pa'i mdun du rtsa ba gsum dang gzhi bdag gtor ma/ sman raka bsham/ bdag bskyed kyi sgrub thabs 'don pa'i dus mdun bskyed gsal 'debs pa'i mdo tsam blos ma lcogs na thun mtshams su/ mchod rdzas brlab pa ni/ gyi dam tshig gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /dngos wor yid sprul mchod pa'i tshogs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rnams/ /thugs dam bskong phyir 'bul gyis bzhes/ /oṃ badz+ra pur+sha āḥ& nas sha rdi'i bar dang / 'di dang sbyan 'dren mgo 'bul rnams rang ga du migasalapa ra tso rta mgrin gsang 'dus nas blangs/ ā+oṃ āḥ/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ hri ṭha/ ā+oṃ āḥ& ma hā pa la ta hūṃ hri ṭha/ ā+oṃ ā hūṃ ma hā rak+ta hūṃ hri ṭha/ lan gsum re brjod/ mdun bskyed kyi rten rnams bdag bskyed ltar gsal gdab/ spyan drang ba ni/ gyi dam tshig chen po'i dus la bde/ /bde chen dbang (79na khrog rol pa yi/ /bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar klong nas/ /dbang gi rgyal po gshegs su gsol/ ā+oṃ ha ya sgyi wa e bye hi dzaḥ/ baṃ hos bstim/ bzhugs gsol ni/ 〉 spros bral bde chen gzhal yas dam pa 'dir//rten dang gnyis med ngang du sgrub slad du/ /dregs pa 'joms shing srin po 'dul ba'i lha/ /rngam brjid 'gying ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ ha ya snro wa sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ phyag ni/ a ti pa ho pra byu ho a la la lho nyer spyod phyi nang 'bul ba ni/ smiḥdabang chen gsang ba'i dkyil 'bor du/ /bdug spos me tog mar me dri/ /zhal yas la snyan mchod pa'i sprin/ /snang srid mchod par 'bul gyis—443

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bzhes//chabadz+ra chu nas shabha pra titsā swā hā/gyi dbang chen gsang ba'i lha tsho gos la//dbang po sna lnga'i me tog dang //gsur wo bdug spos dri yis ma rdzo//tso — snang gsal mar me dang //rdo rje dri chu thog pas ma rdzo//bdud rtsi dri wo zhal zas dang //rkang gling thod pa'i rnga sgras ma rdzo//dug gsum sku gsung thugs gsum dang //dus lnga ye shes lnga ru mchod//snang srid phyag rgya bzhi ru mchod//ma hā pañtsa pā dza hosman gtor rat+na 'bul ba ni/gyi rtsa brgyad star sbyar bdud rtsis mṛ ta//dug lnga gnas gyur ye shes sgrub pa'i rdzas//ro mkho yon to kun dang ldan pa 'di//ga i wo ma rdzo do 'gro ba'i don du bgo//sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūṃ lha'i/chos sku snang mtha' longs sku pad+ma dbang //sprul sku pad 'byung gter ston gong ri ba//chos kyi seng ge gto ston 0 po la//rtsa brgyad steng sbyar bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul//sarba par//chos rje 79bston pa gtsang ma shangs ston dang //rgyal mtshan 'bum pa khyung po tshul khrims mgon//sangs rgyas seng ge sangs rgyas rdo rje las//thar pa dpal bzang sangs rgyas rnam rgyal rje//tshar chen kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse dbang rab zhabs//bka' 'gyur ba dang bsod nams mchog grub la mo'i//slar yang khyung po tshul khrims mgon po'i zhabs//thugs rje chos rgyal don yod rgyal mtshan dpal//kun dga' rgyal mtshan dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i sder mo//chos rje yon mchog bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dpal//gye re lha bas dpal wor lhun grub rje//chos dbyings rang grol rtsa ba'i bla ma la sko//dbang drag khro rgyal rta mchog rol ba'i lha//ma dang mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong tshogs//gter gyi srung ma yul lha gzhi bdag la'i//hrīḥphyi nang dam rdzas gsang ba'i gtor chen po//snang srid gzhi bzhengasa'adod yon ro mchog spus/kha khrag dmar dang zhag gi sprin du gtibs//dbang chen rta mchog zhal du rol zhing bzhes//gtor brlab rgyud sdo'og ma ltar dang 'bul sngags zur yangs pa'i yig cas su snang bag khog yigidagongs par ma ma' ma hā bha lin+ta khā hi/khyoḥdug gsum rtsad gcod dgra bgegs bsgral//'khor 'das mnyam rdzogs bhan+ta ra 'khyil//dug lnga gnas su gzhom pa'i phyir//dbang chen rta mchog zhal du 'bul//ma hā rak+ta ko ni ri ti ji hi/bstod pa ni/khyi/rgyal ba tso gyi chos sku pad+ma'i gdung //chos rje 'od dpag 444

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ 6)med pa rdo rje chos/ /spyan ras gzigs sprul hrīḥlas rngam chen sprul/ /rta mgrin rta skad bzhed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang chen kun 'dus dbang gi rgyal po ste/ /dbang gi mdog dmar bskal pa'i me 'dra la/ /dbang chen rngam brjid nyi ma 'bum gyi (80na)gzhi/ /dbang mdzad dbang gi sku la phyag 'tshal lo//thugs rje byams pa'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /las ngan gdug pa'i sems can sgral mdzad pa/ /zhe sdang gtum khro dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar/ /rngam brjid 'gying pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhi bdag la gtor ma bsngo/ /tshogs bya bar 'dod na yang gsang dang gsang 'dus sogs nas blangs pas 'grub cing / /tsho gos phud dang po slob dpon pad+ma/ gnyis pa yi dam/ gsum pa chos skyong / bzhi pa gzhi bdag /lnga pa gnod byed rnams la 'bul bar dmigs bsal du bshad/ mtshams grol khar dngosagrub blang ba bshags pa/ rten la brtan bzhugs smon lam shis brjod bya'o/ /rgyal kun gsung gi rdo rje snang mtha' yas/ /mi bzad bgegs dpung mthar byed rta mchog gi /gdams pa'i rin chen gling bgrod tshong phrug phal/ /log rtog mching bu'i khres kyis gcig tu ngal/ /o rgyan mkhan po'i bzhed gzhung bcu drug cha/ /yongs gang gzur gnas kun+da 'dzum pa'i tshe/ /'gal dum spel ba'i yig nag chu nang gzugs/ /zla bar 'dzin rnams byis pa'i blo gros bzhin/ /de phyir nyams len khyer bde kun tshang ba'i//tshig gi srad bur brgyus pa'i pad rag phreng / shes ldan mgul pa'i rgyan du spud pa'i dges/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal gyur cig /de'ang snga thog phyogs 'di la 'dris pa chung dus drung yig ngag dbang dge legs dang sngags rams pa blo bzang don grub gnyis kyis bskul ma byung tshe brag sna chos rjes g.yas zhal dkar ba dang gshog pa yod pa sogs 'grig 'grig mang po gleng ba tshad mar zung ba'i g.yar khral zhig bgyis pa dpyod ldan (80bsgoms khrel 'das kyi rgyu las ma mchis nye lam sgrub thabs pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba zhes pa 'di ni drung yig dar rgyas bkra shis kyis gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang bcas bskul zhing dge slong yon tan dpal bzang dang sngags rams pa blo bzang chos ldan/dgon ka ba blo bzang don ldan rnams kyis dgos tshul rim par byung ba dang / ging chen tshangs pa'i sku —445

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)khog dbang 'dus rgyal pos gser srang gang sogs kyi skyes dang bcas bskul ba ltar dpyad shin tu bzod pa'i lugs su byas pa mon pa gro ba'i rdor gcod du 'gro shas che'ang theg dgu'i rnam gzhag mkhyen pa rnams kyis ma 'phya ba rgyu mtshan du byas te yongs 'dzin dam pa chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i bka' drin las chos tshul 'di la blo mig yangs pa za hor gyi sngags btsun che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyis me 'brug chu stod kyis nya ba bden pa bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen gyi nyin sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam grags pa'o/ /na mo ba dzñā yu ṅgā ya/ gang zhig zhabs sen dmar ba'i rdul/ /spyi bor lhung ba'i mod nyid la/ /ngan 'gro las ldog mi 'khrugs pa'i/ /sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim pa 'dri/ /de'ang bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'brugs pa lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor rnal 'byor rgyud du bkral ba dang / lha dgu bya rgyud du gtogs pa gnyis gar dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i mngon dkyil gyi rnam gzhag yod la/ 'dir jo bo chen po mar me mdzad nas nye bar brgyud de dpal snar thang ba'i bka' srol las byung ba'i gtso rkyang gi mngon par rtogs pa nyams su bstar ba la skyabs sems spyi ltar ram bsdu na/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma bya/ tshogs zhing ni/ rang rdo rje mi 'khrugs par gsal ba'i thugs kar zla gdan (81na〉pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru saḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ak+ṣa saḥmaṇ+ḍa le saḥs phyag bya/ oṃ badz+ra a khyo saḥ.a: pra tits+tsha swāhā/pā rdu nas sha rdi'i bar gyis mchod/ gur las byung ba'i rgyun bshags dang tshad med bzhi bsgom/ su bhā bas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig mthing shun gyi mdog lta bu de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can rnams ngan 'gror skye ba'i rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa'i tshogs dang khyad par rang gi lus rnam smin sha khrag rdos bcas kyi phung po dang sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus —446

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ thenayongs su gyur pa las rang gi sems kyi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'byugs pa sku mdog in+d+ra nī la'i mdog ltar sngo ba/ dbu'i gtsug tor dang na bza' chos gos dmar po sogs sprul pa'i sku'i cha lugs can/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i spyan gnyis 'gro la gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil mo krung gis pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi zhakhrugs pa'i ye shes pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza yis spyan drangs/ gong gi phyag mchod byed cing / bstod pa ni/ chos nyid mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos kyang / /thugs rjes rtag tu mya ngan mi g.yo bar/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don bsgrub lhur mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan mi gzugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje (81ba)mi zhabrugs pas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ dzaḥ& baṃ lho3sa gnyisasu med par bstim/ yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs oṃ pañtsa kū la sa pa ri wā ra a lha nas sha sna' bar gyis mchod/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni zhes sogs kyi mthar oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhid bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ /mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan pa'i zla gdan la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ kai ka ni kai ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/hre ṭa ni hro ṭa ni/ tru sa ni tru sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba ga rma pa raṃ pa rā ṇi me sarba sa tā na lha tsa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng klog pa'i tshul lam/ zhal nas thon te lte ba nas zhugs sku'i dbyibs brgyud mgal me 'khor ba ltar dmigs nas bzlas pa ci nus su bya/ yi ge brgya pas byin rlabs brtan par bya/rang nyid ltar gsal ba'i gdan pad zla nas yar 'od du zhu/ sku'i stod nas mar 'od du zhu thugs dzi'i zla gdan sngags 'khor dang bcas pa la thim/ de nyid hūṃ la thim/ de'i zhabs kyu ha la/ ha ha'i mgo bo —447

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ thig le nā da la/ nā da yang mi dmigs par bsam/ de lasalangs te lhar gsal bas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /mi 'khrugs rgyal po 'grub gyur nas/ /zhes sogs kyi smon lam shis brjod bya'o/ /snar thar brgya rtsa'i nang tshan rdo rje mi 'brugs pa gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs ngan 'gro kun khebs zhes pa 'di ni sngags ban ngag dbang rgya mtshos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bsdos sbyar ba'i yi (82na)ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /su sti/ bde gshegs gtsug tor las zhabrungs lha mo'i tshul/ /zhab sen dmar 'od spyi bor bkod pa'i mod/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal byed gdugs dkar mo'i/ /sgrub thabs 'jigs med 'byung gnas bzhed srol 'dri/ de la 'dir jo bo gdugs dkar mo'i mngon par rtogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang gtso rkyang la brten pa'i zur bka' dang spyi bka'i rnam grangs mang ba las/ rdo rje gdan gyi ma hā bo lha'i gnang ba rjes su thob nas slob dpon chen po a bha yā ka ras sgrub thabs nyis brgya dang zhe gnyis gsungs pa'i nang tshan gzhan gyis mi thub ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo'i rnal 'byor la/skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas/ rang skad cig gis g.yin gyis mi thub pa'i gtsug tor gdugs dkar mor gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das gzhan gyis mi thub ma la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas dbu brgyan par sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/oṃ badz+ra puspro āḥ/ nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ gur las 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum dang tshad med bzhi bsgom/ shu n+ya ༷sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems ma dkar po las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du rang nyid gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i gdugs dkar mo can sku mdog dkar mo dkar sngo dmar po'i zhal gsum zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra gnag snum ral pa'i thor tshugs lhag ma'i lan bu cung zad 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas thar rtse ba'i gsal sgron du g.yas gsum 'khor lo mda' lcags kyu/ g.yon gsum rdo rje gzhu zhags pa 'dzin pa/—448

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum 'u myo// (thadabargya rtsa dang mthun pa byung bas dngos bstan dang dgongs pa 'grel (82ba/rugs kyi khyad par yin nam snyam/ gsum na 'khor lo lcags kyu gzhu/ g.yon gsum na rdo rje mda' zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub can/ /rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ se mo do/ do shal/ phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu/ 'og pag ga rin po che'i rgyan dang / dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs gsol ba/ khros pa'i lta stangs kyis sa 'og gi gdon thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa/ zhabs skyil mo krung gis 'od dang 'od zer 'phro ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ /mgrin par āḥdamar po/ /thugs kar hrī sngon po/ /de'i steng du zla ba la oṃ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i yi ge pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥlha baṃ spos gnyis su med par bstim/ yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ de bzhin
