gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ zhes dbang bskur bas lus gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ nyer spyod dang rol mos mchode/ hūṃ/ bde gshegasathugs rje'i gtsug tor las zhabrungs shing / /bde 'byung bstan la gnod byed phyir bzlog pa/ /bde gshegs 'bras bu nyer bar stsol mdzad pa'i/ /bde mchog gdugs dkar can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod/ thugs kur zla gdan la oṃ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar dmigs te/oṃ si ta ta pa tre/ a pa ra mi ta sarba gra ha na/ tru sa ya tru sa ya/ ha na ha na/ nai ju/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā zhes bzla/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ dge ba (83na 'di yis myur du bdag /ces sogs kyi smon lam dang shis brjod ci rigs bya'o/ /dran pa'i mod la nyes brgya'i smag gi rum/ /mthar byed bcom ldan gdugs dkar rta bdun pas/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du mgon mdzad nas/ /srid zhi'i phun tshogs snang ba 'bar bar shog /de ltar bcom ldan 'das gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i sgrub —449

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)thabs rdo rje pha lam zhes pa 'di ni bya nag rigs kyi thig le paṇa chen dkon mchog chos grags dang /gsung gling dka' bcu rgyal mtshan dar rgyas gnyis kyis bskul ma byung ba bzhin sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rgya gzhung thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyi gsung rab kyi dgongs don ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /na mo gu ru tho gu tho pa ta ye/ grangs med rgyal ba'i gsang ba kun gyi mdzod/ /'dzin mdzad lag na rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid/ /khyab bdag bla ma'i zhabs rdul gtsug bsten nas/ /sgrub thabs dngos grub 'dod pa rnam par 'jo/ /de la 'dir dpal gsang ba'i bdag po gos sngon can gyi rnal 'byor nyams su blang ba ni/ /dben pa'i gnas su bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs dang ldan pa'i ngang nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba bya/ rang skad cig gis phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros bla ma dang dpal phyag na rdo rje'i lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru saḥ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid sogs dang / phyag na rdo rje stobs po che/ /gas po drag po rdo rje'i sku/ /mi bzad nam mkha'i mdog 'dra ba/ /'joms mdzad khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes phyag bya/ /oṃ ni le wa ra (83bci ra badz+ra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra a lha nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyun bshags bya zhing tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shā n+ya tus sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hrīḥlas pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid yi ge hūṃ sngon po de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros/'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad dpal phyag na rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongasasu gyur pa las rang nyid dpal phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas sa ser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa mkha' la 'phyar bas steng gdon rnams skrag par byed pa/ g.yon thugs gar —450

rta mgrin shā na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ 6)sdigs mdzub mdzad pas 'og gdon rnams 'jigs par byed pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa smin ma dang sma ra dang dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang pas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dbral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ/ thugasagar hūṃ/ thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/a lha nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥs bstim/ slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ a: nas shabha'i bar gyis mchode/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣañtsa tu / / zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang / sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa (84na〉skrul sku'i cha lugs can gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ tshogs zhing ltar mchod/hūṃ/ bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon po/ /klu chen brgyad kyis sku la brgyan/ /zhe sdang can ni 'joms pa'i rtags/ /nyon mongs spangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag na rdo rje stobs po che/ /rdo rje lan gsum gsor ba yis/ /gnod sbyin drag po 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /gnod sbyin gos sngon phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa de'i lte bar yi ge hūṃ sngon po/ /de'i mtha' skor du/ oṃ ni la wa ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa kyis bskor ba la dmigs nas ma yengs par ci 'grub bzlas/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na khungs btsun gyi yi ge gzhan las shes par bya zhing / bdag bskyed kyi rnal 'byor la ma byas kyang chad lhag tu mi 'gro bsam spros/ thun mtshams su gong ltar mchod bstod bya/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis chad lhag kha bkang / ma 'byor ba sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ rang nyid dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis/ 'gro la phan bde ma lus bskyang ba'i rgyu/ /thub bstan skyon med yun ring gnas pa dang / /de 'dzin gang zag tshogs rnams chos 'phel—451 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)zhing / /chos kyi bar chad ma lus zhi bar shog khres dang gzhan yang bsngo ba smon lam ci rigs pa bya'o/ /phyag na rdo rje 'bar ba'i che ba brgyad/ /ma rtogs gsang bdag ming tsam la 'brel ba'i/ /mngon rtogasabyed po phal cher grags skam gyi/ /mun pa'i khung bur spyod mod bde bar nyal/ /phyogs 'dir gzhan dring mi 'jog rdo rje 'chang / /rnam gsum spyos rdul gtsug tu yongs bsnyen mthus/ khung zad smra ba'i mgrin pa gzengs mtho ba/ /za hor rigs kyi bhu su ku yis bkod/ /bsod nams phung po ri bo ltar brtsegs(84ba)pa'i/ /lci bas yid srub gser ldan rngul ba'i rgyun/ /'bab byed gsang bdag gar dgu'i rol gar gyis/ /'jig rten kun tu khyab pa'i dpal 'bar shog /ces dpal phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi sgrub thabs dngos grub 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba 'di ni chen po hor gyi rgyal khams su zhwa ser cod paṇa 'chang ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i gsal byed co ni chos rje blo bzang nyi mas don gnyer chen pos bskul ba la brten nas khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po'i gsung rab kyi dgongs don bzhin za hor gyi ban+de 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis me sbrul po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dag legs so/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rgyun gyi rnal 'byor du byed na/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs mas skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ su bhā was sbyangs/ 'khor 'das chos kun stong pa nyid kyi ngang / /pad dkar 'dab brgyad zla ba nya gang steng / /dngul chu'i mdog ltar 'tsher ba'i hūṃ yig las/ /'od 'phros don gnyis byas nas tshur 'dus hūṃ/ /yongs gyur bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' che/ /dwangs shel ltar gsal gangs kyi ri bo la/ /nyi mas khyab 'dra'i rab dkar gzi mdangs can/ /zhal ga ṇi ga phyag gnyis dgyes 'dzum zhi ba'i nyams/ /'gro la rjes chags gzigs pa'i spyan dkyus can/ /smin ma'i nags klung 'byug cing mchu yi sgros/ /rab dmar snyan gshog rgyas shing shangs dkyus ring / /dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag thor tshugs mdzes/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga thugs gar 'dzin/ /g.yon pa dri pa bu dku yi g.yon phyogs 'dzin/ /brog zhu rgyan cha mgur chu dpung pa'i rgyan/ /se mo do dang do shal 'og pag dang //—452

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ thenaphyag zhabs gdu bu rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /pañtsa li ga'i stod g.yogs sham thabs gsol/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje (85na〉skyel krung tshul gyis bzhugs/ /thugs gar zla steng hūṃ dkar spu shad mthar/ /yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba las/ /'od 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma yi/ /byin rlabs kun 'dus sa bon sngags phreng la/ /thim zhing de dang sku yi cha rnams nas/ /bdud rtsi 'o ma'i mdog can dpag med babs/ /brag gi steng nas chu bo 'bab pa bzhin/ /spyi bo'i gtsug zhugs lus kun thams cad khyab/ /thog med nas bzung da lta'i bar bsags pa'i/ /sdig pa mi dge'i las ni bgyis so cog khyad par dkor dang srog bcad gnod sems sogs//rgyud la bgos pa'i dri ma mtha' yas pa/ /dud khu snag khrag bshang gci ljan ljin dang / /srog chagasarnam par rkang mthil bshang gci'i lam/ /ba spu'i bu ga kun nas phyir thon te/ /sa 'og tu song rang lusashel ltar gyur/ /zhes pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas yi ge brgya pa ci nus su bzla/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /zhes pa nas 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi'i mthar/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chags dang / /lus ngag yid kyi las bcu la sogs pa/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung las nyon de 'bras kun//lhag med byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab pas bcom ldan 'das/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lta bur 'od du zhu/ /spyi bo nas thim rang gi sems nyid dang / /chu la chu bzhag bzhin du dbyer med gyur/ /zhes pa'i don la mnyam par bzhag pa'i mthar dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gyi rgyas btab bo/ /zhes pa 'di'ang sde pa blo bzang sbyin pa'i nyams len du dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /mar gad 'khri shing bskyod 'dra'i (85ba)phyag sor rtse/ gtsug tu bkod pa'i mod la 'jigs chen brgyad/ /gzhil mdzad rgyal yum seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol/ /mkhyen brtse nus pas byang chub bar du skyongs/ /dpal mnyam med jo bo mar me mdzad yab sras kyi thugs dam gyi nying khu bka' gdams lha bzhir grags pa'i nang mtshan rje btsun sgrol ma gtso 'khor gsum gyi sgom bzlas nyams su blang —453

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)bar byed pa la thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar ram bsdu na sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma sngon du btang nas/ rang nyid rje btsun sgrol mar gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma gtso 'khor gsum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma/ /tu tā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol/ khu res na ba rnams las sgrol/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes phyag bya rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo spros te mchod par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārla tā ra sa pa ri bā ra a: pra titsā ye swā hā/ puṅge āḥ/ nas shabha āḥ& gi bar brjod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum gyi rjes su tshogs zhing rnams rang la bstim/sems can thams cad bde ba dang zhes sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ su bhā bas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du sems kyi ngo bo two yig ljang gu de la 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon ut+pala'i yu ba mtheb srin gyis thug gar 'dzin cing / 'dab ma snyan gyi thad dkar kha bye ba/ bar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis (86na)bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su 'od zer can ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas mya ngan med pa'i shing dang / g.yon me tog ba ku la bsnams pa/ g.yon du khro gnyer can nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin pa/ gnyis rka'ang dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing zhabs phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ gtso 'khor gsum gyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ /mgrin par āXdamar po/ thugs gar hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ku'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sgrol ma gtso 'khor gsum badz+ra sa mā dzaXs spyan drangs/dza:nyu baṃ hoḥs dam tshig pa la bstim/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha sngar bzhin spyan drangs/oṃ pañtsa kū la sa pa ri wā ra a: sogs kyis mchod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la —454

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bsgor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ (thadamangon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo bzhi'i phyag tu bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ zhes dbang bskur bas sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag /ye shes bdud rtsis lus thams cad gang / chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso mo la don yod grub pa dang 'khor gnyis la gtso mo nyid kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ thugs ka nas byung ba'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams te/ a lha puspe nas sha rdi'i bar gyis tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ 'khor ba las sgrol sogs kyis bstod/rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du two yig ljang gu'i mthar yi ge bcu pa dang gzungs sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros sems can gyi don byas par dmigs nas/ oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re swāhā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa sogs dang gzungs ring ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ārla a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwa ya/ (86ba〉ba hā sa tā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ ta du thā/ oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re ma ma bri te sarba du/ na ya/ ji bha le/ lte bha ya/ ma ha ya/ rjo ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba dus dus bha ni tā ra swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol mas bdag sogs sems can thams cad 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug las skyob pa dang / 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral du gsol/ zhesagasol ba gdab/ 'khor gnyis 'od du zhu nas gtso mo la thim par bsams la dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam shis brjod ci rigs pa bya'o/ /snang stong lha skur gsal ba'i ngang nyid las/ /sngags stong bzlas pas yi dam thugs rgyud bskul/ /rig stong spros bral dbyings nas dngos grub kun/ /sgrub thabs dbang gi rgyal po e ma mtshar/ /zhes lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas lugs gnyis kyi khyab pa drung gnas rin po che gsung rab rgya mtshor 'gran bzod pa sde pa blo bzang sbyin pa'i yi dam gyi lha 'phags ma sgrol mar brtag pa babs pa bzhin rgyun khyer gyi mngon par rtogs pa zhig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar/thugs rje zla ba shar pas yid can rnams/ /ngan 'gro'i srid mun mthar byas gdengs can —455

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)tshogs/ /bde skyid kun+da ba 'ad pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /klu dbang rgyal po'i sgrub thabs deng 'dir spel/ /de yang thog mar gtor zlum zhig bshams la chab kyis bran/ a skṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du kho las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa'i 'byung po rnams tshim par nus pa'i byed las khyad par can dang ldan par gyur par bsam/ rang skad cig gis bgegs mthar byed du gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer lcags (87na)gyu lta bu 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bkug par gyur par mos te/ oṃ a kā ra mu kho sarba dharmā r+ṇa ā du nut+pa na tā ta oṃ āḥsnyi phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum gyis bsngos/ oṃ āḥbisnrun+ta kri ta hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas bgegs rnams bskrod par gyur par bsam/ de nas tshad med bzhi'i rtsis zin pa'i sgo nas skyabs 'gro bzhi skor spyi ltar lan gsum brjod/ sems bskyed pa ni/bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas la sems can thams cad kyi rgyud kyi las nyon rnams sbyong zhing / ngan 'gro'i skye gnas dang / klu thams cad klu'i skye gnas las thar ba'i ched du/ bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po bsgom par bgyi'o lan gsum brjod/ /rang tha mal du gnas pa'i snying gar hūṃ be+e ḍūrla 'a mdog lta bu las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis lus kyi nang thams cad khyab pas mun khung du sgron me bteg pa ltar nad gdon sdig sgrib ma lus pa sangs/ rang nyid de bzhin gshegs pa klu dbang gi rgyal po'i skur gyur pa'i snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar de bzhin gshegs pa klu dbang gi rgyal po gtso 'khor lnga la bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ji snyed su dag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod yan gyis phyag bya/ me tog dam pa nas/ rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi zhes pa'i bar dang / oṃ badz+ra puṅge āḥ/ gis me tog thogs pa'i lha mo sngon mo/ /oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥ& gis bdug spos thogs pa'i lha mo ser mo sa badz+ra di pe āḥ& gis mar me thogs pa'i lha mo dmar mo/ /oṃ (87ba ji dz+ra ༷ āḥlha gis ni mchog —456

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ (tha)thogs pa'i lha mo ser mo/ /oṃ badz+ra ni wi du āḥ/ gis zhal zas thogs pa'i lha mo ser mo rnams so sor nam kha' gang ba dang / oṃ sarba bi shwa dha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa hūṃ/ zhes pa las rin po che sna tshogs kyi gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang dril bu dang bla bre la sogs pa dang 'khor los sgyur ba'i rin po che sna bdun gyis mchod par gyur par bsam/ sdig pa bshags pa sogs yan lag lhag ma lnga po/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni zhes sogs dkyus bzhin bya/ tshad med pa bzhi tshig dang bstun nas bsgom/ oṃ su bhā ba shu zlaḥsarba dharmāḥsu bhā ba shud+dhi3nya/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong nyid spros pa dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bur gyur/ stong pa nyid kyi ngang du gnas pas sems can gyi don mi 'grub pa'i phyir spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i dbyings nas sems can rnams la rjes su brtse ba'i gdangs 'gag pa med pa snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa yangs shing rgya che ba de'i steng du chos thams cad mtha' dbus med par ston par byed pa'i yi ge a dkar po 'od du zhu ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i steng du rang gi sems kyi ngo bo yi ge hūṃ mi dmigs pa rin po che'i mdog lta bu las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod klu rnams dang sems can gyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang des bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad dag par byas/ 'od zer tshur 'dus hūṃ la thim la yongs su gyur pa las/ skad cig ma gcig la bcom ldan 'das klu dbang phyug rgyal po sku mdog mi dpogs pa rin po che'i mdog lta bu dri ma med pa'i mkha' ltar dngas shing zhal skyin zla ba ltar dkar ba/ dbu la sprul mgo bdun gdengs pa'i rgyab yol can/ /chos gos ngur smrig (88na gi sol ba/dbu gtsug tor dang ldan pa/ klu thams cad klu'i skye gnas las thar par byed pa dang / sems can ngan 'gro'i skye gnas las thar bar byed pa'i phyag rgya dang ldan pa/ zhal 'dzum bag can mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyis spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis 'od zer gyi dra ba'i khor yug gi dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun du byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam par sel ba sku mdog dkar po rin po —457

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)che'i myu gu phyag g.yas na bsnams pa/ g.yon na bum pa bsnams shing pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' byams pa sku mdog dmar po klu shing gi me tog dang ril ba spyi blugs bsnams pa/ rgyab tu 'jam dpal gzhen nur gyur pa sku mdog gser bco ma'i mdog lta bu la bsnams pa/ g.yon du spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dkar po pad+ma bsnams pa/ bzhi ga'ang bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'o/ /g.yas phyogs su byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dang /g.yon phyogs su dgra bcom pa dpag tu med pa/ 'og gi phyogs su klu'i tshogs dpag tu med pa rin po che thogs pa thal mo sbyar ba gyen du blta bar gyur/ rang gi thugs spu'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bcom ldan 'das klu dbang phyug rgyal po gtso 'khor lha'i rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nā gen+da rā dza sa pa ri wā ra a lha nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa klu'i dbang phyug rgyal pos rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyi rgyud kyi las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad byang zhing skye gnas ngan pa las thar pa dang /klu rnams klu'i skye gnas las thar zhing bde ba phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pas sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen gyis klu'i gdon gyis zin pa'i sems can mtha' dag nad dang sdug bsngal kun las thar (88ba〉bar mdzad nas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dgyes bzhin du zhal gyis bzhes nas dzaḥlha baṃ hoḥs dgug gzhug bcing mnye byas te gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ bzlas pa bya ba ni rang gi thugs rkar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas la mchod pa phul/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i rgyu las dang nyon mongs pas bskyed pa'i 'bras bu 'khor ba spyi dang bye brag gnas ngan len gyi sdug bsngal las thar par byed/ khyad —458

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ (thanapar klu rnams nam mkha' lding dang bye tshan sogs gnod pa sna tshogs kyis gtses nas nyam thag pa dang mthar klu'i skye gnas las thar par byas/ de'i mthus las dang 'phral rkyen gyis klu'i gdon dang dug nad kyis zin pa mtha' dag sdug bsngal de las rnam par grol te bde ba dang ldan par bsams la/ta du thā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bha ga wa nā nā ga rā dze shwa ra a nga na a dhi nyi te swā hā/ zhes 'bum phrag bzlas pas mdze nad dang myong par nges pa'i las thams cad 'dzad par 'gyur ro/ thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na dkar gtor gsum bshams pa chab kyis bran/ a mṛ tas bsangs/swa bhā bas sbyangs/ stong pa'i dang las zlo las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma lha'i zhal zas 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du oṃ āḥ& gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad bkug nas 'bru gsum la thim/ de yang 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥsnyi gis byin gyis brlabs/ cha dang po bcom ldan 'das kyi sngags 'od zer gyi bu gus gsal bar bsams la/ gong gi mtshan sngags kyi mthar a kwa ro btags pa lan gsum gyis dbul/ chu gnyis nyer spyod kyis mchod/ gang gi mtshan tsam dran pas srid zhi yi/ /mi bzad sdug bsngal mtha' dag sel mdzad pa/ klu yi dbang phyug rgyal po gtso 'khor ldan/ /lus ngag yid (89na)gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod/ gnyis pa ni cha gsum gyi cha dang po sor bzhag 'bul/ cha gsum pa ni/ oṃ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu/ /'jog po dang ni stobs kyis rgyu/ /pad+ma pad+ma r+ṣa po dang / dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan no/ /lha mo lha mo r+ṣa po dang / /zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che/ /dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang / /sog ma med dang hu lun+ta/ /dga' bo dang ni nye dga' bo/ /rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang / /tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang / /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che/ /rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang / /gzugs mdzes chen po sprul bzang dang / /lto 'phye chen po tshi li dang / /tshi li chen po rnams dag ni/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ā la ā la ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye sarba bhu baḥsbyo bu swāhā/ ches/pas mdun du —459

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)byon par bsams/ pad+ma ka ma la ye sto gyis gdan phul/ oṃ ma hā nā ga a dhi ba ta ye gro ste rda ji swāhā/ de bzhin du a: gyi gnas su puṅge dhū pe/ dī pe/ ༷ bcug pas mchod/ klu dga' bar byed pa'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ hi li hi li ma hā hi li hūṃ phu swā hā/ zhes se gol gtog pa dang bcas lan gsum dang /oṃ bha k+ṣa ya bha k+ṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha / phu swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyi gtor ma bsngo/ ye dharmā dang / sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes cho so kyi sbyin pa byin/ klu chen brgyad sogs klu rigs thams cad dang / /bye brag bdag cag rnams la gnod byed kun/ /gtor ma 'dis tshim dgyes shing gdug sems zhi/ /phan pa (yob)byang chub sems dang ldan gyur cig /ces smon lam gdab/ oṃ nā ga a dhi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra la zhes pas dkar phyogs : klu rigs rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang / oṃ ga ru ḍa lha sa he tsa le tsa le swā hā/ zhes nag po'i klu rigs rnams bskrad par mos so de nas bcom ldan 'das mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bkang / ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang / zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ badz+ra muḥs gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ bdag bskyed kyi gdan pad zla dang dbu'i gtsug tor gnyis nas rim gyis bsdus te thugs ga'i hūṃ la thim/ de yang mthar nā da'i bar du bsdus te nam mkha' la 'ja' yal pa lta bu'i ngang nas slar yang lha'i skur langs te bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis bya/ bum sgrub bya bar 'dod na lag len logs su shes par bya'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i sgrub thabs 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi gsung rab dang bcom ldan ral gri'i phyag bzhes la khyer bde nag bgros kyi tshul du las dang po pa rnams la phan phyir lcags mo bya lo cho 'phrul gyi zla bar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang po'o/ /na ma spra shu kla smi ra tsakra mnyu shri ye/ zla zhun bye bas nye bar byugs pa shel dkar rdul brtsegs —460

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ 6)khengs 'phrog sku/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis shes byar srid rnams smra la brjod pa rnam dag gsung / /lkog gyur chos rnams gnas lugs gzugs brtan mkhyen rab me long ngos shar thugs/ /gzhen nu'i tshul 'dzin rgyal kun yab cig zur phud lnga pas rtag tu skyongs/ /(90na)bur shing sogs kyi mngar khyad 'byed dka' bzhin/ /'gro ngor brtan pa'i 'khor lo zhi khro'i gar/ /tshad bzung min kyang shes rab snang ba'i gter/ /sbyin mdzad gangs ri'i mdangs phyog 'jam dpal rgyal/ /dkar ba'i mtshan dang bkod pa dpag yas nang / /dgra labs rnam par rgyal bas legs bkral ba/ /ma ti'i lugs che lta/kha che paṇa chen gyi/ /thugs dam rnam bzhi'i nang tshan 'di med byung / /brgyud lugs chu bo brgya phrag gcig 'dus kyang / /grags pa don ldan paṇa chen stag tshang pa'i/ /zhal gzigs rdo rje 'chang dbang tshar pa la /bka' babs 'di ko sngon med legs lam srol/ /rmongs chen smag rum mthar skrod blo gros kyi/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dren byed sgrub pa'i thabs/ /dri bzhen rta ljang rnam dpyod mkhar rgyu tshe/ /lkog gyur shes bya'i mtshan mo da ga re/ 'dir paṇ+ḍita chen po dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i zhal snga nas kyis legs par bkral ba'i 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkar po paṇa chen ma ti lugs shes rab blo 'phel du grags pa ga smi ra pa'i bsod snyoms pa chen po shākya gri'i thugs dam bzhi'i ya rgyal zab pa las kyang ches zab pa khyad par thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig pa'i gnas thams cad la mkhyen dpyod 'gran zla dang bral ba stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por sku'i snang ba dngos su bstan pas zhal gzigs mar grags pa tshar chen chos kyi rgyal por bka' babs pa brgyud pa ma nyams pa las 'ongs pa'i bzhed srol ltar nyams su blang ba la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sha chang sgog btsong sogs ro dang dri ngan pa rnams spang zhing /rdzun dang 'khu 'khrig (90ba)bud med la 'dzem pa khrus sogs gtsang sbra ldan pas bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ thog mar skyabs 'gro bzhi skor spyi dang mthun/ sems bskyed pa ni/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du mi shes rmongs pa'i mun pa bsal nas shes rab kyi snang ba rgyas par byas te/—461 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs dkar po shes rab blo 'phel yi dam gyi ltar bzung zhing / de'i sgom bzlas zab mo nyams su blang bar bya'o/zhes lan gsum brjod/ tshogs zhing ni/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gsal ba'i thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du āḥdakar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs pa'i rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta ārla mañdza shrī sa pa ri wā re saḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ gong gi sngags gsham du a: pra la ye swāhā/ pā byi pra stusmo ye swāhā/badz+ra puspye āḥ& nas/ shabha'i bar gyi phyag rgya dang bcas te mchod/ gur las byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum dang tshad med bzhi bsgom/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ oṃ su bhā ba shurnya sarba dha phya su bhā ba shud+dhi3gi/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i stong nyid spros bral nam mkha' lta bur bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i dbyings su paṃ yig dkar po zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dkar zhing bsil ba/ yangs shing rgya che ba pad tshal gyi dra bas khebs shing (91na〉pa tha' ni'u gsing me tog sna tshogs bkra bas bskor ba/ glang po che dkar po mche ba drug ldan mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa mang po dal bar rgyu zhing pad+ma'i rtsa ba za ba/ ngang ngur sogs chu bya mang po rol zhing rtsed 'jo dang bcas skad snyan pa'i sgra sgrog pa/ de'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma stong ldan rgyas pa sdong po yal ga lo 'bras gser las byas pa mnyen lhug mdzes shing yid du 'ong bas dud cing dri bsung phun sum tshogs pa'i lte ba ljang ser la ge sar dmar ser du yod pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba bsil zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i gdan la/ rang gi sems nyid āḥdakar po 'od kyi dra ba sna tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'i 'od zer gyis 'phags pa rnams mchod/ sems can —462

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bsgor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ (thadathams cad kyi gti mug gi sgrib pa sbyangs/ shes rab kyi snang ba la bkod/ 'od zer slar ā dkar po nyid la 'dus pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa sku mdog ston rka'i zla ba bzhin dkar la dri ma med pa'i shel dkar gyi phung po ltar dngas shing 'od zer 'phro ba/ lo brgyad lon pa'i byas pa gzhon nu'i gzugs can/ zhi zhing 'dzum la sgeg pa'i nyams kyis 'gying ba zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing lta bas chog mi shes pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin pa'i phyag rgyas pad+ma dkar po'i rtsa ba nas bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad gar rgyas pa'i dbus su shes rab kyi ral gri dang / g.yon ut+pala'i sdong po thugs gar 'dzin pa/ phrag gong g.yon gyi thad du legs par kha bye ba la stong phrag brgya pa'i po nyis mtshan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas shing brtan par bzhugs pa'i 'od 'bar ba/ rin po che du ma'i rgyan dang dar dkar gyi na bzas spras pa/ de'i dpral (91ba〉bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i āḥyig dkar po las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ dzaḥ& baṃ lhos gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa kū la sa pa ri wā ra arnya nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ ji tar bltams pa sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ lus gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ slar yang yid 'byung gi mchod pas tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ ri bong 'dzin pa ltar dkar glegs bam ral gris phyag mtshan zhing / /rab mdzes shin tu zhi ba'i gzhen nu zur phud lnga ldan pa/ /dka' ba rgya chen mthar mchog spyan —463

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)ni pad ma'i 'dab ltar yangs/ /blo gros ngan pa bsregs mdzad 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas 'dud/ ces bstod/ lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag /bsgoms pas skyo na bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying rtse mo gyen du bsten pa'i dbus su zla ba'i steng du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs drug pa'i lte ba la āḥ rtsibs drug la mdun phyogs nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du yi ge 'bru drug dkar po 'od (92na)zer dkar dmar 'phro ba 'khor lo kha ma reg tsam du bkod la/'khor lo chos 'khor du myur du 'khor zhing yig 'bru g.yon du 'khor ba lta bu snang ba la dmigs nas sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsams shing / oṃ wa kye rda na maḥ zhes ci nus su bzla/ bsnyen tshad ni/slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes/ rig sngags rgyal po 'bum phrag gcig gis 'grub/ /zla ba gcig gis blo 'phel rig pa 'dzin/ /dngos sam rmi lam nyid du mthong thos shing / grub pa'i rtags ni gzhan yang snang bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa 'bras bu dang sgrub pa'i dus la dgongs shing / deng sang dus cher snyigs pa'i skabs su bsnyen tshad las mang bar bzla dgos pas rgya ston gyis 'bum tsho gsum dang /ja ston pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis 'bum phrag drug bzla bar gsungs/ zla ba gcig gis dus kyi bsnyen pa/ mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa ni/ zhal mthong zhing gsung thos pa'am/ g.yin yang po ti dang / mtshon cha mthong ba dang / me tog snyog pa dang / mar me bltams pa dang / nyi zla shar ba dang / dar 'phyar zhing rol mo 'bud dkrol byed pa nam mkha' la 'phur ba/ lus la me 'bar ba/ chu la brgal ba dang / gosadakar po gyon pa la sogs pa rmis so/ /dmigs pa'i gnad ni/ 'khor lo'i lte ba dang / yi ge rnamasami 'gul zhing / myur du 'khor bas khams 'dus pa sogs skyon sel zhing / blo gros myur ba dang / rtse mo rngams shes rab rno zhing stobs che ba dang / dkar zhing 'od zer 'phro bas 'dzin blo gsal ba ni/slob dpon rnar bu gling pas/ snying dbus bla ma'i 'khor (92ba〉po rtsibs drug la/ /'bru drug yi ge bkod la g.yas g.yon bskor/ khugs drag rtse mo rno zhing rab dkar bas/ /nyes 'joms stobs ldan myur 'dzin rab gsal 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ gsum pa mjug ni/ thun mtshams su bdag bskyed —464

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ 6)kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur zhes zhal tshur gzigs nas bzhugs par bsam/rgya ston gyis rang tha mal pa'i gzugs zhes gsung pa bya rgyud la rje 'khol gyi tshul du bya ba la dgongs pa 'dra/rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis chu gnyis sngon du 'gro bas mchod/maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun mar bshams la/'dzam bu gling dang gling gzhan rnams//nor bu rin chen gyis bkang ste//stong gsum la sogs ma lus pa//zhus pa med par byas te 'bul//zhes 'bul/mtshan brjod 'don/shin tu dkar ba'i mdangs ldan rgya mtsho'i dbus na pad ma ge sar rgyas//sdong po 'byungs shing ri bong 'dzin pas brgyan pa'i steng na 'jam dbyangs ni//gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs gangs ri dang mtshungs pa//zhal gcig phyag gnyis mchog sbyin la legs bsnams 'jam dbyangs khyed la 'dud/zhes pa'am/ rgyas par spro na/ don zab sngags kyi stobs kyis rab sbyangs pa'i/ /stong gsal nam mkha' dri med dang mtshudas par//paṃ yig las byung dkar dwangs bdud rtsi'i mtsho//gting zab yangasapa can la phyag 'tshal lo//mtsho mtha' glang chen thal skar gyis bskor zhing /mnyen lcug 'khril ldem pad zlum dra bas khyab//lom gur lding dkar mdzes me tog las//yid 'phrog dri bsung ldan la phyag 'tshalalo//mtsho chen dbus na paṃ yig las byung ba/93na/pad sdong yal ga lom phun tsho gos gser//'dab rgyas dkar ser ge sar dmar ser can//lte ba ljang ser mtho la phyag 'tshal lo//de steng a yig mchog rab yongs gyur las//rab zlum 'khor lo rnam dag phun tshogs mdzes/zhan tu mdog dkar ri bong 'dzin gzugs can//bsil zer phyogs bcur 'gyed la phyag 'tshal lo//der bzhugs āḥdakar las grub dpa' bo'i sku//zung bzhi'i na tshod rdo rje skyil krung brtan//chu shel dri med ji bzhin rab dkar dwangs//mtshan mchog dpe byad 'bar la phyag 'tshal lo//thor tshugs rtse nas rin chen tog mdzes shing //rtse mo lnga ldan zur phud shin tu gsal//snyan gong ut+pal dri ldan dar dpyangs phur//snyan shal nor bu phyang la phyag 'tshal lo//de bzhin mgul rgyan dpung rgyan phyag gdub dang //zhabasagadub ska rags do shal bzang po dang //sna tshogaXn bza' rin r+ṣa rgyan gyis spras//sil sil sgra

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)snyan 'brol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin legs par brkyang mdzad cing / /g.yon pa ut+pal sdong po thugs skar 'dzin/ /srab 'jam dung mdog na bzas rnam brgyan cing / /mu med 'od zer 'phro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal mchog sku yi rnam pa dran gyur pas/ /rig sngags cung zad bzlasapa tsam gyis kyang / /dus der dar dkar ma sha'i sbyor ba yis/ /phun tshogs blo gros 'phel la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang gzhon nu dpa' bos legs bstan pa'i/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang rdzas sbyor ci rigs kyis/ /gnas skabs mthar thug yon tan ma lus kun/ /slu med nges par 'grub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngo bo ma (93bshor chos nyid rab mkhyen cing / /rnam pa ma lus chos can lhang nger gzigs/ /thugs rje che dang thabs tshul dpag med kyis/ /srid mtsho mtha' dag skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs mgon po gus pas rjes dran zhing / /sgom bzlas legs mchod mngon par bstod pa yis/ /blo ngan mun nag 'thibs pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /sprin med nyi ma bzhin du dwangs bar mdzod/ khes bstod/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud byin gyis rlobs la shes rab phun sum tshogs pa bskyed cing / /mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ zhes dang / gang tshe blta bar 'dod pa'am/ /zhes sogs dang / brtse ldan khyed kyi mkhyen rab 'od zer gyis/ zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bkang / ma 'byor ba dang zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par bsol/ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ ces sogs kyi mthar/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/rang nyid dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal la gnas pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥ dmar po/thugs gar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par bsams la lus bsrung / legs byas 'di bsags 'bras bus tshe rabs su/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis dge ba'i bshes mdzad nas/ /bden pa gnyis kyi gnas lugasam lus pa/ /ji bzhin rtogs pa'i shes rab stsal du gsol/ zhes dang / g.yin yang smon lam shis brjod ci rigs pa bya'o/ /ngag gi dbang phyug zhal lung dze tā rir/ /mngon sum stsal ba sgeg pa'i rdo rje la/ /—466

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ thenabaka' babs kha che'i yul gyi kha ḍi ta'i/ /thugs kyi (94na po pa la ber gtams pa bdud rtsi'i bcud//nor skyong mi dbar ma bzhugs mkhas grub phreng / /chad med las 'ongs zur chen thams cad mkhyen/ /khyab bdag zha lu pa yi bka' drin las/ /rnyed 'di skye mang bsod nams zong gis bsgrubs/ /rang gzhan mang por phan 'dod lhag bsam gyis/ /'bad pas bsgrubs mthus rnam mkhyen ma thob bar/ /chos kun blta ba'i blo meg ches yangs pa/ /mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang bdag mtshungs shog /ces ma ti lugs kyi 'jam dkar shes rab blo 'phel gyi sgrub thabs rta ljang dbang po ni gzhung lugs gsar pa'i rab byams smra ba'i bshes gnyen sku skye bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos don gnyer chen pos bskul ba la brten paṇ+ḍita sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ rgya ston/ bsod nams pa rin chen rgyal mtshan rnams kyi yi ge la gzhi byas/ brgyud ldan mkhas pa'i phyag bzhes kyis legs par brgyan te za hor gyi ban+de tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes lcags mo bya lo snon gyi zla bar pho brang dmar po rir sbyar pa'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang pos bgyis pa pradzñā wadhe bha / /tshangs pa'i sras mo yid 'ongs lus dkar can/ /mgrin dbus pad mtshor bzhad pa'i zhal sgo las/ /legs bshad rdo rje blun rmongs gnyen po sa /gdangs mdzad bka' drin zla bral bla ma dang / /ke la sha yi mdzes sdug 'phrog pa'i lha/ /rgyal kun yab gyur brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i zhabs/ /dngos po gcig tu lta ba'i gdung shugs kyis/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs gsol nas/ /rnam 'byed shes rab ral gris sgrib gnyis kyi/ /'ching rgya dbral nas srid zhi'i rgya mtsho las/ /blo gros gzings kyisabasgral te lus can kun/ /'dren pa'i (94bsdad dpon chen por 'gyur bar shog /ces pa 'di'ang sku skye bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos 'jam dkar gyi nyams len skabs 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mthar rgyas pa blo bzang dbang pa'o/ /na mo ྅ dzo ta nā thā ya/ byams brtse'i shel gyis las nyon zhugs kyi phung / /nyer bsil phan bde'i lo tog rgyas mdzad pa/ /bskal bzang sangs rgyas lnga pa ma pham mgon/ /ring po'i phyag khyod —467

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)bdag sogs 'gro dbugs phyung / /rnam 'dren spyan sngar bla gos phrag par gzar/ /pus btsugs thal sbyar sra mkhregs rdo ba'i ngos/ /bris pa'i dam bca'i ri mo zubs min phyir/ /gzungs sngags 'bras bu myong la gcig tu spro/ /mgon po mtha' med 'khor mtsho nyer sgrol ba'i/ /ded dpon khyod la gtan gyi skyabs song ste/ /sgrub thabs 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyis bkral ba'i/ /rjes 'brang go sla'i ngag gis deng 'dir spel/ /de'ang rdo rje gdan gyi mahā bo dhi'i gnang ba thob pa la brten nas paṇa grub chen bo a bha yā ka ra gu dhas shing rta'i srol legs par phye ba sgrub thabs nyis brgya zhe gnyis gsungs pa'i nang tshan rje btsun byams pa'i sgrub thabs bklags cho go gi tshul du bkod pa la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro bzhi skor spyi ltar bya/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags pa byams pa'i sgom bzlas zab mo nyams su blang bar bya'o lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ tsho gos zhing ni/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun byams pa mgon por gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun byams pa mgon bor bla ma rdo rje sems (95na sko pa'i rnam pas dbu brgyan pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra puṅge ā hūṃ nas/ shabha'i bar gyis mchode/ gur las byung ba'i rgyun bshags tshar gsum dang tshad med bzhi bsgom/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ shā n+ya lhas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems mo ser po las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa rnams mchod pas mnyes par byas/ 'gro ba rnams kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las po las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i gdan la rang nyid 'phags pa byams pa gur gum gyi mdog lta bu rtsa zhal ser/ g.yas nag g.yon dkar ba'i zhal gsum/spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thugs kar chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yas 'og masamachog sbyin dang / g.yon 'og mas nā ga ge sar gyi me tog gi snye ma bsnams pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/—468—

rta mgrin shwa na sto bsgor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ 6)snya o/ mgulas/ dpung o/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ sa mo do/do shal gyis ma ro zhe par sprasashing / lha rdzas dar gyi stod g.yogs dang pañtsa lika'i sham thabs gso me ba/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ thugs ka'i steng du zla ba la tshe ser po/ /de las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥ& baṃ ho la gnyis su med par bstim/slar yang 'od los dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā (95na)dzaḥs spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sam ya shrī ya hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas tshogos zhing gi skabs ltar nyer spyad rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ byams 'a me yis zhe sdang bud shing bsreg /sogs kyis bstod/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mi gyi mthar bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'phags pa byams pa go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus thugs ka'i sa bon la thim pa'i dmigasapa'i 'phro 'du dang bcas nas/ oṃ mi tra ye swā hā/ zhes ci nus su bzla/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/sngar bzhin mchod cing bstod/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ rang nyid dam tshig par gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan pas lus bsrung / bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis ci rigs bya'o/ /de ltar sgrub thabs rgya mtsho las gsungs pa'i rje btsun byams pa'i sgrub thabs dga' ldan du bgrod pa'i them skas 'di ni dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho spro ba'i byed po chos rje sngags ram pa nam mkha' bzang po dang / rab 'byams pa blo bzang rdo rjes bskul ba'i ngor/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen —469

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)brtse'i dbang phyug gi reg zig la tshig sna cung zad spros te za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi (96na〉ke pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon mchog go/na mo gu ru mañdzu shri ye/ 'khor lo tha ma'i snying po phal chen nas/ /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam gsungs pa yi/ /'phros don bde ldan zhing du 'pho ba'i thabs/ /nyal sgom mkhas pa'i bzhed srol deng 'dir spel/ de'ang bzang po spyod pa'i bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa'i tshe/ zhes sogs kyi dgongasadon ltar mgon po 'jam dbyangs kyis slob dpon dze tā ri la stsal ba rim gyis brgyud pa ra lo chen gyi man ngag gong ma lnga'i zab chos brgyud pa'i chu bo zam ma chad pa las nye bar 'ongs pa la/ sbyor ba dngosagazhi mjug phan yon dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā bas/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro dang / /de nas byang chub sems bsgom bya/ /mdun du snang ba mtha' yas bsgom/ /de la phyag 'tshal mchod par bya/ /zhes pa'i don/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa'i sgo nas sdig pa sbyong zhing bde ba can gyi zhing khams su skye bar 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas gnas khang byi dor byas par bde ba can gyi zhing bkod dam/ ma 'byor na snang ba mtha' yas kyi sku bris 'bur gang yang rung ba zhal shar du phyogs pa bzhugs su gsol/ mchod pa ci 'byor ba bshams/ de'i mdun du nub ma nyal ba'i dus gnyid log pa'i sngon du stan bde ba la mgo nub tu bstan/ slo g.yas pa 'og tu bcug nas nyal/'od dpag med gtso bor gyur ba'i dkon mchog gsum mkha' khyab tu bzhugs pa la dmigs nas skyabs 'gro bzhi skor grangs bdun nam gsum sogs ci rigs pa bya'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du 'od dpag med bsgom par bya snyam du sems bskyed/(96ba〉tanas khang dang sa phyogs thams cad dag pa'i zhing bde ba can dngos su bsams la rang nyid mos pa'i yi dam gyi lhar gsal btab/ mdun du rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar po zha lu gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che sna tshogs kyis —470

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ 6)brgyan pa longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs can/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras shing snang la rang bzhin med pa nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon lta bu bdag la dgyes bzhin du bzhugs pa/ de'i mtha' skor du chos 'di ston pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams dang /de'i rgyab tu sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sprin gyi phung po 'khrigs pa ltar bzhugs par bsam/ de la dmigs nas yid kyis yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum mam/ yang na sapaṇa gyis mdzad pa'i chos spyod bcu pa'am/ 'jug pa bde bar byed na 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i/ na mo bha ga ba te a mi te ṣ+ṭhaḥ zhes phyag 'tshal/ me rtag la sogs pas mchode par bsgoms nasabacom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa la skyabs su mchi'o/ sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags so/ /bsod nams thamasacad la rjes su yi rang ngo / /sangs rgyas thams cad chos kyi 'bor lo bskor bar bskul lo/ mya ga las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs so/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig /ces lan gsum bya/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ sdig pa dag pa'i nges shes(97na〉skyed/ /zhen pa thams cad btang bar bya/ /'chi bar 'jigs pa med sems kyis/ /snang ba mtha' yas ting 'dzin bsgrub/ /ces pa ltar snang ba mtha' yas la bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems kyisabaskor ba rten gyi stobs/ sngon chad kyi sdig pa la dug khong du song ba lta bu'i 'gyod sems rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi bgyid snyam pa nyes pa las slar bzlog pa'i stobs/yan lag bdun pa sogs kyi tshogs gsog pa gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs te stobs bzhi tshang na sdig pa'i phung po ri rab tsam yang 'dag par nges shes bskyed/ tshe 'di'i lus longs spyod nye du 'khor g.yog sogs rang 'chi ba'i dus nges par 'bral bas chen 'dzin thams cad btang / bdag 'chi ba'i dus na bde ba can du 'gro snyam pa'i gdengs tshod kyis 'khor ba dang ngan song la mi 'jigs pa'i bsam pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs 471

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)rgyas 'od dpag tu med pas bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing bde ba can gyi zhing khams su skyes nas byang chub tu lung bstan pa 'thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas dbugs phyir rgyu ba'i tshe rang gi rnam par shes pa 'di dkar po'i rnam pa can sna phug g.yon nas thon/ bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas kyi shangs bug g.yas su zhugs sku'i dbyibs brgyud thugs ga'i hrīXl thim pas rgyal ba'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du bsam/dbugs nang du 'jug pa'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ga'i hrīḥlas sems kyi ngo bo 'od dkar po mar me gcig las gnyis ma chad kyi rnam par byung / shangs bug g.yon nas thon te rang gi sna bug g.yas su (97ba)rdugs/ snying gar thim nas rgyal ba'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du bsam/de lta bu'i ting 'dzin 'gal me 'khor ba ltar grangs mi bzung bar ji tsam nus kyi bar bya/ gsum pa mjug ni/ phyi nang rim bzhin lus la bsdu/ bdag nyid dad pa'i ngo bor bskyed/ dge ba sems can rnams la bsngo/ /phyis kyang de la goms par bya/ zhes pa ltar thun 'jog khar/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma la thim/ bla ma rnams sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la thim/ dbugs nang du 'jug pa dang bstun snang ba mtha' yas 'od du zhu nas bdag la thim/ bdag kyang 'od du zhu nas sangs rgyas yi dam rang sems gsum dbyer med du 'dres pa'i ngang nas mgon po 'od dpag med sngar bsgoms pa ji lta ba bskyed pa la dmigs pa bstod de/ oṃ a ma hā bha hrī:swā hā/zhes ci nus bzla/ de nas 'grub na bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam dang / de tsam ma lcogs na/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ /pad+ma dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes/ /snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bsam pha sum du/ /lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der thob shog /ces smon lam btab/dge 'dis bdag gis gtso byas sems can kun/ /nying mtshams sbyar tshe bde ba can zhing du/ /brdzus te skyes nas 'od dpag med mgon gyis/ /dgyes bzhin rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ zhes pas mtsho ni te bsngo smon gyis rgyas 'debs/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas rang la bstim pas sangs rgyas bde ba can du —472

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bsgor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ thena'ags par bsams la/ rang gi dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga rnams su oṃ āḥlha gsum bkod pas bsrungs nas yid gzhan du mi 'gyur ba bde ba can du 'pho ba'i 'dun pa dung nge ba'i ngang du gnyid log (98na)go /nyin mo sogs gnas skabs kyi spyod lam thams cad 'dug pa'i gnas de bde ba can gyi zhing khams su bsams la rtag tu sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa dang mi 'bral bar bsgom/'gro ba'i tshe rang gi mdun du sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa'i phyogs su 'gro bar bsam mo/ bzhi pa phan yon ni/ 'di la nad dang gdon mi 'byung / /'chi ba'i dus na sdug bsngal med/ /bar dor thub pas rjes su 'dzin/ /phyi ma'i dus su thar pa thob/ /ces pas don de lta bu'i rnal 'byor nyams su blangs pas tshe 'dir nad gdon bar chad med cing tshe ring ba dang / 'chi ga'i dus 'od dpag med kyi thugs rjes gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal mi 'byung / bar do'i 'jigs pa las bsgral nas lus 'di sbrul shun brjes pa ltar nub phyogs bde ba can du pad+ma las brdzus te skyes nas snang ba mtha' yas la chos nyan par dkon mchog brtsegs pa las gsungs shing / de'i gdams pa nyams su blangs pas thar pa thob par gdon mi za'o/ /rgya gar mkhas grub bod kyi lo tsā ba'i/ /man ngag sa skya'i 'jam mgon rim byon gyi/ /dgongs don zhabrul med khyer bder bkod pa'i dges/ 'gro kun bde ldan zhing du bgrod par shog /ces bzang spyod las byung ba'i nyal sgom gyi nyams len bde ldan zhing gi 'jug ngog zhes pa 'di ni lha sa ba blo bzang dpal 'byor gyis bskul bas rkyen byas tshul 'dir mos pa'i las dang po ba rnams la phan phyir khyab bdag zha lu pa rin chen bsod nams mchog grub dang mkhas grub chen po khra tshang pa blo mchog rdo rje'i drung du nos shing khong du chud pa'i drin las rje btsun sa paṇa gyi rtsa tshig la gzhi byas/ de'i rang 'grel dang chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i gsung rab kyi don tshang bar bsdus te za hor gyi ban+de 'jam dbyangs (98ba po ga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis lcags bya hor zla lnga pa'i nyer drug la pho brang po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon mchog go / —473—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)thugs rje chen po rgyal po lugs kyi las byang dang 'brel ba'i tshogs mchod ni/ thugs spu'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pa'i rtser/ /raṃ las ye shes me yis rdzas rnams kyi/ /ma dag nyes pa'i skyon kun ma lus bsregs/ /yaṃ las chos nyid rlung gis rdzas rnams kyi/ /ma dag nyes pa'i ston kun ma lus gtor/ kho las mtshan med chu yis rdzas rnams kyi/ /ma dag nyams pa'i skyon kun ma lus bkrus/ /oṃ gyis kun rdzob chos kun stong pa'i ngang / thabs mchog āḥlas pad ma'i snod yangs por/ khres rab hūṃ gis tshogs kyi dngos po kun/ /zung 'jug khyuḥlas zag med bdud rtsir bsgyur/ /slar yang 'od los 'byung bzhi lha mo sogs/ /snod bcud kun gyi yon tan thams cad dang / /rgyal ba zhi khro'i sku gsung thugs byin rlabs/ /'khor 'das yongs kyi ro bcud nus pa tshogs/ /thogs med bkug nas dbyer med gcig tu gyur/ raṃ yaṃ kho/ oṃ āḥ&/ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ spyan 'dren ni/rang snang dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /gnas khang 'di ru byin gyis rlomes/ /tshogs gtor 'di la bcud cig phob/ /'dir tshogs mched lcam nyams rtogs spor/ /snang srid bde ba chen por mdzod/ /oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā gi ni dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ sgrub pa'i rten dang gtor ma la/ gnyisasu med par brtan par bzhugs/ pad+ma ka ma (99na tshe pa pa skye/ yi ge bcu pa lan bdun bzlas nas/ /gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la/ /sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur/ /bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /tshogs dang bo 'bul ba ni/ /'phags mchog thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor la/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sogs/ /'dod yon phyi mchod nam mkha' gang / /bdud rtsi sman phung rak+ta dang / /dam rdzas rgyan ldan nang mchod bshams/ /mdzes sdug phyag rgyar mnyam sbyor ba/ /gsang ba bde chen mchod pa'i rdzas/ /kun kyang rig pa'i rang gdangs las/ /mchod bya mchod byed dang bral ba/ /'dod yon tsho gos kyi mchod pa 'bul/ /thugs dam skongs la dgos grub stsol/ /oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni dharma pā las pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pu dza khā hi/ bar pa bshags pa ni/—474

rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches sum ldan/ (thadabadag cag ma rig dbang gyur pas/ /nyams chags 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa/ /rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams la bshags/ /tshangs pa khrus kyi dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ pad+ma sa twa sa ma ya sogs snang ba mtha' yas kyi yi ge brgya pa gsum mam bdun brjod/ tha ma bsgral ba ni/ e las thar med 'brub khung 'bar ba'i nang / /ni dang tri las gnod byed gzugs phung la/ /pho nya rnams kyi dgra dang bgegs kyi tshogs/ /khug cig dzaḥ& baṃ hoḥs gnyis med gyur/ /dbang chen rab khros sku smad phur pa'i dpal/ /snying gar btab pas srog bcad rnam shes spar/ /spu gri 'bar bas yan lag sha khrag rus/ /nang khrol ma lus phye ma dum bur gtubs/ /hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha ya shrī ba hu lu hu lu dgra bgegs kyi bla tshe srog gsum thams cad mā ra ya rbad ces bsgral/ stobs(99ba)pa ni/ phyi ltar dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus/ /nang du tshogs brgyad dag pa'i phung po lnga/ /gsang ba bde stong ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin//gnas lugs rang ngo shes pa'i ngang nas 'bul/ /gong gi sngags gsham du ma hā me sa rak+ta kai ni ri ti kha raṃ 'a hi/ lhag ma ni/ kha chus bran la/ phyi yi 'khor yug la gnas pa'i/ /thugs rje chen po'i bka' skyong tshogs/ /yang 'khor sdebargyad pho nyar bcas/ /lhag pa'i gtor ma 'di long la/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bstan gnod dgra bgegs 'joms pa dang / /rnal 'byor sdong grogs bya ba dang //'gro kun phan bde sgrub par mdzod/ /oṃ u tsi gi ba li ta bha k+ṣa se swāhā/ chad mtho ni/ sngon tshe 'og min bde ldan zhing khams su/ /dpal ldan kun bzang gar gyi dbang po yis/ /rang las gzhan min dag pa'i 'khor rnams la/ /byar med ngang nas chos kyi gnas lugs kun/ /tshig dang yi ge med pa bstan pa'i tshe/ /gsang ba ye shes la sogs mkha' 'gro yis/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ji bzhin du//gtor ma 'di long bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /de 'og bar gyi bskal pa dbus ma la/ /ra sa zhabrul snang dpal gyi gzhal yas su/ /srong btsan sgam po o rgyan khri srong rjes/ /'phags mchogo zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ /gter kha gsum du zab gter sbas pa'i tshe/ /dung skyong ma sogs chosasrung gter bdag gis/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ji bzhin du/ /gtor ma 'di long bcol ba'i —475

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)'phrin las mdzod/ /de 'og rtsub 'gyur bskal ba'i tha ma la/ /laṅka'i rgyal khab dpal ri'i pho brang du//slob dpon thod phreng slob ma dngos grub myang / 'i kya bzang po gter ston rnam gsum gyis/ /'jig rten dbang phyug dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas/ /ma sring dregs pa dam la btags(1yin lnga'i tshe/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ji bzhin du/ gtor ma 'di long bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /da lta bkra shis byin chags gnas ma ga 'dir/ /dam gtsang rdo rje'i spun grogs mched lcam gyis/ /'gro 'dul thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bdag don byang chub nar mar bsgrubs pa'i tshe/ /yar gnasamachod byin mar gnas sbyang ba dang / /bstan srung dam skang g.yar dam gso byed na/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ji bzhin du/ gtor ma 'di long bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /bstan ma bskyang ba ni/ bdag nyid chen mo la so gos bdud mo bzhi/ /gangs dkar sha med la so gos gnod sbyin bzhi/ /kong btsun de mo la sogs sman btsun bzhi/ /'khor bcas dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'di bzhes la/ /dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i nad rims dal kha chad/ /sad ser btsa' than lo nyes dmag zhakhrugs sogs//nyer 'tshe kun zhi chos srid legs tsho gis rnams/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bro brdungs/ gtor gzheng ri rab gsal ba'i 'go /gnod byed dgra bgegs dam sri rnams/ /lusapag yid gsum mnan byas nas/ /thar pa med pa'i bro brdung ngo / /dbang chen rta skad cer ra ra/ /rol pa'i rta bro chem se chem/ khro bo rnams kyis bro brdungs bar/ khro mo rnams kyis rgyas 'debs so/ /dbang drag zhi rgyas bro brdungs bas/ khams gsum dbang sdud gnod byed bsgral/ /nad gdon kun zhi tshe dpal rgyas/ /las bzhi thams cad lhun grub shog /pa shi ku ru mā ra ya shan+ti ku sa rig ku ru swāhā/zhes rgyal po bka' 'bum du tshogs 'khor gyi tshig zin med cing gangs ri ba'i yig char phyogs tsam snang ba ha cang tshang ba mi 'dug pa/ nye char 'byul snang bya 'dabs kyi ma ṇi ba dgos bstan spyi sos bskul ba ltar za hor gyi ban+de byang sems myu gu rtsal gyis lcags bya glu dbyangs kyi zla bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon mchog go /sarba maṅga lo//—476

gzur gnas blo ldan ngo mtshar skyed byed gzungs 'bul gyi lag len/ 6)gzur gnas blo ldan ngo mtshar skyed byed gzungs 'bul gyi lag len 'khrul spong nyin mor byed pa bzhugs/( skyi sirnyi/'gyur med chos sku don dam mkha' khyab spros dang bral ba'i rang bzhin las//sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar mkhan dkyil 'khor bdag por mngon bzhengs pa'i//rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dngos 'jam mgon bla ma myong kha pa//zung 'jug dbang gi rgyal po'i 'byung gnas khyod zhabs snying gi pad mtshor bzhugs/sang zad bsten kyang rnam par dkar ba'i 'bras//mngon par rgyas mdzad yang dag dge ba'i bshes//'khon ston shes bya kun mkhyen khyod nyid las/khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon de gzhan na su//gsang chen rgyud sde rgya mtshor mnga' bsgyur ba'i//mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin//sngon byon tshad mar gyur pa'i phyag bzhes dag/'khrul pa med pa'i lam du deng 'dir spel//de yang mgon po byams pas//rig 2na ) pa'i gnasalnga dag la mkhas par ma byas na//'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid thob mi 'gyur/zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi rig pa'i gnas lnga'i nang nas gzhan rjes su 'dzin par bzo rig par grags pa 'di nyid lus can kun gyi phan pa dang bde ba ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas su bla na ma mchisapa'i rgyu mtshan/mnyam med jo bo chen pos/'phags pa rnam par grol ba'i sde'i rjes su 'brangs te gtsug lag khang mtha' yas pa'i gnyer kha mdzad de lde mig mang du bzung ba sogs rnam thar rnamasalas byung ba ltar dang /ston pa rin po ches dge 'dun gyi gnas gzhi bzhedas pa las lhag pa'i 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa med par gsungs pa la brten nas/dge ba'i bshes gnyen spyan snga bas gtsug lag khang dang kun dga' ra ba mang du bzhengs pa'i sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar ltar ro//de lta bu la rten gnas gzhi 'ding ba dang /der bzhugs pa/ brten pa sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzheng ba'i tshul

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gnas kyi mtshan nyid spyir dge bcu tshang ba/ bye brag tu dpal dī paṃ kā ra'i sa dpyad 'phrul gyi lde mig /phur (2ba)pa yang gsang bla med/ /rje yang dgon pa'i ri chos sogs yig cha khungs thub rnams las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin legs par brtag dgos la/ gtso bo ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa bcu gnyis lta bu bstan pa'i gnas dang / dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rnams rang bzhin gyis 'du ba'i yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'am de dang 'dra ba/ g.yin yang rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rgyal blon dam pa tshad ldan rnams kyi zhabs kyis bcags shing / byin rlabs mdzad pa rnams ni gnas kyis gang zag byin gyis brlabs pa yin pas/ dus dang bstun pa'i rang gzhan gyi gang zag rnams la lhag par sman yon du 'gyur bar sems shing / don bsdu na dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ gang las skyong chos ldan zhing / skye dgu bder gnas rtsod pa med/ ces dang / mdo sde rgyan las/blo ldan gang du bsgrub pa'i yul/ /legs par rnyed dang gnas bzang dang / /sa bzang pa dang grogs bzang dang / /rnal 'byor bde ba'i yo byad ldan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa der bzhugasapa'i rten la/ ngos 'dzin tshul/ tshe dang phan yon/ gzungs gzhug 'bul tshul dang bzhi/ dang po la sku gsung thugs kyi rten gsum las/ dang po sku'i rten ni/ longs sku/ sprul sku so gos sangs rgyas dang /sems dpa' byams 'jam dbyangs lta bu dang / nyan rang gi rigs dang / rang rang gi dngos brgyud kyi bla ma'i sku sogs rigs mang zhing / da lta ngos 'dzin tshul la/ bla med kyi rigs lnga lta bu longs sku dang //bdag cag (3na)gi ston pa lta bu sprul sku'i tha snyad du byed pa yang mi rung ba ma yin mod/ 'on kyang de tsam gyis longs sprul gyi dbye ba bya ba ni ma yin te/ 'dus pa dang bde dgyes sogs dkyil 'khor ba'i lha rnams ni ngo bo ye shes kyi sku/ 'byung lus rags pa dang bral ba'i longs sku de las sprul bas na sprul skur ngos 'dzin pas so/ /de ltar dkon mchog gsum gyi dbang du byas na snga ma 'di dag ni sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang / phyi ma rnams dge 'dun dkon mchog rten du 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa gsung gi rten ni/ mdo sde ltar na chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / sngags la pha rgyud bye ba phrag —478

gzur gnas blo ldan ngo mtshar skyed byed gzungs 'bul gyi lag len/ 6)drug/ma rgyud bye ba phrag bcu drug sogs glegs bam du bkod pa ste/dkon mchog gsum las chos dkon mchog gi rten no//gsum pa thugs kyi rten ni//rang bzhin lhun grub gyi mchod rten ni//snod bcud la sbyar ba dang //bla na med pa'i mchod rten ni//thig le dbang gi rgyud las gling bzhin tshad med bzhi la sbyar ba dang //byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod rten ni sku gdung cha brgyad gling bzhir so sor bzhugs pa dang /dngos grub 'byung ba'i mchod rten ni sngon he ru gas drag po btul ba'i tshe yul brgyad kyi dur khrod du ma mo brgyad kyi dngos grub 'byung ba'i mchod rten brgyad dang /gzhan yang theg pa so so'i mchod rten nyan thos rang rgyal theg chen gyi rten dbyibs tshad mi 'dra ba rnams dang /bye brag tu 'o skol gyi ston pas sku tshe 'di'i mdzad pa khyad par can rnams las grong khyer ser skyar sku bltams pa'i tshe bde gshegs 3bsgo cho de rten/rgyal po'i khab tu mngon par byang chub pa'i tshe byang chen mchod rten/wā ra ṇa sir chos kyi 'bor lo bskor ba'i tshe ye shes mar rten/mkha yod dze waṃ tshal du cho 'phrul bstan pa'i tshe//mu stegs pham byed kyi mchod rten/yangs pa can du lha'i dbyar gnas mdzad pa'i tshe//sum cu lha'i mchod rten/rgyal po'i khab tu lhas byin gyis dge 'dun gyi dbyen byas pa mchog zung gnyis kyis 'dums pa'i tshe/byang dngos mchod rten/yangs pa can du sku tshe byin gyis brlabasapa'i tshe/byin rlabs mchode rten//rtomachoge gi grong khyer du mya ga las 'das pa'i tshe myang 'das ma chad rten//gzhan yang ras tshig pa'i mchod rten/ma tshig pa'i mchod rten/sol ba'i mchod rten/tshems kyi mche ba lha dang srin pos khyer ba'i mchod rten/chos rgyal mya ngan med kyis bzhengs pa'i mchod rten bye ba sogs rnam grangs mtha' yas pa ste/sku gsum nang nas chos sku'i rten no//gnyis pa ni/de lta bu'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams bzhed ba la/de dag rnams kyi tshad gnas khang dang sbyin bdag rnamasakyi 'byor ba dang bstun pas che chung mtha' gcig tu ma nges shing /phyag tshad kyi rim pa mchod rten/sku gzugs/phyag mtshan dang bcas pa'i thig rtsa'i rim pa dus 'khor/sdom 'byung rtsa 'grel/kri ye samu tsa ḍa/shā ri'i bus zhus pa'i mdo la brten pa'i /phyaX tshad/gzhan yang bod kyi mkhas pa thams cad

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)mkhyen pa zha lu bu ston dang / skad gnyis smra ba shes rab rin chen/ thams cad mkhyen pa (4na sko ge 'dun grub kyis zin bris su mdzad pa la sman bla don grub kyis kha 'gengs sbyar byang dang bcas bkod pa sogs mkhas pa'i gsung rab rnams las byung ba'i phyag tshad ji lta ba bzhin du bzhengs shing /glegs bam dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs thon mi sa sto ṭa dang / don gyi paṇ+ḍita chen po chos skyong bzang po sogs kyis legs par bshad pa las byung ba'i sdebs dang brda dag sogs rung bar bya dgos te/ sku gzugs phyag tshad med pa dang / glegs bam brda dag med pa sogs la rgyu song gi 'bras bu ni 'byung mod/ de yang theg pa gsum po gang rung gi myang 'das la dmigs pa'i bsam pas zin na sgrub po rang nyid la phan yon ni bla na med pa 'byung ba khyim bdag dpal skyes kyi thar pa'i sa bon shin tu phra ba mdo las gsungs pa dper mtshon te dpog par nus la/ bstan pa'i rgyun la ni sku gzugs dang glegs bam bzheng tshul ma dag pa de dag gis gzhan dag mang pos kyang che ge mo la 'di dag snang zhes dper bzung nas ma dag pa'i rgyun chen por 'byams te bstan pa dri bcas su 'gyur zhing / khyad par rgya gar lta bu'i chos kyi dag ther med pa'i rang cag bod sogs mtha' 'khob pa rnams ni mkhas blun dbye ba mi phyed pa'i dbang gis/ /gdung rus yul gnyen por grags pa dang / mkhas pa dang grub pa'i skye ba dang sprul par grags pa dang / 'khor g.yog mang po'i 'du 'god sogs 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi g.yeng ba can rnams la skyes bu dam par brtsi zhing / de dag gis rnam par (4ba tha 'tsham pa'i snang ba la gang shar gyi rang bzo chen po zhig byas kyang / yang dag par 'dzin pa'i dbang gis bstan pa dang rang gzhan mang po bslu ba'i g.yang sa chen po mthong ba de'i phyir/ shes ldan rnams kyis zhib mor dpyod pa gnad du che zhing / sku gsung thugs rten 'di lta bu bzhengs so zhes pa'i snyan grags tsam 'dod de lag tu blang ba'i rim pa rnams hral por byed pa dang / tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i bde ba tsam don du gnyer ba ni 'khor ba'i 'khor lo bskor bar zad do/ /gsum pa phan yon ni/ /gsal rgyal gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ /thub pa'i mchod rten byed dam byed bcug pa/ /mya ngan 'joms dang lus kun grims—480

gzur gnas blo ldan ngo mtshar skyed byed gzungs 'bul gyi lag len/ 6)pa dang //rin chen mdzod mang 'jig rten gtsor 'gyur zhing //mi de dgra yi tshogs las rgyal bar 'gyur//bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod rten rnams dang ni//sku gzugs rnams la rdul phran ci yod pa//de 'dra'i grangs de snyed kyi rgyal srid dang //lha yul sa steng mi yis nges par 'thob//gzugs dang gzugasamed khams kyi ting 'dzin ni//phun sum tsho gos pa'i sa mchog kun myong nas//tha mar skye dang rga ba la sogs pa'i//sdug bsngal dang bral sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob//'di ni rgyal ba'i sku gzugs byed pa ni//gzugs dang skal bzang yon to nye bar ldan//de ni dbang po sbas dang nyi ma'i 'od//'jig rten kun gyis mthong na dga' bar 'gyur//bde bar gshegs pa li sku gzugs bzhedas pa gang //de yi lus ni dri ma med pa dang //ldan skod dang 'jigs dang mya ngan sdug bsngal bral//pad+ma'i nang bzhin 'jam dang yangs par 'gyur//'di na rgyal ba'i sku gzugs byed pa gang //bran du mi 'gyur dbul po'i rang bzhin min//las byed ma yin skye ba dman par min//dbang po ma tshang min te skyes mchog 'gyur/zhes dang /sdud pa las/la las gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed zhing rnams na//sems can ji snyed 'khod kun dgra bcom nyid btul bas//gang gis shes rab pha rol phyin 'di yig bris te//sems can mchog la glegs byin bsod nams khyad par 'phags//zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro//bzhi pa gzungs gzhug 'bul tshul la//'bul yul gyi rten de nyid sbyor dngos mjug gsum gyi sgo nas mtshan nyid tshang dgos par bstan pa/log rtog bsal ba/mtshan nyid de ldan gyi rten la gzungasagazhug 'bul ba dngos dang gsum/dang po ni/sngar bshad pa'i phyag tshad de tsam dang ldan pas chog gam snyam na/de tsam gyis kyang chog pa min te/rgyu'i yan lag sbyin bdag de ni//mkhas pa'i gsung las/sdig la mi 'dzem dad 'dun chung //phan yon ma mthong yid mi ches//bsgrub blo med pa'am yod na yang //tshe 'di'i lo 'dod grangs 'dod phyir/rkyen dang mi la'i blo rgya byed//4 thung blo dog bzod sran wo //lha dang bzo bo smod byed cing //'gyod pa skyes nas 'phro 'jog pa'o//zhes pa lta bu'i skyon dang mi ldan zhing //phan yon mthong ba'i shes rab can//rtse//ga sems5ba lnga'i bsam gtan can//brtan cing

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smyonaspro ba'i brtson khrus can//dka' spyad mi skyo bzod bsran can//ngang ring tshig 'jam tshul khrims can//g.yo med gtong phod sbyin par ldan//rim gyis dga' spro bsgom pa'o//zhes pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa zhig dgos so//de bzhin du bzo bo yang //yon to mi mkhasang rgyal che//'grogs pa mi bde bkur sti 'dod//'phral du tshig rtsub phugs 'dod tshe//yon brgyags bla thang ched med 'bebs//des kyang mi tshim rgyu cha brku/khong zad tsam la bzo 'phro 'jog/'gro sdigs byed cing chang nag 'tshol//dge las sdig par bsgyur mkhan yin/zhes pa'i skyon rnams dang mi ldan zhing /yon to gyi khyad par sdom 'byung las//dul zhing bzo rnams kun shes la//cho ga mthong zhing mnyam gzhag pa/zhes dang /dpal kha sbyor las/dul zhing dad ldan lang tshor babs//dbang po rnam gsal rnam rtog med/khro med lkog lus mi byed cing /zhan tu mkhas la spro ba che//bzod ldan snying rje'i chen po can//zhes rgyud sdernams las legs par gsungs pa dang ldan dgos shing /sku'i rgyu rnams kyang rang nyid kyis 'byor bzhi du ser snas bcings te rgyu ga ngon tsam bto ba la 'bras bu bzang por 'dod pa dang /blo gros kyi rtsal dang mi ldan pa dag gis bkod pa legs su re ba rnams ni nam mkha'i pad+mo dang chos mtshungs shing /gzhan yang sku rgyu dang rgyan spros kyi rim pa sogs kyang spyir btang dmigs bsal gyi dbye ba legs par phyed dgos 6na〉sgo/de yang thog mar bzheng pa'i tshe/sa'am yo byad 'tshol ba na/phyi ltas skyes bu'i bya spyod/rdzas dang /skad dang /sgra la sogs pa bzang ngan gyi rim pa la brten nas rten 'brel brtag pa/dpal g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba sogs rtsis kyi gzhung lugs dang /g.yin yang ltas kyi bstan bcos rnams las shes dgos shing /de'i rgyu mtshan yang /spyir chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stongs kyang /tha snyad du bya byed thams cad 'thad pas na rten 'brel 'grig pa ni legs tsho gos 'byung ba'i sgo ste/bshes spring las/rten cing 'brel bar 'byung 'di rgyal ba yi//gsung gi mdzod kyi gces pa zab mo ste//gang gis 'di ni yang dag mthong ba des//sangs rgyas de nyid rig pa rnams mchog mthong /zhes dang /lam gos don ༷sdus ma las//rten 'brel rnam gsum rang la 'dzom

gzur gnas blo ldan ngo mtshar skyed byed gzungs 'bul gyi lag len/ 6)pa yis/ khyu rkyen gzhan med re dogs bral bar mdzod/ ces dang / rgyal ba btsong kha pas/ de phyir rten nas 'byung ba las/ /ma gtogs chos 'ga' yod min pas/ /rang bzhin gyis ni stongs pa las /ma gtogos chos 'ga' med par gsungs/ zhes pa ltar ro/ /gzhan yang rdo rje phreng ba dang / rdo rje 'chang chen po'i lam gyi rim pa sogs dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mang po las gsungs pa'i sa brtag pa/ bslang ba/ sbyang ba/ bzung ba/ bgegs bzlog pa rnams tshig gi 'don bsgyur ma gtogos la na dgos shing /lto 'phye brtag pa la rtsis dkar nag dang rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i rigs rnam (6ba)grangs mang yang /gtso bor rdo rje 'chang chen po'i lam gyi rim pa las bshad pa bzhin byas na legs shing / sa dang / lha dang / bum pa sta gon yang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga nas bshad pa ltar bya bar rigs so/ /de bzhin du bzo bo dang / sku rgyu dang / lag cha'i rim pa rnams byin gyis brlab pa'i sta gon gyi lag len dang /ngag 'don gyi rim pa ni zur du shes dgos shing / gtsug lag khang dang / mchod rten sogs la bum gter gzhug pa'i lag len zhib mo yang man ngag las ji ltar 'byung ba ltar dang / mdor na las rnams rtsom pa'i thog ma'i tshe/ dkar rtsis las bshad pa'i gza' skar sbyor byed dang / nag rtsis kyi sabadag sogs brtsis te ras spyod gzu lums su ma song ba sogs dgos te/ rgyu mtshan bshad ma thag pa de rnams mkhas grub tshad ldan rnams kyi phyag len las rim par byung zhid / khyad par snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha pa chen po'i dgongs don ji lta ba bzhin rdo rje 'chang sngags ram pa dge 'dun bkra shis sogs kyis phyag len du legs par bstar mod/ deng sang ni dus dbang gis bstan pa'i rnam gzhag rnams rim gyis 'gribs pas sku gsung thugs rten bzheng pa la tshul de dag lag tu blang pa lta ci smos/ /dgos pa'i gtam tsam yang cher mi snang ngo / /gnyis pa log rtog bsal ba ni/yon tan phyogs re tsam gyis dregs shing / mdo bstan bcos dgos 'grel ris su ma chad pa la lta ba'i blo mig rnam par ldongs pa 'dod pa'i lhas rdzas su bzung ba la la dag gis sku gzugs (7na)dang mchod rten sogs bzhengs pa la gzungs gzhug 'bul ba 'di dag bod kyi bla ma rnams kyis byas —483

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)kyi/ rgya gar na med do snyam pa'i log rtog gi ngan smras sgrog cing / de'i khungs su/ rgya gzhung 'ga' zhig na rten 'brel snying bo lta bu'i gzungs dmigs bsal re re tsam 'jug zer ba las/ deng sang yongs su grags pa 'di 'dra byed pa'i 'phros zur tsam yang mi snang ba dang / 'phags yul gyi sku li ma rnams gar lugs shas che bas gzungs gzhug med pa mngon sum gyis grub cing / bod 'dir sngon du bzhengasapa'i lder bzo zhig pa rnams la brtags tshe yang gzungs gzhug ji bzhin mi 'dug pa mthong bas so zhes zer mod/ de dag gi bdud kyis kha rnam par phye ba'i gtam ste/ mdo las/ sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun bye ba phrag du ma dang bcas pa la lo grangs dpag tu med par yo byad kyis bsnyen bkur byas pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs mtshon gang ba ring bsrel gyi snying po can zhig 'jim pa las bsgrubs pa bsod nams lhag pa sogs mang du gsungs pas/ ring bsrel la rnam grangs mang yang / gtso bor chos sku'i ring bsrel ni gzungs la ngos 'dzin pa'i phyir/ gzungs 'bul tshul gyi lag len zhib mo rgya gar du yod pa lung rigs gnyis kas 'grub cing / rgya gzhung 'ga' zhig tu gzungasa'abul ba'i gsal cha med pa tsam gyis/ rgya gar du med pa mi 'grub ste/ mdo lugs kyi dbang du byas na bshes sprin las/ ji ltar bde gshegs (7ba〉sku gzugs shing las kyang / /bgyis pa ci 'dra'ang rung ste mkhas pas mchod/ ces pa ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs grub tsam nyid nas mchod pa'i yul du gsungs kyi/ rab tu gnas par ma bshad pas/ mdo lugs nas ma gsal ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis rab gnas mi 'thad par khas len dgos par 'gyur zhing / gzhan yang man ngag tu byas te zhal dang snyan nas brgyud dgos pa rnams chos kyi spyan dang ldan pas gzigs tshe rgyud sde rnams las gab dkrugs thor bu'i tshul gyis bstan pa sha stag yin na'ang / rmongs pa mkhas par rlom pa rnams la ni rgyud sde rnams las nag po 'gro shes lta bur gsal bar ma bkod pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ sangasargyas kyis ma gsungs so zhes smre sngags kyi than skad sgrog na/ bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ /zhes dbang bzhi pa bskur tshul rgyud sde rnams su sbas pas/ dbang bzhi pa bskur tshul bod kyi bla ma rnams kyi blos —484

gzur gnas blo ldan ngo mtshar skyed byed gzungs 'bul gyi lag len/ (thadabyas yin no zhes rigs mthun gyi blun po kun la 'bad pas sgrogs shig /rang gis oṃ bsgrub tshul tsam yang mi shes na rgya dpe lta ci smos/ /snang tshul de dang ldan bzhin du rgya gar kha spu can gyi lugs byed ces ham pa byed pa ni rgya dkar nag lta bu'i lugs gnyis kyi khrims med pa'i skyon no/ /li'i rgyu rnams la sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyis byin rlabs mdzad par bshad pas/ li'i sku 'ga' zhig la gzungs gzhug med kyang sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa las lhag pa'i gzungs ci zhig dgos/ de'i dpes gzhan dag la (8na〉nga khegs par 'gyur ro snyam na/ da lta'i gang zag rnams kyi sangs rgyas 'od srungs dang shākya thub pa sogs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdzad pa de dag dngos su ston zhig dang / kho bos snying nas rjes su yi rang bar byed do/ /sngon gyi lder bzo rnying pa 'ga' zhig la gzungs gzhug tshad ldan mi 'dug go zhes zer ba ni shin tu mi rigs te/ snga rabs kyi dus su byung ba rgyu mtshan du byas te khungs btsun par 'gyur na/ bod du nang pa'i bstan pa las bon po'i bstan pa snga zhing / ka ma la shwe la'i ring lugs las hwa shang gi grub mtha' snga ba dang / rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po'i lta ba'i bzhed pa las jo mo nang pa'i lta ba dag snga ba'i phyir na/ snga ma rnams dag gi phyi ma rnams mi dag go /zhes smra dgos par 'gyur ba sogs gnod byed mi zad pa thog tu 'bab bo/ /gsum pa rten la gzungs 'bul ba dngos la/ dngos dang / pos don bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ lo chen rin chen bzang po'i rab gnas kyi sdom las/ ring bsrel gzhug cing gsol ba gdab/ ces sogs gsungs pa ltar/ 'thad ldan lag tu blang ba'i rim pa la/ srog shing yang rab tsan+dan/ de ma 'byor na'ang shug pa'am 'bras bu can gyi shing / ma bcad pa'i snga rol nas phyogs mi nor ba'i mtshan ma btab pa zhig dgos shing / de'ang rab gnas don gsal sogs su/ sarba bi rgyu'i sngags mchod rten gyi srog shig la 'dri zhing / sku gzugs 'bur ma yin na dbu la gzhug par bshad pa dang / mnga' dbul gyi skabs mchod (8bskyon la srog shing gi mnga' dbul byung zhing / sku gzugs la ma byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ sku gzugs la srog shing med du mi rung ba ni ma yin la/ 'on kyang brdungs ma sku tshad —485

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)che ba'i rigs la sku'i tsho 'dzin par 'gyur zhing legs pa yin no/ /lder bzo rus shing 'jog pa'i tshad la/ rus shing srog shing gcig par bsgrubs na legs par sems shing / 'phags pa rin po ches chos skyong gi sku la srog shing nges can du gsungs pa ni/ man ngag dmigs kyis bsal ba ste/ chos skyong gi gzungs 'bul skor la khyad par gyi rnam grangs ches mang ba nas/ spyi 'gro'i lag len tsam gyis khyab pa min no/ /de yang sngar bshad pa'i rgyu de dag las grub pa'i srog shing / mchod rten gyi chosa'akhor yan chad dmigs kyis bsal ba'i zlum po dang / gzhan thams cad gru bzhi pa rtsa rtse'i rnam pa'i phra sbom yod par byas la/ de'i rtse mor rnam rgyal mchod rten dang / rtsa bar rdo rje phyed pa 'grub na brko ba'am/ ma 'grub na 'dri ba gang rung byed/ de yang rtsa dbu ma'i mtshon don yin pas sku gzugs la rdo rje skyil krung yan chad dam/ yang na lte ba yan chad tsam dang / mchod rten la gdung chen yan chad kyi tshad du bya yi/ de man chad du gtong ba ni rus shing dang srog shing gi dbye ba ma phyed pa'o/ /g.yas g.yon du ro rkyang mtshon pa'i rten 'brel du dur ba dang ku sha cung zad 'bul/ srog shing kha dog yi ge gang 'dre'i mdog dang mi zlos pa'i tshon gyis byugs/ /sku'i dbu'i dbyings dang mchod rten gyi bre'i thad tsam la/oṃ sarba bi sdi swāhā zhes pa dang / rten gyi thugs ka'i thad tsam du oṃ (9na〉badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ zhes pa dang / oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā zhes pa bri/ gnas lngar oṃ āḥ& tre hri zhes pa bkod/ gzhan yang shar ngos la gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ lhor dri med/ nub tu gsang ba ring bsrel/ byang du byang chub rgyan 'bum gyi gzungs thung rnams bri zhing / bzhi ga'i gsham du rten 'brel snying po dang / bzod pa dka' thub dam pa sogs dang / rten 'brel snying po bod skad du bsgyur ba rnams bri/ nang rten lta bu la gshegs pa de nyid rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bris 'bur gyi sku gang yang rung ba dbu'i gtsug tor gyi nang dang / lhag pa'i lha 'am yi dam gang yin pa de nyid kyi sku bris 'bur gang rung thugs spu'i thad du gzhug pa la mu tig dang gser la sogs pa'i rin po che'i phreng ba'i rigs dang / rin po che'i phye ma dang dri bzang po sman gyi tshogs rnams sku mdog dang mthun
