pa'i dar gyis gril la sku gzugs gnyis dang lhan cig tu —486

gzur gnas blo ldan ngo mtshar skyed byed gzungs 'bul gyi lag len/ 6)legs par gtums te gzhug pa'i phyi rol tu shog bu la/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje slob dpon che ge mo zhes bgyi bas/ sbyin bdag gam tshe 'das che ge mo zhes bgyi ba la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/sdig sgrib nyes lhung gi tshogs rnams byang ba dang / 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las thar pa dang / myur du rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa chen po thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa lta bu rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar/ yi dam la yang bcom ldan 'das yi dam che ge mo zhes bsgyur ba'i shog dril gyis dkris/khyad par sdig sbyong lta bu gtso bor yin na/ thugs rje chen po/ kun (9ba)rig /mi 'khrugs pa sogasarang gang mos kyi ngan song sbyong ba'i lha'i sku dang / de'i mtha' skor du sngags phreng spel tshig dang bcas pa yang dgos pa yin no/ /gson po'i don du bzhengs pa la che ge mo zhes bgyi ba la gnas skabs su nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnams nye bar zhi zhing / tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod snyan grags mthu stobs sogs legs tshogos thams cad 'phel ba dang / mthar thug gi don zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab pa'i tshig rgyas bsdus gang 'os dang / bla ma dam pa zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs dang bzhugs pa'i mdzad pa lta bu la ni zhing khams gzhan dag tu sems can gyi don rlabs po che 'grub pa sogs ji ltar bzhed pa'i dgongs pa rnams rdzogs pa dang / yang zhing 'dir 'gro ba'i don du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs pa dang / sku tshe mdzad pa 'phrin las rnams 'phel zhing / gdul bya'i tshogs rnams smin cing grol bar byin gyis brlab pa sogs spel tshig rgyas par bya/ lte ba'i 'og tsam du bzheng yul gyi sku de bla ma lta bu'i yin na de kha'i dang / yang na sbyin bdag gi 'am/ rab gnas kyi tshe bsko rgyu'i chos skyong lta bu/ mdor na yul dus gnas skabs sogs dang bstun pa'i chos skyong gi sku mthun rdzas rnams dang lhan cig tu bzhugs pa la mthun rkyen bsgrub pa dang dgra bgegs sgrol ba sogs rten gnyer gtad kyi spel tshig rgyas par bya'o/ ring bsrel la/ sku gdung gi (10na)ring bsrel/ yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel/ sku bal gyi ring bsrel/ chos sku'i ring bsrel rnams las/ sku gdung ni/ sangs rgyas/ byang —487

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)sems/ nyan rang / bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi gdung rus lta bu/ yungs 'bru ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung dang / mkhas grub rnams kyi ring bsrel/ sku bal ni dbu skra/ sen mo sogs/ chos sku'i ring bsrel ni gzungs rnams la ngos 'dzin pas/ dang po gsum ni theg pa gsum gyi 'phags tshogs dang rgya bod kyi lo paṇa gong ma rnas ma kyi byin rlabs rten tsam tshogs pa yin mod/ de phyin chad la 'ga' zhig kun slong ngan pas/ lta grub mi gcig pa mi 'jug pa dang / la la dag snang phyogs med 'dod nas/ chos rgyun dang 'bul sa'i rten gyi khyad par sogs kyi dbye ba med par/ byin rlabs rten lag tu 'byor tshad 'jug par 'dug kyang / lugs gnyis ka 'thad par mi sems shing / dper na gsang ba 'dus pa lta bu'i sku la mar 'gos nas bzung ste/ dbang bka' bshad bka' man ngag gi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs rten gang rnyed gtso bor 'jug /gzhan yang rang gis thos pa'i chos zab mo gzhan dag gi bla ma brgyud pa'i byin rlabs rten yang 'jug rigs la/ rang dang dam sel yod pa dang lha gang yin pa de'i chos rgyun la dam sel yod pa'i rigs ni cig shos de ji ltar 'gangs che yang mi 'jug pa gnad du zab bo/ /de yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gtso bor gyur pa'i sku gdung sku bal ring bsrel ji snyed pa rnams dri bzang po dang lhan cig tu dar (10ba)ras ser pos gtums/gang zag dman pa'i rus pa ni der bcug na/ gang zag khyad par can gyis phyag mchod mdzad pa sogs kyis shin tu gnod par 'od srungs rdzogs byed kyi gtam rgyud las 'byung ba ltar mi rung bas/rus chog byas pa'i sol ba snag tshar bsres nas gzungs par 'debs pa sogs kyi rgyu byas na legs so/ /bla ma'i sku chos dang ber sogs na bza' gtos che bar yod na gzungs kyi na bza'i tshul du bkri zhing / na bza' spyi chags pa'i rigs dang / zhabs lham sogs ni 'jug tu mi rung yang / mkhas rlom rtog spyod can rnams ni dogs pa'i gnas tsam yang byed par mi snang ngo / /chos sku'i ring bsrel gzungasakyi rim pa 'bul ba ni rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i gzungs rnams ha cang mangs pas bri bar dka' zhing /chad lhag kyang 'byung nye bas na par du bsgrub pa legs shing / de yang par la la dag ni gtsug tor —488

gzur gnas blo ldan ngo mtshar skyed byed gzungs 'bul gyi lag len/ 6)sogs gzungs ring po rnams dpe cha ltar yig phreng dang po'i mjug gnyis pa'i 'gor bris pa sogs mchis pas/ /gzungs dril ba'i tshe yang stod smad bar gsum nas dril ba 'dra zhig ma gtogs tshad ldan zhig mi 'byung bas na/ yig 'phreng dang po'i bsham de par shing gnyis pa'i yig phreng dang po dang /de las kyang mang ba dgos na par shing gsum pa sogs ji snyed kyi bar du yig phreng dang po kho na yod pa byas pas/ shog mtshams rnams sbyar bas gzungs ji ltar ring yang yig phreng gcig tu 'byung ba ni legs pa yin no/ 'dri dgos pa rnams ni/ gser/ dngul/ mtshal snag gang 'byor (11na ting / bla gzugs ni gha lha dang kha ches sa kyang legs so/ /de yang mtshan sngags kyi rim pa ni/ oṃ āḥn ma shrī dzi niḥpra bhu badz+re bhi dha rā ya hūṃ/ zhes pa lta bu 'bru gsum gyi bar du mtshan sngags phyag 'tshal sngon du 'gro ba can legs sbyar gyi skad du bsgyur ba dang lus wa rtul/ nā ga ra/ rgya mtsho mtha'/ ga smi ra'i yi ge lta bu 'bri ba legs na'ang / legs par sbyar ba'i bstan bcos ka tsa na sogs la sbyangs pa rnams kyis bya bar rigs kyis/ sgra mtshams sbyor lnga pa tsam yang mi shes par/ so: ta'i skad 'dod nas rnam dbye dang rkyen gyi 'jug tshul cung zad kyang med pa'i skad dod rdo chag bsgrigs ma dag pa'i phung po la snying po med pas/ de bas 'di ltar bya ste/ oṃ āḥrgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po la phyag 'tshal lo hūṃ/ zhes pas dper mtshon nus shing / bla ma brgyud pa yang rgyas par spro na/ so thar byang sems sngags kyi sdom pa thob pa'i brgyud pa/ dbang rjes gnang gi rim pa dang / nyams khrid/ bshad bka'/ man ngag gi brgyud pa sogs rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar re re bzhin dgos/ bsdu na rang gtso bor nyams su gang len dang / ma mtha' yang sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam chos skyong gi sku gang yin pa de kha'i chos rgyun gyi bla ma ni tshang bar dgos so/ /gzungs sngags kyang med du mi rung ba'i gzungs chen sde lnga ni/ rnam rgyal/ dri med/ gsang ba ring bsrel/ byang chub rgyan 'bum/ rten 'brel snying po rnamasadang / sangs rgyas byang sems/ yi dam chos skyong gang yin par(11ba)snying po nye snying 'phreng sngags las sngags sogs dang / bla ma'i sku gzugs la/ rgya skad shes na mtshan sngags legs sbyar gyi skad du —489

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 63)bsgyur ba dang / bla ma de kha'i yi dam chos stong gi sngags rnams dgos shing / de dag gi mthar mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'grub pa'i spel tshig mjug tu pu sna ku ru oṃ zhes pa sbyor ba dang / rgyas par grub na rgyud sde bzhi'i yi dam chos stong so so'i sngags kyi rim pa rnams dang / gzhan yang mdo las 'byung ba'i nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang dang / yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa/ bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rnams kyang 'dri ba'am par du 'debs pa sogs rung ba shog 'thung sogs ma nor ba byas la/dri bzang pos byugs/ ma dril ba de nyid la bgegs bskrad/ rab gnas bsdus pa sogs lag len zur du 'byung ba ltar bya/ de nas dril ba ni/ kun mkhyen bu ston gyis mjug nas dril ba dang / sa skya pa'i rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes rje ngor chen pa'i lugs la/ oṃ nas sbrul 'khyil ba ltar mjug mthar yong ba'i lugs gnyis/ /stag tshang lo tsā bas/ thams cad dril lugs shin tu dam pa mi 'jig pa dang / dbu zhabs ma log ces pa tsam las gsal kha ma byung la/ de yang chos rje bu ston zhabs ni rtsod med yongs grags kyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po yin cing / ngor chen pa ni sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan gyis zin pa'i tshad thub kyi rdo rje slob dpon yin 'dug pas/ de gnyis lugs gcig 'thad/ gcig mi 'thad ces kha tshon gyis gcod mi nus mod/ des na rang (12na༄ga rnams ni dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi ngo bo chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i gsung rab las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin lag tu bstar dgos na'ang / gzungs 'bul gyi skor 'di la rje bla ma'i gsung gsal ba dri ma med pa zhig ni ma mchis shing / rjes 'jug gong ma 'ga' zhig gis zha lu ba'i lugs de la rang lugs su byed par mchisapa ni zha lu ba'i lugs la dga' ba tsam du zad do/ de'i phyir na/ rim lnga gsal ba'i sgron me las sngags kyi brda ni sngags kyi ming ste/ de yang 'gor oṃ dang / mthar swā hā yod pa'i sbrul dang / oṃ yod la swā hā med pa'i mtha' med dang / de las ldog pa'i 'go med dang / gnyis ka med pa'i btus pa zhes pa bzhi dang / snying po nye snying shes gas du ma zhig yod kyang / zhes pa dang / spyod bsdus las/rdor zlasakyi yi ge gsum gyi skabs su/ de la sprul la sogs pa'i sngags rnams ni/ /a li ka li las byung ba —490

gzur gnas blo ldan ngo mtshar skyed byed gzungs 'bul gyi lag len/ (thadarnams so/ /zhes gsungs pa la dpags nas ngor cher gyis gsang sngags sbrul 'khyil ba'i dbyibs can du mdzad pa legs par mngon zhing / lag len kyang dbu nas dril ba 'di bzhin byas la dar ras kyi na bza' ser pos gril zhing / de'i skud pas dam du bkri'o/ /de nas gzungs 'bul ba'i gnasakhang der/ gser zangs sogs kyi sku dang / rgyu de las grub pa'i mchod rten rnams la ni thog mar byin rlabs rten/ srog shing / sku gzugs dang / gzungs dril grub pa rnams dang / tsan+dan (12ba)dang shug pa sogs spos kyi phye dang / sman sna 'bru sna/ thums rdzas kyi gos dar gser g.yu sogs mdor na der dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshogs pa la/ rdo rje slob dpon lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pas sbyang ba bgegs bskrad drag tu bya/ bsrung 'khor bsgom/ slar yang gzungs rnams la rab gnas bsdus pa zhig bya/ sku gzugs kyi nang dang mchod rten gyi nang gi gad ro ma lus par bton/ phyi'i gser mdangs sogs la ma gnod par chus bshal nas bsdam/ gzer gyi bug pa dang bsgrigs mtshams la chu 'gro ba yod na ma 'ongs pa na sku rjen pa la khrus chab lta bu gsol ba'i tshe rlan gyis gzungs rul 'gro bas/bsgrigs mtshams dam zhing / 'byor na 'ber dang / tha ma'ang bkrag chus srubs med par byas/ de nas tsan+dan dkar dmar/ a ka sa shug phye sogs kyis gzhi byas/ dri bzang po'i sman tsho gos tshad/ spos reng gi rigs sogs zhib tu btags pa chu gtsang gis spran pa'i gar sla zho tsam/ gser zangs kyi nang dang mchod rten gyi shing sogs thams cad la lan mang du byugs te/ srab mthug ba'i ko ba tsam byung ba dang / dri ngad mi yal ba'i phyir grib skams bya/ sman sku'i rigs 'ga' zhig la/ gzungs thog ma nasaphul grub pa dgos pa sogs go rim cung zad mi 'dra ba rigs pas dpyod do/ /de nas rten rnams la sbyang gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i bgegs bskrad byas/ gu gul gyis bdugs/ gzungs 'bul ba'i lasabyed nang gi de nyid mngon du gyur ba'i rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po rnams la rten ma nges (13na)kyang /dus kyis rnyed par dka' zhing / gzhan du na rab dge slong / 'bring dge tshul/ tha ma'ang dge bsnyen nam/khyim pa gso sbyong la gnas pa dag gis khrus byas/ gos gsar pa gyon/ sha chang sgog btsong sogs kha —491

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)zas ma rungs pa dag spangs te/ oṃ mas ṅgā tu ga ya swā hā/ zhes gzungs 'jug pa'i bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'don bzhin pa'i ngag nas las byed/ de rnams la ja bzang po dang / ka ra bu ram/sbrang rtsi sogs dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis tshim par byas na sbyin bdag la longs spyod kyi rten 'brel du che/ gser sku lta bu la/ skye mched byin rlabs rnams gtsug tor smin mtshams sogs so so'i thad gar sbyar/ sman sku la tshon 'og tu bri/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung gis thog drangs/ sku gdung /sku bal/ sku yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel/ na bza'i dum bu rnams gtsug tor ram/ thor tsugs can gyi dbu skra'i nang ngam/ bla ma lta bu'i dbu'i gtsug /mchod rten gyi tog dang gdugs kyi nang du gzhug/de'i mdzod spur nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang la rgyas pa'i spel tshig sbyar ba dang / de'i 'og tu bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan gzungs rnams dang / gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba'i gzungs la bar chad zhi ba'i spel tshig dang / gdugs dkar lta bu rgyud sde gong 'og la mi ltos par dmigs bsal gyis 'jug /mchod rten yin na bre yan chod du gzhug /sku'i mgul dang / mchod rten gyi bre zhabs kyi thad du dbyings gsal gyi gzungs gang mang / sku'i stod dang mchod (13ba lhan gyi bum stong la bla med kyi gzungs/ de yang g.yas su pha rgyud/ g.yon du ma rgyud/ sa zhal gnyis dbus su gnyis med kyi rgyud zer yang / rang lugs bla med kyi rgyud yin na gnyis med kyi rgyud yin pas khyab pas/ dgyes rdor/ dus 'khor lta bu la gnyis med kyi rgyud ces sger du ming 'dogs pa'i rnam gzhag mi byed kyang / rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i bla med kyi rgyud sde gang yin de dbus su gzhug pa legs par sems/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten gyi rigs byin rlabs can yod na gzhug de 'og sku sked dang / bum sked la rnal 'byor rgyud/ spyod rgyud/bya rgyud kyi gzungs dkyus ma rnams go rim ma log par gzhug /lte 'og /bum smad la gzungs chen (snga/ yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa/ gzhan yang mdo las sting ba'i gzungs rnams dang / phyag la gzungs la sdug par shar na/ bla med kyi gzungs kyi rigs dpung mgo nas mthe bong gi bar la yas bcol nas 'jug /stod gzungs/ smad gzungs/ bar gzungs rnams la gos dar ser po sogs kyis—492

gzur gnas blo ldan ngo mtshar skyed byed gzungs 'bul gyi lag len/ 6)mtshams dar legs par btang / sku'i skyil krung dang mchod rten gyi bang rim rnams la/ rgyud sdebazhi dang theg pa gong 'og sogs go rim ma 'dzol bar byas te/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang de'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos/ mngon rtogs sgrub skor las tshogos sogs kyi glegs bam/ shog bu'i bar bar la yang dri bzang dang bcas/ nang gril gos dar kha dog sna tshogs gang 'byor/ phyi gril dar ser pos byas/ dbu shog yar log /mdun logs kyi dbu/ rten gyi (14na lob phyogs su yod par byas te ci shong bcug /gzungs dang glegs bam gyi srubs stong par lus pa rnams/ shug phye/ spang spos/ gtso bo bum rdzas nyer lnga/ g.yin yang dri bzang ci 'byor gyi phye ma dang ras ser por thums bu byas nas 'gengs/ rten gyi pad+ma'i stod dam/ mchod rten gyi seng khri'i stod kyi thad du/ dbus su bkra shis pa'i tshigs bcad lhug dang bkra shis pa'i gzungs rnams kyi shog dril/ g.yas su chos skyong bsrung ma/g.yon du dpal mgon bdun sto rtsa lnga/ rgyab tu gnod sbyin nor lha'i gzungs sngags/ phyogs skyong rgyal chen sde bzhi/ gza' rgyu skar lha klu sa bdag mthu bo che rnams kyi sngags/ de dag rnams kyi bar du'ang bra bo dang pad kha ma yin pa'i 'bru sna'i rigs dar ras ser pos gtums te bcug la/ dar rasaser pos mtshams bcad de mi lug par bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'phros don bye brag tu bshad pa la/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo bca' tshul/ dmigs bsal gyi rim pa gnyis/ dang po la/ g.yin lugs mi 'thad pa dgag pa/ rang lugs 'thad ldan du bzhag pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ zha lu pa'i lugs kyi lag len mo 'khor steng du bya ba dang / stag tshang lo tsā bas/ 'dab ma'i sngags mgo phyir bstan pho 'khor steng du byas pa la/ 'dab ma'i sngags rnams g.yas bskor g.yon bskor khyad par mi rigs pa'i sgrub byed dang bcas pa'i lugs/ 'ga' zhig gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu'i lder sku gzhug pa dang / shing byang la ri mo bris (14ba)te kha sbyar du byas nas 'jug pa sogs lugs mang zhig mchis pa/ snga ma 'thad par mi sems te/ 'khor lo 'di dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud le'u gnyis pa las/ gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo bris te nor dang 'byor ba bsgrub pa'i ched du mo 'bor gnyis kha sbyar ram/ pho mo kha sbyar —493

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)bar gsungs pas/ 'di nyid rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i nor bsgrub kyi 'khor lo'i las tshogs yin pa'i phyir na/ mo 'khor steng du byed pa rgyud sde gzhan dag gi lugs srol dang mi mthun pa'i nyes pa mngon sum du grub pas so/ khyu mtshan bde dgyes/ gsang 'dus/ dus 'khor/ khyad par dmar nag 'jigs gsum sogs gsang sngags gsar ma'i rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i 'khor lo'i las tshogs rnams dang / gsang sngags rnying ma'i las tshogos mtha' dag gang la yang / pho 'khor steng du byas te bsgrubs pas las ji bzhin ma 'grub na/ spogs pa'i cho ga la pho mo go bzlog ste byed par bshad pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnod sbyin 'khor lo la spogs cho go tu 'gyur ba'i skyon 'byung la/ spogs chog ni las mtha' rdugs na byed cing mi shis par yang bshad pas/ sbyin bdag sogs la 'byor ba dang bkra shis par bsgrub pa'i 'khor los/ de'i bzlog phyogs bsgrubs te phyin ci log tu 'gyur ro/ /yang 'di la skyon med de rgyu mtshan/ gsang 'dus lta bu'i dkyil thang gan rkyal du bzhag pa'i tshe yab kyi steng du yum yong ba mngon sum gyis grub pas so zer na/ de nyid dod ma tsos na 'bor lo (15na)kha sbyor ba las ras gzhi gcig la pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba dang bcas par gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu dkyil thang gi lha ltar bris kyang rung bar 'gyur zhing / gzhan yang 'khor lo'i dpe dkyil thang la 'gebs na/ dkyil thang gis 'khor lo'i go chod par khas len dgos/ de ltar blangs na/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum lta bu la 'phrul 'khor 'di pa sogs kyi dka' ba khyad du bsad de/ dkyil thang tsam la brten nas 'phrul 'khor gyi las tshogs sgrubs shig /gzhan yang dkyil thang zhal bsnyel ba de'i tshe mo steng du yod pas bsgrub na/ ga k+ṇi sogs kyi gnam rgyan la mo 'og tu 'byung bas cis mi 'grub/ lugs snga ma de 'dra ni gsung rab kyi brda chad lta zhog /'jig rten tha snyad las kyang 'gal ba'i gtam mo/ /lugs bar pa yang mi rigs te/ de lta na steng 'og gnyis ka g.yas bskor byas pa'i skyon gyis lho'i lha dang byang gi lha zhal sbyar ba zhig yong zhing / de la skyon mi yong na bris thang gi dkyil 'khor lta bu la yang shar gyi lha'i yum de nub kyi lha dang zhal sbyor du bris pa de la nyes pa mi 'jug par —494

gzur gnas blo ldan ngo mtshar skyed byed gzungs 'bul gyi lag len/ 6)'gyur ro/ /yang mngon sum phal pa la de ltar snang ba tsam gyis mi gnod de/ sgom don la phyogs kyi lha rnams ma 'dres par 'byung ba'i phyir dper na dkyil thang bkram pa'i tshe shar phyogs pa rnams/dngos su dbu 'thur la bstan kyang / sgom don la de ltar min pas so zer na/ de ltar na mi 'khrugasapa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang yang (15ba〉bskur rung ste/ dkyil 'khor de mngon sum du phal pa la mi 'brugs pa'i dkyil 'khor du snang gi /sgom don la rnal 'byor pa'i dmigs pas gang 'dod du bsgyur thub pa snga ma dang dod mtshungs pa'i phyir/ yang g.yas bskor g.yon bskor du byas na thabs shes sbyor ba'i tshe/ zhal gsum yod pa lta bu la/ yab kyi g.yas zhal dang yum gyi g.yas zhal gnyis sbyor dgos pa'i rigs pa gtong ba ni shin tu mi rigs te/ rgyu mtshan de ltar na/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi 'phrul 'khor gyi skabs yi ge bcu bdun po g.yas bskor g.yon bskor du 'bri bar bshad 'dug pas phyogs gcig gi yi ge rnams log por 'dri dgos par 'gyur zhing / des na ṇa dgos sar na 'dri ba sogs 'chugs tshabs chen por 'gyur ro/ /mtshan nyid pa rgan po dang / tha snyad mkhan po dag man ngag dang bral ba'i rang bzo la brten nas rgyu mtshan med pa'i blos byas ma mdzad cig /lugs phyi ma ni snga ma bkag pa'i shugs kyis khegs so/ /gnyis pa rang lugs 'thad ldan du bzhag pa ni/ dpa' bo gcig grub nas gsungs pa'i yab yum gnyis med kyi dngos grub blang thabs bsnyen pa dang bcas te bsgrub pa dang / bsnyen pa med kyang 'khor lo bcas la dngos grub blang ba'i tshul gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma ltar te/ bri gzhi gser dngul zangs kyi byang leb bam/ mthing shog gos ras gro shog gang 'dzom la steng 'og mnyam par/ gzong brkos sam gser dngul rgya snag mtshal lta bu la sman (16na〉sna rin po che sna tshogs kyi phye btab pa sogs yo byad 'dzom pa dang bcas/ rgyu skar rgyal la bab pa'i tshe 'am/ yang na gza' skor sbyor byed legs pa la phri ba ni/ dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud las/ yang na gser la sogs pa'i byang bu la ba su khyu ra gnod sbyin mo dang bcas pa dang / byang bu gnyis pa la bcom ldan 'das ji bha la gnod sbyin gyis bskor ba —495—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)yang dag par bris la kha sbyor du byas te/ zhes gsungs pas/ nor rgyun ma gtso bor bya ste/ 'khor lo mu khyud rim pa bzhi bskor ba'i lte bar nor rgyun ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na shing thog :lha pā ra dang / g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa'i zhabs 'og na pad+ma'i sdong gi gter mnan pa/ bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gying ba'o/ /mu khyud gnyis pa la pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa la/ gtso mo'i mdun shar nas brtsams te/ gtso mo dang 'dra ba'i nor rgyun ma brgyad dbu phyir bstan pa bri'o/ /dbus kyi nor rgyun ma'i thugs gar oṃ bhā su dha ri ni swāhā/ shar gyi zla 'od ma'i thugs kur oṃ tsan+d+ra gci swā hā/ lhor nor sbyin ma'i thugs kar oṃ dan tā yi swāhā/ nub tu rab sbyin ma'i thugs gar oṃ su da na tā yi swāhā/ byang du 'phags ma'i thugs kar oṃ ār+ya ye swāhā/ shar lhor rab bzang ma'i thugs gar oṃ su bha dra ye swāhā/ lho nub tu sbas ma'i thugs kar oṃ bu pa tā ye swāhā/(16ba〉kyib byang du mdzes ma'i thugs kar oṃ de byi yi swā hā/ byang shar du dbyangs can ma'i thugs skar oṃ su ra su skye swā hā/zhes phyogs ma nor bar bri'o/ /gsum pa dang bzhi pa la rdo ra me ri'o/ /gnyis pa pho 'khor bri ba ni/ mu khyud bzhi bskor ba'i lte bar/ rdza bha la ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchogo sbyin gyi mthil na :ñtsa pā ra dang / g.yon zhe'u le rin chen skyug pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs skyil krung phyed pas gter gyi steng na bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i thugs skar oṃ dzam bha la dza len+d+ra ya swāhā/ mu khyud gnyis pa la pad 'dab brgyad la 'khor brgyad sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs gtso bo dang 'dra ba las/ gtso bo'i mdun shar phyogs su u phyir bstan nas/ nor bu bzang po'i thugs kar oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ya swāhā/ byang du gang ba bzang po'i thugs rkar/ oṃ puṇ+ḍa bha dra ya swāhā/ nub tu nor sbyin gyi thugs gar/ oṃ dha na da ya swāhā/ lhor rnam thos sras kyi thugs kar/ spya sha ma ṇa ya swāhā/ /byang shar du rol pa'i phreng ba'i thugs dar/ /oṃ ki li mā li ba swā hā/ nub byang du 'jam po 'khyil ba'i thugs gar oṃ tsi bi kuṇ+ḍali ni swāhā/ lho nub tu gdong gi dbang po'i thugs kur oṃ mu khen —496

gzur gnas blo ldan ngo mtshar skyed byed gzungs 'bul gyi lag len/ 6)dra ya swāhā/ shar lhor spyod pa'i dbang po'i thugs gar oṃ tsa ren+d+ra ya swā hā/ zhes pa rnams bri'o/ /dbus kyi yi ge'i mgo dang / lha gtso bo'i dbu nub tu bstan/ phyogs mtshams kyi yi ge rang lha'i dbu phyir bstan no/ /'bring lha bri ba ma (17na〉〉spyab na/ pad 'dab la sngags bris kyang rung ngo / /sngags rnamasakyi su hā'i gong du/ ma ma dha rna de hi de hi zhes pa'am/ yang na che ge mo'i nor dang 'bru dang dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa la sogs pa'i spel tshig gang 'dod bri'o/ /mu khyud gsum pa dang bzhi pa la rdo ra me ri'o/ /yang na dngos gzhi bri lugs sogs sngar ltar la/ pad 'dab kyi lha sngags rnams kyi dbu nang du bstan/ gtso bo'i dbu shar du bstan pa byas na mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi bdag nyid dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gi bzhed pa'o/ /lugs gnyis ka la rgyas 'bring gnyis 'dri ba ma 'grub na/ bsdus pa ba dgu ṭ+wāṃ dgu 'dri ba phyag len yin kyang / 'ga' zhig sngags med par lha rkyang pa 'dri ba ni ma dag pa'o/ /lugs snga ma ni sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjo la sgrub thabs rgyas pa las/ dpal ldan mgon po rjo bha la/ /nor rgyun ma la 'byud ma dang / zhes dang / dpa' bo gcig grub tu mo gtso bor gsungs pa'i rgyab rten shin tu bzang la/ sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma'i bzhed pa shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan sogs mkhas pa'i yig char bkod pa lung rigs kyi sgrub byed dang 'brel chags shing / yang lugs phyi ma ni rdza la gtso bor 'dod pa'i dbang du byas pa yab yum go rim 'khrug cing sngags spyi skad dang 'brel bas lugs de 'dod phyin pho mo go bzlog ba sogs rnam par mi 'tshams pa'i mu cor smra mi dgos pa'i legs bshad/ lung dang (17ba)rigs pa 'brel ba'i mkhas pa dga' ba bskyed pa'i gnas so/ /la la dag 'dab ma'i sngags rnams dbu nang du bstan pas drag por 'gyur ro snyam na/ dbu phyir bstan la 'jam po dang nang bstan la drag bos khyab par shugs la 'gro zhing de ltar na dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi 'phrul 'khor thams cad las 'jam po 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur la/ /bram ze sdom bzang gi rlung 'khor sogs 'khor lo kha sbyar gcig gi steng nas zhi drag gnyis ka yod par 'gyur ro/ /bris zin pa dang ras shog bu lta bu la —497

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)tshon gyis bkra bar bya/ yang tshogs bdag 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud rim pa lnga pa rtsibs brgyad dang bcas pa'i lte bar hūṃ hrīḥ: mthar gug na pa ta ye dwa na pa ti sa pa ri wā ra pusti ku ru oṃ gyi mjug tu rgyas pa'i spel tshig 'dod bcol bya/ gnyis pa la oṃ badz+ra a du sha ma dza ti ga ta pe ta ā ga r+ṣa ya da na ba su ā yuḥpuṣ+ṭha snyo ku ru swāhā/ ga ga ga ga ga rnams kyi mthar spel tshig /rtsibs brgyad la ga bzhi pa la rten 'brel snying po/ lnga par bkra shis rtags brgyad 'bri/ de rjes dar ras gtsang ma'i lte ba gzhi'i steng du rin po che'i snod 'brus bkang ba'i steng du 'khor lo rnams bzhag /slob dpon lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pas sbyang gsum sngon du 'gro bas bgegs bskrad/ gu gul gyis bdugs/ 'khor lo rnams kyi bskyed chog sogs gzhud ltar byas/ 'grub na ras zhag bdun/ 'bri zhag gsum/ tha ma'ang nyin zhag gcig tsam du bsgrub grogs sam rang nyid gcig bus kyang rung ste/ 'khor lo'i (18na sngags ci mang bzlas/rten 'brel snying po'i sngags dang bcas me tog 'thor/ shis brjod dang 'od bzhu sogs rgyas par bya dgos so/ /deng sang ni 'khor lo bris grub 'phral kha sbyar nas 'jug thub pa gtso bor 'don pa ma gtogs/ 'khor lo'i rab gnas bskyed chog bsgrub pa sogs cung zad kyang mi byed pa mang du 'dug la/ lto phyir rgyal khams kun tu gzungs gzhug 'bul bar wa ltar 'khyam pa la la ni tshogs bdag 'khor lo yang mi dgos zer ro/ /de 'dra'i lag len 'chol bas rang gzhan bslu ba'i bya ba phub ma'i chu dong dag ring du spongs la blo ldan rnams bstan pa dang sems can gyi bde skyid snying la chongs la dri ma med pa'i lag len ltar gyis shig /'khor lo'i bsgrub pa thon nas/ sbrang ka ra mar gyis byug cing pad+ma lha sngags rnams ma 'dzol bar sbyar la skud pa ser pos mi mngon par rgya gram du bcings/ de nas seng khri'i nang du dar ras sogs legs par btings pa'i steng du tshogs bdag 'khor lo dbu rgyab phyogs su bstan te bzhag /de steng gnod sbyin 'khor lo sngags mgo phyir bstan la dbu rgyab dang / yang nang bstan la sku'i mdun du yong ba dang / gnyis ka pho steng mo 'og ma nor bar bzhag /sman sna/ zas sna/ 'bru sna/ rin po che/ dri bzang / sa sna/ rdo sna/ shing sna/ dar sna/ ja la sogs pa'i rigs —498

gzur gnas blo ldan ngo mtshar skyed byed gzungs 'bul gyi lag len/ 6)thams cad bum gter du bcug la 'khor lo'i steng gi dbus dang phyogs mtshams su bzhag na dngos gtsang zhing legs so/ da lta phal cher thams cad 'khor lo'i steng (18ba〉du khrog lugs su blugs pa'i sbyor ba rtsing po mang zhing de 'dra'i rigs rten gyi nang du byi ba'i tshang 'cha' ba'i thabs sha stag go /bum gter la'ang lugs mi gcig pa dang / thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa sogs rnam grangs mang bas/ khyad par shes dgos kyi/ mi shes ba'i na du rang bzo'i zobs kyis rgyal khams ma 'gengs shig/gzhan yang rten chen la seng khri'i bar steng du ja sbab rtse khrab rmog gi rin po che'i dpyad pa sogs blos dpyad de 'jug tu mi rung pa ma yin pa thams cad 'khor lo dang bum par mi gnod pa byas nas 'jog la/ /la la zas kyi rnam grangs su bsams te sha 'jug pa 'dug kyang gnod sbyin 'khor lo bya rgyud du bshad pas/ de'i rgyud sde'i don spyi ma chags pa'o/ /sngon gyi bla ma'i phyi rten 'ga' zhig na/ bla ma de kha'i lhung bzed dkar yol phor ba sder ma bzed zhal chab ril sogs nyer mkho'i chas thams cad/bum nang du bla ma'i sku 'dra la bskor nas bzhag pa'ang mthong ba/ spyir byin rlabs rten gyi dbang du byas te zhal dkar lta bu yang 'jug tu rung mod/ 'on kyang / bla ma bzhugs dus kyi rnam pa lta bu de 'dra byed pa ni/ bon lugs kyi bang so dang khyad par ma mchis pas/ chos dang bon bsre bar ma byed cig /gnyis pa dmigs bsal gyi rim pa ni/ bye brag 'byed pa dang / dge 'dun 'du ba'i 'khor lo dang /gañdzi ra'i nang gzhug 'bul lugs sogs rnam grangs mang ba sku rten dang thugs rten gyi gzungs 'bul dngos gzhi sngar bshad pas khyab na'ang / bye brag bla ma'i sku (19na tshe spru zhal bzhugs dang bstun pa'i brtan bzhugs la tshe bsgrub kyi sngags dang 'dod bcol rdzas sogs dang / zhing gzhan du gshegs pa la sngon sangs rgyas rnams kyis dam bca' mdzad pa'i gzungs dang 'dod gsol dang / yi dam 'dod lha'i rigs la yang mchog thun mong gang bsgrub kyi sngags 'khor lo 'dod gsol smon lam rgyud tshig rdzas sogs so sor dbye ba phyed pa'i gang dgos dang / thos bsam sgom pa bshad sgrub kyi bya ba gtso bor bsgrub na blo 'phel gyi gzungs 'khor lo rdzas 'dod don smon lam dang / bla ma'i gdan sal gang —48

rgyal dbang lnga pyong ga dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)stongs byung na bla ma brgyud pa dang / mi rgyud phra ba la srog shing dang / nor la dar rgud byung na nor lha'i sar nan tan dang / dmag 'brug nad mu ge bdud rigs 'dre gdon bzlog na gnyen po'i khro po dang gdugs dkar sogs kyi gzungs rdzas/ gzhan yang man ngag zab mo du ma las de dang de'i gnyen po kha 'geng dang / sgrib sbyong la rtsa rig /mi 'brugs pa thugs rje chen po sogs kyi sngags dang 'dod don smon lam gtso bor byed dgos pas lag len gyi tho tsam bris kyi/ zhib tu mthong brgyud las shes dgosashing / chos skyong gi gzungs gzhug thun mong ba yang dkyus dang mi 'dra ba'i rdzas sogs dgos kyang /da lta chos skyong gi sku la de rigs bya ba'ang dkon zhing / 'ga' zhig la thun mong ma yin pa bshad pa dag ni/ snyan brgyud ma yin pa la snyan brgyud du ming btags pa tsho dang mi 'dra bar/ grags pa don ldan gyi snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi (19bskon shes pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon gyi zhal las blang dgos kyi/ chen po 'ur rgyangs can dang / rtog ge tha snyad tsam gyis dregs pa'i mkhas rlome dang / skye ba dang gdung rabs mang po bgrangs par grags pa phal cher gyi spyod yul ma yin no/ /dge 'dun 'du ba'i 'khor lo spyir dbang gi las tshogs su 'du zhing / de yang dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang gi 'phrul 'khor las byung ba dang / klu ba'i gser chos bcu bzhi'i nang gi thun mong bsgrubs pas mchog zhan la 'byung ba dmar po skor gsum sogs/ dbang gi skor sngags gsar rnying mtha' yas pa nas 'byung ba de dag gi man ngag zhal shes rnams rang nyid kyis tshul bzhin khong du chud par bya dgos kyi/ mtha' mi mang gis bskor ba'i chos brgyad gang 'phel la 'gangs cher bzung ba'i da lta'i bstan 'dzin phal cher ni/ longs spyod dang rnyed bkur snyan grags kyi 'dod pa ni snying la zug /dka' gnad zab mo'i chos la lag len dmar khrid du bstar ba'i gdengs ni med/ grwa rigs sbyin bdag sogs kyis re ba bcas tshe blo gzur gnas shig yin na shes pa dang mi shes pa'i rgyu mtshan so sor byed kyang / dus dbang gis dam par rlom pa rnams ma bslabs pa'i kun mkhyen 'dod nas mi shes zer ba la ngo tshar byas te/ chos ma thob pa'i thob rdo mi shes pa'i shes brdzu'i rang bzo'i thob kyis gang dran zhig byas pa la stabs 'grig —500

gzur gnas blo ldan ngo mtshar skyed byed gzungs 'bul gyi lag len/ (thadagi legs pa cung zad byung na byin rlabs dang thugs rje/ nyes pa zhig byung na sngon las su ming btags te/ rang gzhan bslus shing mi shes bzhin du (20na〉las la 'jug pa ni/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug gis/ thabs byung de rgyu lkog gyur pa/ /de 'chad pa ni dka' ba yin/ zhes pa'i don thog tu babs so//shes rlom can 'ga' zhig man ngag zhib cha de 'dra rang mi dgos kyi ting nge 'dzin sogs byin rlabs gtso che'o zhes mas nyid dang ldan pa byas pa la ngo tshar 'dzin cing / tho cho'i spyod rtsing la kha phor byas te rang dang rigs mthun pa'i skad ngan 'a ta'i tshogs dbus long bas long ba 'khrid pa mkhas grub kyi mdzad par byed do/ /yang 'jigs byed kyi dbang gi 'phrul 'khor la brten pa'i dge 'dun 'du 'khor du byas pa la dbus kyi yi ge 'pho dgos pa la ma 'phos shing / kha sbyar med pa'i 'khor lo gcig rkyang sngags btum byas pa dang / 'bri tshul drag po dang 'dres pa'i nor ba chen po byed pa ni rwa lo tsā ba dang rgyal ba myong kha pa chen po la med pa'i man ngag khyad par can gcig khyod la yod 'dug pas rdo rje 'chang las kyang khyod lhag par snang ngo / /gañdzi ra la gzungs 'bul ba'i tshe 'ga' zhig sku gzugs mchod rten sgra ji bzhin pa byed pa'i lag len yod pa de bzhin byas kyang phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur zhing / ma 'grub kyang 'gal ba med la/ med du mi rung ba ni srog shing gi sngags 'god lugs sogs mchod rten dang mtshungs shing tog gi nang du de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung / rgya bod kyi bla ma tshad ldan rnams kyi byin rlabs rten gyi rigs ji snyed pa/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar gyi gzungs/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ mdo (20ba7sa 'byung ba'i bkra shis pa'i tshigs bcad lhug /gzungs bsdus nang gi mdo phran gyi rigs gang 'dzom/ sku gzugs gdung rten gyi rigs byin can/ sa rdo/ sman 'bru/ rin po che gos dar sogs legs par 'jug dgos pa yin no/ /gtsug lag khang dang rgyal po'i pho brang dang / dgon gnas grong khyer sogs la mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa dang 'tshe ba dag srung bar byed pa la gdugs dkar gyi bsrung 'khor gañdzi ra'am rgyal mtshan gyi nang du gzhug pa byin rlabs che bas de 'dri tshul ni/ 'khor lo mu khyud rim pa bcu gcig tu byas pa'i lte bar —501 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)oṃ gyi mthar/ ta bya thā/ a na le/ a na le/ bi ṣa de bi ṣa de/ be+e ra/ be+e ra ma badz+ra dha ri/ ban dha ban dha ni/ badz+ra pā ṇi phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ byu phaṭa/ ces spel tshig dang bcas pa bri/ dang por pad 'dab dmar po brgyad la gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang gdung bdun la phyag 'tshal spel tshig dang bcas pa bri/ gnyis pa la/ ta bya thā/ sarba ta thā ga to/ a sni ban dha ban dha che ge la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ cha ri ṣi ga na pra shāsta ya te nywa ga to nyi ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūṃ dzñā spel tshig can/ gsum pa la 'khor lo dkar po'i rtsibs brgyad la rim bzhin du/ rdza bha na ka rā hūṃ sa/ sto bha na ka rī hūṃ h+pho/ ma hā bi sdi 6bhak+ṣa ṇa /ri hūṃ sa/ par bi sdi saṃ bhak+ṣa ṇa ka rī hūṃ hūṃ/ sarba du pyi — ri bha ka rī hūṃ ju/ sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa gra hā 'o bi lha sa na ka rī hūṃ dzñā/ tsa tu ra shī tī / gra ha sa ha swā 'o bi lha sa na ka rī hūṃ h+pho/ a ṭ+wā ཾ bi sha tī lha na k+ṣa tru ṭ+wāṃ bra swā da na ka rī hūṃ / / a ṭ+wā ཾ / ma hā gra hā r+ṇa bi lha sa na ka rī hūṃ dzñā/ 'dod (21na skosol dang bcas bri/ /mtshan brgyad la gtum chen ma/ pad+ma'i ma' mtshan can/ 'bar chen mo/ gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ gos dkar mo/ rdo rje'i mchu/ sgrol ma/ rgyal ba'i rdo rje ma rnams kyi mthar/ sbyor ngan/ mtshon/ dus min 'chi ba/me chu/ gsod bcing / gnod sbyin srin po/ rmi lam ngan pa/ dug rnams kyi gnod pa bsrung ba'i spel tshig rgyas par bri/ bzhi pa la thams cad kyi 'go bor oṃ sbyar ba'i/ oṃ sgri ye/ asna ye/ ya mā ye/ ni ṛ ta ye/ ba ru ṇa ya/ bā ya be/ ku be ra ye/ shā na ye/ u ra dhe pra h+ma ṇa ye/ sur+ya gra ha a dhi pa ta ye/ tsan+d+ra na k+ṣa gra a dhi pa ta ye a ra dho bṛ thi sa saḥ.a su re 7zhwa ge saḥsgri ta ra tra/ be+e ru ḍa ga bi ru pa snye/ be+e shra pa ṇa ye/ me go la ye/ shi snya — nga ya/ rak+ṣa e gha ku mā ra ye/ shu tra ye/ kṛ ha pa ti/ gis war+ṇa ye/ a mṛ ta bri yā ya/ sarba na k+ṣa tra/ rā hu la zhes 'dod gsol dang bcas bri/ lnga pa la/ sangs rgyas/ chosadage 'dun/ sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ dgra bcom pa/ rgyun zhugs/ phyir 'ong / phyir mi 'ong / 'jig rten na yang dag par song ba/ yang dag par zhugs pa/ lha'i drang srong dmod pa grub pa/ rig sngags grub pa/ tshangs pa/ dbang po/ les ldan drag po dka' thub bzlog pa'i bdag po dang lhan cig pa/ legs ldan sred med kyi bu phyag rgya chen po lngas phyag byas pa/ /—502

gzur gnas blo ldan ngo mtshar skyed byed gzungs 'bul gyi lag len/ 6)legs ldan nag po chen po grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig par byed pa dur khrod gnas par mos pa ma mo'i tshogs kyis phyag (21ba)byas pa/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' brtan pa'i sde mtshon cha'i rgyal po/ 'od dpag med/ mi 'khrugs pa/ sman bla/ sa la'i dbang po me rtag kun tu rgyas pa/ shāka thub/ rin po che tog gi rgyal po/ kun bzang / rnam snang / spyan rgyas pa ut+pala'i bsung gi rtog gi rgyal po zhes pa rnams la phyag 'tshal btags te bri/ drug pa la 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bcu la/ oṃ badz+ra u sgri ṣa kro dha thams cad kyi 'go dang / ki li ka lwa ya hūṃ phaṭa thams cad kyi mjug tu sbyar ba'i bar du rim bzhin hūṃ kā ra/ bi dza ya/ ni la dan ḍa/ ya mun ta ka /ār+ya a tsa la/ ha ya gyib/ ma hā ba la/ ṭak+ki rā dza/ a mṛ ta/ tri lo kya zhes bri/ mtshan bcu la rim bzhin khro bo re re'i mtshan gyi mjug tu tshangs pa/ dri za me lha/ gshin rje/ srin po/ chu lha/ sa bdag /rlung lha/ gnod sbyin/ dbang ldan gyi gnod pa rak+ṣa zhes g.yon du bskor/ bdun pa la yig mgo nang du bstan pa 'di rnams bri/ oṃ a si ta a na lārka pra bhā sbu ga bi ka gi tā ta pa tre oṃ/ dzā la dzā la/ khā da ji da/ da ra da ra/ bi da ra bi da ra/ rten da ༷na da/ bhin+da bhin+da/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ he he phaṭa/ ho ho phaṭa/ a mo ghā ya phaṭa/ a pra ti ha tā phaṭa/ ba ra pra dwa phaṭa/ a su ra bi drwa be ka phaṭa/ sarba de be saḥphaṭa/ sarba nā ga saḥphaṭa/ sarba a su re saḥphaṭa/ sarba ma ru de saḥphaṭa/ sarba ga ru ḍa juḥ phaṭa/ sarba gan dharba saḥphaṭa/ sarba ko nā re 6 ཿphaṭa/ sarba ma ho ra ge saḥphaṭa/ sarba ya snye saḥphaṭa/ sarba rāk+ṣa se khyeḥphaṭa/ sarba pre te saḥphaṭa/ sarba (22na)pi shā tse khyeḥphaṭa/sarba bhū te saḥphaṭa/ sarba ku :ṇ+ḍi bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba pā ta ne saḥphaṭa/ sarba ka ṭa pā ta ne saḥphaṭa/ sarba skan de saḥphaṭa/ sarba ā lha de saḥphaṭa/ sarba tsū ya saḥphaṭa/ sarba a pa smu re saḥphaṭa/ sarba o stu ra ge saḥphaṭa/ sarba du rla gi te saḥphaṭa/ sarba du spre khru te khyoḥ phaṭa/ sarba dz+wa re saḥphaṭa/ sarba kri t+yā skadze ka kho rde saḥphaṭa/ ki ra ṇi be tā ḍi saḥphaṭa/ byu pre sha ka du :de dur snurnya saḥphaṭa/ sarba ti ni ke saḥphaṭa/sarba shra ma ṇi saḥphaṭa/ sarba bi sdi dha re khyeḥphaṭa/ dza ya ka ra ma dhu ka re saḥphaṭa/ sarba a the swā dha ke saḥphaṭa/ bi sdi tsa re saḥphaṭa/ tsa tung bh+yo bha gi ni ṣ+ṭhaḥphaṭa/ badz+ra ko mā rī ye saḥphaṭa/ bi sdi ra dhī te ye saḥ—503

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)phaṭa/ ma hā pra 6 gi re saḥphaṭa/ badz+ra hri kha lā ya/ bra 6 gi re rā dzā ya phaṭa/ mahā kā lā ya māX ga ṇa na ma skṛ tī ye phaṭa/ biṣ+ṭha bī ye phaṭa/ bra h+pha ṇi ye phaṭa/ asna ye phaṭa/ ma hā kā lī ye phaṭa/ bā la da: ye phaṭa/ rnyi ye phaṭa/ ro ḍi ye phaṭa/ kumā rī ye phaṭa/ bā rā hrī ye phaṭa/ tsā mun ḍi ye phaṭa/ ro di ye phaṭa/kā la rā hrī ye phaṭa/ ya ma da: ye phaṭa/ ka pā snyi ye phaṭa/ a ti mug ti shā shā na ba si ni ye phaṭa/ brgyad pa la/ gdon thams cad kyis byis pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ des 'gre'o/kun tu rgyus byas pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro mas byas pa'i/ sdu/gas bdag chen pos byas pa'i/ /sred med kyi bus byas pa'i/ nag po chen po dang ma mo'i tshogs kyis byas pa'i mi'i thod pa can gyis byas pa'i/ rgyal bar byed pa dang / sbrang (22ba〉rtser byed pa dang / don kun grub pas byas pa'i/sring mo bzhis byas pa'i/ byung gi ri ti dang / dga' byed dbang phyug dang / tshogs kyi bdag po dang lhan cig pas byas pa'/ dge sbyong gcer bus byas pa'i/ dgra bcom pas byas pa'i/ 'dod chags dang bral bas byas pa'i/ gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ zhes pa bri/ dgu pa la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nasabyung ba'i gdugs dkar po can rdo rje gtsug tor phyir bzlog pa chen mo/ phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/dbu stong / spyan bye ba brgya phyag stong / me byed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ rdo rje yangs pa chen mo sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' ba chen mo/ kun nas che ge la bsrung du gsol bsrung du gsol/ oṃ rgyal po'i 'jigs pa dang / 'gre 'o/ chom rkun gyi/ me'i/ chu'i/ dug gi /mtshon gyi/ pha rol gyi dmag tsho gos kyi/ mu ge'i/ dgra'i gnad kyi lce 'bab pa'i/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i/ sa g.yo ba'i/ skar mda' lhung ba'i/ rgyal po'i chad pa'i 'jigs pa dang / lha'i gdon dang / klu'i gdon dang / lha ma yin gyi/ rlung lha'i nam mkha'i lding gi /dri za'i/ mi 'am ci'i/ lto 'phye wo po'i/ gnod sbyin gyi/ srin po'i/yi dwags kyi/ sha za'i/ 'byung po spyi'i/ grul bum gyi/ srul po'i/ lus srul po'i/ skem byed kyi/ brjed byed kyi/ spyo byed kyi/ grib gnon gyi/ rnon po'i/ nam gru'i/ gshin rje'i/ bya'i ma mo dga' bar byed pa'i/—504

gzur gnas blo ldan ngo mtshar skyed byed gzungs 'bul gyi lag len/ 6)kun tu brel ba'i (23na)tsher ma 'don pa'i gdon rnams bzlog cig /rims nyin gcig pa dang /nyin gnyis pa dang / nyin gsum pa dang / nyin bzhi pa dang / nyin bdun pa dang / rtag pa'i rims rnams dang / rims mi zad pa rnams dang / rims ldang dub pa rnams dang / rlung las gyur pa dang / 'khrisapa las gyur pa dang / bad gan las gyur pa dag /'dus pa las gyur pa rnams bzlog cig /rimasand thams cad dang / klad pa na ba dang / gzhogs phyed na ba dang / 'gre'o/ yi ga 'chus pa dang / mig /sna/ kha/ mgul/ snying / lkog ma'i lha gor/ rna ba/ so rnyil/ rtsib logs/ rgyab/ sto/ sked pa/ chu so/brla/ rje ngar/ lag pa/ rkang pa/ yan lag /nying lag na ba rnams phyir bzlog par gyur cig /gzi brjid 'phrog pa dang / mdangs 'phrog pa dang / zas su mngal za ba dang / zas su khrag /zas su zhag /zas su sha/ zas su tshil/ zas su rkang / zas su btsas pa/ srog 'phrog pa dang / zas su skyug pa/zas su mi gtsang ba/ zas su gcin 'thung ba dang / zas su stor khung nas 'bab pa/ zas su lhag ma/zas su mchil ma/ zas su snabs/ zas su rnag /zas su phyi sa/ zas su phreng ba/ zas su dri/ zas su bdug pa/ zas su me tog /zas su gos bu/ zas su lo tog /zas su sbyin bsreg za ba rnams phyir bzlog par gyur cig /rims dang / shu ba dang / yams dang / 'brum bu phra mo dang / mdze dang / phol mig dang dbal lhogs dang / tshe dbal dang / g.yen pa dang / lhog pa dang / skom pa (23ba jing / skrag pa dang / dbyig dug dang / dug sbyar ma dang / byad dang / me dang / chu dang / mi ngas dang / dgra dang /gnod pa dang / dus mo yin par 'tsheb dang / sbrang bus ma bu ga dang /〉 la ta dang / sdig pa dang / sbrul dang / sre mong dang / seng ge dang / stag dang / dom dang / dred dang / spyang gi dang / chu srin dang / bung ba lta bus g.yin gyi srog 'phrog pa rnams bzlog par gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegasapa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can rdo rje gtsug tor phyir bzlog pa chen mo/ phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ dbu stong / spyan bye ba brgya phrag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ /mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ rdo rje yangs pa chen mo sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad ma chen mo 'dis dpag —505

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo3)tshad bcu gnyis kyi nang tshun chad du nad dang / gdon thams cad dang / gzhan gyis byas pa'i rig sngags thams cad dang / gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ /bcu pa la rten 'brel snying po dang bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rnams mgo nang du bstan pa dang / de dag gi phyogs mtshams brgyad du rdo rje brgyad bri/ bcu gcig pa la mi ri/ thams cad la so so'i tshon gyis byugs/ /spyan gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i bgegs bskrad/ gu gul gyis bdug pa/ bskyed bstim mchod bstod bsgrub pa sogs gzhung bzhin bya/ tsakra lag len ltar bltab/ dar tshon gyis rgya gram du bcings/ bsrung bya'i yul gyi khams dang bstun pa'i dar ras kyis gril te tog gi nang du 'jug /gañdzi dang rgyal mtshan la rab (24na gi nas dngos gzhi byed pa'i lugs ltar ram/ /yang na 'khor lo yod pa dang bcas gdugs dkar gyi sgrub mchod sogs dang ma 'brel kyang / pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad bris pa'i dbus su bzhag la/sbyang khrus bskyed bstim sogs gzhung bzhin byas/ /legs ldan mched gsum dang phyogs skyong rnams la gtor ma 'bul ba'i 'don cha dang bcas lag len ltar btsugs/ shis brjod rgyas par bya/ g.yin yang bshad sgrub kyi bya ba dang tshe dang bsod 'i nams rgyas pa' thabs/ byad kha bzlog pa'i thabs rimasand bsrung thabs/ yul 'khor bsrung ba la brten nas pha rol gyi dmag tshogs bzlog pa sogs/gsang sngags gsar rnying rnams las bshad pa'i man ngag zab mo ji snyed pa so so las shes dgos kyi/rgyas pa ni yi ge mangs kyis dogs 'jigs nas ma spros so/ /smras pa/ legs lam bye ba'i snang mdzod ches dkar las/ /phan bde'i zla shel 'bum du 'dzag pa yis/ /mtha' yas lus can kun+da'i nyer 'tsho'i gzhi/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag mtshan mo'i mgon po mchog /bsam bzhin zhing 'dir ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gar/ /ston mdzad rgyal ba'i yab gcig tsong kha ba'i/ /dri med ring lugs nor bu'i yu ba yis/ /rab bteg gdugs dkar 'gro 'di'i dpal du 'khor/ /bde skyid dbyar skyes ljang gzhen rgyas byed pa'i/ /rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lo'i char chen po/ /zhabrul ba'i rnyog bral ma dros chu klung las/ /nyer 'ongs legs bshad nyal 'gros phyogs kun khyab/ /mkhas (24ba)mang lugs srol ku —506

gzur gnas blo ldan ngo mtshar skyed byed gzungs 'bul gyi lag len/ 6)mu da yi tshal/ /blun po rang bzos sbyor ba'i srin bu'i me/ /dregs ldan 'byung po'i bya yi skad ga sgra/ /bstan bcos nyin byed shar tshe cig car nyams/ /tshe 'di'i snang shas khe 'dod grags pa'i ched/ /rten bzhengs gzungs 'bul rab gnas byed mang yang / /tshad ldan lag len shes pa'i rig sngags 'chang /kha ba'i ljongs 'dir nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin/ /sngon byon mkhas grub chu lha'i mngal du gzims/ /cher rlom dam par grags pa'i mun sdug 'thibs/ /thub bstan bya gzhag snang ba mi gsal ba'i/ /snyigs mas sbags pa'i dus 'dir skal ngan byas/ /gzur gnas snod ldan rin chen yol go'i nang / /bshes gnyen spe rgan tshogs kyis nyer sdugs pa'i/ /nyes bshad mi gtsang bshang gci'i phung po la/ /blun rmongs rdo rje'i rna ldan dga' bas spyod/ /stobs ldan tshogs kun zog po gtsug tu 'khrur/ khres ldan 'ga' zhig lha bu'i zhags pas bcings/ /mkhas par grags rnams blun po skyabs su bsten/ /mang du thos kyang lag tu len la rdugs/ /zas gtsang sras khyod snying stobs go cha yis/ /ma dag 'gro ba 'dren pa'i khur khyer na/ /da dung gdul dka'i skye bo mtha' klas pas/ /thugs rje'i mthu dpung skyed cig shākya'i gtso/ /de ltar bstan dang 'gro ba'i rtsa lag mchog /bsod nams zhing gi yul gyur rten mchod la/ /gzungs 'bul 'khrul pa spong ba'i lag len gyi/ /man ngag nyin mo'i snang ba khrigs su bsdebs//dge des rgyal (25na)ba'i bstan pa rgyal mtshan rtser/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs yid bzhin nor bus phyogs kun tu/ /don gnyis 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor rgyas gyur cig /ces rten la gzungs gzhug 'bul ba'i lag len gyi rim pa khrigs su bsdebs pa 'khrul spong nyin mor byed pa zhes bya ba 'di yang / ring po nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen du mas bskul ba dang / slar yang de mo sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang dge legs rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ sa dpyad brtag cing / sa dgra 'chos pa/ phyag tshad kyi zhib cha dang / sa brtag slong sogs kyi skor/ sku rgyu lag cha gzungs 'khor lo rnams kyi bskyed bstim rgyas 'debs/ mchod 'bul bsgrub pa rab gnas sogs kyi ngag 'don gyi rigs rnams zur du kha 'phangs shing / g.yin ma lag len gyi rim pa rnams/ man ngag gis brgyan —507

pas gsal zhing mtha' chod par byas nas/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba'i za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes sa mo glang gi lo chu stod kyi zla ba'i phyogs snga ma'i dga' ba dang po'i tshes la pho brang chen po po ta la'i gzims chung khams gsum zil gnon du sbyar pa'i yi ge pa ni grong smad pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i// maṅga lo//

su cha 'deb pa'i gsal byed legs tshogs lhun grub/ the)sāts+tsha 'debs pa'i gsal byed legs tshogs lhun grub bzhugs/swā sti pra dza saḥ bsams pa tsam gyis phan bde kun stsol ba'i/ /bslu med dkon mchog gsum la gus btud de/ /bsod nams rlabs chen bskrun pa sāts+tsha yi/ /'debs byed lag len rim ba gsal bar dgod/ tshogs ra du rko na/ gnas der waṃ bdag la ge' bye ṣ+ka / oṃ badz+ra kha na kha na hūṃ/ ldes brjod cing si mu sna bdun gyi sa gzhir bsams la/'og nas yang ba'i gzung sngags 'don zhing brko bar bya'o/ /de na lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong mthe chung mnan pa kha yar bstan/ g.yas pa de bzhin du byas la kha phu'i pa'i bar du 'jim pa bzhag la/ rang gang mos kyi lhar gsal༅sgo nas/ su bhā was 'jim pa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du/ sne lasa'ajim pa rin po che'i phung por bsam/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs rgyud bskul te/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung 'jim pa la thim pas de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin du gyur par ba smos la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te be+e ro tsa nā ya bra bha rā dzā ya ta thā ga tā ya a rta te saṃ myakle bud dh+wa ya/ ta bya thā/ oṃ ji ༷ / sa me sa me ye/ shārnye dwarnye/ a sa mā ro pe/ a na la:/ ta byung/ ya sho wa ti ma hā te dze/ nir kū le/ ni ri wa ṇi/ sarba bud dha/ a — na a dhiṣ+ṭha te swāhā/ zhes ga nyer gcig bzla/ 'ag pa gto (2na mi'i sngags ni/ na ma sma man+ta bud dhā — / oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ oṃ ba su dha swāhā/ 'a pi 'bi bya ༅sngags ni/ chab dzod bha wā ya swā hā/zhe brjod cing ye shes lnga'i rang bsto rgya par bsam/ snum 'byug pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ a ra dze bi ra dze swāhā/ zhes brjod cing byang chub kyi sems kun tu bzang por bsgom/ 'bi 'bi bar du 'jug pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra dha tu gar+bhe swāhā/ oṃ dharma dha tu gar+bhe swāhā/ na brjod cing thabs shes zung du sa par bsam/ brdung pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra mud ga ri a ko ṭa ya a ko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa dang / rten tshol snying po brjod cing ye shes 'a po'i ngo bor gyur par bsam/ gzung sngags sam me tog 'bul ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ sa spru bi du swāhā/ bar nas 'don pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ 0 ri ra te swāhā/ zhes brjod cing rgyu 'braspo—309

sāts+tsha 'debs pa'i gsal byed legs tshogs lhun grub/ 6)rnams brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang rten 'di la spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa rnams rten 'di 'byung ba bzhis ma zhig gi bar du brten par bzhugs nas/ bdag sogs rnams la mchog thun gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swāhā/ zhes me sto lan gsum ga sto/ slar yang sngar bsto mar bstod bya/ de nas rten 'brel snying po gang 'grub dang / phun sum tshogs pa sogs bkra shis pa'i tshigs yod ci rigs brjod par bya'o/ /rab gnas gong gi 'di mchib/ oṃ sa ta thā ga ta ma ṇi sha ta di ba te dz+wa la dz+wa la 3 rna tu skyi swā hā/sngags 'di brjod pas kyang ra btu gnas pa'i sho rdzo do/ /de ltar sāts+tsha 'debs pa'i lag len gyi/ /rim pa legasatshogs lhun 'grub ces bya 'di/ /rang gzhan mang por phan 'dod lhag bsam gyis/ /bskrun 'dod blo yi zhing sa gshin po la/ /nye char grong smad wen las rgya mtsho yis/ /bskul tshig sa bon yi ge'i drod gsher las/ /don bzang myu gu g.yur du za ba'i gos/ /stsol ba'i byed po za hor bsdo'o// maṅga lo//shing rta lor 7lnga pa chen po'i gsung par nyams gso'i skabs gsar brkos/ /
